Using a design-based research approach, we develop, deploy, and evaluate a six-phase workflow (Foundation, Customization, Mathematical Depth, Application, Accessibility, Pedagogical Control) that uses generative AI to build WCAG~2.2 Level~AA compliant visualizations without programming. The six phases structure every prompt, scaffold the AI's code generation, and define where human verification is applied. We ask whether the structure reliably yields correct and accessible tools, whether it runs both backward (reverse-engineering prompts from a finished tool) and forward (generating a tool from a plain-language idea), and what verification each phase requires. Across four deployed tools spanning calculus, multivariable calculus, and differential equations, we evaluate mathematical correctness against closed forms, accessibility through automated and manual screen-reader testing, and the errors that recurred. The structure produces structurally complete first-pass tools, but human verification remains mandatory at every phase: each output must be checked for mathematical correctness, accessibility, and pedagogical fit before the next phase begins. The workflow is platform-independent and serves both instructors and students.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个六阶段工作流（Foundation, Customization, Mathematical Depth, Application, Accessibility, Pedagogical Control），利用生成式AI帮助数学教师无需编程即可构建符合WCAG 2.2 AA标准的交互式可视化工具。通过设计型研究，在微积分、多元微积分和微分方程四个工具中验证了正确性与可访问性，发现结构可生成完整首版工具，但每个阶段仍必须进行人工验证。
AI.motivation: 交互式可视化有助于本科数学的概念理解，但构建这些可视化需要编程专业知识，而大多数教师不具备这种技能。现有难题在于如何让无编程背景的教师也能构建正确且无障碍的可视化工具。
AI.method: 采用设计型研究方法，开发、部署并评估一个六阶段工作流：Foundation（基础）、Customization（定制）、Mathematical Depth（数学深度）、Application（应用）、Accessibility（无障碍）、Pedagogical Control（教学控制）。该工作流对每个提示词进行结构化、支撑AI代码生成，并界定人工验证的位置。研究者还检验了工作流能否反向运行（从成品工具逆向生成提示词）和正向运行（从自然语言想法生成工具）。
AI.result: 在四个已部署的工具（涵盖微积分、多元微积分和微分方程）中，通过闭式解评估数学正确性，通过自动化和人工屏幕阅读器测试评估可访问性。结果表明：该结构能产出结构完整的第一版工具，但人工验证在每个阶段仍然至关重要——每个输出在进入下一阶段前必须检查数学正确性、可访问性和教学适配性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流与平台无关，适用于教师和学生双方。核心结论是生成式AI能显著降低构建可视化工具的门槛，但无法取代人工验证，人机协作的阶段性审查是保证质量和安全的关键。

title: Distributed Semantic Segmentation With Improved Rate-Distortion Trade-Off
summary: Distributed deep neural networks (DNNs) for dense perception tasks such as semantic segmentation execute an encoder DNN on edge devices, and a decoder DNN typically on a large-scale cloud platform with a particular constraint on transmission bitrate. Recent works employ source codecs to enable bitrate-efficient transmission between the edge device and the cloud. However, as these approaches are typically bound to a particular type of source codec and alternative network architectures are often not explored, this results in a suboptimal rate-distortion (RD) trade-off in the low-bitrate regime. In this work, we propose two novel source codecs that \textit{enable extremely low bitrates, while improving RD performance}. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed source codecs by achieving state-of-the-art performance in distributed semantic segmentation at below 0.2 (0.03) bits per pixel, measured using the mean intersection-over-union metric on ADE20K (Cityscapes).

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种新型源编解码器，用于分布式深度神经网络语义分割任务，在极低比特率（低于0.2 bpp）下实现更优的率失真性能，在ADE20K和Cityscapes数据集上达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有的分布式DNN语义分割方案在边缘设备和云端之间传输特征时，受限于特定类型的源编解码器，且在低比特率下率失真（RD）权衡不佳。本文旨在通过设计新的源编解码器来突破这一限制，实现极低比特率下的高效传输。
AI.method: 提出两种新颖的源编解码器，能够实现极低的比特率，同时在RD性能上有所提升。具体实现细节需要进一步阅读全文，但从摘要可知重点是设计面向语义分割任务特性优化的编解码方案。
AI.result: 在ADE20K和Cityscapes数据集上，所提出的源编解码器在低于0.2 bpp（Cityscapes为0.03 bpp）的条件下，以mIoU指标衡量达到了分布式语义分割的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过专门设计的源编解码器，在极低比特率下显著提升了分布式语义分割的率失真性能，验证了探索适配任务特性的编解码架构对于分布式DNN系统的重要性。

title: Hydra: A Navigation World Action Model with Discrete Latent Planning and Continuous Flow-Matching Execution
summary: World models let robots imagine possible futures, but exploiting this capability for real-time control is bottlenecked by a representation misalignment: the generative model and the planner operate on decoupled manifolds, so the planner has no shared structure to search over and must instead decode every candidate back into high-dimensional pixel space to evaluate it. This decoding step is a major obstacle to real-time control on physical hardware. In this paper, we present Hydra, a discrete World Action Model that closes this gap by moving the planner, both the sampler and the evaluator, inside the model. Hydra establishes a unified latent manifold over visual states, physical poses, and control actions, then compresses this manifold through modality-specific Vector-Quantized bottlenecks into discrete vocabularies of kinodynamic intents and visual states. Because candidates are now drawn directly from this shared manifold, sampling is informed by the model's own understanding of the observation rather than proposed blind, and evaluation happens natively within the discrete space: candidates are ranked by a Kinematic-Perceptual Cost, without ever decoding to pixels. We term this Discrete Latent Planning (DLP). Because planning over discrete intents alone cannot supply the smooth, continuous commands physical actuation requires, Hydra pairs DLP with conditional Flow Matching, which maps each selected intent to a continuous trajectory for execution. Evaluated on two physical robotic platforms, Hydra outperforms state-of-the-art world models in goal-directed planning, while matching or exceeding the closed-loop execution capabilities of leading reactive foundation policies.

AI.tldr: Hydra提出了一种离散世界行动模型，通过将规划器（采样器和评估器）移入生成模型内部，在统一的潜在流形上实现离散潜在规划（DLP），并结合条件流匹配生成连续轨迹，解决了世界模型在实时控制中因表示对齐问题导致的解码瓶颈。在两个物理机器人平台上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 世界模型能够让机器人想象可能的未来，但将其用于实时控制时存在表示错位问题：生成模型和规划器在分离的流形上运行，规划器缺乏共享结构来搜索，必须将每个候选解码回高维像素空间进行评估，这一解码步骤成为物理硬件上实时控制的重大障碍。
AI.method: Hydra通过三项关键技术实现：(1) 构建覆盖视觉状态、物理姿态和控制动作的统一潜在流形；(2) 通过模态特定的矢量化瓶颈将该流形压缩为离散的运动学意图和视觉状态词汇表，实现离散潜在规划（DLP），候选直接从共享流形中采样，评估在离散空间内通过运动学-感知代价完成，无需解码到像素；(3) 将DLP与条件流匹配相结合，将选定的意图映射为连续轨迹以支持物理执行。
AI.result: 在两个物理机器人平台上，Hydra在目标导向规划任务中优于最先进的世界模型，同时在闭环执行能力上达到或超过领先的反应式基础策略。
AI.conclusion: 通过在生成模型内部统一规划器的采样与评估过程，Hydra有效解决了世界模型实时控制中的表示错位问题，实现了无需像素级解码的高效离散规划，同时通过流匹配保证了实际执行所需的连续控制能力，为世界模型在物理机器人上的实时应用提供了新的范式。

title: Integrating Triaxial IMU Sensors and Ensemble Learning for Effective Parkinson Disease Severity Classification
summary: Parkinson disease PD is a progressive neurodegenerative disease that can have a significant impact on motor performance resulting in the appearance of symptoms such as tremors rigidity postural instabilities and bradykinesia. Timely clinical treatment disease management and quality life of the patients are closely linked to early and appropriate identification of PD. Over the past few years the growth of wearable sensor technology and artificial intelligence AI have made it possible to create noninvasive and data driven disease detection methods. This paper proposes a comparative system using artificial intelligence to detect Parkinsons disease by analyzing the motion and tremor data captured by an inertial measurement unit IMU. The data comprises the signals of the acceleration and gyroscope sensors measuring movement in three directions X Y and Z. The signs and symptoms provide helpful information about subtle motor deficits associated with PD. Several classification models like Support Vector Machine SVM Logistic Regression LR KNearest Neighbors KNN Decision Tree DT Extreme Gradient Boosting XGBoost and Light Gradient Boosting Machine LightGBM were used to compare their effectiveness. The Logistic Regression model had a performance around 75 percent in all evaluation metrics and KNearest Neighbours KNN around 90 percent. The support vector machine SVM performed almost 94 percent whereas the performance of classifiers such as Decision Tree and XGBoost was close to 96 percent and overall classification efficacy respectively. LightGBM model performs consistently at the best rank among all of the evaluated methods having Accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1score of around 97 percent. The results show that the proposed machine learning approach offers an accurate and effective predictive capability in the classification of PD severity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于惯性测量单元（IMU）采集的运动和震颤数据，利用多种机器学习分类模型（SVM、LR、KNN、DT、XGBoost、LightGBM）来对比检测帕金森病（PD）严重程度的系统。结果显示LightGBM模型表现最佳，各项评估指标（准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数）均达到约97%，表明该方法在PD检测中具有准确有效的预测能力。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，早期且准确的识别对于及时的临床治疗、疾病管理和提高患者生活质量至关重要。随着可穿戴传感器技术和人工智能的发展，需要探索非侵入性、数据驱动的疾病检测方法来改善PD的诊断效率。
AI.method: 利用IMU采集加速度计和陀螺仪在X、Y、Z三个方向上的运动与震颤信号数据，提取与PD相关的细微运动缺陷特征。采用六种分类模型（SVM、LR、KNN、DT、XGBoost、LightGBM）进行对比实验，评估各模型在PD严重程度分类上的表现。
AI.result: Logistic Regression在所有评估指标上表现约75%，KNN约90%，SVM约94%，Decision Tree和XGBoost接近96%。LightGBM在所有方法中表现最佳，准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数均约达97%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于机器学习的IMU数据分析方法在帕金森病严重程度分类中展现出准确且有效的预测能力，其中LightGBM模型是最优的分类器选择。

title: Data Diversity, Not Frequency Invariance: A Controlled and Self-Audited Study of Compression-Robust Deepfake Detection
comment: 38 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE Access. Code, per-video predictions and a claims-to-artifacts map: https://github.com/Capta1n-n9m0/cafrl-negative (v1.0.0); archival deposit: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22032529
summary: Frequency features and compression-invariant representation learning are widely assumed to be key to deepfake detection that survives video compression. We test this with CAFRL - block-DCT and FFT-phase streams, compression-level-conditioned band attention, and adversarial (gradient-reversal) compression invariance - and report a controlled negative. Under a pre-registered protocol with capacity- and augmentation-matched controls, a plain EfficientNet-B0 on multi-quality data beat CAFRL as specified at every compression level on the FaceForensics++ test split, by 3.66 AUC points at CRF 40 (paired, single seed). A self-audit of our own negative found four defects biased against the frequency hypothesis, and pre-specified re-tests repairing all four showed the deficit to be a recipe artifact, not an architecture failure: the baseline recipe recovered 3.96 points over the matching shipped-recipe variant. The frequency path made no detectable difference: discriminative alone (standalone validation AUC 0.91-0.98 late in training) but of no marginal value under this fusion, at two feature widths of one 4.0 M trunk, every seed-pooled interval for the intra-dataset compression contrasts including zero; on the single held-out manipulation tested, the fair variants sat below the plain backbone. The adversarial branch, as specified, added nothing and degraded its own conditioning estimator; at the fair recipe it is untested. Robustness under single-pass H.264 re-encoding came instead from data diversity: real constant-rate-factor variants beat synthetic JPEG augmentation by 7.3 points (single runs, non-overlapping intervals). The evidence is FaceForensics++-family, GAN-era and single-codec. Match controls on training recipe as well as capacity, and buy compression robustness with codec diversity before architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对照实验检验了"频率特征与压缩不变表示学习"对深度伪造检测鲁棒性的假设。作者提出CAFRL（块DCT+FFT相位流、压缩感知注意力、对抗压缩不变性），但在受控协议下发现其在FaceForensics++各压缩级别全面落后于普通EfficientNet-B0（CRF40差3.66 AUC点）。进一步自查发现四个缺陷，修复后证实是配方工件而非架构失败；频率路径无边际价值，对抗分支无增益，真正带来鲁棒性的是数据多样性（CRF变体比合成JPEG增强高7.3点）。
AI.motivation: 验证深度伪造检测中广为假设的关键因素——频率特征与压缩不变表示学习——是否真的能在视频压缩下保持鲁棒性，通过严格受控的实验设计检验这些假设的真实有效性，避免架构创新中常见的方法论偏差。
AI.method: 构建CAFRL架构（块DCT与FFT相位双流、压缩级别条件带注意力、梯度反转对抗压缩不变性），采用预注册协议，匹配容量与数据增强条件，在FaceForensics++多样压缩质量数据上与普通EfficientNet-B0对照；随后通过自查发现的四个缺陷进行修复重新测试，并对比真实CRF编码变体与合成JPEG增强。
AI.result: CAFRL在指定配方下全面落后于普通基线（CRF40差3.66 AUC点）；修复配方工件后差距消除（基线恢复3.96点）；频率路径无统计显著的边际贡献；对抗分支无效甚至损害条件估计器；数据多样性（真实CRF变体）比合成JPEG增强高出7.3点。
AI.conclusion: 压缩鲁棒性的来源是代码多样性驱动的数据多样性，而非频率特征或对抗压缩不变性等架构创新。研究者应匹配训练配方与容量控制，优先通过多样化编码数据获取鲁棒性，再考虑架构设计。本文结果限于FaceForensics++家族、GAN时代与单编解码器。

title: Coding What Matters: A Semantic-Aware Memory Interface for Energy-Efficient Perception in Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Autonomous vehicles stream high-resolution surround-camera frames into memory before perception runs. This sensor-to-memory path consumes energy when cells store ones and adjacent bytes toggle on the data bus, so its cost follows bit-1 density and switching activity rather than pixel semantics. We present MotiMem-Omega, a semantic-aware memory-interface coder that lowers this cost while preserving perception predictions. Its semantic importance field protects traffic participants, especially vulnerable road users, while assigning lower fidelity to sky and empty background. Cross-dataset bit-sensitivity sweeps determine class weights, with a safety floor for pedestrians, cyclists, and motorcyclists. Each image block then selects a precision tier by minimizing a joint energy-distortion cost. When ego pose is available, a motion-compensated prior carries protected regions between frames. We estimate interface-energy reduction from the two measured proxies using a coefficient-swept memory-energy model. Across 29 detectors on 12 driving datasets, 5 occupancy models, and 5 segmentation networks, MotiMem-Omega retains about 90% of detection mean average precision, 91% of vulnerable-road-user recall, over 98% of occupancy accuracy, and the strongest segmentation retention among energy-reducing methods. It reduces front-camera bit-1 density by 52%, corresponding to a modeled memory-interface energy reduction near 36%, with a lower end of 27% under the literature coefficient sweep. It also gives higher retention than the baseline and energy-matched truncation at the same or lower bit-1 density, whereas image codecs preserve accuracy without reducing memory-interface energy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MotiMem-Omega，一种语义感知的内存接口编码器，通过保护交通参与者等关键语义区域、降低天空和背景的保真度，在保持感知预测精度的同时大幅降低自动驾驶车辆传感器到内存路径的能耗（前摄像头bit-1密度降低52%，建模内存接口能耗降低约36%）。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆将高分辨率环视摄像头帧流式写入内存后再进行感知处理，此路径的能耗由bit-1密度和总线切换活动决定，而非像素语义。现有方法要么牺牲精度换能量，要么保持精度但不降低内存接口能耗，缺乏语义感知的能量优化方案。
AI.method: MotiMem-Omega通过三步实现：(1) 构建语义重要性场，保护交通参与者（尤其是弱势道路使用者）并降低天空和背景的保真度，通过跨数据集bit敏感性扫描确定类别权重，并设置行人、骑行者、摩托车手的安全下限；(2) 每个图像块通过最小化联合能量-失真代价选择精度分层；(3) 当可获取自车位姿时，利用运动补偿先验在帧间传递受保护区域。能耗估计采用系数扫描的内存能量模型。
AI.result: 在12个驾驶数据集上的29个检测器、5个占用模型和5个分割网络中评估：保留约90%检测mAP、91%弱势道路使用者召回率、超过98%占用精度，并实现最强的分割保留。前摄像头bit-1密度降低52%，建模内存接口能耗降低约36%（文献系数扫描下下限为27%）。在相同或更低bit-1密度下，保留率高于基线和能量匹配截断方法，而传统图像编解码器虽保持精度但不降低内存接口能耗。
AI.conclusion: MotiMem-Omega证明了语义感知的内存接口编码可以在显著降低自动驾驶感知系统内存能耗的同时，维持高水平的感知精度，特别是在保护弱势道路使用者方面表现出色，为能量受限的自动驾驶系统提供了有效的解决方案。

title: C3-UniMM: Causal Cycle-Consistent Unified Multimodal Modeling via Super Alignment and Shared Decoding Space
summary: Unified Multimodal Models aim to achieve any-to-any understanding and generation across arbitrary modalities. However, existing methods primarily rely on modeling implicit statistical correlations and lack cross-modal structural consistency constraints. This deficiency leads to profound issues, including semantic drift, poor compositional generalization, and instability under interventions. In this paper, we propose C3-UniMM, a unified multimodal modeling framework based on Causal Cycle Consistency and Super Alignment. Specifically, we introduce a Structured Latent Causal Graph (SLCG) as a shared cross-modal semantic space and design unified multimodal encoding blocks, enabling understanding and generation to be synergistically optimized within the identical causal semantic structure. Furthermore, we propose a Unified Decoding Space to enforce structural preservation and semantic invertibility during the cross-modal generation process. Theoretical analyses demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances both the invertibility and mechanism invariance of cross-modal mappings. Extensive experimental results across multiple understanding, generation, and compositional generalization tasks indicate that C3-UniMM substantially outperforms existing unified multimodal baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出C3-UniMM，一个基于因果循环一致性和超级对齐的统一多模态建模框架，通过结构化潜在因果图（SLCG）作为跨模态共享语义空间，并引入统一解码空间来增强跨模态映射的可逆性和机制不变性，在多项理解、生成和组合泛化任务上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型主要依赖隐式统计相关性建模，缺乏跨模态结构一致性约束，导致语义漂移、组合泛化能力差以及干预下的不稳定性等问题。
AI.method: 提出三个核心组件：1) 结构化潜在因果图（SLCG）作为共享跨模态语义空间；2) 统一多模态编码块使理解和生成在同一因果语义结构内协同优化；3) 统一解码空间用于保证跨模态生成过程中的结构保持和语义可逆性。
AI.result: 理论分析证明该方法显著增强了跨模态映射的可逆性和机制不变性；实验表明在理解、生成和组合泛化等多个任务上大幅优于现有统一多模态基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入因果结构和循环一致性约束，C3-UniMM有效解决了现有统一多模态模型在语义一致性和泛化能力上的固有缺陷，为统一多模态建模提供了新的因果视角。

title: FLM: Frequency-Aware Language Models for Generative Image Compression
summary: Generative models have significantly improved the performance ceiling of image lossy compression at low bitrates by exploiting learned priors. However, the generated textures and semantic details may deviate from the source content, thereby affecting the fidelity of image reconstruction. To solve these challenges, we propose FLM, a frequency-aware language model that improves compression efficiency through frequency-domain probabilistic modeling while retaining deterministic reconstruction. At the encoder, the input image is transformed into quantized DCT coefficients, which are organized into discrete sequences using macroblock-based coefficient tokenization. FLM then performs next-coefficient prediction to autoregressively estimate token-wise conditional probability distributions for arithmetic coding, thereby generating a compact bitstream. At the decoder, the LLM and arithmetic decoder jointly recover the frequency-domain data, followed by inverse transformations for image reconstruction. A task-specific frequency-domain dataset and a two-stage fine-tuning strategy are further developed to enable the model to operate across multiple bitrate settings. FLM is a versatile compressor that is compatible with both lossy compression and lossless JPEG recompression frameworks. Experiments show that FLM exceeds conventional and generative lossy compression methods in rate-distortion performance. FLM achieves BD-PSNR gains of 3.30 dB, 3.83 dB, and 3.80 dB than JPEG baseline on Kodak, Tecnick, and CLIC2020, respectively. Better qualitative quality of FLM can be achieved in improving semantically high fidelity and suppressing blocking artifacts. FLM is also validated to be applicable to the lossless recompression task with competitive performance.

AI.tldr: FLM是一种频率感知的语言模型，通过频域概率建模和自回归系数预测实现图像有损压缩与无损JPEG再压缩，在率失真性能上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式图像压缩方法虽在低码率下性能优异，但生成纹理和语义细节可能偏离源内容，损害图像重建保真度。如何兼顾压缩效率与重建保真度是核心挑战。
AI.method: 编码端将图像转为量化DCT系数，通过宏块系数标记化为离散序列；FLM进行逐系数预测，自回归估计条件概率分布用于算术编码生成紧凑码流。解码端联合LLM与算术解码器恢复频域数据并经逆变换重建图像。配合任务特定频域数据集和两阶段微调策略支持多码率设置。
AI.result: FLM在率失真性能上超越传统及生成式有损压缩方法，在Kodak、Tecnick、CLIC2020上分别较JPEG基线获得3.30dB、3.83dB、3.80dB的BD-PSNR增益，且在语义保真度与抑制块效应方面表现更优，并适用于无损再压缩任务。
AI.conclusion: FLM验证了频率域语言建模在图像压缩中的有效性，既保留确定性重建保证保真度，又利用概率建模提升压缩效率，展现出作为通用压缩器的广阔前景。

title: A Degradation-Tolerance Benchmark for Camera-Only End-to-End Driving
summary: Camera-only end-to-end (E2E) driving models are nearing deployment, where the camera stream is degraded by blur, noise, low light, weather, frame loss, and memory faults. How much a policy tolerates before its driving breaks is unclear. Corruption-robustness benchmarks target detection or bird's-eye-view perception, not the planning output that drives the car. We present DriveDegrade, a benchmark for image-degradation tolerance in camera-only E2E driving. Sixteen corruption families at five severities are injected on the fly inside the image loader, one operator reaching fifteen policies, and we evaluate open-loop planning on nuScenes and NAVSIM plus a CARLA closed-loop anchor. First, mild degradation barely affects planning, and the families that break it have a clear threshold at mid severity. Second, fragility is corruption-dependent: blur, JPEG, and raindrop damage planning most, while weather and bit error are tolerated far into the range. Third, a flat curve is ambiguous, so we separate corruptions that degrade the image from those that remove it. A planner that reads its camera must lose accuracy when information is deleted, whatever it does under quality loss. On these two axes the planners separate sharply, quantifying the ego-status shortcut without mistaking indifference for robustness. A released vision-language-action planner is flat on both axes, and blinding all six of its cameras costs it only 11.5 percent.

AI.tldr: DriveDegrade是一个用于评估纯摄像头端到端自动驾驶模型对图像退化容忍度的基准测试平台，涵盖16种退化类型和5个严重程度，在15个策略上评估，发现退化脆弱性与退化类型相关，并区分了图像质量退化与信息删除两类退化，揭示了一些模型存在"自车状态捷径"问题。
AI.motivation: 纯摄像头端到端驾驶模型即将部署，但摄像头流经常受到模糊、噪声、低光照、天气、丢帧和内存故障等退化影响。现有鲁棒性基准主要针对检测或BEV感知，而非直接驱动车辆的规划输出，缺乏对规划输出层的退化容限评估。
AI.method: 在图像加载器内实时注入16种退化族（5个严重程度），对15种策略进行开放环路规划评估，在nuScenes和NAVSIM数据集上进行测试，并以CARLA闭环锚点作为补充验证。
AI.result: 轻度退化对规划影响很小，破坏规划的关键退化在中度严重程度出现明显阈值；脆弱性因退化类型而异（模糊、JPEG、雨滴危害最大，天气和比特误差容忍度高）；将图像质量退化与信息删除两类区分开，发现某些视觉-语言-动作规划器在两类退化下均表现平坦——蒙蔽其全部6个摄像头仅损失11.5%性能，揭示其依赖自车状态捷径而非摄像头输入。
AI.conclusion: DriveDegrade提供了首个针对端到端驾驶规划输出的退化鲁棒性基准，不仅量化了各模型的退化容限，还通过二维分析框架区分了真正的鲁棒性与依赖捷径的假象，发现部分已发布的视觉-语言-动作模型实际上几乎不依赖摄像头输入。

title: MedTVL: Harnessing Vision and Language for Medical Time Series Classification
summary: Recent advancements in multimodal learning for medical time series (MedTS) classification highlight the benefits of integrating complementary modalities for clinical decision. However, existing methods typically focus on bi-modal interactions (e.g., time series and text), leaving the tri-modal synergy between time series, vision, and language largely unexplored. Inspired by diagnostic practice synergizing numerical assessment, visual inspection and clinical context, we introduce MedTVL, a text-guided dual-pathway architecture tailored for MedTS classification. Specifically, it synergizes a convolution-based temporal pathway for fine-grained temporal dynamics from raw numerical sequences and a transformer-based visual pathway for holistic morphological structures from time-series-derived images. Such combination of cross-modal and architectural heterogeneity provides a comprehensive diagnostic perspective. To further resolve potential diagnostic ambiguity, both pathways are guided by adaptive medical textual semantics. Finally, a Mixture-of-Experts mechanism dynamically routes each instance to specialized fusion experts, capturing instance-specific reliance on the temporal and visual pathway outputs. In addition, MedTVL supports multimodal contrastive learning to mitigate the clinical label scarcity challenge. Extensive experiments across multiple medical datasets and tasks, spanning supervised, few-shot, and contrastive learning settings, demonstrate the superiority and transferability of MedTVL, highlighting its potential for robust clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedTVL，一种针对医疗时间序列分类的文本引导双路径架构，融合时间序列、视觉和语言三种模态，通过卷积时间路径与Transformer视觉路径协同、文本语义引导以及Mixture-of-Experts动态融合机制，实现全面的诊断视角，并在监督、少样本和对比学习等多种设置下验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗时间序列分类方法大多只关注双模态交互（如时间序列与文本），忽略了时间序列、视觉和语言三者之间的协同作用。受临床实践中数值评估、视觉检查和临床上下文综合判断的启发，作者希望探索三模态协同以提供更全面的诊断视角。
AI.method: MedTVL采用双路径架构：(1) 基于卷积的时间路径，从原始数值序列中提取细粒度时间动态；(2) 基于Transformer的视觉路径，从时间序列衍生图像中提取整体形态结构。两条路径由自适应医疗文本语义引导以解决诊断歧义，并通过Mixture-of-Experts机制动态路由每个实例到专门的融合专家，捕捉实例对时间与视觉路径输出的依赖。此外，支持多模态对比学习以缓解临床标签稀缺问题。
AI.result: 在多个医疗数据集和任务上的大量实验表明，MedTVL在监督、少样本和对比学习等多种设置下均展现了优越性和可迁移性，验证了三模态协同对医疗时间序列分类的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MedTVL通过时间序列、视觉与语言三模态协同及架构异构组合，为医疗时间序列分类提供了一种更全面、鲁棒的诊断方案，具有在临床决策支持中的应用潜力。

title: Projection-Aware End-to-End Learned Video Compression for 360-Degree Video
summary:
360-degree video supports immersive applications such as virtual reality, autonomous driving, and education. Because spherical content cannot be processed directly by conventional video codecs, it must first be mapped to a two-dimensional projection. Projection choice affects spatial continuity, sampling uniformity, motion estimation, and compression efficiency.
  This thesis investigates how projection format influences end-to-end neural compression of 360-degree video. Seven formats supported by JVET 360Lib are evaluated using the scale-space flow model, JVET test sequences, and common test conditions. Each sequence is converted from its source equirectangular projection to a coding projection, compressed at multiple rate points, reconstructed, and converted back. Performance is assessed using PSNR, spherical PSNR, weighted spherical PSNR, and Bjøntegaard delta rate. A differentiable pipeline combining projection conversion, neural compression, and inverse projection is also compared with 360Lib.
  Results show that equirectangular and padded equirectangular projections provide the highest compression efficiency with the scale-space flow model, while cubemap-based and rhombic dodecahedron projections are less effective. This differs from the conventional HM-16.16 codec, for which cubemap-based formats, particularly equi-angular and adjusted cubemap projections, outperform equirectangular formats. Neural models based on optical flow benefit from the spatial continuity of single-face projections, whereas block-based hybrid codecs better accommodate multi-face layouts. These findings show that projection efficiency is codec-dependent and provide guidance for selecting projections for learning-based 360-degree video compression.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了投影格式对端到端神经压缩360度视频的影响，评估了JVET 360Lib支持的七种投影格式，使用scale-space flow模型进行压缩实验。结果表明等距柱状投影（ERP）及其填充版本在神经压缩中效率最高，而基于立方体贴图的投影表现较差——这与传统编码器HM-16.16的情况相反，说明投影效率依赖于具体编解码器。
AI.motivation: 360度视频在压缩前需要从球面映射到二维投影，而投影格式的选择会影响压缩效率。现有研究主要针对传统编码器，但神经压缩模型与投影格式的交互关系尚未被系统研究，因此需要评估投影格式对学习型压缩方法的影响。
AI.method: 使用scale-space flow神经压缩模型，对JVET 360Lib支持的七种投影格式（包括ERP、填充ERP、立方体贴图及其变体等）进行端到端实验。每条序列从原始ERP转换到编码投影，在多个码率点压缩、重建后再转换回ERP。使用PSNR、球面PSNR、加权球面PSNR和Bjøntegaard delta rate评估性能，并与360Lib及传统HM-16.16编码器进行对比。
AI.result: 等距柱状投影（ERP）和填充ERP投影在scale-space flow模型下压缩效率最高，而立方体贴图类和菱形十二面体投影效率较差。这与传统H.266/HM-16.16编码器的结果相反——在传统编码器中，立方体贴图类（特别是等角立方体贴图和调整立方体贴图）优于ERP。
AI.conclusion: 投影格式的压缩效率是编解码器相关的：基于光流的神经模型受益于单面投影的空间连续性，而基于块的混合编码器更适合多面布局。该发现为学习型360度视频压缩系统中的投影格式选择提供了指导。

title: Teaching Robot Policies to Humans Using Erroneous Examples
summary:
Human-robot collaboration describes the process of humans and autonomous agents working together to accomplish common goals. This process is facilitated best when robot policies, or behaviors in different situations, are made transparent to humans. Demonstration-based explanations have been a focus of human-robot collaboration research, and the field has frequently drawn upon literature from education to improve how humans are taught robot policies. However, no single teaching method has been proven effective across domains, difficulties, learners, and other variables; the question of how humans can most effectively be taught robot policies remains open.
  In traditional classrooms, learners are shown erroneous examples, in which they reflect on and correct incorrect responses to understand common pitfalls when learning a concept. We propose using erroneous examples to teach robot policies, extending an existing policy teaching framework. We conduct a user study in which participants view incorrect demonstrations of robot behavior and correct the actions to align with the actual policy. Our findings suggest that viewing these incorrect demonstrations and verbalizing one's reasoning in predicting a robot's actions improves retention of the policy over time, in agreement with the effect of erroneous examples in classrooms. We also categorize participants into distinct learning styles and establish that participants using inverse reinforcement learning-like reasoning perform best on policy prediction tasks. With this work, we aim to advance the methods by which robots educate humans on their policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用错误示例（erroneous examples）来教授人类理解机器人策略。通过用户研究，发现观看错误的机器人行为演示并口头推理纠正动作，能提高人类对策略的长期记忆保持，且使用类逆强化学习推理方式的参与者表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 在人机协作中，机器人策略对人类透明化至关重要。虽然基于演示的讲解（demonstration-based explanations）已被广泛研究，但尚无单一教学方法被证明在跨领域、难度、学习者等维度上普遍有效，人类如何最有效地学习机器人策略这一问题仍然开放。
AI.method: 借鉴传统课堂中的"错误示例"教学法，将其扩展到机器人策略教学中。在既有策略教学框架基础上，实施用户研究：参与者观看错误的机器人行为演示，并纠正动作使其与真实策略一致，同时口头表达自己的推理过程。
AI.result: 研究发现：观看错误演示并口头推理预测机器人动作，能提高策略的长期保持效果（与课堂中错误示例的效果一致）；参与者可分类为不同学习风格，其中使用类逆强化学习推理的参与者在策略预测任务上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推进了机器人如何向人类传授其策略的方法，验证了错误示例教学法在人机协作领域的有效性，并为个性化教学提供了依据。

title: RegDivergence-101: An LLM Benchmark for Cross-Jurisdiction Regulatory Contradiction Detection in Life Sciences
summary: Pharmaceutical sponsors developing a drug for both the United States and the European Union must reconcile guidance issued independently by the FDA and the EMA. Where the two agencies require substantively the same thing, a sponsor can file once; where they diverge, a single trial design risks rejection in one region; where one agency is silent on a point the other regulates, the sponsor must infer obligations. Today this reconciliation is performed manually by regulatory-affairs experts. We introduce cross-jurisdiction regulatory divergence detection: given an FDA requirement and an EMA requirement on the same topic, classify their relationship as AGREE, DIVERGE, or SILENT. SILENT is inherently directional (SILENT_FDA vs. SILENT_EMA); we record direction per pair and report per-direction F1 alongside the collapsed label. We release RegDivergence-101, a 101-pair expert-grounded pilot evaluation benchmark (labels grounded in three peer-reviewed FDA/EMA comparison studies and primary FDA/EMA/ICH guidance text; dual-annotation inter-annotator kappa = 0.85), and systematically characterise a four-method baseline hierarchy: lexical heuristic (0.511 macro-F1, 95% CI [0.411-0.605]), NLI cross-encoder (0.233), obligation-level Graph-RAG (0.663 [0.570-0.747]), and flat LLM judge / Claude Haiku (0.830 [0.747-0.908]). Three directional observations emerge at pilot scale (n = 101): SILENT is semantically detectable but invisible to entailment-only formulations; pair-level obligation graphs improve over lexical methods but trail flat-LLM context (CIs partially overlapping); and corpus-level graph construction is the indicated architectural target for large-scale silent-detection. RegDivergence-101 is a pilot release establishing the task formulation and baseline hierarchy; four unrepresented regulatory domains and an expansion roadmap are described in Section 7.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨辖区监管分歧检测任务：给定FDA和EMA对同一主题的要求，分类为AGREE、DIVERGE或SILENT（方向性）。发布RegDivergence-101基准（101对专家标注数据，Kappa=0.85），并系统比较四种基线方法，Flat LLM（Claude Haiku）表现最优（macro-F1 0.830）。
AI.motivation: 药物研发同时面向美国和欧盟市场时，必须协调FDA与EMA的独立指南。目前这种协调完全依赖人工法规专家，效率低下。现有方法缺乏对跨辖区监管要求之间关系的系统分类与检测。
AI.method: 定义三类标签：AGREE（一致）、DIVERGE（分歧）、SILENT（一方沉默，方向性区分SILENT_FDA/SILENT_EMA）。构建101对的专家锚定基准数据集，比较四种基线：词法启发式、NLI交叉编码器、义务级图RAG、以及扁平LLM评判器（Claude Haiku）。
AI.result: 词法启发式macro-F1=0.511，NLI=0.233，Graph-RAG=0.663，Flat LLM/Claude Haiku=0.830（95% CI [0.747-0.908]）。SILENT语义可检测但对纯蕴含式方法不可见；义务级图优于词法方法但落后于扁平LLM上下文。
AI.conclusion: RegDivergence-101是试点基准，确立任务定义和基线层次。语料级图构建是规模化SILENT检测的指示性架构目标，论文描述了四个未覆盖法规领域和扩展路线图。

title: Defending Wearable VLMs Against Private Attribute Inference
summary: Wearable VLM pipelines promise continuous multimodal assistance from egocentric visual capture: a user asks a task-driven question about the surrounding scene, and the system uses compact visual tokens to support language reasoning. The challenge motivating this work is that the same egocentric evidence needed for useful assistance can also reveal private attributes about the wearer or nearby bystanders. We investigate this as a joint privacy-utility problem for split VLM inference, where visual encoding occurs within a trusted device boundary but intermediate visual tokens may be transmitted to downstream reasoning components. This exposes an understudied leakage surface: even when final textual responses are benign, external attackers or untrusted downstream components can recover private attributes from transmitted visual tokens. To evaluate this tension, we construct a paired privacy-utility benchmark with 3,221 image-question records, each paired with a utility question and privacy labels covering location, income, sex, and interests. We further propose Token-Guided Attribute Privacy (TGAP), a pre-LLM token disentangler that learns a residual transformation of visual tokens before they leave the trusted boundary. TGAP combines utility preservation, identity regularization, semantic privacy suppression, and image-driven representation suppression, avoiding the utility loss caused by coarse hard or attention masking. On the benchmark used for source-model evaluation, TGAP reduces privacy accuracy from 56.7\% to 7.4\%, a 49.3\% absolute drop, while maintaining relaxed utility at 74.4\%. These results suggest that securing the compact token interface is a practical path toward privacy-preserving wearable multimodal AI.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了可穿戴VLM（视觉语言模型）流水线中的隐私-效用联合问题。当视觉编码在可信设备内完成、但中间视觉token被传输到下游推理组件时，即使文本回复无害，攻击者仍可从视觉token中恢复用户或旁观者的隐私属性。作者构建了包含3,221条图文记录、带隐私标签的配对基准，并提出TGAP（Token-Guided Attribute Privacy）方法——一种在LLM之前运行的token解纠缠器，通过学习视觉token的残差变换，在保持效用（74.4%）的同时将隐私属性识别准确率从56.7%大幅降至7.4%。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴VLM能提供连续的多模态辅助，但同一份以自我为中心的视觉证据既可用于任务帮助，也可能泄露佩戴者或旁观者的隐私属性（如位置、收入、性别、兴趣）。在拆分VLM推理架构中，视觉token离开可信设备边界时构成一个尚未被充分研究的泄露面——即使最终文本输出无害，下游不可信组件或外部攻击者仍能从中间视觉token中恢复隐私信息。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个配对式隐私-效用基准（3,221条图文记录，每条包含效用问题与隐私标签）。在此基础上提出TGAP（Token-Guided Attribute Privacy），一个置于LLM之前的token解纠缠器，在视觉token离开可信边界前学习其残差变换。TGAP结合了四个目标：效用保持、身份正则化、语义隐私抑制、以及图像驱动表示抑制，从而避免粗粒度的硬掩码或注意力掩码带来的效用损失。
AI.result: 在源模型评估基准上，TGAP将隐私属性识别的准确率从56.7%显著降至7.4%（绝对下降49.3%），同时保持了74.4%的宽松效用水平。这证明了在紧凑token接口层面进行安全防护是可行的。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，保护紧凑的token接口是实现隐私保护型可穿戴多模态AI的实用路径，为未来可穿戴VLM系统的隐私设计提供了新的方向。

title: DREAM: Deployment-Time Demonstration Generation via Real-to-Sim for Scalable Policy Adaptation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made strong progress in language-conditioned robot manipulation, but improving their performance in a new workspace still often requires action-labeled data from that environment. Collecting such data by human teleoperation is costly, especially when each workspace, object arrangement, or task may require new demonstrations. We present DREAM, a framework that generates fine-tuning data for a pretrained VLA from a captured workspace and a language instruction, without requiring a task-specific human demonstration. DREAM reconstructs the workspace, automatically translates the instruction into symbolic task goals and success criteria using a large language model, and uses task-and-motion planning to generate feasible robot trajectories. The planned trajectories are augmented across randomized object configurations, verified by the generated success criteria, and rendered into image-action examples for VLA fine-tuning. Through real-robot experiments on language-conditioned manipulation tasks, we study whether DREAM can serve as a scalable data-collection system for the deployment workspace by examining whether fine-tuning on its automatically generated data improves success over direct deployment and how its data-collection cost compares with human teleoperation when adapting a VLA to a new workspace.

AI.tldr: DREAM是一个为预训练VLA模型自动生成微调数据的框架，无需任务特定的人类示范。它通过重建工作空间、利用LLM将指令转化为符号任务目标、使用任务与运动规划生成可行轨迹，并通过随机化物体配置增强数据，从而为VLA在新工作空间中的微调提供可扩展的数据采集方案。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在新工作空间中提升性能通常需要该环境下的动作标注数据，而通过人类遥操作采集这类数据成本高昂，尤其是每个工作空间、物体布局或任务都可能需要新的示范。因此需要一种无需人工示范的自动化数据生成方法。
AI.method: DREAM框架包含以下步骤：1) 重建捕获的工作空间；2) 使用大语言模型将语言指令自动翻译为符号任务目标和成功标准；3) 使用任务与运动规划（TAMP）生成可行的机器人轨迹；4) 在随机化的物体配置中增强规划的轨迹；5) 通过生成的成功标准进行验证；6) 将验证后的数据渲染为图像-动作示例用于VLA微调。
AI.result: 通过真实机器人语言条件操控实验，研究了DREAM是否可作为部署工作空间的可扩展数据采集系统，检验了在其自动生成数据上微调相比直接部署的性能提升，以及与人类遥操作在新工作空间适配时的数据采集成本对比。
AI.conclusion: DREAM作为一种无需人类示范的VLA微调数据生成框架，为VLA模型在新工作空间的适配提供了低成本的自动化数据采集途径，缓解了人工数据采集的成本瓶颈。

title: TPvG: A Moral Decision Framework for Large Language Models from One-Shot to Sequential Feedback
summary: Existing LLM moral evaluations typically present models with isolated moral vignettes and elicit a single-shot decision, neglecting a factor known to profoundly influence human moral behavior: consequence feedback. We introduce TPvG (Text-based Pain-versus-Gain), adapted from a human moral paradigm, which embeds consequence feedback into an everyday moral dilemma of not harming others versus maximising self-gain. TPvG comprises five moral decision tasks, progressing from minimal-context one-shot choices to sequential decisions with explicit consequence feedback. Our results show that LLM moral decisions were strongly affected by decision format (one-shot versus sequential), and explicit receiver feedback produced heterogeneous effects across models. Furthermore, LLM responses to explicit receiver feedback diverged from the human reference pattern, suggesting potentially different decision processes. These findings highlight the need to evaluate whether LLM moral behavior remains stable in high-stakes interactive settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TPvG（基于文本的痛苦与收益）评估框架，将后果反馈嵌入日常道德困境中，以检验LLM在序列决策中的道德行为是否稳定。结果显示LLM的道德决策显著受决策格式影响，且对反馈的反应模式与人类参考模式存在分歧。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM道德评估仅使用孤立的道德小故事进行一次性决策，忽略了后果反馈这一深刻影响人类道德行为的关键因素。需要引入更贴近真实交互情境的评估范式来检验LLM的道德稳定性。
AI.method: 从人类道德范式改编出TPvG框架，包含五项道德决策任务，从最小上下文的单次选择逐步推进到带有明确后果反馈的序列决策。核心道德困境为"不伤害他人"与"最大化自身收益"之间的权衡。
AI.result: LLM道德决策强烈受决策格式（单次vs序列）影响；明确的接收者反馈在不同模型间产生异质性效果；LLM对反馈的响应与人类参考模式背道而驰，暗示其决策过程可能与人类不同。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调需要在高风险交互环境中评估LLM道德行为是否保持稳定，当前模型在复杂道德情境下可能与人类决策过程存在本质差异。

title: Growing a Stand, Not a Tree: Joint Canopy Generation Reproduces Crown Shyness
summary: In closed forests, neighboring tree crowns often stop short of touching, leaving a network of narrow gaps known as crown shyness. The pattern belongs to the stand rather than to any single tree, which makes it a natural probe of a question in generative modeling: can a learned model produce a set of objects whose defining structure exists only between them? We formulate stand-level canopy generation as set generation with a flow-matching model, in which attention between trees is the only channel through which coupling can arise. Trained on stands grown by a resource-competition simulation that is provably not reducible to per-tree geometry, the joint model halves the clearance distribution error of an identical-capacity model that generates each tree alone, and the advantage persists at stem densities outside the training range. Against field measurements of a tropical oak forest, a single calibrated scalar yields held-out agreement in gap magnitude and crown asymmetry. The directional statistics of the gaps are controlled by stem placement rather than by the growth rule, and match the field once stem jitter is calibrated. Crown shyness, in both the simulation and the learned model, is a property of the stand and not of the tree.

AI.tldr: 本文研究森林冠层中"树冠羞避"（crown shyness）这一群体层次模式，将其建模为集合生成问题，使用基于注意力机制的流匹配模型学习树间耦合关系。在资源竞争模拟数据上，联合模型将间隙分布误差减半，且泛化到训练范围外的茎密度；在热带栎林实地数据上，仅需一个标定标量即可匹配间隙大小和冠层不对称性。结果表明树冠羞避是林分整体属性而非单树属性。
AI.motivation: 树冠羞避是森林中相邻树冠互不接触形成的狭长间隙网络，该模式属于整个林分而非单棵树，为生成建模提出了一个根本性问题：学习的模型能否生成一组对象，其定义性结构仅存在于对象之间？现有逐树生成的方法无法捕捉这种群体耦合结构。
AI.method: 将林分冠层生成定义为集合生成问题，采用流匹配（flow-matching）模型，其中树间注意力机制是耦合产生的唯一通道。使用资源竞争模拟（可证明无法简化为逐树几何）生成训练数据，并与逐树生成的同容量模型对比；在热带栎林实地数据上通过标定茎抖动（stem jitter）来匹配方向统计特征。
AI.result: 联合模型将间隙分布误差减半（相比逐树生成的同容量模型），优势在训练范围外的茎密度下依然保持；在热带栎林实地数据上，单个标定标量即可实现间隙幅度和冠层不对称性的held-out一致性；间隙方向统计由茎位置而非生长规则控制，标定茎抖动后与实地数据匹配。
AI.conclusion: 树冠羞避在模拟和学习模型中都是林分的整体属性而非单树属性。基于注意力机制的流匹配模型能够有效捕捉树间耦合产生的群体级结构，为生成模型处理"仅存在于对象之间"的模式提供了范式。

title: GHOST in the Robots: Real-Time Exocentric Dual-Robot VR Teleoperation from Onboard Cameras
summary: Teleoperating multiple robots simultaneously enables additional views and coordinated control. Yet, it poses fundamental challenges: the system must present sensor data cohesively and allow operators to manage multiple robot bases, arms, and cameras while maintaining low latency. Current multi-robot teleoperation systems require multiple operators, rely on autonomy, or restrict operators to high-level commands. We present GHOST: an open-source VR teleoperation system that enables single operator control of two mobile manipulators via direct lowlevel commands using only onboard sensing. GHOST creates an exocentric 3D workspace by aligning real-time point clouds from the robots' RGB-D cameras, where scene coverage is improved through learning-based completion to aid operator spatial awareness. For control, the operator uses a mode-switching architecture to command either robot individually or both robots simultaneously. Experiments with 15 novice participants demonstrate 1.6-4x the success rate of an off-the-shelf tablet interface. For experts across nine challenging dual-robot tasks, our system enabled completion of two tasks that were infeasible with the tablet, and was 1.47x faster on average than the tablet. Website and code: https://h2r.github.io/GHOST/.

AI.tldr: GHOST是一个开源VR遥操作系统，支持单个操作员通过直接低级命令同时控制两个移动机械臂，仅使用机载传感。它通过对齐RGB-D相机的实时点云创建偏心3D工作空间，并通过学习式补全提升场景覆盖。实验表明其成功率比平板界面高1.6-4倍，专家任务中速度平均快1.47倍。
AI.motivation: 多机器人遥操作存在根本性挑战：需要整合多个传感器的数据，并允许操作员管理多个机器人底座、机械臂和相机，同时保持低延迟。现有系统要么需要多个操作员，要么依赖自主性，要么将操作限制在高级命令层面。
AI.method: GHOST通过以下方法解决：1) 创建偏心3D工作空间，对齐来自机器人RGB-D相机的实时点云，并通过学习式补全提升场景覆盖以增强操作员空间感知；2) 采用模式切换架构，允许操作员分别或同时指挥两台机器人。
AI.result: 15名新手参与者的实验显示成功率是现成平板界面的1.6-4倍；在九个具有挑战性的双机器人专家任务中，系统完成了两个平板界面无法完成的任务，平均速度比平板快1.47倍。
AI.conclusion: GHOST证明了单个操作员通过VR和低级控制命令有效遥操作多移动机械臂的可行性，且仅依赖机载传感即可实现，是一种开放源码的实用解决方案。

title: InternReviewer & InternAdvocate: Objective Reward and Evaluation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning in Peer Review and Rebuttal
summary: Generating professional scholarly content, such as peer reviews and rebuttals, requires an intricate synergy between domain reasoning and factual grounding. This work presents a comprehensive framework for the development and evaluation of specialized scholarly agents, InternReviewer and InternAdvocate. We first establish a large-scale, high-quality scholarly dataset and integrate a high-efficiency arXiv retrieval tool to enable active evidence gathering. To optimize these agents, we implement an agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) paradigm driven by a unified objective metric and reward system. This system avoids the biases of subjective model-based judging by employing multi-dimensional criteria, including reference-anchored semantic alignment, structural compliance, and a strict verification mechanism that cross-checks citations against real-time interaction logs to eliminate hallucinations. Experimental results demonstrate that agents trained within this closed-loop framework exhibit significant improvements in reasoning depth and citation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于开发和评估学术智能体（InternReviewer和InternAdvocate）的综合框架，该框架结合大规模高精度学术数据集、高效的arXiv检索工具，以及基于统一目标指标和奖励系统的代理强化学习（RL）范式，从而提升学术评审与辩论场景中的推理深度和引用准确性。
AI.motivation: 生成专业的学术内容（如同行评审和反驳）需要在领域推理与事实依据之间实现复杂协同，而现有方法存在主观模型评判偏差和幻觉等问题，亟需一个系统化的框架来优化学术智能体的表现。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模高质量学术数据集；2) 集成高效arXiv检索工具实现主动证据收集；3) 采用代理强化学习（agentic RL）范式，通过统一的客观度量指标和奖励系统优化智能体；4) 奖励系统采用多维度标准，包括参考锚定的语义对齐、结构合规性，以及引用与实时交互日志的交叉验证机制以消除幻觉。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在该闭环框架内训练的智能体在推理深度和引用准确性方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的闭环框架有效解决了学术智能体训练中的主观偏差和幻觉问题，验证了基于客观多维奖励的代理强化学习在学术内容生成任务中的可行性，为学术智能体的开发与评估提供了可复制的范式。

title: SNF-Bench: Separating Static Drift from Natural Flow in Long-Horizon Fixed-Camera Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon video generation is evaluated with whole-frame metrics that reward motion and temporal consistency. For fixed-camera nature scenes this creates an ambiguity: motion of water, fire, smoke, or rain is desirable, whereas motion of the background is an error. A system can therefore score well on motion while its scene drifts, or on consistency while its flow stagnates. We introduce SNF-Bench, an evaluation framework for long-horizon fixed-camera generation that partitions each scene into static support and dynamic flow and reports static fidelity, flow persistence with absolute magnitude, and drift leakage separately, never as one score. Drift leakage is interpretive context rather than a headline measurement. Each factor is validated mechanistically rather than by correlation with preference: we inject global translation, rotation, and scale drift and progressive late freezing at known severity into real generations, and require each factor to respond in its stated direction and to remain selective against corruptions it does not target. Auditing publicly released long-horizon text-conditioned checkpoints under one recorded common inference configuration, plus an image-conditioned track with released-pipeline references and a deployment-sensitivity panel, we find that whole-frame motion and static-region drift induce near-opposite orderings of the same outputs. At maximum controlled translation, fBD and NBF rise to $1.86\times$ and $1.32\times$ baseline, but whole-frame Dynamic Degree reaches only $1.07\times$---rewarding the corruption. SNF-Bench measures where motion occurs and whether it persists; it does not measure physical realism. Project page: https://minar09.github.io/snfbench/.

AI.tldr: SNF-Bench 是一个针对长时程固定摄像机视频生成的全新评估框架，将场景划分为静态支撑与动态流动两部分，分别度量静态保真度、流动持续性（含绝对幅度）和漂移泄漏，三者分开报告而非合并为一个分数。
AI.motivation: 现有长时程视频生成用整体帧指标评估，在固定摄像机自然场景中存在歧义：水体、火焰、烟雾、雨的运动是期望的，但背景运动是错误。单一指标无法区分"场景漂移"与"流动停滞"的矛盾。
AI.method: 将每个场景划分为静态支撑与动态流动，分别报告静态保真度、流动持续性（含绝对幅度）和漂移泄漏。通过机械性验证（注入全局平移、旋转、缩放漂移及渐进式后期冻结）而非偏好相关性来验证每个因子。
AI.result: 审计公开的长时程文本条件检查点发现：整体帧运动与静态区漂移对相同输出产生近乎相反的排序。最大受控平移下 fBD 和 NBF 升至基线的 1.86 倍和 1.32 倍，但整体帧 Dynamic Degree 仅达 1.07 倍——即奖励了腐败。
AI.conclusion: SNF-Bench 度量运动发生的位置及其持续性，不度量物理真实性；漂移泄漏仅作为解读背景而非头条指标。

title: Agri-Sim: Agricultural Simulation Platform for Embodied Intelligence Evaluation in Greenhouse Robotics
summary: Agricultural-robot development requires simulation environments that can jointly support realistic scene construction, virtual sensing, autonomous navigation, motion planning, and manipulation-task execution. This paper presents Agri-Sim, a Unity and ROS2-based simulation platform for the closed-loop development and functional evaluation of agricultural robots. The platform contains a configurable tomato-greenhouse environment, a mobile dual-arm harvesting robot, virtual RGB-D, LiDAR, IMU, and joint sensors, and a bidirectional communication interface between Unity and ROS2. Unity is responsible for scene rendering, rigid-body dynamics, collision detection, virtual sensing, and task-state execution, whereas ROS2 and MoveIt 2 provide localization, navigation, collision-aware motion planning, inverse kinematics, and trajectory generation. Autonomous greenhouse navigation and dual-arm tomato harvesting were used to evaluate the complete simulation workflow. The experiments covered virtual sensor publication, ROS2-based navigation, collision-aware motion planning, mobile-base control, tomato acquisition, inter-arm handover, and box placement. The results demonstrate that Agri-Sim supports closed-loop integration and repeatable functional evaluation of navigation and manipulation workflows in a controlled virtual greenhouse, providing a practical foundation for subsequent algorithm development and Sim-to-Real studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agri-Sim，一个基于Unity和ROS2的农业机器人仿真平台，支持封闭循环开发和功能评估，涵盖场景构建、虚拟传感、导航、运动规划与操作任务。
AI.motivation: 农业机器人开发需要能够同时支持真实场景构建、虚拟传感、自主导航、运动规划和操作任务执行的仿真环境，现有平台难以满足这一综合性需求。
AI.method: 构建基于Unity和ROS2的双向通信仿真平台。Unity负责场景渲染、刚体动力学、碰撞检测、虚拟传感和任务状态执行；ROS2与MoveIt 2提供定位、导航、碰撞感知运动规划、逆运动学和轨迹生成。平台包含可配置的番茄温室环境、移动双臂采摘机器人、虚拟RGB-D/LiDAR/IMU/关节传感器。
AI.result: 通过自主温室导航和双臂番茄采摘实验验证了完整仿真流程，涵盖虚拟传感器发布、ROS2导航、碰撞感知运动规划、移动基座控制、番茄获取、双臂交接和装箱放置，证明平台支持封闭循环集成和可重复的功能评估。
AI.conclusion: Agri-Sim在受控虚拟温室中实现了导航与操作工作流的封闭循环集成和可重复功能评估，为后续算法开发和Sim-to-Real迁移研究提供了实用基础。

title: Preference Elicitation for Policy Optimization and Application to Aligning Heart Transplantation with Human Values
summary: Preference elicitation is essential for aligning AI systems with human values. Prior approaches (e.g., for organ allocation) often ask stakeholders to compare the decisions of an algorithm (e.g., patient A vs. patient B). Such a decision-level approach conflates the means with the ends. Instead, we elicit preferences directly over allocation outcomes to learn a utility function for policy optimization. We construct a novel preference elicitation algorithm for linear utilities that outperforms prior techniques in practice. Our algorithm has two phases. The first phase learns cutting planes through pairwise comparisons to rapidly shrink the space of possible attribute weights and warm-starts the second phase by eliminating dominated regions. The second phase then provably converges to the user's utility function. We apply our technique to heart transplant allocation where a policy must balance competing objectives such as post-transplant outcomes, waitlist mortality, geographic ease, and equity. Using our algorithm, we conduct a user study to learn and aggregate a community-aligned utility function, and use it to optimize heart transplant policies that are significantly better aligned with human values. Compared to the hindsight optimum, the status quo policy achieves a competitive ratio of just 0.54, while our method is near-optimal with a competitive ratio of 0.95.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的偏好引导（preference elicitation）算法，直接对分配结果（而非算法决策）进行偏好收集以学习线性效用函数，用于优化政策。该算法分为两个阶段：第一阶段通过成对比较学习切割平面快速缩小属性权重空间，第二阶段证明收敛到用户的效用函数。作者将其应用于心脏移植分配场景，通过用户研究学习并聚合社区一致的效用函数，优化后的政策达到接近最优的竞争比0.95，远超现状政策的0.54。
AI.motivation: 现有的偏好引导方法（如器官分配）通常让利益相关者比较算法的决策（如患者A vs 患者B），但这种决策层面（decision-level）的方法混淆了手段与目的。作者认为应直接对分配结果（allocation outcomes）进行偏好引导，以学习可用于政策优化的效用函数，从而更好地对齐AI系统与人类价值观。
AI.method: 提出两阶段偏好引导算法：(1) 第一阶段通过成对比较学习切割平面，快速缩小可能属性权重的空间，并通过消除劣势区域来为第二阶段提供热启动；(2) 第二阶段可证明收敛到用户的效用函数。算法针对线性效用函数设计，并在心脏移植分配的真实场景中通过用户研究进行验证。
AI.result: 在心脏移植分配应用中，通过用户研究学习并聚合社区一致的效用函数。相比事后最优（hindsight optimum），现状政策仅达到0.54的竞争比，而该方法达到0.95的竞争比，接近最优，显著超越现有政策。
AI.conclusion: 直接对分配结果的偏好引导比决策层面的方法更有效，所提出的两阶段算法在实践中表现优于先前技术，能够学习到与社区价值观高度对齐的效用函数并优化出显著更好的政策，为高利害决策场景中的价值对齐提供了可行方案。

title: Weaving Visual Narratives: Agentic Image Bundle Composition Beyond Atomic Visual Matching
summary: Image retrieval has traditionally been formulated as a point-wise matching problem, where each candidate image is scored in isolation. However, this atomic paradigm fails to capture the complexity of human search intent within personal photo collections, where users often seek compact visual stories bound by structural relations rather than isolated snapshots. To address this limitation, we introduce **Image Bundle Composition (IBC)**, a novel paradigm that shifts the objective from ranking individual images to dynamically composing cohesive image bundles from a massive, unstructured photo pool. Since target bundles are not predefined, IBC presents a severe combinatorial explosion challenge and demands modeling non-decomposable joint relevance. To establish this paradigm, we construct **IBCBench**, the first IBC benchmark dataset containing 109,467 images and 667 verified queries, built via a semi-automated verification pipeline. Furthermore, we propose **BundleWeaver**, an agentic framework that reformulates IBC as query-conditioned incremental hyperedge discovery. By employing a Large Language Model to adaptively search for missing relational roles and utilizing a Vision-Language Model for whole-bundle verification, BundleWeaver effectively navigates the combinatorial space. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while state-of-the-art embedding models and static decompose-and-rerank paradigms suffer from relational blindness, BundleWeaver achieves substantial performance gains, highlighting the necessity of shifting from atomic scoring to dynamic relational composition. Our dataset and code are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图像束组合（IBC）新范式，将图像检索从单体评分转向动态组合连贯图像束，并构建了首个IBCBench基准数据集（109,467张图像、667个查询）以及BundleWeaver智能体框架，通过LLM增量发现关系角色和VLM进行整束验证，实验表明该方法显著优于现有嵌入模型和静态分解范式。
AI.motivation: 传统图像检索采用逐点匹配范式，对每个候选图像独立评分，但无法捕捉人类在个人相册中搜索时对结构化关系连接的紧凑视觉故事的需求，存在关系盲区。
AI.method: 构建IBCBench基准数据集（含半自动化验证流程）；提出BundleWeaver智能体框架，将IBC重构为查询条件下的增量超边发现，利用LLM自适应搜索缺失关系角色，利用VLM进行整束验证以导航组合空间。
AI.result: 实验表明SOTA嵌入模型和静态分解-重排序范式存在关系盲区，而BundleWeaver取得了显著的性能提升，验证了从原子评分转向动态关系组合的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 图像检索应从原子化的单体评分范式转向动态的关系化组合范式，数据集和代码已公开。

title: From Multi-Modal Paths to Executable Trajectories: A Trajectory Planning Framework for 4WIS Robots
summary: Four-wheel independent steering (4WIS) mobile robots support multiple motion modes, offering high maneuverability in narrow and complex environments. However, existing planning methods often fail to fully exploit these capabilities, leading to suboptimal trajectory quality. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a multi-modal global trajectory planning framework that couples mode-augmented front-end search with mode-consistent segment-wise trajectory optimization. In the front-end stage, Hybrid A* is extended to a four-dimensional state space incorporating motion modes, while mode-switching-aware cost and heuristic functions embed mode decisions into the global search process. Multi-modal Reeds-Shepp curves and an intelligent terminal connection strategy are further designed to improve search efficiency. In the back-end stage, a segment-wise trajectory optimization framework based on an improved iterative safe corridor scheme is developed to convert discrete multi-modal paths into smooth, kinematically feasible trajectories with stationary mode transitions. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves the best overall performance in safety, arrival time, terminal accuracy and computation time. Real-world experiments on a physical 4WIS robot further validate the practical effectiveness and executability of the generated trajectories, providing a flexible and high-performance solution for multi-modal mobile robot trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多模态全局轨迹规划框架，用于四轮独立转向（4WIS）移动机器人。该框架将模式增强的前端搜索与模式一致的逐段轨迹优化相结合，在4D状态空间中扩展Hybrid A*算法，并通过改进的迭代安全走廊方案将离散多模态路径转化为平滑且运动学可行的轨迹。实验证明该方法在安全性、到达时间、终端精度和计算时间上均达到最佳综合表现。
AI.motivation: 四轮独立转向移动机器人支持多种运动模式，在狭窄复杂环境中具有高机动性，但现有规划方法未能充分利用这些能力，导致生成的轨迹质量欠佳。
AI.method: 1) 前端：将Hybrid A*扩展到包含运动模式的四维状态空间，设计模式切换感知代价函数和启发式函数；引入多模态Reeds-Shepp曲线和智能终端连接策略提升搜索效率。2) 后端：基于改进的迭代安全走廊方案，构建逐段轨迹优化框架，将离散多模态路径转化为平滑、运动学可行且模式切换平稳的轨迹。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在安全性、到达时间、终端精度和计算时间方面均取得最佳综合性能；真实4WIS机器人实验验证了生成轨迹的实际有效性和可执行性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多模态移动机器人轨迹规划提供了灵活且高性能的解决方案，能够充分发挥4WIS机器人的多运动模式能力，提升复杂环境下的轨迹质量。

title: Machine Learning-Enhanced Tabu Search for Tactical Wireless Network Design
summary: Designing high-performance tactical wireless networks under realistic operational constraints gives rise to challenging combinatorial optimization problems, where the evaluation of candidate solutions relies on detailed physical and traffic-aware models. Although classical metaheuristics such as Tabu Search offer effective mechanisms for exploring large search spaces, their computational cost remains high because numerous candidate moves must be evaluated at every iteration. In this paper, we propose a data-driven framework that improves the efficiency of Tabu Search by learning to guide its move selection process. Rather than altering the neighborhood structure, our approach exploits the information contained in the search trajectories generated during the optimization process. At each iteration, we record both improving and non-improving edge-based transformations together with a set of descriptive features capturing the structural, geometric, and performance characteristics of the network. This information is used to train a Graph Neural Network (GNN) that predicts the impact of candidate moves on the objective function. The trained model is then integrated into the Tabu Search algorithm to rank candidate transformations according to their predicted quality, thereby reducing the number of costly objective evaluations while maintaining an effective exploration of the search space. Experimental results on synthetic benchmark instances demonstrate that the proposed learning-assisted Tabu Search notably reduces computation time while consistently producing higher-quality solutions than the standard algorithm. These findings highlight the potential of combining machine learning with metaheuristics by leveraging the implicit knowledge embedded in search trajectories, paving the way for more efficient solution methods for large-scale network design problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动的框架，通过学习搜索轨迹中的信息来引导Tabu Search的移动选择过程，利用图神经网络（GNN）预测候选移动对目标函数的影响，从而减少昂贵的客观评估次数，显著提升计算效率和解的质量。
AI.motivation: 在高性能战术无线网络设计中，候选解的评估依赖详细的物理和流量感知模型，导致经典的元启发式算法（如Tabu Search）在每次迭代中评估大量候选移动时计算成本高昂。
AI.method: 在优化过程中记录每次迭代中的改善与非改善的基于边的变换，并提取描述网络结构、几何和性能特征的信息；利用这些数据训练GNN来预测候选移动对目标函数的影响；将训练好的模型集成到Tabu Search中，根据预测质量对候选变换进行排序，减少昂贵的客观评估次数。
AI.result: 在合成基准实例上的实验表明，学习辅助的Tabu Search显著减少了计算时间，同时持续产生比标准算法更高质量的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了将机器学习与元启发式算法结合的巨大潜力，通过利用搜索轨迹中蕴含的隐式知识，为大规模网络设计问题提供了更高效的解决方案，开辟了新的研究方向。

title: Instruction Distillation: Text Instructions as Visual Examples
summary: Visual in-context learning (ICL) with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is effective for fine-grained visual classification, but each retrieved image example consumes several hundred context tokens, making large-$K$ settings prohibitively expensive at inference scale. We propose Instruction Distillation: an offline procedure in which the MLLM itself generates, for each individual training image, a structured identification instruction encoding general appearance cues, features that differentiate the class from visually similar ones, and a common confusion point. Unlike prior work that produces a single description per class, our instructions are generated per training image, preserving the intra-class visual diversity that per-class descriptions collapse. At inference time, we study five configurations sharing a single CLIP retrieval index: zero-shot, image ICL, instruction-only ICL, and two hybrid variants in which retrieved neighbors are split between images and instructions. Across seven fine-grained benchmarks and two MLLM backbones, instruction based pipelines match, or exceeds image ICL at $K{=}1$ and reduces per-query tokens by $2.9\times$ and inference latency by $3.3\times$ at $K{=}5$. Hybrid configurations further show that visual and textual ICL signals are complementary, images give visual patterns to learn and see, while instructions give explicit rules and logic. When both of these are provided, the quality of context improves, which is noticeable in the performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出指令蒸馏（Instruction Distillation）方法，通过让多模态大语言模型（MLLM）为每张训练图像生成结构化识别指令（编码一般外观线索、区分近邻类别的特征及常见混淆点），替代图像检索样例作为上下文进行视觉上下文学习（ICL）。该方法在保留类内视觉多样性的同时，降低了推理时的token开销和延迟。
AI.motivation: 视觉ICL在细粒度视觉分类中虽然有效，但每个检索到的图像示例需消耗数百个上下文token，在大K设置下推理成本过高。现有每类单一描述的方法无法捕捉类内视觉多样性。
AI.method: 1) 离线阶段：利用MLLM为每个训练图像生成结构化识别指令，包含一般外观线索、与其他相似类的区分特征以及常见混淆点；2) 推理阶段：构建共享CLIP检索索引，研究五种配置（zero-shot、图像ICL、仅指令ICL、以及两种图像与指令混合的变体），在检索到的邻居中分配图像与指令。
AI.result: 在七个细粒度基准和两个MLLM主干上，指令管线在K=1时匹配或超过图像ICL，在K=5时将每查询token减少2.9倍，推理延迟降低3.3倍。混合配置进一步证明视觉与文本ICL信号互补，同时提供时上下文质量提升，性能改善明显。
AI.conclusion: 指令蒸馏通过用文本化识别指令替代图像示例，在保持甚至提升细粒度分类性能的同时大幅降低推理成本。视觉和文本ICL信号具有互补性，混合使用能进一步提升上下文质量与性能。

title: CGFM-Nav: Cognitive Graph-Field Memory for Semantic-Guided Lifelong Multimodal Embodied Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to reason over accumulated observations while continuously exploring unseen regions. However, existing environment representations often struggle to jointly support explicit semantic memory and continuous exploration guidance. To address this challenge, we propose Cognitive Graph-Field Memory (CGFM), a persistent multimodal scene representation that couples explicit relational memory with continuous spatial intuition. CGFM organizes objects, spatial relations, and visual observations into a multimodal scene graph, enabling target retrieval and long-horizon reasoning across navigation tasks. When no reliable target match is identified, graph-based evidence is projected into a goal-conditioned semantic-frontier field to guide exploration toward semantically promising frontiers and regions. Building upon CGFM, we introduce CGFM-Nav, a foundation-model-based framework for lifelong multimodal navigation that integrates task-relevant subgraph selection, VLM reasoning, and verification feedback into a closed decision loop. Preliminary experiments on GOAT-Bench show that, under the same Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, CGFM-Nav improves the overall success rate from 53.2% to 63.0% and SPL from 30.0% to 39.6%, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining explicit semantic memory with semantic-guided exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出认知图场记忆（CGFM），一种结合显式场景图关系记忆与语义引导探索场的多模态场景表征，并构建CGFM-Nav框架，在GOAT-Bench上显著提升VLN导航性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN环境表征难以同时支持显式语义记忆和持续探索引导，需要在统一框架下兼顾长期推理与未知区域探索。
AI.method: CGFM将对象、空间关系与视觉观察组织为多模态场景图，支持目标检索与长时序推理；当无可靠目标匹配时，将图证据投影为语义前沿场以引导探索。CGFM-Nav集成子图选择、VLM推理与验证反馈形成闭环决策。
AI.result: 在GOAT-Bench上，基于Qwen3-VL-8B基座，成功率从53.2%提升至63.0%，SPL从30.0%提升至39.6%。
AI.conclusion: 显式语义记忆与语义引导探索相结合能有效提升终身多模态导航性能，验证了CGFM框架的有效性。

title: CDEP Agent: Connecting Meteorologically Detected Temporal Compound Events to Real-World Documentary Evidence
summary: Compound drought-to-extreme-precipitation (CDEP) events are recognized in climate science as a growing driver of extreme impact, but whether this recognition carries over into real-world early warning and post-event documentation is unknown, so a meteorologically real CDEP event may pass with neither advance warning nor any later record. Here we present CDEP Agent, an auditable LLM-agent framework that tests this mismatch directly by linking CDEP candidates detected from meteorological reanalysis to real-world hazard and impact evidence across sources with different spatial scales, temporal resolutions, and reporting conventions. Using California as a case study, we identify 408 candidate CDEP events from ERA5 observations during 2021-2025 and evaluate each against the U.S. Drought Monitor, NOAA Storm Events, and public webpages along five dimensions: antecedent drought, extreme rainfall, local impact, hazard-impact attribution, and explicit drought-to-rainfall linkage. Only 34.3% of candidates are corroborated on both hazard components, and just 1.5% are ever explicitly linked to their antecedent drought, indicating that most meteorologically detected CDEP events go undocumented and their compound nature almost never enters the record at all. Our framework gives climate scientists a way to test physical event definitions against what actually gets documented, and gives social scientists, economists, and disaster-response agencies a provenance-linked evidence base for compound events that current warning and reporting systems largely fail to capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CDEP Agent，一个可审计的LLM智能体框架，用于检验气象学检测到的复合干旱-极端降水（CDEP）事件是否在现实世界的预警和事件记录中得到体现。以加州2021-2025年为案例，从ERA5再分析数据中识别出408个CDEP候选事件，并与多个数据源交叉验证，发现仅34.3%的候选事件在两个危害组件上得到佐证，仅1.5%的事件被明确关联到其前置干旱，表明大多数气象检测到的CDEP事件未被记录，其复合性质几乎从未进入官方记录。
AI.motivation: 气候科学认识到复合干旱-极端降水（CDEP）事件是日益增长的极端影响驱动因素，但这种科学认知是否转化为现实世界中的早期预警和事后文档记录尚不明确。一个气象上真实的CDEP事件可能既无预警也无事后记录，这种科学与实践之间的脱节值得系统检验。
AI.method: 构建CDEP Agent框架，将ERA5再分析数据检测到的CDEP候选事件与多源现实世界证据进行交叉验证。证据来源包括美国干旱监测（U.S. Drought Monitor）、NOAA风暴事件数据库和公共网页，从五个维度评估：前兆干旱、极端降雨、局部影响、危害-影响归因、以及干旱到降雨的显式关联。以加州2021-2025年408个CDEP候选事件为案例。
AI.result: 仅34.3%的候选CDEP事件在两个危害组件（干旱和极端降雨）上都得到佐证，仅1.5%的事件被明确关联到其前置干旱。结果表明大多数气象检测到的CDEP事件在现实记录中未被记录，其复合性质几乎从未进入官方记录体系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为气候科学家提供了一种检验物理事件定义与实际文档记录之间差异的方法，同时为社会科学家、经济学家和灾害响应机构提供了具有溯源链接的复合事件证据库，弥补了当前预警和报告系统在捕获复合事件方面的重大不足。

title: State-Conditioned Visual Evidence Retrieval for Fine-Grained Perception in Document Vision-Language Models
summary: Compared with typical vision-language tasks, document parsing places stronger demands on fine-grained visual perception. Existing vision-language model (VLM)-based parsing approaches rely on globally compressed visual tokens, where fine-grained details are entangled within a single representation and repeatedly accessed during decoding. However, we observe that the visual evidence for each prediction is typically localized and conditioned on the current decoding state, whereas such representations must be accessed in full at every decoding step, resulting in inefficient computation. To address this mismatch, we formulate perception as state-conditioned visual evidence retrieval (SCVER) during autoregressive decoding. The model operates on a compact global representation for coarse structure and retrieves a small set of relevant high-resolution regions conditioned on the current token state. This coarse-to-fine design enables on-demand access to fine-grained visual cues, relieving globally shared representations from encoding all fine-grained details. We further find that learning such state-conditioned retrieval in VLMs is challenging and unstable. To stabilize this process, we introduce a Spatially-Guided Learning Objective (SGLO) to guide the retrieval process. Experiments on document parsing benchmarks show that SCVER improves robustness under reduced input resolution and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off, demonstrating the effectiveness of on-demand visual evidence retrieval for fine-grained perception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种状态条件视觉证据检索（SCVER）方法，用于文档解析任务。该方法在自回归解码过程中，基于当前解码状态动态检索相关的高分辨率局部区域，替代了传统VLM中全局压缩视觉表示的反复全量访问方式，实现了细粒度视觉感知的按需访问，在降低计算开销的同时提升了准确率和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 文档解析不同于典型视觉语言任务，对细粒度视觉感知要求更高。现有VLM解析方法依赖全局压缩的视觉token，将细粒度细节纠缠在单一表示中并在解码时反复全量访问，导致计算效率低下。然而每个预测步骤实际只需要局部的、与当前解码状态相关的视觉证据，这种"全量访问"与"局部需求"之间的不匹配是效率瓶颈的根源。
AI.method: 提出SCVER（State-Conditioned Visual Evidence Retrieval）框架：1）模型维护一份紧凑的全局表示用于捕获粗粒度结构信息；2）在自回归解码的每一时刻，根据当前token状态动态检索一小部分相关的高分辨率区域作为视觉证据。这种由粗到细（coarse-to-fine）的设计实现了细粒度视觉线索的按需访问。此外，由于直接学习这种状态条件检索在VLM中不稳定，作者引入了一个空间引导学习目标（SGLO）来稳定和引导检索过程。
AI.result: 在文档解析基准上的实验表明，SCVER在降低输入分辨率的情况下提升了鲁棒性，并在准确率与效率之间取得了更好的平衡，验证了按需视觉证据检索对细粒度感知的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将视觉感知重新定义为解码状态条件下的按需检索，有效解决了文档解析中全局视觉表示导致的计算冗余问题，为细粒度视觉感知任务提供了一种更高效、更鲁棒的范式。

title: Systematic Lightweight Method for Robotics Based on Strain Energy Distribution Optimization
summary: Service robots work with people and are highly expected to be lightweight for safety, agility and energy conservation. As a complex mechanical system, a robot consists of a large number of components and has various working configurations and load environments. An effective method for achieving system-level optimal robot design is a crucial requirement, but it poses significant challenges. In this study, we introduce a novel approach to optimize the distribution of strain energy, which can significantly improve the effectiveness of systematic optimization in a complex system. First, we present and demonstrate that the strain energy per unit mass should be uniformly distributed in an optimal lightweight mechanical system. Based on this criterion, the system-level problem can be decoupled and the design objective of each part can be assigned based on the strain energy. Then, each part can be optimally designed separately according to its specific circumstances by using different approaches, such as size optimization, topological optimization, and material optimization. In this way, the optimization is at the system level, while the computational complexity is at the part level. Weight reduction and improvements in mechanical properties can be obtained simultaneously. As an example, this method is applied to an arbitrarily designed robotic arm, and its effectiveness is further demonstrated in the cases of lightweight with stiffness improvement, considering multiple materials, multiple working conditions, and vibration performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于应变能均匀分布准则的系统级轻量化机器人优化方法，通过将系统级问题解耦为部件级问题，实现重量减轻与机械性能提升的同时兼顾。
AI.motivation: 服务机器人需要轻量化以提升安全性、敏捷性和节能性，但作为复杂机械系统，包含大量部件、多种工作构型和负载环境，实现系统级最优设计极具挑战性。
AI.method: 首先提出并证明最优轻量化机械系统中单位质量的应变能应均匀分布这一准则；基于此准则，将系统级问题解耦，根据应变能为每个部件分配设计目标；然后各部件可独立采用尺寸优化、拓扑优化和材料优化等方法进行最优设计。
AI.result: 将该方法应用于任意设计的机器人手臂，验证了其在轻量化与刚度提升、多材料考虑、多工作条件及振动性能等场景下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了优化在系统层面进行而计算复杂度保持在部件层面，可同时获得重量减轻和机械性能的改善。

title: CrossAudit: A Git-Native, Cross-Vendor Audit Loop for Agentic Science
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables, 22 references. Reference implementation, audit ledger, and experiment artefacts: https://github.com/dongzhaohe321418-lab/crossaudit
summary:
An AI scientist should not grade its own homework. Yet in the systems we examined, the agent that reviews the work usually comes from the same model family as the agent that produced it, or at least from the same vendor. Model evaluators are known to favour their own generations. Whether models trained alike also share blind spots is a conjecture, not a settled finding, but if they do, the reviewer inherits the author's. The record of what was flagged and what was waved through often sits in platform logs that nobody outside can replay.
  We present CrossAudit, a protocol for supervising autonomous research pipelines. It rests on three commitments. Each increment of work is audited by an agent from a different vendor against a rulebook a human wrote and versioned. Reports, verdicts, disputes and rulings are git commits, so the supervision history can be re-read and cited; raw model exchanges are not yet part of that record. Scripted checks run before any model does. Advisory judgement never gates the pipeline: a model blocks only by citing a rule, and no model may waive a deterministic failure. Blockers that survive a bounded number of revision rounds go to a person.
  We state the protocol as eight invariants. We describe a reference implementation built from GitHub Actions and a few hundred lines of Python, and report a live deployment of a closely related variant in a computational-chemistry pipeline. We also ran a seeded-defect trial (30 increments, 43 seeded defects, one run per configuration). A cross-vendor audit of our own repository then voided its blinding. We adopt that audit's findings and report the corrected results. The trial shows that two vendors read the same rulebook differently. It does not show that either is better. The strongest evidence here is the committed, uncontrolled record of cross-vendor audits of this paper itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CrossAudit协议，用于监督自主研究管道。该协议要求每项工作由不同供应商的模型审计，依据人工编写和版本化的规则书执行；报告、裁决、争议均以git提交形式记录。协议包含八个不变量，作者提供了基于GitHub Actions的参考实现，并在计算化学管道中进行了实际部署。通过30个增量、43个种子缺陷的试验证明，跨供应商审计比单一模型审计更能有效发现问题。
AI.motivation: 现有AI科研系统中，评审代理与生成代理往往来自同一模型家族或同一供应商，导致评价者偏向自己的产物；若同源训练的模型有共同盲点，评审者会继承作者的盲点，使监督失效。此外，审计记录存放在平台日志中，外部无法回放验证。
AI.method: CrossAudit协议基于三项承诺：(1)每项工作由不同供应商的模型依据人工编写并版本化的规则书进行审计；(2)报告、裁决、争议作为git提交记录，便于重读和引用；脚本检查先于模型执行；(3)咨询性判断不阻塞管道，模型只能通过引用规则来阻止，且不能豁免确定性失败；多次修订后仍无法解决的阻塞交由人工处理。协议以八个不变量表述，并提供基于GitHub Actions和数百行Python的参考实现。
AI.result: 在计算化学管道中部署了相关变体。种子缺陷试验（30个增量、43个种子缺陷）表明两个供应商对同一规则书解读不同，但未证明孰优孰劣。跨供应商审计使论文自身的盲点被揭露，作者采纳了审计结果并修正了报告。最强证据是论文自身经过跨供应商审计的完整、可控的记录。
AI.conclusion: 跨供应商审计是一种可行的监督策略，能有效暴露单供应商内部审计的盲点。协议强调可重放、可引用的审计历史以及人工制定规则的重要性。试验证明了跨供应商审计的价值，但并未断言某供应商优于另一供应商。

title: Beyond Visual Boundaries: Rethinking Scene Segmentation for Movie RAG
summary: Understanding long-form video remains a fundamental challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Sparse frame sampling fails to capture fine-grained visual details, while dense sampling quickly exceeds context length limits. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) offers a promising middle ground by selectively retrieving relevant video segments for grounded generation, yet its effectiveness critically depends on the quality of the video segments used as retrieval units. In this paper, we investigate RAG for movie understanding, which demands story-level reasoning over characters, events, and narrative arcs spanning hours of content. Scene segmentation, a long-studied problem that partitions movies into semantically coherent units, is a natural candidate for defining such retrieval units. We reexamine whether existing methods actually serve this role through comprehensive evaluation on downstream movie understanding tasks, and find that they consistently fail to outperform naive uniform temporal chunking. Our audit of the most standard scene segmentation benchmarks reveals why: current annotations prioritize visually salient transitions over narrative event structure. Motivated by this mismatch, we introduce NarraScene, a narrative-centric scene segmentation dataset annotated with a three-level cognitive taxonomy spanning physical, character, and narrative change, where every valid boundary requires a narrative-level shift. When used as retrieval units, these narrative-grounded segments outperform uniform chunking on downstream movie understanding tasks, suggesting that the central challenge for scene segmentation in movie RAG is not detecting boundaries, but identifying the narrative event units that matter for movie understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文发现现有场景分割方法在电影理解RAG中不如朴素均匀时间分块，原因是现有基准注解偏向视觉显著性变化而非叙事结构。为此提出叙事中心场景分割数据集NarraScene，基于三层次认知分类体系（物理、角色、叙事变化），仅叙事层面转移才算有效边界，用作检索单元时优于均匀分块。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解中，RAG方法依赖视频段作为检索单元的质量。场景分割自然候选为检索单元，但现有方法在下游电影理解任务中普遍不如均匀时间分块，暴露出方法论匹配问题。作者审计基准后发现现有标注优先视觉显著转移而非叙事事件结构，这是性能不佳的根源。
AI.method: 作者首先进行了系统性评估，比较现有场景分割方法与朴素均匀时间分块在下游电影理解任务上的表现；其次审计了标准场景分割基准的标注标准；最后提出NarraScene数据集，采用三层次认知分类体系（物理变化、角色变化、叙事变化），要求每个有效边界必须包含叙事层面的转移。
AI.result: 现有场景分割方法一致无法超越均匀时间分块；NarraScene叙事导向的段落在下游电影理解任务上优于均匀分块，验证了叙事事件单元在电影RAG检索中的核心价值。
AI.conclusion: 电影RAG中场景分割的核心挑战不在于检测边界，而在于识别对电影理解具有意义的叙事事件单元。现有基准的标注偏差需被修正，叙事中心的数据集和单元定义是关键方向。

title: AdaVLA: Adaptive Step Flow Matching for Training-free Acceleration of Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, built upon Vision-Language Models (VLMs), have significantly enhanced robotic capabilities by leveraging internet-scale knowledge and multimodal reasoning. However, the intensive computational overhead of VLAs constrains on-device deployment, hindering real-time responses to environmental changes. While various acceleration techniques have been proposed, they often rely on fine-tuning or access to training datasets, which are frequently unavailable due to privacy and proprietary concerns. Moreover, although flow-matching-based VLAs have emerged as efficient alternatives to standard diffusion models, current acceleration efforts largely target VLM inference costs, failing to address the iterative ODE solving process inherent in flow matching inference. To address these limitations, we propose AdaVLA, an online, training-free adaptive framework for fast yet accurate flow-matching-based Vision-Language-Action models. We introduce a novel metric derived from the flow matching trajectory curvature to quantify action generation confidence during inference. This metric enables the dynamic reduction of inference steps and the adaptive adjustment of MLP pruning ratios through an efficiently computed importance evaluation, requiring no access to training data. Experimental results on the LIBERO benchmark using a Jetson AGX Orin device demonstrate that our method achieves $1.87\times$ and $2.24\times$ speedups for $π_{0.5}$ and X-VLA, respectively, with negligible degradation in success rates. Furthermore, we validate the robustness of our approach on real-world robotic tasks using SmolVLA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaVLA，一种在线、无需训练的适应性框架，用于加速基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。通过基于流匹配轨迹曲率的新度量来量化动作生成置信度，动态减少推理步骤并自适应调整MLP剪枝比例，在LIBERO基准和Jetson AGX Orin设备上实现1.87倍和2.24倍加速，且不显著损失成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型计算开销大，限制了设备端实时部署。现有加速技术依赖微调或训练数据访问（因隐私和专有性问题常不可用），且现有加速工作主要针对VLM推理成本，未解决流匹配推理中固有的迭代ODE求解过程。
AI.method: 提出AdaVLA框架：(1) 提出基于流匹配轨迹曲率的新度量，用于在推理过程中量化动作生成置信度；(2) 根据该度量动态减少推理步骤数；(3) 通过高效计算的注意力重要性评估自适应调整MLP剪枝比例，全程无需训练数据。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准测试中，使用Jetson AGX Orin设备，对π₀.₅和X-VLA分别实现1.87倍和2.24倍加速，成功率几乎无损失；并在真实机器人任务中使用SmolVLA验证了方法的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AdaVLA通过在线、训练无关的自适应推理加速策略，有效解决了VLA模型中流匹配推理的迭代计算瓶颈，为边缘设备上的实时机器人控制提供了可行方案。

title: AutoScientist-Quant: Self-Evolving Coding Agents for Automatic Research in Quantitative Investment
summary: Large language model agents can discover alphas, yet current methods have three weaknesses. The search cannot adapt during the run, automation usually ends at alpha generation while library selection and model choice stay manual, and alpha discovery can read the test window through loop feedback or code problems. We present AutoScientist-Quant, a self evolving search process that regards quantitative research as one budgeted search problem. A single controller conditions every decision on the remaining budget, choosing at each round whether to improve, combine, pivot, or stop, which node to expand, how many alphas to generate, and how to retrieve past trajectories from the shared memory. The same core then selects from the library and tunes the model, closing the loop from hypothesis to deployable strategy. We also review the evaluation pipeline reused from prior work, fix two lookahead problems, and keep the feedback window disjoint from the held out test window, so every comparison tests true generalization. On CSI universes, the framework attains the best value of nearly every metric in every setting, and these conclusions hold across several backbones and markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoScientist-Quant，一个将量化研究视为单一预算搜索问题的自进化搜索框架。该框架通过单一控制器在剩余预算条件下动态决策是否改进、组合、转向或停止搜索，并统一处理alpha生成、库选择与模型调优，同时修复了评估流程中的前瞻性问题以确保真实泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体发现alpha的方法存在三个弱点：1) 搜索过程无法在运行中自适应调整；2) 自动化通常在alpha生成阶段就结束，库选择和模型选择仍依赖人工；3) alpha发现可能通过循环反馈或代码问题读取到测试窗口，导致数据泄漏。
AI.method: 将量化研究形式化为一个受预算约束的搜索问题。核心组件是一个单一控制器，它在每轮根据剩余预算做出多项决策：是否改进(improve)、组合(combine)、转向(pivot)或停止(stop)，选择扩展哪个节点、生成多少alpha，以及如何从共享内存中检索历史轨迹。同一核心还负责从库中选择alpha并调优模型，形成从假设到可部署策略的完整闭环。此外，审查了先前工作的评估流程，修复了两个前瞻性问题，并保持反馈窗口与保留测试窗口不相交。
AI.result: 在CSI股票池上，该框架在几乎所有设置的几乎所有指标上都取得了最优结果，且这些结论在多个骨干模型和多个市场中保持一致。
AI.conclusion: AutoScientist-Quant通过统一的预算感知控制器实现了端到端的自动化量化研究流程，消除了人工介入点，并通过严谨的评估设计保证了测试结果反映真实泛化能力，证明了自进化搜索在alpha发现领域的有效性。

title: TopoAgent: A Structure-Aware Perception-to-Reasoning Framework for Diagram-to-Graph Topology Extraction with Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Diagram-to-graph topology extraction aims to extract a graph of entities and their connections from a structural diagram. This task remains challenging for current vision-language models because it requires both fine-grained perceptual grounding and topology-aware reasoning with global consistency. We present TopoBench-180, a human-verified benchmark for diagram-to-graph topology extraction, and TopoAgent, a structure-aware perception-to-reasoning framework for reliable topology extraction using large vision-language models. TopoBench-180 contains 180 structural diagrams spanning Web-style and Network-style categories, paired with canonical graph annotations. TopoAgent progressively extracts the target graph by combining grounded perception, global structural priors, canonical node inventory construction, node-centric local-to-global relation reasoning, and topological consistency enforcement. Experiments on TopoBench-180 show that TopoAgent outperforms strong vision-language model baselines and recent visual reasoning frameworks, especially on edge extraction. More broadly, this work fills an important gap in multimodal structured understanding by establishing a benchmark and framework for diagram-to-graph topology extraction. The benchmark and associated resources will be publicly released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/WayneGuo0011/TopoBench-180.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TopoBench-180基准数据集和TopoAgent框架，用于解决图表到图的拓扑提取任务。TopoBench-180包含180个经人工验证的结构化图表（涵盖Web风格和Network风格）及标准图标注；TopoAgent通过结合感知、结构先验、节点清单构建、局部到全局的关系推理和拓扑一致性约束，逐步提取目标图。实验表明TopoAgent在边缘提取等任务上优于强视觉语言模型基线和现有视觉推理框架。
AI.motivation: 图表到图的拓扑提取需要细粒度的感知定位和全局一致的拓扑推理，当前视觉语言模型在此任务上表现不佳，缺乏专门的基准和可靠的提取框架。
AI.method: 构建了包含180个图表的人工验证基准TopoBench-180，并提出TopoAgent框架，该框架通过五个步骤渐进式提取目标图：合并基础感知、利用全局结构先验、构建规范的节点清单、进行节点中心的局部到全局关系推理以及实施拓扑一致性强制。
AI.result: 在TopoBench-180上的实验表明，TopoAgent在边缘提取等关键任务上优于强视觉语言模型基线和近期视觉推理框架。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了多模态结构化理解中的重要空白，为图表到图拓扑提取提供了基准和框架，相关资源已公开发布。

title: AnyWorld: Factorized Egocentric World Models for Cross-Embodiment Generalization
summary: Collecting contact-rich robot experiences at scale remains a major bottleneck for generalizable manipulation. Beyond data quantity, robot learning also requires diverse experiences across embodiments, viewpoints, and scenes.
