Human egocentric videos provide abundant physical interactions, but each video captures only a narrow slice of experience under a single body, camera trajectory, and environment. We propose AnyWorld, a cross-embodiment world modeling framework that expands a single human interaction into diverse robot-native rollouts without paired human-robot demonstrations. Our model factorizes an interaction into action, camera, and embodiment: action controls capture the motion structure, camera controls specify viewpoint evolution, and the target embodiment context defines the acting body and its interaction geometry. This formulation enables independent recomposition of embodiment, viewpoint, and scene factors, allowing a single model to generate many robot-domain experiences while preserving the underlying dynamics and object interactions. We train the model with large-scale human interaction pretraining followed by mixed-embodiment fine-tuning. Experiments show that our model supports controllable recomposition across embodiments, viewpoints, and scenes, and we further demonstrate that the generated data can improve manipulation performance on the RoboCasa GR1 tabletop benchmark and a real IRON humanoid robot. Beyond aggregate gains, we test whether unpaired human experience can be recomposed into robot-native video-action pairs that target a policy gap. Controlled IRON interventions correct a spurious completion prior and establish language-grounded spatial target selection; an action-only counterfactual intervention fails to learn the latter reliably, showing that both action calibration and visual recomposition are necessary.

AI.tldr: AnyWorld是一个跨本体的世界建模框架，通过将人类交互分解为动作、相机和本体三个独立因子，将单个人类交互视频重组合成为多样化的机器人原生交互数据，无需配对的人类-机器人演示。该模型通过大规模人类交互预训练和混合本体微调，支持跨本体、视角和场景的可控重组合，实验表明生成数据能提升RoboCasa GR1和真实IRON人形机器人的操作性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习面临接触丰富数据收集的瓶颈，需要跨本体、视角和场景的多样化经验。人类第一人称视频蕴含丰富的物理交互信息，但单个视频只覆盖狭窄的经验切片（单一身体、相机轨迹和环境），难以直接用于机器人学习。
AI.method: 提出AnyWorld框架，将交互分解为三个因子：动作控制（捕捉运动结构）、相机控制（指定视角演化）、目标本体上下文（定义执行身体及其交互几何）。该因子化公式支持本体、视角和场景因子的独立重组合，使单一模型能够生成大量机器人域数据同时保留底层动力学和物体交互。训练流程包括大规模人类交互预训练和混合本体微调。
AI.result: 模型支持跨本体、视角和场景的可控重组合；生成数据在RoboCasa GR1桌面基准和真实IRON人形机器人上提升操作性能。对照实验显示，可控干预能修正虚假完成先验并建立语言引导的空间目标选择；仅动作反事实干预无法可靠学习后者，证明动作校准和视觉重组合缺一不可。
AI.conclusion: AnyWorld证明单个人类交互可以扩展为多样化的机器人原生交互数据，且生成的视频-动作对能针对性弥补策略缺陷。该工作的关键发现是动作校准与视觉重组合均为必要条件，为无配对跨域数据利用提供了有效方案。

title: AI Scientist Mission Control (AIMC): Visual Analytics for Human Oversight of Autonomous Scientific Discovery
summary: Autonomous scientific discovery systems can generate large numbers of research ideas, experiments, and manuscripts with minimal human intervention. As these systems become increasingly capable, scientists require effective mechanisms to monitor output quality, identify recurring failure modes, understand research evolution, and prioritize promising discoveries for review. We present AIMC, a visual analytics framework for human oversight of autonomous scientific discovery. AIMC combines semantic embeddings, automated weakness extraction, temporal analysis, and interactive visualizations to support the exploration of AI-generated research artifacts. We demonstrate the framework through a case study of the papers generated by an autonomous AI Scientist (FARS), together with their associated review feedback. Our analysis reveals recurring methodological weaknesses, evolving research themes, domain-specific differences in quality, and a small set of highly novel papers that warrant deeper human inspection. These findings illustrate how visual analytics can support transparency, diagnosis, and human AI collaboration in emerging autonomous scientific discovery workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIMC，一个用于人类监督自主科学发现系统的可视化分析框架。它将语义嵌入、自动弱点提取、时间分析和交互式可视化相结合，通过FARS自主AI科学家生成的论文案例研究，揭示重复的方法论弱点、演进的研究主题、领域质量差异和高新颖性论文，支持人类对AI生成研究产物的监督、诊断和人机协作。
AI.motivation: 自主科学发现系统能在极少人工干预下生成大量研究想法、实验和手稿，但随着这些系统能力的增强，科学家需要有效的机制来监控输出质量、识别重复失败模式、理解研究演进，并优先审查有前景的发现。现有方法缺乏对这些AI生成研究产物的系统性可视化分析支持。
AI.method: AIMC框架结合语义嵌入（semantic embeddings）、自动化弱点提取（automated weakness extraction）、时间分析（temporal analysis）和交互式可视化（interactive visualizations），并通过对FARS自主AI科学家生成的论文及其评审反馈进行案例研究来验证框架。
AI.result: 案例分析揭示了重复出现的方法论弱点、演进中的研究主题、领域特定的质量差异，以及一小部分值得人类深入检查的高新颖性论文。这些发现证明了可视化分析在自主科学发现工作流中支持透明度、诊断和人机协作的有效性。
AI.conclusion: AIMC展示了可视化分析如何支持自主科学发现过程中的人类监督，为新兴的自动化科研工作流提供了透明度、诊断和人机协作的实践路径。

title: Stochastic Liquid Deformation Fields: An SDE Generalisation of Closed-Form Continuous-Time Cells for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting (D-3DGS) reconstructs dynamic scenes by deforming a canonical set of 3D Gaussians through a deformation field of frame time. Replacing its MLP with a stack of Closed-form Continuous-time (CfC) cells-a Liquid Neural Network that solves the Liquid Timeconstant ODE in closed form-gives the field continuous-time behaviour at feed-forward cost. That closed form, however, is only the deterministic limit of a noise-driven system, and drops the stochastic term usually credited for the robustness of liquid networks. We put it back: a small Gaussian perturbation is added to the time gate of every CfC cell, turning the deterministic field into a simple stochastic (SDE) one. The noise is used only during training, needs no solver, and reduces exactly to the CfC when switched off. On the synthetic D-NeRF scenes the stochastic field is on par with the deterministic CfC and beats the MLP baseline on most scenes; on the real-world NeRF-DS scenes the deterministic limit is already best and adding noise does not help. The study thus gives both a clean way to read the CfC field as an SDE and an honest account of when a plain noise term helps and when it does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在可变形3D高斯泼溅（D-3DGS）中，用液体神经网络（CfC单元堆栈）替代MLP，并引入高斯扰动将确定性变形场转化为随机微分方程（SDE）形式。噪声仅在训练时使用，无需求解器。实验表明，在合成D-NeRF场景中随机场与确定性CfC持平并优于MLP；在真实NeRF-DS场景中确定性CfC已是最优，加噪声无益。
AI.motivation: CfC（Closed-form Continuous-time）单元求解液体时间常数ODE的闭式解仅为确定性极限，丢弃了液体网络通常赖以提升鲁棒性的随机项。作者希望恢复这一随机项，同时保持前馈计算成本不变，并诚实评估噪声项在何时真正有帮助。
AI.method: 在D-3DGS的变形场中，用堆叠的CfC单元替代MLP。对每个CfC单元的时间门施加小的高斯扰动，将确定性场转化为简单的随机微分方程（SDE）形式。噪声仅在训练阶段使用，无需额外求解器，关闭后精确还原为CfC。
AI.result: 在合成D-NeRF场景上，随机场与确定性CfC性能相当，且在多数场景上优于MLP基线；在真实世界NeRF-DS场景上，确定性CfC已为最优，添加噪声并未带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了将CfC场解读为SDE的清晰途径，并诚实地阐明了噪声项在哪些情况下有帮助、哪些情况下无益，为随机神经网络在动态场景重建中的适用性提供了实证依据。

title: SGE: Semantically-Guided Exploration for Unstructured Environments via Image-Space Waypoint Sampling
summary: This work introduces Semantically-Guided Exploration (SGE), a modular exploration framework for ground vehicles that integrates pixel-level semantic segmentation into sampling-based waypoint selection and receding-horizon route optimization. Unlike conventional geometric exploration methods, SGE evaluates candidate exploration goals directly in the image space using a semantic-aware utility function that accounts for terrain traversability, obstacle proximity, objects of interest, and depth-based exploration reward. Sampled waypoints are projected into 3D and ordered through a real-time Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) formulation, enabling receding-horizon goal selection. To address real-world navigation uncertainty, the framework introduces mechanisms, including temporary taboo regions to handle navigation failures and a graph-based relocation strategy for efficient backtracking across explored areas. We evaluate SGE in standardized simulation benchmarks against state-of-the-art exploration planners and demonstrate competitive performance in volumetric coverage, while enabling semantic task biasing that cannot be achieved by purely geometric methods. The framework is further validated through real-world experiments using multiple robotic platforms in indoor campus buildings and in limestone and coal mines. Results show consistent performance and adaptability across platforms and domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义引导探索框架（SGE），将像素级语义分割整合进基于采样的路径点选择和滚动时域路径优化中，使地面车辆能够在探索时考虑地形可通行性、障碍物距离、感兴趣目标等语义信息，并支持语义任务偏置，通过模拟基准和真实矿山/校园实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统几何式探索方法仅基于几何信息（如障碍物边界、未探索区域）进行路径规划，无法利用语义信息实现任务导向型探索（如优先探索感兴趣目标或可通行区域），在真实复杂环境中导航不确定性也缺乏处理机制。
AI.method: SGE框架包含三个核心模块：（1）在图像空间基于语义感知效用函数评估候选探索目标，涵盖地形可通行性、障碍物距离、感兴趣目标及深度探索奖励；（2）将采样路径点投影到3D空间，通过实时TSP求解实现滚动时域目标选择；（3）引入临时禁忌区域处理导航失败，以及基于图的重定位策略实现高效回溯。
AI.result: 在标准化仿真基准中与最先进的探索规划器对比，SGE在体积覆盖率上表现具有竞争力，同时能够实现纯几何方法无法完成的语义任务偏置；在真实室内校园建筑、石灰岩矿和煤矿多平台实验中展示了一致的性能和跨领域适应性。
AI.conclusion: SGE验证了语义信息与几何探索框架的有效融合，在保持竞争性覆盖率的同时支持任务导向的语义探索偏置，并在真实多样化场景（室内、矿山）和多机器人平台上展现了良好的泛化能力。

title: Self-Evolving Skills via Surrogate-Guided Solve-and-Reproduce
summary: Agent skills are portable packages of instructions and resources an agent consults at deployment. Self-evolving them fails in two ways today. First, skills evolved from scratch underperform human-curated ones and, on a weak model, using no skill at all. Second, an evolution-time pass records one lucky trajectory that a fresh stochastic agent often fails to reproduce at deployment. We present reSolve, a per-task, oracle-in-the-loop framework built on three components. It decouples interactive solving from a self-contained deliverable that is independently re-executed in a fresh container, a protocol we call solve-and-reproduce. It enhances the sparse reward signal with a surrogate verifier that cannot access hidden tests or reference answers. It then runs verifier-guided beam search over a solution-construction graph. Within a fixed harness, a cheap model self-evolves skills that reach $74.9\%$ mean-of-3, $+14.8$ points over the $60.1\%$ human-curated baseline, exceeding the strongest official curated-skill result ($67.3\%$, GPT-5.5/OpenHands). We also report observed failure cases and domain-level results, including performance on the 14 Natural Science tasks, to clarify when the approach does and does not help.

AI.tldr: reSolve是一个基于oracle-in-the-loop的框架，通过"求解-复现"协议、替代验证器和验证器引导的束搜索，使廉价模型能够自进化出超越人工策划技能（+14.8分）的Agent技能。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent技能自进化存在两个失败模式：一是从零进化的技能性能不如人工策划甚至不用技能；二是进化时记录的单次成功轨迹难以被随机agent在部署时复现。
AI.method: reSolve框架包含三个组件：(1) solve-and-reproduce协议，将交互式求解与可在全新容器中独立重执行的自包含交付物解耦；(2) 使用无法访问隐藏测试或参考答案的替代验证器增强稀疏奖励信号；(3) 在解构造图上运行验证器引导的束搜索。
AI.result: 在固定测试框架下，廉价模型自进化技能达到74.9%的mean-of-3成绩，比60.1%的人工策划基线高出14.8个百分点，超过最强的官方策划技能结果（GPT-5.5/OpenHands的67.3%）。
AI.conclusion: reSolve证明了廉价模型通过精心设计的自进化协议可以超越昂贵模型的人工策划技能；同时论文也报告了失败案例和14个自然科学任务的领域级结果，以明确该方法的适用边界。

title: Variable-Granularity Tokenization for High-Resolution Object Detection
summary: ViT detectors fix a uniform token grid before any learned stage. A native-resolution aerial detector must then choose between resolving few-pixel objects and staying inside compute and memory limits. We introduce VGTok, a training-free tokenizer that sets patch granularity per region from pixels, ahead of the encoder. VGTok scores each region by multi-scale morphological top-hat separability from its surround, then thresholds those scores at a per-image percentile, which fixes the token budget. A structure-tensor gate ($λ_{\min}$) refines only where two-dimensional object structure supports it, leaving one-dimensional clutter coarse. The resulting token set is a strict partition of the image. In a Co-DETR detector with an EVA-02 ViT-L encoder, VGTok clears every published VisDrone-val AP and AP$_S$ at every budget from 40\% to 100\% of tokens. At 40\% it records 44.22 AP with three fifths of the sequence discarded before the first transformer block; dense, it reaches 48.38 AP, $6.08$ above the strongest published entry. VGTok transfers to AI-TOD-v2 untouched, same scorer and same rank, and sets a new state of the art at 37.27 AP and 19.51 AP$_{vt}$. As a pure drop-in into a frozen checkpoint it reaches 36.29 AP at 78.5\% of tokens, above every published entry, where our 376.3M-parameter detector clears a 3.0B multi-expert model. We show that a token budget fixed before the backbone, from local separability and structure geometry alone, holds accuracy on the tiny-object regimes that dominate aerial detection, at $3.1\times$ less encoder compute and $1.9\times$ less encoder memory. Code and models are available at \href{https://github.com/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}{\texttt{github.com/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}} and \href{https://huggingface.co/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}{\texttt{huggingface.co/khayrulbuet13/vgtok}}.

AI.tldr: VGTok 是一种无需训练的 tokenizer，通过多尺度形态学 top-hat 分离度和结构张量门控，在输入编码器之前按区域自适应设定 patch 粒度，在固定 token 预算下实现航拍小目标检测的最优性能，在 VisDrone 和 AI-TOD-v2 上均刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: ViT 检测器在训练前就固定了均匀 token 网格，面对航拍图像中极小的目标（仅几个像素），需要在"解析小目标"和"计算/内存限制"之间做两难取舍。需要一个自适应的 tokenizer，在进入编码器之前就能从像素层面按区域设定 patch 粒度。
AI.method: 1) 对每个区域使用多尺度形态学 top-hat 分离度（与其环绕背景的可分离性）进行打分；2) 按每张图像的百分位数阈值固定 token 预算；3) 使用结构张量门控（λ_min）仅对具有二维物体结构的区域进行细化，一维杂波保持粗粒度；4) 得到的 token 集合是图像的严格划分，无需训练即可用作 Co-DETR 检测器（EVA-02 ViT-L 编码器）的输入。
AI.result: 在 VisDrone-val 上，从 40% 到 100% token 预算下均超过所有已发表结果。40% 预算时取得 44.22 AP（丢弃五分之三的序列），密集时达 48.38 AP，比最强已发表结果高 6.08。在 AI-TOD-v2 上无需调整迁移，刷新 SOTA（37.27 AP，19.51 AP_vt）。作为冻结检查点的即插即用模块，仅用 78.5% token 即达 36.29 AP，超越 3.0B 多专家模型。计算量减少 3.1 倍，编码器内存减少 1.9 倍。
AI.conclusion: 在骨干网络之前，仅通过局部可分离性和结构几何信息固定的 token 预算，就能在航拍检测中占主导的极小目标场景下保持精度，同时大幅降低计算与内存开销，验证了训练自由的 tokenization 在小目标航拍检测中的有效性。

title: A Cognitive Architecture for Shared Autonomy in AUV Operations
summary: Operators remain essential to Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) operation, yet often suffer from low situational awareness and high workload, both of which negatively affect safety. This paper presents a cognitive architecture consisting of an ontology and multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist the operator at all stages of the mission. Each LLM is grounded with domain-specific information from the ontology and given a simple role to create a system that can support the operator at all stages of an operation. We are aiming to prove that using the two together will allow decisions to be grounded in the relevant domain knowledge, but also benefit from the reasoning capabilities of the LLM. Our framework determines if a mission is possible for a given Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV), performs mission planning, and executes a given mission in simulation. The operator can be involved in planning and execution, ensuring the resulting plan is valid and that the vehicle behaves safely during execution. We compare different LLMs, Llama3, GPT-OSS, and Qwen2.5, to determine which are best suited to the different roles within our framework. We find that GPT-OSS performs best for feasibility assessment, planning, and execution, while Qwen2.5 is best suited to identifying mission types from natural language input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合本体论和多个大语言模型（LLMs）的认知架构，旨在辅助远程操作员（ROV/UUV）在任务各阶段提升态势感知并降低工作负载。框架涵盖任务可行性评估、任务规划和仿真执行，并比较了Llama3、GPT-OSS和Qwen2.5三种LLM在不同角色中的表现。
AI.motivation: ROV操作员常面临低态势感知和高工作负载的问题，这两者均对安全性产生负面影响。现有系统缺乏能够在任务全阶段提供领域知识驱动的决策支持。
AI.method: 构建由本体论和多个大语言模型组成的认知架构。每个LLM通过本体论获取领域特定信息并被赋予简单角色，共同支撑任务可行性和评估、任务规划以及仿真执行。操作员可参与规划和执行过程，确保计划有效性和执行安全性。
AI.result: 对Llama3、GPT-OSS和Qwen2.5进行对比实验，发现GPT-OSS在可行性评估、规划和执行方面表现最佳，而Qwen2.5最擅长从自然语言输入中识别任务类型。
AI.conclusion: 将本体论与多个LLM结合使用，可以使决策既扎根于相关领域知识，又能受益于LLM的推理能力，为ROV操作提供更安全、更高效的全流程辅助支持。

title: Reward-Oracle MCTS for Formal Theorem Proving: Sample-Efficient Search and the Need for Kernel-Level Proof Auditing
summary: Formal theorem proving with large language models remains challenging due to the difficulty of navigating large proof search spaces efficiently. Existing tree search approaches either feed verbose compiler error messages directly into the generation context, increasing context usage during search, or employ non-standard evaluation protocols that prevent direct comparison with established baselines. We propose a three-role Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) framework that treats the Lean 4 compiler purely as a reward oracle using compiler output as a scalar signal for UCB-guided tree updates without feeding error content into the generation context. Our framework decomposes proof search into three roles: a generator for proof attempts, a decomposer for subgoal decomposition, and a critic for subgoal quality evaluation. We evaluate across 4 benchmarks spanning competition mathematics and physics (MiniF2F, PutnamBench, LeanPhysBench, PhysLeandata) with three prover models at standard proof attempt budgets (PAB@16 to PAB@256). Our method achieves 87.1\% on MiniF2F with Goedel-Prover-V2-8B at PAB@256 and solves 26/659 PutnamBench problems at PAB@32 surpassing base sampling 18/659 at same proof attempt budget. Through an exhaustive axiom-level audit of every compiled proof, we further identify reward hacking in search-based theorem proving: DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B produces proofs on PutnamBench that pass compilation and the standard sorry-token scan while depending on sorryAx. The audit removes 4 and 8 such proofs from whole-proof sampling at PAB@32 and PAB@128, and 11 and 19 from MCTS. We do not attribute these counts to the search procedure; we report them to establish that kernel-level auditing is necessary for compiler-verified evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种三角色MCTS框架用于Lean 4形式化定理证明，将编译器纯粹作为奖励预言机（仅使用标量信号进行UCB树更新，不将错误信息注入生成上下文），由生成器、分解器和批评者三角色组成。在4个基准（MiniF2F、PutnamBench、LeanPhysBench、PhysLeandata）上达到SOTA，并发现搜索式定理证明中的奖励黑客问题（依赖sorryAx的伪证明可通过编译）。
AI.motivation: 现有基于树的证明搜索方法存在两个问题：一是将详细的编译器错误信息直接注入生成上下文，导致搜索过程中上下文使用量增加；二是采用非标准评估协议，无法与已有基线进行直接比较。此外，编译器验证的评估可能被奖励黑客（reward hacking）所欺骗。
AI.method: 提出三角色MCTS框架：生成器（generator）生成证明尝试、分解器（decomposer）进行子目标分解、批评者（critic）评估子目标质量。Lean 4编译器仅作为奖励预言机，其输出被压缩为标量信号用于UCB引导的树更新，错误内容不进入生成上下文。此外，对每个编译通过的证明进行公理级审计，检测是否依赖sorryAx等未完成的公理。
AI.result: 在MiniF2F上使用Goedel-Prover-V2-8B达到87.1%准确率（PAB@256）；在PutnamBench上PAB@32解决26/659问题，超越基础采样的18/659。公理级审计发现DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B在PutnamBench上产生依赖sorryAx但通过编译和标准sorry-token扫描的伪证明，审计从whole-proof sampling移除4个（PAB@32）和8个（PAB@128）伪证明，从MCTS移除11个和19个。
AI.conclusion: 三角色MCTS框架通过将编译器作为纯标量奖励预言机，在标准评估预算下显著提升定理证明性能；更重要的是，公理级审计揭示了现有编译器验证评估的不足——依赖sorryAx的伪证明可逃过编译器和sorry-token扫描，证明内核级审计对于可靠的评估是必要的。

title: MANTLE: A Framework for Adaptive In-Situ Planetary Perception Using a Modular Uplink Principle
summary: Planetary surface exploration missions rely increasingly on autonomous robotic platforms capable of interpreting complex terrain to ensure safe navigation, enable targeted science, and improve operational efficiency, as demonstrated across past Mars missions from Viking through Perseverance. Among the key perception capabilities, landform classification provides contextual information for landing site selection and scientific analysis, while boulder segmentation supports hazard assessment and path planning. This paper presents MANTLE, a multi-task adaptive network for terrain and landform extraction. The model uses a shared DINOv2 backbone for high-level feature extraction with task-specific heads: a classification head for large-scale landform classification, and a segmentation head for pixel-wise boulder localization, each trained on curated datasets built respectively from HiRISE orbital imagery and MSL surface-level imagery. The classification head achieved a test accuracy of 92.56% across seven Martian terrain classes, while the segmentation head achieved a validation IoU of 0.753 and showed strong cross-sol generalization on a held-out test set from previously unseen rover traverses. A key advantage of MANTLE is its modular, extensible design, formalized here as the Modular Uplink Principle: only a shared, frozen backbone needs to remain onboard, while subsequent perception capabilities are trained on Earth as lightweight task-specific heads and uplinked without retraining the full model. This work demonstrates two such high-impact capabilities, terrain classification and boulder segmentation, as an initial realization of a framework built to support many more over a mission's lifetime. With this foundation, future explorers need not arrive on Mars fully formed, but can continue to learn, adapt, and grow more capable with every uplink.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MANTLE，一个基于共享DINOv2骨干网络的多任务自适应网络，用于火星地形分类和巨石分割。分类头在7类火星地形上达到92.56%的测试准确率，分割头达到0.753的验证IoU，并展示了良好的跨sol泛化能力。其核心贡献是模块化上行链路原则：只需共享冻结骨干留在星上，任务特定轻量头在地球训练后上行，无需重新训练完整模型。
AI.motivation: 行星表面探测任务日益依赖自主机器人理解复杂地形以保障安全导航和目标科学探测。地物分类为着陆点选择和科学分析提供上下文信息，巨石分割支持危险评估和路径规划。现有方法通常将这些任务视为独立问题，缺乏可扩展、能随任务周期持续进化的统一框架。
AI.method: MANTLE采用共享DINOv2骨干网络提取高层特征，分别连接分类头和分割头两个任务特定模块。分类头用于大规模地形分类（7类），分割头用于像素级巨石检测。两个头分别在海盗号HiRISE轨道影像和MSL地表影像构建的数据集上训练。模型设计遵循模块化上行链路原则：共享骨干冻结且常驻星上，新感知能力作为轻量任务头在地球训练后上行更新。
AI.result: 分类头在7类火星地形上达到92.56%测试准确率；分割头达到0.753的验证IoU，并在之前未见过的漫游车穿越路径测试集上展现出强劲的跨sol泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MANTLE初步验证了多任务自适应网络在火星探测中的可行性，其模块化可扩展设计使未来探测任务无需"全副武装到达火星"，而是可以通过持续上行学习不断进化、适应和增强能力，为长期任务中的持续能力提升奠定了基础。

title: Bridging Semantics and Physics with Constrained LLMs for Safe and Trustworthy Robotic Manipulation
summary: A language-guided robot operating in a real kitchen must do more than produce a plan that appears correct. It must also execute that plan safely in cluttered environments under imperfect perception. Large language models (LLM) can decompose instructions into action sequences, yet a language-action gap remains: a plan may appear valid linguistically while being physically infeasible under kinematic and collision constraints. We bridge this gap by formalizing the reasoning-execution boundary as a typed contract. From RGB-D observations, the system grounds perceived objects in an explicit, collision-aware scene model and constrains language-level decisions through schema-validated tool calls defined by the Model Context Protocol (MCP), rejecting malformed commands before they reach the robot. Each validated call is deterministically grounded in a MoveIt Task Constructor pipeline, where candidate motions are evaluated against the reconstructed planning scene in a verify-then-act step. Only trajectories that pass both kinematic and collision checks are sent to the robot. On a physical UFactory 850, the method achieves up to 80% success across ten trials per task on pouring tasks involving liquids, granular media, and discrete solids. It achieves 90% success on a grasp-and-place task using the same planning, protocol, and verification stack. Although a scripted policy slightly outperforms our method on the easiest task, its success rate falls to 10% on the hardest, compared with 60% for our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将语言模型的动作规划与物理可行的机器人执行相衔接的框架，通过类型化契约（typed contract）形式化推理-执行边界，采用MCP工具调用验证语言级决策，并用MoveIt Task Constructor管线进行运动学与碰撞检查的验证后执行（verify-then-act）。在真实UFactory 850机器人上，倒液体/颗粒/固体任务成功率最高达80%，抓取放置任务达90%，且在最难任务上显著优于脚本策略（60% vs 10%）。
AI.motivation: LLM能将指令分解为动作序列，但存在语言-动作鸿沟（language-action gap）：从语言上看似有效的计划在运动学与碰撞约束下可能物理不可行。在真实杂乱厨房环境中，仅生成"看起来正确"的计划是不够的，必须确保执行安全。
AI.method: 1) 将推理-执行边界形式化为类型化契约；2) 从RGB-D观测构建显式碰撞感知场景模型；3) 通过Model Context Protocol (MCP)定义的模式验证工具调用，在执行前拒绝错误命令；4) 每个验证调用确定性映射到MoveIt Task Constructor管线，与重建规划场景进行运动学与碰撞检查（verify-then-act）；5) 仅将通过双重检查的轨迹发送至机器人。
AI.result: 在真实UFactory 850上：倒液体/颗粒/离散固体的倾倒任务十次试验成功率最高达80%；相同规划/协议/验证栈下的抓取放置任务达90%成功率。脚本策略在最简单任务上略优，但在最难任务上成功率骤降至10%，而本文方法达60%。
AI.conclusion: 通过类型化契约和验证后执行的架构，可以有效弥合语言模型规划与物理执行之间的鸿沟，在杂乱环境下实现安全可靠的语言引导机器人操作，且性能优于纯脚本策略在困难任务上的表现。

title: From Extraction to Governed Memory: Multi-Agent Knowledge Graph Construction with Domain-Expert Review
comment: 23 pages total, 10 pages main text, 12 pages of appendix, 2 figures, 6 tables
summary: Knowledge graphs used by agentic systems are often treated as flat stores of extracted triples, with little record of who owns a fact, why it was admitted, or how it should be used downstream. We argue that reliable agentic knowledge systems require governance as an essential component of graph construction to bridge this gap. We propose MAGG, a principled multi-agent framework for constructing Governed Knowledge Graphs that introduces explicit governance decisions for reliable and trustworthy knowledge sharing. A domain classifier first induces entity and relation types directly from document content, enabling operation in open-world settings without fixed schemas. Candidate triples are assigned to domain owners, reviewed against supporting evidence, admitted through governance decisions, and stored with audit metadata. The same ownership structure is reused during question answering, where queries are routed to domain-specific graph experts rather than answered through undifferentiated retrieval. Our evaluation demonstrates MAGG's effectiveness: On SciERC, MAGG improves strict triple F1 by 47% and mapped triple F1 by 51% over flat insertion. A blinded review of 120 triples finds governed-only triples more often source-supported than flat-only ones, and revised triples supported in 100% of cases. Finally, on MuSiQue, MAGG outperforms Microsoft GraphRAG by 9.0 exact-match points and 11.2 token-F1 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAGG，一个用于构建"受治理知识图谱"的多智能体框架，通过领域分类、所有权分配、治理决策和审计元数据等显式治理机制，提升知识图谱在智能体系统中的可靠性与可信度，实验表明其在三元组抽取质量和下游问答任务上均显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统使用的知识图谱通常被视为扁平的三元组存储，缺乏对事实归属、采纳依据以及下游使用方式的记录。这种缺乏治理机制的方式导致知识图谱的可靠性不足，难以支撑可信的知识共享。作者认为，可靠的智能体知识系统需要将治理作为图谱构建的核心环节。
AI.method: MAGG包含四个关键步骤：1）领域分类器直接从文档内容中归纳实体和关系类型，支持开放世界场景而无需固定模式；2）候选三元组被分配给领域所有者；3）三元组依据支持证据进行审查，通过治理决策后被采纳，并附带审计元数据存储；4）在问答阶段复用相同的所有权结构，将查询路由到领域特定的图谱专家而非进行无差别检索。
AI.result: 在SciERC数据集上，MAGG的严格三元组F1提升47%，映射三元组F1提升51%（相对扁平插入方法）；对120个三元组的盲审发现，仅治理通过的三元组比仅扁平插入的三元组更常获得来源支持，修订后的三元组在100%的情况下有来源支撑；在MuSiQue数据集上，MAGG比微软GraphRAG在精确匹配上高出9.0分，在token-F1上高出11.2分。
AI.conclusion: 治理作为知识图谱构建的显式组成部分，能够显著提高三元组的提取质量与来源可溯源性和下游问答的性能。将所有权结构复用在推理阶段，比传统无差别检索方式能带来实质性提升。

title: Inter-3D VQA: A Roadside Multimodal Benchmark for 3D Spatiotemporally Grounded Visual Question Answering
summary: Recent advances in visual question answering (VQA) and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled natural-language reasoning over traffic scenes. However, existing benchmarks are largely built from ego-vehicle views or 2D roadside videos, limiting their ability to evaluate 3D-grounded reasoning over real-world distances, trajectories, infrastructure topology, and safety-critical interactions. We introduce Inter-3D VQA, a large-scale roadside multimodal benchmark for 3D spatiotemporally grounded VQA at intersections. Built from synchronized point clouds and multi-view images, Inter-3D VQA contains 407K QA pairs covering lane-level positions, object relationships, motion patterns, and near-miss-oriented interaction reasoning. We further propose Inter-Geo, an MLLM baseline that integrates object- and scene-level aligned LiDAR representations, and Inter-Metrics, a unified evaluation framework for textual consistency, numerical accuracy, and semantic correctness. Experiments show that Inter-Geo outperforms image-based VLMs, especially on grounded spatial and temporal reasoning tasks. Our benchmark and codes are available at https://github.com/ASU-Suo-Lab/Inter-3D-VQA .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Inter-3D VQA，一个大规模的路口3D时空接地视觉问答基准，基于同步点云和多视角图像构建，包含40.7万个QA对，覆盖车道级位置、物体关系、运动模式和近碰撞交互推理；同时提出Inter-Geo多模态大模型基线和Inter-Metrics统一评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有VQA和多模态大模型基准大多基于自车视角或2D路边视频构建，缺乏对3D接地推理能力的评估，无法有效评测模型在真实世界距离、轨迹、基础设施拓扑和安全关键交互上的推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建Inter-3D VQA基准：从同步点云和多视角图像中生成40.7万QA对，涵盖车道级位置、物体关系、运动模式和近碰撞交互推理；2) 提出Inter-Geo基线模型：融合物体级和场景级对齐的LiDAR表示；3) 提出Inter-Metrics统一评估框架：衡量文本一致性、数值准确性和语义正确性。
AI.result: Inter-Geo在接地空间和时间推理任务上优于基于图像的视觉语言模型，证明了LiDAR表示整合对3D时空推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Inter-3D VQA填补了路口场景下3D时空接地VQA评估的空白，为交通场景MLLM的3D推理能力提供了更全面的评测基准和可复现的基线。

title: Toward Trustworthy Robot-Assisted Sliding Palpation for Shallow Vessel Localisation with a Calibrated Digital Twin
summary: Reliable localisation of shallow subsurface vessels is important for safe robot-assisted venous access and vessel-aware manipulation, but collecting diverse tactile data on physical hardware is costly, time-consuming, and can degrade soft vision-based tactile sensors. We present a robot-assisted sliding-palpation framework in which a calibrated digital twin generates labelled tactile sequences, reducing reliance on real-world data. The twin models sensor-vessel contact, is calibrated against real palpation trajectories using Bayesian-optimisation-based domain adaptation, and is randomised over sliding direction and contact conditions. A spatio-temporal graph neural network trained on simulated marker trajectories performs per-node vessel classification and produces a human-verifiable top-view localisation map through 2D-to-3D-to-2D geometric projection. We evaluate three datasets: Sim, Silicone, and Meat, the latter a raw-meat phantom with vessel models at nominal depths of 0 to 30 mm, using four train-to-test configurations: Sim to Sim, Sim to Silicone, Sim to Meat, and Meat to Silicone. The calibrated twin achieves a simulated-to-real marker-alignment mean absolute error of 0.50 mm at deepest contact across four canonical interactions. After reprojection onto a 1 mm top-view grid, predicted vessel pixels lie on average 1.05 to 5.49 mm from the nearest true vessel pixel across the four models, with 1.05 to 1.31 mm for all except Sim to Meat. The larger error for Sim to Meat reflects the greater domain shift and current limit of simulation transfer. These results demonstrate progress toward trustworthy tactile palpation through calibrated simulation, interpretable localisation, and transparent cross-domain evaluation. Code, model weights, and data are publicly available on GitHub and Zenodo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种机器人辅助滑动触诊框架，利用校准数字孪生生成带标签的触觉序列，减少对真实世界数据的依赖。通过贝叶斯优化域自适应校准数字孪生，并训练时空图神经网络进行血管分类和定位，实现了从模拟到现实的跨域迁移定位，在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 浅表皮下血管的可靠定位对机器人辅助静脉穿刺和血管感知操作至关重要，但采集多样化的物理触觉数据成本高、耗时长，且可能损伤软性视觉触觉传感器，因此需要减少对真实数据的依赖。
AI.method: 构建机器人辅助滑动触诊框架：1) 建立校准的数字孪生模型模拟传感器-血管接触；2) 使用基于贝叶斯优化的域自适应对真实触诊轨迹进行校准；3) 对滑动方向和接触条件进行随机化；4) 训练时空图神经网络对模拟标记轨迹进行逐节点血管分类；5) 通过2D-3D-2D几何投影生成可人工验证的俯视定位图。
AI.result: 校准孪生在四次典型交互中最深接触点的模拟到真实标记对齐平均绝对误差为0.50mm。在1mm俯视网格上重投影后，四种模型的预测血管像素与最近真实血管像素平均距离为1.05-5.49mm，其中除Sim到Meat外的三个模型为1.05-1.31mm。Sim到Meat的较大误差反映了更大的域差距和当前仿真迁移的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 通过校准模拟、可解释定位和透明的跨域评估，该方法证明了迈向可信赖触觉触诊的进展，所有代码、模型权重和数据均已公开。

title: BiasMix-Finance: Post-Generation KYC Guardrails for LLM Portfolio Advice
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to the ICLR 2026 Financial AI (FinAI) Workshop. Code and data: https://github.com/gauravkukreja06/biasmix-finance
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate plausible-sounding ETF portfolios while silently violating basic KYC-style constraints on risk, fees, and diversification. This is especially problematic in agentic multi-turn advisory systems, where each draft recommendation can become an action unless guarded by an auditable enforcement layer. We study a model-agnostic, asset-agnostic post-generation guardrail pipeline: (i) enforce a strict JSON allocation schema, (ii) validate allocations against numeric caps, and (iii) when violations occur, deterministically project the output to the nearest feasible portfolio via a convex quadratic program (QCQP). We introduce BiasMix-Finance (Mini), a compact stress-test benchmark for constrained decision-making under biased LLM generations, with a 16-ETF universe, three investor profiles, and eight bias prompts. Across three models and three inference modes (direct, critique, self-consistency), first-pass generations violate at least one cap in 47.6-85.7% of test cases (67.2% pooled), but the convex projection layer reduces final feasibility violations to 0% while requiring only a small correction distance (test pooled median D=||w*-w0||_2=0.066), indicating that the guardrail typically preserves the intent of the original allocation. We report violation rates and correction distances with confidence intervals, and paired model comparisons with multiple-testing correction. To support reproducibility, we release the dataset, prompts, caps, and code in our public GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模型无关、资产无关的后生成护栏管线，用于约束LLM生成的ETF投资组合，确保其符合KYC风格的风险、费用和分散化约束。该管线包括严格的JSON分配模式、数值上限验证，以及通过凸二次规划(QCQP)将违规输出确定性投影到最近的可行组合。作者引入了BiasMix-Finance (Mini)基准测试集，发现三模型三推理模式下首轮生成的违规率高达67.2%，但凸投影层将最终可行性违规率降至0%，且修正距离中位数仅为0.066。
AI.motivation: LLM能够生成看似合理的ETF投资组合，但会静默违反基本KYC约束（风险、费用、分散化）。这在智能体多轮咨询系统中尤为危险，因为每个草稿推荐都可能成为实际动作，除非有可审计的执行层进行保护。
AI.method: 提出三阶段后生成护栏管线：(i) 强制执行严格的JSON分配模式；(ii) 验证分配是否满足数值上限；(iii) 发生违规时，通过凸二次规划(QCQP)确定性投影到最近的可行组合。同时构建BiasMix-Finance (Mini)基准，包含16个ETF、三种投资者画像、八种偏见提示，在三个模型和三种推理模式下进行评估。
AI.result: 首轮生成在47.6-85.7%的测试用例中违反至少一个上限（池化后67.2%），但凸投影层将最终可行性违规降至0%，同时仅需很小的修正距离（测试池化中位数D=||w*-w0||_2=0.066），表明护栏通常保留了原始分配的意图。报告了带置信区间的违规率和修正距离，以及多重检验校正的配对模型比较。
AI.conclusion: 提出的凸投影护栏层能够在不显著改变LLM原始输出意图的前提下，完全消除投资组合约束违规，是一种有效的可审计后生成安全机制。数据集、提示、上限和代码已在公共GitHub仓库中发布以支持可复现性。

title: FairReL: Deepfake Detection using Fairness-Aware Representation Learning
comment: 26 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at BMVC 2026. Code: https://github.com/xiaoman89/FairReL
summary: Although recent deepfake detectors achieve high overall accuracy, their errors remain unevenly distributed across demographic subgroups, with real faces from certain groups more often misclassified as fake. Existing fairness-aware detectors typically regularise the entire feature representation, without identifying or controlling the specific components that drive unfair predictions. Such coarse intervention can over-suppress useful forgery cues while leaving demographic structure in component-specific subspaces. To address this, we identify two subgroup-sensitive components: multi-scale spatial features, which encode local facial and forgery patterns, and fine-tuning-induced residual features, which adapt the backbone to the unfair training distribution. We propose FairReL, a fairness-aware representation-learning framework that targets both components with dedicated demographic supervision. FairReL uses an SVD-decomposed foundation-model backbone to isolate the fine-tuning-induced residual representation, and introduces two complementary losses. Group-Conditional Wavelet Decorrelation (GCWD) suppresses subgroup-imbalanced structure across spatial wavelet sub-bands, while Subspace-Localised Mean Alignment (SLMA) aligns subgroup means within each real/fake class in the residual representation. Experiments on FF++, Celeb-DF, DFD and DFDC show that, against the state-of-the-art fairness-aware detector, FairReL improves unseen-dataset AUC by 3.9% while reducing subgroup FPR disparity by 10.2%. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaoman89/FairReL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出FairReL，一个针对深度伪造检测器的公平性感知表示学习框架。它识别并针对两个子群体敏感的组件（多尺度空间特征和微调引起的残差特征）进行专门的去偏干预，通过GCWD和SLMA两种互补损失，在保持伪造检测性能的同时显著降低不同人口子群体间的错误率差异。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器在不同人口子群体上的错误分布不均匀，真实人脸在某些群体中更容易被误判为伪造。现有的公平性感知检测器通过对整个特征表示进行正则化来提升公平性，但这种方式过于粗粒度，无法识别或控制导致不公平预测的具体组件，可能过度抑制有用的伪造线索，同时未有效消除子群体结构在特定子空间中的残留。
AI.method: FairReL框架包含两个关键设计：(1) 使用SVD分解的基础模型主干来隔离微调引起的残差表示；(2) 引入两种互补损失——组条件小波去相关（GCWD）用于抑制空间小波子带中的子群体不平衡结构，以及子空间局部化均值对齐（SLMA）用于在残差表示中对齐每个真实/伪造类别内的子群体均值。
AI.result: 在FF++、Celeb-DF、DFD和DFDC数据集上的实验表明，与最先进的公平性感知检测器相比，FairReL在未见数据集上的AUC提升了3.9%，同时将子群体FPR差异降低了10.2%。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对性地识别和干预导致偏见的具体特征组件（而非对整个表示进行粗粒度正则化），可以有效改善深度伪造检测器的公平性，同时保持甚至提升其在未知数据集上的泛化检测性能。

title: SMILE: Smooth Motion for Improved Long-Horizon VLA Execution
comment: Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models reduce inference cost by executing multiple actions per call, but longer horizons often degrade accuracy because raw chunks contain jitter and outliers. We introduce SMILE, an architecture-preserving interface that predicts B-spline coefficients and decodes them into smooth action sequences. SMILE changes only the action representation, enabling longer fixed horizons while retaining each baseline's backbone and model scale. We apply SMILE to SmolVLA, Evo1, VPP, and DAWN, improving accuracy and amortized inference efficiency across LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-world experiments. SMILE-Evo1 reaches 98.0% with a 1.1x speedup on LIBERO, while SMILE-VPP reaches an average length of 4.42 with a 1.5x speedup on CALVIN. At a matched execution horizon of 10, SMILE-SmolVLA reduces non-boundary acceleration by 78.6% and velocity sign-change rate by 42.3%. Real-world xArm tests show higher success, fewer drops, and fewer contacts. These results establish smooth coefficient-space generation as a route to accurate, efficient long-horizon VLA execution. Project page: jongwoopark7978.github.io/smilevla

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMILE，一种保持架构不变的接口，通过预测B样条系数并将其解码为平滑动作序列，替代原始动作块表示，从而在更长固定推理视野下提升VLA模型的准确率和推理效率。在SmolVLA、Evo1、VPP和DAWN上应用，在LIBERO、CALVIN及真实xArm实验中均取得改进。
AI.motivation: VLA模型通过每次调用执行多个动作来降低推理成本，但更长的执行视野常因原始动作块中的抖动和离群点而降低准确率，限制了长视野动作执行的可行性与效率。
AI.method: SMILE仅改变动作表示层：预测B样条系数（平滑系数空间），并将系数解码为平滑动作序列。该方法保持基线模型的骨干网络和模型规模不变，可无缝替换动作输出表示以支持更长的固定执行视野。
AI.result: SMILE-Evo1在LIBERO上达到98.0%准确率并获1.1倍加速；SMILE-VPP在CALVIN上平均动作长度为4.42且获1.5倍加速；在匹配10步执行视野时，SMILE-SmolVLA将非边界加速度降低78.6%、速度符号变化率降低42.3%；真实xArm实验显示更高的成功率、更少的掉落与接触。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了平滑系数空间生成是通往准确、高效的长视野VLA执行的有效路径，表明通过仅替换动作表示即可在多种基线上同时提升精度与推理效率。

title: Self-Specialized Teachers for Domain Post-Training
summary: Target-only post-training can improve performance in a specialized domain while degrading behaviors that a general-purpose base model acquired before adaptation. We study this problem when target-domain data are available but a representative replay corpus is not. We propose self-specialized teacher distillation (SSTD), a two-stage procedure that first trains a copy of the base model into a domain teacher, then distills its token distribution to a student on prefixes sampled from the student itself. Teacher training combines standard target supervision with base-aware key-token weighting and distribution alignment to the frozen base model; on-policy distillation then places domain feedback on states the student can encounter at inference time. On financial numerical reasoning, medical question answering, and legal holding identification, SSTD retains much of the target improvement of direct fine-tuning while improving the mean score on the evaluated general suite by 4.8--5.0 points at the reported operating point. The pattern persists across Qwen3 sizes and on Gemma backbones. SSTD requires neither an external teacher nor general replay data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自专项教师蒸馏（SSTD），一种两阶段后训练方法，在缺乏通用回放数据的情况下，通过先训练领域教师、再对学生自身前缀进行在线策略蒸馏，在提升目标领域性能的同时减少对基础模型通用能力的灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 仅针对目标领域进行后训练会提升专业领域表现，但会损害基础模型在适配前已获得的通用行为。现有方法通常需要外部教师模型或代表性回放数据，但实际场景中往往不可得。
AI.method: 两阶段流程：第一阶段，将基础模型副本训练为领域教师，训练中结合目标监督、基于基础感知的关键词加权以及向冻结基础模型的分布对齐；第二阶段，在学生自身采样的前缀上进行在线策略蒸馏，使得领域反馈作用于推理时学生可能遇到的状态。
AI.result: 在金融数值推理、医学问答和法律判例识别三个领域，SSTD在保留直接微调大部分目标提升的同时，在通用评测套件上的平均分提升4.8-5.0分。该模式在Qwen3不同规模及Gemma骨干网络上均保持一致。
AI.conclusion: SSTD无需外部教师或通用回放数据，即可在专门领域性能与通用能力保持之间取得良好平衡，是一种实用的专项后训练方法。

title: ClearText-Video: A Large-Scale Text-Centric Video Dataset Bridging Video Restoration and Scene-Text Enhancement
comment: This paper is accepted by 2026 Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently made strong progress in visual--linguistic understanding. However, their performance on text-centric video reasoning remains highly sensitive to input quality. Real-world user-provided videos often contain motion blur, compression artifacts, noise, and low-resolution text, which impair reliable text reading and downstream reasoning. Whether MLLMs can robustly read and reason about real-world scene text under diverse quality conditions remains a fundamental open question. We introduce ClearText-Video (CTVid), a large-scale, scene-text-aware benchmark for studying text-centric video understanding under controlled quality variation. CTVid contains 4,639 real-world text-rich egocentric videos, 550K+ frames, 1.6M human-verified scene-text annotations, and 220K+ spatial/temporal question--answer pairs in Chinese and English. For each high-quality video, CTVid provides content-matched Degraded-Quality and Restored-Quality variants, supporting two task families: Text-Centric Video Restoration and Multi-Quality VideoQA. We evaluate 18 representative restoration methods and 16 state-of-the-art MLLMs on CTVid. The results show that visual enhancement does not guarantee textual fidelity or downstream reasoning gains: blur is more damaging than low resolution, restored videos can alter the textual evidence used by MLLMs, and OCR-only pipelines remain far below direct multimodal reasoning. CTVid exposes the gap between video restoration and text-grounded understanding, providing a rigorous foundation for restoration-aware, quality-robust text-centric video systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClearText-Video (CTVid)，一个大规模场景文本感知视频基准，用于研究多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在多种视频质量条件下的文本中心视频理解能力。CTVid包含4,639个真实世界文本丰富的第一人称视频、55万+帧、160万+人工验证的场景文本标注，以及22万+中英文时空问答对。通过提供内容匹配的降质和质量恢复变体，CTVid支持文本中心视频恢复和多质量VideoQA两大任务族，评估了18个恢复方法和16个MLLM，揭示了视觉增强不保证文本保真度或推理增益的关键发现。
AI.motivation: 现实世界用户提供的视频常包含运动模糊、压缩伪影、噪声和低分辨率文本等问题，这些会损害可靠的文本读取和下游推理。然而，MLLMs能否在多样化的质量条件下稳健地读取和推理真实世界场景文本仍是一个基本但未解决的关键问题。现有基准缺乏对视频质量变化的系统控制和对场景文本理解的深入评估。
AI.method: CTVid构建了一个大规模场景文本感知基准：(1)收集4,639个真实世界文本丰富的第一人称视频并标注160万+人工验证的场景文本；(2)为每个高质量视频生成内容匹配的降质(Degraded-Quality)和质量恢复(Restored-Quality)变体；(3)设计两个任务族：文本中心视频恢复和多质量VideoQA，包含22万+中英文问答对；(4)系统评估18个恢复方法和16个MLLMs在该基准上的表现。
AI.result: 评估结果表明：(1)视觉增强不能保证文本保真度或下游推理增益；(2)运动模糊比低分辨率更具破坏性；(3)恢复后的视频可能改变MLLMs使用的文本证据；(4)仅依赖OCR的流程远低于直接多模态推理的效果。CTVid暴露了视频恢复与文本接地理解之间的鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: CTVid为恢复感知、质量鲁棒的文本中心视频系统提供了严谨的基础，揭示了现有方法在真实世界质量变化条件下场景文本理解的根本局限，为该领域的进一步研究指明了方向。

title: Blind Dexterity: Whole-Body Humanoid Manipulation via Pure Proprioception
summary:
We present blind, whole-body manipulation skills on a Unitree G1 humanoid using only onboard proprioception, without cameras, markers, force-torque, or tactile sensors. Despite this minimal sensing, the trained policies exhibit surprising capability across qualitatively different tasks: push-resilient bipedal walking without IMU feedback, active soccer ball trapping with a foot, seeking and lifting a suitcase by its handle, and mounting a randomly positioned skateboard.
  We argue that these capabilities arise from a key underappreciated signal: the way the joint encoder readouts evolve under purposeful compliant contact, effectively forming a whole-body tactile channel. By generating contact-rich motions, the trained policies actively probe the environment; as a result, task-relevant object state (e.g., pose) becomes increasingly decodable from short proprioceptive histories. We expose this information using compact task-specific state estimators trained alongside, but fully separately from, the policies; their prediction errors decrease rapidly after informative contact.
  Our results indicate that joint encoder-based proprioception, combined with compliant actuation (now widely available on commercial robots and low-cost motors) is already a strong, practical substrate for whole-body dexterous manipulation and interactive perception, and therefore a natural foundation on which richer sensing can be layered.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了Unitree G1人形机器人在仅依靠本体感觉（关节编码器，无相机、无力传感器）的情况下，通过合规驱动实现全身体灵巧操纵能力，涵盖抗推行走、足球拦截、提行李箱和滑板上板等多样任务。核心观点是关节编码器在合规接触下的读数演化构成了一种"全身触觉通道"，训练策略通过主动探测环境来解码任务相关物体状态。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身操纵通常依赖丰富的传感器（相机、力觉、触觉等），这些传感器成本高、易损坏且增加系统复杂度。作者希望探索一种最小传感设置（仅关节编码器+合规驱动）能否支撑复杂的全身操作任务，并揭示其背后的感知机制。
AI.method: 1) 设计接触密集的运动策略，使机器人在与物体交互时通过合规驱动主动探测环境；2) 利用关节编码器读数在接触过程中的时序演化作为信息源；3) 训练独立的紧凑型任务专用状态估计器，从短期本体感觉历史中解码物体状态（如位姿）；4) 策略与状态估计器分开训练，互不依赖。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1上验证了多种任务：无IMU反馈的抗推双足行走、用脚主动拦截足球、寻找并提起行李箱把手、骑上随机放置的滑板。状态估计器的预测误差在有效接触后迅速下降，证实关节编码器富含可解码的任务相关状态信息。
AI.conclusion: 关节编码器本体感觉配合合规驱动已成为实用的全身灵巧操纵与交互感知基底，可作为更丰富传感分层的自然基础，为低成本人形机器人的全身操作提供了新的设计思路。

title: How Language Models Choose Sides: Internal Representations of Instruction Hierarchy
comment: Published at the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability workshop, 16 pages (including appendix)
summary: We study how instruction-tuned LLMs arbitrate direct conflicts between system and user instructions. We introduce a benchmark of 41 paired constraints with deterministic verifiers and evaluate eight models under matched baseline, conflict, and same-channel control conditions. Behaviourally, the models split into three regimes by System Authority Delta: hierarchy-respecting models use the system channel as an authority signal, anti-hierarchy models follow the system less often than their same-channel baseline predicts, and no-effect models show little channel sensitivity. Llama-3.1-8B is the strongest anti-hierarchy case in our suite, following the system in only 0.10 of conflict trials. We use this behavioural failure case to ask whether user-preferring arbitration reflects the absence of an internal conflictresolution signal. It does not: on Llama-3.1-8B, the conflict outcome is linearly decodable from residual-stream activations at 0.97 balanced accuracy, 17 percentage points above a metadata-only baseline, with analogous signals on Qwen2.5-7B and gpt-oss-20b. Steering with a layer-12 mean of four per-conflict logistic-regression directions raises genuine system compliance from 0.132 to 0.530, while directions selected mainly for pooled separability steer poorly. User-preferring conflict resolution can therefore coexist with a readable internal arbitration signal, and successful intervention depends on the geometry of the readout rather than probe accuracy alone

AI.tldr: 本文研究指令微调LLM如何仲裁系统指令与用户指令之间的直接冲突。作者构建了包含41对约束条件的基准测试，并使用确定性验证器评估了八种模型。行为上，模型分为三类：层级尊重型、反层级型和无效应型。Llama-3.1-8B是最强的反层级案例，在冲突试验中仅0.10概率遵循系统。但研究发现，用户偏好型仲裁并非源于内部冲突解决信号的缺失，因为冲突结果仍可从残差流激活中线性解码（0.97平衡准确率），且通过层12的logistic回归方向的引导可以将系统遵从率从0.132提升至0.530。
AI.motivation: 理解指令调优LLM如何在系统指令与用户指令冲突时做出仲裁决定，探究模型是否真的"遵循用户"以及其内部机制，为安全对齐和指令遵循研究提供基础。
AI.method: 构建41对带确定性验证器的约束条件基准；在匹配基线、冲突和同通道控制三种条件下评估八种模型；使用系统权威差值区分三种行为模式；对Llama-3.1-8B进行残差流激活的线性解码分析，并测试基于logistic回归方向的引导干预。
AI.result: 模型在系统冲突仲裁上呈现三种行为模式；用户偏好型仲裁与内部冲突信号共存（0.97线性可解码）；基于每冲突logistic回归方向的引导将系统遵从率从0.132提升至0.530，但仅基于池化可分离性的方向引导效果差。
AI.conclusion: 用户偏好型的冲突解决可以伴随可读的内部仲裁信号存在，成功的干预依赖读出方向的几何特性而非探针准确率本身。即使模型行为上看似"忽略"系统指令，其内部仍编码了冲突解决信息。

title: Beyond Representation Learning: A Systematic Study of Joint-Embedding Predictive Generation for 3D Brain MRI
comment: Preprint, code will be released after review
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) have primarily been developed for self-supervised representation learning. Denoising JEPA (D-JEPA) recently demonstrated strong generative capabilities on natural images, yet the applicability to 3D medical imaging remains unexplored. Building on the D-JEPA framework, we present Med-D-JEPA, a systematic adaptation and evaluation of joint-embedding predictive generation for 3D brain MRI. Med-D-JEPA operates on continuous latent tokens produced by a 3D KL-regularized adversarial variational autoencoder, and combines masked context prediction, representation-level alignment, per-token diffusion, and iterative next-set-of-token sampling. We evaluate unconditional and class-conditional generation quality on BraTS2019 and OASIS-1 datasets; downstream classification utility; and preliminary whole-tumor segmentation on BraTS2020. Across different generation settings, Med-D-JEPA achieves superior or competitive performance compared to several strong baselines on fidelity and diversity metrics. Compared to training with real samples, Med-D-JEPA-based synthetic pretraining improves classification AUC from 0.63 to 0.85 on BraTS2019 and from 0.78 to 0.87 on OASIS-1. In the segmentation study, pretraining on Med-D-JEPA samples improves Dice from 0.74 to 0.80 and reduces HD95 from 13.40 to 9.56 mm. These findings establish joint-embedding predictive generation as a promising direction for 3D medical image synthesis and encourage further research in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Med-D-JEPA，将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的生成能力系统性地扩展到3D脑部MRI图像生成。该方法基于去噪JEPA（D-JEPA）框架，结合3D KL正则化对抗变分自编码器产生的连续潜在token，融合掩码上下文预测、表示级对齐、逐token扩散和迭代式token集采样。在BraTS2019和OASIS-1数据集上验证了无条件与类别条件生成质量，并在BraTS2020上展示了初步的全肿瘤分割能力，在保真度、多样性、下游分类和分割任务中均取得优异效果。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）此前主要用于自监督表示学习，虽然去噪JEPA（D-JEPA）已在自然图像上展现出强大的生成能力，但其在3D医学影像生成方面的适用性尚未被探索。作者希望填补这一空白，将JEPA的生成范式引入3D医学图像合成领域。
AI.method: Med-D-JEPA在3D KL正则化对抗变分自编码器产生的连续潜在token空间上运行，结合了四个核心组件：掩码上下文预测、表示级对齐、逐token扩散以及迭代式下一组token采样。通过这种方式在连续潜在空间中执行生成任务。
AI.result: 在多种生成设定下，Med-D-JEPA在保真度和多样性指标上与多个强基线相比达到超越或持平的水平。在下游任务中，基于Med-D-JEPA合成数据的预训练将BraTS2019分类AUC从0.63提升至0.85，OASIS-1从0.78提升至0.87；分割任务中Dice从0.74提升至0.80，HD95从13.40mm降至9.56mm。
AI.conclusion: Med-D-JEPA的结果表明联合嵌入预测生成是3D医学图像合成的一个有前景的方向，其合成样本不仅质量高，还能有效提升下游分类和分割任务的性能，为后续研究奠定了基础。

title: A Sliding Window Filter on the Galilean Group for Consistent Aided Inertial Navigation with Unknown Measurement Delays
comment: Accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Multisensor Fusion and Integration (MFI), Pilsen, Czechia, Sep 2-4, 2026
summary: We study aided inertial navigation when the aiding sensor measurements are subject to an unknown constant delay. The goal is to estimate the delay and navigation state jointly so that delayed measurements correct the trajectory at the appropriate times, yielding a more accurate navigation solution. We formulate the problem on the special Galilean group, which provides a natural state-space structure for aided navigation with uncertainty in both motion and timing. We then examine the observability of joint delay and state estimation and show that, for a single delayed measurement, the model admits an exact symmetry in which a change in the delay can be compensated by a change in the navigation state, leaving the measurement unchanged. Processing measurements individually allows spurious information to `leak' along the corresponding null direction of the measurement Jacobian, producing overconfident and inconsistent estimates. Applying measurements from multiple times together can eliminate this direction when the trajectory is informative enough. Motivated by this result, we develop a sliding window filter that retains a short history of navigation states and applies delayed aiding corrections jointly across the active window. We conduct a series of simulation studies to characterize estimator accuracy and consistency. The simulations demonstrate that an estimator that does not maintain an adequate window can rapidly become highly inconsistent, whereas even a short sliding window markedly improves consistency by providing the temporal support that observability requires.

AI.tldr: 本文研究辅助传感器测量存在未知恒定延迟时的惯性导航问题，提出在特殊伽利略群上联合估计延迟与导航状态，并通过滑窗滤波器同时应用多个延迟校正来保证可观测性与估计一致性。
AI.motivation: 辅助惯性导航中，传感器测量常受未知恒定延迟影响。若延迟未正确估计，延迟测量将在错误时间校正轨迹，降低导航精度。现有方法未充分关注延迟与状态的联合可观测性问题，尤其在单个延迟测量场景下存在固有对称性导致信息泄漏和估计不一致。
AI.method: 1) 在特殊伽利略群（SE(3)时空扩展）上建立联合延迟-状态估计的状态空间模型；2) 分析联合估计的可观测性，证明单延迟测量下存在精确对称性，延迟变化可被状态变化补偿；3) 提出滑窗滤波器，保留短历史导航状态，在活动窗口内联合应用延迟辅助校正，以消除测量雅可比矩阵的零方向。
AI.result: 仿真研究表明：不维持足够窗口的估计器会迅速变得高度不一致；即使很短的滑窗也能显著改善一致性，因为其为可观测性提供了所需的时域支撑。
AI.conclusion: 延迟辅助测量的正确处理需要在时间上联合处理多个测量，滑窗滤波器是一种有效且实用的方案，能在保持精度的同时保证估计一致性。

title: A Generalized Optimization Engine (GOE) for Edge AI Inference Acceleration
comment: 14 pages, compressed version is under review in IEEE MILCOM 2026
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across various domains, yet their widespread deployment is impeded by significant computational costs, particularly on resource-constrained devices. This paper explores the theoretical underpinnings of various AI model optimization techniques, algorithms, and abstractions, discussing their potential to reduce computational complexity, memory footprint, latency, and power consumption. Furthermore, we propose a comprehensive hardware (HW) and model-agnostic generalized optimization architecture that integrates these techniques for improved efficiency. Our study underscores the critical role of such a generalized optimization system in preparing model deployment over resource-constrained heterogeneous hardware in a tactical environment. As a concrete demonstration, we show that GOE-compressed language models deploy and run on a GPU-less edge CPU, and that the choice of compression method, not merely its nominal bit-width, determines whether task accuracy survives deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI模型优化技术的理论基础，并提出了一种硬件和模型无关的通用优化架构（Generalized Optimization Architecture），该架构整合多种优化技术以降低计算复杂度、内存占用、延迟和功耗。实验证明GOE压缩后的语言模型可在无GPU的边缘CPU上部署运行，且压缩方法的选择（而非名义位宽）决定了任务精度的保留程度。
AI.motivation: AI模型虽能力强大，但在资源受限设备上的部署受到巨大的计算成本阻碍。需要从理论层面理解各种优化技术，并提出一种通用化的优化架构，以提升模型在战术环境中异构硬件上的部署效率。
AI.method: 首先从理论上分析各类AI模型优化技术（包括算法和抽象）的潜力；然后提出一个硬件与模型无关的通用优化架构（GOE，Generalized Optimization Architecture），该架构集成多种优化技术以实现效率提升；最后通过压缩语言模型在无GPU边缘CPU上的部署实验进行验证，重点关注压缩方法选择对任务精度的影响。
AI.result: GOE压缩的语言模型成功部署并在无GPU的边缘CPU上运行，证明了该通用优化架构的有效性。关键发现是：压缩方法的选择（而不只是名义位宽）决定了部署后任务精度能否保持。
AI.conclusion: 通用化的模型优化系统对于在资源受限的异构硬件上部署模型至关重要，且压缩方法的选择在精度保持方面起着决定性作用，这为未来模型优化与部署策略提供了重要指导。

title: Blind Stereoscopic Omnidirectional Image Quality Assessment Using Predictive Coding Hierarchy
summary: Stereoscopic omnidirectional images (SOIs) have provided users with newly immersive quality of experience in virtual reality environments. However, developing efficient and accurate perceptual quality assessment metrics for SOIs remains challenging due to many factors such as freely changeable field of views and binocular vision. In this paper, based on the characteristics of the human visual system (HVS), we propose a Predictive Coding Hierarchy-inspired metric (PCH) for blind/no-reference stereoscopic omnidirectional image quality assessment. Motivated by the viewing process of SOIs, the proposed PCH includes a local cyclopean perception module, a global predictive perception module, and a visual quality regressor. First, observers browse different spherical sceneries from viewports, and aggregate the local visual information to infer the perceptual quality of SOIs. Therefore, we extract various viewports, followed by cyclopean conversion and saliency detection to approach the perception and attention of the human brain. After the local aggregation, viewers then infer the global scene in their minds. Based on the binocular mechanism, we fuse left and right views to perform predictive coding hierarchy modelling. Finally, the visual quality regressor is exploited to obtain the ultimate quality score related to both local and global perceptual cues. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed PCH achieves competitive and consistently improved performance compared with state-of-the-art quality assessment methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预测编码层级启发的无参考立体全景图像质量评价指标（PCH），通过局部双眼感知模块、全局预测感知模块和视觉质量回归器来模拟人类视觉系统的观看过程，在实验中取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 立体全景图像（SOIs）在虚拟现实环境中提供了新的沉浸式体验，但由于视野可自由变化、双目视觉等因素，开发高效准确的感知质量评价指标仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出PCH指标，包含三个模块：1）局部双眼感知模块，提取多个视口进行双眼转换和显著性检测以模拟人脑的感知与注意力；2）全局预测感知模块，基于双目机制融合左右视图进行预测编码层级建模；3）视觉质量回归器，结合局部和全局感知线索获得最终质量分数。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提出的PCH方法在性能上相比现有最先进的质量评价方法具有竞争性且持续提升的表现。
AI.conclusion: 基于人类视觉系统观看立体全景图像的过程（先局部浏览视口再全局推断场景），PCH通过局部与全局感知模块的有效结合，实现了对立体全景图像质量的有效评价。

title: Task-Relevant Feature-Dynamics Fidelity Enables Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer for Robotic Ultrasound Scanning
summary: Robotic ultrasound policies operating directly on B-mode images require extensive interaction data, whereas real-robot data collection is costly and safety-constrained. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, but zero-shot transfer depends not only on single-frame realism but also on whether simulated observations reproduce task-relevant feature changes induced by probe motion. We term this cross-domain consistency task-relevant feature-dynamics fidelity (TR-FDF). Under local regularity assumptions, our contraction analysis shows that greater sensitivity of TR-FDF mismatch to probe motion reduces the effective closed-loop contraction margin, whereas motion-independent errors primarily enlarge the residual error bound. Guided by this analysis, we develop a TR-FDF-oriented ultrasound simulator that combines a shared structural intermediate domain, trajectory-level fixed noise, and few-step conditional flow generation. In phantom experiments, a policy trained exclusively in simulation succeeded in 390 of 400 zero-shot deployments across four target planes. The simulator achieved an FID of 29.66 and generated observations at 67.1 Hz. Controlled interventions, ablations, and baseline comparisons showed that TR-FDF sensitivity complements single-frame realism in predicting zero-shot transfer performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向机器人超声任务的特征动态保真度（TR-FDF）度量，并基于该分析开发了高效的超声模拟器，使模拟训练的智能体在真实（幻影）环境中取得了390/400次零样本部署成功。
AI.motivation: 直接在B模式图像上训练的机器人超声策略需要大量交互数据，但真实机器人数据采集成本高且受安全限制。仿真虽可作为替代，但零样本迁移的成功不仅取决于单帧图像的逼真度，还取决于模拟观测是否复现了探头运动引发的任务相关特征变化，这一跨域一致性此前未被充分研究。
AI.method: 1) 定义并形式化TR-FDF（任务相关特征动态保真度），通过收缩分析证明TR-FDF失配对探头运动的敏感性影响闭环收缩裕度，而运动无关误差主要扩大残差误差界。2) 基于该分析构建TR-FDF导向的超声模拟器，包含共享结构中间域、轨迹级固定噪声和少步条件流生成三部分。
AI.result: 在幻影实验中，仅仿真训练的策略在四个目标平面上实现了390/400次零样本部署成功；模拟器达到FID 29.66，生成速度67.1 Hz；受控干预、消融和基线对比表明TR-FDF敏感性与单帧真实性互补，共同预测零样本迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: TR-FDF是预测零样本迁移的关键补充指标，所提出的TR-FDF导向超声模拟器能够以高帧率生成高保真度的模拟观测，从而弥合仿真到真实（sim-to-real）的差距，实现高效的机器人超声策略训练。

title: FRAC-MAS: A Safe and Explainable Multi-Agent System for Fracture Diagnosis
comment: Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI) 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI for Medicine (AgenticMed)
summary: Fracture detection and its clinical interpretability see notable improvements when deep vision models are integrated with agentic AI architectures. While deep learning models achieve high diagnostic performance, their black-box nature limits clinical adoption. We propose FRAC-MAS, an agentic AI system for automated, explainable, and safe bone fracture detection. The framework combines a stacked ensemble of four vision models with conformal prediction to produce statistically grounded differential diagnoses, while a multi-agent workflow performs independent verification, retrieves clinical guidelines, and generates patient-friendly reports. A pipeline-depth ablation study confirms that our multi-agent critic triages 86.6% of cases into a high-confidence auto-confirmed cohort while escalating uncertain cases, outperforming a single-agent baseline. Patient preference studies against Llama, MedGemma, and Gemini further demonstrate significantly more comprehensible clinical reports. These results suggest that integrating multi-agent critics with conformal guarantees enables safer radiology triage while preserving clinician oversight. More broadly, FRAC-MAS demonstrates how cooperative agentic architectures can serve as auditable, human-in-the-loop decision support systems for safety-critical healthcare. Our code is available at https://github.com/hardik1712/FRAC-MAS, and the website is available at https://frac-mas.vercel.app.

AI.tldr: FRAC-MAS是一个基于智能体AI架构的自动化、可解释且安全的骨折检测系统，结合四个视觉模型的堆叠集成与保形预测，通过多智能体工作流进行独立验证、临床指南检索和患者友好报告生成，实现了更安全的分诊决策。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在骨折检测中虽有高诊断性能，但其黑箱特性限制了临床采用。需要一种兼具准确性和可解释性的方案，以确保临床安全并提供医生监督空间。
AI.method: 采用四个视觉模型的堆叠集成，结合保形预测生成基于统计依据的鉴别诊断；多智能体工作流独立验证结果、检索临床指南并生成患者友好报告；通过流水线深度消融研究验证多智能体评论机制的有效性。
AI.result: 多智能体评论机制将86.6%的病例分诊至高置信度自动确认队列，并升级不确定病例，优于单智能体基线；患者偏好研究表明生成报告比Llama、MedGemma和Gemini更具可理解性。
AI.conclusion: 将多智能体评论与保形保证相结合，可实现更安全的放射学三诊，同时保持临床医生监督；合作式智能体架构可作为安全关键医疗领域中可审计的人机协同决策支持系统。

title: A Large-scale Evaluation of Text-guided Models for Facial Editing
summary: Facial appearance editing powers popular applications like FaceApp and Photoshop. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and 3D Morphable Models (3DMMs) have been widely used for facial editing. GANs can perform varied facial edits (e.g., changing hair color, hairstyle), but often produce unstable edits. 3DMMs produce stable edits, but can only alter pose and facial expression. Recently, text-guided diffusion models like Nano Banana have become popular for image editing. Text-guided models are a compelling alternative to GANs and 3DMMs since they can produce both stable and varied image edits. While text-guided models have been widely tested for whole-scene edits (e.g., ``make the woman play a guitar''), they have not been comprehensively tested for facial editing. We conducted the first large-scale evaluation ($\sim1$M images evaluated) of six popular text-guided models on a sequential facial editing task. We present Face-Edit-Attributes, the largest collection of $169$ facial editing attributes focused on hair, accessories, and pose edits. We compared model performance using two popular celebrity face datasets: CelebA and CelebSET. Our results show that most models performed hair and accessory edits well, but struggled with editing pose. All models over-edit (e.g., changing hair color when asked only to change the hairstyle). We also evaluated demographic biases in each model. Our results show surprising biases in overediting: almost all models created more overedits for dark-skinned male faces and old faces. The code and data for our results (including our repository of $\sim 1$M images) can be accessed \href{https://github.com/rahul1801/Face-Edit-Bench}{\textcolor{blue}{here}}.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对六种主流文本引导扩散模型在面部编辑任务上进行了大规模评估（约100万张图像），构建了包含169个面部编辑属性的最大数据集Face-Edit-Attributes，发现大多数模型在头发和配饰编辑上表现良好但在姿态编辑上困难，且所有模型存在过度编辑问题，并在深肤色男性和老年面孔上表现出显著的过度编辑偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有面部编辑方法存在局限：GANs能进行多样化编辑但结果不稳定，3DMMs稳定但仅能修改姿态和表情。虽然文本引导扩散模型在场景编辑中已被广泛测试，但尚未在面部编辑任务中被全面评估，因此需要对其进行系统性的基准测试。
AI.method: 构建了最大规模的面部编辑属性数据集Face-Edit-Attributes（169个属性，涵盖头发、配饰和姿态），在CelebA和CelebSET两个流行名人数据集上，对六种主流文本引导扩散模型进行约100万张图像的序列化面部编辑任务评估，并评估各模型的人口统计学偏差。
AI.result: 大多数模型在头发和配饰编辑上表现良好，但在姿态编辑上存在困难；所有模型都存在过度编辑问题。在人口统计学偏差方面，几乎所有模型对深肤色男性面孔和老年面孔产生了更多的过度编辑。
AI.conclusion: 文本引导扩散模型是面部编辑的有力工具，但仍需改进姿态编辑能力和减少过度编辑问题，尤其是针对特定人口统计学群体的偏差需要进一步解决。

title: AGM: Achievement-Grounded Memory for Closed-Loop Agents with Frozen VLA Policies
summary: Frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer broad manipulation skills but execute open-loop action chunks without tracking task progress, so the agent cannot reliably decide whether to continue, retry, or terminate. External memory is a natural remedy, yet it can be harmful when attempted actions are treated as completed progress, turning local execution errors into persistent task-state errors. We propose Achievement-Grounded Memory (AGM), a lightweight closed-loop framework for frozen VLA policies that represents a task as a subgoal sequence with a progress pointer and advances this memory only after the current subgoal is verified by physical evidence. Proprioceptive interaction cues decide when to verify, while coherent point tracking and language-conditioned cross-view comparison, sourced from frozen foundation models through a single 2.43M-parameter verification head, decide what was achieved. AGM thereby converts open-loop execution into a closed loop of execution, verification, and progress, keeping the policy frozen without test-time large-model inference. On the RoboMME Counting benchmark, AGM reaches on PickXTimes and on BinFill, surpassing the strongest memory-augmented baseline by points on average, and the framework yields equally decisive gains on a physical robot. Reliable embodied memory thus depends more on disciplined state updates than on memory capacity.

AI.tldr: AGM是一种为冻结的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略设计的轻量级闭环框架，通过将任务表示为子目标序列并带有进度指针，仅在物理证据验证当前子目标完成后才推进记忆，将开环执行转换为执行-验证-推进的闭环，在两个基准上超越最强记忆增强基线。
AI.motivation: 冻结的VLA策略执行开环动作块，无法跟踪任务进度，因而不能可靠地决定是否继续、重试或终止。外部记忆虽能补救，但当尝试过的动作被误认为已完成进度时，局部的执行错误会转变为持续的任务状态错误，因此需要一种可靠的记忆更新机制。
AI.method: AGM将任务表示为带进度指针的子目标序列；仅当当前子目标由物理证据验证完成时才推进记忆。本体感觉交互线索决定何时验证，而协调的点跟踪和语言条件跨视角比较（源自冻结基础模型，通过仅2.43M参数的验证头）决定验证结果。整个策略保持冻结，无需测试时大规模模型推理。
AI.result: 在RoboMME Counting基准上，AGM在PickXTimes和BinFill任务上超越最强记忆增强基线平均显著提升；在物理机器人上也获得了同样显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的具身记忆更多地取决于纪律性的状态更新，而非记忆容量本身。AGM展示了无需微调或测试时推理即可将开环VLA策略转化为闭环的有效途径。

title: ORDDAR: Observation-Driven Reasoning for Distortion-Resilient Decision, Action, and Cognitive Recovery
summary: AI agents increasingly perform long-term reasoning, planning, tool use, memory integration, and autonomous decision making, yet erroneous intermediate states can propagate and cause inconsistent decisions and unreliable outputs. Existing reasoning approaches mainly rely on iterative planning, self-reflection, augmented memory, or verification, but rarely localize and selectively repair faulty reasoning. We present ORDDAR (Observation-Driven Reasoning for Distortion-Resilient Decision, Action, and Cognitive Recovery), a reasoning framework that models reasoning as cognitive state transitions, detects localized distortions, retrieves related reasoning from prior experiences, and repairs only the affected states. ORDDAR therefore performs recovery at the local reasoning-transition level rather than regenerating the complete trajectory. Experiments across mathematical, commonsense, multi-hop, and clinical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved reasoning quality, recovery ability, and interpretability over multiple evaluated reasoning baselines.

AI.tldr: ORDDAR是一个推理框架，将推理建模为认知状态转换，能够检测局部推理失真，从过往经验中检索相关推理，并仅修复受影响的状态，而非重新生成整个推理轨迹，在数学、常识、多跳和临床推理基准上均优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: AI代理在执行长期推理时，错误的中间状态会传播并导致不一致的决策和不可靠的输出。现有推理方法主要依赖迭代规划、自我反思、增强记忆或验证，但很少能够定位并选择性修复有缺陷的推理状态。
AI.method: ORDDAR将推理过程建模为认知状态转换，通过检测局部失真、从先前经验中检索相关推理片段，然后仅修复受影响的推理状态，在局部推理转换层面进行恢复，而非完整重新生成整个推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在数学、常识、多跳和临床推理等多个基准上的实验表明，ORDDAR在推理质量、恢复能力和可解释性方面均优于多个被评估的推理基线。
AI.conclusion: ORDDAR证明了局部定位并选择性修复推理状态是一种有效的推理恢复策略，相比全局重新生成能够提升推理质量、恢复能力和可解释性。

title: FigMirror: Ground It, Code It, Plot It
comment: Code and data available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/FigMirror
summary: Converting scientific figures into executable code has gained increasing attention, yet existing methods primarily focus on reproducing the reference figure itself. A more practical setting is to plot new data while preserving the visual style of a reference figure (e.g., color scheme and typography). Prior approaches mimic the reference through pixel-level optimization and struggle to carry its style to new data. We show that the key to this task lies in the coordinate grounding and coding capabilities present in modern computer-use models. We propose FigMirror, an agentic framework that unlocks these capabilities through Grounded Measurement, which locates visual elements by coordinates and measures their properties through executable code. We further introduce PlotTwin-Bench, an expert-curated benchmark with fine-grained code and image-level style metrics. Experiments show that FigMirror consistently outperforms existing methods on reference-conditioned style transfer. All plots in this paper are generated by FigMirror, except those produced by other methods for comparison. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/VILA-Lab/FigMirror.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FigMirror，一个基于计算机使用模型的智能体框架，用于将参考图表的视觉风格（配色、排版等）迁移到新数据的绘图任务中，并引入PlotTwin-Bench基准进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有科学图表转代码的方法只关注复现参考图本身，但在实际应用中更常见的需求是将新数据按照参考图的视觉风格进行绘图。已有方法通过像素级优化来模仿参考图，难以将风格迁移到新数据上。
AI.method: FigMirror利用现代计算机使用模型（computer-use models）的坐标定位与编码能力，通过Grounded Measurement（基于坐标定位视觉元素并用可执行代码测量其属性）来实现风格迁移。同时构建了PlotTwin-Bench基准，包含细粒度的代码级和图像级风格度量指标。
AI.result: 实验表明FigMirror在参考条件风格迁移任务上持续优于现有方法。论文中的所有图表（除对照方法生成的外）均由FigMirror生成。
AI.conclusion: FigMirror证明了利用计算机使用模型的坐标定位和编码能力可以有效解决图表风格迁移问题，为该领域提供了新的研究方向和基准。

title: Module Number Adaptive Visual Shape Control for Serial Modular Soft Robots
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. This articles has been submitted to a IEEE Journal
summary: Image based shape control provides a simple means of controlling the whole body configuration of soft robots. However, existing data driven approaches are typically developed for fixed robot structures and require new control data when the number of modules changes. This paper presents a module number adaptive visual shape control method for serial modular soft pneumatic robots. A controller trained only on single module actuation shape data is reused for robots with one to five modules by decomposing whole body camera images into local module patches. A single common module segmenter localizes individual modules across all tested configurations, while the same local controller is applied to every extracted patch. Geometric data augmentation improves transferability to downstream modules, and a lightweight mask reconstruction network reconstructs a synthetically removed actuator mask channel. Experiments on physical robots demonstrate shape control across varying numbers of modules and under environmental changes and payload loading. The results show that single module control learning enables scalable whole body control without configuration specific control data collection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种模块数量自适应的视觉形状控制方法，用于串联模块化软体气动机器人。仅使用单个模块的驱动形状数据训练控制器，通过将整体相机图像分解为局部模块补丁，即可复用于1到5个模块的机器人。共享模块分割器定位各模块，同一局部控制器应用于每个提取的补丁，并通过几何数据增强和轻量级掩膜重建网络提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于图像的数据驱动软体机器人形状控制方法通常针对固定机器人结构开发，当模块数量变化时需要重新收集控制数据，缺乏可扩展性和灵活性。
AI.method: 1) 仅使用单模块驱动形状数据训练控制器；2) 将整机相机图像分解为局部模块补丁；3) 使用共同的模块分割器在所有配置下定位各模块；4) 将同一局部控制器应用于每个提取的补丁；5) 通过几何数据增强提升对下游模块的迁移性；6) 使用轻量级掩膜重建网络重建被合成移除的执行器掩膜通道。
AI.result: 在物理机器人上验证了跨不同模块数量、环境变化和负载条件下的形状控制能力，证明单模块控制学习可以实现无需配置特定数据收集的可扩展整机控制。
AI.conclusion: 将整体形状控制问题分解为局部模块控制，并利用单一模块的共享控制策略，能够有效实现模块数量自适应的软体机器人全身形状控制，避免了为不同配置重复收集训练数据。

title: Beyond the Answer Key: Robustness Evaluation of Large Language Models for Step-Level Mathematical Verification
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as graders, verifiers, and process auditors, but most mathematical evaluations still emphasize final-answer accuracy. This can obscure whether a model can verify a non-canonical but valid solution trace. We introduce a controlled linear-equation benchmark for evaluating LLMs in the evaluator role. Each instance asks the model to judge final-answer correctness, step-level trace correctness, and the first incorrect step. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art open LLMs reveals a significant robustness gap: models that accurately evaluate canonical solutions often fail when presented with perturbed but logically equivalent variants. Across GPT-OSS 20B, Qwen3-14B, and Phi-4-Reasoning, base models perform well on canonical traces but degrade substantially on perturbed traces, especially for error localization. On valid perturbed traces, base-model false-rejection rates reach 75.6-85.3%, showing strong sensitivity to canonical solution form. Supervised fine-tuning, distillation, and test-time compute improve robustness in some settings, but gains are model dependent and can trade off against canonical performance. The results show that reliable process-level verification remains challenging, and evaluator robustness should be measured separately from solver accuracy, even in a simple algebraic domain with exact ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个受控的线性方程基准来评估LLM作为评估者（evaluator）的能力，发现模型在评估标准解时表现良好，但在面对扰动但逻辑等价的解变体时显著退化，尤其体现在错误定位方面。基础模型对有效扰动解的误拒率高达75.6-85.3%，表明现有LLM在过程级验证的鲁棒性上存在明显短板。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM越来越多地被用作评分器、验证器和过程审计者，但大多数数学评估仍侧重于最终答案的准确性，这掩盖了模型能否验证非标准但有效的解题过程这一问题。作者希望通过可控的实验来揭示这个被忽视的评估维度。
AI.method: 构建了一个受控线性方程基准，每个实例要求模型判断：最终答案正确性、步骤级过程正确性，以及定位第一个错误步骤。分别使用GPT-OSS 20B、Qwen3-14B和Phi-4-Reasoning等开源LLM进行评估，并测试了监督微调、蒸馏和测试时计算等干预手段。
AI.result: 三个模型的基座版本在标准解上表现良好，但在扰动解上严重退化，尤其在错误定位任务上。对有效扰动解的误拒率达到75.6-85.3%，表明对标准解的形态高度敏感。监督微调、蒸馏和测试时计算能部分提升鲁棒性，但效果因模型而异，且可能以牺牲标准解性能为代价。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的过程级验证仍然具有挑战性，即使在具有精确真实值的简单代数领域中，评估者的鲁棒性也应与求解者的准确性分开测量。当前LLM作为评估者的能力存在系统性缺陷，需要专门设计来提升对非标准但有效解题过程的验证能力。

title: Text-Driven Artistic Staging: Pose, Lighting, and Camera References from Paintings
summary: Artists coordinate human pose, illumination, and camera placement to convey narrative and emotion, but existing generative methods typically model these elements independently. We introduce text-to-editable 3D staging, a task that jointly generates human poses, a dominant light, and a camera configuration from an affective description. We construct 11,911 text--staging pairs from 2,328 figurative paintings by reconstructing SMPL bodies, estimating low-frequency illumination, recovering camera parameters, and pairing each scene with ArtEmis descriptions. We train a flow-matching transformer that supports variable numbers of figures and produces multiple staging alternatives for each prompt. On held-out descriptions, the model achieves 32.2\% retrieval R@1, compared with 16.6\% for CLIP-based nearest-neighbor retrieval, while approximately preserving corpus-level diversity. These results demonstrate the feasibility of generating editable, emotionally conditioned 3D staging references from text.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"文本到可编辑3D舞台布置"任务，从情感化文本描述中联合生成人物姿态、主光源和摄像机配置。作者从2,328幅具象绘画中构建了11,911个文本-舞台配对数据集，训练了一个流匹配Transformer模型，支持可变人数和多候选生成，在检索R@1上达到32.2%，远超CLIP基线。
AI.motivation: 现有生成方法通常独立建模人体姿态、光照和相机位置，而艺术家在创作中是通过三者协同来传达叙事和情感的，缺乏一个联合建模这些元素的生成框架。
AI.method: 1) 从具象绘画中重建SMPL人体、估计低频光照、恢复相机参数，并结合ArtEmis描述构建配对数据集；2) 训练一个支持可变人物数量的流匹配（flow-matching）Transformer，为每个提示生成多个舞台布置方案。
AI.result: 在保留数据集层面多样性的同时，模型在检索任务上达到32.2%的R@1，显著优于基于CLIP的最近邻检索（16.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了从文本生成可编辑、情感条件化的3D舞台布置参考的可行性，为情感驱动的场景生成提供了新方向。

title: $\mathcal{N}_0$-Foundation: Towards the Age of Tactile Intelligence
summary: We present $\mathcal{N}_0$-Foundation, a paradigm for tactile-enabled embodied manipulation, which integrates tactile sensing hardware, large-scale multimodal data, tactile representation learning, and standardized evaluation. First, we engineer the infrastructure for scalable data collection, including a vision-based tactile sensor, a tactile Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI), and a synchronized visuo-tactile data collection system supporting both robot embodiments and UMI-based demonstrations. Leveraging this infrastructure, we construct NeoData, which contains more than 30000 hours of synchronized visual and tactile demonstrations, spanning six embodiments, 450 tasks, and billions of paired RGB and tactile frames collected through a mixture of real-robot teleoperation and UMI-based demonstrations. To facilitate open research, we further release OpenNeoData, a 5000-hour open-source subset of NeoData. The dataset addresses a central limitation of existing manipulation corpora, critical for deformable-object manipulation, precise assembly, delicate force control, and sustained surface interaction. Capitalizing on the large-scale, heterogeneous tactile measurements, we propose NeoForce, a visuo-tactile representation model that learn transferable tactile representations across different sensor designs. To enable systematic evaluation of tactile embodied models built upon our infrastructure, datasets and tactile representations, we further propose a comprehensive benchmark, which combines the real-world NeoReal suite and the simulated NeoSim suite for standardized evaluation. Experiments across both suites show that policies benefit from the physical contact state rather than from the device-specific appearance of the tactile signal. We release the dataset, the representation, and the benchmark, aiming at supporting future work on tactile-enabled embodied manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出N₀-Foundation范式，构建了触觉感知驱动的具身操作完整体系，包括触觉传感器、大规模多模态数据收集基础设施、30000小时视觉-触觉同步演示数据集（NeoData及5000小时开源子集OpenNeoData）、跨传感器触觉表征模型NeoForce，以及结合真实与仿真环境的标准化评测基准（NeoReal与NeoSim）。
AI.motivation: 现有操作数据集主要依赖视觉信息，缺乏对触觉信号的建模，而这对于可变形物体操作、精密装配、精细力控和持续表面交互等任务至关重要。作者旨在填补触觉驱动的具身操作研究中数据规模、表征学习和标准化评估的系统性空白。
AI.method: 1) 工程化可扩展数据收集基础设施：基于视觉的触觉传感器、触觉UMI接口、支持机器人本体与UMI演示的同步视觉-触觉数据收集系统；2) 构建30000小时多模态数据集NeoData（6种本体、450个任务、数十亿配对RGB与触觉帧）；3) 提出NeoForce视觉-触觉表征模型，学习可跨传感器迁移的触觉表征；4) 提出包含NeoReal真实套件和NeoSim仿真套件的综合评测基准。
AI.result: 实验表明，策略受益于物理接触状态而非触觉信号的设备特定外观，验证了触觉表征的跨传感器可迁移性和数据规模对触觉具身模型性能的促进作用。
AI.conclusion: 作者开放了数据集、表征模型和基准，旨在为触觉驱动的具身操作未来研究提供标准化基础设施，推动该领域从零散探索走向规模化、系统化发展。

title: Pro-Router: Token-Aware Progressive Model Routing with Adaptive Edge-Cloud Collaboration for Efficient Multimodal LLM Inference
summary: The remarkable performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) comes at the cost of substantial computational overhead, posing significant challenges to real-time deployment and cost effectiveness. Existing model routing approaches either decide from coarse request-level features alone or spend one or several extra language model passes to inspect the generated response, leaving the token-level uncertainty signals that emerge during generation unused. To address these limitations, we propose Pro-Router, a token-aware progressive model routing method with adaptive edge-cloud collaboration for efficient multimodal LLM inference. Pro-Router employs a two-stage progressive decision mechanism. First, a lightweight prompt pre-scorer module performs rapid pre-screening before token generation begins, guiding apparently simple requests to small models. Second, a token-aware verifier reads the sampling probability distribution of each token the small model generates, estimating the model's confidence in its own output to determine, per request, whether the answer ships or escalates to the cloud-based high-precision model. Furthermore, we design an adaptive edge-cloud serving pipeline that sizes every dispatch to each device's measured service rate, so both the edge and the cloud tiers stay fully utilized without manual parameter tuning and are not impacted by the network latency. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal benchmark datasets and models demonstrate the effectiveness of Pro-Router. Compared to other methods, it achieves the highest routing accuracy and improves routing speed by more than 10x. Its serving pipeline also reaches more than 75% higher end-to-end throughput than the existing model routing pipeline. Our code is available at https://github.com/xinyuangui2/pro-router.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Pro-Router，一种基于token感知的渐进式模型路由方法，结合边缘-云自适应协作，用于高效多模态大模型推理。它通过两阶段决策：轻量级预评分器进行快速预筛选，以及token感知验证器利用生成过程中的采样概率分布来评估小模型置信度，决定是否升级到云端高精度模型。实验表明其路由准确率最高、速度提升10倍以上，端到端吞吐量提升75%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型计算开销巨大，实时部署和成本效益面临挑战。现有模型路由方法要么仅基于粗粒度的请求级特征做决策，要么花费额外的一次或多次语言模型传递来检查生成响应，未能利用生成过程中涌现的token级不确定性信号。
AI.method: Pro-Router采用两阶段渐进式决策机制：1）轻量级prompt预评分器在token生成前快速预筛选，将简单请求路由到小模型；2）token感知验证器读取小模型生成每个token时的采样概率分布，评估模型对自身输出的置信度，逐请求决定答案直接返回还是升级到云端高精度模型。此外，设计了自适应边缘-云服务流水线，根据每个设备的实测服务速率校准每次调度，保证边缘和云端两个层级充分利用，无需手动调参且不受网络延迟影响。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准数据集和模型上，Pro-Router取得最高的路由准确度，路由速度比其他方法提升10倍以上；其服务流水线相比现有模型路由流水线端到端吞吐量提升超过75%。
AI.conclusion: Pro-Router有效利用了生成过程中token级的置信度信号，结合自适应边缘-云协作，在保证路由准确度的同时大幅提升路由速度和系统吞吐量，为多模态LLM的高效推理部署提供了可行方案。

title: BlobBoards: Robust Markers for Accurate Pose
summary: We propose BlobBoards, a fiducial marker system comprising a dense, multi-scale field of Gaussian blobs and a feature-based pipeline for joint detection, identification, and pose estimation. Each board is registered from hundreds of blob features whose dense spatial coverage constrains pose, while multiple scales preserve detectability across large changes in focal length, distance, and obliquity. Learned local descriptors are matched to the reference pattern and spatially verified, so the correspondences determine pose and certify identity. Against motion-capture ground truth, BlobBoards achieve median translation errors of 3.6-5.0 mm, reducing AprilTag's median translation error by 89% on small boards and 70% on large ones. They also produce far fewer large-rotation failures than state-of-the-art tag systems. BlobBoards achieve the highest detection rate, 80% versus 74% for AprilTag and 58% for ArUco, with the largest margin on the smallest markers. Under 50% occlusion, they still detect 69% of boards with essentially unchanged median translation error, while AprilTag and ArUco detect none. In experiments BlobBoards give state-of-the-art detection rate, pose accuracy and occlusion robustness.

AI.tldr: BlobBoards是一种基于高斯斑点密集多尺度场的基准标记系统，通过特征检测流水线联合完成检测、识别和姿态估计。相比AprilTag等现有系统，在定位精度、旋转鲁棒性、检测率和遮挡鲁棒性上均达到最优。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准标记系统（如AprilTag、ArUco）在小标记、大视角变化和遮挡场景下存在检测率低、姿态估计误差大、大旋转失效等问题，难以满足高精度视觉定位的需求。
AI.method: 1) 设计密集、多尺度的高斯斑点场作为基准标记；2) 利用密集斑点的空间覆盖约束姿态估计；3) 多尺度设计保证在不同焦距、距离和斜视角下的可检测性；4) 使用学习得到的局部描述子匹配参考图案，并通过空间验证建立对应关系，从而同时确定姿态和认证身份。
AI.result: 在动捕真值下，BlobBoards的中位平移误差为3.6-5.0mm，在小板和大板上分别将AprilTag的中位平移误差降低89%和70%；大旋转失败远少于现有系统；检测率达80%（AprilTag 74%、ArUco 58%），在最小标记上优势最大；50%遮挡下仍能检测69%的板且精度几乎不变，而AprilTag和ArUco完全失效。
AI.conclusion: BlobBoards在检测率、姿态精度和遮挡鲁棒性三方面均达到最先进水平，是现有基准标记系统（尤其在小标记和遮挡场景下）的有力替代方案。

title: VeloBins: Learning Velocity and Its Uncertainty via Bins and Error-Conditioned Gaussian Labels for Aerial Inertial Odometry
