comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/QkZY0So3myw
summary: Inertial odometry (IO) is critical for aerial robots, where aggressive maneuvers and poor lighting degrade visual sensors. Recent learning-based IO methods improve traditional integration-based approaches by learning motion priors from IMU and platform-specific sensors, then fusing the predictions within an extended Kalman filter. However, learning velocity through regression is difficult, while jointly estimating uncertainty with a separate decoder and negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss further complicates training and can lead to over-confident estimates. We introduce VeloBins, which reformulates velocity regression as classification over discretized velocity bins. We decode both the velocity from the bin distribution's expectation and the uncertainty from its variance, removing the need for a separate uncertainty decoder. We further supervise the uncertainty explicitly using an error-conditioned Gaussian label centered at the ground-truth velocity, with a standard deviation set to the velocity error. We evaluate VeloBins on four aerial datasets, ranging from free-form aggressive flights and a 27 g nano-quadrotor to drone racing at over 21~m/s. VeloBins achieves the lowest average errors on all four datasets, reducing velocity, relative trajectory, and absolute trajectory errors by 3-27%, 8-40%, and 6-53%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline. Notably, the proposed supervision achieves the lowest NLL and best filter consistency despite never optimizing an NLL loss. The code will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: VeloBins将惯性里程计中的速度回归问题重构为离散速度箱的分类问题，通过箱分布的期望解码速度、方差解码不确定性，消除了独立不确定性解码器的需要。它使用以真实速度为中心、标准差为速度误差的高斯标签显式监督不确定性。在四个空中数据集（从自由飞行的激进机动、27克纳米四旋翼到超过21m/s的无人机竞速）上，VeloBins在速度、相对轨迹和绝对轨迹误差上分别降低了3-27%、8-40%和6-53%，且在不优化NLL损失的情况下达到了最低NLL和最佳滤波器一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于学习的惯性里程计方法通过回归来学习速度较为困难，而通过单独的解码器和负对数似然损失联合估计不确定性会使训练复杂化并导致过度自信的估计。作者希望设计一种更简单、更鲁棒的方案来同时估计速度和不确定性。
AI.method: VeloBins将速度回归重构为离散速度箱上的分类问题。从箱分布的期望解码速度，从方差解码不确定性，无需额外的不确定性解码器。不确定性监督采用误差条件的高斯标签，以真实速度为均值、速度误差为标准差。
AI.result: 在四个空中数据集上，VeloBins相比最强基线将速度误差降低3-27%、相对轨迹误差降低8-40%、绝对轨迹误差降低6-53%。同时在不优化NLL损失的情况下取得最低NLL和最佳滤波器一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将回归转化为分类并利用方差显式监督不确定性是一种有效且简洁的方案，既提升了精度又改善了滤波器一致性，表明该范式优于传统的回归+独立不确定性解码的方法。

title: PermitGPT: A Unified Generative-AI Pipeline for Construction Hazard Forecasting, Permit Prediction, and Community Impact
comment: 1 figure, 3 tables, Accepted at 2026 International Conference on Power, Electronics, Communications, Computing, and Intelligent Infrastructure (PECCII)
summary: Urban construction governance requires early decisions that connect workplace safety, permitting requirements, and community impact, yet the relevant evidence is often scattered across separate municipal and regulatory data sources. This paper presents PermitGPT, a unified generative artificial intelligence framework for converting unstructured construction permit descriptions into structured decision-support outputs across three domains: safety hazard identification, permit requirement specification, and community impact assessment. To address data fragmentation, we spatially and temporally align records from the New York City Department of Buildings, Occupational Safety and Health Administration, and NYC 311 service requests, producing 90,000 structured prompt-response pairs derived through rule-based alignment and domain-informed spot checking. We fine-tune three open-weight language models using parameter-efficient adaptation and evaluate them on 2,833 held-out test cases. The results show complementary model behavior: Gemma-3-1B provides the most efficient inference at 3.07 samples per second with low memory usage, Llama-3.2-3B gives the highest lexical overlap for regulatory-style outputs with a BLEU score of 0.0091, and 4-bit Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 achieves the strongest semantic alignment with a BERTScore-F1 of 0.7747. Because the task involves open-ended structured generation, low BLEU values are interpreted alongside semantic metrics and qualitative output structure rather than as standalone indicators of utility. Overall, PermitGPT provides an initial step toward AI-assisted construction governance while identifying directions for stronger task-level evaluation and real-world validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PermitGPT，一个统一的生成式AI框架，用于将非结构化的施工许可描述转化为三个领域的结构化决策支持输出：安全危险识别、许可要求规范和社区影响评估。通过空间和时间对齐纽约市建筑局、OSHA和311服务请求的数据，构建了90,000个提示-响应对，并微调了三个开源语言模型进行对比评估。
AI.motivation: 城市施工治理需要早期决策，涉及施工安全、许可要求和社区影响多个方面，但这些相关信息分散在不同的市政和监管数据源中，缺乏统一的证据整合和分析框架。
AI.method: 采用规则导向对齐和领域知情的抽查方法，将NYC建管局、OSHA和311服务请求的数据进行时空对齐，生成90,000个结构化提示-响应对；使用参数高效微调三种开源语言模型（Gemma-3-1B, Llama-3.2-3B, Mistral-7B）；在2,833个测试用例上评估。
AI.result: 三个模型表现互补：Gemma-3-1B推理效率最高（3.07样本/秒，低内存占用）；Llama-3.2-3B在法规风格输出上词汇重叠最高（BLEU 0.0091）；4-bit Mistral-7B在语义对齐上最强（BERTScore-F1 0.7747）。
AI.conclusion: PermitGPT为AI辅助施工治理提供了初步探索，识别了更强的任务级评估和真实世界验证的方向；由于开放式结构化生成任务，低BLEU值需结合语义指标和定性输出结构综合解读。

title: MWIR-4-Plastic: The Identification of Complex End-of-Life Industrial Plastic using Mid-wave Infrared Hyperspectral Imaging and Machine Learning
summary: The automated sorting of shredded black plastics from end-of-life (EOF) industrial waste presents a significant challenge in recycling facilities, primarily due to the limitations of current sensing and analytical approaches. Existing studies predominantly rely on single-point contact-based mid-infrared spectroscopy or laboratory hyperspectral imaging (HSI) setups, which fail to provide the spatially resolved analysis necessary for fast, bulk processing. Moreover, available datasets are laboratory-controlled and focus on intact rather than shredded plastics, hindering further recycling refinement. Black industrial plastics, in particular, are underrepresented, while most classification pipelines depend on manual region selection and rule-based spectral matching, neglecting spatial information and modern deep learning (DL) methods. To address these gaps, we introduce the first publicly available HSI dataset of shredded black plastics from EOF vehicle, comprising four industrial polymers across 13 co-registered RGB, VNIR, SWIR, and MWIR scenes and their segmentation pipeline. We developed a multi-modal spectral-spatial framework that integrates foreground isolation, pixel-wise classification, and object-level majority voting. By adapting advanced hyperspectral transformers from earth observation and incorporating chemometric band selection, we achieve accurate classification of complex black plastics. The study establishes the first comprehensive benchmark using nine processing methods, including chemometric, machine learning, and DL architectures. To ensure reproducibility, the complete dataset and methodologies are publicly released, establishing a benchmark for a hyperspectral object-analysis pipeline in industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了第一个公开的破碎黑色塑料高光谱图像(HSI)数据集，来自报废车辆的四种工业聚合物，包含RGB、VNIR、SWIR和MWIR共13个配准场景。同时开发了一个多模态光谱-空间框架，结合前景隔离、像素级分类和对象级多数投票，并适配地球观测领域的超光谱Transformer和化学计量波段选择，建立了涵盖九种处理方法的综合基准。
AI.motivation: 现有的黑色塑料分拣研究受限于单点接触式中红外光谱或实验室高光谱成像，缺乏空间分辨率分析能力，无法满足快速批量处理需求；现有数据集为实验室控制条件且集中于完整而非破碎塑料，黑色工业塑料代表性不足；分类流程依赖手动区域选择和基于规则的谱匹配，忽视了空间信息和现代深度学习方法。
AI.method: 构建了首个公开的破碎黑色塑料HSI数据集（4种工业聚合物、13个多模态配准场景），开发了多模态光谱-空间框架：包括前景隔离、像素级分类和对象级多数投票三个步骤；通过适配地球观测领域的超光谱Transformer并结合化学计量波段选择来实现精确分类；建立了包含化学计量学、机器学习和深度学习架构共九种方法的综合基准。
AI.result: 通过融合多模态光谱-空间信息和先进Transformer架构，实现对复杂黑色塑料的准确分类；建立了首个综合基准，验证了九种不同处理方法在破碎黑色塑料识别上的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了破碎黑色塑料高光谱数据集空白，验证了结合先进深度学习与多模态光谱策略在工业检测中的有效性，并通过公开数据集和方法论建立了工业检测中超光谱目标分析管道的基准，推动回收精细化发展。

title: DriftingVLA: Native One-Step Vision-Language-Action Generation via Per-Dimension Temporal Drifting
summary: Conventional flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models support expressive continuous action generation but rely on multi-step refinement to produce each action chunk, increasing latency in online robot control. To address this issue, we introduce DriftingVLA, a native one-step VLA that generates a complete action chunk with a single action-expert forward pass. Rather than learning a flow field that requires iterative integration at inference, DriftingVLA uses a distribution-drifting objective to learn a direct noise-to-action-chunk mapping for one-step deployment. Since robot action dimensions carry distinct control semantics and distributional characteristics, we further introduce Per-Dimension Temporal Drifting (PDTD). PDTD treats the complete temporal trajectory of each action dimension as a separate drifting unit, enabling finer-grained modeling and shaping of dimension-specific action distributions. This per-dimension decomposition applies only to the training objective; the shared VLA model still generates the complete action chunk jointly, thereby preserving cross-dimensional dependencies. DriftingVLA achieves 98.32% success on LIBERO, 81.09% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 77.67% across six real-world single- and dual-arm tasks, outperforming the evaluated multi-step flow policy and one-step VLA baselines. Native one-step deployment also delivers a 3.36-fold speedup in action-chunk generation, eliminating iterative refinement without sacrificing control performance.

AI.tldr: 提出DriftingVLA，一种原生单步视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，通过分布漂移目标直接学习噪声到动作块的映射，避免多步迭代精化带来的推理延迟，在多个基准上取得优异性能并实现3.36倍加速。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于流的VLA模型虽然支持表达性强的连续动作生成，但生成每个动作块需要多步精化迭代，这在在线机器人控制中引入了显著的延迟问题，需要一种无需迭代采样的原生单步方案。
AI.method: 1) 采用分布漂移目标(distribution-drifting objective)学习直接噪声到动作块的映射，替代需要迭代积分的流场；2) 引入Per-Dimension Temporal Drifting (PDTD)，将每个动作维度的完整时间轨迹视为独立的漂移单元进行细粒度建模；3) 该分解仅作用于训练目标，推理时共享VLA模型仍联合生成完整动作块，保持跨维度依赖。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上达到98.32%成功率，RoboTwin 2.0上81.09%，六个真实世界单双机械臂任务上77.67%，优于多步流策略和单步VLA基线；单步部署带来3.36倍动作块生成加速。
AI.conclusion: 原生单步部署能够消除迭代精化过程而不牺牲控制性能，验证了分布漂移与按维度时序漂移建模在VLA动作生成中的有效性。

title: Efficient Geothermal Well-Control Optimization via Diffusion-Surrogate Reinforcement Learning
summary: Real-time decision-making for enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) is challenging because long-term production periods involve high-dimensional control spaces and a large number of time-consuming high-fidelity hydrothermal simulations. Reinforcement learning provides a natural framework for state-dependent sequential control, but direct policy training with numerical simulators is computationally expensive. To address this issue, we propose a diffusion-surrogate guided reinforcement learning framework for long-horizon EGS well-control optimization. The reservoir temperature and pressure fields are used as system states, while injection rates are selected as control actions. A learned surrogate environment is constructed using conditional diffusion models to predict the evolution of reservoir temperature and pressure fields and a separate reward model to estimate the corresponding economic return. The surrogate environment is then integrated with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for efficient policy training. Experiments on a fractured EGS benchmark show that the diffusion surrogate can accurately reproduce reservoir-state evolution over multiple control stages. The resulting surrogate-assisted PPO policy achieves competitive well-control performance compared with direct simulator-based PPO and existing optimization methods, while substantially reducing the dependence on expensive high-fidelity simulations. These results demonstrate the potential of diffusion-based surrogate environments for efficient reinforcement learning in geothermal well-control optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散代理模型的强化学习框架（diffusion-surrogate guided RL），用于增强型地热系统（EGS）的长期井控优化。该框架使用条件扩散模型预测储层温度和压力场的演化作为代理环境，并结合PPO算法进行高效策略训练，在降低对高保真数值模拟依赖的同时，实现了与直接模拟器训练相当的井控性能。
AI.motivation: EGS实时决策面临两大挑战：长期生产涉及高维控制空间，以及大量耗时的保真水热模拟计算成本过高。虽然强化学习天然适合状态依赖的序贯控制，但直接使用数值模拟器进行策略训练的计算开销巨大，亟需一种更高效的训练途径。
AI.method: 1）以储层温度和压力场作为系统状态，注入速率作为控制动作；2）构建条件扩散模型作为代理环境，预测储层温度和压力场的演化；3）另设奖励模型估计对应的经济回报；4）将代理环境与Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)集成，实现高效策略训练。
AI.result: 在裂缝性EGS基准测试中，扩散代理模型能够准确再现多个控制阶段的储层状态演化。代理辅助的PPO策略在井控性能上与直接基于模拟器的PPO及现有优化方法相当，同时大幅减少了对昂贵高保真模拟的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型作为代理环境在EGS井控优化的强化学习中展现出巨大潜力，能够在保持良好优化性能的同时显著降低计算成本，为地热等复杂地下系统的实时决策提供了高效可行的新途径。

title: Pixel-wise Geo-registration of Drone and Satellite Images
summary: Pixel-level cross-view geo-registration aims to align a query image (e.g., drone) to a geo-referenced satellite map so that every query pixel can be mapped to real-world GPS coordinates. Despite strong progress in cross-view geo-localization, existing benchmarks largely provide only GPS labels, limiting evaluation to a single coordinate per image and leaving dense geodetic alignment underexplored. We introduce SkyReg, a dataset and standardized benchmark for pixel-level drone-to-satellite geo-registration, providing dense per-pixel geo-location supervision across diverse settings (orthographic and perspective), scene types (urban, landmark-centric, suburban/rural), and camera configurations. Using SkyReg, we evaluate a broad set of baselines spanning retrieval, feature matching, homography-based alignment, and feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Finally, cross-view pairs from SkyReg, we train a geometry-aware reconstruction pipeline that achieves state-of-the-art results,improving performance by a significant margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkyReg，一个用于像素级无人机到卫星图像地理配准的数据集和标准化基准，提供密集的逐像素地理定位监督，覆盖多种场景和相机配置，并训练了一个几何感知的重建管线取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位基准仅提供GPS标签，只能评估每张图像一个坐标，导致密集的地理配准对齐问题未被充分探索，缺乏逐像素级别的监督数据。
AI.method: 构建SkyReg数据集，提供密集逐像素地理定位监督，涵盖正射和透视两种成像方式、城市/地标/郊区等多种场景类型及不同相机配置；在此基础上训练几何感知的重建管线。
AI.result: 在SkyReg上评估了检索、特征匹配、单应性对齐和前馈3D重建等广泛基线，所提出的几何感知重建管线达到最先进水平，性能提升显著。
AI.conclusion: SkyReg填补了像素级跨视角地理配准领域缺乏密集标注基准的空白，并为该任务提供了标准化的评估平台和强基线方法。

title: LARC: Lazy Adaptive Reachability Certification of Robot Manipulator Trajectories
summary: Discrete trajectory checks can miss collisions between sampled robot states. Reachability-based certification bounds motion between states, but uniform time partitions waste computation where clearance is large. We present lazy adaptive reachability certification (LARC), which checks a planned trajectory by bisecting only intervals with an inconclusive clearance test. For piecewise-cubic Hermite joint trajectories, the method bounds link occupancy using midpoint capsules inflated by exact componentwise speed maxima. Certified intervals covering the trajectory provide continuous-time external-obstacle clearance, subject to geometric containment, static obstacles, and a prescribed margin. On 160 AgileX PIPER trajectories from 80 start-goal pairs, LARC matched all decisions of the fixed-fine baseline at depth nine. It used 20328 interval evaluations (24.8% of baseline work), with a median paired speedup of 10.28x. A separate MoveIt/FCL audit checked 158051 states and detected collisions in 21 direct-interpolation controls, none of which LARC certified. The method reduced computation under a shared certificate model, but 27 of 139 sampled-clear trajectories remained uncertified. The sampled audit cannot independently prove continuous-time clearance.

AI.tldr: 提出LARC方法，通过懒惰自适应二分轨迹区间进行可达性认证，在保持与固定精细基线相同决策结果的同时，将区间评估计算量减少至24.8%，中位加速10.28倍。
AI.motivation: 离散轨迹检查可能遗漏机器人状态之间的碰撞，而基于可达性的认证虽然能约束状态间的运动，但均匀时间划分在间隙较大的区域浪费计算资源。
AI.method: 采用懒惰自适应可达性认证（LARC），只对清除测试不确定的区间进行二分。对于分段三次Hermite关节轨迹，使用中点胶囊和精确分量速度最大值来约束连杆占用空间。
AI.result: 在160条AgileX PIPER轨迹上，LARC匹配了深度9固定精细基线的所有决策，仅使用20328次区间评估（基线工作的24.8%），中位配对加速10.28倍。MoveIt/FCL审计检测到21个直接插值控制中的碰撞，均未被LARC认证。
AI.conclusion: LARC在共享认证模型下减少了计算量，但139个采样清除轨迹中有27个仍未被认证，且采样审计无法独立证明连续时间清除性。

title: Enhancing SAE-based Steering via Neighbor Integrated Feature Selection
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) disentangle model activations into interpretable features and are widely used for steering large language models. Most existing SAE-based steering methods select features by applying a top- filter based on statistical scores, assuming that higher-scoring features yield stronger steering effects. In this paper, we show that this assumption is often invalid, leading to suboptimal feature selection. Our analysis reveals that effective steering features may be distributed among representationally adjacent, semantically similar groups induced by feature splitting in SAEs. Within such groups, features may exhibit disparate statistical scores despite having comparable steering influence, causing score-based selection to overlook important features. Based on these observations, we propose \textsc{Neighbor Integrated Feature Selection} (\textsc{NIFS}), a plug-and-play strategy that leverages representation similarity to improve feature selection for steering. We evaluate \textsc{NIFS} across multiple SAE-based steering methods and tasks, and demonstrate consistent performance gains over conventional top-$k$ selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为NIFS（Neighbor Integrated Feature Selection）的即插即用特征选择策略，用于改善基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的大语言模型引导（steering）效果。作者发现现有基于统计分数top-k筛选特征的假设（高分特征即强引导效果）常常失效，因为有效引导特征可能分布在表征相邻、语义相似的特征组中，且组内分数差异大而引导效果相近。NIFS利用表征相似性改进特征选择，在多个SAE引导方法和任务上一致超越了传统top-k选择。
AI.motivation: 现有的SAE-based引导方法依赖统计分数进行top-k特征筛选，但这一假设并不总是成立，导致特征选择欠优。作者通过分析发现，SAE特征分裂（feature splitting）会产生表征相邻、语义相似的特征组，组内各特征统计分数差异显著但引导影响相当，使得基于分数的筛选会漏掉重要特征。
AI.method: 提出NIFS（Neighbor Integrated Feature Selection），一种即插即用的策略，利用特征间的表征相似性来改进引导任务中的特征选择。该策略可集成到现有的SAE-based引导方法中，通过聚合相邻相似特征的信息来替代单纯的top-k分数筛选。
AI.result: 在多个SAE-based引导方法和任务上评估NIFS，实验结果表明相对于传统的top-k特征选择方法，NIFS一致性地带来了性能提升。
AI.conclusion: NIFS证明了仅依赖统计分数选择SAE特征用于引导是不够的，利用表征相似性可以更有效地识别具有引导影响力的特征，为进一步提升SAE-based模型引导的效果提供了新思路。

title: ReconSplat: Generalizable 3D Scene Reconstruction Beyond Observed Views
comment: ECCV 2026. Code and additional visual results are available on our project page: https://visinf.github.io/reconsplat
summary: We introduce ReconSplat, a feed-forward model for 3D scene reconstruction that aims to address the longstanding trade-off between plausible view generation for unobserved regions and geometric consistency, providing both geometrically aligned novel views and sharp depth estimates. Our approach builds on 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) as an intermediate differentiable scene representation and integrates it with a multi-view latent diffusion model (MV-LDM) trained to act simultaneously as a refiner and an inpainter for appearance and scene geometry. We enforce geometric consistency by guiding the diffusion process with variational 3D latent features for appearance and geometry, encoded by the feed-forward 3DGS representation and rasterized to 2D latent space. ReconSplat produces both photorealistic novel views and accurate depth maps on real-world benchmarks, RealEstate10K and DL3DV-10K, outperforming existing methods in challenging extrapolation setups. Notably, ReconSplat allows the extrapolation of unseen and challenging viewpoints jointly with coherent and precise scene geometry.

AI.tldr: ReconSplat是一个前馈式3D场景重建模型，以3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）作为中间可微场景表示，并集成多视角潜在扩散模型（MV-LDM），同时充当外观和场景几何的精炼器与修复器，从而在未观测区域的新视角生成与几何一致性之间取得平衡，实现几何对齐的新视角和锐利深度估计。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在3D场景重建中面临两难困境：一方面要生成未观测区域的合理新视角（需要生成能力），另一方面要保持几何一致性（需要重建精度）。作者希望同时解决这两个问题，而非在两者之间做权衡。
AI.method: 1) 以3DGS作为中间可微场景表示；2) 集成多视角潜在扩散模型（MV-LDM），同时作为外观和几何的精炼器与修复器；3) 通过变分3D潜在特征（包含外观与几何）引导扩散过程，这些特征由前馈3DGS表示编码并光栅化到2D潜在空间，从而强制几何一致性。
AI.result: 在真实世界基准RealEstate10K和DL3DV-10K上，ReconSplat生成的神经辐射场新视角具有真实感，深度估计准确，在具有挑战性的外推（extrapolation）设置下优于现有方法。尤其能够在推断未见过的困难视角时，同时保持连贯且精确的场景几何。
AI.conclusion: ReconSplat证明了通过将可微3DGS表示与多视角潜在扩散模型相结合，可以有效解决新视角生成与几何一致性之间的冲突，实现既能外推未观测视角又保持几何精确的场景重建。

title: SmoothRL: Online Reinforcement Learning During Asynchronous Execution
summary: Deploying robot policies in the physical world requires satisfying two fundamental desiderata: reliability and smooth real-time execution. However, deploying state-of-the-art generalist models presents challenges on both fronts. Achieving the precision and robustness required for real-world deployment necessitates sample-efficient online reinforcement learning (RL) to adapt pretrained models. Meanwhile, the increasing scale of robot foundation models has led to higher inference latency. To satisfy real-time constraints under high latency, modern systems adopt asynchronous inference with action chunking, overlapping policy computation with chunk execution to hide latency and enable smooth control. Despite their complementary roles, integrating asynchronous execution with gradient-based online RL remains underexplored. We present SmoothRL, an online RL framework that fine-tunes a pretrained policy within an asynchronous inference loop. SmoothRL follows a value-gradient paradigm, directly updating policy parameters using gradients of the action-value function with respect to policy actions. To enable correct optimization under asynchronous execution, SmoothRL explicitly models the asynchronous inference process during training. Specifically, each generated action chunk is partitioned by frame index into three regions: a committed region, consisting of actions committed by the previous inference cycle; an execution region, containing newly generated actions executed by the robot; and a discarded region, containing actions superseded by the next inference cycle. Gradients are propagated only through the execution region, ensuring policy optimization aligns with the trajectory distribution induced by asynchronous execution. We evaluate SmoothRL on real-world robotic tasks requiring high precision, as well as highly dynamic tasks that necessitate asynchronous execution.

AI.tldr: SmoothRL是一个在线强化学习框架，用于在异步推理循环中微调预训练策略，通过显式建模异步推理过程（将动作块分为提交区、执行区和丢弃区）确保策略优化与异步执行产生的轨迹分布对齐，实现高精度和实时平滑控制。
AI.motivation: 现实世界部署机器人策略需兼顾可靠性和平滑实时执行，但现有通用模型在精度和推理延迟两方面均存挑战。虽然异步推理与动作分块可隐藏延迟，但如何将其与基于梯度的在线强化学习整合仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: SmoothRL采用值梯度范式，直接利用动作价值函数对策略动作的梯度更新策略参数。训练时显式建模异步推理过程，将每个生成的动作块按帧索引划分为三个区域：已提交区域（前一推理周期已提交的动作）、执行区域（新生成并由机器人执行的动作）和丢弃区域（被下一推理周期取代的动作），仅在执行区域传播梯度，确保策略优化与异步执行诱导的轨迹分布对齐。
AI.result: 该框架在需要高精度的真实世界机器人任务以及需要异步执行的高度动态任务上进行了评估。
AI.conclusion: SmoothRL通过将异步执行与在线RL正确集成，弥合了精度需求与实时执行需求之间的鸿沟，为预训练机器人策略在现实世界的高效适应提供了一种统一的优化范式。

title: Capability-Stratified Degradation in Ternary Language Models
summary: Extreme low-bit inference offers a route toward smaller models and constrained deployment. Ternary language models restrict weights to $\{-1,0,+1\}$, approaching the limit of $\log_2 3 \approx 1.585$ bits/weight. The practical question for a pretrained model is not simply whether weights can be quantised but which capabilities survive and whether it remains useful for adaptation. We explore this by converting Qwen3.5-0.8B (752M parameters) to ternary weights using 72.4M tokens of quantisation-aware training (QAT). The resulting model, Cloe, is evaluated across 29 benchmarks, representation diagnostics, and downstream fine-tuning. The evidence shows non-uniform degradation. A linear probe recovers 43.76% of MMLU answers from the full-precision teacher's representations but only 26.19% from Cloe (near chance), indicating specialist factual information is lost. However, Cloe retains measurable performance on ten tasks, averaging 77.1% of teacher performance. Crucially, fine-tuning raises Cloe to 89.8% on SST-2 (95.6% of the matched teacher) and reaches 79.4% teacher retention on XSum. We attribute degradation to a combination of quantisation-induced information loss and incomplete recovery due to the limited QAT budget. We also highlight an evaluation pitfall: standard answer-letter scoring failed (Cloe emitted "A" on 98.6% of MMLU questions), necessitating continuation scoring. Ultimately, ternary conversion is unsuitable as a drop-in general replacement yet remains valuable as a compact substrate for task-specific models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将预训练模型Qwen3.5-0.8B通过量化感知训练(QAT)转换为三值权重模型Cloe（约1.585 bits/权重），并在29个基准、表征诊断和下游微调中评估其能力保留情况。结果显示能力退化呈非均匀分布：事实性信息大量丢失（MMLU仅达随机水平），但保留了10个任务的可测性能（平均为教师模型的77.1%），且下游微调可显著恢复性能（SST-2达教师模型的95.6%）。作者指出三值转换不适合作通用替代品，但可作为任务特定模型的紧凑基座。
AI.motivation: 极端低位推理有望实现更小的模型和受限部署，三值语言模型将权重限制在{-1,0,+1}，接近log2(3)≈1.585 bits/权重的极限。然而关键问题不仅是权重能否量化，而是预训练模型量化后哪些能力得以保留、是否仍可用于适配。作者旨在系统性地回答这个问题。
AI.method: 将Qwen3.5-0.8B（752M参数）转换为三值权重，使用72.4M token进行量化感知训练(QAT)得到Cloe模型。评估方法包括：29个基准测试、线性探针表征诊断、以及下游任务微调实验。同时作者发现并处理了标准答案字母评分失效的问题（Cloe在MMLU中98.6%都输出"A"），改用续写评分（continuation scoring）。
AI.result: 关键发现：（1）线性探针从全精度教师表征恢复43.76%的MMLU答案，而Cloe仅恢复26.19%（接近随机），表明专家事实信息丢失；（2）Cloe在10个任务上保留可测性能，平均为教师模型的77.1%；（3）微调后Cloe在SST-2上达到89.8%（为匹配教师的95.6%），在XSum上保留79.4%的教师性能；（4）退化源于量化导致的信息损失加上有限QAT预算带来的不完整恢复。
AI.conclusion: 三值转换并非通用的即插即用替代方案，但作为任务特定模型的紧凑基座具有重要价值。该工作揭示了极端量化下能力保留的非均匀性，并为评估低位量化模型提供了方法学警示（如答案字母评分陷阱）。

title: Coarse to Fine: Iterative Adversarial Neural Cellular Automata for Medical Image Synthesis
summary: Large-scale, publicly available datasets have driven advances in deep learning, but privacy and legal restrictions often limit data sharing in medical imaging. Synthetic data generation offers a privacy-friendly alternative to enable the training of high-performance models on health data. While most state-of-the-art generative models produce high-quality images, they remain computationally expensive, which limits their applicability on resource-constrained hardware. We propose StyleGANCA, the first lightweight general-purpose NCA-based generative adversarial network. The architecture integrates a StyleGAN-inspired mapping network and adaptive style modulation into a multi-scale NCA synthesis process, enabling latent-controlled image generation through iterative local interactions. We evaluate StyleGANCA on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST against adversarial, variational, diffusion, and NCA-based baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that StyleGANCA achieves competitive image quality with substantially fewer parameters than baseline architectures, achieving the best FID and KID scores on PathMNIST with only 617k parameters. Furthermore, downstream experiments show that the generated images preserve class-specific information and effectively support the training of multi-class classifiers. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/MECLabTUDA/StyleGANCA

AI.tldr: 提出StyleGANCA，首个轻量级基于NCA的通用生成对抗网络，结合StyleGAN风格映射与自适应风格调制到多尺度NCA合成过程，在医疗影像数据集上以极少参数达到竞争性图像质量。
AI.motivation: 医疗影像领域数据共享受隐私和法律限制，合成数据生成是隐私友好的替代方案。但现有最先进的生成模型虽然图像质量高，却计算开销大，难以在资源受限硬件上部署。
AI.method: 将StyleGAN风格的映射网络和自适应风格调制集成到多尺度NCA（神经细胞自动机）合成过程中，通过迭代局部交互实现潜变量控制的图像生成，构建轻量级GAN架构StyleGANCA。
AI.result: 在BloodMNIST和PathMNIST上与对抗、变分、扩散及NCA基线对比，StyleGANCA以仅617k参数在PathMNIST上取得最佳FID和KID分数；下游实验表明生成图像保留类别信息并有效支持多类分类器训练。
AI.conclusion: StyleGANCA证明了轻量级NCA架构与StyleGAN风格建模结合可以兼顾图像质量和参数效率，为资源受限场景下的医疗影像合成提供了可行方案。

title: Learning Agile Perceptive Traversal of Sparse 3D Structures for Humanoids
summary: Traversing sparse 3D structures requires humanoid robots to perceive thin, overhanging geometry while executing agile, accurate whole-body motions. We study this problem through monkey-bar traversal, where the robot must jump to the structure, traverse it through sparse bar interactions, and land safely. For this task, we present a reinforcement-learning-based perceptive control system that operates directly on observations from a head-mounted solid-state lidar. To extract task-relevant geometry from the sparse returns, the policy consumes the raw lidar scan through an attention-based encoder with recurrent memory. This policy is obtained by a phase-scheduled teacher- student pipeline that combines privileged experts for jumping up, brachiating, and jumping down. For transfer to hardware, we model lidar noise, battery-voltage sag, and actuator thermal limits, and equip the humanoid with passive hook end-effectors for robust bar interaction. On hardware, the resulting policy completes the full jump-up->brachiation->jump-down sequence in 14 of 15 trials across three bar configurations and reaches brachiation speeds up to 0.5 m/s. Beyond brachiation, the same perception backbone supports a separately trained policy that ducks beneath thin overhead obstacles with 2 cm cross-sections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的感知控制系统，使类人机器人能够通过头部固态激光雷达的稀疏点云观测，完成猴棒穿越（跳跃上杆→双臂摆动→跳跃下杆）的完整任务序列，并在15次试验中成功14次，摆动速度最高达0.5m/s。
AI.motivation: 穿越稀疏3D结构（如细长悬空几何体）要求类人机器人同时具备薄型结构的感知能力和敏捷、精确的全身运动控制能力，这是一个极具挑战性的问题。
AI.method: 采用强化学习感知控制系统：1) 策略直接使用头部固态激光雷达的原始稀疏点云，通过基于注意力机制的编码器结合循环记忆提取任务相关几何特征；2) 采用相位调度的师生训练流程，组合多个特权专家策略（跳跃上杆、双臂摆动、跳跃下杆）；3) 为硬件迁移，对激光雷达噪声、电池电压跌落和驱动器热限制进行建模，并为机器人配备被动钩状末端执行器。
AI.result: 在硬件上，策略在三种杆配置下15次试验中成功完成完整序列14次，摆动速度最高达0.5m/s；同一感知骨干网络还支持训练出躲避2cm横截面薄型顶部障碍物的策略。
AI.conclusion: 基于注意力编码器和循环记忆的稀疏激光雷达感知方法，配合相位调度的师生强化学习训练，能够使类人机器人在真实硬件上可靠地完成猴棒穿越任务，且该感知骨干具备良好的泛化能力以支持其他下游任务。

title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) in Computational Pathology: Definitions, Taxonomy, and Recommendations
comment: On behalf of MICCAI SIG-CompPath. More information: https://miccai.org/index.php/special-interest-groups/sig-comppath/
summary: Computational pathology (CompPath) is transforming medicine by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms to support diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment prediction from gigapixel whole-slide images. Clinical adoption is progressing, but is constrained by concerns about safety, accountability, and regulatory oversight in high-stakes clinical environments. Explainable AI (XAI) systems hold promise for building trust and enabling verification, yet the literature remains fragmented due to inconsistent terminology, overlapping methodological families, ad hoc validation, and current reviews. This review aims to formalize XAI methods in CompPath through the: i) introduction of a pathology-centric vocabulary comprising seven core terms; ii) development of a taxonomy across methodological families and three orthogonal axes (stage, type, scope); and iii) establishment of a task-driven framework that maps five clinical questions to recommended methods, method evaluation, and deployment context. Five key gaps between current XAI capabilities and clinical deployment are identified, and actionable steps are proposed to advance XAI for CompPath.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，旨在规范计算病理学（CompPath）中的可解释人工智能（XAI）方法。作者提出了病理学专属的七核心术语词汇表、跨方法族和三个正交轴（阶段、类型、范围）的分类体系，以及将五个临床问题映射到推荐方法、评估和部署情境的任务驱动框架，并识别了当前XAI能力与临床部署之间的五大差距。
AI.motivation: 计算病理学正在通过AI改变医学，但临床采用受到安全性、责任和监管问题的制约。现有XAI文献因术语不一致、方法论重叠、验证随意和综述碎片化而缺乏系统性，需要形式化和规范化的框架来弥合XAI研究与临床部署之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出了三项核心贡献：(i) 引入包含七个核心术语的病理学为中心词汇表；(ii) 构建跨方法论家族、沿三个正交轴（阶段、类型、范围）展开的XAI分类法；(iii) 建立任务驱动的框架，将五个临床问题映射到推荐方法、方法评估和部署情境。
AI.result: 识别出当前XAI能力与临床部署之间的五个关键差距，并提出了推动CompPath中XAI发展的可行步骤。
AI.conclusion: 该综述通过系统化的词汇、分类法和任务驱动框架，为计算病理学中的XAI建立了统一的学术基础，明确了差距并指明了未来发展方向，有助于加速XAI在临床病理环境中的安全采用与监管落地。

title: mmIR: Frequency-Space Inverse Rendering for 3D Millimeter-Wave Radar ADC Synthesis
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026. Project page: https://mmwave-inverse-rendering.github.io/
summary: High-resolution 3D radar data is scarce. Commodity mmWave sensors use small antenna arrays that limit angular resolution to several degrees, and existing datasets provide only 2D range-azimuth maps or sparse point clouds rather than raw analog-to-digital converter (ADC) signals. Hardware scaling is expensive, synthetic-aperture scanning is impractical at fleet scale, and learned synthesis methods are bottlenecked by the very data shortage they aim to address. We present mmIR, an open-source differentiable frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar inverse renderer that fits a physics-based forward model to real captures and re-renders from dense virtual apertures to synthesize high-resolution 3D radar data. Because radar resolution is too coarse to recover geometry directly, mmIR performs LiDAR-assisted inverse rendering: using LiDAR-derived meshes as a geometric scaffold, mmIR optimizes per-vertex International Telecommunication Union (ITU) physics materials, vertex normals, and antenna beam patterns through end-to-end automatic differentiation of a phase-coherent multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) forward model with multi-bounce propagation, polarization, and free-space diffraction. On seven outdoor and six indoor ColoRadar scenes, mmIR achieves 0.914 mean Pearson correlation on range-azimuth maps versus 0.307 for Sionna-RT. Scenes trained on a cascaded imaging radar transfer to a co-located single-chip radar without re-training (0.554 correlation), and dense virtual arrays (100x100 elements) produce single-frame 3D occupancy validated against LiDAR. Project page: https://mmwave-inverse-rendering.github.io/

AI.tldr: mmIR是一个开源的FMCW雷达可微逆渲染器，通过将基于物理的正向模型拟合到真实采集数据中，并从密集虚拟孔径重新渲染，以合成高分辨率3D雷达数据。该方法利用LiDAR辅助逆渲染，优化材料参数、法线和天线波束方向图，在ColoRadar数据集上显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D雷达数据稀缺：商用毫米波传感器天线阵列小导致角度分辨率受限（仅几度），现有数据集只提供2D距离-方位图或稀疏点云而非原始ADC信号。硬件扩展昂贵，合成孔径扫描在车队规模上不切实际，学习方法又受限于数据短缺本身。
AI.method: mmIR采用LiDAR辅助逆渲染：使用LiDAR派生的网格作为几何支架，通过端到端自动微分对相位相干MIMO正向模型（包含多跳传播、偏振和自由空间衍射）优化每顶点ITU物理材料、顶点法线和天线波束方向图。通过可微FMCW正向模型将基于物理的模型拟合到真实捕获数据，并从密集虚拟孔径重渲染合成高分辨率3D数据。
AI.result: 在7个室外和6个室内ColoRadar场景上，mmIR在距离-方位图上达到0.914的平均Pearson相关系数（对比Sionna-RT的0.307）。在级联成像雷达上训练的场景可零训练迁移到共置的单芯片雷达（0.554相关），密集虚拟阵列（100x100单元）生成经LiDAR验证的单帧3D占据图。
AI.conclusion: mmIR证明了基于物理的逆渲染方法能够有效突破雷达数据稀缺瓶颈，通过物理学正向模型拟合真实数据并合成高分辨率雷达信号，且具有良好的跨设备泛化能力。

title: Sampling-based Certified Planning with Graphs of Convex Sets
summary: Planners on graphs of convex sets return trajectories that are collision-free by construction, provided the convex regions are collision-free. The region generator only promises that property probabilistically, and no planner in the family verifies it. We report the first measurement of what the gap costs. On a scaled 14-DOF bimanual library, $3.2\%$ of interface samples are in collision, and a search-based GCS planner (\gcsstar) turns that volume error into a $62\%$ answer error: $18$ of $29$ pick-and-place queries return trajectories that drive the arms through the shelves, up to $91$\,mm deep, reported as successes. Repairing the library does not work; a ten times stricter acceptance contract, sums-of-squares certified regions, and uniform margins each destroy the connectivity planning needs before they deliver soundness. We instead build a planner that certifies its answers. It samples the overlaps and shared faces of the decomposition, prunes with an admissible informed bound, and verifies the one candidate each search round proposes, continuously, by a chain of clearance certificate balls with no resolution parameter; failures are repaired with local in-region detours, and the convex polish is re-verified. Head-to-head on all $29$ task queries it delivers zero invalid answers against $21$ for the reference, reaches its first certified answer in $0.11$\,s against $1.59$\,s for the reference's unverified one, and reproduces the reference optimum exactly on every query whose reference answer is physically valid.

AI.tldr: 本文首次量化了"凸集图上的规划器"中区域生成器概率性保证与实际碰撞之间的代价差距。在14自由度双臂抓取场景中，3.2%的界面样本发生碰撞，导致GCS规划器将体积误差转化为62%的答案错误（29个查询中18个返回穿过货架的轨迹）。修复库本身（更严格的验收、SOS认证区域、均匀边距）会破坏连通性。作者转而构建一个能认证自身答案的规划器：采样重叠区域和共享面，用可采纳的启发式剪枝，通过连续的无分辨率参数的清晰度证书球链验证候选解，失败时用局部绕行修复并重新验证。在全部29个任务查询中，该规划器零无效答案（对比参考方法的21个），首个认证答案仅需0.11秒（对比参考方法1.59秒的未认证答案），且在参考答案物理有效的情况下完美复现其最优解。
AI.motivation: 凸集图上的规划器依赖于区域生成器概率性保证区域无碰撞，但没有任何规划器验证这一保证。这种差距导致规划器会返回实际穿过障碍物的"成功"轨迹，而无人量化此代价。作者想测量这一差距有多大，并构建一个能够真正认证其答案的规划器。
AI.method: 作者提出一个认证型规划器：1) 采样分解的重叠区域和共享面；2) 使用可采纳的信息下界进行剪枝；3) 对每次搜索轮次提出的候选解，通过一条连续的清晰度证书球链进行验证（无分辨率参数）；4) 失败时用局部区域内绕行修复，并重新验证凸优化的结果。
AI.result: 在14-DOF双臂库的29个抓取任务中：所提规划器零无效答案（参考方法有21个）；首个认证答案0.11秒（参考方法1.59秒得到未认证答案）；在参考方法答案物理有效时，完美复现其最优解。同时量化了差距：3.2%界面样本碰撞导致62%答案错误，最深穿透达91mm。
AI.conclusion: 修复区域库本身（更严格验收、SOS认证、均匀边距）是无效的，因为它们会在实现可靠性之前破坏连通性。唯一有效的路径是让规划器在搜索过程中持续验证候选答案，这既保证了无碰撞性，又在速度和最优性上没有牺牲。

title: Discovering Machine Correlates of Consciousness
comment: published in: Springer Lecture Notes in Artificial Intelligence Vol. 16855, Proceed- ings of the 19th International Conference on Artificial General Intelligence (AGI- 2026), San Francisco, CA, July 2026. pp. 237-255 https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3- 032-33195-3_18
summary:
Currently, in biological systems Neural Correlates of Consciousness (NCCs) are characterized in terms of EEG and FMRI signals. Unfortunately, this characterization prevents the transferability of the NCCs concept to machines. Such transferability would be useful in order to investigate AI consciousness. In this paper we provide an alternate characterization that is transferable, and enables the analogous definition of Machine Correlates of Consciousness (MCCs). Specifically, we propose that NCCs (MCCs) are substrate-level signals that are not under human (AI agent) control, and that are reliably modulated by emotions.
  This paper presents the first empirical investigation of MCCs. Specifically, we present the results of experiments conducted with two LLMs, Llama-2 7B and Llama-3.1 70B parameters. In these LLMs we collect hardware anomaly traces that are substrate-level indicator-sequences. And we show that after controlling for confounding factors, these are modulated differently by emotional and neutral computations. And this difference is statistically significant for the larger Llama-3.1 70B, but not for the smaller Llama-2 7B. The results constitute initial empirical evidence that MCCs are present in the Llama-3.1 70B configuration. And they are consistent with the hypothesis that consciousness probability and degree increase with the LLM sophistication.
  Independently of consciousness, MCCs can also be used for detection of emotions in AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了机器意识相关性（MCCs）的概念，作为神经意识相关性（NCCs）的可迁移替代定义，并在两个大型语言模型（Llama-2 7B和Llama-3.1 70B）上进行了首次实证研究，发现硬件异常痕迹在情感与中性计算中表现出统计显著的差异调制，为AI意识研究提供了初步证据。
AI.motivation: 现有的意识神经相关性（NCCs）基于EEG和FMRI信号定义，仅适用于生物系统，无法迁移到机器上以研究AI意识。作者希望提出一种可迁移的替代性表征，使机器意识研究成为可能。
AI.method: 提出NCCs/MCCs的新定义：底物级信号，不受人类/AI代理控制，且可靠地受情绪调制。在两个LLM（Llama-2 7B和Llama-3.1 70B）中收集硬件异常痕迹作为底物级指示序列，在控制混杂因素后比较情感与中性计算下这些信号的调制差异。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1 70B中，情感与中性计算下的硬件异常痕迹调制差异具有统计显著性；但在较小的Llama-2 7B中差异不显著。结果为较大模型存在MCCs提供了初步经验证据，且与意识概率和程度随LLM复杂度增加而提高的假说一致。
AI.conclusion: MCCs作为NCCs的可迁移替代概念具有可行性，首个实证研究支持较大规模的LLM可能表现出MCCs。此外，MCCs可独立于意识研究用于AI代理的情绪检测。

title: ActiveAugment: Online Active Learning for Augmentation Selection in Deep Learning
summary: Data augmentation is a cornerstone of deep learning pipelines, yet existing strategies treat it as a static, model-agnostic preprocessing step, either relying on expensive dataset-specific policy search or applying transformations uniformly at random, regardless of what the model has already learned. We introduce ActiveAugment, a unified framework that treats augmentation selection as an online active learning problem. For each training minibatch, ActiveAugment generates a pool of candidate augmented views and scores each candidate using a combination of the model's predictive uncertainty and the feature discrepancy induced by the augmentation. The augmentation under which the current model is most fragile is selected per sample, and the model is then trained with a joint supervised classification and supervised contrastive objective that enforces intra-class invariance to the selected augmentations while maintaining inter-class separation. We evaluate ActiveAugment on eight benchmark datasets spanning natural and medical imaging, using CNN and transformer architectures across three training regimes (training from scratch, full fine-tuning, and linear probing), and comparing eight active selection strategies for augmentation scoring. ActiveAugment outperforms AutoAugment, RandAugment, and TrivialAugment under controlled augmentation shifts across all domains and budgets, with the most pronounced gains at low labelling budgets. On medical imaging datasets, where data is scarce and domain shift relative to natural-image pretrained models is large, ActiveAugment achieves higher test F1 than all baselines, demonstrating strong cross-domain adaptability. Our analysis reveals that the augmentation selection policy evolves meaningfully during training and that strategy choice has a direct impact on generalisation. Code is available at: https://github.com/noahvide/ActiveAugment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ActiveAugment，将数据增强选择视为在线主动学习问题，通过模型预测不确定性和特征差异为每个样本动态挑选最"脆弱"的增强方式，并联合监督分类与监督对比学习目标进行训练，在八个数据集上超越AutoAugment等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据增强策略是静态且模型无关的，要么依赖昂贵的特定数据集策略搜索，要么随机均匀施加变换，忽略了模型已学习到的信息，缺乏针对性和适应性。
AI.method: 将增强选择建模为在线主动学习问题：对每个训练minibatch生成候选增强视图，结合模型预测不确定性与增强引起的特征差异为每个候选打分，选择模型当前最脆弱的增强方式；训练时使用联合监督分类与监督对比学习目标，强化类内不变性并保持类间分离。
AI.result: 在涵盖自然图像和医学图像的8个基准数据集上，跨越CNN和Transformer架构、三种训练范式（从头训练、全微调、线性探测），与8种主动选择策略对比。ActiveAugment在所有领域和预算下均优于AutoAugment、RandAugment和TrivialAugment，在低标注预算时增益最显著；在医学影像数据集上F1分数最高，跨域适应能力强。
AI.conclusion: 增强选择策略在训练过程中会演化且具有意义，策略选择直接影响泛化性能。ActiveAugment在数据稀缺和域偏移大的场景（如医学影像）中表现尤为突出，展示了强大的跨域适应性。

title: Self-Aware Active Learning Enables Continual Improvement in Autonomous Driving
summary: Learning-based autonomous driving (AD) systems can perform reliably in familiar conditions, yet rare distribution shifts and long-tail events remain a major source of abrupt failure. A central limitation is that most agents learn primarily from passive experience and lack mechanisms to estimate when their competence is insufficient, seek timely assistance, and convert safety-critical encounters into targeted improvement. Here we present self-aware guided exploration (SAGE), an active learning framework for post-training adaptation in AD. SAGE learns a predictive world model that generates two online intrinsic signals: fear, which estimates short-horizon predictive risk and model uncertainty, and curiosity, which measures novelty through prediction error. Curiosity adaptively calibrates the intervention threshold for fear, allowing the agent to regulate risk in a context-dependent manner. When predicted fear exceeds this adaptive threshold, the agent transfers control to an expert or fallback policy and uses the resulting takeover trajectories for focused imitation learning. In parallel, fear is integrated into policy optimization and evaluation as a safety-oriented constraint to reduce performance regressions during adaptation. We evaluate SAGE in simulated route-transfer tasks, Waymo-based logged driving scenarios, CARLA occlusion hazards, and real-world mobile robot navigation tests. Across these settings, SAGE improves robustness in novel and safety-critical scenarios, reduces safety violations, and maintains task performance comparable to strong baseline policies. These results suggest that agents can improve after initial training by estimating the limits of their competence, requesting guidance when needed, and learning selectively from rare high-value events.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了自我感知引导探索（SAGE）框架，一种用于自动驾驶系统训练后适应的主动学习方法。SAGE通过学习预测世界模型生成两个内在信号——恐惧（预测风险和模型不确定性）和好奇心（通过预测误差衡量新颖性），好奇心自适应校准恐惧的干预阈值。当恐惧超过阈值时，智能体将控制权转移给专家并使用接管轨迹进行聚焦模仿学习，同时将恐惧作为安全约束集成到策略优化中，从而在分布偏移和长尾事件中提高鲁棒性并减少安全违规。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的自动驾驶系统在熟悉条件下表现可靠，但在罕见分布偏移和长尾事件中容易发生突发性失败。核心局限在于大多数智能体主要从被动经验中学习，缺乏估算自身能力不足、主动寻求及时帮助以及将安全关键事件转化为针对性改进的机制。
AI.method: SAGE包含三个核心组件的主动学习框架：（1）学习一个预测世界模型，生成恐惧信号（估计短时预测风险和模型不确定性）和好奇心信号（通过预测误差衡量新颖性）；（2）好奇心自适应校准恐惧的干预阈值，使智能体以上下文相关的方式调节风险；（3）当恐惧超过阈值时转移控制权给专家策略，利用接管轨迹进行聚焦模仿学习，并将恐惧作为安全导向约束集成到策略优化和评估中。
AI.result: SAGE在模拟路线迁移任务、基于Waymo的日志驾驶场景、CARLA遮挡危险以及真实世界移动机器人导航测试中进行了评估。结果显示SAGE提高了新颖和关键安全场景中的鲁棒性，减少了安全违规，并保持了与强基线策略相当的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 智能体可以在初始训练后通过估算自身能力限制、在需要时请求指导和选择性地从罕见高价值事件中学习来持续改进，为自动驾驶系统的适应性学习提供了可行的框架。

title: Evaluating the Hidden Costs of Personalization in Large Language Models
summary: While Large language models (LLMs) incorporate user personalization signals to improve usability and helpfulness, they increasingly shift from providing balanced, informative responses toward optimizing for user satisfaction when conditioned on personal context such as conversation history, inferred preferences, and user profiles. Specifically, we identify three emerging risks: (1) irrelevant personalization, where models reference personal information in unnecessary contexts; (2) preference narrowing, where models reinforce informational echo chambers; and (3) sycophantic bias, where models agree excessively with user opinions. As a result, models may reference personal information in contexts where it is unnecessary, inadvertently collapse response diversity, or agree excessively with user opinions. Despite the growing use of personalization in AI assistants, there has been limited systematic evaluation of its potential side effects. To bridge this gap, we propose PRISK, a dynamic evaluation framework with automated data generation and tailored metrics that uncovers systematic limitations in current LLM personalization and how personalized information shapes its responses. Our empirical analysis across 13 LLMs demonstrates the presence of user profiles and retrieved memories consistently exacerbates biases, resulting in an average drop of 45.9% in irrelevant personalization, 41.7% in preference narrowing and 61.7% in sycophantic bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISK框架，系统评估LLM个性化带来的三个风险：不相关个性化、偏好窄化和谄媚偏见。通过对13个LLM的实证分析发现，用户画像和检索记忆会显著加剧这些偏见。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地整合用户个性化信号来提升可用性，但现有研究缺乏对这种个性化可能带来的副作用（如信息茧房、谄媚偏见等）的系统性评估。
AI.method: 提出PRISK动态评估框架，包含自动化数据生成和定制化度量指标，用以系统性地揭示LLM个性化中的局限性以及个性化信息如何影响模型响应。
AI.result: 对13个LLM的实证分析表明，用户画像和检索记忆的存在一致性地加剧偏见，导致不相关个性化指标平均下降45.9%，偏好窄化下降41.7%，谄媚偏见下降61.7%。
AI.conclusion: 个性化信息在LLM中会系统性地放大三类偏见风险，需要进一步研究和缓解这些副作用以平衡个性化与响应质量。

title: NBS: No Bias Stereo
summary: Stereo reconstruction is one of the last remaining Computer Vision tasks where all state-of-the-art methods employ a heavy architectural inductive bias. Even though it has been demonstrated that the task can be solved using general-purpose methods, it is widely believed that inductive biases in stereo are strictly necessary for both high-quality results and computational efficiency. We challenge this paradigm. In this paper, we demonstrate that both state-of-the-art accuracy and superior runtime efficiency are achievable with a model completely devoid of architectural inductive biases, relying instead on a simple, end-to-end Vision Transformer. By training on massive synthetic datasets, we show that pure data-driven learning can surpass explicitly engineered geometry. This work proves that explicit inductive biases are no longer a prerequisite for stereo matching, ultimately unlocking true scaling laws for continuous improvement in 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了立体匹配中归纳偏置必要的传统范式，证明一个完全不含架构归纳偏置的简单端到端Vision Transformer，仅通过在海量合成数据上训练，就能在精度和运行效率上超越所有现有最先进方法，解锁3D重建的持续改进缩放定律。
AI.motivation: 立体重建是计算机视觉中最后一个所有最先进方法都依赖重架构归纳偏置的任务。尽管已有研究证明通用方法可以解决此任务，但业界普遍认为归纳偏置对高质量结果和计算效率是严格必需的。作者挑战这一范式，希望证明纯粹数据驱动的学习可以超越显式设计的几何先验。
AI.method: 采用一个简单、端到端的Vision Transformer架构，完全去除架构层面的归纳偏置（如代价体构造、多尺度金字塔等手工设计），仅依赖在海量合成数据集上进行大规模训练，通过纯数据驱动学习来隐式地捕获立体匹配所需的几何与对应关系。
AI.result: 实验表明，该无归纳偏置的模型在立体匹配精度上达到最先进水平，同时在运行效率上也优于现有方法。这证明了数据驱动的学习能力可以超越显式设计的几何归纳偏置。
AI.conclusion: 显式归纳偏置不再是立体匹配取得高性能的必要前提。该工作验证了纯数据驱动方法在此任务上的可行性，为3D重建领域实现真正的缩放定律和持续改进打开了道路。

title: EMERGE-Policy: A Robot Mind Emerges Beyond a Single Policy
summary: A robot's effective ``mind'' need not reside in a single policy. It can emerge when specialized components perceive, reason, predict, act, verify, and remember within a shared orchestration process. EMERGE-Policy turns this perspective into a graph-structured agentic framework that coordinates both capability invocation and information exchange. A Main Agent retains task-level state within an active context window, while role-specific Sub Agents process perception, execution monitoring, verification, and memory consolidation in isolated contexts and return structured, task-relevant evidence. Role-specific contexts control information load by exposing only decision-relevant evidence to the Main Agent, while the functional Skill interface composes heterogeneous backends as Operational, Imagination, and Evaluation Skills. Criterion-grounded verification, textual failure diagnosis, and Branch Stack recovery provide localized correction, with token-aware external memory preserving task-relevant state. Together, their closed-loop interaction realizes the system-level policy captured by the name EMERGE-Policy. Without additional fine-tuning, we achieved outstanding performance on several public benchmark that have had a wide-reaching impact, and conducted a series of real robot experiments. These system-level results suggest that through the division of different functional sub-tasks among multiple agents and their concurrent collaboration, as well as the technical paradigm where the model is regarded as a skill and called within the framework, EMERGE-Policy can extend the robust robot policies beyond isolated runs.

AI.tldr: EMERGE-Policy 是一个图结构的多智能体机器人控制框架，通过主智能体与多个角色子智能体（感知、执行监控、验证、记忆）的协作，以及将模型作为技能调用的范式，在不额外微调的情况下实现了多个公开基准上的优异表现和真实机器人实验验证。
AI.motivation: 单一策略网络难以承载机器人有效"心智"，需要将感知、推理、预测、行动、验证和记忆等功能组件通过协调过程组织起来，以超越孤立运行的鲁棒策略。
AI.method: 构建图结构智能体框架：主智能体维护任务级状态和活动上下文窗口；角色级子智能体在隔离上下文中处理感知、执行监控、验证和记忆整合并返回结构化证据；功能技能接口将异构后端组合为操作、想象和评估技能；结合基于标准的验证、文本失败诊断和分支栈恢复实现局部修正，并使用token感知的外部记忆保持任务状态。
AI.result: 无需额外微调，在多个具有广泛影响的公开基准上取得优异性能，并完成了一系列真实机器人实验。
AI.conclusion: 通过将不同功能子任务分配给多个智能体并发协作，以及将模型视为技能在框架内调用的技术范式，EMERGE-Policy 能够将鲁棒机器人策略从孤立运行扩展到更广泛的场景。

title: MineCEraft: Evaluating Language Models as Construction Engineers in the World of Minecraft
summary: We introduce MineCEraft (Minecraft Construction Engineering Benchmark, pronounced mine-see-ee-raft), an easy-to-use, open-source benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the reliability and limitations of LLMs for construction tasks in Minecraft. The MineCEraft benchmark comprises 723 domain-expert hand-crafted natural-language instructions with programmatically verifiable evaluation, spanning 17 distinct task categories, providing a safe and controllable experimental environment for assessing LLMs' ability to perform realistic construction engineering tasks. With this benchmark, we conduct an in-depth evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and perform a detailed error analysis, revealing key failure modes and practical challenges in applying LLMs to construction engineering tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MineCEraft基准，一个用于系统评估LLMs在Minecraft中执行建筑工程项目可靠性与局限性的开源基准，包含723条领域专家手工构建的自然语言指令和17个任务类别。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏一个系统化、可验证的基准来评估LLMs在建筑施工工程任务中的表现，需要安全可控的实验环境来测试其实际应用能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含723条专家手工制作的自然语言指令的基准数据集，涵盖17个不同的任务类别，并采用程序化可验证的评估方式，在Minecraft环境中提供安全可控的实验平台。
AI.result: 对最先进的LLMs进行了深入评估，并通过详细的错误分析揭示了模型在建筑工程任务中的关键失败模式与实际挑战。
AI.conclusion: MineCEraft基准能够有效评估LLMs在建筑施工工程任务中的可靠性，并通过错误分析指出了实际应用中需要解决的关键问题。

title: FractureFields: Contact-Aware Binary Multi-Field Transfer for Fractured 3D Gaussian Simulation
summary: Physics-integrated 3D Gaussian representations make it possible to simulate image-reconstructed assets directly as particles, but current Gaussia-MPM pipelines keep a single Eulerian velocity field even after fracture. When disconnected fragments share interpolation support, they still write to and read from the same grid nodes, producing cross-fragment momentum leakage that appears as residual adhesion and non-physical stretching. We present FractureFields, a topology-adaptive transfer for fractured 3D Gaussian objects. After a structural event assigns persistent fragment identities, FractureFields builds fragment-specific mass and momentum fields in a single P2G pass, advances each field independently, and performs a field-aware G2P update so particles only sample their own fragment's grid state. To handle re-contact, we add a momentum-conserving contact projection that applies equal and opposite normal impulses only when two fragment fields are approaching, preserving free separation otherwise. Experiments on reconstructed scenes and a controlled re-contact benchmark show that fragment-conditioned routing eliminates realized cross-fragment mixing by construction, while contact projection reduces interpenetration during collision without reintroducing residual coupling. Overall, we argue that post-fracture simulation should treat structural disconnection as a change in local dynamical state, not merely a change in constitutive stress.

AI.tldr: FractureFields提出了一种拓扑自适应的传输方法，用于断裂后3D高斯物体的物理仿真。该方法为每个碎片构建独立的质点-网格（P2G）质量与动量场，独立推进各场，并在G2P更新时确保粒子只采样所属碎片的网格状态，从而从构造上消除跨碎片的动量泄漏。同时引入动量守恒的接触投影处理重新接触场景。
AI.motivation: 现有的Gaussia-MPM管线在断裂后仍保留单一欧拉速度场。当断裂后的离散碎片共享插值支撑时，它们会读写同一网格节点，导致跨碎片动量泄漏，表现为残余粘附和非物理拉伸。论文认为断裂后仿真应将结构断开视为局部动力学状态的改变，而非仅仅是本构应力的改变。
AI.method: 1) 结构事件后为每个碎片分配持久的碎片身份标识；2) 在单次P2G传递中构建碎片特定的质量场和动量场；3) 独立推进每个碎片场；4) 执行场感知的G2P更新，使粒子仅采样自身碎片的网格状态；5) 对于碎片重新接触，添加动量守恒的接触投影，仅当两个碎片场接近时施加等大反向的法向冲量，自由分离时则不加约束。
AI.result: 在重建场景和受控再接触基准上的实验表明：碎片条件路由在构造上消除了跨碎片混合，接触投影减少了碰撞期间的相互穿透，且不会重新引入残余耦合。
AI.conclusion: 后断裂仿真应将结构断裂视为局部动力学状态的改变，而不仅仅是本构应力的变化。Fragment-conditioned routing + contact projection为断裂3D高斯物体的物理仿真提供了有效的拓扑自适应方案。

title: System Identification of Admittance Models for Large Real-World Objects
summary: Simulation of admittance-type models requires physically consistent dynamic models that are rarely available for off-the-shelf, everyday objects, limiting the fidelity of haptic interfaces that rely on such simulations. This paper presents the first complete workflow for producing physically consistent models of large real-world objects with various constraints and mechanisms, guaranteeing physical consistency of inertia and friction parameters. The workflow separates each object and identifies the handle and body in two stages, requiring no torque sensors at hinges, axles, or other constrained joints. Models are produced for a heavy, closer-actuated door and a wheelbarrow, representing objects of differing constraint types and model complexity. The door is modeled using four-bar linkage kinematics and a fluid dynamics-based lumped parameter model including opening, backcheck, swing, and latch zones. The wheelbarrow is modeled as a rigid body with a spherical wheel and no slip during rolling. Handle estimation RMS errors were below 0.64 N and 0.042 Nm across both objects. Door body estimation had RMS error of 2.19 Nm and wheelbarrow body estimation had RMS error of 6.77 Nm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个完整的物理一致性建模工作流，用于为日常大型物体生成符合物理规律的动态模型，无需铰链等关节处的力矩传感器即可保证惯性和摩擦参数的物理一致性，并在重型闭门器和独轮车上验证了模型精度。
AI.motivation: 触摸模拟（haptic interface）依赖物理一致的动态模型，但现成日常物体缺乏此类模型，限制了模拟的真实性和沉浸感。
AI.method: 采用两阶段流程：先分离物体并识别手柄和本体，无需在关节处安装力矩传感器；门模型使用四杆连杆运动学和基于流体力学的集总参数模型（包含开门、回弹、摆动和锁止区域），独轮车模型为带球形轮的刚体且滚动时无滑动。
AI.result: 手柄估计均方根误差在两物体上低于0.64 N和0.042 Nm；门本体的均方根误差为2.19 Nm，独轮车本体估计的均方根误差为6.77 Nm。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流能够为具有不同约束类型和复杂度的真实大型物体生成物理一致的动态模型，适用于闭门器和独轮车等各类物体，可提升触觉接口的仿真保真度。

title: Oculi: A Conversational Agentic Platform for Automated Credit Risk Analysis
comment: This work was completed at Royal Bank of Canada as part of the RBC Amplify program
summary: Credit risk analysis in financial institutions traditionally requires analysts to manually write SQL queries, run statistical computations, and build visualization dashboards. This is a time-consuming workflow that limits exploration to familiar segments. We introduce \textbf{Oculi}, a conversational platform that transforms natural language questions into comprehensive credit risk analyses, complete with data queries, statistical testing, and interactive visualizations. Oculi employs a three-layer architecture that separates reasoning (LLM-powered agent), execution (Model Context Protocol tool servers), and presentation (agentic UI), enabling analysts to discover high-risk portfolio segments. Within Oculi, a new segment discovery pipeline is proposed that combines deterministic statistical methods with LLM-guided feature selection, leveraging LLM semantic domain knowledge alongside data-driven metrics to identify meaningful, actionable portfolio segments. Evaluated on a mortgage portfolio with 200+ features, Oculi demonstrates effectiveness in discovering material risk segments previously intractable through manual exploration, reducing time-to-insight significantly while maintaining auditability and statistical rigor.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Oculi，一个将自然语言问题转化为全面信用风险分析（包括数据查询、统计检验和交互式可视化）的对话式平台，采用三层架构（推理、执行、展示），并提出了结合确定性统计方法与LLM引导特征选择的新段发现流程，在200+特征的抵押贷款组合上显著缩短洞察时间并保持审计性和统计严谨性。
AI.motivation: 传统信用风险分析依赖分析师手动编写SQL、执行统计计算并构建可视化仪表板，耗时且仅能探索熟悉的细分市场。这种工作流限制了探索范围，无法高效发现高风险的组合分段。
AI.method: Oculi采用三层架构：LLM驱动的代理负责推理、模型上下文协议（MCP）工具服务器负责执行、代理式UI负责展示。同时提出新的段发现流程，将确定性统计方法与LLM引导的特征选择相结合，利用LLM的语义领域知识配合数据驱动指标来识别有意义且可操作的投资组合分段。
AI.result: 在具有200多个特征的抵押贷款组合上评估，Oculi能够发现通过手动探索难以实现的重要风险分段，显著缩短了获得洞察的时间，同时保持可审计性和统计严谨性。
AI.conclusion: Oculi证明了LLM驱动的对话式平台能够有效地辅助信用风险分析，在提升探索效率和发现深度方面具有显著优势，为金融分析工作流提供了可行的自动化替代方案。

title: RoSe-SLAM: Robust Semantic-Aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM from Dynamic Monocular Videos
comment: Accepted by IEEE/RSJ INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON INTELLIGENT ROBOTS & SYSTEMS (IROS), 2026
summary: In dynamic and unstructured environments, conventional SLAM systems generally suffer from significant accuracy degeneration due to their static assumptions. In this work, we propose Robust Semantic-aware Gaussian Splatting SLAM (RoSe-SLAM), to address the dynamic challenge by a holistic semantic scene understanding from uncalibrated monocular inputs, achieving accurate camera tracking and high-quality geometry reconstruction. Unlike conventional semantic SLAM using handcrafted semantic labels, our RoSe-SLAM exploits the semantic feature from 2D foundation model to enhance the dynamic tracking and mapping performance. By distilling the rich semantic features to our Gaussian fields, our method effectively identifies dynamic distractors and achieves semantic-aware multi-view consistency, significantly enhancing the geometric reconstruction and scene inpainting. Specifically, we propose a spatial-temporal motion mask generation module, enabling both long-term motion monitoring and short-term transient dynamics capturing, achieving robust and effective disentanglement of dynamic objects and static backgrounds. During global bundle adjustment, we propose an occlusion-aware keyframe selection mechanism to prioritize the occlusion as metric to pick the keyframes, and a multi-view semantic consistency module to improve the mapping quality in dynamic environments. By combining geometric motion cues with semantic priors, our system dynamically filters unreliable observations and reconstructs accurate static scene geometry. Extensive experiments conducted on benchmark datasets including dynamic TUM, Bonn and Wild-Mocap datasets, demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance in both trajectory estimation and static scene mapping, outperforming existing dynamic RGB SLAM baselines in long-term dynamic indoor environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoSe-SLAM，一种鲁棒的语义感知高斯溅射SLAM系统，通过利用2D基础模型的语义特征从单目未标定输入中实现动态场景下的精确相机跟踪和高保真几何重建，在动态TUM、Bonn和Wild-Mocap数据集上优于现有动态RGB SLAM基线。
AI.motivation: 传统SLAM系统基于静态假设，在动态和非结构化环境中会遭受严重的精度退化。现有语义SLAM依赖手工标注的语义标签，无法有效应对动态挑战。
AI.method: 1) 利用2D基础模型提取语义特征并蒸馏到高斯场中，实现语义感知的多视图一致性；2) 提出时空运动掩码生成模块，同时捕捉长期运动监控和短期瞬态动态；3) 在全局BA中采用遮挡感知的关键帧选择机制（以遮挡为度量）和多视图语义一致性模块；4) 结合几何运动线索与语义先验，动态过滤不可靠观测。
AI.result: 在动态TUM、Bonn和Wild-Mocap数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在轨迹估计和静态场景建图方面均取得优越性能，在长期动态室内环境中优于现有动态RGB SLAM基线。
AI.conclusion: RoSe-SLAM通过整合语义理解与几何运动线索，有效实现了动态物体与静态背景的解耦，在动态环境下同时实现了精确的相机定位和高质量的场景重建。

title: Training-Free Action Correction for VLA Model Failures via Language Feedback
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong semantic understanding yet exhibit systematic failures during deployment. The conditions under which these failures occur, and whether they can be corrected without retraining, remain poorly understood. In this paper, we take steps toward addressing this gap. We present CorrectVLA, a framework that translates task-level natural language corrections into additive action magnitude adjustments without modifying policy weights. A human provides a single task-level correction, applied uniformly across all rollouts without per-episode intervention. In simulation, CorrectVLA recovers execution misalignment failures across both in-distribution and OOD tasks. In real-robot experiments on a UFactory xArm7 under environment shift, CorrectVLA restores near-perfect success where the base policy almost entirely breaks down, generalizing across object locations and identities. Through a taxonomy of failure modes on LIBERO-90, we find that execution misalignment failures, where the policy reaches the correct target but miscalibrates action magnitudes, represent the correctable subset, while other failure modes where semantic comprehension itself breaks down are not amenable to this approach. The approach succeeds when policies possess strategic correctness and fails when fundamental comprehension is absent, establishing a practical operational boundary for inference-time correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CorrectVLA框架，通过任务级自然语言纠正来调整动作幅度，无需修改策略权重即可修复VLA模型在部署中的执行错位失败，并在模拟和真实机器人实验中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽具有强语义理解能力，但在部署时会出现系统性失败。目前对这些失败发生的条件以及能否在不重新训练的情况下进行纠正仍缺乏理解，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: CorrectVLA将任务级自然语言纠正转化为加性的动作幅度调整，不修改策略权重。人类提供单一任务级纠正，统一应用于所有rollout，无需逐次交互。通过LIBERO-90上的失败模式分类，识别可纠正的失败子集。
AI.result: 在模拟环境中恢复了分布内和分布外任务的执行错位失败；在真实UFactory xArm7机器人上，在环境变化下将近乎完全失效的策略恢复到接近完美的成功率，并能泛化到不同物体位置和身份。
AI.conclusion: 执行错位失败（策略到达正确目标但动作幅度计算错误）是可纠正的子集，而语义理解本身崩溃的失败模式无法通过此方法修复。该方法在策略具备战略正确性时成功，在基本理解缺失时失败，确立了推理时纠正的实际操作边界。

title: Automated Researchers Can Reliably Mitigate Alignment Failures
summary: Automating alignment research may accelerate progress toward aligned AI, but whether it does is hard to measure. Luckily, many alignment failures, such as deception, sycophancy, and jailbreaks, are already measurable by public benchmarks. We study whether automated alignment researchers (AARs) can post-train to mitigate alignment failures by proposing training methods and data to simultaneously optimize multiple safety benchmarks, while preserving general capability. Across 10 alignment failures, the strongest AAR methods significantly reduce the targeted alignment failures and generalize to a held-out benchmark, multi-turn behavioral audits, and models up to 4.7 times larger than the target model. As a human baseline, 28 experienced researchers receive up to eight hours to develop methods for the same benchmarks, but their methods underperform the best AAR methods. Using human ideas as the AARs' initial research direction does not improve performance, suggesting current AARs may not need guidance from experienced researchers. These results suggest that automating alignment research on well-characterized failures may be practical in the near term.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动化对齐研究者（AARs）能否通过后训练缓解对齐失败。在10种对齐失败基准上，最强AAR方法显著降低目标失败，并泛化到保留基准、多轮行为审计及更大模型。相比之下，28位经验丰富的人类研究者在8小时内开发的方法表现不如最佳AAR，且加入人类想法作为初始研究方向并不能提升性能。结果表明，在特征明确的失败上自动化对齐研究在近期可能是可行的。
AI.motivation: 自动化对齐研究可能加速对齐AI的进展，但其效果难以衡量。幸运的是，许多对齐失败（如欺骗、谄媚、越狱）已有公开基准可测量，这为研究自动化对齐研究者是否有效提供了可量化的评估途径。
AI.method: 研究让自动化对齐研究者（AARs）通过提出训练方法和数据来后训练模型，同时优化多个安全基准并保持通用能力。与28位经验丰富的人类研究者（每人最多8小时）进行对比，还测试了将人类想法作为AAR初始研究方向是否有助于提升性能。
AI.result: 最强的AAR方法在10种对齐失败上显著减少目标失败，并成功泛化到保留基准、多轮行为审计以及比目标模型大4.7倍的模型上。最佳AAR方法超越了人类研究者的表现，且使用人类想法作为初始方向未能改善AAR的性能。
AI.conclusion: 自动化对齐研究在特征明确的（well-characterized）对齐失败上可能是近期可实现的实用方案，当前AAR甚至可能不需要经验丰富研究者的指导。

title: Towards Fully Automated Medical Imaging Code Generation via Validation-based Context Engineering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated considerable promise in program generation for small-scale and conventional application development; however, they remain limited when applied to complex, domain-specific tasks such as medical image processing. General-purpose models lack explicit domain knowledge and robust validation mechanisms to ensure correctness, often requiring substantial human intervention to produce reliable processing pipelines. To address these limitations, we propose AutoMedImg, a multi-agent framework for fully automated medical image processing code generation. AutoMedImg orchestrates specialised agents across two phases: a Planning Phase that performs dataset analysis and architecture design with semantic and formal verification, and a Coding Phase that generates modules in parallel with static checking, execution testing, and assembly validation. This multi-stage validation mitigates error propagation throughout generation, while comprehensive auto-context engineering combining domain-specific knowledge bases, shared memory, and validation feedback automates context construction without manual prompting. A cross-project adaptive pipeline synthesis mechanism further accumulates validated pipelines and retrieves proven components for new tasks based on project similarity, enhancing generation efficiency through cross-project learning. Extensive evaluation across six diverse and well-established medical imaging datasets with five backbone LLMs demonstrates that AutoMedImg achieves zero human intervention, with Dice scores of up to 0.90 for segmentation tasks and 99% accuracy for classification.

AI.tldr: 提出了AutoMedImg，一个面向医学图像处理代码生成的多智能体框架，通过两阶段（规划与编码）的多级验证机制实现零人工干预的自动化代码生成，在六个医学影像数据集上取得了Dice最高0.90、分类精度99%的优异性能。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型在复杂领域任务（如医学图像处理）中缺乏领域知识和验证机制，需要大量人工干预才能生成可靠的代码管线，难以满足医学影像处理的专业需求。
AI.method: AutoMedImg采用多智能体两阶段框架：(1) 规划阶段进行数据集分析和架构设计，包含语义与形式化验证；(2) 编码阶段并行生成模块，执行静态检查、运行测试和组装验证。结合领域知识库、共享内存和验证反馈的自动上下文工程，以及基于项目相似性的跨项目自适应管线合成机制。
AI.result: 在六个医学影像数据集和五个骨干LLM上进行了广泛评估，实现了零人工干预，分割任务Dice分数最高达0.90，分类任务准确率达99%。
AI.conclusion: AutoMedImg通过多级验证和跨项目学习有效解决了LLM在医学图像处理代码生成中的局限性，实现了无需人工干预的高质量、自动化医学图像处理流程生成。

title: MiBOT: A head-worn robot that modulates cardiovascular responses through human-like soft massage
comment: Published at 2024 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: Massage therapy is helpful for the rehabilitation of various diseases, such as headaches caused by migraines and stress. Existing robotic systems have focused on massage therapy on the torso and limbs, but performing massage motions through suitable actuation on a person's head has been a challenge. In this paper, we present MiBOT, a head-worn massage robot that actuates two soft tactors to produce touch motions mimicking human massage. A key design principle behind MiBOT is its silent actuation, which we achieve through pneumatic artificial muscles in conjunction with a controller loop to respond to contact pressure. We evaluated the effectiveness of MiBOT in a controlled study and assessed subjects' blood pressure and heart rate levels while applying MiBOT. We found that our mechanical system generated positive and conclusive quantitative outcomes that are similar to the human-administered massage, decreasing participants' mean systolic and diastolic blood pressure by 2.8 mmHg and 1.7 mmHg, respectively, as well as calming their heart rate by 8-10% on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiBOT，一种头戴式按摩机器人，通过两个软触觉执行器模拟人类按摩动作，采用气动人工肌肉实现静音驱动，并带有压力反馈控制回路。对照实验表明其效果接近人工按摩，可降低收缩压2.8 mmHg、舒张压1.7 mmHg，并使心率平均降低8-10%。
AI.motivation: 按摩疗法对多种疾病康复有益（如偏头痛和压力引起的头痛），但现有机器人按摩系统多聚焦于躯干和四肢，通过合适的驱动方式在人体头部执行按摩动作一直是一个挑战。
AI.method: 设计了MiBOT头戴式按摩机器人，采用两个软触觉执行器产生模拟人类按摩的触觉动作；关键设计原则是实现静音驱动，通过气动人工肌肉配合控制回路来响应接触压力。
AI.result: 在对照研究中，MiBOT产生了积极且结论性的量化结果，与人工按摩效果相似：参与者平均收缩压和舒张压分别降低2.8 mmHg和1.7 mmHg，心率平均降低8-10%。
AI.conclusion: MiBOT作为头戴式按摩机器人，其机械系统在静音驱动下能够产生与人工按摩相当的生理学效果，证明了该技术在头部按摩康复领域的有效性和可行性。

title: From Location Phrases to Geographic Entities: Task-Adapted Retrieval for People Search
summary:
People search must map free-form location phrases to geographic entities used as structured retrieval filters. Lexical standardizers handle canonical names well but are brittle to aliases, misspellings, metropolitan expressions, and same-name ambiguity. We formulate this task as graded, set-valued entity retrieval over a fixed ontology. We identify three coupled design requirements: distinguishing identity-preserving variation from knowledge-dependent aliases, controlling false negatives among valid same-name entities, and separating stable transformations from mutable entity knowledge. We realize them in a prompt-asymmetric bi-encoder with calibrated alias support, bounded ambiguity-aware negatives, and editable entity documents that support localized updates without retraining.
  Across a fixed production-derived development benchmark and a public GeoNames transfer task, task adaptation improves substantially over frozen encoders and standard token baselines. Controlled development ablations show that specialized supervision contributes beyond standard task fine-tuning and encoder scaling. On GeoNames, the adapted model improves known-target Recall@1 throughout zero-to-moderate character overlap, while character n-grams retain a small aggregate Target Recall@5 advantage. In a blinded human comparison on a stratified production challenge set, our model raises relevant P@1 from 28.0% to 46.0% (p=0.012). Fixed-query endpoint estimates improve on non-canonical queries and remain close to control on frequent queries; a randomized live experiment detects no engagement regression. These results support task-adapted geographic entity retrieval as a practical replacement for the incumbent taxonomy-based standardizer, with the largest relevance gains on non-canonical queries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将自由形式的地点短语映射到地理实体（作为结构化检索过滤条件）的任务，提出了一种提示非对称的双编码器（prompt-asymmetric bi-encoder）方法，通过校准的别名支持、有界歧义感知负样本和可编辑的实体文档来满足三个耦合的设计需求。实验表明该方法在生产和公共数据集上均优于冻结编码器和标准词法基线，在人工比较中相关P@1从28.0%提升至46.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有词法标准化器（lexical standardizers）能很好处理规范名称，但对别名、拼写错误、都市表达和同名歧义等问题表现脆弱，无法满足人物搜索中自由形式地点短语到地理实体的映射需求。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为固定本体上的分级集合值实体检索（graded, set-valued entity retrieval），提出prompt-asymmetric bi-encoder架构，包含三个关键组件：校准的别名支持（calibrated alias support）、有界歧义感知负样本（bounded ambiguity-aware negatives）以及支持局部更新的可编辑实体文档（editable entity documents）。
AI.result: 在固定生产开发基准和公共GeoNames迁移任务上，任务适应显著优于冻结编码器和标准词法基线。GeoNames上已知目标Recall@1在零到中等字符重叠范围内持续提升；人工比较中相关P@1从28.0%提升至46.0%（p=0.012）；随机在线实验未检测到参与度回退，且非规范查询获得最大相关性增益。
AI.conclusion: 任务适应的地理实体检索可以作为现有基于分类法的标准化器的实用替代方案，最大相关性增益体现在非规范查询上，同时保持高频查询的稳定性。

title: Explainable Multi-Loss Distillation Framework for Efficient and Interpretable Shrimp Disease Text Classification
comment: Accepted at Journal of King Saud University Computer and Information Sciences
summary: Shrimp disease classification has become an urgent issue due to its significant impact on the import-export output of producing countries, particularly Vietnam. Most existing studies focus on image-based classification, which typically operates at the late stage of disease manifestation. Therefore, text-based classification has the potential to enable early and timely disease detection. To address this limitation, we introduce the SALT (Shrimp disease text Analysis with multi-Loss disTillation) framework, which incorporates explainability analysis using Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to evaluate model predictions and interpret the learned linguistic features. Experimental results demonstrate that SALT achieves competitive performance across multiple distillation objectives, outperforming supervised baselines while providing a favorable trade-off between predictive performance and computational efficiency. Moreover, it exhibits strong explainability, accurately identifying key linguistic features and semantic patterns relevant to disease descriptions. These findings highlight the potential of knowledge distillation-based text classification for future applications in early shrimp disease diagnosis and related research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SALT框架，利用知识蒸馏进行虾病文本分类，结合LIME和SHAP可解释性分析，在越南虾病早期检测中取得优于监督基线的性能，同时具备良好的计算效率和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有虾病分类主要基于图像，但图像方法通常在疾病晚期才能有效检测。文本分类具有实现早期和及时疾病检测的潜力，因此需要开发基于文本的虾病分类方法，以解决传统图像方法的时序局限性。
AI.method: 提出SALT（Shrimp disease text Analysis with multi-Loss disTillation）框架，采用多损失知识蒸馏目标进行训练，并集成LIME和SHAP两种可解释性分析工具来评估模型预测和解释学习到的语言特征。
AI.result: SALT在多个蒸馏目标上取得竞争性表现，优于监督学习基线，在预测性能与计算效率之间实现了良好权衡；同时具备强可解释性，能够准确识别与疾病描述相关的关键语言特征和语义模式。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏驱动的文本分类方法在早期虾病诊断和后续相关研究中具有广阔的应用前景，为克服图像分类的晚期检测局限提供了新思路。

title: Rethinking Language's Role in Efficient VLA for Autonomous Vehicles: Toward Smarter, Trustworthy Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are reshaping autonomous driving (AD) by unifying perception, reasoning, and control through language, enabling semantic grounding, interpretable decisions, and better long-tail generalization. But language is expensive onboard: latency and memory budgets are tight, and autoregressive decoding is inherently sequential. This work reframes the central question as when and where language should act at inference, since inference cost recurs at every deployed frame while training cost is paid once. We introduce the Language Residue taxonomy to organize methods by their inference-time use of language: train-time-only supervision (L1), latent non-textual reasoning (L2), conditional invocation (L3), and full per-frame generation (L4). We review representative methods and tag each across five deployment axes (latency, parameters, memory, FLOPs, tokens), analyzing them on major open- and closed-loop driving benchmarks (e.g., nuScenes, NAVSIM, Bench2Drive). We further trace how efficient methods from NLP/LLM are adapted in AD, identifying the constraints and motivations driving these adaptations. A continuously updated repository will be available at Github.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶中的应用，核心聚焦于推理阶段语言开销的成本问题，提出了Language Residue分类法，将方法按推理时语言使用方式分为四类（L1-L4），并从五个部署轴（延迟、参数、内存、FLOPs、token）对代表性方法进行标注分析，同时回顾NLP/LLM高效方法在自动驾驶中的适配。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在自动驾驶中展现出巨大潜力，但语言模型在车载环境的推理开销（延迟、内存）是严重瓶颈。由于推理成本在每个部署帧都会重复发生而训练成本只付一次，需要重新审视"语言应在推理的何时何地起作用"这一核心问题，因此需要系统性的分类和分析框架。
AI.method: 提出Language Residue分类法，将方法按推理时语言使用方式分为四类：L1（仅在训练时监督）、L2（潜在非文本推理）、L3（条件触发调用）、L4（每帧全量生成）。对代表性方法在五个部署轴（延迟、参数、内存、FLOPs、token）上进行标注，并在多个开环和闭环驾驶基准（nuScenes、NAVSIM、Bench2Drive）上进行分析，同时梳理NLP/LLM高效方法在AD中的适配路径。
AI.result: 建立了VLA方法推理开销的系统分类与分析框架，识别了各层级方法在部署轴上的权衡，并追踪了从NLP/LLM领域迁移到自动驾驶的高效技术路线及其约束和动机。
AI.conclusion: 语言在推理中扮演的角色从L1到L4逐步加深，但推理开销也随之增加；实际部署需要在语义能力与推理成本之间做权衡。该综述为VLA自动驾驶研究提供了分类学参考，并配套持续更新的开源仓库。

title: Efficient GPU Retrieval for Semantic Search
summary:
Semantic Search on LinkedIn must retrieve relevant profiles from a corpus of hundreds of millions in response to natural-language queries such as "a fintech founder in Berlin who worked in payments." The deployed relevance policy is bottleneck-oriented: every active non-negotiable facet must be satisfied, and a pre-existing LLM Graded Relevance (GR) judge operationalizes this through a fixed min/median aggregation over facet grades. Cosine similarity instead averages evidence, letting a strong match on one facet mask failure on another, capping the recall of the first-stage (L0) retriever.
  We present a policy-aligned retrieval framework: embeddings are partitioned into eight category-supervised segments whose scores follow the same min/median rule at serving time; for multi-vector retrieval, this segment score is computed independently per tagged document slot and maximized across slots. A lightweight single-slot Stage-1 scorer generates high-recall candidates, while scale-invariant relative-norm gating keeps category activation consistent across training, evaluation, and serving. On 21K held-out queries, this representation improves offline relevance over a matched-capacity baseline, with gains broadly distributed across facet combinations.
  We serve this framework with a two-stage GPU architecture: an FP8 coarse ranker scores the full corpus, increasing per-shard capacity by 71% and Stage-1 matmul throughput by 36%, then an FP16 stage exactly re-ranks an oversampled candidate set, recovering 99.6-99.8% of full-FP16 recall at over 500 QPS per shard replica. In a member-randomized A/B test, exploratory-query Precision@10 under the unchanged GR judge rises from 63.7% to 79.0% and navigational Precision@1 from 65.5% to 74.7%, with a blinded human evaluation independently confirming the Precision@10 gain.

AI.tldr: LinkedIn提出了一个策略对齐的检索框架，将嵌入划分为八个类别监督的片段，在服务时遵循与现有LLM相关性评判器相同的min/median聚合规则，并配合FP8/FP16两阶段GPU架构，在保持高召回率的同时显著提升搜索相关性指标。
AI.motivation: LinkedIn语义搜索面临的核心问题：现有基于余弦相似度的检索器采用平均化评分，允许一个方面的强匹配掩盖另一个方面的失败，这与部署的"瓶颈导向"相关性策略（即所有非协商要素必须满足）不一致，限制了L0阶段检索器的召回上限。
AI.method: 1) 将嵌入划分为八个类别监督片段，每个片段独立打分，遵循min/median聚合规则；多向量检索时按文档槽位独立计算并跨槽最大化。2) 轻量级单槽Stage-1评分器用于高召回候选生成，尺度不变的相对范数门控确保类别激活在训练/评估/服务间一致。3) 两阶段GPU架构：FP8粗排全语料库（提升分片容量71%，吞吐量36%），FP16阶段精确重排过采样候选集，恢复99.6-99.8%的全FP16召回率。
AI.result: 在21K留出查询上离线相关性优于同等容量基线；A/B测试中，探索性查询Precision@10从63.7%提升至79.0%，导航性查询Precision@1从65.5%提升至74.7%，盲评人员评估独立确认了增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过使检索表示和评分逻辑与部署的相关性策略对齐，可以在不牺牲系统效率的前提下显著提升搜索质量，验证了"策略对齐检索"这一设计理念在大规模工业系统中的有效性。

title: DocIntent: Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration for Real-World Document Visual Question Answering
summary: Real-world degradations such as blur, shadow, distortion, and moire patterns severely impair the document question-answering capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Applying restoration tools before Visual Question Answering (VQA) is an intuitive solution. However, existing restoration approaches remain limited, as manually designing and executing restoration strategies is labor-intensive and requires domain expertise. Agentic restoration offers new possibilities for automation, yet existing frameworks primarily target natural images and pursue perceptual quality, overlooking that restoration should serve downstream tasks rather than optimize generic image quality metrics. To this end, we explore the value of agentic restoration for real-world degraded document VQA and propose DocIntent, a training-free Answerability-Guided Agentic Restoration framework. DocIntent first assesses question answerability, then identifies task-relevant degradations and selectively invokes restoration tools. A Comparison-Based Rollback mechanism validates each restoration step and reverts it when question-relevant evidence becomes less decipherable. The entire process requires no additional pretrained degradation classifier or image quality assessment model. Extensive experiments on the WildDoc benchmark show that DocIntent consistently improves the average score and consistency of different open- and closed-source MLLMs. The code and experimental data will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出了DocIntent，一个无需训练的、基于可回答性引导的智能智能恢复框架，用于改善真实场景退化文档的视觉问答表现。该框架评估问题可回答性、识别任务相关退化并选择性调用恢复工具，通过比较回滚机制验证每一步恢复操作。实验证明在WildDoc基准上能持续提升不同MLLM的平均得分和一致性。
AI.motivation: 真实世界中的文档退化（模糊、阴影、扭曲、摩尔纹等）严重损害多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的文档问答能力。现有的恢复方法需要人工设计恢复策略且劳动密集；已有的智能体恢复框架主要面向自然图像并追求感知质量，忽略了恢复应服务于下游任务而非优化通用图像质量指标。
AI.method: DocIntent框架包含三个核心组件：1) 可回答性评估（Answerability-Guided）：首先评估问题能否被回答；2) 任务相关退化识别与选择性恢复：识别与问题相关的退化类型并选择性调用恢复工具；3) 基于比较的回滚机制（Comparison-Based Rollback）：验证每一步恢复操作，当问题相关证据变得不可辨识时回滚该操作。整个框架无需额外的预训练退化分类器或图像质量评估模型。
AI.result: 在WildDoc基准上的大量实验表明，DocIntent持续提升了不同开源和闭源MLLM的平均得分和回答一致性。
AI.conclusion: DocIntent证明了智能体恢复可以自动化地服务于文档VQA下游任务，通过任务导向的恢复策略和回滚验证机制，无需额外训练模型即可显著改善退化文档场景下的MLLM问答能力。

title: Contrast-Free Autonomous Navigation of Untethered Endovascular Microrobots Using Single-Plane Fluoroscopy
summary: Reliable three-dimensional (3D) navigation of magnetically actuated untethered microrobots remains a major barrier to clinical translation. X-ray fluoroscopy is the standard real-time imaging modality for endovascular procedures, but single-plane fluoroscopy provides only a two-dimensional (2D) projection, eliminating depth information and complicating autonomous navigation. Recovering this information through biplane imaging or repeated contrast-enhanced angiography increases procedural complexity, radiation exposure, or contrast burden. Here, we introduce VISTA (Virtual Integration for Spatial Tracking and Autonomy), a digital twin framework enabling contrast-free autonomous navigation under single-plane fluoroscopy. VISTA reconstructs vascular anatomy as a 3D digital twin, discretizes the vessel centerline into navigation milestones, and assigns the detected 2D robot position to the nearest projected milestone. Consecutive milestones define the local vessel orientation used to generate magnetic actuation commands, converting single-plane fluoroscopic observations into topology-constrained navigation states without requiring contrast injection during navigation. VISTA is demonstrated across anatomically distinct vascular phantoms under continuous flow and within the inferior vena cava of a live rat in vivo.
