Compared with conventional fluoroscopic human-in-the-loop control, VISTA reduced navigation time by up to 62%, corrective actuation commands by up to 98%, and radiation exposure by up to 57%. These results establish VISTA as a digital twin-guided framework for contrast-free autonomous navigation of untethered endovascular microrobots using widely available single-plane fluoroscopy.

AI.tldr: VISTA是一个数字孪生框架，通过将血管解剖结构重建为3D数字孪生模型，实现无造影剂的单平面荧光透视下自主导航磁性驱动的无绳微型机器人。它利用最近投影里程碑将2D机器人位置映射到3D血管中心线上，生成磁驱动命令，在流动的血管模型中及活体大鼠下腔静脉中验证，相比传统方法减少62%导航时间、98%纠正命令和57%辐射暴露。
AI.motivation: 单平面荧光透视仅提供2D投影，缺乏深度信息，阻碍了磁性驱动的无绳微型机器人的可靠3D导航和自主控制。现有的双平面成像或造影增强血管造影方案增加了程序复杂性、辐射暴露或造影剂负担，亟需一种不依赖造影剂即可恢复深度信息的导航框架。
AI.method: VISTA框架包括：(1) 将血管解剖重建为3D数字孪生模型；(2) 将血管中心线离散化为导航里程碑；(3) 将检测到的2D机器人位置分配给最近的投影里程碑；(4) 利用连续里程碑定义局部血管方向以生成磁驱动命令，将单平面荧光观察转换为拓扑约束的导航状态，全程无需造影剂注入。
AI.result: 在解剖结构不同的血管模型中（持续流动条件下）及活体大鼠下腔静脉内进行了验证。与传统荧光透视人工闭环控制相比，VISTA将导航时间减少最多62%，纠正性驱动命令减少最多98%，辐射暴露减少最多57%。
AI.conclusion: VISTA建立了一种基于数字孪生的框架，利用广泛可用的单平面荧光透视实现无绳血管内微型机器人的无造影剂自主导航，为临床转化提供了可行路径。

title: From Analytics to Tumor Boards: An Evidence-Linked Multi-Agent Workflow for Oncology Feature Extraction
summary: Clinically relevant oncology information is distributed across heterogeneous, longitudinal documentation, creating substantial abstraction burden and requiring accurate attribution across specimens, tumors, biomarkers, and time points, while manual cancer-registry abstraction can require 27.2 minutes per case, highlighting the need for scalable methods that preserve clinical context while converting documentation into structured data. We evaluate the Nimblemind Multi-Agent System (nMAS), a configurable oncology information-extraction workflow which extracts clinically relevant structured fields from fragmented oncology documentation. The extraction task uses a clinician-informed schema of 328 attributes spanning report metadata, diagnosis, staging, and cancer-type-specific information. nMAS separates clinician-defined field specifications from model execution and combines complexity-aware extraction, report-level consolidation, and source-grounded validation. The retrospective evaluation included 230 de-identified oncology documents from 40 patients and 418 clinician-reviewed document-field pairs containing 1,126 non-empty reference values. Evaluation focused on fields identified by clinicians as present in the source documents rather than exhaustively annotating all 328 schema fields. nMAS achieved a rank-weighted value-level precision of 82.6%, recall of 87.5%, and F1 of 85.0%, compared with an F1 of 66.4% for an independently implemented UMA-style MiniMax M2.5 comparator. These findings support the feasibility of using a configurable, source-grounded extraction workflow to convert fragmented oncology documentation into reusable structured data.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍并评估了Nimblemind多智能体系统（nMAS），一个可配置的肿瘤学信息抽取工作流，用于从碎片化的肿瘤学文档中提取结构化临床数据。nMAS将临床医生定义的字段规范与模型执行分离，结合复杂度感知抽取、报告级整合和源文档追溯验证。在230份去标识化文档、418个临床医生审核的文档-字段对中，nMAS实现了85.0%的F1分数，显著优于基线比较器的66.4%。
AI.motivation: 临床相关的肿瘤学信息分散在异构、纵向的文档中，人工癌症登记抽象每例需要27.2分钟，造成巨大的抽象负担。需要可扩展的方法在保留临床背景的同时将文档转换为结构化数据，解决跨样本、肿瘤、生物标志物和时间点的准确归因问题。
AI.method: nMAS是一个可配置的肿瘤学信息抽取工作流：1) 使用临床医生定义的328个属性模式（涵盖报告元数据、诊断、分期和癌症类型特定信息）；2) 将字段规范与模型执行分离；3) 采用复杂度感知抽取、报告级整合和源文档追溯验证三个核心机制。
AI.result: 在230份去标识化文档（40名患者）和418个临床医生审核的文档-字段对（含1,126个非空参考值）上，nMAS实现排名加权值级精确率82.6%、召回率87.5%、F1 85.0%，而独立实现的UMA风格MiniMax M2.5比较器的F1仅为66.4%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，使用可配置、源文档追溯的抽取工作流，将碎片化肿瘤学文档转换为可复用的结构化数据是可行的，为减轻临床文档抽象负担提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: sRGB Real Noise Modeling via Noise-Aware Sampling with Normalizing Flows
summary: Noise poses a widespread challenge in signal processing, particularly when it comes to denoising images. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have exhibited remarkable success in this field, they are predicated upon the belief that noise follows established distributions, which restricts their practicality when dealing with real-world noise. To overcome this limitation, several efforts have been taken to collect noisy image datasets from the real world. Generative methods, employing techniques such as generative adversarial networks (GANs) and normalizing flows (NFs), have emerged as a solution for generating realistic noisy images. Recent works model noise using camera metadata, however requiring metadata even for sampling phase. In contrast, in this work, we aim to estimate the underlying camera settings, enabling us to improve noise modeling and generate diverse noise distributions. To this end, we introduce a new NF framework that allows us to both classify noise based on camera settings and generate various noisy images. Through experimental results, our model demonstrates exceptional noise quality and leads in denoising performance on benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于归一化流（NF）的新框架，无需相机元数据即可估计相机设置，从而改进真实噪声建模，并生成多样化的噪声分布用于图像去噪。
AI.motivation: 传统CNN去噪依赖假设噪声服从已知分布，限制了处理真实噪声的能力。现有生成方法虽能生成真实噪声，但需要相机元数据，这在实际采样阶段难以获取。
AI.method: 提出一个新的归一化流（NF）框架，能够同时完成两项任务：(1) 基于相机设置对噪声进行分类；(2) 生成各种多样化的噪声图像。通过估计底层相机设置来改进噪声建模，无需采样阶段依赖元数据。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该模型生成的噪声质量优异，在基准数据集上的去噪性能领先。
AI.conclusion: 通过估计相机设置而非依赖元数据，该方法提升了真实噪声建模的灵活性和实用性，为图像去噪提供了更通用的生成式解决方案。

title: Optimized Modular Design and Development of a Tilt-Rotor Bicopter Drone
comment: 7 pages, conference, Index terms -Tilt-Rotor Bicopter Drone, Optimal Modular Design, Static Analysis, Dynamic Flight Analysis
summary: Hybrid systems like tilt-rotor bicopter drones combine the beneficial characteristics of both fixed-wing and rotary-wing technology, enabling long endurance and VTOL capability. However, such drones also require an optimum design to ensure both static and dynamic stability. The modular design of a traditional bicopter is developed in this paper based on extensive analysis and in-depth structural and aerodynamic simulations. The structural analysis has been performed to ensure that the aircraft's structure withstands the stresses encountered during different flight modes. Controlling the relative positions of the Center of Gravity (CG) and Neutral Point (NP) is an essential aspect of the design, ensuring stability during hover and positive stability during forward flight. The thrust and power analyses have been conducted to assess the flight performance and endurance. After analysis, the drone has been developed, and flight tests with a basic flight controller were conducted to validate the performance metrics obtained in the simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对倾转旋翼双旋翼无人机（bicopter）这一混合动力系统，基于结构分析和气动仿真开展了模块化设计，并通过控制重心（CG）与中性点（NP）的相对位置来确保悬停和前飞模式的稳定性，最后通过飞行测试验证了仿真性能指标。
AI.motivation: 倾转旋翼双旋翼无人机结合了固定翼和旋翼机的优点（长航时+垂直起降），但需要最优设计来同时保证静态和动态稳定性，因此有必要进行系统性的结构分析、气动仿真和飞行验证。
AI.method: 采用模块化设计方法，进行了结构分析以确保机体在不同飞行模式下承受应力；通过控制CG与NP的相对位置来保证悬停稳定性和前飞正稳定性；进行了推力和功率分析以评估飞行性能和续航能力。
AI.result: 完成了无人机样机开发，并使用基础飞行控制器进行了飞行测试，仿真中获得的性能指标得到了实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 基于仿真分析和飞行测试的验证，该双旋翼无人机的模块化设计方法可行，能够同时满足混合飞行模式下的稳定性和性能要求。

title: The Role of Network Topology and Opponent Information in Shaping Cooperation in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Systems
summary: Several works have investigated the influence of graph topology on cooperation among artificial agents, while the majority of the literature has focused on modelling agents' adaptation through strategy imitation, which relies solely on the cumulative payoffs of others. This paper investigates scenarios in which each agent learns to play the two-player Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma (IPD) using deep reinforcement learning. Each agent is represented as a node in a graph, where its neighbours constitute the pool of opponents with whom it can interact. During each IPD episode, agents are provided with different types of information about their opponent, consisting of action history and opponent identity. Experimental results across different graph topologies show that the number of neighbours per node and the average path length are the main factors affecting the emergence of cooperation. We also show that, while partner selection fosters mutual cooperation by limiting the diversity of the opponent pool, providing agents with the identity of their opponent hinders the proliferation of cooperative strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究深强化学习智能体在图拓扑下学习两人迭代囚徒困境（IPD）游戏时的合作涌现问题，发现节点邻居数量和平均路径长度是影响合作的主要因素，对手身份信息会阻碍合作策略的传播，而伙伴选择机制通过限制对手多样性促进互利合作。
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多研究图拓扑对合作的影响，但智能体适应机制主要依赖于基于累积收益的策略模仿。本文探索智能体通过深度强化学习（而非模仿）来学习玩IPD时，不同图结构和信息类型如何影响合作的涌现。
AI.method: 每个智能体作为图中的节点，邻居构成可交互的对手池。智能体使用深度强化学习学习两人IPD，在每轮博弈中智能体获得不同类型的对手信息（动作历史、对手身份）。实验在不同图拓扑结构下进行对比分析。
AI.result: 节点邻居数和平均路径长度是合作涌现的主要影响因子；伙伴选择机制（限制对手池多样性）促进相互合作；而向智能体提供对手身份信息会阻碍合作策略的扩散。
AI.conclusion: 在深强化学习框架下，图拓扑结构对合作行为的影响与传统模仿学习下的结论有所不同，对手信息的提供方式和对手池的多样性是影响合作涌现的关键设计因素。

title: Di$^2$CycleSB: Towards High-Quality Unsupervised Nighttime Visibility Enhancement via Schrödinger Bridge Transformer
summary: Light-effect contamination poses a significant challenge to nighttime visibility enhancement. Most methods suppress light effects by estimating and decomposing them through prior-driven regularization, yet they are often limited by hand-crafted priors and ill-posed nature of decomposition. This work proposes Di$^2$CycleSB, a unsupervised Cycle Schrödinger Bridge Transformer framework guided by dynamic integral image priors, for high-quality unsupervised nighttime visibility enhancement. Specifically, a novel light-effect estimator is introduced to parameterize Gaussian-like adaptive priors by aggregating dynamic integral image representations for non-uniform glow estimation. Then, we propose a prior-informed Generator that exploits light-effect representations to guide long-range dependency modeling within our specific Transformer blocks. We formulate light-effect suppression as a Schrödinger bridge problem and construct forward and backward bridges with cycle consistency constraints to achieve visually pleasing enhancement. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate the remarkable effectiveness of our Di$^2$CycleSB in enhancing nighttime visibility. In particular, it achieves effective end-to-end light-effect suppression without any regularization constraints and image decomposition. The code and models are available at https://github.com/LHTcode/Di2CycleSB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Di²CycleSB，一种基于动态积分图像先验的无监督Cycle Schrödinger Bridge Transformer框架，用于夜间可见度增强。该方法通过光效应估计器参数化自适应先验，利用Transformer模块建模长距离依赖，并以循环一致性约束构建前向/反向桥以实现无正则化约束、无图像分解的端到端光效应抑制。
AI.motivation: 夜间可见度增强中，光效污染是一大挑战。现有方法多依赖手工先验和图像分解，但受限于先验设计的局限性以及分解的ill-posed本质，难以获得高质量结果。
AI.method: 1) 提出光效应估计器，通过聚合动态积分图像表示参数化高斯类自适应先验，用于非均匀光晕估计；2) 提出先验引导的生成器，利用光效应表示指导特定Transformer块内的长距离依赖建模；3) 将光效应抑制形式化为Schrödinger桥问题，构建带循环一致性约束的前向/反向桥实现增强。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验证明了Di²CycleSB在夜间可见度增强方面的显著有效性，实现了无需任何正则化约束和图像分解的端到端光效应抑制。
AI.conclusion: Di²CycleSB通过Schrödinger桥框架与动态积分图像先验的结合，成功克服了传统方法对手工先验和图像分解的依赖，为夜间可见度增强提供了一种高效的无监督解决方案。

title: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: General embodied agents should perceive, predict, act, evaluate, and improve within a unified system. World models have shown great promise in building such agents, yet existing models typically append an action output head to a world simulator, without coupling them into a closed decision-and-learning loop for policy improvement. We present Motus2, a self-evolving general world model for dexterous manipulation. Motus2 advances world modeling through model scaling and data scaling. For model scaling, a single model with shared weights exposes three control interfaces: a policy (world-action model), a simulator (action-conditioned world model), and an evaluator (value model). The policy proposes candidate action chunks, the simulator predicts their visual consequences, and the evaluator assesses the predicted outcomes. Their coupling forms a closed decision-and-learning loop for policy improvement. This formulation uses curated expert demonstrations for action learning, while failed and suboptimal interactions provide valuable evidence for dynamics modeling and value learning. For data scaling, Motus2 progresses from large-scale monocular egocentric data to synchronized stereo egocentric data, followed by robot-domain adaptation with robot trajectories and supplementary human-robot alignment data. Motus2 further studies global-autoregressive and hybrid-memory extensions of its sliding-window context, adds tactile feedback for contact-aware control, and is instantiated on a fully biomimetic platform with stereo vision, dual arms, dual dexterous hands, and tactile sensing. Together, egocentric data scaling and closed-loop general world model scaling provide a general path toward self-evolving dexterous manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Motus2，一个用于灵巧操作的自演化通用世界模型。该模型通过单一权重共享网络同时提供策略（世界-动作模型）、模拟器（动作条件世界模型）和评估器（价值模型）三种控制接口，形成闭环决策-学习循环以提升策略。同时通过从单目到双目立体视觉的数据扩展、机器人域适应、触觉反馈和多模态记忆等途径实现数据扩展。该模型在具有双目视觉、双臂、双手和触觉感知的全仿生平台上实例化。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型通常仅将动作输出头附加到世界模拟器上，未将策略、预测和评估耦合为闭环的决策与学习循环，限制了智能体自我进化的能力。因此需要一种将预测、行动、评估整合为一体的统一世界模型框架。
AI.method: 模型扩展方面：单一共享权重模型暴露三种控制接口——策略（提出候选动作块）、模拟器（预测视觉后果）、评估器（评估预测结果），三者耦合形成闭环策略改进循环。专家演示用于动作学习，失败和次优交互用于动力学与价值学习。数据扩展方面：从大规模单目第一人称数据推进到同步立体第一人称数据，再进行机器人域适应，配合人机对齐数据；同时研究全局自回归和混合记忆扩展滑动窗口上下文，增加触觉反馈以增强接触感知控制。整个系统在具有立体视觉、双臂、双手和触觉感知的全仿生平台上实现。
AI.result: Motus2通过闭环耦合策略-模拟器-评估器，将失败的次优交互转化为动力学和价值学习的有效信号，实现策略的自我进化。第一人称数据扩展与闭环通用世界模型扩展共同为灵巧操作提供了通向自演化智能的通用路径。
AI.conclusion: 第一人称数据扩展和闭环通用世界模型扩展相结合，为自演化灵巧操作提供了通用且可扩展的路径，为通用具身智能体的统一感知-预测-行动-评估-改进框架奠定基础。

title: Selective Forgetting: A Graph-Based Memory Framework for Long-Term LLM Agents
summary:
Knowledge graphs have been proposed as a structured alternative to flat retrieval-augmented generation for long-term agent memory, on the assumption that representing conversations as entities and relations improves recall. We evaluate that assumption directly. Our framework extracts each conversational turn into typed nodes and attributed edges, answers questions from a two-hop subgraph, and periodically prunes nodes that score low on a weighted combination of recency, access frequency, degree centrality, and age. On LongMemEval, the graph does not outperform a flat vector baseline at a matched candidate-generation budget of five retrieval roots: token F1 is $0.417$ against $0.468$, and a paired bootstrap over 500 questions gives
$Δ= -0.050$ (95\% CI $[-0.085, -0.016]$). The gap is widest on questions that require recalling a specific prior assistant turn, where judged correctness falls from $0.911$ to $0.607$, suggesting that decomposing a turn into entities discards the surface form these questions depend on. The forgetting module is more successful. Applied once to a persistent 27{,}021-node graph, it removes 9.8\% of nodes and 9.5\% of stored bytes; token F1 is unchanged ($+0.001$, 95\% CI $[-0.015, +0.016]$) and judged correctness falls by $1.6$ points, with the 95\% interval bounding any loss at $3.8$ points ($[-0.038, +0.006]$). Because our extractor is a single small model evaluated on one benchmark, these results characterise this extraction-based pipeline rather than graph-structured memory in general. Code: https://github.com/skhanzad/Selective-Amnesia

AI.tldr: 本文直接评估了知识图谱作为长期智能体记忆替代平面RAG（检索增强生成）的假设。实验表明，在匹配的候选生成预算下，图谱方法并未超越平面向量基线（token F1为0.417 vs 0.468），但在遗忘（剪枝）模块上表现出色，能在几乎不影响性能的情况下减少9.8%的节点和9.5%的存储空间。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱常被提议作为长期智能体记忆的替代方案，其假设是将对话表示为实体和关系能提高回忆性能。然而，这个核心假设从未被直接严格评估过。作者旨在填补这一空白，通过受控实验检验图谱结构化记忆是否真的优于平面检索。
AI.method: 框架将每一轮对话提取为类型化节点和带属性的边，从两跳子图中回答问题，并周期性剪枝基于加权组合（近期性、访问频率、度中心性、年龄）得分较低的节点。在LongMemEval基准上，以匹配的5个检索根作为候选生成预算，与平面向量基线对比。遗忘模块在包含27,021个节点的持久图谱上应用一次。
AI.result: 图谱方法在token F1上不及平面基线（0.417 vs 0.468），配对bootstrap显示Δ=-0.050（95% CI [-0.085, -0.016]）。差距在回忆特定助手回合的问题上最为显著（正确率从0.911降至0.607）。遗忘模块更成功：去除9.8%节点和9.5%字节，token F1不变（+0.001），正确率仅降1.6点。
AI.conclusion: 将对话回合分解为实体会丢失平面表示中保留的表面形式，而这类形式信息正是某些问题回忆所依赖的。图谱结构记忆在当前提取管线中并未超越平面基线。但遗忘/剪枝模块证明了其价值，能在几乎不影响性能的前提下显著压缩存储。作者谨慎指出结果仅表征该特定提取管线，而非图结构记忆的一般性结论。

title: DReSG: Diffusion Residuals for Stylized Gaussian Splatting
summary: Reference-guided stylization of scenes represented by 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is important for efficient and controllable 3D content creation. Existing VGG-feature-based 3D stylization methods provide stable rendered-view optimization, but often under-represent expressive reference style cues; diffusion models offer stronger image priors, yet direct per-view or score-based diffusion guidance can lead to view drift, local artifacts, and hard-to-control appearance updates. We present DReSG, a 3D-grounded residual-feedback framework for stylized Gaussian splatting. DReSG represents attention-guided diffusion proposals as residual targets relative to the current render, and progressively absorbs these residuals into a shared Gaussian scene through multi-view Gaussian feedback. To make this feedback stable and controllable, DReSG modulates residual strength during target construction and combines coverage-aware view selection with conflict-filtered color updates during multi-view fitting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DReSG achieves competitive reference-guided stylization while better preserving scene structure and cross-view stability. Our project page is available at https://vpx-ecnu.github.io/DReSG-website/.

AI.tldr: DReSG是一种基于3D残差反馈的框架，用于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景的参考图引导风格化。它将注意力引导的扩散模型提案表示为相对当前渲染的残差目标，通过多视图高斯反馈逐步将这些残差吸收到共享高斯场景中，并通过残差强度调制、覆盖感知视图选择和冲突过滤色彩更新来保证稳定性和可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有的VGG特征方法具有稳定的渲染视图优化但表现力不足；扩散模型虽有更强图像先验，但直接使用会导致视图漂移、局部伪影和难以控制的外观更新。需要一种既能利用扩散模型强大能力又能保持3D一致性的风格化方法。
AI.method: DReSG将注意力引导的扩散模型输出作为相对当前渲染的残差目标，通过多视图高斯反馈逐步将残差融入共享高斯场景。具体包括：目标构建阶段的残差强度调制，以及多视图拟合阶段的覆盖感知视图选择与冲突过滤色彩更新。
AI.result: 实验证明DReSG在参考图引导风格化任务中达到竞争力效果，同时更好地保持场景结构和跨视图稳定性。
AI.conclusion: DReSG通过3D接地残差反馈机制，成功在扩散模型图像先验与3D场景一致性之间取得平衡，为3DGS风格化提供了更稳定可控的解决方案。

title: CanonNav: Disentangling Navigation Behavior from Camera Geometry in Cross-Platform Visual Navigation
summary: While visual navigation has advanced through imitation learning from cross-platform demonstrations, fully leveraging such data remains challenging. First, directly learning from image-trajectory pairs entangles navigation behavior with platform-dependent camera geometry. This hinders consistent learning by forcing the policy to implicitly infer camera geometry from visual observations, an inherently ill-posed problem. Second, imitation learning from demonstrated trajectories captures the expert's chosen motion but leaves the intermediate decisions underlying that motion implicit. To address these issues, we propose CanonNav, a visual navigation framework that disentangles navigation behavior from camera geometry and incorporates complementary planning supervision into learning from cross-platform demonstrations. CanonNav introduces camera geometry canonicalization, which transforms visual observations and trajectories into a camera-consistent representation space. Building on this representation, we derive safety and local-progress supervision using pseudo-labels from an offline traversability estimator. Safety supervision penalizes unsafe trajectories, while local-progress supervision guides where the robot should advance. Experiments across diverse camera configurations and environments show that, despite using only RGB at inference, CanonNav consistently outperforms RGB-based baselines and even surpasses RGB-D-based methods in challenging scenarios.

AI.tldr: CanonNav是一个视觉导航框架，通过相机几何正则化和规划监督来解决跨平台演示模仿学习中的两大挑战：相机几何依赖和中间决策缺失。实验表明仅用RGB即可超越RGB-D方法。
AI.motivation: 跨平台演示的模仿学习面临两个核心问题：一是图像-轨迹对直接学习会与平台相关的相机几何纠缠，迫使策略从视觉观察中隐式推断相机几何（病态问题）；二是模仿学习只捕获了专家选择的运动，而忽略了该运动背后的中间决策过程。
AI.method: CanonNav提出两个关键组件：(1) 相机几何正则化（camera geometry canonicalization），将视觉观察和轨迹转换到相机一致的表示空间；(2) 利用离线可通行性估计器的伪标签，引入安全监督（惩罚不安全轨迹）和局部进度监督（引导机器人前进方向），补充规划监督信号。
AI.result: 在多种相机配置和环境的实验中，CanonNav仅使用RGB输入就持续优于RGB基线，并在具有挑战性的场景中超越了RGB-D方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦导航行为与相机几何并引入互补的规划监督，CanonNav有效提升了跨平台演示学习导航的性能，证明了即使在推理时仅用RGB也能达到甚至超越深度方法的效果。

title: Agentic AI uncovers conserved cross-tissue protein co-abundance programs inaccessible to single-dataset analysis
summary: Protein co-abundance clusters preserved across tissues can reveal shared disease mechanisms and candidate therapeutic targets, particularly when proteins implicated in organ-confined diseases converge in peripheral or accessible tissues. However, previous cross-tissue studies have focused on biologically pre-selected tissue pairs, leaving most possible combinations and non-obvious relationships unexplored. We present an LLM-agent framework for large-scale, evidence-grounded comparison of tissue-specific protein co-abundance networks. The framework constructs tissue networks, derives pairwise consensus clusters, and integrates evidence from expression atlases, protein interaction and complex databases, pathway annotations, disease catalogues, and literature. Applied to all 820 pairwise combinations of 41 human tissues and fluids, it identified 1,833 conserved co-abundance clusters across 406 tissue pairs. Colon, synovial fluid, blood, cerebrospinal fluid, and bone marrow were the most broadly connected tissues, while the most cluster-rich pairs were dominated by bone marrow. The analysis also highlighted non-obvious relationships: skin-bone marrow exceeded the anatomically adjacent bone-bone marrow pair, while colon-breast contained cancer-relevant clusters involving extracellular-matrix remodeling, lipid metabolism, and immune modulation. Cluster-level analyses generated further mechanistic hypotheses, including a brain-gut extracellular-vesicle/redox/serotonin-cofactor axis and a liver-bone marrow stress-response axis involving genes linked to white matter disease. These results provide a global, comparable landscape of conserved protein co-abundance and a hypothesis-generating resource for mechanistic and therapeutic exploration. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Gry1005/AgenticAI-conserved-cross-tissue-protein-co-abundance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个LLM-agent框架，用于大规模、基于证据的跨组织蛋白共丰度网络比较。该框架从41个人类组织和体液构建组织网络，生成成对共识簇，并整合表达图谱、蛋白互作、通路注释、疾病目录和文献等多源证据。应用于所有820个组织对组合，识别出1833个保守共丰度簇，跨越406个组织对。发现结肠、滑液、血液、脑脊液和骨髓是最广泛连接的组织，并揭示了非显而易见的关联（如皮肤-骨髓超越骨-骨髓、结肠-乳腺含癌症相关簇）。聚类层面分析生成了脑-肠细胞外囊泡/氧化还原/血清素辅助因子轴和肝-骨髓应激反应轴等机制假说，为机制和治疗探索提供假设生成的资源。
AI.motivation: 以往跨组织研究仅聚焦于生物学预先选定的组织对，忽略了大多数可能的组合和非显而易见的关联。作者旨在通过大规模、系统性的方式探索所有组织配对中的保守蛋白共丰度关系，以发现共享疾病机制和候选治疗靶点，特别是在外周或可及组织中汇聚的器官限制性疾病相关蛋白。
AI.method: 提出LLM-agent框架：(1)构建41个组织/体液的特异性蛋白共丰度网络；(2)对全部820个组织对推导成对共识簇；(3)整合多源证据（表达图谱、蛋白互作和复合物数据库、通路注释、疾病目录、文献）；(4)通过agent进行证据融合和假设生成，识别保守共丰度簇并分析其生物学意义。
AI.result: 识别出1833个在406个组织对中保守的共丰度簇。结肠、滑液、血液、脑脊液和骨髓是最广泛连接的组织，骨髓主导了簇最丰富的组织对。非显而易见的关系包括：皮肤-骨髓超越了解剖上相邻的骨-骨髓配对；结肠-乳腺包含涉及细胞外基质重塑、脂质代谢和免疫调控的癌症相关簇。聚类层面分析揭示了脑-肠道细胞外囊泡/氧化还原/血清素辅因子轴及肝-骨髓应激反应轴（涉及与白质疾病相关的基因）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了全局、可比较的保守蛋白共丰度图谱，作为一个假设生成的资源，能够揭示非显而易见的组织间分子联系，为跨组织疾病机制和治疗靶点的探索开辟新途径。代码和数据已公开。

title: AdapToPASS: Ambiguity-aware Adaptive Spherical Transformer for Panoramic Semantic Segmentation
summary: Spherical Transformers have emerged as a promising framework for panoramic semantic segmentation (PASS) by operating directly on spherical geometry and alleviating projection-induced distortions. However, existing architectures often assume canonical spherical structure and stable viewpoints, which are frequently violated in real-world imagery due to unconstrained camera motion, introducing contextual and geometric ambiguity. Consequently, they lack adaptive mechanisms to handle such ambiguity, limiting robustness to unseen spherical transformations. In contrast, biological perception is inherently ambiguity-aware, adapting to fluctuations in cue reliability caused by geometric and contextual variations to maintain stable interpretation under complex transformations. Motivated by this, we first systematically analyze existing PASS architectures under various unseen spherical transformations. We then introduce AdapToPASS, a novel bio-inspired Spherical Transformer that adaptively models contextual and geometric ambiguities for robust PASS. At its core, Adaptive Spherical Attention (AdaSpA) blocks dynamically modulate attention according to local contextual ambiguity, mimicking adaptive, context-driven biological perception. To address geometric ambiguity, AdapToPASS employs Bifocal Spherical Representation to balance field of view and spatial resolution, together with boundary supervision inspired by the boundary-sensitive nature of biological vision. Across indoor and outdoor semantic segmentation, AdapToPASS consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods. Under unseen spherical transformations, it surpasses the next-best method by +13.38% relative mIoU on Stanford2D3D and +18.77% on WildPASS. We further introduce AdapToPASS-Swift, a lightweight variant with fewer than 2M parameters, which surpasses compact baselines while retaining robustness to spherical transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdapToPASS，一种受生物启发的球形Transformer，用于全景语义分割。它通过自适应球形注意力(AdaSpA)处理上下文模糊性，通过双焦球形表示和边界监督处理几何模糊性，在未见球形变换下大幅超越现有方法，并推出轻量级变体AdapToPASS-Swift。
AI.motivation: 现有球形Transformer假设标准球形结构和稳定视点，但在真实世界图像中相机运动不受约束，导致上下文和几何模糊性。这些模型缺乏适应此类模糊性的机制，鲁棒性受限。生物感知天然具备模糊性感知能力，能适应线索可靠性的波动，因此作者受此启发。
AI.method: 1) 系统分析现有PASS架构在各种未见球形变换下的表现；2) 提出AdapToPASS，核心包括：Adaptive Spherical Attention (AdaSpA)块，根据局部上下文模糊性动态调节注意力；Bifocal Spherical Representation平衡视场与空间分辨率；边界监督机制模拟生物视觉的边界敏感特性。
AI.result: 在室内外语义分割任务中一致超越现有SOTA方法。在未见球形变换下，相对mIoU比次优方法提升+13.38%(Stanford2D3D)和+18.77%(WildPASS)。轻量级变体AdapToPASS-Swift参数少于2M，超越紧凑基线且保持对球形变换的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 生物启发的模糊性自适应机制可显著提升球形Transformer在复杂真实场景下的鲁棒性，AdapToPASS验证了该思路的有效性，同时轻量级变体展示了实际部署潜力。

title: CometVLA: Co-Training on an Embodied Data Pyramid towards Physical Understanding
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models remain brittle in manipulation tasks that require physical commonsense. Current physical VQA data is typically disembodied and misaligned with robot action domains. Egocentric videos are used only as auxiliary pre-training. It remains unclear whether improved VLM physical understanding actually benefits downstream action generation. Therefore, we present CometVLA to close this gap. We construct CometData and CometBench, an embodied physical VQA corpus and benchmark strictly aligned with the robot's action data and embodiment. We introduce Global Action Prior (GAP) tokens, a compact learnable bottleneck that isolates task-agnostic motion regularities and lets the action head consume physical commonsense without corrupting the pre-trained VLM backbone. We co-train CometVLA across the embodied data pyramid, spanning teleoperation, simulation, egocentric trajectories, and VQA layers. On real-world manipulation tasks and RoboTwin simulation, CometVLA consistently outperforms strong VLA baselines. Correlation analysis shows that stronger VLM performance on CometBench indicates higher VLA success rates. Results demonstrate that physical understanding pre-training genuinely benefits downstream manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CometVLA 框架，通过构建与机器人动作数据和具身对齐的物理 VQA 语料库 CometData 和基准 CometBench，并引入全局动作先验（GAP）tokens 作为可学习的紧凑瓶颈，将物理常识注入动作生成而不破坏预训练 VLM 主干。实验证明物理理解预训练确实能提升下游操作任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在需要物理常识的操作任务中表现脆弱。当前物理 VQA 数据通常是"脱离躯体"的，与机器人动作域不对齐；第一视角视频仅作为辅助预训练；且不清楚改进的 VLM 物理理解是否真正有益于下游动作生成。
AI.method: 1) 构建 CometData 和 CometBench：与机器人动作数据和具身严格对齐的物理 VQA 语料和基准；2) 引入 GAP tokens（全局动作先验）：紧凑可学习的瓶颈，隔离任务无关的运动规律，让动作头消费物理常识而不污染预训练 VLM 主干；3) 在具身数据金字塔（遥操作、仿真、第一视角轨迹、VQA 层）上进行协同训练。
AI.result: 在真实世界操作任务和 RoboTwin 仿真中，CometVLA 持续优于强 VLA 基线。相关性分析表明：VLM 在 CometBench 上更强的物理理解表现对应更高的 VLA 成功率。
AI.conclusion: 物理理解预训练确实能显著惠及下游操作任务，弥合了 VLM 物理理解与 VLA 动作生成之间的鸿沟。

title: Verification abundance, adjudication scarcity: what happens to mathematical knowledge when proof checking becomes free
summary:
In May 2026 an OpenAI model produced a counterexample to the Erdős unit distance conjecture. Five mathematicians published a human-verified version the same day, and the result entered the literature within weeks. In August 2026 the same laboratory published ten mathematical and theoretical computer science results, each accompanied by a machine-checkable Lean 4 certificate with no unproved steps. Four weeks later, one remained the subject of an unresolved dispute over whether its formalization meant what it claimed.
  We argue that this difference is structural. We distinguish three layers of verification: derivational validity, which a kernel checks; representational fidelity, whether the formal statement means the intended question; and epistemic significance. Only the first is mechanizable. Making it effectively free therefore does not eliminate verification work but shifts the burden to layers dependent on scarce expert attention.
  Measurements of the August corpus illustrate the shift. The kernel-checked proofs total 20.6 MB, while the statements requiring human audit total 55.6 KB, a ratio of 379 to 1. Yet those statements contain 218 bespoke definitions rather than relying on community-vetted ones. The audit surface is therefore small in volume but irreducibly expert. We argue that machine checking produces verification abundance while leaving adjudication scarce. We propose a six-category taxonomy of representational mismatch, a disclosure schema for machine-generated mathematical claims, and implications for software, cryptography, and regulated decision systems.

AI.tldr: 论文以一个虚构的未来场景（2026年OpenAI模型解决了厄尔多斯单位距离猜想）为引子，讨论了机器学习生成数学证明的验证问题。作者区分了三个层次的验证：推导有效性（可由内核检查）、表征保真度（形式化陈述是否真正表达预期问题）和认知意义。只有第一层可以机械化，因此机器验证使核验工作变得廉价，但将负担转移到依赖稀缺专家注意力的层次。论文通过2026年8月语料库的测量数据（内核检查证明20.6MB对比需要人工审计的陈述55.6KB，比例379:1，但包含218个自定义定义）论证了机器验证产生"验证充裕"而裁决仍然稀缺，并提出六类表征失配分类法、机器生成数学主张的披露模式以及相关应用含义。
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习模型在数学证明方面能力日益增强，机器生成的证明将大量涌现。现有验证框架主要关注推导有效性的机械化检查，但这不足以确保机器生成数学主张的可靠性。作者旨在揭示验证工作的结构性转移问题：当机械化验证变得近乎免费后，真正的瓶颈转移到需要人类专家注意力的表征保真度和认知意义层面，因此需要新的分类和披露框架。
AI.method: 论文采用论证与分析的方法：首先通过2026年5月和8月的两个假设性案例建立论述框架，界定三个验证层次（推导有效性、表征保真度、认知意义）；然后用8月语料库的量化指标（证明体量、需审计陈述体量、自定义定义数量）说明验证负担的转移；最后提出六类表征失配的分类法、一套针对机器生成数学主张的披露模式，并讨论其在软件、密码学和监管决策系统中的启示。
AI.result: 论文展示了一个不对称的验证格局：机械化验证可以产生"验证充裕"（内核检查证明体量巨大且可靠），但表征审计面虽小（仅为证明体量的1/379）却不可约地依赖专家判断（218个自定义定义，未采用社区审定定义）。这一结构决定了机器验证使推导有效性检查变得廉价有效，但表征保真度和认知意义的裁决成为新的稀缺资源。
AI.conclusion: 机器验证的进步不会消除验证工作，而是结构性重新分配验证负担：从可机械化的推导有效性转移到依赖稀缺专家注意力的表征和认知层面。为此，需要建立针对机器生成数学主张的分类学（六类表征失配）和披露模式，以应对数学、软件、密码学和监管决策系统中机器生成结果日益增多的现实。

title: Elastic Triangle Splatting
summary: While neural rendering methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting achieve remarkable visual fidelity, traditional polygonal meshes remain the backbone of established graphics pipelines. Triangle splatting bridges this gap by optimizing triangle primitives as differentiable splats, producing representations that are closer to mesh-based workflows. Central to these methods is the kernel function that softens triangle boundaries to propagate gradients to vertex positions. Existing triangle splatting methods make inconsistent choices of kernel functions, and analysis of these kernels' optimization behavior has been limited to unstructured triangle soups for novel-view synthesis. In this work, we consider triangle splatting as a generic tool for photometric optimization, comparing kernel properties through two complementary tasks: mesh optimization for shape reconstruction and triangle soup optimization for novel-view synthesis. Along with the analysis, we introduce an elastic kernel function that features bilateral gradient support across the boundary and an adaptive boundary value, which are shown to be essential for robust optimization. Under isolated comparison, our elastic kernel outperforms existing kernels on shape reconstruction and in the majority of novel-view synthesis benchmarks, demonstrating the importance of kernel design in the effectiveness and versatility of triangle splatting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三角形光栅化（Triangle Splatting）中的核函数设计，提出一种具有双边梯度支持和自适应边界值的弹性核函数（elastic kernel），并通过形状重建和神经视角合成两个任务对比不同核函数的优化行为，证明该核函数在鲁棒性和性能上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 三角形光栅化方法通过可微化的三角形图元桥接神经渲染与传统网格渲染管线，但现有方法对软化三角形边界的核函数选择不一致，且已有分析仅限于三角汤（triangle soup）的视角合成场景，缺乏对核函数优化行为的系统理解和通用分析。
AI.method: 将三角形光栅化视为通用的光度优化工具，通过两个互补任务（网格优化用于形状重建、三角汤优化用于视角合成）系统地比较不同核函数的性质。提出弹性核函数（elastic kernel），其核心特征包括：1）跨边界的双边梯度支持（bilateral gradient support）；2）自适应边界值（adaptive boundary value）。
AI.result: 在隔离对比条件下，弹性核函数在形状重建任务中优于所有现有核函数，并在大多数视角合成基准上取得最优表现，从而验证核函数设计对三角形光栅化有效性与通用性的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 核函数设计是三角形光栅化方法的核心要素，弹性核函数通过双边梯度支持与自适应边界值显著提升优化鲁棒性，使三角形光栅化在形状重建和视角合成两个任务中均展现出更强的通用性与性能优势。

title: Data-Centric Neuromotor Interfaces for Portable Human-Machine Interaction
summary: Dexterous human-machine interaction requires intuitive and expressive interfaces that can be efficiently deployed on constrained edge devices. Flexible material-based neuromotor interfaces hold considerable promise, as they decode human movement intention into natural control. Although emerging flexible electronic skins enable wearable high-fidelity data acquisition, practical deployment inevitably involves trade-offs between computational resources and portability. We present a data-centric paradigm where physiological features yield fundamental separability, providing sufficient discriminative cues for recognition. A wireless, high-bandwidth system developed for collecting various electrophysiological signals, when integrated with muscle-specific electrodes, forms a surface electromyography-based interface. Exploiting highly separable data, a 2,210-parameter model achieves 94.36% accuracy across 34 gestures and can be rapidly deployed on edge devices, establishing a new thousand-parameter benchmark for dexterous decoding. The underlying data-algorithm interactions in the data-centric paradigm are further clarified, demonstrating its feasibility in real-world scenarios. This study provides a principled and validated pathway for practical deployment of reliable neuromotor interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以数据为中心的范式，通过无线高带宽采集系统与肌肉特异性电极结合，获取高度可分离的表面肌电信号，使仅含2,210个参数的轻量模型即可在边缘设备上实现34种手势94.36%的识别精度，建立了千参数级别的灵巧解码新基准，为神经运动接口的实际部署提供了可靠路径。
AI.motivation: 灵巧的人机交互需要直观且表达能力强的接口，但受限于边缘设备的计算资源；现有柔性电子皮肤虽能实现高保真数据采集，但实际部署中需要在计算资源与便携性之间做出权衡，缺乏既能高效解码又适合边缘部署的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用以数据为中心的范式，通过无线高带宽系统采集多种电生理信号，结合肌肉特异性电极形成表面肌电接口；利用生理特征的内在可分离性为识别提供充分判别线索，配合仅2,210个参数的轻量模型进行手势解码。
AI.result: 所提模型仅凭2,210个参数即实现34种手势94.36%的识别精度，可在边缘设备上快速部署，建立了千参数级别的灵巧解码新基准，并通过阐明数据-算法交互机制验证了其在真实场景中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为神经运动接口的可靠部署提供了一条有原理依据且经过验证的路径，证明了以数据为中心的范式能够在有限计算资源下实现高精度手势解码，兼具实用性与可扩展性。

title: Multi-Step Forecasting of Grape Berry Temperature based on LSTM Model with Feed-Forward Attention
summary: Accurate forecasting of grape berry temperature (Tb) is essential for enabling timely heat stress management in vineyards. In this study, a feed-forward attention mechanism integrated with a Long Short-Term Memory network (FAM-LSTM) was developed and evaluated for multi-step, high-resolution Tb prediction. Models were trained using environmental data from 2023 and 2024 at Prosser, WA, USA, and validated on 2025 summer data. FAM-LSTM was benchmarked against LSTM, GRU, RNN, and Random Forest (RF) across horizons ranging from 15 minutes to 72 hours (288 time steps). Two input scenarios were evaluated: nearest open-field weather station observations and in-vineyard microclimate measurements. FAM-LSTM consistently outperformed all benchmark models across all horizons and input scenarios. Incorporating in-vineyard microclimate data significantly improved forecasting accuracy at longer horizons. Using open-field data, FAM-LSTM achieved MAE and RMSE ranges of 0.58 to 1.70 deg C and 0.65 to 2.07 deg C, respectively. In-vineyard observations further improved performance, with MAE and RMSE in the ranges of 0.51 to 1.55 deg C and 0.71 to 1.87 deg C. Error analysis showed prediction uncertainty was highest during peak daytime periods (11:00 to 18:00) and increased progressively with forecast horizon. Overall, the FAM-LSTM framework offers robust Tb forecasting to support precision heat stress management in vineyards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种集成前馈注意力机制的LSTM网络（FAM-LSTM），用于葡萄浆果温度的精准多步预测，在15分钟至72小时（288步）的预测范围内，FAM-LSTM在多种基准模型（LSTM、GRU、RNN、RF）中表现最佳，且使用葡萄园内微气候数据在长时程预测上显著优于开放式气象站数据。
AI.motivation: 葡萄浆果温度的准确预测对于葡萄园热胁迫的及时管理至关重要，而现有方法在多步、高分辨率预测场景下表现有限，需要更精准的预测框架。
AI.method: 提出FAM-LSTM模型，将前馈注意力机制与长短期记忆网络相结合，利用2023-2024年环境数据训练，以2025年夏季数据验证；对比LSTM、GRU、RNN和随机森林（RF）在15分钟到72小时的多时域预测性能，并评估开放式气象站与葡萄园内微气候两种输入场景。
AI.result: FAM-LSTM在所有预测时域和输入场景下均优于基准模型；使用开放式气象数据时MAE为0.58-1.70°C，RMSE为0.65-2.07°C；引入葡萄园内微气候数据后MAE降至0.51-1.55°C，RMSE降至0.71-1.87°C；预测不确定性在白天高峰时段（11:00-18:00）最大，并随时域增加而增大。
AI.conclusion: FAM-LSTM框架为葡萄园提供了稳健的浆果温度预测能力，可有效支持精准热胁迫管理。

title: NFAD: Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection Under Distribution Shift
summary: Recent advances in anomaly detection (AD) for industrial inspection have pushed performance on standard benchmarks toward saturation. However, strong benchmark performance does not necessarily translate to real-world deployment, as these benchmarks are primarily collected under controlled acquisition conditions. Changes in illumination, background, viewpoint, and other environmental factors can shift normal samples away from the learned normal distribution and cause false anomaly responses. We address AD under such distribution shifts by explicitly modeling nuisance variation from changing imaging conditions in feature space. Without anomaly labels or target-domain data, our Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection (NFAD) framework estimates a nuisance subspace from matched feature displacements induced by content-preserving perturbations and suppresses its contribution to anomaly residuals at inference. The same subspace supports two complementary branches: full projection for image-level detection and selective suppression for pixel-level localization, preserving evidence of localized defects. On AeBAD-S, a benchmark specifically designed for AD under acquisition shifts, NFAD achieves 91.0\% image-level AUROC, establishing a new state of the art. Notably, this robustness does not come at the expense of conventional AD performance: NFAD remains competitive on standard benchmarks that do not explicitly evaluate distribution shift, including VisA, Real-IAD, and MVTec AD. These results show that explicitly suppressing such nuisance variation improves AD under distribution shift while preserving strong performance in standard settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Nuisance-Filtered Anomaly Detection (NFAD)框架，通过显式建模并抑制成像条件变化（光照、背景、视角等）带来的干扰子空间，解决工业异常检测在分布偏移下的鲁棒性问题，在AeBAD-S基准上达到91.0%的SOTA，同时不牺牲标准基准（VisA、Real-IAD、MVTec AD）的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有异常检测基准在受控采集条件下趋于饱和，但真实部署面临光照、背景、视角等环境变化，会使正常样本偏离学习到的正常分布，引发虚假异常响应。传统方法缺乏对此类分布偏移的显式建模。
AI.method: NFAD框架在特征空间中显式建模干扰变化：通过内容保持的扰动生成匹配的特征位移，估计出干扰子空间；推理时抑制该子空间对异常残差的贡献。框架包含两个互补分支——全投影用于图像级检测，选择性抑制用于像素级定位，从而保留局部缺陷证据。
AI.result: 在AeBAD-S基准上达到91.0%图像级AUROC，刷新SOTA；在VisA、Real-IAD、MVTec AD等标准基准上保持竞争力，说明鲁棒性提升不以牺牲常规性能为代价。
AI.conclusion: 显式抑制干扰变化能有效改善分布偏移下的异常检测性能，同时维持标准场景下的强表现，验证了该方法的通用性和实用性。

title: SpectraTac: A Compact Camera-Free Optical Tactile Sensor with Distributed Color Sensing
summary: Tactile sensing is essential for physical interaction in robotics and human--machine systems. However, combining rich tactile information with compact hardware, low cost, and low computational overhead remains challenging. This work presents SpectraTac, a compact, camera-free optical tactile sensor that combines active red--green--blue (RGB) illumination with spatially distributed color sensing. Contact deforms a compliant transparent elastomer and modulates its internal light field, producing spatially differentiated changes in color and intensity. Three distributed color sensors capture these responses as low-dimensional spatio-spectral features, avoiding cameras, imaging optics, and high-dimensional image processing. The device measures 19.2 mm in diameter and 4 mm in height, with a material cost below USD~5. A data-driven decoding framework simultaneously estimates three-dimensional (3D) force and the contact region from the optical measurements. For 3D force prediction, the sensor achieved mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 0.161, 0.164, and 0.429 N along the x-, y-, and z-axes, respectively. The nine-region contact-classification accuracy was 99.9%. We further evaluated real-time 3D force tracking and contact-region-based human--machine interaction through an interactive control task. These results indicate that distributed color-resolved optical sensing offers a compact, low-cost alternative to camera-based tactile sensing for robotics, wearable sensing, and interactive systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpectraTac，一种紧凑、无摄像头的光学触觉传感器，通过主动RGB照明与分布式颜色传感相结合，利用弹性体形变调制内光场，实现三维力与接触区域的同步估计。传感器直径19.2mm、高4mm，材料成本低于5美元，三维力预测MAE为0.161/0.164/0.429 N（x/y/z轴），九区域接触分类准确率达99.9%。
AI.motivation: 触觉传感对机器人物理交互至关重要，但如何在紧凑硬件、低成本、低计算开销的前提下同时保留丰富的触觉信息仍具挑战。现有基于相机的触觉传感虽信息丰富，但体积大、成本高、计算负担重，亟需一种无摄像头、低维度的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用无摄像头光学方案：主动RGB照明配合分布式颜色传感，接触使透明弹性体变形并调制内部光场，产生空间差异化的颜色与强度变化。三个分布式颜色传感器捕获低维时空光谱特征，避免相机与图像处理。数据驱动的解码框架同时估计三维力和接触区域。
AI.result: 传感器尺寸19.2mm×4mm，成本低于5美元。三维力预测MAE为x:0.161N、y:0.164N、z:0.429N；九区域接触分类准确率99.9%，并完成实时三维力跟踪与接触区域人机交互控制任务验证。
AI.conclusion: 分布式颜色分辨光学传感为基于相机的触觉传感提供了一种紧凑、低成本且有效的替代方案，适用于机器人、可穿戴传感和交互系统。

title: Frequency Selective Neural Networks as a Foundation Architecture for Time Series Learning
summary: Time-series data across physical and biological domains are fundamentally driven by complex, non-stationary oscillatory modes. While deep learning models, such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks, and Transformers, have dominated sequential analysis, they remain fundamentally "spectral-blind". By mapping continuous physical waves into unconstrained spatial or discrete token spaces, these architectures suffer from severe spectral entanglement, acting as opaque black boxes that decouple predictive accuracy from physical reality. In this paper, we introduce the Frequency Selective Neural Network (FSNN), pioneering a foundation architecture guaranteeing physical interpretability without sacrificing expressive power of deep learning. FSNN addresses spectral entanglement by explicitly embedding the rigorous mathematics of advanced signal processing into its neural topology. Through a fully differentiable Wiener-like filter bank optimized via complex-domain backpropagation, FSNN autonomously discovers and isolates the precise physical modes of a given task. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FSNN establishes state-of-the-art predictive performance, achieving $77.0\%$ average accuracy on the standard 10 multivariate UEA datasets and leading across all major metrics on the highly imbalanced PTB-XL clinical ECG benchmark. Crucially, in contrast to yielding abstract feature maps, FSNN converges directly on physically meaningful frequency bands, such as isolating the cardiac QRS complex, providing a highly scalable, interpretable paradigm for robust pattern recognition in complex temporal domains. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ad6174hhhh/FSNN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出频率选择性神经网络(FSNN)，通过将高级信号处理的严格数学嵌入神经拓扑结构，解决深度学习模型对时序数据的"频谱失明"问题。FSNN利用全可微的Wiener-like滤波器组，通过复数域反向传播优化，自主发现并隔离任务相关的物理模式，在保持深度学习表达能力的同时保证物理可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型(CNN、RNN、Transformer)将连续物理波映射到无约束的空间或离散token空间，导致严重的频谱纠缠，成为"频谱失明"的黑盒，预测准确性与物理现实脱节。需要一种既能保持深度学习强大表达能力，又能保证物理可解释性的架构。
AI.method: 提出FSNN架构：(1) 将高级信号处理的严格数学显式嵌入神经拓扑结构；(2) 构建全可微的Wiener-like滤波器组；(3) 通过复数域反向传播进行优化；(4) 使模型自主发现并隔离任务所需的精确物理模式。
AI.result: 在10个多变量UEA标准数据集上达到77.0%的平均准确率，实现最先进性能；在高度不平衡的PTB-XL临床心电图基准上所有主要指标均领先。与抽象特征图不同，FSNN直接收敛到具有物理意义的频带，如隔离心脏QRS波群。
AI.conclusion: FSNN提供了高度可扩展、可解释的范式，用于复杂时域中的稳健模式识别，克服了深度学习在时序分析中的频谱盲区，实现了预测能力与物理真实性的统一。

title: GramLoop: Training-Free Gram-Gated Replay for Robust Dense Prediction
summary: We aim to improve frozen DINOv3 dense-prediction models under distribution shift by adding inference computation inside the visual backbone, without changing model weights, task adapters, or prediction heads. The challenge is that repeated transformer-block computation must refine dense features without disrupting the pairwise patch relations that DINOv3 uses to preserve spatial structure. We introduce GramLoop, a training-free framework that replays a short transformer window and controls each replay through final-layer cosine-Gram consistency. Each proposal is propagated through the frozen suffix, measured against the standard DINOv3 trajectory, and accepted through a patchwise gate at the replay-window endpoint. Across object detection and semantic segmentation under corruptions, perturbations, and natural shifts, GramLoop improves all five shifted benchmarks over the paired DINOv3 baseline. On COCO-O, it improves mAP by +0.252 and Effective Robustness by +0.250, while preserving clean ADE20K performance. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GramLoop，一种免训练框架，通过在冻结的DINOv3视觉骨干内部添加推理时计算（重放短transformer窗口），以改善分布偏移下的密集预测性能。该方法通过最终层余弦Gram一致性控制每次重放，并在重放窗口端点使用patchwise门控接受候选提案，在不改变模型权重、任务适配器或预测头的条件下，在COCO-O、ADE20K等五个偏移基准上全面超过DINOv3基线。
AI.motivation: DINOv3等冻结的密集预测模型在分布偏移下性能下降，而现有方法要么需要微调权重，要么需要修改任务头。挑战在于如何在骨干内部增加推理计算来细化密集特征，同时不破坏DINOv3用于保持空间结构的逐patch关系。
AI.method: GramLoop为免训练框架：(1) 在视觉骨干内重放一个短的transformer窗口；(2) 通过最终层的余弦Gram一致性来控制每次重放；(3) 每个候选提案经过冻结的后缀传播，与标准DINOv3轨迹进行比较；(4) 在重放窗口端点通过patchwise门控接受或拒绝提案。
AI.result: 在目标检测和语义分割的多种分布偏移（损坏、扰动、自然偏移）下，GramLoop在所有五个偏移基准上均优于配对的DINOv3基线。在COCO-O上mAP提升+0.252，有效鲁棒性提升+0.250，同时保持干净ADE20K的性能不下降。
AI.conclusion: 通过在冻结骨干内部进行受控的推理时计算，GramLoop在不改变任何模型权重或任务头的情况下，显著提升了DINOv3在分布偏移下的密集预测鲁棒性，证明了"推理时计算"作为一种零训练鲁棒性提升策略的有效性。

title: PAVE: Predictive Alignment and Value-Guided Evolution for World-Action Policies
summary: Direct vision-language-action policies generate continuous robot actions efficiently, but standard behavior cloning leaves two complementary gaps: their representations are not explicitly required to describe how the scene evolves over multiple time scales, and deployment trajectories of unequal quality are often reused without separating useful dynamics from undesirable behavior. We introduce \method, a direct world-action policy that combines outcome-agnostic predictive learning with outcome-aware policy improvement. \method first retains a local fixed-offset JEPA objective and adds trajectory-relative multi-horizon transition alignment at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% of the remaining episode. These training-only targets require the current policy representation to preserve both local physical changes and longer-range task progress, without supplying explicit future tokens to the action head. \method then trains an independent distributional value critic on cumulative deployment trajectories, computes action-chunk-aligned $N$-step advantages, and converts them into positive, negative, or null text conditions for a flow-matching actor. Thus, every valid trajectory can teach what physically happened, while the actor is deployed only under the condition associated with relatively better actions. The multi-horizon predictor and critic are removed from online execution, preserving direct action generation from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioception. \redclaim{Across the three simulation benchmarks, \method achieves the strongest overall performance while preserving the direct actor's online execution path.}

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种直接世界动作策略（Direct World-Action Policy），将结果无关的预测学习与结果感知的策略改进相结合。该方法通过多时间尺度的转移对齐（25%、50%、75%、100%剩余回合）来增强策略表示，同时利用分布值评论家计算N步优势，并将其转化为正/负/空文本条件来指导流匹配动作生成器。在推理时移除所有辅助组件，保持直接的在线动作生成路径，在三个模拟基准上取得了最优综合性能。
AI.motivation: 直接视觉-语言-动作策略虽然能高效生成连续机器人动作，但标准行为克隆存在两个互补的缺陷：1）策略表示未被显式要求描述场景在多时间尺度上的演变；2）训练时复用了质量不均的部署轨迹，未分离有用动力学与不良行为。
AI.method: 1) 保留局部固定偏移的JEPA目标，并添加轨迹相对的多时域转移对齐（覆盖剩余回合的25%、50%、75%和100%），使策略表示同时保留局部物理变化和长程任务进展，但不向动作头供给显式未来token。2) 训练独立分布值评论家，计算与动作块对齐的N步优势，并将其转化为正、负或空文本条件用于流匹配动作生成器。3) 多时域预测器和评论家在在线推理时被移除，保持直接的基于当前观测、语言指令和本体感受的动作生成。
AI.result: 在三个模拟基准上，该方法取得了最强的综合性能，同时保留了直接动作生成器在线执行路径的完整性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过训练阶段的多时域预测学习与优势条件化策略改进，使所有有效轨迹都能教授物理动力学知识，而动作生成器仅在相对较优动作对应的条件下部署，实现了性能提升与在线执行效率的兼顾。

title: Disentangling Representation using Attributes-based Gaussian Estimation for Medical Sound Diagnosis
comment: 4 figures, 2 tables, code is available at: https://github.com/ZhaoKe1024/DisentangledRepr
summary: Deep learning has a powerful capability of feature extraction. However, the lack of fairness and interpretability in deep neural networks poses limitations to their adoption in the medical domain. This paper proposes a disentangled representation learning (DisenRL) framework, named the Attributes-based Gaussian Estimation for Disentangled Representation (AGEDR), which incorporates Attribute Mapping Embedding (AME) modules designed to map attributes into vectors and align them with a subset of the latent vectors in a Variational AutoEncoder (VAE). This part of the latent vector will be disentangled from the remaining latent vectors by minimizing mutual information. A classifier is then trained using the mean parameters of the latent vectors from the VAE. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AGEDR outperforms both conventional classification models and existing disentangled representation learning methods. The ablation experiments also indicate the disentangling capability and fairness of AGEDR. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/ZhaoKe1024/DisentangledRepr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于属性的高斯估计解耦表示学习框架（AGEDR），通过属性映射嵌入模块将属性映射为向量并与VAE潜变量子集对齐，最小化互信息实现解耦，从而提升深度神经网络在医学领域的公平性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的特征提取能力强大，但深度神经网络在公平性和可解释性方面的不足限制了其在医学领域的应用。现有方法难以同时兼顾公平性、可解释性和分类性能。
AI.method: 提出了AGEDR框架，包含三个关键部分：(1) 属性映射嵌入模块（AME），将属性映射为向量并与VAE潜向量的子集对齐；(2) 通过最小化互信息，将这部分潜向量与其余潜向量解耦；(3) 使用VAE潜向量的均值参数训练分类器。
AI.result: 大量实验表明AGEDR在分类性能上优于传统分类模型和现有的解耦表示学习方法；消融实验验证了AGEDR的解耦能力和公平性。
AI.conclusion: AGEDR通过在VAE框架中引入属性映射嵌入和互信息最小化，成功实现了兼具公平性、可解释性和高性能的医学图像分类，并公开了源代码以便复现和进一步研究。

title: Acoustically Grounded Cost Learning for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Semantic Segmentation (OV-AVSS) aims to perform pixel-level segmentation of sound-emitting objects from an open set of categories. The previous method relies on a class-agnostic foreground definition, which groups semantically diverse objects into a heterogeneous positive set, causing the model to learn unstable sounding patterns and produce unreliable proposals. To address this, we reformulate the objective to be category-specific and propose a novel Acoustically Grounded Cost Learning (AGCL) framework to transform the static, audio-agnostic visual-text priors into dynamic, audio-grounded cost representations. For intra-category soundingness discovery, we devise Audio-Modulated Cost Generation (AMCG) and Audio-Guided Temporal Aggregation (AGTA) modules to enable both frame-level sounding region highlighting and video-level temporal refinement with a low-intrusive audio injection mechanism. For inter-category distractor discrimination, we introduce a Synergistic Distractor Mining (SDM) strategy, which selectively penalizes acoustically and semantically confusing negative categories to learn more discriminative decision boundaries. Extensive experiments on the AVSBench-OV dataset demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art approaches, particularly on unseen categories. Code is available at https://github.com/spyflying/AGCL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的开放词汇音视频语义分割（OV-AVSS）方法AGCL，通过将目标重构为特定类别，利用音频调制代价生成和音频引导时序聚合模块实现框架级别的声音区域突出和视频级时序细化，并引入协同干扰物挖掘策略来区分混淆的负类别，在AVSBench-OV数据集上显著优于先前方法。
AI.motivation: 先前方法依赖类别无关的前景定义，将语义上多样化的对象分组成异构的正样本集，导致模型学习到不稳定的声音模式并产生不可靠的提议。作者希望通过将目标重构为特定类别来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出声学接地代价学习（AGCL）框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 音频调制代价生成（AMCG）和音频引导时序聚合（AGTA）模块，用于框架级声音区域突出和视频级时序细化，采用低侵入式音频注入机制；2) 协同干扰物挖掘（SDM）策略，选择性地惩罚声学和语义上混淆的负类别，学习更具判别性的决策边界。
AI.result: 在AVSBench-OV数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于先前的最先进方法，特别是在未见类别上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过将静态的、音频无关的视觉-文本先验转化为动态的、音频接地的代价表示，AGCL框架有效解决了开放词汇音视频语义分割中类别无关前景定义带来的问题，并在未见类别上取得了显著的性能提升。

title: A Hybrid PEM-GP Framework for Uncertainty-Aware System Identification of Quadcopters
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures. Published in International Journal of Control, Automation, and Systems, Vol. 24, No. 8, pp. 2047-2057, 2026
summary:
Accurate dynamic models play a central role in achieving reliable control of quadcopters. Classical system identification methods remain widely used, mainly because of their interpretability. However, they often fail to capture important nonlinear effects, especially in small-scale aerial platforms where such effects become more pronounced.
  Data-driven approaches offer a different perspective. They can represent complex nonlinear dynamics more effectively, but this comes at the cost of reduced interpretability and the absence of well-calibrated uncertainty estimates.
  In this work, we propose a framework that combines physics-based modeling with data-driven learning, while explicitly accounting for uncertainty. A physics-based model is first identified using the Prediction Error Method (PEM), which captures the main structure of the system. The remaining dynamics are then modeled using a Gaussian Process (GP), allowing the residual behavior to be learned directly from data. This separation makes it possible to distinguish between known physical effects and unmodeled dynamics.
  The proposed framework is validated on a Duckiedrone-like experimental setup. The results show that the PEM-GP model achieves prediction accuracy comparable to that of a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, while additionally providing calibrated uncertainty estimates. This combination improves model reliability and supports uncertainty-aware decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出一个混合框架，将基于物理的预测误差法（PEM）与高斯过程（GP）相结合，用于四旋翼飞行器动力学建模，在保持预测精度的同时提供校准的不确定性估计。
AI.motivation: 经典系统辨识方法（如PEM）具有可解释性但难以捕捉小规模四旋翼平台上的非线性效应；纯数据驱动方法（如LSTM）虽能表达复杂非线性但缺乏可解释性和校准的不确定性估计。现有方法无法同时满足精度、可解释性和不确定性量化的需求。
AI.method: 首先使用预测误差法（PEM）辨识物理基模型，捕捉系统的主要动力学结构；然后利用高斯过程（GP）对剩余残差动态进行建模，直接从数据中学习未建模的非线性效应。通过这种分离，可以区分已知物理效应和未建模动力学。
AI.result: 在类Duckiedrone实验平台上验证，PEM-GP模型实现了与LSTM网络相当的预测精度，同时额外提供了校准的不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: 混合PEM-GP框架在保持与数据驱动方法相当的预测性能的同时，提供了物理可解释性和校准的不确定性量化，提高了模型可靠性并支持不确定性感知的决策。

title: Facts Without Rules: Boundary Metadata Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Handoffs
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems often coordinate by compressing an upstream interaction into a handoff artifact that downstream agents treat as shared state. We show that this handoff step is a structural source of privacy leakage: summaries preferentially preserve operational facts while weakening the boundary metadata that governs how those facts may be used---a failure mode we call \emph{summary collapse}. On a controlled multi-agent coordination testbed we measure marker survival with a human-validated judge ($κ= 0.74$), where $σ_b = 1$ means every boundary marker survives verbatim and $σ_b = 0$ means all are lost. Boundary-marker and operational-fact survival are nearly uncorrelated at the handoff level on both GPT-5-mini and DeepSeek-R1-32B (Pearson $r$ near zero): uncompressed free-text handoffs preserve boundaries at $σ_b \approx 0.80$, whereas a $25$-word budget drops $σ_b$ to ${\approx}0.57$ while operational-fact survival stays near ceiling. Controlled downstream tests reveal that protection depends on \emph{boundary explicitness}: vague languages leak in $73\%$ of GPT and $50\%$ of DeepSeek cases, while explicit constraints reduce leakage to under $15\%$ across all three tested models. A no-handoff single-agent control further shows the failure is not reducible to multi-agent topology as direct full-marker access still leaks more often than the operationalized handoff. Prompt-only mitigation and exact-string redaction only partially address the problem, while a gold-derived audience allowlist nearly eliminates leakage across models, showing that correctly identifying audience boundaries is the key factor.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示多智能体LLM系统中，上游交互压缩为交接工件（handoff artifact）的过程本身是隐私泄露的结构性来源。作者称之为"摘要坍缩"（summary collapse）：摘要倾向于保留操作性事实，却削弱了管理这些事实使用方式的边界元数据。实验证明边界标记与操作事实的存活率几乎不相关，压缩会显著降低边界保留但几乎不影响事实保留。关键发现是保护取决于边界显式性，正确识别受众边界是核心因素。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统通过将上游交互压缩成交接工件作为共享状态进行协调，但作者发现这一交接步骤是隐私泄露的结构性来源。摘要过程优先保留操作事实而弱化边界元数据（决定这些事实如何被使用的信息），作者将其命名为"摘要坍缩"，并希望系统性地测量和理解这一失败模式。
AI.method: 作者在受控的多智能体协调测试平台上测量边界标记存活率，使用人类验证的评判器（κ=0.74）。σ_b=1表示所有边界标记逐字保留，σ_b=0表示全部丢失。测试了GPT-5-mini和DeepSeek-R1-32B两个模型，对比无压缩自由文本交接与25词预算压缩交接，并进行受控下游测试、无交接单智能体对照、以及多种缓解策略（提示词缓解、精确字符串编辑、基于gold的受众白名单）。
AI.result: 边界标记与操作事实存活率在交接层面几乎不相关（Pearson r接近零）；无压缩交接保留边界σ_b≈0.80，而25词预算将σ_b降至≈0.57，但操作事实存活仍接近上限。模糊语言的泄露率在GPT中达73%、DeepSeek达50%，而显式约束将泄露率降至15%以下。单智能体对照表明失败不仅源于多智能体拓扑。提示词缓解和精确字符串编辑只能部分解决问题，而gold-derived受众白名单几乎消除了所有模型的泄露。
AI.conclusion: 交接压缩过程中的"摘要坍缩"是隐私泄露的关键结构性来源。保护信息边界的核心在于正确识别和显式化受众边界，而非单纯依赖拓扑设计或后处理手段。正确的受众识别（如gold-derived白名单）能近乎彻底消除泄露，这为多智能体系统隐私保护设计提供了重要方向。

title: Dancing Stick Figures: An Introductory Dataset for Training Video Generation Models
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Dataset, code, reference models, and Colab notebook are linked from the paper
summary: Training a video-generation model from scratch is hard for reasons that precede model design. The feedback loop is long: a failure that appears only after a training run can make each attempted fix another run. The data are hard to reach: the corpora and recipes behind strong models are large, heterogeneous, and often unreleased. And scoring is blunt: open-ended generation has no single correct output, and an aggregate score does not by itself establish whether a sample succeeds or which property failed. Dancing Stick Figures is a synthetic video dataset built against these three obstacles. For iteration speed, its 64x64, 64-frame reference task is sized for practical repeated training on a single workstation GPU. For accessibility, the release is a 0.79-GB training tier of 4,020 video clips--1,340 six-second source motions, each rendered from three cameras by a deterministic dataset-generation harness--with checkpoints and a Colab workflow that reruns the reference training pipeline at reduced budget on a 16 GB Tesla T4. For scoring, every frame retains its generating state (ARDY cskel27 joint positions, camera, body parameters, and source motion) and per-pixel depth, surface normals, and part labels. These annotations support dataset-specific metrics for visible topology and part-wise motion; corruptions expose their sensitivities and blind spots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dancing Stick Figures，一个合成视频数据集，旨在解决视频生成模型训练中的三大障碍：迭代周期长、数据难以获取、评分粗糙。数据集包含64x64、64帧的参考任务，4,020个视频片段（0.79GB），并附带每帧的完整生成状态标注（关节位置、相机参数、深度、法线、部件标签），支持精细化的数据集特定指标评估。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型从零训练面临三个根本性障碍：1）反馈循环长——失败往往在训练结束后才显现，每次修复都需重新训练；2）数据难以获取——现有强模型的训练语料和配方规模大、异构且大多未公开；3）评分粗糙——开放式生成没有唯一正确答案，聚合分数无法定位具体失败样本或失败的属性。
AI.method: 构建一个合成视频数据集Dancing Stick Figures：1）将参考任务设计为64x64、64帧，可在单张工作站GPU上反复训练；2）发布0.79GB训练集，包含4,020个视频片段（1,340个六秒源动作×3个相机视角），由确定性数据集生成管线渲染；3）提供检查点和Colab工作流，可在16GB Tesla T4上以缩减预算重跑参考训练流程；4）每帧保留完整的生成状态（ARDY cskel27关节位置、相机、身体参数、源动作）以及逐像素深度、表面法线和部件标签，支持拓扑可见性和部件级运动的指标评估。
AI.result: 数据集提供了一套完整的研究基础设施：可用于快速迭代训练的可重复参考任务、易于获取的公开数据与复现工作流、以及细粒度的标注指标。通过引入数据损坏（corruptions）还可以暴露这些指标的敏感性和盲点。
AI.conclusion: Dancing Stick Figures通过精心设计的合成数据集，同时缓解了视频生成研究中的迭代速度、数据可获取性和评分细粒度三大问题，为视频生成模型的诊断和改进提供了可控的实验环境。

title: Anomaly Detection on Small Industrial Components via Vision-Based Tactile Sensing
summary: Automated inspection of small industrial components, including sub-centimetre-scale parts where defects are geometry-driven and poorly resolved by standard optical cameras, calls for sensing modalities that can directly capture fine surface geometry. Vision-based tactile sensors address this need by converting contact imprints into high-resolution image-like data compatible with existing deep-learning pipelines, yet their effective use for industrial anomaly detection (AD) remains largely unexplored. This work systematically evaluates unsupervised AD methods on a real tactile dataset covering five genuine industrial components acquired with a GelSight Mini sensor mounted on a collaborative robot. Four feature-embedding methods, SPADE, PaDiM, FAPM, and InReaCh, are compared under three validations explicitly motivated by the deployment constraints of contact-based sensing: a Good Fraction analysis establishing the minimum number of nominal contacts for stable performance, directly bounded by gel wear since every acquisition degrades the soft interface; a cross-position evaluation assessing generalization across different contact locations observing the same recurring surface pattern; and a low- versus high-resolution comparison evaluating the cost-benefit of higher-resolution tactile acquisition. Overall, this systematic benchmarking study provides practical guidance for researchers and practitioners adopting vision-based tactile sensing for industrial AD and shows how this modality can serve as a viable alternative for industrial quality-control tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了基于视觉的触觉传感器在工业异常检测（AD）中的应用，使用GelSight Mini传感器采集五个真实工业部件的触觉数据集，对四种无监督AD方法（SPADE、PaDiM、FAPM、InReaCh）进行了三种部署约束下的对比实验，为工业质检提供了实用指导。
AI.motivation: 小型工业部件的自动检测（尤其是亚厘米级部件）中，缺陷是几何驱动的，标准光学相机难以捕捉，需要能直接获取精细表面几何的传感模态。视觉触觉传感器虽能满足此需求并兼容深度学习，但其在工业异常检测中的有效应用尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在真实触觉数据集上（GelSight Mini传感器配合协作机器人采集5个真实工业部件），对比四种特征嵌入方法（SPADE、PaDiM、FAPM、InReaCh），并在三种由接触式传感部署约束驱动的验证设置下评估：1）Good Fraction分析——确定稳定性能所需的最少标称接触次数（受凝胶磨损限制）；2）跨位置评估——测试不同接触位置对同一重复表面图案的泛化能力；3）低分辨率与高分辨率对比——评估高分辨率触觉采集的成本效益。
AI.result: 论文提供了系统的基准测试结果，给出了触觉传感工业AD的实践指导，包括最小标称接触次数、跨位置泛化性能以及分辨率选择对成本效益的影响，表明视觉触觉传感可作为工业质量控制任务的可行替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 该基准研究为研究人员和实践者采用视觉触觉传感进行工业异常检测提供了实用指导，证明了该模态在工业质检中作为可行替代方案的潜力。

title: Learning to Follow In-Context Watermark Instructions via Self-Distillation
summary: In-context watermarking (ICW) prepends an instruction to a query asking the model to embed a statistically detectable signal in its response. It thus equips LLMs with a watermarking interface that third parties can invoke without access to model internals. Its reliability hinges on the LLM following the instruction without degrading answer quality, yet how well current LLMs do so has not been measured. We introduce $\mathsf{ICWBench}$, a benchmark of three verifiable ICW instruction families, each scored on both detectability and answer quality. Evaluating 14 frontier proprietary and open-source LLMs, we find that none of the evaluated LLMs achieves both objectives across all three families. To address this, we propose a self-contained two-stage training method, requiring no distillation from a stronger model, no manual annotation, and no pre-existing ICW IF ability. The first stage, self-distillation with logits perturbation (SDLP), uses the same base LLM as both teacher and student: an instruction-equivalent decoding-time logits perturbation makes the teacher follow the ICW instruction, and the student is trained to match the teacher's output distribution. The second stage applies reinforcement learning with the automatic verifier as the reward. Applied to Qwen3-14B and GPT-OSS-20B, our method raises average TPR@$1\%$FPR across three ICW instructions from $0.100$ to $0.974$ and from $0.337$ to $0.968$, respectively, while maintaining high response quality under both perplexity evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICWBench基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在上下文水印（ICW）指令下的表现，涵盖可检测性和答案质量两个维度。测试发现14个前沿模型均无法同时在这两个目标上表现优异。为此提出两阶段自包含训练方法（SDLP + RL），在不依赖蒸馏、人工标注或预存在ICW能力的情况下，将Qwen3-14B和GPT-OSS-20B的平均TPR@1%FPR分别从0.100提升至0.974和从0.337提升至0.968，同时保持高质量响应。
AI.motivation: 上下文水印（ICW）是一种通过指令让LLM在其响应中嵌入可检测信号的机制，可由第三方在无需访问模型内部的情况下调用。但其可靠性取决于模型能否在遵循指令的同时不降低答案质量，而目前尚无系统评估当前LLM在这方面的表现。
AI.method: 1) 提出ICWBench基准，包含三类可验证的ICW指令族，从可检测性和答案质量两个维度评分。2) 提出两阶段训练方法：第一阶段为带logits扰动的自蒸馏（SDLP），用同一基础模型既当教师又当学生，通过解码时logits扰动使教师遵循ICW指令，学生则学习匹配教师的输出分布；第二阶段应用强化学习，以自动验证器作为奖励信号。
AI.result: 评估14个前沿专有和开源LLM，发现没有任何模型能在所有三类指令上同时达到可检测性和答案质量双目标。应用所提方法后，Qwen3-14B和GPT-OSS-20B的平均TPR@1%FPR分别从0.100提升到0.974、从0.337提升到0.968，同时在高困惑度评估和LLM-as-a-Judge评估下保持高质量响应。
AI.conclusion: 当前前沿LLM在ICW上的能力普遍不足，但通过自包含的两阶段训练方法可以在不依赖外部资源的情况下显著提升模型遵循ICW指令的能力，同时保持输出质量，为上下文水印的实际部署提供了可行路径。

title: Efficient Language-to-Vision Feature Injection for Referring Single-Object Tracking
summary: Referring single-object tracking enables language-grounded target initialization and subsequent tracking by jointly leveraging semantic cues and visual templates. The core difficulty is to use language differently across stages: it is indispensable for grounding but can induce semantic drift during tracking when overemphasized. Meanwhile, current methods often require costly vision-language alignment training. We present LVTrack, a pure transformer framework that introduces a mode-conditioned Gated Feature Injector to adaptively regulate textual guidance and alleviate semantic drift. Together with targeted adaptations, it directly harnesses a frozen vision-language pretrained model, greatly reducing training cost and preserving strong language understanding. To further improve temporal localization, LVTrack integrates hybrid relative-absolute positional encodings with a lightweight memory mechanism and optimizes autoregressive box prediction using a Gaussian-smoothed KL loss. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that LVTrack achieves strong performance.

AI.tldr: LVTrack是一个纯Transformer框架的指代单目标跟踪方法，通过模式条件门控特征注入器自适应调节文本引导以缓解语义漂移，直接利用冻结的视觉-语言预训练模型降低成本，并集成混合相对-绝对位置编码、轻量记忆机制和高斯平滑KL损失，在各标准基准上取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 指代单目标跟踪的核心难点在于语言在不同阶段的差异化使用：语言对于目标定位不可或缺，但在跟踪过程中过度强调会导致语义漂移；同时现有方法通常需要昂贵的视觉-语言对齐训练。
AI.method: 提出纯Transformer框架LVTrack，包含：(1)模式条件门控特征注入器，自适应调节文本引导并缓解语义漂移；(2)直接利用冻结的视觉-语言预训练模型，配合定向适配以降低训练成本并保持语言理解能力；(3)混合相对-绝对位置编码结合轻量记忆机制提升时间定位；(4)高斯平滑KL损失优化自回归框预测。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明LVTrack取得了强性能。
AI.conclusion: LVTrack通过模式条件门控注入器有效解决了语言在跟踪过程中的语义漂移问题，并凭借冻结预训练模型显著降低了训练成本，在性能与效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Behavior-Skill: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Reliable execution of long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks remains challenging because overall task success depends on the successful completion of multiple constituent skills. Existing benchmarks, however, still rely primarily on full-task rollouts and aggregate task-level metrics, making intermediate failures difficult to observe and analyze. We present Behavior-Skill, a benchmark that reformulates the learning and evaluation of long-horizon tasks around executable constituent skills. It contains 235,492 skill instances from 10,000 demonstrations across 50 household tasks and 34 semantic skill categories. Each instance pairs a skill instruction with an aligned observation-action segment, and is further associated with a restorable intermediate state and a skill success condition to enable independent evaluation under valid preconditions. We further introduce trajectory-level and skill-level metrics to characterize policy capability beyond aggregate task success. Extensive experiments across representative VLA policies including pi0.5 and GR00T on the complete 50-task benchmark show that failures are highly non-uniform across skills, with contact-rich manipulation skills forming persistent bottlenecks. These results demonstrate that Behavior-Skill complements full-task evaluation by exposing intermediate capability profiles for analyzing and improving long-horizon VLA policies. Behavior-Skill is publicly available at https://github.com/nubot-nudt/Behavior-Skill.

AI.tldr: Behavior-Skill是一个新的基准，通过将长期移动操作任务重构为可独立评估的可执行技能实例（包含235,492个技能实例、34个语义技能类别），引入轨迹级和技能级指标来暴露中间失败，从而补充传统的全任务评估。实验表明接触丰富的操作技能是VLA策略的持续瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 长期移动操作任务的成功依赖于多个子技能的成功执行，但现有基准仅依赖全任务回放和聚合任务级指标，难以观察和分析中间失败，无法深入定位策略能力的短板环节。
AI.method: 将长期任务重新构架为可执行子技能，从10,000条演示中提取235,492个技能实例，涵盖50个家庭任务和34个语义技能类别。每个实例配备指令-观测动作段对齐、可恢复的中间状态和技能成功条件，支持在有效前提条件下独立评估。引入轨迹级和技能级指标。
AI.result: 在50个任务的完整基准上对pi0.5和GR00T等代表性VLA策略进行广泛实验，发现失败在技能间高度非均匀分布，接触丰富的操作技能构成持续瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: Behavior-Skill通过暴露中间能力画像来补充全任务评估，有助于分析和改进长期VLA策略，且已公开提供。

title: EmoLASP: Emotion Recognition with Language Models and Answer Set Programming
comment: 13 pages. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Emotion recognition in conversations is increasingly tackled with language models, but these models can be unstable and expensive to fine-tune or to prompt with long dialogue histories. We propose EmoLASP, a framework that combines a language model with declarative reasoning via Answer Set Programming (ASP) to predict VAD scores (Valence-Arousal-Dominance) in conversations. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset (IEMOCAP) across six open-source LLMs (3B-120B) and two PLMs (BERT, RoBERTa) show that EmoLASP improves prediction performance compared to using the language model alone, even when the LLMs/PLMs are given no dialogue history in their prompts or input vectors. The gains are largest for prompt-only LLMs, which EmoLASP uses without any fine-tuning. However, for fine-tuned PLMs, the reasoner adds little once dialogue history is available. EmoLASP's LLM pipeline demonstrates the potential advantages of using a reasoning approach to ensure emotion prediction consistency and to reduce both the cost of fine-tuning and the cost of prompting with long dialogue histories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EmoLASP框架，将语言模型与回答集编程（ASP）声明式推理相结合，用于对话中的情绪识别（VAD分数预测）。在IEMOCAP基准上对六个LLM和两个PLM的实验表明，即使LLM/PLM没有对话历史输入，EmoLASP也能提升预测性能，且对纯提示的LLM增益最大，同时降低微调和长对话提示成本。
AI.motivation: 对话情绪识别越来越多地依赖语言模型，但这些模型在微调或使用长对话历史进行提示时存在不稳定性和高成本的问题。
AI.method: 提出EmoLASP框架，将语言模型与基于回答集编程（ASP）的声明式推理相结合，用于预测对话中的VAD（Valence-Arousal-Dominance）分数。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP数据集上，对六个开源LLM（3B-120B）和两个PLM（BERT、RoBERTa）的实验表明：EmoLASP相比单独使用LM能提升预测性能，即使LM没有对话历史输入；对纯提示LLM（无需微调）增益最大；但对微调后的PLM，在已有对话历史时推理器增益有限。
AI.conclusion: EmoLASP的LLM流水线展示了推理方法在确保情绪预测一致性、降低微调成本和减少长对话历史提示成本方面的潜在优势。

title: Chat-Edit-3D++: Interactive 3D and 4D Scene Editing via Large Language Models
summary: Recent work on image content manipulation based on vision-language pre-training models has been effectively extended to text-driven 3D scene editing. However, existing schemes for 3D scene editing still have certain shortcomings, hindering their further development as interactive design tools. Such schemes typically adhere to fixed input patterns, limiting flexibility in text input. Furthermore, their editing capabilities are constrained by a single or a few 2D visual models and require intricate pipeline design to integrate these models into 3D reconstruction processes. To address the aforementioned issues, we propose the Hash-Atlas network, which reformulates 3D scene editing as operations on 2D atlas images, thereby achieving a workflow decoupling of the 2D editing and 3D reconstruction processes. Building on this foundation, we introduce a dialogue-based 3D scene editing approach, termed CE3D++, which is centered on a large language model (LLM) that allows arbitrary textual input from users and interprets their intentions, subsequently facilitating the autonomous invocation of the corresponding visual models. Additionally, we extend CE3D++ to monocular 4D scenes by imposing motion constraints on moving objects and further fine-tuning the LLM by creating a trajectory dataset related to editing tasks, which enables the smaller LLM to schedule up to 30 different visual tools accurately. Experimental results demonstrate that CE3D++ effectively integrates multiple visual models to achieve diverse visual editing effects, possessing strong scene comprehension and multi-round dialog capabilities. The source codes and trained models are available at https://github.com/Fangkang515/CE3D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CE3D++，一种基于对话的3D场景编辑方法。通过Hash-Atlas网络将3D场景编辑转化为2D atlas图像操作，实现2D编辑与3D重建的解耦；以大型语言模型（LLM）为核心，支持任意文本输入并自动调用相应视觉模型，并扩展到单目4D场景编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景编辑方法存在两大问题：一是输入模式固定，缺乏文本输入的灵活性；二是编辑能力受限于单一或少数2D视觉模型，且需要复杂的流水线设计来集成这些模型到3D重建中，阻碍了其作为交互式设计工具的发展。
AI.method: 1) 提出Hash-Atlas网络，将3D场景编辑重新表述为2D atlas图像上的操作，实现2D编辑与3D重建的流程解耦。2) 提出CE3D++对话式3D场景编辑方法，以LLM为核心，接受任意用户文本输入并解释其意图，自主调用对应视觉模型。3) 扩展到单目4D场景，对移动物体施加运动约束；通过创建与编辑任务相关的轨迹数据集对LLM进行微调，使较小的LLM能够精准调度多达30种不同的视觉工具。
AI.result: 实验结果表明CE3D++能有效集成多种视觉模型实现多样的视觉编辑效果，具备强大的场景理解能力和多轮对话能力。
AI.conclusion: CE3D++通过对话式交互和Hash-Atlas解耦机制，显著提升了3D场景编辑的灵活性和可扩展性，为3D/4D场景编辑作为交互式设计工具的发展提供了有效方案。

title: Temporal Forcing: 4D Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) methods improve manipulation performance by aligning their representations with 3D scene geometry. However, these methods often struggle with long-horizon manipulation and observation aliasing between visually similar states due to a lack of temporal information: the 3D scene geometry captures only the current state, rather than how it has evolved over time. To resolve this, we present Temporal Forcing, a 4D representation alignment method for VLA models. Specifically, we first introduce a history pathway that enables a vanilla VLA model to summarize observation history into temporally aware latent representations. Then, the latent representations are aligned with the geometric features extracted by a pretrained 4D foundation model, which captures the evolving 3D world through temporally consistent geometric representations, enabling a deeper understanding of dynamic environments. Temporal Forcing reaches 98.8% on LIBERO, outperforming its base model by 2.2 points. On a physical hidden-placement task, it raises full-task success from 20.0% to 43.3%. Code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: Temporal Forcing是一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的4D表示对齐方法，通过引入历史路径让模型汇总观测历史，并与预训练4D基础模型提取的时间一致几何特征对齐，解决长时程操作和视觉相似状态观测混淆问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA方法通过将表示与3D场景几何对齐来提升操作性能，但3D几何仅反映当前状态而缺乏时间信息，导致在长时程操作中难以处理视觉相似状态的观测混淆问题。
AI.method: 1) 引入历史路径（history pathway），使普通VLA模型能够将观测历史汇总为时间感知的潜在表示；2) 将这些潜在表示与预训练4D基础模型提取的几何特征进行对齐，该4D模型通过时间一致的几何表示捕获动态演化的3D世界。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上达到98.8%的准确率，比基础模型提升2.2个百分点；在物理隐藏放置任务中，将完整任务成功率从20.0%提高到43.3%。
AI.conclusion: Temporal Forcing通过融合时间维度信息，有效提升VLA模型对动态环境的理解和长时程操作能力，显著优于仅依赖当前3D几何信息的方法。

title: Let Prompts Bridge Defense Knowledge: Transferable Graph Purification via Vulnerability-Aware GPL
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26). 10 pages, 7 figures, and 4 tables. Shuomin Xue and Jingyuan Li contributed equally to this work
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a cornerstone for representing complex relational dependencies in diverse multimedia tasks, particularly in cross-platform user interest modeling and cross-modal semantic alignment. In the real world, a practical defense against graph adversarial perturbations is needed. However, we observe that the prevailing adversarial purification methods are essentially domain-restricted defenses, which leads to the following shortcomings: (1) single-domain data provides insufficient structural and semantic diversity for learning robust purification criteria; (2) training of domain-specific defense strategies from scratch consumes substantial computational cost. To address the above limitations, we propose a transferable graph purification scheme, named ProGAP, to bridge adversarial defense knowledge via vulnerability-aware graph prompt learning. Firstly, to capture universal adversarial patterns, a perturbation-capture edge detector is pretrained on data-rich graphs by jointly modeling topological and semantic information. Subsequently, to achieve more knowledge transfer w.r.t. robustness, vulnerability-aware prompts are designed that inject targeted purification guidance into biased nodes, during which the pretrained detector adapts to distribution shifts in downstream graphs without parameter-laborious updates. Experimental results demonstrate that compared with state-of-the-art baselines, our ProGAP achieves 1%-9% improvement, and reduces the time consumption by up to 2.2x. The code for ProGAP is available at https://github.com/Lieyoufffff/ProGAP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProGAP，一种基于漏洞感知图提示学习的可迁移图净化方案，用于跨域防御图对抗扰动。通过预训练扰动捕获边检测器学习通用对抗模式，并设计漏洞感知提示将净化知识迁移到下游图，在降低计算成本的同时提升防御性能（1%-9%提升，最多2.2倍加速）。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗净化方法本质上是域受限防御，存在两个缺陷：(1)单域数据缺乏足够的结构和语义多样性，难以学习鲁棒的净化准则；(2)为每个域从零训练专属防御策略代价高昂。
AI.method: (1)在数据丰富的图上预训练扰动捕获边检测器，联合建模拓扑和语义信息以捕获通用对抗模式；(2)设计漏洞感知提示，将针对性的净化指导注入有偏节点，使预训练检测器适应下游图的分布偏移，无需大规模参数更新。
AI.result: 与最先进基线相比，ProGAP在性能上获得1%-9%的提升，并将时间消耗降低最多2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: ProGAP通过图提示学习实现了跨域的对抗净化知识迁移，验证了预训练加提示微调范式在图防御领域的有效性，兼顾了鲁棒性与计算效率。

title: STARLINC: Satellite Trail Artifact Removal using Inter-Frame Correlation
summary: The rapid expansion of low Earth orbit satellites such as Starlink is increasingly contaminating astronomical surveys. In practice, contaminated images are often identified through inspection. However, modern surveys generate terabytes of data each night, making manual screening infeasible and necessitating reliable automated methods for satellite trail removal. Unfortunately, existing general-domain line detection methods fail to generalize to astronomical images due to domain mismatch, which are mostly grayscale with sparse bright stars and have a low signal-to-noise ratio. Moreover, training new models from scratch is impractical due to the lack of large-scale annotated astronomical datasets. To address these challenges, we introduce STARLINC, the first ML-based framework for satellite trail removal without requiring tedious pixel-level annotation of astronomical images. STARLINC combines synthetic satellite trail generation for training, inter-frame differential maps from temporally adjacent exposures to highlight transient trails, and heatmaps to provide additional localization cues for pixel-level segmentation. Extensive experiments on real-world data demonstrate substantial improvements over baselines, establishing STARLINC as a scalable solution for next-generation astronomical surveys. Code is available at https://github.com/starioKim/STARLINC.

AI.tldr: STARLINC是首个无需像素级标注的ML框架，用于从天文图像中去除卫星轨迹。它结合合成轨迹生成、帧间差分图和热图定位提示，实现弱监督下的像素级分割，在真实数据上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 低轨卫星（如Starlink）快速扩张持续污染天文图像，而手动筛查大规模星表不可行。现有通用线条检测方法因域差异（灰度、稀疏亮星、低信噪比）难以泛化到天文图像；同时缺乏大规模标注数据集，无法从头训练新模型。
AI.method: STARLINC采用三部分策略：(1) 合成卫星轨迹生成用于训练；(2) 利用时间相邻曝光的帧间差分图突出瞬态轨迹；(3) 使用热图提供额外定位线索辅助像素级分割。整个框架无需繁琐的像素级标注。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据上的大量实验表明，STARLINC相比基线方法有显著改进，展示了其作为下一代天文调查可扩展解决方案的有效性。
AI.conclusion: STARLINC通过合成数据与弱监督策略解决了天文图像卫星轨迹去除的标注瓶颈，在真实数据上验证了优越性，为大规模天文调查提供了可扩展的自动化解决方案，代码已开源。

title: CIG-RL: Curiosity-Driven Information-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Source Term Estimation in Uncertain Environments
summary: Source term estimation (STE), which aims to estimate key properties of the gas source, is essential for identifying hazardous gas releases. Information-theoretic approaches have been adopted for autonomous STE using mobile sensors due to robustness in noisy environments, yet their online action selection incurs substantial computational cost. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) provides a promising alternative with its fast decision-making capability. In DRL-based STE, the agent selects actions based on belief states of the source term updated from noisy measurement sequences. However, existing methods rely on random exploration or solely on belief uncertainty reduction without an effective exploration strategy in DRL, which can limit policy robustness in noisy environments. To address this, we propose a curiosity-driven information-guided reinforcement learning for robust and efficient STE. The proposed method promotes active exploration of novel belief state transitions that have not been sufficiently explored during training. We further introduce an uncertainty-adaptive active perception reward to guide efficient source search under uncertainty. Simulations under high-noise conditions and real-world experiments demonstrate the robustness and feasibility of the proposed framework, highlighting its potential for practical STE problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于好奇心驱动与信息引导的深度强化学习框架，用于自主气体源项估计（STE），在高噪声环境下通过主动探索新颖信念状态转移并引入不确定性自适应感知奖励，显著提升了策略的鲁棒性和效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于信息论的方法虽在噪声环境中鲁棒，但在线动作选择计算成本高；而基于深度强化学习的STE方法缺乏有效的探索策略，仅依赖随机探索或信念不确定性减少，导致策略在噪声环境下的鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 提出好奇心驱动的信息引导强化学习框架：1) 通过好奇心机制促进智能体主动探索训练中未充分探索的新颖信念状态转移；2) 引入不确定性自适应主动感知奖励，在不确定性下引导高效的气体源搜索。
AI.result: 在高噪声条件下的仿真实验和真实世界实验中均验证了所提出框架的鲁棒性和可行性，展示了其在实际STE问题中的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 好奇心驱动与信息引导相结合的方法有效解决了DRL在STE中探索不足的问题，为实际危险气体泄漏源项估计提供了一种稳健且高效的解决方案。

title: Agent2UCB: Agentic System for Generative Engine Optimization
