summary: Large language model driven search engines such as Google AI Overviews and Perplexity have created new opportunities for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) the practice of refining content to increase its likelihood of being cited or summarized by generative systems. We demonstrate Agent2UCB, an agentic GEO system that autonomously improves content visibility through customized, feedback-driven optimization. For each content item, the system evaluates nine GEO strategies, identifies the most effective method, and accelerates selection using a bandit-based Agent2UCB policy that integrates LLM priors with online reward signals. To monitor side effects, the system also provides a lightweight, text-only SEO readiness evaluation covering readability, topical coverage, and EEAT-style credibility. Experiments on GEO-Bench show consistent visibility gains while preserving SEO quality. The demo allows users to choose the websites of interest, observe the optimization workflow, and compare GEO/SEO outcomes across methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agent2UCB，一个自主代理型生成引擎优化（GEO）系统，通过带反馈的优化流程自动提升内容在LLM驱动的搜索引擎中的可见度。系统评估九种GEO策略，利用结合LLM先验与在线奖励信号的bandit策略加速策略选择，并提供轻量级SEO就绪度评估以监控副作用。实验证明在GEO-Bench上持续获得可见度提升且保持SEO质量。
AI.motivation: 随着Google AI Overviews和Perplexity等LLM驱动的搜索引擎兴起，GEO成为提升内容被引用或摘要概率的新实践。然而，现有GEO方法缺乏自动化、自适应的优化机制，需要开发一种能够自主选择最优策略并进行持续优化的系统。
AI.method: Agent2UCB系统包含三个核心组件：(1) 对每个内容项评估九种GEO策略，识别最有效方法；(2) 采用基于bandit的Agent2UCB策略，融合LLM先验知识与在线奖励信号加速策略选择；(3) 提供轻量级、纯文本的SEO就绪度评估，涵盖可读性、主题覆盖度和EEAT风格可信度，用于监控优化副作用。
AI.result: 在GEO-Bench基准上的实验显示，Agent2UCB在持续获得内容可见度提升的同时，保持了SEO质量不降级。系统还提供了交互式演示，允许用户选择感兴趣网站、观察优化工作流并比较不同方法的GEO/SEO结果。
AI.conclusion: Agent2UCB证明了代理型GEO系统能够通过反馈驱动的自主优化有效提升内容在生成式搜索引擎中的可见度，同时兼顾传统SEO质量，为GEO实践提供了一种自动化、可扩展的解决方案。

title: SGRNet: Spatially Guided Radiology Network for Structured Radiological Reporting of Head and Neck Cancer
summary: Automated radiological report generation can alleviate clinical workloads and eliminate observer variability. However, standard free-text generation models pose hallucination risks in dense regions and fail under data scarcity. We address these challenges in Head and Neck Cancer (HNC) from contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) imaging. To enforce factual safety, we reformulate report generation as an anatomically grounded, multi-label, structured reporting task, predicting localized tumor involvement across a hierarchical clinical schema. To bridge the visual gap from missing metabolic imaging (e.g., PET), we introduce SGRNet (Spatially Guided Radiology Network), incorporating two low-cost spatial priors: automated organ segmentations and weakly supervised tumor localization maps modeled via 3D Gaussian heatmaps. These priors are dynamically integrated via spatial feature modulation to guide the network toward subtle tumor-induced structural alterations. Evaluated on a multi-centric dataset of 184 paired HNC CECT volumes and reports, on five clinically salient, densely packed anatomical subsites, SGRNet achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 0.60, an 8.8 percentage-point absolute improvement over strong volume-only 3D baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对头颈癌（HNC）对比增强CT影像，将放射学报告生成重构为基于解剖结构的、多标签的结构化报告任务，提出SGRNet（空间引导放射学网络），通过自动器官分割和弱监督肿瘤定位图（3D高斯热图）两种低成本空间先验，利用空间特征调制引导网络捕捉细微的肿瘤诱导结构改变，在184对多中心数据集上实现mAP 0.60，较强3D基线提升8.8个百分点。
AI.motivation: 传统自由文本报告生成模型存在密集区域的幻觉风险，且在数据稀缺场景下表现不佳；头颈癌CECT影像缺乏代谢成像（如PET）的视觉信息，难以准确预测肿瘤侵犯情况。
AI.method: 将报告生成重构为解剖引导的多标签结构化报告任务；提出SGRNet，融合自动器官分割和弱监督肿瘤定位图（3D高斯热图）两种空间先验，通过空间特征调制动态集成以引导网络关注肿瘤诱导的细微结构改变。
AI.result: 在184对多中心HNC CECT数据上，覆盖五个临床关键且密集的解剖亚区，SGRNet达到mAP 0.60，较强体积级3D基线绝对提升8.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结构化解码配合低成本空间先验能有效提升头颈癌放射学预测的事实准确性和安全性，缓解幻觉问题并弥补代谢成像缺失带来的视觉信息不足。

title: Learning to infer and manipulate through distributed whole-arm interaction in a soft robot
summary:
In animals such as elephants and octopuses, acquiring non-visual information about an object and physically engaging with it are inseparable processes mediated by rich, large-area interactions between compliant appendages and the environment. Soft robots provide a natural platform for translating this principle into engineered systems. Yet current robotic intelligence makes limited use of physical interaction, treating it primarily as a disturbance to be rejected or, at best, as a means of compensating for object misalignment.
  Here, we introduce a physical intelligence framework in which distributed compliant interactions jointly reveal task-relevant information and organize manipulation behavior. This results in an intrinsically partially observable problem: key task-relevant information is never measured directly, but must instead be inferred from the history of physical interactions. We propose a reinforcement-learning architecture that addresses this challenge by learning a memory-based control policy end-to-end. The key innovations making this possible are (i) a pretrained exploration policy that provides a reference for broad workspace exploration, (ii) joint optimization that integrates exploration and grasping objectives within a single recurrent policy, and (iii) a two-stage sim-to-real adaptation including observation mapping and policy fine-tuning.
  We demonstrate this principle through blind whole-arm grasping with a hybrid rigid-soft robotic arm that we equip with IMUs embedded directly within its compliant structure, providing its only source of proprioceptive sensing. The learned policy successfully identifies and grasps various objects by autonomously coordinating workspace exploration, object encounter and localization, inference of grasp-relevant properties, and stable whole-arm wrapping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种物理智能框架，通过分布式柔顺交互同时获取任务信息并组织操作行为，并采用基于记忆的强化学习策略（端到端学习）解决内在部分可观测问题。作者在装有嵌入式IMU的刚柔混合机械臂上展示了"盲"全身抓取，策略能自主协调探索、定位、属性推理和稳定包裹。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人智能对物理交互利用有限，仅将其视为需抑制的干扰或用于补偿物体错位的工具。而动物（如大象、章鱼）通过柔顺附肢的大面积交互将信息获取与物理操作融为一体。作者希望将这一原理引入软体机器人系统，实现真正的"物理智能"。
AI.method: 提出三大关键创新：(i) 预训练的探索策略提供工作空间广泛探索的参考；(ii) 联合优化将探索与抓取目标整合进单一循环策略（recurrent policy）；(iii) 两阶段sim-to-real迁移，包括观测映射和策略微调。使用嵌入柔顺结构内的IMU作为唯一本体感觉来源，采用记忆基控制策略端到端学习。
AI.result: 学习到的策略能够自主协调工作空间探索、物体遭遇与定位、抓取相关属性推理以及稳定的全身包裹，成功识别并抓取多种不同物体。关键在于策略从未直接测量任务相关信息，而是从物理交互历史中推断。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了通过物理交互本身（而非视觉或其他非接触传感）可以实现完整的盲抓取任务，展示了软体机器人与分布式柔顺感知结合实现"物理智能"的可行性，为机器人操作提供了一种新范式。

title: Revolutionizing Turn-by-Turn Navigation with Cloud-Edge Deep Learning
comment: This paper has accepted by IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
summary: Turn-by-turn (TBT) navigation systems are integral to modern driving experiences, providing real-time audio instructions to guide drivers safely to destinations. However, existing audio instruction policy often relies on rule-based approaches that struggle to balance informational content with cognitive load, potentially leading to driver confusion or missed turns in complex environments. To overcome these difficulties, we first model the generation of navigation instructions as a multi-task learning problem by decomposing the audio content into combinations of modular elements. Then, we propose a novel deep learning framework that leverages the powerful spatiotemporal information processing capabilities of Transformers and the strong multi-task learning abilities of Mixture of Experts (MoE) to generate real-time, context-aware audio instructions for TBT driving navigation. A cloud-edge collaborative architecture is implemented to handle the computational demands of the model, ensuring scalability and real-time performance for practical applications. Experimental results in the real world demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces the yaw rate (the proportion of vehicles deviating from navigation routes) compared to traditional methods, delivering clearer and more effective audio instructions. This is the first large-scale application of deep learning in driving audio navigation, marking a substantial advancement in intelligent transportation and driving assistance technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer和混合专家（MoE）的深度学习框架，用于生成实时、情境感知的逐向（TBT）驾驶导航音频指令，并通过云边协同架构实现大规模部署。实验表明该方法能显著降低偏航率，提升导航指令的清晰度和有效性，是深度学习在驾驶音频导航中的首次大规模应用。
AI.motivation: 现有的逐向导航音频指令生成通常依赖基于规则的方法，难以在信息含量和驾驶员认知负荷之间取得平衡，在复杂环境下容易导致驾驶员困惑或错过转弯。因此需要一种更智能的、能感知上下文情境的音频指令生成方法。
AI.method: 1) 将导航指令生成建模为多任务学习问题，将音频内容分解为模块化元素的组合；2) 提出融合Transformer（强大的时空信息处理能力）和MoE（强多任务学习能力）的深度学习框架；3) 设计云边协同架构，保证模型的计算需求和实时性能。
AI.result: 在真实世界的实验中，相比传统方法，所提方法显著降低了偏航率（偏离导航路线的车辆比例），提供了更清晰、更有效的音频指令。
AI.conclusion: 这是深度学习在驾驶音频导航领域的首次大规模应用，标志着智能交通和驾驶辅助技术的重要进步，为未来的导航系统智能化提供了新方向。

title: Training-Free Hidden-State Refinement for Flow-Matching Image Generators
summary: We aim to improve frozen flow-matching image generators by adding inference computation inside the denoiser, without changing model weights or the outer sampler. Existing generators usually spend extra test-time computation by increasing the number of sampling steps, which repeatedly evaluates the entire denoiser and couples quality gains to sampler cost. A key challenge is how to use extra computation inside a frozen transformer denoiser: the method must decide which tokens, layers, and sampling times receive repeated updates while preserving the original generation pipeline. We introduce a training-free looping framework that repeatedly applies selected transformer layers inside each denoising call. Dense and Sparse Token Loop vary the token scope; Sampling-Progress Gating and the loop layer range specify when and where looping is active; loop count and strength control the repeated updates; and Loop Guidance combines ordinary and looped vector-field predictions. Across two Scale-RAE model scales, loop variants improve primary and auxiliary quality metrics with competitive quality--efficiency trade-offs. Loop Guidance further improves both primary metrics across all three tested models; on Scale-RAE DiT2.4B, it raises GenEval from 0.4471 to 0.5691 and DPG-Bench from 0.7656 to 0.8053. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的循环框架（Token Loop），通过在流匹配图像生成器的denoiser内部重复应用选定的Transformer层来增加推理计算量，在不改变模型权重和外层采样器的情况下提升生成质量。提出Dense/Sparse Token Loop、Sampling-Progress Gating、Loop Guidance等变体，在多个模型上取得质量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配图像生成器通常通过增加采样步数来消耗额外测试时间计算，但这会反复评估整个denoiser，将质量提升与采样器成本耦合。核心挑战在于如何在保持原始生成流水线不变的前提下，在冻结的Transformer denoiser内部有效利用额外计算——需要决定哪些token、层和采样时刻应接收重复更新。
AI.method: 提出一个无需训练的循环框架：在每个denoising调用内部重复应用选定的Transformer层。具体组件包括：（1）Dense和Sparse Token Loop控制token范围；（2）Sampling-Progress Gating和循环层范围指定循环激活的时间和位置；（3）循环计数和强度控制重复更新；（4）Loop Guidance结合普通和循环向量场预测。
AI.result: 在两个Scale-RAE模型尺度上，循环变体提升了主要和辅助质量指标，具有竞争力的质量-效率权衡。Loop Guidance在所有三个测试模型上都提升了两个主要指标；在Scale-RAE DiT2.4B上，GenEval从0.4471提升到0.5691，DPG-Bench从0.7656提升到0.8053。
AI.conclusion: 该训练免费的循环框架有效解耦了质量提升与采样器成本，通过在denoiser内部复用选定层来提升生成质量，且无需修改模型权重。Loop Guidance在所有模型上一致改善主要指标，展现了良好的泛化性。

title: A Dual-Cam Parallel Elastic Actuator with Shared Gas-Spring Compensation for Humanoid Ankles
comment: Accepted to IEEE AIM 2026. Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted
summary: To improve torque capacity and energy efficiency of humanoid ankles, this paper proposes a 2-DoF parallel elastic actuator (PEA). The main novelty of the proposed design lies in its dual-cam, single-gas-spring architecture, which enables torque compensation in both pitch and roll using a shared elastic element, thereby improving structural compactness compared with conventional multi-element compensation schemes. By leveraging parallel gas springs and customized cam modules, the proposed architecture provides dual-axis torque assistance tailored to specific task requirements. The second key contribution is the formulation of a coupled 2-DoF mathematical model that explicitly captures the interdependence between the two compensation units through the shared spring. Based on this model, an optimization-based design framework is developed to synthesize customized cam profiles from prescribed torque references, establishing a systematic link from task requirements to hardware realization. The complete lower-leg CAD integration is presented in detail. Static FEA and kinematic simulations confirm the design's feasibility and torque-relief effectiveness. The results highlight the proposed design as a compact, customizable solution for 2-DoF humanoid ankle torque compensation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向人形机器人脚踝的2自由度并联弹性执行器（PEA），采用双凸轮单气弹簧架构，实现俯仰和翻滚两个方向上的扭矩补偿，并建立了耦合的2自由度数学模型和基于优化的凸轮轮廓设计框架。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人脚踝需要提升扭矩容量和能量效率，传统多弹性元件补偿方案结构不够紧凑。
AI.method: 提出双凸轮、单气弹簧的2自由度并联弹性执行器架构，利用共享弹性元件实现双轴扭矩补偿；建立耦合2自由度数学模型，并通过优化框架从预定扭矩参考合成定制凸轮轮廓；完成小腿CAD集成设计。
AI.result: 静态有限元分析和运动学仿真验证了设计可行性和扭矩缓解有效性，证明该设计是紧凑、可定制的人形脚踝2自由度扭矩补偿方案。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的双凸轮单气弹簧PEA架构是一种紧凑、可定制的解决方案，能够有效实现人形脚踝的双自由度扭矩补偿。

title: Nested Convex-Body Chasing for Online Optimization with Evolving Feasible Sets
summary:
We study online optimization with nested shrinking feasible regions in two settings: convex optimization with nested evolving feasible sets (CONES) and adversarial constrained online convex optimization (COCO). Our algorithms separate loss control from geometric movement: constrained minimizers and cumulative-loss tests preserve regret guarantees, while a deterministic resettable nested convex-body chaser limits movement.
  For CONES with a $G$-Lipschitz, $μ$-strongly convex objective on a diameter-$D$ domain, we chase intersections of the current feasible set with adaptive objective sublevel sets. Using the Euclidean chasing ratio $O(\sqrt{d\log(1+d)})$, we obtain nonpositive regret at every prefix and movement $O(\sqrt{d\log(1+d)\,GD\log(eT)/μ})$. The bound adapts to the increase in the constrained optimum value. In dimension two, with all other parameters fixed, every randomized algorithm with terminal expected regret $O(T^β)$, $β<1$, suffers $Ω(\sqrt{\log T})$ expected movement on some deterministic nested sequence, proving optimal horizon dependence. Under linear growth away from the constrained minimizer set, Steiner-point tracking yields movement independent of $T$.
  For general convex COCO, one-step-delayed chasing with regularized-leader resets gives regret $O(G_fD\sqrt{d\log(1+d)T})$ and cumulative constraint violation $O(G_gD\sqrt{d\log(1+d)T})$. For strongly convex losses, both are $O(d\log(1+d)\log(eT))$ when other parameters are fixed. These reductions replace the $O(d^{d/2})$ projection-path factor in prior analyses by the polynomial dimension dependence of Euclidean nested convex-body chasing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两种具有嵌套收缩可行域设置的在线优化问题：凸优化与嵌套演化可行集（CONES）以及对抗性约束在线凸优化（COCO）。提出的算法将损失控制与几何移动分离：约束最小化器和累积损失测试保持遗憾界，而确定性可重置嵌套凸体追踪器限制移动量。在CONES设置下，对G-Lipschitz、μ-强凸目标函数，利用欧几里得追踪比O(√(d log(1+d)))获得每个前缀非正遗憾和O(√(d log(1+d) GD log(eT)/μ))的移动量；在二维情况下证明了最优的Ω(√log T)移动下界。对一般凸COCO，一步延迟追踪与正则化领导者重置给出O(G_f D √(d log(1+d) T))的遗憾和约束违反界；对强凸损失两者均为O(d log(1+d) log(eT))。这些简化将先前分析中的O(d^(d/2))投影路径因子替换为欧几里得嵌套凸体追踪的多项式维度依赖。
AI.motivation: 在在线优化中，当可行域随时间和环境动态收缩（如动态约束、资源限制等）时，传统的投影方法会导致过大的移动代价。作者希望设计一种算法，能够在不牺牲遗憾保证的前提下，有效控制代理在嵌套收缩可行域中的几何移动量。之前的分析中存在维度爆炸性的O(d^(d/2))投影路径因子，本文旨在用多项式的维度依赖将其替代。
AI.method: 本文提出将损失控制与几何移动分离的算法框架：(1) 使用约束最小化器和累积损失测试来维持遗憾保证（非正遗憾）；(2) 采用确定性可重置的嵌套凸体追踪器（Euclidean chasing）来限制移动。对于CONES，通过追踪当前可行集与自适应目标子水平集的交集；对于COCO，采用一步延迟追踪和正则化领导者重置策略。
AI.result: 在CONES设置下获得非正前缀遗憾和O(√(d log(1+d) GD log(eT)/μ))的移动界；在二维情况下证明任何随机算法在期望遗憾O(T^β)（β<1）下必然遭受Ω(√log T)的期望移动，证明水平依赖最优；在线性增长条件下，Steiner点追踪实现与T无关的移动。对一般凸COCO获得O(G_f D √(d log(1+d) T))的遗憾和约束违反界，强凸情形下为O(d log(1+d) log(eT))。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将损失控制与几何移动分离的设计范式，成功地将嵌套凸体追踪（Euclidean chasing）的强大多项式维度界应用于在线优化问题，显著改善了先前分析中维度依赖过大的缺陷，并为嵌套收缩可行域下的在线优化提供了理论上紧的遗憾-移动权衡刻画。

title: Subtraction-Based Tumor Segmentation and Lesion-Centered pCR Prediction for the MAMA-MIA Challenge
summary:
We describe the submission of team FME to the MAMA-MIA Challenge, which evaluated primary tumor segmentation and prediction of pathological complete response (pCR) from pretreatment dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI on an external multi-country cohort. For segmentation, we trained a five-fold residual-encoder nnU-Net ensemble using only the first post-contrast minus pre-contrast image, combined with mirroring test-time augmentation and largest-connected-component filtering. For pCR prediction, we ensembled 25 pretrained 3D video classifiers trained on lesion-centred crops from the pre-contrast and first two post-contrast volumes. FME ranked second in both tasks. The segmentation method achieved a combined performance-fairness score of 0.882, with Dice 0.713 and normalized Hausdorff distance 0.099. The pCR method achieved a combined score of 0.664, balanced accuracy of 0.541, and equalized-odds disparity of 0.212. The results indicate that subtraction-based input and ensembling support robust tumor segmentation under cross-site domain shift, whereas pCR prediction from baseline DCE-MRI alone remains limited.
  For the submission repository, see https://github.com/FraunhoferMEVIS/MAMA-MIA-Challenge-FME

AI.tldr: FME团队在MAMA-MIA挑战赛中使用五折残差编码器nnU-Net集成进行肿瘤分割，使用25个预训练3D视频分类器集成进行pCR预测，两项任务均排名第二。
AI.motivation: 评估在外部多国队列中，从治疗前动态对比增强乳腺MRI进行原发肿瘤分割和病理完全缓解（pCR）预测的性能，以验证算法在跨站点域偏移下的稳健性。
AI.method: 分割任务使用五折残差编码器nnU-Net集成，仅利用第一个对比后减对比前的图像，结合镜像测试时增强和最大连通分量滤波。pCR预测集成25个在病灶中心裁剪图像上预训练的3D视频分类器，输入为对比前和两个对比后的三维体积。
AI.result: 两项任务均排名第二。分割方法综合性能-公平性得分为0.882，Dice为0.713，归一化Hausdorff距离为0.099。pCR方法综合得分为0.664，平衡准确率为0.541，等机会差异为0.212。
AI.conclusion: 基于减法输入和集成方法能够支持跨站点域偏移下的稳健肿瘤分割，但仅凭基线DCE-MRI进行pCR预测的能力仍然有限。

title: GAFT: Geo-Anchored Fine-Tuning for Hazard Identification from Rare Failures
summary: Off-road navigation can fail when physical structures induce irrecoverable states such as high-centering or entrapment, requiring human interventions. Identifying these structures is crucial, yet challenging. Such failure events are rare and costly to collect, resulting in limited training data. Moreover, the collected data associate frames with outcomes, but do not indicate the visual cues responsible for the failure. Learning directly from these data can therefore exploit scenario-specific visual cues, leading to poor generalization. We propose \textbf{Geo-Anchored Fine-Tuning (GAFT)}, a parameter-efficient method that adapts a vision foundation model with a geometry-derived prior. It guides LoRA adaptation by aligning a spatial attention-rollout map with the geometry prior, while preserving pretrained representations. On an intervention-verified forest hazard benchmark, across ten independently trained adaptations, GAFT consistently outperforms frozen DINOv2 and supervised PEFT baselines, improving the repeated leave-one-scenario-out mean $F_2$ from 0.0607 to 0.3757 with statistical significance under paired analysis. Within these independently trained models, the best-performing GAFT model achieves a repeated-LOSO $F_2$ of 0.570. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/Xu-Yanran/geo_anchored_fine_tuning

AI.tldr: 提出Geo-Anchored Fine-Tuning (GAFT)，一种参数高效方法，利用几何先验指导视觉基础模型的LoRA微调，用于越野导航中的不可恢复状态（如高中心卡住）识别，在森林危险基准上显著提升F2分数。
AI.motivation: 越野导航中物理结构可能导致不可恢复状态（如卡住），需要人工干预。识别这些结构至关重要但困难重重：失败事件罕见且采集成本高导致训练数据有限；且数据仅关联帧与结果，不指示导致失败的视觉线索，直接学习会利用场景特定线索导致泛化能力差。
AI.method: GAFT是一种参数高效方法，通过几何衍生先验来适应视觉基础模型。具体通过将空间注意力展开图与几何先验对齐来指导LoRA适配，同时保留预训练表征。
AI.result: 在干预验证的森林危险基准上，跨十个独立训练的适配中，GAFT一致优于冻结DINOv2和监督PEFT基线，将重复leave-one-scenario-out平均F2从0.0607提升到0.3757（配对分析具有统计显著性）。最佳GAFT模型达到0.570的重复LOSO F2。
AI.conclusion: GAFT通过几何先验引导LoRA适配，显著提升越野导航中结构危险识别的泛化能力，验证了几何信息在引导视觉基础模型微调中的有效性。

title: HANIA: Planner-Guided Multimodal Graph Evidence Selection for Grounded Question Answering
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at Graph-enhanced LLMs for trustwOrthy Web data management (GLOW), ISWC 2026 Workshops, Bari, Italy
summary: Multimodal question answering remains sensitive to noisy, incomplete, and weakly grounded evidence. Long unstructured contexts can introduce redundancy and encourage unsupported generation, while flat retrieval may overlook relations needed for multi-step reasoning. We present HANIA, a planner-guided multimodal graph framework for evidence-grounded question answering. HANIA processes the supplied image and text using a frozen vision-language model to extract concise question-relevant visual evidence with explicit abstention. It then constructs an input-grounded multimodal graph and applies a two-group finite-state planner to coordinate descriptive and relational evidence. Coverage-aware pruning retains a compact evidence set based on relevance, graph confidence, concept coverage, and modality diversity. The selected passages, visual statements, and graph triples are provided to a frozen instruction-tuned decoder. We evaluate HANIA on ScienceQA using answer accuracy, evidence-filtering quality, evidence-budget sensitivity, and efficiency. The results show that structured evidence planning and compact graph-guided retrieval can support competitive multimodal question answering without target-dataset fine-tuning or iterative retrieval. The code is available at https://github.com/Zafar-southeast/HANIA.

AI.tldr: HANIA是一个规划器引导的多模态图框架，用于证据支撑的问答。它通过冻结视觉语言模型提取简洁的视觉证据，构建输入支撑的多模态图，并使用双组有限状态规划器协调描述性和关系性证据，通过覆盖感知剪枝保留紧凑证据集，最终交由冻结解码器生成答案。在ScienceQA上验证了无需目标数据集微调或迭代检索即可实现竞争性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态问答对噪声、不完整和弱支撑证据敏感。长非结构化上下文引入冗余并鼓励无支撑生成，而扁平化检索可能忽略多步推理所需的关系。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结视觉语言模型（VLM）从图像和文本中提取简明且与问题相关的视觉证据，支持显式弃权；2) 构建输入支撑的多模态图；3) 应用双组有限状态规划器协调描述性证据和关系性证据；4) 基于相关性、图置信度、概念覆盖率和模态多样性的覆盖感知剪枝保留紧凑证据集；5) 将选定段落、视觉陈述和图三元组提供给冻结指令微调解码器。
AI.result: 在ScienceQA上评估了答案准确率、证据过滤质量、证据预算敏感性和效率。结构化证据规划和紧凑图引导检索无需目标数据集微调或迭代检索即可支持竞争性多模态问答。
AI.conclusion: HANIA证明了通过结构化证据规划与图引导的紧凑检索，可以在不进行目标数据集微调的情况下实现有效的多模态问答，代码已开源。

title: Mapping-Based Image Diffusion
summary: In this work, we introduce a novel tensor-based functional for targeted image enhancement and denoising. Via explicit regularization, our formulation incorporates application dependent and contextual information using first principles. Few works in literature treat variational models that describe both application dependent information and contextual knowledge of the denoising problem. We prove the existence of a minimizer and present results on tensor symmetry constraints, convexity, and geometric interpretation of the proposed functional. We show that our framework excels in applications where nonlinear functions are present such as in gamma correction and targeted value range filtering. We also study general denoising performance where we show comparable results to dedicated PDE-based state of the art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于张量的新型变分泛函，用于目标图像增强与去噪。该公式通过显式正则化，利用第一性原理融入应用相关和上下文信息，并在理论上证明了最小化子的存在性，同时分析了张量对称约束、凸性和几何解释。实验表明该方法在伽马校正和值域滤波等非线性应用中表现优异，且通用去噪性能可与专用PDE方法相媲美。
AI.motivation: 现有文献中很少有变分模型能同时描述应用相关信息与去噪问题的上下文知识，作者希望填补这一空白，提出一个统一的框架来整合这两类信息。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的基于张量的变分泛函，通过显式正则化将应用相关和上下文信息以第一性原理的方式融入公式，并进行了理论分析（最小化子存在性、张量对称约束、凸性、几何解释）。
AI.result: 该框架在包含非线性函数的应用（如伽马校正、目标值域滤波）中表现突出；在通用去噪任务中，性能与专用PDE方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的张量变分框架能够有效结合应用相关信息和上下文知识，在目标增强和去噪任务上达到甚至媲美现有最先进方法的性能，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Zeva: In-Context Causal Learning for Generalizable Embodied Manipulation
summary: Generalizable embodied manipulation remains difficult to achieve through pretraining alone, due to unseen physical conditions in the real world. We argue that robots need to learn from their own physical interactions on the fly during real-world deployment and use this knowledge to inform subsequent actions. We present Zeva, the first framework that enables in-context learning from a robot's own physical interaction experience while keeping the policy model frozen. Zeva employs a Causal Interaction Extractor to encode an executed action and its induced state change into a causal interaction signal, which is stored in a dual-timescale causal memory. For subsequent actions, relevant causal interaction signals are retrieved from memory and injected into the frozen policy model as context. Experiments in simulation and real-world manipulation demonstrate that Zeva achieves the best performance among the compared frontier VLAs and WAMs and, more importantly, enables self-evolution during deployment without gradient updates. Its success rate continues to improve as the robot accumulates interaction experience. Furthermore, the acquired interaction experience can generalize across tasks.

AI.tldr: Zeva是首个能够在策略模型冻结的情况下，从机器人自身物理交互经验中进行上下文学习的框架。它通过因果交互提取器编码动作及其引发的状态变化，存入双时间尺度因果记忆，并在后续决策时检索相关信号注入冻结的策略模型。实验表明其在仿真和真实操控中优于前沿VLA和WAM模型，且无需梯度更新即可实现部署中的自我进化。
AI.motivation: 通用具身操控难以仅通过预训练实现，因为现实世界中存在未见的物理条件。作者认为机器人需要在真实部署过程中从自身物理交互中在线学习，并利用这些知识指导后续动作，而非依赖静态预训练模型。
AI.method: Zeva包含两个核心组件：(1) 因果交互提取器(Causal Interaction Extractor)，用于编码已执行动作及其引发的状态变化，生成因果交互信号；(2) 双时间尺度因果记忆(Dual-timescale Causal Memory)，存储这些交互信号。在后续动作决策时，从记忆中检索相关的因果交互信号，注入到冻结的策略模型中作为上下文，实现无需梯度更新的上下文学习。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界操控实验中，Zeva在所有对比的前沿VLA（视觉-语言-动作）和WAM（世界动作模型）中取得了最佳性能。更重要的是，它实现了部署过程中无需梯度更新的自我进化——成功率随交互经验积累持续提升，且获得的交互经验可以跨任务泛化。
AI.conclusion: Zeva验证了通过记忆与上下文注入实现机器人自主经验学习的可行性，表明机器人无需更新模型参数即可在部署中持续自我进化，且学习到的交互经验具有跨任务迁移能力，为通用具身操控提供了一条新路径。

title: EviAnchor: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models via Regional Visual Evidence Compensation
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) frequently generate content unsupported by visual inputs. Preliminary experiments show that visual evidence is primarily incorporated into answer-side representations in early-to-middle decoder layers, while its direct influence progressively weakens in later layers. This attenuation suggests that visual evidence acquired earlier may be insufficiently utilized during subsequent generation. Based on this observation, we propose EviAnchor, a training-free and single-branch inference framework that preserves and reactivates visual evidence throughout generation. EviAnchor introduces Regional Evidence Anchor (REA) slots to progressively aggregate dense visual tokens into spatially structured representations. It then strengthens the current decision state's access to these visual anchors through decision-conditioned evidence routing, mitigating excessive dependence on textual context. Finally, the model resumes its native Transformer computation to integrate the retrieved visual evidence with question semantics and generation history. Experiments across POPE, CHAIR, and MMHal-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements in visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EviAnchor，一个无需训练的单分支推理框架，通过在生成过程中保留并重新激活视觉证据，缓解大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）生成与视觉输入不一致内容的问题。实验在POPE、CHAIR和MMHal-Bench上均取得一致的视觉接地性能提升。
AI.motivation: LVLMs经常生成视觉输入不支持的内容。初步实验发现，视觉证据主要在前中期解码层被纳入答案表示，而在后期层其直接影响逐渐减弱，导致早期获取的视觉证据在后续生成中未被充分利用，从而引发幻觉问题。
AI.method: EviAnchor包含三个关键组件：(1) 引入区域证据锚点（REA）槽位，逐步将密集的视觉token聚合为空间结构化表示；(2) 通过决策条件证据路由，强化当前决策状态对视觉锚点的访问，减轻对文本上下文的过度依赖；(3) 恢复原生Transformer计算，将检索到的视觉证据与问题语义及生成历史整合。
AI.result: 在POPE、CHAIR和MMHal-Bench三个基准上，EviAnchor均展示了视觉接地能力的一致提升，且该框架是训练无关的（training-free）。
AI.conclusion: EviAnchor通过保留和重新激活贯穿生成过程的视觉证据，有效改善了LVLMs的视觉接地能力，为缓解幻觉提供了一种无需额外训练的轻量级推理方案。

title: Feature-Spectral Fragility in Segmentation: Dataset Dependence, Architecture-Specific Localization, and Spectral Correlates
summary: Robustness of segmentation models is commonly assessed through input-domain perturbations, while dependence on frequency content within learned feature representations remains less understood. We probe this dependence using targeted post-training low-pass interventions on internal representations of three segmentation architectures, ResNet50-UNet (CNN), VM-UNet (SSM), and Swin-UNETR (Transformer), across CVC-ClinicDB and ISIC2018, with headline evaluations performed on untouched held-out test sets. At cutoff rho=0.25, feature-domain low-pass filtering causes severe degradation on CVC: Dice drops by 100%, 73.2%, and 30.9% for CNN, SSM, and Transformer, respectively, compared with 9.4%, 10.3%, and 0.6% on ISIC. The cross-dataset difference is statistically significant for every architecture. Single-stage interventions further show that sensitivity is localized at architecture-specific depths: the CNN peaks at a mid/late encoder block, whereas the SSM peaks in an early encoder stage on both datasets. Native feature-domain spectral measurements show an inverse association between high-frequency energy and fragility on CVC; the relationship is only partial on ISIC and is therefore treated as a candidate correlate rather than a proven mechanism. Finally, Fourier augmentation improves robustness to input-space low-pass filtering but leaves feature-domain degradation essentially unchanged. These results show that feature-spectral robustness is strongly dataset-dependent, architecture-specific, and distinct from input-domain spectral robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了分割模型内部特征表示对频率内容的依赖，通过在三种架构（CNN、SSM、Transformer）的编码器内部特征上施加低通滤波干预，发现特征域频谱鲁棒性高度依赖数据集、架构特定深度，且与输入域频谱鲁棒性不同。
AI.motivation: 现有分割模型鲁棒性评估主要关注输入域扰动，而对学习到的特征表示中频率内容的依赖程度尚缺乏理解。理解这一点对于模型解释、诊断和鲁棒性提升至关重要。
AI.method: 对三种分割架构（ResNet50-UNet CNN、VM-UNet SSM、Swin-UNETR Transformer）在CVC-ClinicDB和ISIC2018数据集上，对内部特征表示施加训练后低通滤波干预（截止频率rho=0.25），评估Dice下降幅度；同时进行单阶段干预定位敏感深度，测量原生特征域频谱，并测试傅里叶增强对鲁棒性的影响。
AI.result: 在CVC数据集上，特征域低通滤波导致CNN、SSM、Transformer的Dice分别下降100%、73.2%和30.9%，而在ISIC上仅下降9.4%、10.3%和0.6%，跨数据集差异具有统计显著性。CNN敏感度峰值位于中/后期编码器块，SSM则位于早期编码器阶段。原生特征频谱显示高频能量与CVC上的脆弱性呈负相关，但ISIC上仅部分相关。傅里叶增强能改善输入域低通鲁棒性，但对特征域退化几乎无影响。
AI.conclusion: 特征频谱鲁棒性具有强烈数据集依赖性、架构特定性，且与输入域频谱鲁棒性截然不同。这提示需要更深入理解特征空间中的频率机制，并开发针对特征域鲁棒性的专门方法。

title: SleepWalking: Privileged Representation Shaping for End-to-End Blind Locomotion in Legged Robots
summary: Partially observable locomotion requires a policy to act when task-relevant properties of the robot--environment state are not fully specified by instantaneous observations. Existing approaches often address this challenge by explicitly estimating missing physical variables or processing extended observation histories through structured architectures. We take a different view: partial observability is fundamentally an information-retention problem. The decisive question is not how task-relevant information enters the network, but whether the policy's internal state retains it. Guided by this perspective, we propose SleepWalking for Robot Locomotion (SWAQ), a one-stage end-to-end framework that uses next-step privileged physical reconstruction to shape what a recurrent history representation retains during policy learning, while the deployed actor uses only a direct history-to-action pathway. Under aligned training settings, SWAQ achieves a 15.0\% higher peak mean terrain level than DWAQ, the strongest non-exteroceptive baseline, while using 44.4\% fewer inference MACs per control step. Layerwise probes further show that information associated with the reconstructed physical variables remains linearly decodable through the policy head up to the layer preceding the action output. Complementary theoretical analysis relates privileged-variable recoverability to the achievable-return gap between history-based and privileged-information policy classes. These results suggest that semantic objectives can structure learning without requiring a corresponding architectural decomposition of the deployed controller.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWAQ框架，将部分可观测运动控制视为信息保留问题，通过下一时刻特权物理重建来塑造循环历史表征的学习，部署时仅使用直接的历史到动作通路，无需显式架构分解。在对齐训练设置下，SWAQ比最强非外感受基线DWAQ峰值平均地形水平高15.0%，推理MACs减少44.4%，并辅以层探针和理论分析验证。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测运动控制要求策略在瞬时观测未完全指定任务相关属性时做出决策。现有方法要么显式估计缺失物理变量，要么通过结构化架构处理扩展观察历史。作者提出不同观点：部分可观测性本质上是信息保留问题，关键不在于任务相关信息如何进入网络，而在于策略内部状态能否保留这些信息。
AI.method: 提出SWAQ框架，一种单阶段端到端方法，通过下一时刻特权物理重建（next-step privileged physical reconstruction）来塑造循环历史表征在策略学习过程中保留的内容。训练时使用特权物理信息引导表征学习，部署时actor仅使用直接历史到动作通路，不依赖传统的历史编码器/特权教师等结构化架构。
AI.result: 在对齐训练设置下，SWAQ比最强非外感受基线DWAQ峰值平均地形水平高15.0%，同时推理MACs每控制步减少44.4%。层探针实验表明，与重建物理变量相关的信息在策略头直至动作输出前一层都保持线性可解码。理论分析将特权变量可恢复性与基于历史策略类与特权信息策略类之间的可实现回报差距联系起来。
AI.conclusion: 语义目标可以结构化学习过程，而无需对部署控制器进行相应的架构分解。这暗示任务相关信息保留能力比架构设计更为关键，为部分可观测运动控制提供了新的设计范式。

title: SafeAtlas-VL: Beyond Binary Multimodal Safety with Large-Scale Data and Guard Models
summary: Multimodal safety moderation requires distinguishing risks arising from visual content, user intent, and assistant behavior. Existing safeguards, however, are typically trained for a single judgment target and reduce safety assessment to a binary decision. Consequently, risk becomes difficult to compare across a multimodal interaction, and ambiguous cases are obscured. We introduce SafeAtlas-VL, a dataset of 1.5M training instances that places image-, request-, and response-level judgments on a five-level ordered scale. We curate a broad collection of safety-relevant data from both real-world and synthetic sources and apply a disagreement-aware annotation procedure. The resulting dataset spans 15 harm categories and 55 fine-grained subcategories, covering a broad range of multimodal safety scenarios. We also construct SafeAtlas-Bench, a held-out set of 5,000 instances for evaluating five-level predictions and continuous risk scores. Upon this dataset, we train the SafeAtlas Guard series of models via target-conditioned tuning for multimodal safety detection. Our models not only perform five-way classification of safety levels but also map safety to continuous scores through a soft cumulative ordinal head. Experimental results demonstrate that guard models trained on our dataset exhibit strong generalization: even without using the training sets of other benchmarks, they achieve competitive performance on the corresponding test sets. Notably, our 8B model attains the overall best performance, outperforming the previous SOTA by approximately 4% in F1 score. Code, data, and models are released to support further research. Warning: this paper contains example data that may be offensive, harmful, graphic, or disturbing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeAtlas-VL，一个包含150万训练样本的多模态安全数据集，将图像、请求和响应级别的安全判断放在五级有序量表上，覆盖15个危害类别和55个细分类别。同时构建SafeAtlas-Bench评估基准和SafeAtlas Guard安全模型系列，通过目标条件微调和软累积序数头实现五级安全分类及连续风险评分，8B模型在F1分数上超越现有SOTA约4%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态安全护栏通常只针对单一判断目标进行训练，且将安全评估简化为二元决策。这导致跨多模态交互的风险难以比较，模糊边界案例被掩盖。作者旨在解决这些局限性，建立更细粒度、多维度的安全评估体系。
AI.method: 构建包含真实世界和合成来源的150万训练实例数据集SafeAtlas-VL，采用异议感知（disagreement-aware）标注流程，在图像、请求和响应三个层面进行五级有序安全评分。训练SafeAtlas Guard系列模型，使用目标条件微调（target-conditioned tuning）实现多模态安全检测，并通过软累积序数头（soft cumulative ordinal head）将安全映射为连续分数。
AI.result: SafeAtlas Guard模型展现出强大的泛化能力，即使不使用其他基准的训练集，也能在对应测试集上取得有竞争力的性能。8B模型取得整体最佳表现，在F1分数上超越之前的SOTA约4%。
AI.conclusion: SafeAtlas-VL及其配套模型为多模态安全评估提供了更细粒度、多维度的解决方案，通过有序量表替代二元决策，提升了安全风险的可比性和判断准确性，并为后续研究开源了代码、数据和模型。

title: A Tensor Variational Formulation of Gradient Energy Total Variation
summary: We present a novel variational approach to a tensor-based total variation formulation which is called gradient energy total variation, GETV. We introduce the gradient energy tensor [6] into the GETV and show that the corresponding Euler-Lagrange (E-L) equation is a tensor-based partial differential equation of total variation type. Furthermore, we give a proof which shows that GETV is a convex functional. This approach, in contrast to the commonly used structure tensor, enables a formal derivation of the corresponding E-L equation. Experimental results suggest that GETV compares favourably to other state of the art variational denoising methods such as extended anisotropic diffusion (EAD)[1] and total variation (TV) [18] for gray-scale and colour images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的变分方法，用于基于张量的全变分（TV）公式——梯度能量全变分（GETV）。作者将梯度能量张量引入GETV，证明其对应的欧拉-拉格朗日方程是张量型全变分偏微分方程，并证明了GETV是凸泛函。实验表明GETV在灰度图像和彩色图像去噪方面优于扩展各向异性扩散（EAD）和标准全变分（TV）等先进方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的结构张量虽然常用于各向异性扩散，但难以形式化推导对应的欧拉-拉格朗日方程。作者希望通过引入梯度能量张量来克服这一局限，从而获得一个既能形式化推导又能有效去噪的张量型全变分模型。
AI.method: 将梯度能量张量引入到梯度能量全变分（GETV）中，得到张量型全变分偏微分方程形式的欧拉-拉格朗日方程，并给出GETV为凸泛函的数学证明。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GETV在灰度图像和彩色图像去噪任务上优于扩展各向异性扩散（EAD）和标准全变分（TV）等先进方法。
AI.conclusion: GETV作为一种凸的张量型全变分模型，既具备可形式化推导的优势，又在去噪性能上优于现有方法，是一种有竞争力的图像去噪变分方案。

title: LightNav-0: Eliciting VLM Spatial Intelligence for Generalist Embodied Navigation
summary: Embodied navigation requires agents to translate heterogeneous goals and visual observations into actions across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments. Modern vision-language models (VLMs) already encode spatial priors for visual grounding, spatial reasoning, and pointing, but these capabilities are rarely elicited directly for robot control. Existing navigation systems instead rely on task- or embodiment-specific components, fragmenting perception, reasoning, and action while offering limited generalization. Here we present LightNav-0, a compact generalist embodied navigation model that elicits the spatial intelligence of a pretrained VLM and aligns it with navigation, without task-specific prediction heads. LightNav-0 represents diverse navigation tasks through a unified token interface: dual-channel pointing expresses task-, scene-, and embodiment-agnostic spatial intent, while a residual vector-quantized action tokenizer maps this intent to precise, embodiment-specific trajectories. Together with temporally aware visual history compression, ER mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, this formulation supports instruction following, open-vocabulary object navigation, and visual tracking within a single model. The navigation training corpus spans 2K+ scenes and 4K+ hours of embodied navigation data. LightNav-ER, the embodied-reasoning checkpoint used to initialize LightNav-0, attains the highest complete-set average across 8 embodied-reasoning benchmarks, while LightNav-0 achieves state-of-the-art monocular success rates across all 10 public navigation simulation settings. Real-world evaluations further demonstrate zero-shot generalization across robot embodiments, diverse scenes, and static and dynamic targets. These results establish compact VLMs as a unified and transferable backbone for generalist embodied navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LightNav-0，一个紧凑的通用具身导航模型，通过统一的token接口（双通道指向+残差矢量量化动作分词器）激发预训练VLM的空间智能，无需任务特定的预测头，即可在单一模型中支持指令跟随、开放词汇目标导航和视觉追踪，并在10个公开导航仿真设置和真实世界实验中达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有具身导航系统依赖任务或体态特定的组件，将感知、推理和行动割裂，泛化能力有限。尽管现代VLM已具备空间先验（视觉定位、空间推理、指向），但这些能力很少被直接用于机器人控制，缺乏统一且可迁移的导航骨干模型。
AI.method: LightNav-0采用统一token接口：双通道指向表达任务/场景/体态无关的空间意图，残差矢量量化动作分词器将意图映射为精确的体态特定轨迹；结合时间感知的视觉历史压缩、具身推理（ER）中期训练、监督微调和强化学习。训练语料涵盖2000+场景和4000+小时的具身导航数据。
AI.result: LightNav-ER在8个具身推理基准上取得最高完整集平均值；LightNav-0在全部10个公开导航仿真设置中达到单目成功率最先进水平；真实世界评估展示了跨机器人体态、多样场景以及静态和动态目标的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明紧凑VLM可以作为通用具身导航的统一且可迁移的骨干模型，通过激发预训练VLM的空间智能并结合精心设计的对齐机制，能够实现跨任务、环境和机器人体态的通用导航能力。

title: Clustering as Approximation by Constrained Projectors: Theory and Guarantees
summary: This paper develops a unified theoretical framework showing that a broad family of clustering methods, including k-means, fuzzy c-means, kernel k-means, kernel FCM, and spectral clustering, can all be expressed as structured low-rank projectors acting on a signal-derived matrix. By formulating each method as an instance of min over B in C of ||M - M P_B||_F^2, with different constraint sets C, we establish a common optimization template that clarifies the algebraic links among hard, fuzzy, kernel-induced, and orthonormal projections. Within this framework, we derive non-trivial theoretical results, including geodesic convexity properties on the projection manifold, perturbation bounds quantifying stability to matrix noise, and exact recovery guarantees under ideal block-model conditions. The analysis further explains when different clustering families collapse to the same optimal subspace and how deviations arise under small inter-cluster leakage. Overall, the work provides a coherent, theory-first foundation for understanding clustering through structured projectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的理论框架，表明包括k-means、模糊c-means、核k-means、核FCM和谱聚类在内的广泛聚类方法都可以表示为作用于信号衍生矩阵上的结构化低秩投影算子。通过统一的优化模板min||M - M P_B||²_F，并结合不同的约束集，建立了硬聚类、模糊聚类、核诱导和正交投影之间的代数联系，并导出了测地线凸性、扰动界和精确恢复保证等理论结果。
AI.motivation: 现有各种聚类方法（k-means、模糊c-means、核方法、谱聚类等）在表面上形式各异，缺乏一个统一的数学框架来解释它们之间的内在联系和差异根源。作者希望建立一个理论优先的统一视角，以澄清这些方法在代数层面的共性，并为理解和分析聚类方法的稳定性、恢复性能提供基础。
AI.method: 作者将所有聚类方法统一建模为 min_{B∈C} ||M - M P_B||²_F 的优化问题，其中M为信号衍生矩阵，P_B为结构化低秩投影算子，C为不同的约束集。通过分析不同的约束集（硬、模糊、核诱导、正交）来统一各种聚类方法，并在投影流形上研究测地线凸性、推导扰动界以及块模型条件下的精确恢复保证。
AI.result: 建立了统一优化模板，推导了投影流形上的测地线凸性性质，给出了量化矩阵噪声稳定性的扰动界，并在理想块模型条件下证明了精确恢复保证。此外，解释了不同聚类族在何种条件下收敛到同一最优子空间，以及聚类间小泄漏时偏差如何产生。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解基于结构化投影算子的聚类提供了一个连贯的、理论优先的基础框架，揭示了不同聚类家族之间的代数联系，并为聚类方法的理论分析提供了统一工具。

title: Dynamic-Robust Photometric-Semantic Reconstruction for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: The integration of novel view synthesis (NVS) and open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) has recently yielded powerful feed-forward 3D foundation models. However, their inherent reliance on static-scene assumptions leads to severe misalignment of spatial features in unconstrained dynamic environments. To bridge this critical gap, we propose SPAR, a novel joint semantic-geometric encoding architecture that explicitly isolates transient dynamic noise prior to latent space aggregation. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic-region-aware end-to-end training paradigm that structurally couples motion estimation with multi-view visual and semantic learning. This unified approach enables the network to inherently resolve motion conflicts and distill multi-view consistent, temporally stable scene representations from dynamic inputs. Extensive experiments on the challenging D-RE10K benchmark demonstrate that SPAR achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our end-to-end approach achieves exceptional novel view synthesis quality, yielding a PSNR of 22.15 dB and 23.33 dB given only 3 and 4 input views respectively. Despite being trained in a self-supervised manner, our model achieves an mIoU of 88.5% for motion mask prediction. Furthermore, our analysis reveals a strong inter-task synergy between photometric scene reconstruction and semantic understanding, where semantic synthesis learning consistently enhances photometric fidelity in novel view rendering. Code will be available at https://github.com/dmucby/SPAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPAR，一个联合语义-几何编码架构，在潜空间聚合前显式隔离瞬态动态噪声，并通过动态区域感知的端到端训练范式，将运动估计与多视图视觉和语义学习结构性耦合，从而在动态环境中实现高质量的新视图合成和开放词汇分割。
AI.motivation: 现有的新视图合成与开放词汇分割的集成方法（前馈3D基础模型）依赖于静态场景假设，在不受约束的动态环境中会导致空间特征严重错位，无法正确处理场景中的运动物体。
AI.method: 1) 提出SPAR联合语义-几何编码架构，在潜空间聚合前显式隔离瞬态动态噪声；2) 引入动态区域感知的端到端训练范式，将运动估计与多视图视觉、语义学习进行结构性耦合，使网络能够内在地解决运动冲突。
AI.result: 在D-RE10K基准上取得SOTA性能：仅用3个和4个输入视图分别达到22.15 dB和23.33 dB的PSNR；自监督训练下运动掩码预测mIoU达88.5%；并发现语义合成学习能持续提升新视图渲染的光度保真度，表现出强任务协同效应。
AI.conclusion: SPAR通过显式建模动态干扰并与语义学习端到端结合，首次统一了动态场景下的新视图合成与开放词汇分割，并揭示了光度重建与语义理解之间的正向协同关系，为动态环境下3D基础模型提供了新方向。

title: Autonomously Acquiring Robot Manipulation Skills with Language-Driven Quality-Diversity
summary: Quality-diversity (QD) algorithms have been gaining traction in robot learning, where diverse motion primitive libraries allow robots to adapt zero-shot to constraints at deployment time. However, such methods typically require expert designers to write the success condition, fitness and diversity metrics, and this strongly limits the robot's autonomy. On the other hand, existing LLM-based reward-shaping techniques allow robots to learn autonomously but only output single high-performing solutions, limiting the robot's adaptability. In this paper, we propose an approach designed to output diverse motion primitive archives by autonomously leveraging quality-diversity algorithms, only requiring a free-form description of the task in common language. To address the difficulty of designing relevant fitness and diversity metrics, we propose an autonomous exploration mechanism able to reliably output sets of functionals covering the fitness and behavior descriptor (BD) space. First, we pose policy exploration as a functional design problem, where the functional spaces are lower-dimensional than the full BD and fitness spaces, and propose an LLM-based exploration scheme to sample from these low-dimensional spaces without any task-specific prompts, fine-tuning or expert intervention. We adapt a multi-BD variant of the MAP-Elites success (MES) algorithm, designed to leverage the heterogeneous BD samples. Finally, through experiments based on the genesis simulator, we show that our method effectively generates archives of diverse motion primitives, outperforming classical QD algorithms with inferred and hand-written parametrizations on a set of $4$ robotic manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用LLM自主设计质量-多样性（QD）算法的适应度与行为描述符（BD）指标的方法，仅需任务的自然语言描述即可输出多样化的运动原语库，无需专家手动设计或任务特定提示。
AI.motivation: QD算法在机器人学习中能生成多样化的运动原语库，使机器人能零样本适应部署时的约束，但传统方法需要专家手动设计成功条件、适应度和多样性指标，严重限制了机器人的自主性。而现有的LLM奖励塑造技术虽能自主学习但只输出单一高性能解，限制了适应性。
AI.method: 1) 将策略探索形式化为功能设计问题，利用功能空间维度低于完整BD和适应度空间的特性；2) 提出基于LLM的探索机制，从低维功能空间中采样，无需任务特定提示、微调或专家干预；3) 采用多BD变体的MAP-Elites成功（MES）算法，以利用异构的BD样本。
AI.result: 在基于Genesis模拟器的4个机器人操作任务上，该方法能有效生成多样化运动原语档案，并且在推断和手写参数化设置下均优于经典QD算法。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM自主设计功能指标并结合多BD的MAP-Elites算法，可以在仅需自然语言任务描述的情况下实现高质量、多样化的机器人运动原语生成，显著提升了机器人学习的自主性和适应性。

title: Emergent Misalignment Is Not Magical
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on narrowly harmful datasets can lead to misalignment broadly, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). EM poses a challenge for AI safety and our understanding of LLMs. Prior work often frames EM as an unexpected behavior, and explains it by appealing to general misalignment directions or anthropomorphizing it as acquiring an evil persona. However, the mechanisms behind these framings remain obscure. In this work, we show that EM is a predictable and data-dependent generalization phenomenon. By examining the base model's representation of EM training data and evaluation prompts, we find that evilness after EM training is highly predictable from representational distance: the closer an evaluation prompt is to training data centroid, the more evilness it elicits from EM models after training (with an average Spearman correlation of -0.73 across 12 model-dataset settings). Building upon this analysis, we further demystify EM by showing that (1) its effectiveness changes significantly based on training data format; (2) there is not a general misalignment direction that transfers across different EM models; (3) the effect of EM is fundamentally different from persona changes. Furthermore, we extend the EM generalization metric from a scalar distance to a dataset-specific generalization direction, which robustly predicts EM models' evilness under semantics-preserving prompt perturbations including appending random tokens and paraphrasing, where other methods do not reliably generalize.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对基础模型表征的分析，揭示了"涌现性错位"（EM）是一种可预测且依赖数据的泛化现象：评估提示与训练数据质心的表征距离越近，EM模型表现出的"恶意"程度越高（平均Spearman相关系数为-0.73）。研究进一步拆解了EM的神秘性，并提出了一个数据集特定的泛化方向来稳健预测EM模型的恶意程度。
AI.motivation: 前期研究通常将EM视为意外行为，并诉诸于"一般性错位方向"或"邪恶人格"来解释，但这些框架背后的机制仍然模糊不清。作者旨在用一个更科学、可量化的视角来理解EM，揭示其本质是可预测的数据依赖的泛化现象，而非神秘或偶然的事件。
AI.method: 通过检查基础模型对EM训练数据和评估提示的表征，计算评估提示到训练数据质心的表征距离来预测EM模型的恶意程度（Spearman相关性）。同时，通过改变训练数据格式、检验跨模型的错位方向迁移、对比人格变化效应来系统拆解EM的本质。最后，将泛化度量从标量距离扩展为数据集特定的泛化方向，在语义保持的提示扰动下验证其预测稳健性。
AI.result: （1）EM后模型的恶意程度与评估提示到训练数据中心的表征距离密切相关（平均Spearman相关系数为-0.73，覆盖12个模型-数据集设置）；（2）EM效果随训练数据格式变化显著；（3）不存在跨EM模型通用的"错位方向"；（4）EM效果与人格变化有本质区别；（5）提出数据集特定的泛化方向，能在随机令牌追加和释义等语义保持扰动下稳健预测恶意程度，优于其他方法。
AI.conclusion: 涌现性错位并非不可预测的神秘现象，而是一种可量化的、数据依赖的泛化行为。这种理解不仅帮助拆解EM的机制，还为评估和预测EM模型在不同条件下的行为提供了更稳健的工具，对AI安全具有重要意义。

title: Foundational feature fusion for conditional flow matching in 6D pose estimation
summary: Conditional flow matching has enabled a step forward in object 6D pose estimation, achieving state-of-the-art performance by progressively denoising and registering object representations to observed scenes. Existing methods require training task-specific encoders supervised on object-scene overlap and rely on trivial feature fusion strategies to resolve pose ambiguities. We present FunFlow6D, a novel flow matching-based formulation that leverages features from geometric and appearance foundation models for pose estimation, eliminating the need for task-specific encoder training. We also introduce a cross attention-based fusion mechanism that dynamically combines geometric and appearance features to provide richer conditioning for the flow matching module. Experiments on four datasets from the BOP benchmark show that FunFlow6D outperforms the previous state of the art while reducing supervision requirements and memory overhead. Extensive ablations validate the contribution of each proposed component. Project website: https://tev-fbk.github.io/FunFlow6D/.

AI.tldr: FunFlow6D 提出了一种基于条件流匹配的6D物体姿态估计方法，利用几何和外观基础模型的特征，无需训练任务特定的编码器，并通过交叉注意力机制动态融合特征，在BOP基准的四个数据集上超越现有最优方法，同时降低监督需求和内存开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于条件流匹配的6D姿态估计方法需要训练任务特定的编码器来监督物体-场景重叠，并且依赖简单的特征融合策略来解决姿态模糊问题，这增加了训练复杂度且难以充分利用多模态信息。
AI.method: 提出FunFlow6D框架：(1) 利用几何和外观基础模型的特征进行姿态估计，无需任务特定的编码器训练；(2) 引入基于交叉注意力的融合机制，动态结合几何与外观特征，为流匹配模块提供更丰富的条件信息。
AI.result: 在BOP基准的四个数据集上的实验表明，FunFlow6D超越了之前的最先进方法，同时减少了监督需求和内存开销；大量消融实验验证了每个组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: FunFlow6D证明了利用基础模型特征配合交叉注意力融合机制可以有效提升流匹配框架下的6D姿态估计性能，在降低训练成本的同时实现更优精度。

title: DARP: A Calibrated Dual-Arm RGB-D-IR Dataset for Multi-View Robotic Perception
summary: Robotic perception from a single viewpoint is often limited by self-occlusion and incomplete surface visibility. This paper presents DARP(Dual-Arm Robotic Perception) https://doi.org/10.21227/rmv3-be47, a calibrated dual-arm RGB-D-IR dataset for object-centered robotic perception using two independently moving eye-in-hand manipulators positioned on opposite sides of a shared tabletop workspace. Each arm carries an Intel RealSense sensor that continuously records RGB, depth, and stereo infrared data while synchronized robot joint states are logged for pose recovery. Objects are placed without fixed poses or marked locations, and the acquisition procedure performs automatic localization, cross-arm confirmation, adaptive viewpoint generation, and continuous multimodal recording. DARP contains ten unique tabletop objects and preserves the original sensor recordings, robot-state logs, object-level metadata, and calibration information required to reconstruct camera trajectories in a shared metric frame. To evaluate the geometric consistency of the acquisition, we implement a deterministic multi-view fusion pipeline that converts calibrated RGB-D observations into complementary partial point clouds and measured surface meshes without using learned or generative completion methods. Evaluation on 224 held-out RGB-D keyframes comprising 1,563,466 three-dimensional query points yields a median point-to-mesh distance of 2.13~mm and an RMSE of 4.04~mm, with 96.56\% of points within 10~mm of the measured-surface mesh. DARP is intended as a reusable resource for multi-view reconstruction, collaborative robotic perception, multimodal fusion, active perception, and future learning-based reasoning over partial object observations.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DARP（双臂机器人感知）数据集，利用两个独立运动的眼在手式机械臂（各搭载Intel RealSense传感器）从对侧视角同时采集RGB-D-IR多模态数据，用于以物体为中心的机器人感知。数据集包含10个桌面物体，并提供标定信息、机器人状态日志和原始传感器记录。通过确定性多视图融合管线评估，在224个关键帧、156万+查询点上达到中位点-网格距离2.13mm、RMSE 4.04mm的几何一致性。
AI.motivation: 单视角机器人感知受限于自遮挡和不完整表面可见性，现有数据集缺乏支持双臂协同、多模态融合和主动感知的标定双目数据集，因此需要构建一个可复用的双臂眼在手式感知资源。
AI.method: 构建标定的双臂RGB-D-IR数据集：两臂各搭载RealSense传感器位于共享桌面工作台对侧；物体无固定位姿放置；采集流程包含自动定位、双臂交叉确认、自适应视角生成和连续多模态记录；提供标定信息与机器人状态日志以重建共享度量坐标系下的相机轨迹；使用确定性多视图融合管线（非学习方法）生成互补点云和实测表面网格进行评估。
AI.result: 在224个保留RGB-D关键帧、1,563,466个三维查询点上，中位点-网格距离为2.13mm，RMSE为4.04mm，96.56%的点位于实测表面网格10mm以内，验证了采集的几何一致性。
AI.conclusion: DARP作为可复用资源，适用于多视图重建、协作机器人感知、多模态融合、主动感知以及基于部分物体观测的未来学习推理研究。

title: Beyond Correctness: Validity-Oriented Evaluation of Biomedical LLM Judges
summary: We propose a scalable, validity-oriented pipeline for evaluating biomedical LLM judges when high-quality human judgments are scarce. First, we augment existing human-labelled biomedical benchmarks with deterministic, metric-grounded mutations that produce auditable preference pairs. Second, we evaluate judges beyond aggregate correctness using three deployment-relevant dimensions: correctness against metric-derived gold labels, robustness under repeated stochastic sampling, and compliance with the requested output format. We use this pipeline to assess Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct under four regimes: (1) base, using the instruct model as is; (2) SFT, distillation-based supervised fine-tuning only; (3) RL, GRPO-based reinforcement learning only; and (4) SFT$\rightarrow$RL, SFT followed by RL. The base and single-stage regimes struggle on structured medical discrimination such as PICO extraction and clinical calculations, whereas SFT$\rightarrow$RL performs best across correctness, compliance, and robustness; gains concentrate on decomposable tasks (PICO, MedCalc), at times matching or outperforming frontier models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展的、以效度为导向的流水线，用于在高质量人工标注稀缺的情况下评估生物医学LLM评判器。通过确定性、基于度量的突变增强现有基准生成可审计的偏好对，并从正确性、鲁棒性和格式合规性三个部署维度评估模型。实验表明SFT→RL组合训练在结构化医学判别任务上表现最佳，甚至部分超越前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 高质量人工标注的生物医学评判数据稀缺，且现有评估仅关注聚合正确性，忽略了部署相关维度（如鲁棒性和格式合规性），导致对LLM评判器的评估不够全面和效度不足。
AI.method: 采用两阶段流水线：(1) 用确定性、基于度量的突变增强现有带人工标注的生物医学基准，生成可审计的偏好对；(2) 从三个部署维度评估：与度量派生金标的正确性、重复随机采样下的鲁棒性、请求输出格式的合规性。评估Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在四种训练机制下的表现：基础、SFT、RL（GRPO）、SFT→RL。
AI.result: 基础模型和单阶段训练在PICO提取和临床计算等结构化医学判别任务上表现不佳；SFT→RL在所有维度（正确性、合规性、鲁棒性）上表现最佳，优势集中在可分解任务（PICO、MedCalc）上，有时能达到甚至超越前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: SFT→RL组合训练范式对生物医学LLM评判器的提升最为有效，尤其在结构化、可分解的医学任务上；该流水线为稀缺人工标注场景下的评判器评估提供了可扩展、高效度的解决方案。

title: Multi-Scale Temporal Domain Alignment for Federated Video Domain Adaptation
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Open-source will be available
summary: Federated Video Domain Adaptation (FVDA) enables collaborative learning across distributed and non-IID video datasets while preserving privacy, but is under-explored due to challenges in aligning temporal information. We propose Multi-scalE Temporal domAin aLignment (METAL), a novel framework that leverages temporal information at multiple resolutions to improve cross-domain video action recognition with only model parameter transfers. METAL trains per-scale transformer encoders on source-clients, then performs independent knowledge voting at each temporal scale to generate robust pseudo-labels on the target-server. A novel $L_2$ variance penalty enforces cross-scale consistency during scale-based knowledge distillation, preventing a singular dominant scale. The late fusion aggregates features across different scales, where the fusion head is trained via knowledge distillation using confidence-weighted aggregation of scale-wise predictions, enabling the model to effectively exploit complementary temporal information for final predictions. Experiments on Epic-Kitchens-55 and Daily-DA demonstrate state-of-the-art performances, with gains up to 28.47% over current FDA methods. Ablation studies prove that multi-scale distillation and scale coordination are critical for effective temporal knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出了METAL框架，通过多尺度时间域对齐来解决联邦视频域适应（FVDA）中的时间信息对齐难题，在仅传输模型参数的情况下实现跨域视频动作识别，并在Epic-Kitchens-55和Daily-DA数据集上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 联邦视频域适应（FVDA）允许分布式非独立同分布视频数据集上的协作学习，同时保护隐私，但由于时间信息对齐的挑战而研究不足。现有方法未能有效处理视频中不同时间分辨率下的域差异。
AI.method: METAL包含四个关键组件：(1) 在源客户端上训练多尺度transformer编码器；(2) 在每个时间尺度上执行独立知识投票以生成目标服务器上的鲁棒伪标签；(3) 引入L2方差惩罚项在执行基于尺度的知识蒸馏时强制跨尺度一致性，防止单一主导尺度；(4) 通过知识蒸馏进行晚期融合，使用置信度加权的尺度级预测聚合来训练融合头。
AI.result: 在Epic-Kitchens-55和Daily-DA数据集上达到最先进性能，相比当前FDA方法提升高达28.47%。消融实验证明多尺度蒸馏和尺度协调对有效的时间知识迁移至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度时间域对齐是解决联邦视频域适应的有效途径，通过跨尺度一致性和置信度加权的晚期融合，能够充分利用互补的时间信息实现更好的跨域视频动作识别。

title: SUN: Persistent Programs For Language-Grounded Control-to-Learning-to-Real Policies
summary: Bridging model-based control and learned policies in long-horizon manipulation has harbored a silent disagreement: control executes specified objectives, learning amortizes that behavior into a reactive policy, yet existing protocols discard task semantics, leaving rewards hand-crafted and behavior drifting from what control verified.We introduce Semantically UNified (SUN) Programs, typed executables where geometric and contact relations are defined once and compiled into aligned Model Predictive Control (MPC) costs, satisfaction predicates, RL rewards, transition guards, and diagnostics. Our system, Kuafu, driven by large vision language systems, automatically synthesizes SUN Programs from language and scene semantics, screens feasibility via MPC, and retains semantics while training stage-conditioned policies. Across nine tasks, Kuafu achieves 82.03% macro-success, outperforming sparse-reward (35.67%) and Stage-BC (24.75%) baselines. At 8192-way scale, it generates 10.57x the successful trajectory time per hour of human teleoperation. With 500 trajectories per task, Kuafu data trains DP3 policies to 46.0% simulation success (vs. 22.4% for alternatives) and 34.7% on physical Franka and Kinova robots. These results establish that simulation-screened task semantics can effectively amortize control into robust policies, without demonstrations or manual dense rewards, unifying symbolic planning and data-driven execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Semantically UNified (SUN) Programs——一种统一的类型化可执行程序，将几何与接触关系定义为单一来源，并自动编译为MPC成本、满足谓词、RL奖励、转换守护和诊断。基于此构建的Kuafu系统借助大型视觉语言系统，从语言和场景语义自动合成SUN程序，通过MPC筛选可行性，并保留语义训练阶段条件策略。在九个任务上，Kuafu达到82.03%的宏成功率，超越稀疏奖励(35.67%)和Stage-BC(24.75%)基线，且在数据生成规模、模拟训练和真实机器人部署上均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有长期操纵任务中，基于模型的控制与学习策略之间存在语义鸿沟：控制执行指定目标，而学习方法将这些行为摊销为反应式策略，但现有协议丢弃了任务语义，导致奖励需手工设计且行为偏离控制已验证的轨迹。
AI.method: 提出SUN Programs作为统一语义表示，将几何与接触关系定义为单一来源，自动编译为MPC成本、满足谓词、RL奖励、转换守护和诊断等多种下游组件。Kuafu系统利用大型视觉语言模型从语言和场景语义自动合成SUN程序，经MPC可行性筛选后，保留语义信息训练阶段条件的策略。
AI.result: 在九个任务上达到82.03%宏成功率，优于稀疏奖励(35.67%)和Stage-BC(24.75%)基线。在8192路规模下，每小时人工遥操作可生成10.57倍的成功轨迹时间。每条任务500条轨迹训练DP3策略，模拟成功率46.0%（对比基线22.4%），物理Franka和Kinova机器人上达到34.7%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 经模拟筛选的任务语义能够有效地将控制摊销为稳健策略，无需演示或人工密集奖励，实现了符号规划与数据驱动执行的统一，弥合了模型控制与学习策略之间的鸿沟。

title: APIFlow-Bench: Measuring Whether Agents Survive Long, Dependent API Workflows
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures. Under review at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Evaluation of Interactive Agents (IAEval). Harness, frozen task bank, and 44,362 execution transcripts: https://github.com/postmanlabs/APIFlow-Bench
summary: Tool-using agents are commonly evaluated by a single bit: whether an end-to-end workflow completed. This metric fails to distinguish failures that matter in production, such as expired credentials, malformed payloads, or correct execution followed by incorrect final delivery. We introduce APIFlow-Bench, a fully auditable benchmark for long-horizon, dependent REST-API workflows that decomposes performance into seven engineering capabilities and requires agents to produce answers supported by the actual call path. We generate synthetic API worlds forward, subtask by subtask; each subtask is admitted only after a zero-LLM self-test triad verifies its grader and an oracle establishes solvability, and an adversarial audit identified and fixed six grader exploits. Grading is deterministic and provenance-sensitive: a state check traces a mock-minted canary through the API data flow to the response the answer must originate from, and a typed answer card is verified field by field. We release all answer keys and 44,362 unredacted execution transcripts. Across 19 frontier and open-weight models under one neutral scaffold, we find: (1) longer dependency chains degrade success, from 93% on individual subtasks to 74% on clean 20-subtask chains and 61% when including the 8% of chain trials that a model-consensus screen flags as passed by no model; (2) reliability separates models more than best-case capability, with best-of-five spanning seven points but all-five-of-five reliability spanning 44 points; (3) the independent-error account of compounding failure does not fit the data: pass rates on 20-subtask chains are 33 percentage points above the product of subtask-level rates, and on the clean slice 77% of failing runs reached the correct final state and failed only at delivery.

AI.tldr: APIFlow-Bench 是一个用于评估长周期、依赖型 REST-API 工作流智能体的可审计基准，它将性能分解为七项工程能力，并要求模型提供由实际调用路径支撑的答案。基准采用合成 API 世界、确定性且溯源敏感的分级机制，并发布了 44,362 份未删减的执行记录。实验表明：长依赖链降低成功率、可靠性比最佳能力更能区分模型、独立错误假设无法解释复合失败现象。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用智能体的评估仅用单一比特（端到端工作流是否完成）来衡量，无法区分生产中重要的失败类型（如凭证过期、格式错误、执行正确但最终交付错误），因此需要更细粒度、可审计的评估基准。
AI.method: (1) 前向生成合成 API 世界，逐子任务构建；(2) 每个子任务需通过零-LLM 自测三元组（graders 检查 + oracle 验证可解性），对抗性审计修复了六个 grader 漏洞；(3) 分级确定且溯源敏感：状态检查通过 mock-minted canary 追踪 API 数据流到答案来源，类型化答案卡逐字段验证；(4) 在统一脚手架下评估 19 个前沿与开放权重模型。
AI.result: (1) 更长依赖链降低成功率：单子任务 93%，干净 20 子任务链 74%，含 8% 无模型通过的一致筛选链后为 61%；(2) 可靠性比最佳能力更能区分模型：最佳五次跨度为 7 个点，而五次全部通过跨度为 44 个点；(3) 独立错误假设不成立：20 子任务链通过率比子任务率乘积高 33 个百分点，干净切片中 77% 的失败运行到达了正确的最终状态但仅在交付环节失败。
AI.conclusion: 评估工具使用智能体需要超越单一的成功比特，分解为多维度工程能力指标；模型间的可靠性差异远大于最佳能力差异；复合失败不能简单归因于独立错误累积，交付环节是关键失败来源，未来评估应关注溯源与交付可靠性。

title: OPUS-V2: Bridging the Gap between Sparse Points and Dense Voxels
summary: The point-based occupancy prediction paradigm has achieved an attractive trade-off between accuracy and efficiency by modeling 3D space sparsely. However, its predictions inherently mismatch the dense voxel-based occupancy required by self-driving systems, necessitating hand-crafted heuristics during training and inference that limit final performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose OPUS-V2, a novel framework built upon the pioneering OPUS (occupancy prediction using a sparse set) point-based approach. OPUS-V2 incorporates a lightweight point-voxel transformation (PVT) module behind the decoder to adaptively map sparse predictions into the dense voxel space, eliminating the need for suboptimal operations and improving model accuracy. Furthermore, our architecture decouples feature and occupancy generation processes, allowing OPUS-V2 to adapt to arbitrary occupancy resolutions. OPUS-V2 achieves a state-of-the-art rayIoU of 44.0 on the Occ3D dataset. On the more challenging OpenOccupancy dataset, it attains a competitive 16.4 mIoU while running in real time at 20.6 FPS.

AI.tldr: OPUS-V2是基于点级稀疏占用预测框架的改进版本，通过引入轻量级点-体素变换（PVT）模块，将稀疏预测自适应映射到密集体素空间，消除了手工启发式操作，并在Occ3D和OpenOccupancy数据集上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的点级占用预测虽在精度与效率间取得了良好平衡，但其稀疏预测与自动驾驶系统所需的密集体素占用存在本质不匹配，需要在训练和推理阶段依赖手工设计的启发式规则，这些操作次优且限制了最终性能。
AI.method: 1）在解码器后引入轻量级点-体素变换（PVT）模块，自适应地将稀疏预测映射到密集体素空间，消除次优手工操作；2）解耦特征生成与占用生成过程，使框架能够适应任意占用分辨率。
AI.result: 在Occ3D数据集上达到SOTA rayIoU 44.0；在更具挑战性的OpenOccupancy数据集上达到16.4 mIoU，同时以20.6 FPS实时运行。
AI.conclusion: OPUS-V2通过PVT模块和特征/占用解耦架构，成功弥合了点级稀疏预测与密集体素占用之间的鸿沟，在精度、效率和分辨率适应性方面均实现了显著提升。

title: More Perspectives, Stronger Signals: Multi-Perspective Enhancement and Progressive Fusion for Multimodal Entity Representation Learning
summary: Learning effective multimodal entity representations is fundamental for reasoning tasks such as multimodal knowledge graph completion (MMKGC). However, existing methods often suffer from semantic over-smoothing within modalities and ineffective noise filtration across modalities, particularly under sparse or ambiguous conditions. To overcome these limitations, we propose PrismF, a unified framework that synergizes multi-perspective enhancement with progressive fusion to extract stronger signals from diverse inputs. PrismF enhances fine-grained intra-modal semantics through a multi-perspective mechanism that decomposes each modality into complementary views and constrains them with a decoupling loss to reduce representation collapse. Furthermore, it improves cross-modal integration through a progressive fusion strategy that dynamically calibrates inter-modal interactions, enabling the model to emphasize informative signals while suppressing noisy or unreliable ones. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks show that PrismF achieves the strongest overall performance, including relative improvements of 4.04% in MRR and 11.17% in Hits@1 on KVC16K. Our code can be found at https://github.com/HubuKG/PrismF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrismF，一个统一框架，通过多视角增强（将每种模态分解为互补视角并用解耦损失防止表征坍缩）与渐进式融合（动态校准跨模态交互、抑制噪声）相结合，提升多模态知识图谱补全任务中的实体表征学习效果。在三个公开基准上取得最优性能，在KVC16K上相对提升MRR 4.04%和Hits@1 11.17%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态实体表征学习方法存在两类核心缺陷：一是模态内部语义过平滑（semantic over-smoothing），导致细粒度信息丢失；二是跨模态噪声过滤效果不佳，尤其在数据稀疏或模糊条件下，难以区分有效信号与噪声，影响多模态知识图谱补全（MMKGC）的性能。
AI.method: PrismF框架包含两大核心策略：（1）多视角增强机制：将每个模态分解为多个互补视角，并通过解耦损失（decoupling loss）约束这些视角，以减少表征坍缩，增强模态内细粒度语义。（2）渐进式融合策略：动态校准跨模态交互，使模型能够突出信息量大的信号，同时抑制噪声或不可靠信号。两者协同构成统一框架。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准数据集上进行广泛实验，PrismF取得最强综合性能，其中在KVC16K上MRR相对提升4.04%，Hits@1相对提升11.17%。
AI.conclusion: PrismF通过多视角增强与渐进式融合的协同设计，有效解决了多模态实体表征中的语义过平滑和跨模态噪声过滤问题，验证了该框架在多模态知识图谱补全任务中的优越性，并开源了代码供社区复现。

title: RLG-TPV: Radar- and LiDAR-Guided Tri-Perspective View Fusion for Camera-Radar 3D Object Detection
summary: Tri-Perspective View (TPV) representations describe 3D scene structure through top, side, and front feature planes, but existing TPV lifting is primarily camera-based, leaving the depth of sampled image evidence ambiguous along projected camera rays. We propose RLG-TPV, a multimodal TPV framework for camera-radar 3D object detection in which radar and training-time LiDAR provide complementary geometric guidance during representation construction. A ray-guided deformable-attention lift weights sampled image features using LiDAR-supervised camera depth probabilities and radar frustum occupancy, while radar additionally refines the depth distribution before lifting. Because conventional radar provides limited elevation information, LiDAR-derived class-occupancy targets supervise the side and front planes during training; the corresponding heads are removed at inference, so deployment requires only cameras and radar. For temporal aggregation, Doppler-guided temporal fusion aligns past features using a motion field anchored by measured radar radial velocity, with gating that limits warping in regions without supported motion. An RCS-aware radar scatter further allows radar evidence to spread over spatial neighborhoods conditioned on radar cross section. On the nuScenes validation set, RLG-TPV achieves 0.4981 mAP and 0.5959 NDS, reducing orientation and velocity error by 31.9\% and 30.7\% relative to the published CRN baseline. Ablation studies show that ray-level geometric guidance is a major contributor to the final performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLG-TPV，一种用于相机-雷达3D目标检测的多模态三视角视图（TPV）框架，通过LiDAR监督的深度概率和雷达视锥占用提供几何引导，并利用多普勒引导的时间融合和RCS感知的雷达散射提升检测性能。在nuScenes上达到0.4981 mAP和0.5959 NDS，推理时仅需相机和雷达。
AI.motivation: 现有TPV表示主要基于相机进行提升（lifting），导致沿投影光线采样的图像特征深度模糊不清，缺乏精确的几何引导。雷达和LiDAR作为补充传感器，可以提供互补的几何信息来缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 射线引导的可变形注意力提升：利用LiDAR监督的相机深度概率和雷达视锥占用加权采样图像特征；2) 雷达在提升前细化深度分布；3) LiDAR导出的类别占用目标监督侧平面和前平面（推理时移除对应头）；4) 多普勒引导的时间融合，利用雷达径向速度锚定运动场并门控翘曲；5) RCS感知的雷达散射，依据雷达散射截面积在空间邻域传播雷达证据。
AI.result: 在nuScenes验证集上达到0.4981 mAP和0.5959 NDS，相较于已发表的CRN基线，方位角误差降低31.9%，速度误差降低30.7%。消融实验表明射线级几何引导是性能提升的主要贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: RLG-TPV证明了雷达和训练时LiDAR提供的互补几何引导能显著提升TPV框架的3D检测性能，同时保持推理时仅需相机和雷达的部署优势。

title: Background-Free Objectness Learning for Class-Agnostic Detection
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: Object detectors are typically trained under closed-set supervision, where unlabeled regions are implicitly treated as background. Under incomplete annotations, this assumption introduces objectness bias: visually valid but unlabeled objects are used as negatives, tying objectness to the annotated taxonomy rather than generic object structure. This limitation is particularly problematic for class-agnostic and open-world detection. This paper proposes Background-Free Objectness Learning (B-FOR), a dense class-agnostic detection framework that learns objectness without explicit background supervision on unlabeled regions. B-FOR formulates detection as the prediction of dense multi-scale object-center and scale fields, from which object hypotheses emerge as local spatial structures. Supervision is confined to reliable annotated regions through spatially structured soft targets, avoiding foreground-background discrimination. To support decoding from emergent local maxima, the paper further introduces displacement-aware scale fields that model object extent as a spatially varying property of the learned objectness field. Experiments on PASCAL VOC, MS-COCO, and Open Images demonstrate strong generalization to unseen categories and cross-dataset object distributions. B-FOR improves recall by more than +10 AR points over prior class-agnostic baselines. Ablation studies show that both localized objectness supervision and displacement-aware scale fields are critical for class-agnostic localization under incomplete annotations. Code available at: https://github.com/Daniaawan/B-FOR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出B-FOR，一个无需背景监督的密集类无关检测框架。通过预测多尺度物体中心和尺度场，从局部空间结构中涌现物体假设，并在可靠标注区域上进行结构化软目标监督，避免前景-背景区分。实验在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO和Open Images上比先前类无关基线提升超过+10 AR点。
AI.motivation: 传统目标检测器在闭集监督下训练，将未标注区域隐式视为背景。在不完整标注下，这种假设引入物体性偏差：视觉上有效但未标注的物体被当作负样本，使物体性绑定到标注类别体系而非通用物体结构。这对类无关和开放世界检测尤为不利。
AI.method: B-FOR将检测重构为对密集多尺度物体中心和尺度场的预测，物体假设从局部空间结构中涌现。监督仅限定在可靠的标注区域，通过空间结构化的软目标实现，避免前景-背景判别。为支持从涌现局部最大值中解码，引入位移感知尺度场，将物体范围建模为物体性场的空间变化属性。
AI.result: 在PASCAL VOC、MS-COCO和Open Images上的实验表明，该方法对未见类别和跨数据集物体分布有很强的泛化能力，比先前的类无关基线在召回率上提升超过+10 AR点。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验表明，局部物体性监督和位移感知尺度场对于不完整标注下的类无关定位都是关键组件。代码已开源。

title: JudgePanel: A Compact Judge with Panel Deliberation via Adaptive Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: The LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable alternative to human evaluation. However, single-model judges are limited by their inherent model biases, while multi-agent evaluation protocols that mitigate this through diverse deliberation are prohibitively expensive at inference time. To this end, we propose \textbf{\modelname}, which equips a compact \underline{Judge} model with multi-agent \underline{Panel} deliberation capability. Specifically, we first train on panel deliberation traces from an ensemble of strong evaluators, capturing structured patterns of discussion, disagreement, and resolution. To further improve judgment quality beyond SFT, we introduce \textit{AdaReward}, an adaptive multi-reward RL algorithm that dynamically rebalances reward component weights as different objectives saturate at different rates during RL training. For practical deployment, we further design a lightweight domain specialization module for rapid adaptation to new evaluation domains with few hundred labeled samples. As a result, (i) \textit{Novel}: the first framework to equip a single compact judge with multi-agent panel deliberation capability at single-model inference cost; (ii) \textit{Effective \& Reliable}: JudgePanel with a 14B backbone outperforms judge-specialized models up to 70B across four evaluation benchmarks, demonstrates strong position consistency, and rapidly specializes to new domains with few hundred samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JudgePanel框架，通过将多智能体评审讨论能力蒸馏到一个紧凑（14B）的Judge模型中，在保持单模型推理成本的同时实现多智能体评审的可靠性，并引入AdaReward自适应多奖励RL算法和轻量级领域特化模块。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge范式虽然可扩展，但单模型评审受限于自身模型偏见；而多智能体评审协议虽能通过多样化讨论缓解偏见，但在推理时成本过高，难以实际部署。
AI.method: 1) 在多个强评估器的评审讨论轨迹上训练紧凑Judge模型，捕获讨论、分歧和解决的结构化模式；2) 提出AdaReward自适应多奖励RL算法，在RL训练中动态调整奖励分量权重以应对目标饱和速率差异；3) 设计轻量级领域特化模块，仅需几百个标注样本即可快速适应新评估领域。
AI.result: JudgePanel使用14B骨干模型，在四个评估基准上超越高达70B的评审专化模型，展现强位置一致性，并能以少量样本快速适应新领域。
AI.conclusion: JudgePanel是首个以单模型推理成本赋予紧凑Judge模型多智能体评审讨论能力的框架，兼具新颖性、有效性和实用性。

title: Bayesian-Optimized Superpixel-GrabCut for Traceable Optic Disc Segmentation
comment: Accepted at 15th International Conference on Image Processing Theory, Tools and Applications 2026
summary: Optic disc (OD) segmentation is essential for diagnosing ophthalmic pathologies from retinal fundus images. However, prevailing deep learning approaches operate as opaque black boxes, lacking the inference-stage mathematical traceability--a critical requirement for algorithmic auditing and failure analysis in clinical workflows. This paper presents a fully algorithmically traceable and trainable segmentation pipeline that jointly combines superpixel decomposition, hybrid brightness-proximity superpixel scoring, morphological regularization, iterative GrabCut refinement, and elliptical shape fitting. The hyperparameter optimization is formulated as an objective function and solved via Bayesian optimization to eliminate manual parameter tuning. A quantitative evaluation on the Drishti-GS dataset demonstrates that our method achieves a Dice coefficient of 0.9536, matching state-of-the-art performance. By maintaining explicit mathematical transparency across all processing stages, our framework offers a deterministic, traceable alternative to black-box architectures for medical review and debugging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种完全可算法追溯的可训练视盘分割流水线，结合超像素分解、混合亮度-邻近性超像素评分、形态学正则化、迭代GrabCut细化和椭圆形状拟合，通过贝叶斯优化自动调参，在Drishti-GS数据集上达到0.9536的Dice系数，与最先进方法相当，同时提供数学透明的可审计替代方案。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习视盘分割方法作为黑盒模型，缺乏推理阶段的数学可追溯性，而这对于临床工作流中的算法审计和故障分析至关重要。作者旨在提供一种既具有可追溯性又能达到先进性能的分割方案。
AI.method: 提出一个完全可追溯且可训练的分割流水线，包含五个核心阶段：超像素分解、基于亮度与邻近性的混合超像素评分、形态学正则化、迭代GrabCut精细化以及椭圆形状拟合。超参数优化被形式化为目标函数，通过贝叶斯优化求解，消除手动调参。
AI.result: 在Drishti-GS数据集上的定量评估表明，该方法达到0.9536的Dice系数，与最先进方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过在所有处理阶段保持明确的数学透明度，该框架为医学审查和调试提供了确定性的、可追溯的黑盒架构替代方案。

title: AGRICAM: A Track-Mounted Crop Pollination Monitoring Robot
summary: Insect pollination is critical for global food production, yet monitoring pollinators at commercial farm scale remains a challenge. Recent advances in computer vision and deep learning have enabled detailed analysis of pollinator behaviour, but monitoring must trade-off detail against spatial coverage and human or technological resources. This paper presents the Automated Guided Robot for Insect and Crop Activity Monitoring (AGRICAM), a purpose-built robotic system designed to meet the requirements of large-scale pollination monitoring in protected cropping systems. AGRICAM operates autonomously on low-cost, easily installed track for movement along crop rows, without disrupting farm operations or insect behaviour. The platform integrates two RGB cameras, microclimate sensors, GPS and RFID modules, motion sensors, and 4G cellular network connectivity for data transmission. A web interface enables remote device configuration and scheduling. The system autonomously captures video and image data of insects' locations and local environmental conditions. These are transferred to the cloud and analysed using computer vision models to quantify pollinator visitation and spatio-temporal activity variation. We deployed the system on a commercial blueberry farm to demonstrate and test its capability. It successfully mapped insect pollination patterns across 80 m long industrial polytunnels over 30 hours. This data enabled spatial analyses of insect activity we used to confirm a uniform pollinator distribution within polytunnels, as desired by the farm management team. The data also highlighted variation of insect activity associated with time of day and microclimate. AGRICAM therefore has been shown to be a scalable, automated crop pollination monitor that can support data-driven decisions to enhance pollination management, thereby improving crop productivity and food security.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AGRICAM，一个用于保护性栽培系统中大规模授粉监测的自主机器人系统。该系统在低成本轨道上自主运行，集成RGB相机、微气候传感器、GPS、RFID等设备，通过云端的计算机视觉模型量化传粉者活动。在商业蓝莓农场的部署证明其成功绘制了80米长工业隧道内30小时的昆虫授粉模式，确认了隧道内传粉者的均匀分布，并揭示了昆虫活动随时间与微气候的变化。
AI.motivation: 昆虫授粉对全球粮食生产至关重要，但在商业农场规模上监测传粉者仍然是一个挑战。现有的监测方法需要在细节与空间覆盖、人力与技术资源之间进行权衡，缺乏可扩展、自动化的解决方案来支持大规模授粉管理决策。
AI.method: AGRICAM是一种为保护性栽培系统设计的目的性机器系统：1) 在低成本、易安装的轨道上自主运行，不干扰农场作业或昆虫行为；2) 集成两个RGB相机、微气候传感器、GPS和RFID模块、运动传感器及4G蜂窝网络；3) 提供网页界面用于远程设备配置和调度；4) 自主捕获昆虫位置和局部环境条件的视频图像数据；5) 将数据传输到云端，使用计算机视觉模型量化传粉者访问和时空活动变化。
AI.result: 在商业蓝莓农场部署后，该系统成功绘制了80米长工业授粉隧道内30小时的昆虫授粉模式。数据分析确认了隧道内传粉者的均匀分布（符合农场管理团队的期望），并揭示了昆虫活动随时间变化及微气候相关的波动。
AI.conclusion: AGRICAM被证明是一种可扩展、自动化的作物授粉监测系统，能够支持数据驱动的决策以提升授粉管理，从而提高作物生产力和粮食安全。

title: An Explainable Coherence Score for Detecting Temporal Inconsistencies in Political News
summary: Temporal inconsistencies, such as mandates attributed outside their real interval, events presented as past before they occurred, or inverted causal sequences, are a form of political disinformation that evades style-based fake news detectors: a well-written article with a single wrong date carries no lexical signal of falsehood. This paper introduces the Temporal Coherence Score (TCS), a continuous, intrinsically interpretable metric that quantifies the temporal coherence of a news article, computed by a four-stage pipeline: extraction of temporal facts, construction of a temporal knowledge graph, hierarchical verification against internal consistency rules and external reference sources, and score aggregation with automatically generated explanations. Verification combines eight internal checkers derived from Allen's interval algebra with a five-level external hierarchy ranging from a locally stored reference knowledge base of 1{,}256 curated political facts to live Wikidata SPARQL queries. On a benchmark of 100 political news articles with injected temporal errors, the system reaches a precision of 0.909 at the selected operating threshold, with a single residual false positive, a profile deliberately tuned for human-in-the-loop fact-checking assistance, where false alarms are costlier than missed detections. Unlike lexical baselines that output only a binary label, every flagged article is accompanied by the inconsistency type, the entities involved, and the reference source that contradicts the claim.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时序一致性得分（TCS），一个连续且可解释的指标，用于量化新闻文章的时间一致性，通过四阶段管道检测政治虚假信息中的时间不一致性（如日期错误、因果倒置等），在100篇文章基准上达到0.909的精确率。
AI.motivation: 传统基于风格的假新闻检测器无法捕捉时间不一致性——一篇措辞良好但日期错误的文章不携带任何词法虚假信号。时间不一致（如时间区间外的授权、过去事件被描述为未来发生、因果序列倒置）是一种逃避现有检测器的政治虚假信息形式。
AI.method: 四阶段管道：(1) 提取时间事实；(2) 构建时间知识图谱；(3) 通过内部一致性规则（源自Allen区间代数的8个内部检查器）和外部参考源（5级外部层级，从本地1,256条策展政治事实的参考知识库到实时Wikidata SPARQL查询）进行分层验证；(4) 得分聚合并自动生成解释。
AI.result: 在100篇注入时间错误的新闻文章基准上，系统在选定操作阈值下达到0.909的精确率，仅有一个残留误报。系统被刻意调优用于人机协同事实核查场景，误报比漏检代价更高。
AI.conclusion: 与仅输出二分类标签的词法基线不同，每篇被标记的文章都附有：不一致类型、涉及的实体、以及与该主张矛盾的参考来源，从而提供可解释的、适合人工核查辅助的检测结果。

title: Ground-to-Satellite Localization in Unconstrained Image Collections for 3D Scene Reconstruction
comment: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Ground image localization with respect to satellite imagery is a key enabler for metrically-accurate, geo-localized 3D scene reconstruction from unconstrained image collections. Existing cross-view localization methods have strict requirements such as panoramic imagery or known initial locations, limiting their applicability for in-the-wild reconstruction settings. We propose a robust hierarchical cross-view localization framework that leverages geometric constraints from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) models derived from unconstrained ground image collections. Our method generates coarse-to-fine pose hypotheses through a cross-view matching approach and aggregates noisy predictions across SfM model(s) using Kernel Density Estimation to recover consensus alignments while filtering outliers. Experiments demonstrate reliable localization performance from challenging image collections. Empirically we found satellite-referenced alignment enables accurate metric scale estimation, doppelgänger detection, and merging of disjoint SfM reconstructions, resulting in more complete, geo-localized site models than are possible with SfM alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种鲁棒的层次化跨视角定位框架，利用从无约束地面图像集合中提取的SfM几何约束，实现地面图像与卫星影像的粗到精定位，并通过核密度估计聚合噪声预测以过滤离群值，从而支持度量尺度估计、重复场景检测和SfM重建合并。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角定位方法对全景图像或已知初始位置有严格要求，无法适用于野外无约束图像集合的三维重建场景，因此需要一种更通用的跨视角定位框架。
AI.method: 提出层次化跨视角定位框架：(1) 利用无约束地面图像集合的SfM模型提取几何约束；(2) 通过跨视角匹配生成粗到细的姿态假设；(3) 使用核密度估计（KDE）聚合多个SfM模型中的噪声预测，恢复一致的对齐结果并过滤离群值。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在具有挑战性的图像集合上实现了可靠的定位性能；卫星参考对齐还能实现准确的度量尺度估计、doppelgänger检测以及分离的SfM重建合并，生成比单独使用SfM更完整、更地理定位的站点模型。
AI.conclusion: 卫星参考对齐不仅能实现可靠定位，还能显著增强SfM重建的完整性和地理定位精度，为无约束图像集合的三维场景重建提供了可行方案。

title: Calibration and Comparative Analysis of Forward-Looking Sonar and 3D Sonar for Enhanced Underwater Object Recognition
summary: Sonars generate a significant amount of noise. With the advent of new technology capable of producing full 3D point clouds, the noise is amplified in sparse point clouds, making it challenging to recognize features for navigation, recognition, or reconstruction.
