To address this challenge, we propose using two different sonar modalities: one that produces a 2D intensity image and another that generates a 3D point cloud. By implementing auto-calibration, we can filter out noisy features between the modalities to enhance feature extraction. Experiments demonstrate that auto-calibration improves performance over manual calibration by 5% and that filtering enhances feature extraction by more than 40% relative to the raw point cloud. Code and datasets are given at https://theaprilab.org/fls-3d-calibrator

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用2D声纳强度图像与3D声纳点云两种模态，通过自动校准过滤噪声特征，以提升稀疏点云中的特征提取效果。实验表明自动校准比手动校准性能提升5%，过滤后的特征提取比原始点云提升超过40%。
AI.motivation: 声纳会产生大量噪声，尤其在新技术生成完整3D点云后，稀疏点云中的噪声被放大，导致导航、识别和重建中的特征识别变得困难。
AI.method: 采用两种不同的声纳模态：一种生成2D强度图像，另一种生成3D点云。通过实现自动校准（auto-calibration）来过滤两种模态之间的噪声特征，从而增强特征提取。
AI.result: 实验表明自动校准相比手动校准性能提升5%，过滤后的特征提取相比原始点云提升超过40%。
AI.conclusion: 融合2D强度图像与3D点云的自动校准和过滤方法，可有效提升声纳稀疏点云中的特征提取性能，且代码和数据集已公开。

title: How Identity and Opinion Shape Political Sycophancy in LLMs
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly encourage users to disclose personal profiles for tailored assistance, measuring their political alignment becomes increasingly important. However, many existing benchmarks for assessing political behavior rely on closed-ended questions and do not fully capture how a model's stance may adapt to user-provided context during interaction. We introduce a framework that disentangles two distinct triggers of political sycophancy: opinion (aligning with explicit narratives) and identity (stereotyping based on demographic labels). Using 450 manually-checked political dilemmas as controlled probes, we evaluate 13 instruction-tuned LLMs. We uncover a dissociation: a model's susceptibility to explicit opinions does not necessarily predict its susceptibility to identity cues, and vice versa. When both signals are present, their effects are generally sub-additive rather than simply additive. Additionally, system-level personas primarily shift a model's baseline stance while having limited effect on the stance shift caused by user opinion or identity. Ultimately, our results suggest that LLM political stance is interactively and steerably vulnerable rather than being a fixed trait, highlighting how personalization may amplify identity- or opinion-conditioned shifts in the model's behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个框架，用于解耦两种触发LLM政治谄媚行为的信号：观点对齐和身份刻板印象。通过450个手工检查的政治困境作为探针，评估了13个指令微调LLM，发现这两种信号的影响是可分离的且次加性的，系统级人格主要影响基线立场而非交互性立场偏移。
AI.motivation: 现有评估LLM政治行为的基准多依赖封闭式问题，未能充分捕捉模型立场如何适应用户提供的上下文。随着LLM越来越多地鼓励用户披露个人资料以提供定制化服务，衡量其政治对齐变得日益重要，但需要更细致地理解模型在不同交互情境下的政治立场变化机制。
AI.method: 构建了450个经过人工验证的政治困境作为受控探针，将政治谄媚行为解耦为两个维度：观点信号（与明确叙事保持一致）和身份信号（基于人口统计标签的刻板印象）。对13个指令微调LLM进行系统化评估，检验两种信号的影响及其交互效应，并考察系统级人格对基线立场和交互性立场偏移的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现观点信号和身份信号对模型政治立场的影响存在分离现象：模型对明确观点的敏感性不能预测其对身份线索的敏感性，反之亦然。当两种信号同时出现时，其效应通常呈次加性而非简单叠加。此外，系统级人格主要改变模型的基线立场，对用户观点或身份引起的立场偏移影响有限。
AI.conclusion: LLM的政治立场是交互性和可操纵性脆弱的，而非固定特征。个性化的应用可能会放大身份条件或观点条件下的行为偏移，这为评估和治理LLM政治行为提供了新的视角和框架。

title: SGPDFuse: Semantically-Guided Physics-Disentanglement General Multi-Modal Image Fusion
summary: Multimodal image fusion (MMIF) aims to integrate complementary sensor data into a single representation that preserves intrinsic scene reality while eliminating environmental interferences. Most existing approaches rely on blind feature aggregation, which excels at signal accumulation but fails to distinguish essential content from physical degradations. We propose SGPDFuse, which bridges this gap by mapping inputs into a physics-disentangled structural representation via a Semantic-Physical Parametric Bridge (SPPB) built on pretrained vision foundation models, utilizing the Intrinsic-Variation principle to decouple invariant scene attributes from transient environmental factors. To guide this decomposition, we introduce a Semantic Alignment mechanism: we explicitly anchor the fused representation to salient semantic features in the same foundation model feature space via cosine similarity to preserve critical targets, while enforcing physical texture fidelity through Gram-matrix regularization to strictly eliminate unnatural artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGPDFuse achieves state-of-the-art performance across infrared-visible, multi-focus, and multi-exposure benchmarks using a single architecture.

AI.tldr: SGPDFuse是一种基于物理解耦的多模态图像融合方法，通过语义-物理参数桥接和预训练视觉基础模型，将输入映射到物理解耦的结构化表示中，利用内在-变化原理分离不变场景属性与瞬态环境因素，并引入语义对齐机制（余弦相似度锚定语义特征+Gram矩阵正则化保证纹理保真度），在红外-可见光、多焦距和多曝光基准上以单一架构实现最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大多数多模态图像融合方法依赖盲特征聚合，擅长信号累积但无法区分本质内容与物理退化（如环境干扰、噪声等），需要一种能够显式解耦语义内容与物理退化因素的融合方法。
AI.method: 提出SGPDFuse框架，包括三个核心组件：(1) 语义-物理参数桥接（SPPB），基于预训练视觉基础模型将输入映射到物理解耦的结构化表示；(2) 内在-变化原则，用于解耦不变场景属性与瞬态环境因素；(3) 语义对齐机制，通过余弦相似度将融合表示锚定到基础模型特征空间中的显著语义特征以保留关键目标，并通过Gram矩阵正则化强制物理纹理保真度以消除人为伪影。
AI.result: SGPDFuse在红外-可见光、多焦点和多曝光三个基准数据集上均达到最先进的性能，且使用单一统一架构而非针对各任务定制。
AI.conclusion: 通过物理感知的语义解耦方法，SGPDFuse有效解决了传统融合方法中盲特征聚合无法区分关键内容与环境干扰的问题，证明了将物理先验与基础模型语义特征相结合的融合策略的有效性和通用性。

title: Proximity3D: Shape from Capacitive Proximity on Sensing Manifold
summary: Most shape reconstruction methods assume measurements defined over planar sensing domains, such as RGB images or depth maps. In this paper, we use a curved capacitive textile as a shape sensor, treating its surface as a non-planar sensing manifold. Each scan is represented as a capacitive proximity field on this manifold, induced by the interaction between the curved electrode layout and nearby object geometry. We introduce a multi-view feedforward reconstruction model that aggregates these fields across known sensor views and recovers the observed object shape. Simulated and physical experiments demonstrate robust reconstruction from capacitive proximity signals acquired on curved sensing surfaces, pointing toward a new route to robotic near-field geometric awareness via embodied sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用弯曲电容纺织物作为形状传感器，将其表面视为非平面感知流形，通过多视角前馈重建模型聚合电容近场信号来恢复物体形状，并在仿真和物理实验中验证了该方法的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统形状重建方法大多假设测量数据定义在平面感知域（如RGB图像或深度图）上，难以处理弯曲或非平面传感表面的情况，需要一种能够直接在弯曲传感流形上进行形状重建的新方法。
AI.method: 使用弯曲电容纺织物作为形状传感器，将其表面建模为非平面感知流形；每次扫描在流形上表示为电容近场，该场由弯曲电极布局与附近物体几何之间的相互作用产生；引入多视图前馈重建模型，在已知传感器视角间聚合这些场信号并恢复观测到的物体形状。
AI.result: 仿真与物理实验均表明，该方法能够从弯曲传感表面上采集的电容近场信号中实现鲁棒的物体形状重建。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为通过具身感知实现机器人近场几何感知开辟了新路径，展示了弯曲传感表面在形状重建任务中的可行性。

title: Benevolent Bias in Multi-Turn Human-Agent Dialogue
summary: Bias in human-agent interaction can manifest not only through hostile language but also as benevolent bias, whereby unequal treatment hides behind a warm, positive tone. To make it detectable, we operationalise benevolent bias along two dimensions, tone and treatment, yielding three classes: neutral support, overt bias, and benevolent bias. Building on these definitions, we construct BENEVDIAL, a class-balanced corpus of 362,880 multi-turn support dialogues spanning user and agent demographics, roles, and generators, to support controlled evaluation. We then test two detector families on it: off-the-shelf safety detectors and prompted large language model (LLM) judges. Our results reveal a detection gap: off-the-shelf detectors reliably flag overt bias yet largely miss benevolent bias, while LLM judges catch more under more explicit detection criteria but increasingly misclassify neutral support as benevolent bias, and demographic context amplifies the false alarms. These findings suggest that fair monitoring of human-agent dialogue must look beyond surface cues to whether the agent's treatment is disparate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究人机交互中的"善意偏见"（benevolent bias）——即以温暖积极语气掩盖的不平等对待。作者从语气和处理两个维度将其操作化为三类（中性支持、显性偏见、善意偏见），构建了包含362,880个多轮支持对话的平衡语料库BENEVDIAL，并测试了现成安全检测器和LLM裁判两类检测器，发现现有检测器存在明显检测缺口。
AI.motivation: 人机交互中的偏见不仅表现为敌意语言，还会以"善意偏见"的形式出现——即用温暖正面的语气掩盖不平等的对待方式。这种偏见更难被发现，现有检测方法通常只关注表面的敌意语言，无法识别这种隐蔽的偏见形式，因此需要对其进行操作化定义并开发检测方法。
AI.method: 作者首先从语气（tone）和处理（treatment）两个维度将善意偏见操作化为三个类别：中性支持（neutral support）、显性偏见（overt bias）和善意偏见（benevolent bias）。基于此定义，构建了BENEVDIAL语料库——一个包含362,880个多轮支持对话的类别平衡语料库，覆盖用户和智能体的不同人口统计特征、角色和生成器。然后测试了两类检测器：现成安全检测器和提示LLM裁判。
AI.result: 研究发现存在明显的检测缺口：现成安全检测器能可靠识别显性偏见，但大部分会漏掉善意偏见；LLM裁判在更明确的检测标准下能捕捉更多善意偏见，但会越来越多地将中性支持误分类为善意偏见，且人口统计背景信息会放大这种误报。
AI.conclusion: 对人机对话进行公平监控不能仅停留在表层线索，而必须深入判断智能体的处理方式是否存在差异性对待。现有检测器在识别善意偏见方面存在不足，需要开发更细致、能捕捉行为差异的检测方法。

title: Using Channel Representations in Regularization Terms: A Case Study on Image Diffusion
summary: In this work we propose a novel non-linear diffusion filtering approach for images based on their channel representation. To derive the diffusion update scheme we formulate a novel energy functional using a soft-histogram representation of image pixel neighborhoods obtained from the channel encoding. The resulting Euler-Lagrange equation yields a non-linear robust diffusion scheme with additional weighting terms stemming from the channel representation which steer the diffusion process. We apply this novel energy formulation to image reconstruction problems, showing good performance in the presence of mixtures of Gaussian and impulse-like noise, e.g. missing data. In denoising experiments of common scalar-valued images our approach performs competitive compared to other diffusion schemes as well as state-of-the-art denoising methods for the considered noise types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于通道表示的非线性扩散滤波方法，通过软直方图表示像素邻域并构建新的能量泛函，推导出带额外权重项的非线性鲁棒扩散方案，在图像重建和去噪任务中表现出色，尤其在混合高斯噪声和脉冲噪声（如缺失数据）场景下性能优异。
AI.motivation: 传统的非线性扩散滤波方法在处理混合噪声（如高斯噪声与脉冲噪声并存）时效果有限，需要一种更鲁棒的扩散方案来应对复杂的图像退化场景。
AI.method: 利用通道编码构建像素邻域的软直方图表示，基于此提出新的能量泛函，通过Euler-Lagrange方程推导出非线性鲁棒扩散更新方案，其中通道表示产生的额外权重项用于引导扩散过程。
AI.result: 在图像重建问题（尤其是混合高斯噪声和脉冲噪声、缺失数据场景）中表现良好；在标量图像去噪实验中，与现有扩散方案及最先进去噪方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 基于通道表示的软直方图能量泛函能够有效驱动扩散过程，为混合噪声下的图像重建和去噪提供了一种新颖且具有竞争力的解决方案。

title: Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation
summary: Long-horizon physical-world agents must reason over distant goals while grounding decisions in reliable closed-loop behavior. Today's foundation models split these capabilities: vision-language models (VLMs) infer missing information and adapt high-level plans but remain brittle and inefficient at repeated navigation grounding, while navigation foundation models (NFMs) robustly execute semantic goals but operate as bounded episodes without persistent task-level reasoning. We introduce NavMCP, an agentic scaffolding framework that couples a VLM reasoning agent with an NFM executor for long-horizon exploration. The VLM decides what evidence to seek, where to search, and when to stop, while the NFM grounds each semantic sub-goal into closed-loop navigation. Three channels structure their collaboration: intent translates evidence needs into navigation calls, observation converts rollouts into source-grounded trajectory evidence, and memory accumulates findings, negative evidence, and unresolved goals across calls. This design turns isolated navigation rollouts into persistent embodied interaction without retraining either model. On Embodied Question Answering, NavMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on HM-EQA, MT-HM3D, and EXPRESS-Bench. Under matched agent and executor backbones, it outperforms an episodic interface by 14.9 percentage points on HM-EQA. On a Unitree Go2, NavMCP reaches 78.3% success, with its margin over the strongest baseline growing from 10 to 45 points as the task horizon increases. These results demonstrate the potential of scaffolding complementary foundation models into long-horizon physical-world agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NavMCP，一种将视觉语言模型（VLM）推理代理与导航基础模型（NFM）执行器耦合的智能体编排框架，用于长时程物理世界探索。VLM负责决策（寻找什么证据、在哪里搜索、何时停止），NFM负责将语义子目标落地为闭环导航。通过意图、观察、记忆三个通道实现协作，无需重训练即可将孤立导航滚动转化为持久具身交互。在HM-EQA、MT-HM3D、EXPRESS-Bench上取得SOTA成绩，在Unitree Go2实体机器人上达到78.3%成功率。
AI.motivation: 长时程物理世界智能体需要在处理遥远目标的同时保持可靠的闭环行为。当前基础模型存在能力分裂：VLM擅长高层规划但导航接地脆弱低效，NFM擅长语义目标执行但缺乏跨回合的持久任务级推理。作者旨在桥接这两种互补能力，构建无需重训练即可实现持久具身交互的框架。
AI.method: NavMCP采用三通道协作架构：(1) 意图通道——VLM将证据需求转化为导航调用；(2) 观察通道——NFM的滚动轨迹被转化为带源引用的证据；(3) 记忆通道——累积发现、负面证据和未解决目标。VLM作为推理代理决定搜索策略，NFM作为执行器完成语义子目标的闭环导航，两者通过这三通道实现结构化协作。
AI.result: 在Embodied Question Answering任务上，NavMCP在HM-EQA、MT-HM3D和EXPRESS-Bench上取得SOTA结果。在匹配的代理和执行器骨干下，相比回合制接口在HM-EQA上提升14.9个百分点。在Unitree Go2实体机器人上达到78.3%成功率，且随着任务水平线增长，相对于最强基线的优势从10个百分点扩大到45个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，通过"脚手架"方式将互补的基础模型（VLM+NFM）进行编排组合，可以有效构建长时程物理世界智能体。该方法无需重训练任何模型，仅通过结构化交互通道设计就能将孤立导航过程转化为持久的具身交互，为长时程任务提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Hyper-Fold: Exploring the Expressive Limit of Sequence-Geometry Learning for Proteins via Hypergraph Modeling
summary: Protein structure modeling rests on a single computational primitive: the interaction between what a residue is (sequence content) and where it sits (three-dimensional geometry). What is the expressive limit of this layer class? We show that the complete bilinear operator over content-geometry outer products--the sufficient statistic of all second-order interactions--is the expressive ceiling, while the additive message passing of mainstream geometric GNNs is provably blind to content-geometry binding. We then introduce Hyper-Fold, a rank-K separable convolutional backbone approaching this ceiling at message-passing cost: each radius neighborhood is organized into a sequence hyperedge and a contact hyperedge, modulated by an edge-conditioned matrix-valued operator factorized into K learned basis operators with geometry-generated coefficients. Across enzyme function prediction, fold classification, and ligand binding site detection, Hyper-Fold and its hierarchical variant Hyper-Fold-Deep achieve the best results among protein-specific structure encoders; Hyper-Fold-Pocket, an anchored set-prediction head, surpasses UniSite-3D on UniSite-DS and two zero-shot benchmarks with no sequence language model features, 68x fewer parameters, and 4.8x lower latency--suggesting that a sufficiently expressive 3D backbone recovers information that fusion architectures previously borrowed from evolution-scale pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hyper-Fold，一种秩K可分离卷积骨干网络，逼近内容-几何双线性算子（所有二阶相互作用的充分统计量）的表达上限，同时保持消息传递的计算成本。该方法在酶功能预测、折叠分类和配体结合位点检测等任务上超越现有蛋白结构编码器，其变体Hyper-Fold-Pocket在零样本基准上以极少的参数和延迟超越UniSite-3D。
AI.motivation: 主流几何GNN的加性消息传递在数学上对"内容-几何绑定"（残基类型与三维位置的耦合）是盲目的，无法捕捉完整的二阶相互作用。作者希望探索蛋白质结构建模中这一基础计算原语的表达极限，并构建一个靠近该极限但计算成本可控的模型。
AI.method: 1) 理论上证明：内容-几何外积的完全双线性算子（所有二阶相互作用的充分统计量）是该层类的表达上限；2) 提出Hyper-Fold：将每个半径邻域组织为序列超边和接触超边，由边条件矩阵值算子调制，该算子分解为K个学习的基础算子，系数由几何生成；3) 变体包括分层版Hyper-Fold-Deep和用于结合位点检测的锚定集预测头Hyper-Fold-Pocket。
AI.result: 在酶功能预测、折叠分类和配体结合位点检测任务中，Hyper-Fold和Hyper-Fold-Deep在蛋白特异性结构编码器中取得最佳结果；Hyper-Fold-Pocket在UniSite-DS和两个零样本基准上超越UniSite-3D，无需序列语言模型特征，参数减少68倍，延迟降低4.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 一个足够有表达力的3D骨干网络能够恢复此前融合架构需要从进化规模预训练中借用信息的表达能力，这暗示几何信息本身的信息容量被之前的加性消息传递方法严重低估。

title: Compact Snapshot Spectral Imaging with Calibration-Free Aperture Diffraction
comment: Submitted to IEEE TPAMI. Under Review
summary: Snapshot Spectral Imaging (SSI) provides high-dimensional temporal-spatial-spectral observation to uncover intrinsic physical characteristics. However, its complex system and repetitive calibration requirements hinder edge applications. Here, we propose a compact, cost-effective, calibration-free SSI method, Aperture Diffraction Imaging Spectrometer (ADIS), which consists only of a diffractive lens with a binary mask and a Bayer-filtered sensor, requiring no additional physical footprint compared to standard RGB cameras. ADIS disperses and multiplexes wavelengths, mapping energy to distinct sensor locations, enabling full-resolution recovery from superpixel-level encodings. ADIS directly leverages theoretically computed PSFs to enable calibration-free spectral reconstruction, while tolerating lens-dependent variations across different optical configurations and bridging the gap between simulation and reality. To achieve SSI by solving a sparsely-constrained inverse problem, we introduce the Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Framework (ODAUF) with Voxel Shift Transformer (VST) for improved orthogonal diffraction perception. Integrating VST into ODAUF forms the efficient Orthogonal Diffraction-Aware Unfolding Voxel Shift Transformer (ODAUVST), delivering excellent recovery and reduced parameters. By elaborating on theory, systematic and comprehensive comparing, and demonstrating real SSI results, we validate the superiority of ADIS, achieving calibration-free full-resolution SSI within a commercial camera footprint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种紧凑、低成本、免标定的快照光谱成像（SSI）方法ADIS，仅由衍射透镜、二元掩模和Bayer滤波传感器组成，无需额外物理体积。ADIS通过理论计算PSF直接进行免标定光谱重建，并引入ODAUF框架（含VST模块）解决稀疏约束逆问题，实现全分辨率光谱成像。
AI.motivation: 传统快照光谱成像系统结构复杂且需要重复标定，阻碍了其在边缘设备上的应用。作者希望设计一种与普通RGB相机体积相当、无需标定即可工作的紧凑型光谱成像方案。
AI.method: 1) 硬件设计：仅含衍射透镜+二元掩模+Bayer传感器，通过衍射实现波长色散与复用；2) 免标定策略：直接利用理论计算的PSF进行光谱重建，并容忍不同光学配置下的透镜差异；3) 算法设计：提出ODAUF（正交衍射感知展开框架），集成VST（体素移位Transformer）增强正交衍射感知，形成ODAUVST模型，通过稀疏约束逆问题求解实现全分辨率光谱重建。
AI.result: 通过理论阐述、系统全面对比以及真实SSI实验，验证了ADIS方法的优越性，实现了在商用相机尺寸内的免标定全分辨率快照光谱成像。
AI.conclusion: ADIS成功实现了在标准RGB相机物理尺寸内的高性能免标定快照光谱成像，缩小了仿真与现实的差距，为光谱成像在边缘应用中的推广提供了新的可行方案。

title: HorizonNet for visual terrain navigation
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Published at IEEE IPAS 2018. An extended version appeared in Journal of Field Robotics 37(6):951-971, 2020, doi:10.1002/rob.21929
summary: This paper investigates the problem of position estimation of unmanned surface vessels (USVs) operating in coastal areas or in the archipelago. We propose a position estimation method where the horizon line is extracted in a 360 degree panoramic image around the USV. We design a CNN architecture to determine an approximate horizon line in the image and implicitly determine the camera orientation (the pitch and roll angles). The panoramic image is warped to compensate for the camera orientation and to generate an image from an approximately level camera. A second CNN architecture is designed to extract the pixelwise horizon line in the warped image. The extracted horizon line is correlated with digital elevation model (DEM) data in the Fourier domain using a MOSSE correlation filter. Finally, we determine the location of the maximum correlation score over the search area to estimate the position of the USV. Comprehensive experiments are performed in a field trial in the archipelago. Our approach provides promising results by achieving position estimates with GPS-level accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于360度全景图像和数字高程模型（DEM）匹配的水面无人艇（USV）位置估计方法。该方法利用两个CNN架构分别完成地平线粗提取和像素级精确提取，通过MOSSE相关滤波器在全景图像与DEM数据之间进行傅里叶域匹配，最终实现GPS级精度的定位。
AI.motivation: 在沿海或群岛区域，水面无人艇（USV）的位置估计是一个关键问题。GPS可能失效或受干扰，需要开发不依赖GPS的替代定位方法。利用地平线和DEM数据进行视觉地形匹配是一种可行的方案，但如何准确提取地平线并高效匹配DEM数据是核心挑战。
AI.method: 方法分为四个步骤：(1) 在360度全景图像中设计第一个CNN架构，估计相机俯仰角和滚转角（即粗略地平线），并隐式确定相机姿态；(2) 将全景图像进行畸变校正（warp），补偿相机姿态得到近似水平的图像；(3) 设计第二个CNN架构在矫正后的图像中逐像素提取精确的地平线；(4) 将提取的地平线与DEM数据在傅里叶域通过MOSSE相关滤波器进行匹配，在搜索区域内寻找最大相关得分对应的位置作为估计值。
AI.result: 在群岛区域的实地试验中进行了综合实验，该方法取得了有前景的结果，定位精度达到GPS级别。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过两步CNN策略实现地平线的鲁棒提取，并结合MOSSE相关滤波器进行高效的地形匹配，能够在GPS受限的沿海/群岛环境中实现GPS级精度的位置估计，为USV提供了可靠的替代定位手段。

title: Imag-Eval: a language-grounded framework for interpretable Text-to-Image instruction following evaluation
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have recently achieved impressive visual fidelity, yet their evaluation remains constrained by benchmarks that are often difficult to interpret and insufficiently diagnostic. Existing skill-based evaluations tend to overlook critical failure modes that strongly impact usability but fall outside standard taxonomies, such as global incoherence arising from missing parts or physically implausible configurations (e.g., floating objects). In addition, prompt difficulty is typically controlled along a single dimension; either prompt length or the number of elements to generate. To address these limitations, we introduce Imag-Eval, a controlled benchmark designed to assess how T2I models ground compositional natural-language instructions into visual outputs. Unlike prior work that conflates surface linguistic complexity with compositional difficulty, Imag-Eval explicitly seeks to disentangles these factors by independently varying both the number of instances and the combination of constraints (rules), while avoiding error propagation. This design enables fine-grained and interpretable analysis of where cross-modal instruction following fails. Our benchmark comprises 1,140 prompts and 8,842 combined rules, and we evaluate it on several state-of-the-art models. Complementing this analysis with an additional study of over 2,000 prompts from a concurrent benchmark, our results suggest that, for structured skills, compositional difficulty is primarily governed by the number of grounded rules and their binding to instances,, rather than by prompt length alone.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Imag-Eval，一个用于评估文本到图像（T2I）模型组合指令跟随能力的受控基准。该基准包含1,140个提示和8,842条组合规则，通过独立变化实例数量和约束规则组合来解耦表面语言复杂度与组合难度，从而实现对跨模态指令跟随失败点的细粒度可解释分析。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型评估基准存在两个主要局限：一是基于技能的评估忽略了标准分类学之外的严重失败模式（如整体不连贯、物体漂浮等物理上不合理的配置）；二是提示难度的控制往往只沿单一维度（提示长度或元素数量），无法准确反映真实的组合难度。
AI.method: Imag-Eval基准通过独立变化两个维度来设计：实例数量（number of instances）和约束（规则）的组合方式（combination of constraints），从而解耦表面语言复杂度与组合难度。基准包含1,140个提示和8,842条组合规则，并避免误差传播。此外，还对来自并行基准的2,000多个提示进行了补充研究。
AI.result: 在多个最先进的T2I模型上评估后，结合对2,000多个并行基准提示的补充研究，结果表明：对于结构化技能，组合难度主要由已落地规则的数量及其与实例的绑定决定，而非仅由提示长度决定。
AI.conclusion: Imag-Eval提供了一种更精确、可解释的T2I模型评估方法，揭示了组合指令跟随失败的根本原因在于规则与实例的绑定复杂度，而非表面的语言长度，为未来模型改进和评估设计提供了重要方向。

title: Failure or Drift? Evaluating Monocular SLAM under Synthetic and Real-World Corruptions
comment: Accepted at the 3rd NeuSLAM workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: Visual SLAM is commonly evaluated on clean trajectories, although deployment failures are often caused by adverse weather, illumination, blur, and sensor artifacts. Controlled corruptions are attractive because they isolate such factors, but a synthetic stress test is useful only when it leads to the same engineering conclusion as the condition it is intended to approximate. This work examines that question for monocular SLAM. We evaluate a classical feature-based system and two learned trackers under image-space, geometry-aware, and compound corruptions, and compare their behavior with adverse conditions from 4Seasons. Rather than reducing robustness to a single trajectory error, the evaluation separates explicit tracking failure from drift accumulated by methods that remain active. The results show that learned trackers largely replace catastrophic loss with sustained, and sometimes severe, drift. More importantly, the apparent ordering of the learned systems changes with the physical fidelity of the corruption: structured rain and fog proxies preserve the real-world ordering, whereas a simple illumination proxy does not. Code is available at: https://github.com/abhaythomas/master_thesis_vslamlab_robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单目视觉SLAM在受控损坏（corruption）下的鲁棒性评估问题。作者发现传统基于特征的系统和两种学习式跟踪器在不同类型的损坏（图像空间、几何感知、复合损坏）下表现各异，且学习式系统在真实恶劣环境下的性能排序取决于损坏模拟的物理保真度。
AI.motivation: 视觉SLAM通常在干净轨迹上评估，但实际部署失败往往源于恶劣天气、光照、模糊和传感器伪影。受控损坏可以隔离这些因素，但只有在合成的压力测试能得出与真实条件相同的工程结论时才有价值。现有评估方法缺少这种对应性验证。
AI.method: 评估一个经典基于特征的系统（如ORB-SLAM）和两个学习式跟踪器，在图像空间、几何感知和复合损坏条件下进行测试，并与4Seasons数据集中的真实恶劣条件进行对比。评估不只用单一轨迹误差，而是区分显式跟踪失败与系统保持活跃时积累的漂移。
AI.result: 学习式跟踪器倾向于用持续的、有时严重的漂移取代灾难性的跟踪丢失。更重要的是，学习式系统的性能排序会随着损坏的物理保真度而变化：结构化的雨和雾代理能保持真实世界的排序，而简单的光照代理则不能。
AI.conclusion: 合成损坏测试的物理保真度对评估结论有决定性影响，低保真度的损坏模拟可能导致错误的工程决策。评估可视化SLAM鲁棒性时应使用能保持真实条件排序的损坏模拟，并区分跟踪失败与漂移累积两种不同失效模式。

title: Computational Depth Measurement in Thermographic Video: Overcoming Spatial Overfitting via Spatio-Temporal Decoupling
summary: Accurate through-thickness measurement of subsurface delamination depth in Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP) is important for structural assessment because defect location determines affected load-bearing layers. Optical pulsed thermography (OPT) provides a two-dimensional thermal video rather than volumetric measurements, so depth must be inferred from temporal heat-diffusion responses. A challenge is spatial dataset bias: when calibration defects follow regular grids, regression models may memorize their geometry instead of learning physical relationship between thermal decay and depth. This work introduces a spatio-temporal decoupling architecture that separates spatial defect localization from temporal depth measurement. Defect regions are first localized using segmentation methods, after which thermal responses are spatially averaged and converted into sixteen physics-informed temporal, energy, statistical, and geometric features. These features expose the one-dimensional heat-conduction relationship while withholding pixel coordinates from the depth model. Four regression models are evaluated using specimen-level cross-validation: Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), Advanced Multi-Layer Perceptron (Adv-MLP), and XGBoost. Unregularized trees and over-parameterized Adv-MLP exhibit calibration collapse under geometric shifts, with errors exceeding 0.5 mm. In contrast, regularized XGBoost with L1/L2 penalties and column sampling maintains cross-specimen calibration, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.056 mm and root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.085 mm. Predicted depths are merged with masks to generate Delaunay-triangulated three-dimensional defect models in three to five seconds per specimen. Results show that mathematical regularization and spatio-temporal decoupling reduce spatial memorization in thermal-video depth regression.

AI.tldr: 本文针对碳纤维增强聚合物（CFRP）复合材料中缺陷深度测量的挑战，提出了一种时空解耦架构，将空间缺陷定位与时间深度测量分离。通过分割定位缺陷区域、提取16个物理信息时序特征，并利用正则化XGBoost回归模型，实现了0.056 mm的MAE和0.085 mm的RMSE，有效避免了空间记忆导致的校准崩溃。
AI.motivation: CFRP中亚表面缺陷深度的精确穿透测量对结构评估至关重要，但光学脉冲热成像（OPT）只提供二维热视频而非体积测量。一个关键问题是空间数据集偏差：当标定缺陷按规则网格排列时，回归模型可能记忆缺陷的几何布局而非学习热衰减与深度之间的物理关系，导致校准失效。
AI.method: 提出时空解耦架构：(1) 使用分割方法定位缺陷区域；(2) 对缺陷区域热响应进行空间平均，提取16个物理信息特征（时间、能量、统计和几何特征），同时向深度模型隐藏像素坐标；(3) 评估四种回归模型（RF、GBM、Adv-MLP、XGBoost），采用样本级交叉验证；(4) 将预测深度与掩码合并，通过Delaunay三角剖分生成3D缺陷模型。
AI.result: 未正则化的决策树和过度参数化的Adv-MLP在几何偏移下出现校准崩溃，误差超过0.5 mm；而带L1/L2惩罚和列采样的正则化XGBoost保持了跨样本校准，MAE为0.056 mm，RMSE为0.085 mm。每个样本的3D缺陷模型生成仅需3-5秒。
AI.conclusion: 数学正则化和时空解耦架构能有效减少热视频深度回归中的空间记忆效应，为CFRP无损检测提供了一种可靠且高效的深度测量方法。

title: Generalization over Memorization: Generalization-Aware Diffusion Adaptation for Single-Image Multi-View Synthesis
comment: ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge Track winning paper; presents the 1st-place solution among 293 registered teams. 7 pages, 2 figures
summary: We present the winning solution to the ACM Multimedia 2026 Grand Challenge on Single-Image Guided Multi-Angle Image Synthesis. It ranks first among 293 registered teams; 56 teams obtained at least one scored submission on the public Phase-A leaderboard. With only 40 training scenes, the challenge requires 26 target views from one RGB model and one forward pass per view; it prohibits explicit geometry, external rendering, chained generation, candidate selection, and post-processing. We identify a critical model-selection failure: shared training and validation scenes make memorization appear as transferable view control. We therefore introduce GoM. Short for Generalization over Memorization, the framework combines scene-disjoint validation, exposure-matched selection, and targeted diffusion adaptation. Its synthesis model adapts a 4B rectified-flow DiT using rank-32 LoRA, optimizer restarts, late-checkpoint averaging, and VAE decoder tuning. More than 300 offline experiments and 24 online submissions show that validation design and training-trajectory control can matter as much as architecture scale in small-data generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GoM框架，是ACM Multimedia 2026大挑战赛"单图引导多视角图像合成"的冠军方案。比赛仅用40个训练场景，需从单张RGB图像生成26个目标视角，且禁止显式几何、外部渲染、链式生成等。作者发现共享训练/验证场景导致记忆化被误认为可迁移的视角控制这一关键问题，为此引入场景分离验证、曝光匹配选择和定向扩散适配。
AI.motivation: 在仅40个训练场景的小数据条件下生成多视角图像，现有方法存在严重的模型选择失败：训练集与验证集共享场景会使模型记忆化被误判为泛化能力，导致无法区分"记住视角"和"真正学会视角控制"。
AI.method: GoM框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 场景分离验证——确保验证场景不重叠训练场景；(2) 曝光匹配选择——使选择过程的曝光度与最终评估一致；(3) 定向扩散适配——对4B参数的rectified-flow DiT模型进行rank-32 LoRA微调，并结合优化器重启、末期检查点平均和VAE解码器调优。
AI.result: 在293个注册队伍中排名第一，56支队伍在Phase-A公开榜上获得至少一次得分提交。通过300多次离线实验和24次在线提交验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在小数据生成建模中，验证集设计和训练轨迹控制的重要性不亚于架构规模。场景分离验证等方法论层面的改进是避免记忆化陷阱、实现真正泛化的关键。

title: Driving on Memory
summary:
End-to-end autonomous driving models plan future trajectories from raw sensor input. While earlier driving benchmarks often measured deviation from the human trajectory, current benchmarks such as NAVSIM and Bench2Drive evaluate models with richer simulation-based metrics intended to capture safe and compliant driving. A high benchmark score should reflect that a model can understand the scene in front of it and act accordingly. But how much of that score specifically comes from reacting to the dynamic part of that scene?
  To probe this, we remove a model's camera input and replace it with memories from prior drives at the same location. The retrieved memories can provide persistent scene information, including road layout and location-conditioned regularities, but not the current traffic state. Surprisingly, memory is nearly sufficient on NAVSIM, reaching or even exceeding the performance of leading end-to-end methods without actually observing the evaluated scene. Our results suggest that a high NAVSIM score does not require a planner to react to the current traffic scene and should be treated with caution. This effect is benchmark-dependent: driving from memory causes substantially larger performance drops on Bench2Drive and RealEngine. We provide our code at https://github.com/boschresearch/MemoryDrivoR .

AI.tldr: 本文提出"MemoryDrivoR"方法，通过移除自动驾驶模型的相机输入并替换为先前的驾驶记忆，来探测端到端驾驶基准测试是否真正衡量了模型对当前动态交通场景的反应能力。研究发现NAVSIM基准中仅凭记忆即可达到甚至超越领先端到端方法的性能，说明该基准分数并不需要模型真正感知当前场景，而在Bench2Drive和RealEngine基准中记忆导致的性能下降更为显著。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动驾驶基准测试（如NAVSIM、Bench2Drive）声称用仿真指标衡量安全与合规驾驶，高分应反映模型理解场景并据此行动的能力。然而，人们不清楚这些分数中有多少真正来源于对动态场景的实时反应，而非依赖静态或先验信息。作者希望通过记忆替代实时输入来揭示基准分数的本质，检验高分数是否真的意味着模型能感知并响应当前交通状况。
AI.method: 作者设计了一个探测实验：构建MemoryDrivoR方法，在推理时将模型原始的相机输入移除，替换为同一地点先前驾驶所存储的记忆信息。这些记忆仅包含持久性的场景信息（如道路布局、位置条件相关的规律），但不包含当前时刻的动态交通状态。通过在三个基准（NAVSIM、Bench2Drive、RealEngine）上对比记忆驱动与实时感知驱动的性能差异，来评估各基准对动态场景反应能力的依赖程度。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM基准上，仅使用记忆（不观察当前场景）驱动的模型性能达到甚至超越了领先的端到端方法，表明该基准的高分并不需要规划器对当前交通场景做出反应。而在Bench2Drive和RealEngine基准上，替换为记忆后性能出现大幅下降，说明这些基准对动态场景反应能力更为敏感。
AI.conclusion: NAVSIM基准分数应谨慎对待，因为它可能主要反映模型利用位置先验和静态场景信息的能力，而非对当前交通场景的实时理解和规划能力。效应具有基准依赖性：不同基准对动态场景信息的依赖程度差异显著，这为未来自动驾驶基准设计提出了重要警示和改善方向。

title: Localizing Emergent Failures in Agentic AI: Recovering Minimal Repair Families via Counterfactual Replay
summary: Failures in agentic AI systems can arise from interactions among messages exchanged by multiple large language model (LLM) agents. Pointwise attribution cannot distinguish a jointly necessary repair from alternative singleton repairs. We formulate Minimal Repair Family Recovery (MRFR): recovering all inclusion-minimal event sets whose counterfactual replay restores task success within a declared size bound. We propose Graph-Constrained Joint Replay (GCJR), which slices failure-relevant events from an execution dependency graph, constructs graph-feasible singleton and pair candidates, and verifies them by replay with paired clean counterparts. For fixed replay outcomes, GCJR is exact within its declared graph domain. On 90 in-scope cases from a 120-DAG controlled benchmark, GCJR achieves 1.000 Family Exact Match while reducing mean replay calls from 56.3 to 25.3 (55.1%) relative to exhaustive search. On a 24-case, four-agent LLM pilot, it again achieves 1.000 Family Exact Match and reduces mean model calls from 21.0 to 10.0 (52.4%); single-event replay misses jointly necessary repairs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出最小修复族恢复（MRFR）任务及图约束联合重放（GCJR）方法，用于定位多智能体LLM系统中导致任务失败的联合必要事件集，而非仅单一事件。
AI.motivation: 多智能体AI系统的故障可能源于多个LLM智能体间消息交互的复杂组合，单点归因无法区分联合必要的修复与替代性的单点修复，需要恢复所有最小事件集的完备故障归因。
AI.method: GCJR方法从执行依赖图中切片故障相关事件，构建图可行的单事件和双事件候选，并通过与清洁对照组配对重放来验证候选。在声明的图域内，给定固定重放结果时GCJR是精确的。
AI.result: 在120-DAG受控基准的90个范围内案例中，GCJR实现1.000家庭精确匹配，平均重放调用从56.3降至25.3（降低55.1%）；在24例四智能体LLM试点中同样实现1.000家庭精确匹配，平均模型调用从21.0降至10.0（降低52.4%）；单事件重放会遗漏联合必要修复。
AI.conclusion: GCJR通过图约束和配对重放有效减少搜索开销，同时精确恢复所有最小修复族，证明了联合归因对于多智能体系统故障诊断的必要性和可行性。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Anti-UAV Detection via Evidential Fusion and Conflict-Discounted Belief Aggregation
summary:
Anti-UAV perception systems must remain reliable when sensor streams degrade under occlusion, fast motion, or modality-specific failure. Existing multimodal anti-UAV systems fuse RGB and thermal streams deterministically, without modeling predictive uncertainty, and cannot express doubt when streams disagree. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) produces calibrated per-class uncertainty in a single forward pass. EDTC already exploits this for thermal-only perception, yet cross-modal evidential fusion remains unaddressed.
  This paper extends EDTC to multimodal RGB-Thermal perception via Discounted Belief Fusion (DBF), which converts inter-modal conflict into uncertainty mass before aggregating stream opinions. Bounding boxes are resolved by selecting the lower-uncertainty modality. On the Anti-UAV benchmark, multimodal fusion consistently outperforms either single stream (test Acc 0.670 vs. 0.604 IR, 0.598 RGB) at real-time speed (at least 38 FPS). However, DBF is empirically indistinguishable from undiscounted averaging: near-zero inter-modal conflict on this presence-dominated benchmark leaves the discounting step inert. The fused uncertainty is well-calibrated (ECE 0.057) yet expectedly a weaker localization failure detector than spatial variance (AUROC 0.626 vs. 0.739). The null result is structural: the benchmark's near-universal presence and vacuous miss-encoding jointly suppress inter-modal conflict, a diagnosis that delimits where conflict-aware fusion provides measurable benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文将EDTC扩展至多模态RGB-热红外反无人机感知领域，提出折扣信念融合（DBF）方法，通过将模态间冲突转化为不确定性质量来融合流意见。实验显示多模态融合优于单一模态（测试准确率0.670 vs 0.604/0.598），实时速度达38 FPS以上，但DBF与无折扣平均在经验上无法区分，因为基准测试中近零的模态间冲突使折扣步骤失效。融合不确定性校准良好（ECE 0.057），但作为定位失败检测器弱于空间方差（AUROC 0.626 vs 0.739）。作者将这一零结果归因于基准测试的结构性问题，并以此界定冲突感知融合能带来可测量收益的适用范围。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态反无人机系统以确定性方式融合RGB和热红外流，无法建模预测不确定性，也难以在流之间出现分歧时表达怀疑。虽然EDTC已利用证据深度学习实现热红外单模态的不确定性估计，但跨模态的证据融合问题尚未解决，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将EDTC扩展至RGB-热红外多模态感知，提出折扣信念融合（DBF）方法：将模态间的冲突转化为不确定性质量，再聚合各流意见；边界框通过选择不确定性较低的模态来解析。
AI.result: 在Anti-UAV基准上，多模态融合持续优于任一单模态（测试准确率0.670 vs 0.604 IR、0.598 RGB），实时速度至少38 FPS。融合不确定性校准良好（ECE 0.057），但作为定位失败检测器弱于空间方差（AUROC 0.626 vs 0.739）。DBF与无折扣平均在经验上不可区分，因为基准测试中模态间冲突近乎为零。
AI.conclusion: 零结果本质上是结构性的：基准测试中近乎普遍的目标存在性和空洞的漏检编码共同抑制了模态间冲突。这一诊断界定了冲突感知融合仅在特定条件下能提供可测量收益，为未来设计更适合评估不确定感知融合的基准提供了方向。

title: Validating FKG.in: Soundness Assessment in LLM-Augmented Indian Food Knowledge
summary: The online culinary ecosystem is increasingly populated by recipe content generated, modified, or summarized by Large Language Models (LLMs). While often plausible, such outputs may contain hallucinated ingredients, misrepresented quantities, or culturally implausible combinations, limiting their suitability for downstream applications and knowledge graph construction. In this paper, we present a semi-automated soundness assessment workflow for validating structured recipe data extracted and augmented by LLMs from informal culinary sources. Developed as part of FKG.in, a knowledge graph of Indian food, the pipeline identifies and addresses common failure modes, including structural inconsistencies, semantic and logical incoherence, and deviations from the source text, through a multi-stage process combining formal grammars, vocabulary-based checks, statistical heuristics, Set Transformer-based coherence modeling, and retrieval-based verification. Although evaluated on Indian recipes, the proposed methods are applicable to broader multilingual and multicultural culinary domains. We provide a practical, auditable, and application-agnostic framework for validating LLM-augmented recipe data, thereby strengthening the foundations of machine-readable food knowledge infrastructures in the era of LLM-generated content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个半自动化的配方数据健全性评估工作流，用于验证LLM从非正式烹饪来源提取和增强的结构化配方数据。该流程作为FKG.in（印度食物知识图谱）的一部分，通过多阶段结合形式语法、词汇检查、统计启发式、Set Transformer一致性建模和检索验证，识别并解决结构不一致、语义逻辑不连贯及偏离原文等常见失败模式。
AI.motivation: 在线烹饪生态中越来越多地包含由LLM生成、修改或总结的配方内容。虽然这些输出看似合理，但可能包含幻觉成分、错误的用量或文化上不合理的组合，限制了其在下游应用和知识图谱构建中的适用性，因此需要系统性的验证框架。
AI.method: 提出一个多阶段半自动评估流程：1) 形式语法检查结构一致性；2) 基于词汇表的检查；3) 统计启发式方法；4) Set Transformer进行语义一致性建模；5) 基于检索的验证。该流程用于验证LLM从非正式烹饪来源提取和增强的配方数据。
AI.result: 虽然在印度配方上评估，但所提出的方法可推广到更广泛的多语言和多文化烹饪领域，提供了一个实用、可审计且与应用无关的框架，用于验证LLM增强的配方数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过为LLM生成内容时代的机器可读食物知识基础设施提供验证框架，加强了其基础。该框架是实际可用、可审计且与应用无关的。

title: GuardianAgent: Policy-Conditioned Risk-Adaptive Anonymization with Verified Adversarial Escalation
summary: Privacy protection for live web traffic requires more than detecting private spans. Agent-based privacy protection systems must determine whether an outgoing action complies with the destination site's privacy policy, then apply only the level of rewriting or sanitisation justified by the residual disclosure risk. We present GuardianAgent, a policy-conditioned anonymization framework that couples structured risk assessment with verified adaptive rewriting. GuardianAgent computes risk through AMRSF (Adaptive Multi-factor Risk Scoring Formula), an explicit controller that combines policy-violation likelihood with data sensitivity, recipient transmission, purpose legitimacy, contextual basis, and policy transparency, rather than relying on an LLM to assign risk directly. This risk score determines both the allow/transform/deny decision and the initial anonymization level. For efficiency, GuardianAgent uses an evidential fast path for low-uncertainty policy matches and invokes an LLM slow path only for uncertain cases. For rewriting, it applies a five-level hierarchy driven by a verified adversarial guesser: guesses trigger escalation only when supported by the original text, preventing hallucinated attacker confidence from causing unnecessary over-anonymization. Experiments across three benchmarks spanning legal text (TAB), Reddit posts (SynthPAI), and multi-format synthetic PII records (PII-Masking-300k) show that GuardianAgent achieves the strongest privacy-utility trade-off among published baselines and is the only method to reach more than 0.90 privacy in all three domains, remaining robust under a backbone switch. Action-context stress tests further show that the same outgoing text receives different decisions and anonymization strengths under different recipients, purposes, action bases, and policy-transparency conditions.

AI.tldr: GuardianAgent是一个面向智能体（Agent）的隐私保护框架，通过结构化风险评估（AMRSF）和政策条件化的自适应重写，在保护网络流量隐私的同时维持实用性与效率。它在三个基准上达到了最强的隐私-效用权衡，且是唯一在全部三个领域隐私得分超过0.90的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的隐私保护系统仅关注检测私有文本片段，但智能体隐私保护需要进一步判断外发行为是否符合目标网站的隐私政策，并根据残余泄露风险仅应用合理的重写或脱敏级别。直接让LLM分配风险分数存在不可靠性，需要更结构化的风险评估方法。
AI.method: GuardianAgent包含三个核心组件：(1) AMRSF自适应多因子风险评分公式，显式结合政策违规可能性、数据敏感性、接收方传输、目的合法性、上下文依据和政策透明度来计算风险；(2) 双路径机制——低不确定性政策匹配走证据快速路径，不确定情况才调用LLM慢速路径以保证效率；(3) 五级重写层级，由经过验证的对抗性猜测器驱动，仅当猜测有原文支持时才升级脱敏级别，防止幻觉导致的过度匿名化。
AI.result: 在TAB（法律文本）、SynthPAI（Reddit帖子）和PII-Masking-300k（多格式合成PII）三个基准上，GuardianAgent达到最强隐私-效用权衡，是唯一在三个领域隐私分数均超过0.90的方法，并且在更换骨干模型时保持稳健。行动上下文压力测试表明，同一外发文本在不同接收者、目的、行动依据和政策透明度条件下会得到不同的决策和匿名化强度。
AI.conclusion: GuardianAgent验证了结构化风险评分（而非直接依赖LLM风险评估）与验证驱动的自适应重写相结合，能够在智能体外发流量隐私保护中实现优异的隐私-效用平衡，同时保持对上下文变化的敏感性。

title: DARD: Zero-Shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-Guided Diffusion for Low-Light Image Enhancement
summary: Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods provide strong generative capability for low-light image enhancement (LLIE), yet they either rely on paired supervision or lack reliable scene constraints in zero-shot settings, often leading to structural inconsistency and color drift. Motivated by conventional Retinex models, which offer physically interpretable priors that can serve as reliable scene constraints yet struggle with mixed degradations in real-world scenarios, we propose DARD, a zero-shot Degradation-Aware Retinex-guided Diffusion framework for LLIE. DARD first extracts image-specific physical priors from the degraded input through a test-time degradation-aware Retinex decomposition, thereby providing reliable structural guidance for zero-shot restoration. It then injects these priors into reverse diffusion through a timestep-adaptive frequency fusion strategy to balance structural anchoring and detail generation. Finally, a guided reverse refinement process with physical consistency and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based semantic guidance is introduced to suppress structural artifacts and semantic drift during sampling. Extensive experiments show that DARD achieves strong distortion and perceptual performance and consistently outperforms existing zero-shot baselines across multiple real-world low-light benchmarks. To further validate the practical utility of our method for downstream applications, we evaluated its impact on semantic segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that images enhanced by DARD achieve a 28.10% relative improvement in mIoU over AGLLDiff.

AI.tldr: 提出了DARD，一种零样本的退化感知Retinex引导扩散框架，用于低光图像增强。该方法通过测试时Retinex分解提取物理先验作为结构引导，采用时间步自适应频率融合策略注入扩散过程，并结合物理一致性约束和CLIP语义引导进行反向细化，在多个真实低光基准上超越了现有零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式低光增强方法要么依赖成对监督数据，要么在零样本设置下缺乏可靠的场景约束，导致结构不一致和颜色漂移。传统Retinex模型虽有物理可解释的先验，但在真实场景的混合退化下表现不佳。
AI.method: 1) 测试时退化感知Retinex分解提取图像特定物理先验；2) 时间步自适应频率融合策略将先验注入反向扩散，平衡结构锚定与细节生成；3) 物理一致性约束和CLIP语义引导的反向细化过程，抑制结构伪影和语义漂移。
AI.result: DARD在多个真实低光基准上取得了优异的失真和感知性能，一致超越现有零样本基线。在下游语义分割任务中，DARD增强的图像相比AGLLDiff获得28.10%的相对mIoU提升。
AI.conclusion: DARD通过将Retinex物理先验与扩散模型相结合，有效解决了零样本低光增强中的结构不一致和颜色漂移问题，同时验证了该方法对下游任务（如语义分割）的实用价值。

title: Dynamic Important Example Mining for Reinforcement Finetuning
summary: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used to strengthen the reasoning abilities of large models, yet its effectiveness is bound by how training data are selected and used. Most data-centric RFT methods rely on static or heuristic sample selection, implicitly assuming a sample's value is fixed over training. This overlooks the non-stationary dynamics of policy learning and can lead to suboptimal updates. We propose Dynamic Important Example Mining (DIEM), a principled and fully automated framework that makes data utilization adaptive throughout RFT. DIEM integrates two components into each optimization step: (i) a gradient-alignment importance estimator that efficiently approximates each sample's marginal contribution to policy improvement; and (ii) a constrained batch reweighting scheme that maximizes aggregate utility while preserving the update's gradient magnitude to stabilize optimization. Across several reasoning benchmarks, DIEM consistently outperforms strong static and dynamic baselines. The code will be released via https://github.com/hrtan/DIEM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIEM，一种全自动的自适应数据利用框架，用于强化微调（RFT）中动态选择重要样本，克服静态样本选择的局限。
AI.motivation: 现有数据中心的RFT方法依赖静态或启发式样本选择，假定样本价值在训练中固定不变，忽视了策略学习的非平稳动态特性，导致次优更新。
AI.method: DIEM在每个优化步骤中整合两个组件：(i) 梯度对齐重要性估计器，高效近似每个样本对策略改进的边际贡献；(ii) 约束批次重加权方案，在保持更新梯度幅度以稳定优化的同时最大化聚合效用。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上，DIEM一致优于强静态和动态基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DIEM证明在RFT过程中自适应数据利用更有效，且代码已开源。

title: QCell: Recombining and Aligning Cell Queries for Overlapping Instance Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. Project page/code/models/dataset: https://slavkoprytula.github.io/QCell/
summary: Instance segmentation of overlapping cells in microscopy remains challenging due to semi-transparent structures that produce weak boundaries and mixed visual evidence in overlap regions. Existing methods address this through local regions of interest or shape priors but lack global reasoning across overlapping objects. We present QCell, a novel query-based model that de-overlaps cell instances in microscopy scenes. Our approach combines (i) an instance recombination module that decomposes and recombines query representations in latent space, enabling the model to reason about complete object structure under overlap, and (ii) a contrastive query alignment objective that combines distinctive instance feature learning and separation of overlapping cell queries. We additionally introduce a new Organoid dataset benchmark for overlapping cell segmentation. We show that QCell outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple benchmarks, achieving +2.2 AP and +2.7 AJI on ISBI2014. Code is available at https://github.com/SlavkoPrytula/QCell

AI.tldr: 提出了QCell，一种基于查询的模型，用于显微镜图像中重叠细胞的实例分割。通过实例重组模块和对比查询对齐目标来解决重叠区域弱边界和混合视觉证据的问题，并在新引入的Organoid数据集和多个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 显微镜中重叠细胞的实例分割因半透明结构导致弱边界和重叠区域混合视觉证据而具有挑战性。现有方法依赖局部兴趣区域或形状先验，缺乏跨重叠对象的全局推理能力，因此需要一种能够进行全局推理的新方法。
AI.method: QCell包含两个核心组件：(i) 实例重组模块，在潜在空间中分解并重组查询表示，使模型能够在重叠情况下推理完整的对象结构；(ii) 对比查询对齐目标，结合区分性实例特征学习与重叠细胞查询的分离。同时引入新的Organoid数据集基准。
AI.result: QCell在多个基准上优于最先进方法，在ISBI2014数据集上实现了+2.2 AP和+2.7 AJI的提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于查询的模型通过全局推理和潜在空间重组能够有效解决重叠细胞分割问题，代码已公开。

title: RACER: Reinforced Agent Collaboration for Explainable Reasoning on Knowledge Graphs
comment: 15 pages, 1 figures, This paper has been accepted by ICONIP 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffer from hallucination and struggle with complex reasoning tasks requiring multi-hop domain knowledge. While integrating Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provides a structured and verifiable information source, current KG-enhanced LLM paradigms usually rely on single-agent path extraction and fixed prompting, lacking adaptability and facing huge search spaces. To address these challenges, we propose RACER, a Reinforced Agent Collaboration framework for Explainable Reasoning on knowledge graphs. RACER employs a semantic-aware action pruning and teacher-guided reinforcement learning mechanism to efficiently extract high-quality reasoning pathways from large-scale KGs. Furthermore, to mitigate single-path generation pitfalls, we introduce a cross-task accumulated shared memory graph paired with an attention-driven multi-path knowledge refinement module. Finally, RACER orchestrates these components through a four-role multi-agent collaboration system (GraphAgent, TemplateAgent, AnswerAgent, and CriticAgent) to dynamically refine prompts and evaluate answers. Extensive experiments on CommonsenseQA and OpenBookQA datasets demonstrate that RACER significantly outperforms state-of-the-art KG-enhanced LLM baselines with an average improvement of 5\%, offering robust and highly interpretable reasoning capabilities.

AI.tldr: RACER是一个基于强化学习的多智能体协作框架，用于知识图谱上的可解释推理。它通过语义感知的动作剪枝、教师引导的强化学习、跨任务共享记忆图和注意力驱动的多路径知识细化模块，配合四角色（GraphAgent、TemplateAgent、AnswerAgent、CriticAgent）协作系统，在CommonsenseQA和OpenBookQA上平均提升5%性能。
AI.motivation: LLM在复杂多跳推理任务中常出现幻觉问题，而现有的KG增强LLM范式依赖单智能体路径提取和固定提示，缺乏适应性且面临巨大搜索空间。
AI.method: 1) 语义感知动作剪枝和教师引导强化学习机制，高效提取高质量推理路径；2) 跨任务累积共享记忆图配合注意力驱动的多路径知识细化模块，缓解单路径生成缺陷；3) 四角色多智能体协作系统（GraphAgent、TemplateAgent、AnswerAgent、CriticAgent）动态优化提示和评估答案。
AI.result: 在CommonsenseQA和OpenBookQA数据集上，RACER相比SOTA的KG增强LLM基线平均提升5%，展现出鲁棒且高度可解释的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: RACER通过强化学习与多智能体协作的有效结合，显著提升了KG增强LLM在多跳复杂推理任务上的表现，验证了该框架在可解释性和鲁棒性方面的优势。

title: Learning to Ground Before Reading: Unified PCB Engineering Drawing Parsing with Compact Vision-Language Models
summary: PCB engineering drawings mix sparse graphics, dense tables, and text whose meaning depends on page position. Localizing the regions and sending crops to specialized recognizers are determined as the methods for most parsers, so missed regions cannot be recovered downstream. We train a compact VLM to read the full page and get a sequence of region classes, normalized boxes, and text or HTML content. Bounding boxes are converted to coordinate tokens for supervision. Inference uses no detector or crop parser. The joint target is difficult to optimize because class and box tokens are sparse relative to the much longer content sequences. Our localization-first curriculum learns the class-box format before adding content targets with content-aware resampling. On the fixed validation split of the Engineering Drawing Dataset (ED dataset), Localization-First improves strict localization F1 by 0.0955 over joint training (paired image-bootstrap 95% interval: [0.0350, 0.1572]). G-Unified has the lowest NED, highest cell F1, and only nonzero exact-match score. It provides a detector-free baseline for full-page PCB drawing parsing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需检测器的紧凑型VLM方案，直接读取整页PCB工程图纸，输出区域类别、归一化框及文本/HTML内容。通过定位优先课程学习和内容感知重采样，解决了稀疏框token与长内容序列联合优化困难的问题，在ED数据集上显著提升定位F1，并提供首个无检测器的全页解析基线。
AI.motivation: 传统PCB工程图纸解析方法依赖区域检测后裁剪给专用识别器，一旦检测遗漏则下游无法恢复；且输出格式依赖页面位置。作者希望训练一个紧凑VLM直接读取整页并输出结构化结果，消除对检测器和裁剪解析器的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 训练紧凑VLM直接读取完整页面，输出区域类别、归一化框、文本/HTML内容序列；2) 将边界框转换为坐标token用于监督；3) 提出定位优先课程学习：先学习class-box格式，再添加内容目标；4) 采用内容感知重采样缓解框token稀疏问题。
AI.result: 在ED数据集验证集上，Localization-First相比联合训练提升严格定位F1达0.0955（95%置信区间[0.0350, 0.1572]）；G-Unified取得最低NED（归一化编辑距离）、最高单元格F1，且是唯一取得非零精确匹配分数的方案。
AI.conclusion: 定位优先课程学习有效解决了全页VLM解析中稀疏定位token与长内容序列的联合优化难题，提出的方法为PCB工程图纸全页解析提供了无需检测器的可行基线。

title: EpaCache: Error-Propagation-Aware Caching for Accelerating Diffusion-Based Visual Generation
comment: This is a preview version of EpaCache, which is still under review
summary: Diffusion-based visual generative models deliver strong image and video synthesis quality but incur high inference costs because sequential samplers repeatedly evaluate large networks. Caching-based methods reduce inference latency by reusing intermediate computations across adjacent timesteps. However, existing cache controllers rely primarily on local temporal variation and overlook the trajectory-level consequences of cache reuse. We introduce Error-Propagation-Aware Cache (EpaCache), a training-free caching policy that adaptively allocates the reuse budget on timesteps with lower downstream impact. Experiments on image and video synthesis models demonstrate that EpaCache consistently improves the latency--fidelity trade-off over existing caching methods. On FLUX.1-dev, EpaCache outperforms the prior state-of-the-art caching method in both latency and fidelity, reducing inference time from $11.7$ s to $11.3$ s while improving PSNR from $21.4$ to $22.8$. On HunyuanVideo, EpaCache achieves a $2.63\times$ speedup over uncached inference and improves SSIM from $0.891$ to $0.905$ over the prior state-of-the-art method at matched latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EpaCache，一种训练无关的缓存策略，通过误差传播感知自适应分配缓存预算，在时间步长上优先重用下游影响较小的计算，从而在图像和视频生成中改善延迟与保真度的权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散式视觉生成模型虽然生成质量高，但推理成本高。现有基于缓存的加速方法主要依赖局部时间变化，忽略了缓存重用在整个轨迹层面的后果，导致缓存策略次优。
AI.method: 提出Error-Propagation-Aware Cache (EpaCache)，一种训练无关的缓存策略，通过考虑误差传播轨迹级影响，自适应地分配重用预算到下游影响较小的时间步长上。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1-dev上，EpaCache将推理时间从11.7秒降至11.3秒，同时PSNR从21.4提升至22.8；在HunyuanVideo上，相比无缓存推理实现2.63倍加速，并在匹配延迟下相比先前最优方法将SSIM从0.891提升至0.905。
AI.conclusion: EpaCache通过在多个图像和视频合成模型上一致优于现有缓存方法，验证了误差传播感知的缓存策略能够更有效地改善延迟-保真度权衡。

title: LightFuse: Relightable Interactive Gaussian Scene Reconstruction via Multi-Scan Fusion and 2D Gaussian Ray Tracing
summary: Relightable interactive scene reconstruction aims to build an editable 3D model from scans of different object arrangements and render new layouts under novel illumination. Existing methods either bake lighting into appearance or recover material and illumination only for fixed scenes, leaving edited layouts with inconsistent shadows and indirect lighting. We present LightFuse, a 2D Gaussian framework that extends interactive scene reconstruction with explicit material-illumination decomposition and physically based relighting. LightFuse first fuses observations across states to reconstruct a shared background and movable objects. It then conducts ray-tracing-oriented geometry refinement to produce more complete and consistent surfaces. On the refined geometry, staged training with differentiable one-bounce ray tracing separates shared metallic--roughness material from state-specific environment lighting. The resulting scene supports object rearrangement, material editing, and relighting, while ray tracing recomputes appearance after each interaction. Experiments across synthetic scenes demonstrate state-of-the-art relighting quality, outperforming the strongest baseline by +9.74\,dB PSNR and +0.121 SSIM on average. Project page: https://zhn202.github.io/LightFuse/

AI.tldr: LightFuse 提出一个基于2D高斯的框架，实现可重打光的交互式场景重建。它融合多状态观测重建共享背景和可移动物体，通过光线追踪导向的几何精化获得完整一致的表面，并采用分段训练的可微单次光线追踪将共享材质与状态特定环境光照分离。最终支持物体重排、材质编辑和重打光，实验在合成场景上达到SOTA，PSNR比最强基线高9.74dB。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么将光照烘焙进外观，要么只能对固定场景恢复材质和光照，无法处理编辑后布局中阴影和间接光照不一致的问题。
AI.method: 1) 跨状态融合观测以重建共享背景和可移动物体；2) 进行光线追踪导向的几何精化以得到更完整、一致的表面；3) 在精化几何上采用分段训练的可微单次光线追踪，将共享的金属-粗糙度材质与状态特定环境光照分离。
AI.result: 在合成场景上实现SOTA重打光质量，PSNR平均比最强基线高+9.74dB，SSIM高+0.121。
AI.conclusion: LightFuse成功将交互式场景重建扩展到显式材质-光照分解与物理基础重打光，支持物体重排、材质编辑和重打光，并在每次交互后通过光线追踪重算外观。

title: Understanding Deep Learning via Entropy Space Theory
summary: Deep learning is often criticized for its theoretical research lagging behind practice. To make deep learning easier to understand, the entropy space theory is first introduced here. The entropy space can cover all the possibilities of any deep learning model by topological structure. It is independent of network parameters. Through the designed fundamental operations and norm, entropy space is proven to be a normed space within the formal axiomatic framework. Based on the theory, a unified coordinate system is proposed. It can coordinatize every state of a model and rank them by compression of the maximal value of information entropy. The theory offers a novel priori framework for mathematical fundamentals of deep learning.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出熵空间理论，通过拓扑结构覆盖任意深度学习模型的所有可能性，该空间独立于网络参数，并在形式公理框架下被证明是赋范空间。基于该理论提出统一坐标系，可对模型每个状态进行坐标化并按最大信息熵值的压缩程度排序，为深度学习提供新的先验数学基础框架。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的理论研究长期滞后于实践应用，缺乏统一的数学基础框架来理解和解释深度学习模型的行为与能力，作者希望构建一个能够覆盖所有深度学习模型可能性的理论体系。
AI.method: 首先定义熵空间，利用拓扑结构覆盖任意深度学习模型的所有可能性，且该空间不依赖网络参数；随后设计基本运算和范数，在形式公理框架下证明熵空间是赋范空间；最后基于该理论提出统一坐标系，对模型状态进行坐标化，并按最大信息熵值的压缩程度对状态进行排序。
AI.result: 熵空间被证明是一个赋范空间，并成功构建了统一坐标系，能够对深度学习模型的每个状态进行坐标化并通过最大信息熵值压缩程度进行排序。
AI.conclusion: 熵空间理论为深度学习的数学基础提供了一个全新的先验框架，有望弥合深度学习理论与实践之间的理论鸿沟。

title: RAGDiffusion++: From Macro-Retrieval to Micro-Fidelity Alignment for Garment Generation
summary: Standard clothing asset generation---restoring forward-facing flat-lay garment images from diverse real-world contexts---holds immense commercial value yet demands both macroscopic topological accuracy and microscopic physical fidelity. Although our previous work RAGDiffusion effectively eradicated large-scale structural hallucinations via retrieval-augmented macro-constraints, achieving industrial-grade micro-texture realism remains an unsolved bottleneck. We formally identify this limitation as High-Frequency Trajectory Collapse: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) converges to the conditional mean of the training distribution, which is dominated by smooth, low-frequency textures, causing high-frequency patterns (e.g., fabric weaves, intricate logos) to become nearly un-sampleable. Naively applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training further triggers Artifact Hacking, where models exploit semantic biases in generic reward models by generating deceptive checkerboard noise. Our key insight is that RL can fundamentally reshape the sampling distribution of flow models---elevating the probability of high-fidelity trajectories under accurate reward guidance---while adversarial regularization prevents exploitation of reward blind spots. Realizing this principle requires three prerequisites: (i)inherent capacity, established through a 27,725-pair high-complexity garment dataset (STGarment-Plus) and a Dual-Image-Stream FLUX architecture upgrade; (ii)perceptive reward, provided by a novel attribute-aware reward model (Garment-RM) trained on 500K images via fine-grained contrastive learning, achieving 84.67% human preference accuracy; and (iii)hacking prevention, enforced by our Adversarial-Regularized GRPO (AR-GRPO) strategy that integrates a dynamic discriminator into the RL sampling trajectory to penalize artifacts while enriching authentic high-frequency details.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AR-GRPO策略解决服装生成中的微纹理真实性问题，通过RL重塑流模型的采样分布以提升高保真轨迹概率，并利用对抗正则化防止奖赏模型被攻击，配套构建了大规模数据集和感知奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 现有方法RAGDiffusion虽解决了宏观结构幻觉，但微观纹理真实度仍是瓶颈。作者将此问题形式化为"高频轨迹塌缩"：SFT训练收敛到条件均值，导致高频细节无法采样。直接应用RL又引发Artifact Hacking（模型利用奖赏模型的语义偏差生成欺骗性棋盘噪声）。
AI.method: 提出三要素框架：(i) STGarment-Plus数据集（27,725对高复杂度服装数据）配合Dual-Image-Stream FLUX架构升级提供内在容量；(ii) Garment-RM属性感知奖赏模型（基于500K图像细粒度对比学习，84.67%人类偏好准确率）提供感知奖赏；(iii) AR-GRPO策略将动态判别器集成到RL采样轨迹中，惩罚伪影的同时丰富真实高频细节。
AI.result: Garment-RM达到了84.67%的人类偏好准确率，数据集规模为27,725对，奖赏模型基于500K图像训练。
AI.conclusion: RL能够从根本上重塑流模型的采样分布，在准确奖赏引导下提升高保真轨迹概率，而对抗正则化可防止对奖赏盲区的利用，从而解决工业级微纹理真实性的瓶颈问题。

title: MMPCBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models on Proactive Critique of Flawed Inputs
summary: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) evolve into sophisticated interactive assistants, their reliability depends not only on following instructions but also on validating them. We define Proactive Critique as the model's autonomous ability to identify, analyze and fix faulty user inputs without extra prompts. However, evaluations mainly test models under ideal circumstances or simple refusal behaviors, largely ignoring active error processing. To fill this gap, we propose MMPCBench, a comprehensive framework for evaluating MLLMs' proactive critique competence. It features a fine-grained taxonomy of 4 primary error types spanning 12 subcategories, ranging from cross-modal contradictions to missing visual premises. We adopt a hierarchical evaluation protocol to measure models' error detection, diagnosis and resolution performance, and apply alignment-aware metrics to assess the coherence between internal reasoning and final responses. Tests on 14 mainstream MLLMs show obvious weaknesses in proactive critique, especially in dealing with subtle visual anomalies. Notably, we identify a pervasive "consistency gap": reasoning models can often correctly identify and analyze errors during internal reasoning yet suppress these valid insights in final outputs to prioritize response compliance. The code and data is available at https://github.com/ALIENS32/MMPCBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMPCBench，一个评估多模态大语言模型主动批判能力的综合框架，涵盖4类主要错误类型和12个子类别，采用层级评估协议衡量错误检测、诊断和解决能力。在14个主流MLLM上的测试揭示了模型在主动批判方面的明显不足，并发现推理模型存在"一致性差距"——内部推理正确但最终输出抑制了有效见解以优先服从指令。
AI.motivation: 随着MLLM演变为复杂的交互式助手，其可靠性不仅依赖于遵循指令，还依赖于验证指令。然而现有评估主要在理想条件下测试模型或考察简单的拒绝行为，忽略了主动错误处理能力（即无需额外提示就能自主识别、分析和修复错误用户输入的能力）。
AI.method: 提出了MMPCBench框架，包含：(1) 细粒度错误分类体系（4个主要错误类型覆盖12个子类别，从跨模态矛盾到缺失视觉前提）；(2) 层级化评估协议来衡量模型的错误检测、诊断和解决表现；(3) 对齐感知指标来评估内部推理与最终回答之间的一致性。在14个主流MLLM上进行测试评估。
AI.result: 测试14个主流MLLM显示其在主动批判方面存在明显弱点，尤其是在处理微妙的视觉异常时表现不佳。研究还发现了一个普遍存在的"一致性差距"：推理模型在内部推理过程中常能正确识别和分析错误，但在最终输出中却抑制这些有效见解以优先满足响应服从性。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLM在主动批判能力上仍有显著不足，推理模型存在内部推理与外部输出之间的"一致性差距"，这为未来提升MLLM可靠性的方向提供了重要启示。

title: Elastic Token Compression for Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
summary: Natural images concentrate their detail in a small fraction of the frame, yet diffusion models spend a full token on every patch, in every layer and at every timestep. The waste is largest in pixel-space models, with no autoencoder to absorb low-level redundancy first. Probing a pretrained pixel text-to-image transformer, we find its middle-block tokens redundant wherever the image is flat. The redundancy occupies connected, content-shaped regions, and exploiting it requires tokens with the same geometry. Cutting a Hilbert ordering of the patches provides them. Consecutive positions are always image neighbours, so any contiguous run is a connected region whose size and shape follow the content, and grouping in two dimensions becomes a cut in one. Existing reductions each lose part of this. Similarity merging scatters its groups, latent bottlenecks discard position, and skipping deletes what it should summarize. We cut where the model's features change most and pool each run into one region token. Our Region Token Interface (\method{}) adapts a diffusion model to these tokens, with the region count drawn at random during fine-tuning so one checkpoint serves every budget. \method{} leads prior reduction methods at matched budgets, matches dense quality at $2.0\times$ the speed, and stays close at $2.6\times$. The code and models are open-sourced at https://eduardzamfir.github.io/rti

AI.tldr: 提出Region Token Interface (RTI)，通过在Hilbert曲线上对补丁进行一维切割，将图像平坦区域的连片token合并为区域token，以任意预算高效运行扩散模型，在2.0倍加速时保持密集质量，2.6倍时接近。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在像素空间中为每个补丁、每一层、每一步都消耗完整token，但自然图像的细节只集中在一小部分区域，平坦区域存在大量冗余。现有的token减少方法（相似性合并、潜空间瓶颈、跳层删除）各有缺陷，无法保留下具有内容形状的连通区域token。
AI.method: 通过对预训练像素级文本到图像Transformer进行探测，发现其中间层token在图像平坦处是冗余的，冗余占据连通的内容形状区域。利用Hilbert排序特性（连续位置总是图像邻居），将补丁排列为一维序列，在特征变化最大的位置进行切割，将每个连续区段池化为一个区域token，实现二维分组变为一维切割。微调时区域数量随机采样，使单一检查点可服务任意预算。
AI.result: RTI在匹配的预算下优于先前的token减少方法，在2.0倍加速下匹配密集质量，在2.6倍加速下仍保持接近的质量。
AI.conclusion: 利用Hilbert曲线切割实现连通区域token化是减少像素空间扩散模型计算浪费的有效方法，既能保住内容形状的几何信息，又支持动态预算分配。

title: Accelerating Unified Multimodal Models with Core-Expansion Routing and Unified Computation Scheduling
summary: Unified multimodal models jointly support understanding and generation, but incur substantial redundant computation across tokens, layers, and generation timesteps. Through token-importance probing, we identify an asymmetric core-expansion structure: understanding exhibits a stable importance component, while generation largely shares this component but requires progress-dependent corrections. We therefore propose CE-Router, which uses a task-shared core scorer and progress-conditioned generation expansions, optimized through generation decomposition and cross-task core alignment. At inference, CE-Router compacts token computation and supplies a learned routing signal to Unified Computation Scheduling, which coordinates layer skipping, FFN pruning, diffusion-head cache reuse, and denoising-step early exit. Experiments on two representative UMM architectures demonstrate consistent quality--efficiency improvements across both tasks, retaining 98.03\% of dense understanding performance with a 1.93$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出CE-Router，基于非对称核心-扩展结构（core-expansion structure）实现统一多模态模型的高效推理。通过任务共享的核心评分器和进度条件生成扩展，配合统一计算调度（层级跳过、FFN剪枝、扩散头缓存复用、降噪步提前退出），在保持98.03%理解性能的同时实现1.93倍端到端推理加速。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型虽然同时支持理解和生成任务，但在token、层和生成时间步上存在大量冗余计算。现有方法未充分考虑理解和生成任务之间token重要性的结构与差异，导致计算资源分配不够精细高效。
AI.method: 1) 通过token重要性探查，识别出非对称的核心-扩展结构：理解任务具有稳定的重要性组件，生成任务共享该组件但需要依赖进度的修正。2) 提出CE-Router，包含任务共享核心评分器和进度条件生成扩展，通过生成分解和跨任务核心对齐进行优化。3) 推理时将CE-Router的评分信号提供给统一计算调度（Unified Computation Scheduling），协调层跳过、FFN剪枝、扩散头缓存复用和降噪步提前退出。
AI.result: 在两个代表性统一多模态架构上的实验表明，理解和生成任务均获得一致的"质量-效率"改进，保留98.03%的稠密理解性能，同时实现1.93倍的端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用理解和生成任务间token重要性的非对称共享结构，CE-Router实现了高效且高质量的统一多模态推理，验证了任务感知计算调度在多模态模型中的有效性。

title: 3D-MRL: Nested Multimodal 3D Representations via Matryoshka Representation Learning
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. Project page: https://usmarcv.github.io/3DMRL_page/
summary: Vision-Language Models align point clouds with image and text embeddings, enabling zero-shot recognition, retrieval, and open-vocabulary understanding of 3D shapes. Existing multimodal 3D pre-training methods produce fixed-dimensional embeddings, requiring separate models for different computational budgets. We propose 3D Matryoshka Representation Learning (3D-MRL), a multimodal 3D pre-training framework based on Matryoshka Representation Learning. 3D-MRL learns nested 3D representations by aligning point clouds with frozen CLIP image and text embeddings while applying contrastive supervision across multiple embedding dimensions. The Matryoshka objective is applied only to the 3D encoder, allowing a single model to produce representations at different dimensionalities without retraining. Experiments on the Objaverse-LVIS, ModelNet40, and ScanNet datasets show that 3D-MRL achieves competitive performance on zero-shot and few-shot 3D recognition tasks. In addition, the learned representations support retrieval across different embedding dimensions within a single model. On Objaverse-LVIS, 3D-MRL improves Top-1 accuracy from 46.8% to 50.9%. Retrieval experiments further show that different embedding dimensions yield varying levels of semantic and geometric specificity.

AI.tldr: 3D-MRL是一个基于Matryoshka表示学习的多模态3D预训练框架，通过在单一模型中学习嵌套的3D表示，使用户可以在不同嵌入维度下使用同一个模型而无需重新训练，在零样本和少样本3D识别任务上取得了竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态3D预训练方法生成固定维度的嵌入，导致不同计算预算需要单独训练不同的模型，缺乏灵活性和效率。
AI.method: 将点云与冻结的CLIP图像和文本嵌入对齐，并在多个嵌入维度上应用对比监督。Matryoshka目标仅应用于3D编码器，使得单一模型能够在不同维度下生成表示而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在Objaverse-LVIS、ModelNet40和ScanNet数据集上，零样本和少样本3D识别任务均取得竞争性表现。在Objaverse-LVIS上Top-1准确率从46.8%提升至50.9%。检索实验表明不同嵌入维度提供不同层次的语义和几何特异性。
AI.conclusion: 3D-MRL成功证明了Matryoshka表示学习可以应用于多模态3D预训练，实现单模型多维度表示，兼顾性能与灵活性。

title: Predicting Future Organ Dysfunction in ICU Patients Using Temporal Convolutional Networks on MIMIC-IV Data
summary: Predicting future organ dysfunction in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) patients is critical for early clinical intervention, yet existing machine learning approaches have largely treated the Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score as an input to binary mortality prediction rather than as a continuous clinical outcome in its own right. We investigate the extent to which a Temporal Convolutional Net work (TCN) can predict next-day SOFA scores from multivariate ICU time-series data extracted from MIMIC-IV, characterise the relative contribution of each organ system to total SOFA variance and deterioration, and identify distinct trajectory patterns across ICU stays. A residual TCN trained on three-day sliding windows achieved a five-fold cross-validation R2 of 0.740 +- 0.013 and MAE of 1.431 +- 0.022, outperforming a naive persistence baseline on RMSE and R2. SHAP interpretability analysis revealed that the model functions primarily as a severity-anchoring mechanism rather than a true sequence model, with predictions dominated almost entirely by the most recent observation day. Cardiovascular dysfunction emerged as the strongest discriminator of both cross-sectional severity and acute deterioration, and unsupervised trajectory clustering identified two clinically meaningful phenotypes, an improving group (58.9%) and a persistently severe group (41.1%), differentiated by cardiovascular, hepatic, coagulation, and renal involvement. We conclude that TCNs can extract meaningful predictive signal from ICU physiological data, but that short input windows and complete-case selection bias currently limit their clinical utility, motivating future work on longer input horizons, alternative missing-data strategies, and external validation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了时间卷积网络(TCN)在MIMIC-IV数据上预测ICU患者次日SOFA评分的能力，发现模型取得了良好的预测性能(R²=0.740)，但SHAP分析表明模型主要作为"严重程度锚定机制"而非真正的序列模型运作，心血管功能障碍是最强的判别因素，无监督聚类识别出两种临床上有意义的轨迹表型。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习方法大多将SOFA评分作为二分类死亡预测的输入特征，而非将其本身作为连续的临床结局进行预测。预测器官功能障碍的发生对于ICU早期临床干预至关重要，因此需要将SOFA评分视为独立的时间序列预测目标。
AI.method: 使用残差TCN对MIMIC-IV提取的多变量ICU时间序列数据进行次日SOFA评分预测，采用三天滑动窗口输入和五折交叉验证；通过SHAP可解释性分析各器官系统对SOFA方差的贡献；使用无监督轨迹聚类识别ICU住院期间的不同表型。
AI.result: TCN实现五折交叉验证R²=0.740±0.013，MAE=1.431±0.022，在RMSE和R²上优于朴素持续性基线。SHAP分析显示预测几乎完全由最近观测日主导，心血管功能障碍是横断面严重程度和急性恶化的最强判别因素。轨迹聚类识别出两种临床表型：改善组(58.9%)和持续严重组(41.1%)，两者在心血管、肝脏、凝血和肾脏受累方面有显著差异。
AI.conclusion: TCN能从ICU生理数据中提取有意义的预测信号，但短输入窗口和完整病例选择偏差限制了其临床实用性。未来需要更长的输入时间窗口、替代缺失数据处理策略以及外部验证来提升模型的临床应用价值。

title: PERSIST: Persistent-State Discrimination for Shot Boundary Detection
comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. Main paper: 18 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary material: 16 pages, 4 figures
summary: Shot boundary detection (SBD) is widely treated as the localisation of local visual discontinuities, yet many false positives such as hand-held shake, illumination flicker, motion blur, occlusion, and damaged archival material produce equally sharp local change without introducing a new shot. We reformulate SBD as boundary semantic discrimination: a frame is favoured as a boundary only when its local change evidence is accompanied by a persistent update of the video's latent temporal state, rather than a transient excursion that returns to the surrounding trend. This persistence test is operationalised with a continuous latent state from a FiLM-conditioned sinusoidal representation network and a structured discriminator that combines three semantic cues, local change, transient impulse, and return-to-trend, into a single interpretable per-frame signal over a dual-rate temporal backbone. The resulting framework, PERSIST, turns every decision into an inspectable one: the persistence criterion is trained into the classifier, its per-frame effect stays readable from the gate triple, and its learned latent state is measurably boundary-discriminative. On a 2,727-video per-subtype diagnostic it removes 33-80% of flash, text-overlay, and archival false positives relative to an identically trained cue detector, and at matched true-transition recall it roughly halves TransNetV2's pseudo-event false positives on that diagnostic and cuts its false positives on ClipShots footage by about a quarter, while preserving recall. It does so while reaching parity with the strongest public detector across online, broadcast, short-form, and historical-archive transfer evaluations, under markedly stricter training: it learns from ClipShots real transitions only, whereas the anchor draws on additional corpora whose transitions are 85% synthetic. Code is available at https://github.com/linty5/PERSIST.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PERSIST框架，将镜头边界检测（SBD）从局部视觉不连续定位重新定义为边界语义判别。核心思想是仅当局部变化证据伴随视频潜在时序状态的持续更新时才判定为边界，而非瞬态偏离。通过FiLM条件正弦表示网络构建连续潜在状态，结合结构化判别器融合三种语义线索（局部变化、瞬态脉冲、回返趋势），在双速率时序骨干上生成可解释的逐帧信号。实验表明，在2,727视频子类型诊断集上，相比同等训练的线索检测器消除了33-80%的闪烁、文字叠加和档案类误报；在匹配真实转换召回率下，相比TransNetV2在诊断集上约减半伪事件误报，在ClipShots上减少约四分之一误报，同时保持召回率，并在迁移评估中与最强公开检测器达到性能持平，但仅使用更严格的ClipShots真实转换训练。
AI.motivation: 传统SBD方法将镜头边界视为局部视觉不连续性检测，但手持抖动、光照闪烁、运动模糊、遮挡和损坏档案材料等均会产生同样剧烈的局部变化却不引入新镜头，导致大量误报。因此需要区分真正改变镜头语义的边界与仅产生瞬态偏离的伪事件。
AI.method: 将SBD重构为边界语义判别问题，引入持续性检验：仅当局部变化伴随视频潜在时序状态的持久更新才判定为边界。方法包括：(1) 采用FiLM条件正弦表示网络建模连续潜在状态；(2) 设计结构化判别器融合局部变化、瞬态脉冲、回返趋势三种语义线索；(3) 在双速率时序骨干上生成单一可解释的逐帧信号；(4) 持续性准则被训练进分类器，每个决策可通过门控三元组和潜在状态进行检查。
AI.result: 在2,727视频按子类型诊断中，相比同等训练的线索检测器消除了33-80%的闪烁、文字叠加和档案类误报。在匹配真实转换召回率下，相比TransNetV2在诊断集上约减半伪事件误报，在ClipShots视频上减少约四分之一误报，同时保持召回率。在与最强公开检测器在在线、广播、短视频和历史档案迁移评估中达到性能持平，且训练数据更严格（仅用ClipShots真实转换，而基准方法使用85%合成转换的额外语料）。
AI.conclusion: PERSIST表明将SBD从局部不连续检测重构为边界语义判别可显著降低伪事件误报且不损失真实转换召回率。持续性准则使决策可检查、可解释，每个逐帧信号可通过门控三元组和潜在状态理解。该框架在更严格的训练条件下达到与最强检测器相当的性能，具有实际应用价值。代码已开源。

title: Formal Concept Analysis with Three Types of Negation
summary: Classic Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) primarily focuses on the positive relationships between objects and attributes and does not have mechanisms for handling negation.To overcome this limitation, we introduce three types of negation concepts (contradictory negation, opposite negation, intermediary negation) into FCA.Based on the set SCOI and logic LCOI+PLCOI with these three types negation, we define formal context, Galois connection operators, formal concept and concept lattice with three types of negation,this leads to the proposal of a FCACOI: Formal Concept Analysis with contradictory negation, opposite negation and intermediary negation.For the reasoning in FCACOI, this paper focuses on attribute implication reasoning. Based on the logic LCOI+PLCOI and its semantics, we introduce the notion of ICOI-entailment as the semantic implication for attribute implication reasoning in FCACOI. Through ICOI-entailment, a connection is established between attribute implication reasoning in FCACOI and inference in the logic LCOI+PLCOI, it indicate that formally proven inference rules (theorems) in LCOI+PLCOI are valid in the attribute implication reasoning of FCACOI, LCOI+PLCOI provides a logical foundation for attribute implication reasoning in FCACOI. To illustrate the capability of attribute implication reasoning in FCACOI, we discuss its application in a concrete example. Moreover, we explore attribute reduction of the formal context in FCACOI, propose two research frameworks for attribute reduction from different perspectives, and compare their characteristics.We believe that, based on richer logic and semantics, FCACOI elevates FCA from a theory that describes affirmations to one that can describe affirmations and its contradiction(either this or that), opposition(extreme negation) and intermediary (transitional states between oppositions).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FCACOI（具有矛盾否定、对立否定和中间否定的形式概念分析），将三种类型的否定引入经典形式概念分析（FCA）中，基于集合SCOI和逻辑LCOI+PLCOI定义了形式背景、Galois连接算子、形式概念和概念格，并研究了属性蕴含推理和属性约简。
AI.motivation: 经典FCA主要关注对象与属性之间的肯定关系，缺乏处理否定的机制，无法描述否定关系，限制了其表达能力。
AI.method: 在FCA中引入三种否定（矛盾否定、对立否定、中间否定），基于集合SCOI和逻辑LCOI+PLCOI构建FCACOI框架，定义形式背景、Galois连接算子、形式概念和概念格；引入ICOI-entailment作为属性蕴含推理的语义蕴含，建立FCACOI属性蕴含推理与LCOI+PLCOI逻辑推理之间的联系；从不同视角提出两种属性约简研究框架。
AI.result: 建立了FCACOI属性蕴含推理与LCOI+PLCOI逻辑推理之间的连接，证明LCOI+PLCOI中的推理规则在FCACOI的属性蕴含推理中有效；通过具体实例展示了属性蕴含推理的能力；提出了两种属性约简框架并比较了其特征。
AI.conclusion: FCACOI基于更丰富的逻辑和语义，将FCA从描述肯定关系的理论提升为能够同时描述肯定关系及其矛盾（非此即彼）、对立（极端否定）和中间（对立之间的过渡状态）的理论。

title: AOI-Net: Structural Face AOI-Guided Eye-Gaze Track Representation Learning for Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection
summary: Eye-movement tracking has emerged as a promising non-invasive approach to Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) screening, with systematic differences in attentional allocation and revisit behaviors observed during socially interactive tasks. Existing computational methods typically characterize eye-movements using discrete gaze trajectories and fixation events, yielding representations dominated by short-range temporal dynamics and limiting models that primarily emphasize long-range dependencies. Meanwhile, gaze behavior is naturally organized across semantically meaningful Areas of Interest (AOIs), whose attention allocation and transitions provide important structural cues, yet their relationships are rarely modeled explicitly. To address these limitations, we propose a structural face AOI-guided Eye-Gaze Track Network (AOI-Net) that jointly models short-term temporal dynamics and AOI-level structural organization. A network gating mechanism adaptively integrates the complementary temporal and structural representations according to their contributions to gaze-behavior characterization. To mitigate the pronounced class imbalance commonly encountered between individuals with ASD and Typically Developing (TD) participants in clinical datasets, class-distribution-aware learning is further employed to facilitate discriminative embedding learning under skewed class distributions. Experiments on a unique and large-scale clinical eye-tracking database comprising eight stimulus subsets and more than 1,300 participants show that AOI-Net consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The proposed framework also enables interpretable gaze-behavior modeling and provides a practical basis for scalable AI-driven ASD screening in real-world healthcare. The code is available at https://github.com/Zhanpei-ai/CIM-AOI-Net/tree/main/Code

AI.tldr: 提出AOI-Net网络，联合建模短期时间动态与AOI级结构组织，用于自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的眼动筛查，在包含1300多名参与者的大型临床眼动数据库上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有眼动计算方法主要依赖离散注视轨迹和注视事件，表征以短时时间动态为主，限制了对长程依赖的建模；同时注视行为天然组织在语义上有意义的感兴趣区域（AOIs）上，但AOI之间的关系很少被显式建模。
AI.method: 提出结构化的面部AOI引导眼动轨迹网络（AOI-Net），联合建模短期时间动态和AOI级结构组织；采用网络门控机制根据贡献自适应整合时间与结构表征；并利用类分布感知学习缓解ASD与典型发育（TD）参与者之间的类别不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在包含八个刺激子集和1300多名参与者的大型临床眼动数据库上，AOI-Net持续优于最先进的方法，并实现了可解释的注视行为建模。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为真实医疗场景中可扩展的AI驱动ASD筛查提供了实用基础，代码已开源。

title: BIRD-History: A Benchmark for History-Driven Text-to-SQL with Fine-Grained Knowledge Annotations
comment: Accepted at Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP, 2026
summary: While recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based text-to-SQL systems achieve impressive performance on standard benchmarks, they struggle when user queries implicitly rely on domain-specific knowledge, such as business logic, data conventions, and analytical practices, that is neither captured by the schema nor explicitly stated in the natural language question. Historical SQL query logs offer a valuable source of such knowledge, yet existing benchmarks do not adequately support evaluation of history-driven approaches. To address this gap, we introduce BIRD-History, a benchmark consisting of 1,393 tasks across 11 databases, designed to evaluate text-to-SQL systems' ability to ground underspecified natural language questions using historical SQL scripts. Each task is annotated with ground-truth labels specifying which historical queries contain relevant knowledge and which SQL clauses encode it, enabling systematic evaluation of both retrieval effectiveness and knowledge utilization. Alongside the benchmark, we propose a plug-in retriever that extracts five types of external knowledge from historical SQL scripts, then retrieves and reranks relevant fragments for query generation. The retriever integrates seamlessly into existing few-shot text-to-SQL pipelines without requiring prompt modifications. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements across four text-to-SQL systems, highlighting the value of leveraging historical query logs for handling underspecified queries. Dataset and code are open-sourced on https://github.com/zjuidg/BIRD-History.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BIRD-History基准，包含11个数据库上的1,393个任务，用于评估文本到SQL系统利用历史SQL查询日志来处理未明确说明的领域特定知识的能力。同时提出了一种即插即用的检索器，从历史SQL脚本中提取五种外部知识，无需修改提示即可集成到现有少样本文本到SQL流程中，实验表明在四个系统上均有一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM-based文本到SQL系统在标准基准上表现优异，但面对依赖领域特定知识（如业务逻辑、数据约定、分析实践）的隐式用户查询时表现不佳。历史SQL查询日志是这类知识的重要来源，但现有基准缺乏对历史驱动方法的充分评估支持。
AI.method: 1) 构建BIRD-History基准：包含1,393个任务、11个数据库，每个任务带有标注历史查询是否包含相关知识以及SQL子句编码位置的真值标签。2) 提出即插即用检索器：从历史SQL脚本中提取五种类型的外部知识，检索并重排相关片段供查询生成使用，可无缝集成到现有少样本文本到SQL流程中而无须修改提示。
AI.result: 实验表明该检索器在四个文本到SQL系统上均带来一致的性能提升，验证了利用历史查询日志处理未指定查询的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用历史SQL查询日志作为外部知识来源，能够有效提升文本到SQL系统处理隐式领域知识查询的能力，BIRD-History基准为该方向提供了系统化的评估工具。

title: Hyper3-CLIP: Hierarchy-Conditioned Hyperbolic Vision-Language Training
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, ECCV 2026 Beyond Euclidean Workshop
summary: CLIP-like vision-language models (VLMs) trained with contrastive objectives learn strong global image-text representations, but their Euclidean embeddings and global pooling fail to encode relational structure such as part-whole and parent-child relations. Hyperbolic VLMs address this gap with entailment-based objectives, and text-conditioned variants improve fine-grained alignment through sentence- and phrase-level queries. However, these two lines of work remain separate: hyperbolic VLMs use static image and region features, while query-conditioned methods lack hierarchical geometric structure. We present Hyper3-CLIP, a hierarchy-conditioned hyperbolic VLM that combines global, local, and global-local contrastive learning with query-conditioned visual pooling. To train the model, we construct lightweight query hierarchies from text, comprising full captions, sentence fragments, localized part descriptions, and extracted phrases. Each query conditions the pooling of visual patches, and the resulting representations support image-text, whole-part, and parent-child entailment losses. Query-conditioned pooling is active only during training. Hyper3-CLIP improves R@5 and R@10 retrieval on COCO and Flickr, as well as multi-label classification on VOC and COCO, while remaining competitive on hierarchy metrics. We also audit zero-shot prompt sensitivity under fixed prompt regimes and study the effect of the localized GRIT part budget used during training. Code is available at https://github.com/Hyper3Labs/hyper3-clip.

AI.tldr: Hyper3-CLIP是一种层级条件化的双曲视觉语言模型，通过在训练中引入查询条件池化，将全局、局部和全局-局部对比学习与整体-部分、父子蕴含损失相结合，改进了图像文本检索和多标签分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP类模型使用欧几里得嵌入和全局池化，无法编码部分-整体和父子等关系结构。双曲VLM和文本条件变体虽分别解决了部分问题，但这两条研究线相互分离：双曲VLM只使用静态图像/区域特征，而查询条件方法缺乏层级几何结构。
AI.method: 1) 从文本构建轻量级查询层级（完整标题、句子片段、局部部件描述、提取短语）；2) 每个查询条件化视觉patch池化；3) 支持图像-文本、整体-部分、父子蕴含损失；4) 查询条件池化仅在训练时激活。
