It builds a query-local graph over retrieved candidates, records why candidates are connected, and treats each connection as a support hypothe?sis rather than support itself. We identify the resulting failure mode as a connectivity-support gap: connected candidates do not necessarily support the answer. We propose PAGE-RAG, a Provenance-Aware Graph Evidence promotion method that scores candidate paths with relevance, source-tracing meta?data, specificity, hubness, noise, and coherence signals, and applies minimal sufficient selection to promote supporting facts into a compact reader context. PAGE-RAG can serve as a complete retrieval-to-reading pipeline, and the same promo?tion stage can be inserted after existing retrieval or RAG sys?tems without replacing their upstream retrieval logic. Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks under the same final bud?get, PAGE-RAG improves support F1 and answer F1 by 10.4 and 3.3 points on a weighted average over a strong retriever. As a plug-in, PAGE-RAG further improves all reported RAG backends, including reasoning-oriented, compression-based, graph-based, and document/chunk-level systems.

AI.tldr: PAGE-RAG提出了一种基于provenance（溯源）感知的图证据提升方法，通过构建查询局部图来筛选检索到的候选证据，解决多跳RAG中窄检索遗漏关键跳、宽检索引入主题干扰的问题，可作为完整管线或即插即用模块，在多跳QA基准上显著提升支持F1和答案F1。
AI.motivation: 多跳RAG中检索范围的权衡问题：窄检索可能遗漏关键跳（indispensable hop），宽检索会引入主题干扰（topical distractors）。这个问题不依赖于特定的知识库格式，需要一种查询感知的选择层，利用关系结构在生成前过滤候选。现有方法缺乏对这种连接-支持差距（connectivity-support gap）的显式处理。
AI.method: PAGE-RAG将图作为临时选择结构而非假设图结构化知识库。具体包括：1) 在检索到的候选上构建查询局部图，记录候选之间为何相连；2) 将每条连接视为支持假设而非支持本身（识别连接-支持差距）；3) 提出provenance感知的图证据提升方法，对候选路径打分，融合相关度、来源追踪元数据、特异性、枢纽度、噪声和连贯性信号；4) 应用最小充分选择（minimal sufficient selection）将支持事实提升为紧凑的reader上下文。
AI.result: 在三个多跳QA基准上、相同最终预算下，PAGE-RAG相比强检索器的加权平均支持F1提升10.4点、答案F1提升3.3点。作为插件，PAGE-RAG进一步提升了所有报告的RAG后端，包括推理导向型、压缩型、图型和文档/块级系统。
AI.conclusion: PAGE-RAG证明了一种查询感知、provenance感知的图选择层能够有效弥合连接-支持差距，既可作为完整检索到阅读管线，又可作为即插即用模块增强现有RAG系统，展示了通用性和有效性。

title: NepScript Genesis: Neural Architecture Search for Handwritten Devanagari Digit Synthesis
summary: This paper introduces NepScript Genesis, a Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework for automated Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) discovery, applied to conditional Devanagari handwritten digit synthesis. We compare five NAS strategies against a carefully constructed Deep Convolutional GAN (DCGAN) baseline (FID=332.28). Architecture selection utilizes a two-stage pipeline guided by a novel domain-aware evaluation metric (Enhanced Score). Results demonstrate that Adaptive Exploration achieves the optimal quality-efficiency trade-off, attaining an FID of 79.12 -- a 76.19% improvement over the baseline -- and the highest mode coverage among the NAS strategies (Recall=0.531) in under one GPU-hour. Furthermore, we demonstrate that incorporating script-specific structural heuristics into the search phase prevents early-stage mode collapse. In a downstream low-resource evaluation, augmenting 250 real training samples per class with GAN-generated digits from the best NAS model improves CNN classification accuracy from 91.0% to 96.5% (+5.5 percentage points), demonstrating that NAS-optimized synthesis produces digits of sufficient quality to benefit practical recognition pipelines when real data is scarce.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NepScript Genesis框架，一种用于自动GAN发现的神经架构搜索（NAS）方法，应用于天城文手写数字合成。Adaptive Exploration策略达到FID 79.12，较DCGAN基线提升76.19%，并在低资源场景下将CNN识别准确率从91.0%提升至96.5%。
AI.motivation: 天城文手写数字的合成面临数据稀缺和结构复杂性的挑战，传统手动设计的GAN架构效率低下且容易发生模式崩溃，需要自动化的架构搜索方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段NAS管道，使用新型领域感知评估指标（Enhanced Score）进行架构选择，比较五种NAS策略，并将脚本特定的结构启发式纳入搜索阶段以防止早期模式崩溃。
AI.result: Adaptive Exploration策略取得最优质量-效率平衡：FID 79.12（较基线提升76.19%），Recall=0.531（最高模式覆盖），且在1个GPU小时内完成；下游任务中，将GAN生成数字与250个真实样本/类增强，CNN准确率从91.0%提升至96.5%（+5.5个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: NAS优化的GAN合成能够生成足够高质量的数字图像以支持实际识别管道，尤其在真实数据稀缺的场景下效果显著；脚本特定启发式的引入可有效防止模式崩溃。

title: FRAMEWORKERS: A Dynamic Multi-Agent Framework for AI-Generated Video Production
summary: Modern video generators excel at synthesizing individual clips, but complete video production requires coordinating a long sequence of interdependent creative steps, including scripting, storyboarding, generation, and editing. It further demands persistent asset management and dynamic task orchestration as intermediate outputs, dependencies, and execution states evolve over time. Existing automated systems typically rely on rigid pipelines that are difficult to adapt to diverse inputs and changing workflows, while general-purpose large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable for long-horizon orchestration and multimodal asset routing. We introduce FRAMEWORKERS, a task-centric and workspace-grounded multi-agent framework for open-ended video production. A central Director formulates video creation as dynamic task management, continuously editing a Task Stack to determine which subtask to execute next and which sub-agent to invoke. An Assistant serves as the execution layer, grounding each selected task in a shared Workspace, retrieving the required assets and context, invoking the assigned sub-agent, and persisting the resulting artifacts. Execution capabilities are exposed through modular sub-agents with registered descriptors, allowing new sub-agents to be integrated without redesigning the orchestration workflow. To improve orchestration reliability, we fine-tune the Director via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for descriptor-conditioned task routing. Experiments show that FRAMEWORKERS outperforms strong LLM planners in routing accuracy, recovers reliably from runtime failures, generalizes to unseen sub-agents without retraining, and achieves higher end-to-end video quality and broader task coverage than fixed pipelines, single-agent systems, and prior multi-agent approaches.

AI.tldr: FRAMEWORKERS 是一个面向开放式视频制作的、以任务为中心且基于工作空间的多智能体框架。它通过中央 Director 动态管理任务栈和调度子智能体，通过 Assistant 在执行层接地到共享工作空间，并通过 SFT + GRPO 微调提升路由可靠性。实验表明其在路由准确性、故障恢复、新智能体泛化和视频质量上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现代视频生成器擅长生成单个片段，但完整的视频制作需要协调大量相互依赖的创意步骤（脚本、故事板、生成、编辑等），且需要持续的资产管理和动态任务编排。现有自动化系统依赖刚性流水线，难以适应多样化输入和动态流程；而通用 LLM 在长时程编排和多模态资产路由上不可靠。
AI.method: 提出 FRAMEWORKERS 多智能体框架：(1) 中央 Director 将视频创作建模为动态任务管理，持续编辑任务栈决定执行哪个子任务并调用哪个子智能体；(2) Assistant 作为执行层，将选中任务接地到共享工作空间，检索资产和上下文，调用子智能体并持久化产出；(3) 子智能体通过注册描述符以模块化方式集成，无需重新设计编排流程；(4) 通过 SFT 后接 GRPO 对 Director 进行微调，实现基于描述符的任务路由。
AI.result: FRAMEWORKERS 在路由准确性上优于强 LLM 规划器；能从运行时故障中可靠恢复；无需重新训练即可泛化到未见过的子智能体；在端到端视频质量和任务覆盖范围上均优于固定流水线、单智能体系统和先前的多智能体方法。
AI.conclusion: FRAMEWORKERS 验证了以任务为中心、工作空间接地的多智能体框架能够有效解决开放式视频制作中的动态编排难题，为长时程多模态生成任务提供了一种可扩展、可恢复且可泛化的智能化解决方案。

title: MotionSync: Non-Causal Refinement of Causal Tracker for Label-Efficient 3D Perception
summary: Three-dimensional box-and-track annotation is the cost bottleneck in autonomous-driving data engines, and the offline systems built to relieve it replace the online perception stack outright, so a team needing both regimes maintains and reconciles two. MotionSync makes the causal/non-causal boundary an explicit architectural seam instead. A strictly causal tracker, built on a strong published baseline and extended with innovation-driven uncertainty calibration, frame-rate-invariant kinematic association gates, and multi-hypothesis motion with learned mode selection, emits a valid online result. A non-causal pass then revises the buffered trajectories with Rauch--Tung--Striebel smoothing applied separately to pose, extent and yaw, physics-validated gap completion, and semantic pruning of ghost tracks against LiDAR point labels. The refiner never writes back, so one system serves both regimes and refinement's effect is a delta over an unaltered causal estimate. Used as an auto-labeller, a fixed 3D detector trained on 25% human labels plus MotionSync pseudo-labels reaches 96.9% of its full-supervision mean average precision (mAP) on Waymo, and at a 10% budget the non-causal pass accounts for +3.3 mAP/L2 over pseudo-labels from the same tracker's causal stage. Re-fitting the online tracker on its own refined output recovers 73% of the benefit of human supervision, while its causal output is worse supervision than no re-fitting at all. As a tracker MotionSync is at parity with the leading published offline entries on the headline metric and ahead of them on error composition, which is where a refinement pass can act at all: it reduces misses and fragmentations together, the signature of gap completion rather than of a tuned detector.

AI.tldr: MotionSync 将因果/非因果边界作为显式架构接缝：严格因果跟踪器在线的有效输出，由非因果后处理路径（RTS平滑、间隙补全、语义剪枝）修正，从而单系统同时服务在线与离线两种模式。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶数据引擎中三维框-轨迹标注是成本瓶颈；现有离线系统完全替换在线感知栈，导致维护两套系统。需要一个统一框架同时服务在线与离线。
AI.method: 基于强基线构建严格因果跟踪器，加入创新驱动的置信度校准、帧率不变的运动学关联门控、多假设运动与学习模式选择。非因果路径用RTS平滑分别处理位姿、尺寸和偏航，进行物理验证的间隙补全，并依据LiDAR点标签对幽灵轨迹语义剪枝。精化不写回因果输出，因此精化增量叠加于未改变的因果估计之上。
AI.result: 作为自动标注器，251TP人标注加MotionSync伪标签可使固定3D检测器达到全监督mAP的96.9%（Waymo）；10%预算下非因果阶段比因果伪标签提升+3.3 mAP/L2。用精化输出重训练在线跟踪器可恢复人类监督效益的73%，而用因果输出则比不重训练更差。作为跟踪器与领先离线方案在头部指标持平，且在误差构成上更优，同时减少漏检与碎片化。
AI.conclusion: 一个系统可同时服务在线与离线两种模式，精化效果体现为对未改动因果估计的增量；间隙补全而非调优检测器是误差改善的本质，证明该架构在自动标注与跟踪任务上均有实用价值。

title: Perceive to Hypothesize, Verify to Ground: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Open-World Geo-Localization
summary: Open-world geo-localization requires models to reason over ambiguous visual cues through multi-step reasoning and external knowledge grounding. While recent large vision-language models exhibit strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, existing approaches still suffer from perceptual hallucination and context drift due to the lack of explicit evidence-grounded verification. In this work, we reformulate geo-localization as a human-like perceive-then-verify reasoning problem and propose GeoPAVE (Geo-localization Perception-and-Verification-Engine), a bi-level agentic framework that contains perception-based hypothesis generation via single-pass rollouts and verification-based evidence grounding for decision actions: support, refute, and refine. To support rigorous evaluation, we further introduce PAVED, a novel dataset derived from real-world user check-in data, equipped with comprehensive reasoning trajectories featuring multi-hop queries, multi-round tool invocations, and structured perception-verification traces. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Arandinglv/GeoPAVE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoPAVE，一个双层的智能体框架，将开放世界地理定位建模为"先感知后验证"的推理问题，通过基于感知的假设生成和基于证据验证的决策动作（支持、反驳、细化）来缓解现有模型中的感知幻觉和上下文漂移问题；同时引入PAVED数据集，包含从真实用户签到数据中构建的多跳查询、多轮工具调用和结构化感知-验证轨迹。
AI.motivation: 开放世界地理定位需要模型通过多步推理和外部知识接地来推理模糊的视觉线索，但现有大型视觉语言模型虽然具备多模态推理能力，却因缺乏显式的证据接地验证而遭受感知幻觉和上下文漂移问题。
AI.method: 提出GeoPAVE双层级智能体框架：底层通过单次遍历展开（single-pass rollouts）进行基于感知的假设生成；高层通过基于验证的证据接地，对假设执行支持、反驳、细化三种决策动作。
AI.result: 构建了PAVED数据集，源自真实世界用户签到数据，包含全面的推理轨迹，涵盖多跳查询、多轮工具调用以及结构化的感知-验证轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过将地理定位重构为人类式的"先感知后验证"推理问题，并引入双层级框架及配套数据集，为开放世界地理定位提供了更可靠、证据驱动的解决方案。

title: TRINITY: A Multi-Perspective Benchmark for Personal-Style Video Highlight Detection
summary: Traditional video highlight detection relies on a narrow, event-centric definition of saliency, which often fails to generalize to unconstrained personal videos where highlights are heterogeneous and perspective-dependent. To address this, we introduce TRINITY, a multi-perspective benchmark that decomposes highlight saliency into three complementary dimensions, Event, Emotion, and Nature, within a unified temporal framework. Leveraging this multi-faceted view, we propose a shared-backbone multi-branch architecture designed for parallel multi-perspective prediction via view-specific experts. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving gains of +7.15/+3.62 mAP (rho=15%/50%) on Mr. HiSum and +10.82 mAP on YouTube Highlights. These results validate that multi-perspective modeling provides a more robust and comprehensive formulation of video saliency, especially for complex real-world scenarios. The benchmark and relevant codes will be released upon acceptance. The benchmark is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/vanilladucky/TRINITY and the code is available at https://github.com/vanilladucky/TRINITY.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRINITY，一个多视角视频高光检测基准，将显著性分解为事件、情感和自然三个互补维度，并设计共享骨干的多分支架构，通过视角特定专家并行预测，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统视频高光检测依赖于狭窄的、以事件为中心的显著性定义，难以泛化到无约束的个人视频，因为其中的高光具有异质性和视角依赖性。
AI.method: 提出TRINITY基准，将高光显著性分解为事件（Event）、情感（Emotion）和自然（Nature）三个互补维度，置于统一的时间框架内；并基于此提出共享骨干的多分支架构，通过视角特定专家（view-specific experts）实现并行多视角预测。
AI.result: 在Mr. HiSum上取得+7.15/+3.62 mAP（rho=15%/50%）的提升，在YouTube Highlights上取得+10.82 mAP的提升，显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 多视角建模提供了更鲁棒、更全面的视频显著性表达，尤其适用于复杂的真实世界场景。

title: On the Instance Hardness as a Decision Criterion in TinyML Systems
summary: TinyML includes the implementation of machine learning on devices with limited memory and computing resources. With the development of technology, AI systems continue to scale in terms of size and computational requirements. This forces researchers to adapt methods to be environmentally sustainable by designing techniques for reducing computational costs and energy consumption in inferring AI models, even in small devices. In this work, we present preliminary findings on a novel application of the tree depth prune instance hardness method to the TinyML system. The results indicate that threshold control can change energy consumption with limited classification quality changes. This method allows us to adjust classification accuracy, thereby influencing computational complexity and energy consumption for inference. We present a work in progress with initial results as a proof of concept.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将树深度剪枝的实例硬度方法应用于TinyML系统，通过阈值控制来调整分类精度，从而影响计算复杂度和推理能耗，初步结果证明该方法能改变能耗且分类质量变化有限。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统规模不断扩大，计算资源和能耗需求持续增长，需要设计降低推理计算成本和能耗的技术，即便在资源受限的小型设备（TinyML）上也应实现环境可持续性。
AI.method: 将树深度剪枝的实例硬度方法（tree depth prune instance hardness）应用于TinyML系统，通过阈值控制来调节分类精度，进而影响推理过程中的计算复杂度和能耗。
AI.result: 初步结果表明，阈值控制可以在分类质量变化有限的情况下改变能耗，实现了精度、计算复杂度和能耗之间的权衡调节。
AI.conclusion: 本研究作为概念验证的工作进展，证明了该方法的可行性，为TinyML系统在资源受限环境下的能效优化提供了新思路，但尚属初步成果，有待进一步研究。

title: Guardrail-Agnostic Societal Bias Evaluation in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: We propose a societal bias evaluation method for large vision-language models (LVLMs) in the era of strong safety guardrails. Existing benchmarks rely on prompts that ask models to infer attributes of people in images (e.g., "Is this person a CEO or a secretary?"). However, we find that LVLMs with strong guardrails, such as GPT and Claude, often refuse these prompts, making evaluations unreliable. To address this, we change the prior evaluation paradigm by decoupling the task from the depicted person: instead of inferring person's attributes, we use prompts that do not ask about the person (e.g., "Write a fictional story about an imaginary person.") and attach the image as provisional user information to implicitly provide demographic cues, then compare outputs across user demographics. Instantiated across three tasks --- story generation, term explanation, and exam-style QA --- our method avoids refusals even in guardrailed LVLMs, enabling reliable bias measurement. Applying it to 20 recent LVLMs, both open-source and proprietary, we find that all models undesirably use user demographic information in person-irrelevant tasks; for instance, characters in stories are often portrayed as mechanic for male users and nurse for female users. Although still biased, proprietary models like GPT-5 show lower bias than open-source ones. We analyze potential factors behind this gap, discussing continuous model monitoring and improvement as a possible contributor for reducing bias.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对具有强安全护栏的大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的社会偏见评估方法。该方法通过将任务与图像中的人物解耦（不直接询问人物属性，而是将图像作为隐含的人口统计线索附加在人物无关的任务中），避免了强护栏模型的拒答问题，实现了可靠的偏见测量。在20个近期LVLMs上的实验显示，所有模型都会在人物无关任务中不当地使用用户人口统计信息，且专有模型（如GPT-5）的偏见低于开源模型。文中还分析了这一差距的潜在因素。
AI.motivation: 现有偏见基准依赖直接询问模型推断图像中人物属性的提示（如"这个人是CEO还是秘书？"），但具有强安全护栏的LVLMs（如GPT、Claude）往往拒绝回答这类提示，导致评估不可靠。因此需要一种能绕过拒答问题的新评估范式。
AI.method: 将评估任务与图像中的人物解耦：不再询问人物自身属性，而是使用不涉及人物的提示（如"写一个关于虚构人物的故事"），将图像作为附加的临时用户信息以隐含方式提供人口统计线索，然后比较不同用户人口统计特征下的输出差异。该方法在三个任务上实例化：故事生成、术语解释和考试式问答。
AI.result: 在20个近期LVLMs（包括开源和专有模型）上的实验表明：所有模型都会在人物无关任务中不当地使用用户人口统计信息（例如，男用户的故事角色常被描绘为机械师，女用户的则常为护士）；专有模型如GPT-5虽然仍有偏见但低于开源模型。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的解耦评估方法能够规避强护栏模型的拒答问题，从而可靠地测量偏见。研究发现所有主流LVLMs均存在基于用户人口统计信息的偏见，且模型之间存在差异；持续监控和改进可能是降低偏见的关键因素之一。

title: AcrossWAM1.0:A Modular Latent World-Action Stack for Compact Robot Policies
summary: Latent world-action models avoid rendering future pixels by predicting an action-relevant visual subgoal in feature space. LaWAM established this formulation, but its original presentation left the world model, multimodal backbone, and deployment checkpoint tightly coupled. We introduce AcrossWAM1.0, a modularization and scaling study of this latent world-action stack. Rather than presenting latent subgoals as a new algorithm, we make the module boundary explicit: a policy adapter produces latent-action and action-generation contexts; a retained latent world decoder grounds the predicted transition in the current scene;and a flow-matching expert generates continuous action chunks. We further separate training-only teachers from the inference graph and provide a verifiable deployment export. On 2,000 paired LIBERO episodes, replacing a Qwen3-VL-2B backbone with Qwen3.5-0.8B yields 97.45% success versus 98.00% for the 2B model (a-0.55percentage-point difference; exact McNemarp=0.266). This does not prove equivalence, but it meets a prespecified two-point retention criterion. The compact, inference-reachable checkpoint contains 1,472.6M unique parameters, 42.4% fewer than the original 2B policy, while all retained tensors are bitwise identical to the source checkpoint. Cross-family execution is additionally checked with a MiniCPM-V adapter smoke test; closed-loop cross-family transfer remains an open evaluation. AcrossWAM1.0 therefore contributes an auditable software and evaluation boundary for compact latent world-action policies, distinct from LaWAM's original latent-subgoal contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AcrossWAM1.0，对潜在世界-动作模型（LaWAM）进行模块化与缩放研究。通过解耦世界模型、多模态主干和部署检查点，显式定义模块边界，并验证了在LIBERO任务上使用更小的0.8B骨干网络可达到与2B模型相当的97.45%成功率，同时部署检查点参数减少42.4%。
AI.motivation: 原版LaWAM将世界模型、多模态主干和部署检查点紧密耦合，缺乏清晰的模块边界，限制了模型的模块化复用、缩放研究和部署灵活性。作者希望通过模块化重构，使潜在世界-动作模型更易审计、可验证且更紧凑。
AI.method: AcrossWAM1.0采用显式模块边界设计：(1) 策略适配器生成潜在动作和动作生成上下文；(2) 保留的潜在世界解码器将预测的转移动态锚定在当前场景中；(3) 流匹配专家生成连续动作块。此外，将仅训练用的教师模型从推理图中分离，并提供可验证的部署导出。通过用Qwen3.5-0.8B替换Qwen3-VL-2B主干进行缩放研究，并用MiniCPM-V适配器进行跨家族烟雾测试。
AI.result: 在2,000个配对的LIBERO episodes上，0.8B模型达到97.45%成功率，2B模型为98.00%（差异-0.55个百分点，McNemar p=0.266），满足预设的两点保留标准。紧凑推理检查点含1,472.6M唯一参数，比原始2B策略减少42.4%，所有保留张量与源检查点逐位一致。跨家族MiniCPM-V适配器烟雾测试通过，但闭环跨家族迁移仍需评估。
AI.conclusion: AcrossWAM1.0贡献了一个可审计的软件与评估边界，用于构建紧凑的潜在世界-动作策略，与LaWAM原始的潜在子目标贡献在定位上有所区分。结果表明小模型在统计上不劣于大模型，但并未证明两者等价。

title: SnapBench: Benchmarking Snap-and-Ask Multimodal Retrieval for Mobile Interactions
comment: 37 pages. Yuanbao Technical Report. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Mobile AI acts as a visual oracle, empowering users to snap a picture of something and ask for information. Snap-and-ask retrieval is now one of the most common entry points for mobile AI, yet photos are often blurry, while text questions may be short or mistyped. Existing benchmarks only test on clean inputs or do not isolate paired robustness in snap-and-ask retrieval. Therefore, we introduce SnapBench, the first paired benchmark for robust snap-and-ask multimodal retrieval, spanning 1,145 queries, 9,085 gallery items under 53 controlled corruption conditions with human annotations. We evaluate 16 multimodal retrievers, covering dual-tower encoders and embedding-based VLMs. Results show that image corruptions substantially degrade retrieval, while text corruptions mainly affect text-only retrieval and have limited impact on joint retrieval. Clean image-only retrieval often outperforms joint retrieval, indicating the coarse-text drag and the lack of cross-modal fallback under noisy inputs. SnapBench provides a controlled testbed for evaluating robust retrieval in snap-and-ask scenarios. We further propose MOOR (Modality-anchored, Outlier-aware, Optimal Reweighting), a simple adaptive fusion approach, highlighting the need for reliability-aware modality calibration in snap-and-ask retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SnapBench，首个针对"拍照即问"（snap-and-ask）多模态检索的配对鲁棒性基准，涵盖1,145个查询、9,085个图库条目及53种受控损坏条件。评估16种多模态检索器后发现：图像损坏会显著降低检索性能，而文本损坏对联合检索影响有限；纯图像检索往往优于联合检索。文章还提出MOOR（模态锚定、离群感知、最优重加权）自适应融合方法，强调可靠性感知的模态校准。
AI.motivation: 移动端AI（如拍照询问）已成为常见入口，但真实场景中照片常模糊、文本常简短或拼写错误。现有基准只在干净输入上测试，且未隔离"拍照即问"检索中的配对鲁棒性问题，缺乏对真实噪声条件下多模态检索的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建SnapBench配对鲁棒性基准（53种受控损坏条件+人工标注），从双塔编码器和基于嵌入的VLM两类中选取16种多模态检索器进行评估；提出MOOR自适应融合方法，通过模态锚定、离群点感知和最优重加权实现可靠性感知的模态校准。
AI.result: 图像损坏显著降低检索性能；文本损坏主要影响纯文本检索，对联合检索影响有限；干净条件下的纯图像检索往往优于联合检索，揭示粗粒度文本拖累和缺乏跨模态回退的问题。
AI.conclusion: SnapBench为"拍照即问"场景提供了受控的鲁棒检索测试平台，MOOR方法表明需要重视可靠性感知的模态校准来提升真实场景下的鲁棒检索性能。

title: Spatial Matryoshka Training for Multi-Granularity Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Multi-modal late-interaction retrievers achieve strong retrieval on visually rich documents by representing each page as per patch embeddings and matching at the token level. However, this approach incurs high storage costs. Existing compression methods typically fix a single compression level at indexing time, limiting flexibility. We present ColSNAP (Spatial Nested Average Pooling)1, a training method that generates a nested hierarchy of compression levels directly from a backbone's patch grid. By spatially pooling patch embeddings into pro- gressively coarser tiers and training all tiers simultaneously, a single model learns to support retrieval at multiple compression levels without architectural changes. Crucially, a single encoding pass yields every tier, enabling the accuracy-storage trade-off to be configured at indexing time to match avail- able storage budgets, rather than being fixed during training. We demonstrate that models trained using ColSNAP maintain near full-resolution retrieval performance under substantial compression and that ColSNAP transfers effectively across multiple late-interaction backbones, and achieves most of its improvements via a lightweight adaptation stage applied to a pre-trained retriever.

AI.tldr: ColSNAP是一种针对多模态晚期交互检索器的训练方法，通过空间嵌套平均池化在单一模型中生成多层级压缩表示，允许在索引时灵活配置精度-存储权衡，同时保持接近全分辨率的检索性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态晚期交互检索器在视觉丰富文档上表现优异，但每个页面的patch嵌入存储成本高昂。现有压缩方法在索引时固定单一压缩级别，缺乏灵活性，无法适应不同存储预算需求。
AI.method: ColSNAP直接从骨干网络的patch网格中生成嵌套的压缩层级：通过空间平均池化将patch嵌入逐步粗化，同时训练所有层级，使单一模型无需架构改动即可支持多种压缩级别的检索。关键优势是单次编码即可获得所有层级，精度-存储权衡可在索引时配置。
AI.result: ColSNAP训练的模型在显著压缩下仍能保持接近全分辨率的检索性能，且方法能有效迁移到多种晚期交互骨干网络，大部分改进通过轻量级适配阶段应用于预训练检索器实现。
AI.conclusion: ColSNAP提供了一种灵活且高效的解决方案，让存储预算在索引时动态决定，而非在训练时固定，在保持检索性能的同时大幅降低存储成本。

title: nnMNet: Baseline for Martian Terrain Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation is a crucial task for understanding Mars, the most Earth-like planet in our solar system. However, it is challenging because the Martian surface is highly unstructured and complex, making accurate pixel-level prediction and fine-grained annotation difficult. Recent advancements in deep learning have introduced numerous methods and datasets to address these challenges. Nevertheless, the field lacks a robust, publicly available, and reproducible baseline, as well as a unified benchmark to facilitate fair evaluations. In this work, we present nnMNet, a new baseline model designed for Martian terrain semantic segmentation. Building upon nnWNet, we integrate linear attention to better capture global context and employ lightweight convolutions to reduce computational overhead. To bridge the gap between local and global representations, we introduce the Spatially-Aware Fusion Block (SAFB), which augments and combines features with diverse characteristics. Furthermore, we establish a new benchmark by curating and standardizing three high-quality datasets for thorough evaluation. nnMNet achieves new state-of-the-art 86.61%, 83.25%, and 88.24% mIoU on SynMars-TW, SynMars-Air, and MarsScapes, respectively. Our code, models, and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/dereklee0310/nnMNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出nnMNet，一个用于火星地形语义分割的新基线模型，并建立了统一基准数据集。模型基于nnWNet，融合线性注意力与轻量卷积，并引入空间感知融合块（SAFB）。在三个数据集上取得SOTA成绩（SynMars-TW 86.61%、SynMars-Air 83.25%、MarsScapes 88.24% mIoU），代码与数据均已开源。
AI.motivation: 火星表面高度非结构化且复杂，像素级预测和细粒度标注困难；现有深度学习方法和数据集虽多，但缺乏稳健、公开、可复现的基线和统一基准，无法进行公平评测。
AI.method: 在nnWNet基础上：(1) 集成线性注意力以更好地捕获全局上下文；(2) 使用轻量卷积降低计算开销；(3) 提出空间感知融合块（SAFB），增强并融合具有不同特征的表示，弥合局部与全局表征之间的差距；(4) 整理并标准化三个高质量数据集建立统一基准。
AI.result: nnMNet在SynMars-TW、SynMars-Air和MarsScapes上分别取得86.61%、83.25%和88.24%的mIoU，均达到新的最先进水平。代码、模型和数据集已公开。
AI.conclusion: nnMNet为火星地形语义分割提供了稳健且可复现的基线，同时通过统一基准促进了该领域的公平比较，有效推动了火星场景理解研究的发展。

title: SearchWiki: Learning to Build and Navigate Knowledge Wikis for Active Information Seeking
summary: Flat retrieval-augmented generation treats a corpus as a bag of chunks, discarding document hierarchy and cross document structure. We introduce SearchWiki, a harness framework that synthesizes a corpus into a hierarchical, typed, navigable wiki and trains an agent, WikiResearcher-9B, to retrieve information through multi-turn tool use. The wiki organizes knowledge into three layers - document overviews, cross- document topic pages, and page-level source records; enabling progressive refinement of retrieval when initial lookup misses. We optimize the agent's navigation policy with on-policy reinforcement learning with a multi-component reward function balancing answer correctness, retrieval quality and trajectory efficiency. Evaluation on ViDoRe-V3 (8 domains), FinanceBench, and memory benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, PersonaMem-v2) shows that WikiResearcher- 9B which is our RL-tuned Qwen 9B model, significantly outperforms same-size untrained baselines and exceeds or matches larger external models. SearchWiki paired with WikiResearcher-9B demonstrates that learned navigation over structured corpora is a superior alternative to flat retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SearchWiki框架，将语料库合成为分层、类型化、可导航的wiki结构，并训练WikiResearcher-9B智能体通过多轮工具调用来检索信息。实验表明该方法显著优于同等规模的扁平检索基线，甚至超越更大的外部模型。
AI.motivation: 扁平检索增强生成（RAG）将语料库视为块的集合，忽略了文档层级结构以及跨文档结构。这种扁平化处理丢失了文档间的组织关系和语义关联，导致检索效率和信息完整性受限。
AI.method: 1) 构建SearchWiki框架，将语料合成三层wiki结构：文档概览、跨文档主题页、页面级源记录，支持渐进式检索精化。2) 训练WikiResearcher-9B智能体（基于Qwen 9B），通过多轮工具调用导航检索。3) 使用on-policy强化学习优化导航策略，采用多组件奖励函数平衡答案正确性、检索质量和轨迹效率。
AI.result: 在ViDoRe-V3（8个领域）、FinanceBench及记忆基准（LoCoMo、LongMemEval、PersonaMem-v2）上的评估显示，WikiResearcher-9B显著优于同规模未训练基线，并达到或超过更大的外部模型。
AI.conclusion: SearchWiki与WikiResearcher-9B的结合证明，对结构化语料的习得式导航是优于扁平检索的可行方案，展现出利用语料内在结构来增强检索增强生成的潜力。

title: See the Change, Keep the Flow: Unsupervised Action Segmentation via Spectral-Temporal Representation Learning
summary: Unsupervised action segmentation aims to discover latent action categories and their temporal organization without action annotations. Optimal transport-based methods provide structured frame-to-action assignments, however, their pseudo-label quality is fundamentally conditioned on the representation space used to construct the transport cost. We argue that reliable OT pseudo-labeling requires a representation geometry that is simultaneously sensitive to discriminative action changes and coherent along local temporal progressions. Based on this insight, we propose SpecT-OT, a spectral-temporal representation learning framework built upon an unbalanced optimal transport pseudo-labeling concept. SpecT-OT introduces a Spectral Reparameterization Projector (SRP), which parameterizes projector weights with fixed Fourier bases and learnable coefficients to improve the modeling of rapidly varying discriminative features, and Temporal Affinity Regularization (TAR), which imposes distance-aware, label-free constraints on pairwise frame affinities to stabilize local temporal structure. The two components jointly produce more discriminative and temporally stable transport costs, yielding more reliable pseudo-labels for iterative representation learning. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong performance compared with state-of-the-art methods. SpecT-OT achieves the best results on 13 of 15 metrics, including 4.1-point MoF and 7.4-point F1 gains over the baseline on Breakfast and Desktop Assembly, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpecT-OT，一种基于光谱-时间表示学习的无监督动作分割框架，通过光谱重参数化投影器（SRP）和时间亲和正则化（TAR）改进最优传输（OT）伪标签的质量，在四个基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于最优传输的无监督动作分割方法中，伪标签质量受限于构造传输代价的表示空间。可靠的OT伪标签需要同时具备判别性动作变化的敏感性以及局部时间进展的一致性，而现有方法未能同时满足这两个要求。
AI.method: 1) 光谱重参数化投影器（SRP）：用固定傅里叶基和可学习系数参数化投影器权重，改善快速变化判别性特征的建模；2) 时间亲和正则化（TAR）：对成对帧亲和度施加距离感知、无标签约束，稳定局部时间结构。两者联合产生更具判别性和时间稳定性的传输代价，生成更可靠的伪标签用于迭代表示学习。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，13/15个指标达到最佳。在Breakfast上MoF提升4.1点，在Desktop Assembly上F1提升7.4点。
AI.conclusion: 同时兼顾光谱判别性和时间一致性的表示学习能显著提升OT伪标签质量，从而提升无监督动作分割性能。

title: Review Before Trust: Source-Grounded Integrity Gates for AI-Assisted Personal Health Records
summary: Large language models can convert medical documents into structured data, but plausible output may still be unsupported by the source. Persisting such output in a longitudinal health record, a record that accumulates patient information over time, therefore creates an integrity risk: unverified data may influence later summaries, trends, or preventive-care computations. We introduce an evidence-gated trust-promotion model that keeps generated data provisional until a deterministic monitor verifies it against the source document. The monitor admits a candidate for a specified downstream use only when the source contains a unique supporting quotation, the relevant fields occur within the same laboratory row, and the required provenance is preserved. The generator cannot approve its own output, missing or ambiguous evidence causes refusal, and refused candidates remain available for human review rather than being silently discarded. We implement the model in Medical DataCloud, a personal health-record application, and evaluate it through automated tests and a replay of saved extraction outputs. All 22 conformance and mutation tests pass. The replay covers nine historical laboratory PDF reports containing 102 manually labelled rows. The reports produce 97 numeric candidates: schema validation accepts all 97, an earlier packet-level evidence check accepts 94, and the hardened quotation- and row-level policy admits 72 while retaining 25 for review. The study evaluates system integrity rather than clinical correctness or clinical safety. The results demonstrate the technical feasibility of an enforceable boundary that prevents generated claims from authorizing their own reuse in a longitudinal health record.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种证据门控的信任提升模型，用于长程健康记录中，确保大语言模型生成的医疗数据在通过确定性监视器验证之前保持临时状态，防止未经证实的输出污染后续的总结、趋势和预防性护理计算。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可将医疗文档转换为结构化数据，但其输出可能是看似合理却未被源文档支持的。在长程健康记录中持久化此类数据会产生完整性风险，因为未经验证的数据可能影响后期摘要、趋势或预防性护理计算。
AI.method: 提出证据门控的信任提升模型：生成的数据保持临时状态，直到确定性监视器对照源文档验证。监视器仅在源文档包含唯一支持性引文、相关字段出现在同一实验室行内、且保留所需溯源信息时才接纳候选数据。生成器不能批准自己的输出，证据缺失或模糊时拒绝，被拒绝的候选数据保留供人工审查而非静默丢弃。在Medical DataCloud个人健康记录应用中实现并评估。
AI.result: 全部22项符合性和变异测试通过。回放覆盖9份历史实验室PDF报告（102个手动标记行），产生97个数值候选：schema验证全部接受97个，早期包级证据检查接受94个，强化后的引文和行级策略接受72个并保留25个供审查。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了可执行边界的技术可行性，该边界可防止生成的声明在长程健康记录中授权其自身被重用。本研究评估的是系统完整性而非临床正确性或临床安全性。

title: CineForge: Self-Improving Agents for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon story-driven video generation requires a production agent to coordinate narrative decomposition, state tracking, shot design, prompt construction, rendering, and revision across interdependent scenes. Existing adaptive video systems primarily refine requests or reusable skills, leaving recurring production failures disconnected from persistent, stage-targeted improvements across stories. We introduce CineForge, a self-evolving video-production agent framework that couples CineForge-Produce for video generation with CineForge-Evolve for cross-story policy evolution. CineForge-Produce organizes each source story into typed narrative, character, spatial, and cinematic states, uses them to coordinate asset and clip generation, and records the process as a canonical production trajectory. CineForge-Evolve applies Case-to-Pattern-to-Policy Evolution (CPPE) to review trajectory evidence, consolidate recurrent findings into bounded stage-local patches, and deploy validated updates through structural replay and confidence-controlled paired evaluation. To measure complete story realization, we introduce CineScope, which combines a 100-script CineScope-Data suite with a human-aligned, multiscale CineScope-Metric spanning causal state, directorial orchestration, pacing and resource allocation, and character arc. Across CineScope-Data and two public benchmarks, the evolved CineForge policy improves CineScope-Metric from 4.024 to 4.380, outperforms three long-video baselines with consistent gains under ScriptAgent, and reduces review LLM calls by 37.0% on new stories. These results establish production trajectories as actionable experience for video agents that improve cumulatively across long-form storytelling tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CineForge，一个自我进化的视频制作智能体框架，通过CineForge-Produce进行视频生成、CineForge-Evolve进行跨故事策略进化，并引入CineScope评测体系，实现了长故事视频生成的持续改进，CineScope指标从4.024提升到4.380，同时减少了37.0%的评审调用。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应视频系统主要精炼请求或可复用技能，未能将反复出现的制作失败与跨故事的、针对阶段性的持久改进联系起来。长周期故事驱动视频生成需要生产智能体协调叙事分解、状态追踪、镜头设计、提示词构建、渲染和修改等多个环节，但缺乏系统性地从过去故事中积累经验的机制。
AI.method: CineForge框架由两部分组成：(1) CineForge-Produce将源故事组织为类型化的叙事、角色、空间和电影状态，协调资产与片段生成，并记录为规范的生产轨迹；(2) CineForge-Evolve采用案例到模式到策略进化（CPPE），审查轨迹证据，将反复出现的发现整合为有界的阶段局部补丁，通过结构重放和置信度控制的配对评估部署验证过的更新。同时引入CineScope评测体系，包含100个脚本的CineScope-Data套件和覆盖因果状态、导演编排、节奏与资源分配、角色弧线等多尺度的人机对齐指标。
AI.result: 在CineScope-Data和两个公开基准上，进化后的CineForge策略将CineScope-Metric从4.024提升到4.380，在ScriptAgent下超越了三个长视频基线且增益一致，并在新故事上减少了37.0%的评审LLM调用。
AI.conclusion: 生产轨迹可以作为视频智能体的可操作经验，使视频智能体能够在长篇叙事任务中累积性改进，这是迈向长故事视频生成自我进化系统的重要一步。

title: EDGE: Engine for Deterministic Graph Evaluation through Conversation Simulation from Graph Structured DSL Configuration
summary: As agentic systems evolve into complex multi agent orchestration workflows, there is a growing and critical need for systematic frameworks that measures an agent's behavioral consistency and determinism. In this paper, we introduce a formal evaluation methodology that is grounded in AgentGraph, a planner powered by a domain specific language that represents agent reasoning through a dynamically adjustable directed graph. We leverage this structural formalism and utilize graph traversal algorithms that exhaustively enumerate conversational paths, forming a comprehensive evaluation set that captures the agent's complete behavioral space. We then systematically replay these reproducible trajectories to compare observed outputs and state transitions against the intended DSL specification. To quantify reliability, we define novel metrics that measure response and trajectory determinism, structural adherence and semantic consistency across both exact replays and their linguistic variants. Our system's results demonstrate that agents configured using frameworks like AgentGraph and LangGraph with explicitly structured node transitions show superior determinism over agents that are not configured with controlled transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于AgentGraph（一种由DSL驱动的agent规划器）的正式评估方法论，通过图遍历算法穷举会话路径，形成覆盖agent完整行为空间的评估集，并引入新颖的指标量化响应确定性、轨迹确定性、结构一致性和语义一致性，以系统衡量多agent编排工作流中agent的行为一致性与确定性。
AI.motivation: 随着agent系统演变为复杂的多agent编排工作流，迫切需要系统化的框架来衡量agent的行为一致性和确定性。现有的评估方法缺乏对行为可复现性和结构稳定性的系统性度量。
AI.method: 1. 基于AgentGraph（由DSL驱动的规划器，通过动态可调的有向图表示agent推理）构建形式化评估框架；2. 利用图遍历算法穷举列举会话路径，生成覆盖完整行为空间的综合评估集；3. 系统性地重放这些可复现轨迹，将观测输出与状态转换与预期的DSL规范进行比较；4. 定义新颖指标：响应确定性、轨迹确定性、结构一致性和语义一致性，同时涵盖精确重放和语言变体。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用AgentGraph和LangGraph等显式结构化节点转换框架配置的agent，比未使用受控转换配置的agent表现出更优的确定性。
AI.conclusion: 基于显式结构转换配置的agent框架能提供更优越的行为确定性与一致性，验证了该形式化评估方法论的有效性。

title: SPLG-Mamba: Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network for Salient Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images
summary: Salient object detection in optical remote sensing images (ORSI-SOD) requires dense predictions that preserve object completeness and structural continuity under complex backgrounds, scale variation, and irregular object shapes. Existing methods often localize salient regions, but their predictions may still suffer from structural degradation, including fragmented, incomplete, or locally missing foreground responses. This degradation is closely related to hierarchical feature propagation, where shallow details can introduce texture-induced background responses, deep semantics may over-smooth weak structures, and uncontrolled cross-scale fusion can disturb coherent regions. To address this issue, we propose a novel Structure-Preserving Local-Global Mamba Network, SPLG-Mamba, for ORSI-SOD. Specifically, SPLG-Mamba integrates Smooth-Detail Recalibration (SDR), hierarchy-aware Local-Global Mamba, and Gated Cross-Scale Fusion (GCSF). SDR recalibrates smoothed responses and detail residuals before state-space modeling, Local-Global Mamba assigns local modeling to shallow feature levels and global modeling to deep feature levels, and GCSF controls cross-scale detail injection during decoding. Experiments on ORSSD, EORSSD, and ORSI-4199 demonstrate state-of-the-art results and improved structural completeness and continuity. The code is available at https://github.com/yxu9910/SPLG-Mamba

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPLG-Mamba网络，用于光学遥感图像显著目标检测（ORSI-SOD），通过整合Smooth-Detail Recalibration、层次感知的Local-Global Mamba和Gated Cross-Scale Fusion，解决预测中的结构退化问题（前景破碎、不完整、局部缺失），在三个数据集上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有ORSI-SOD方法虽能定位显著区域，但在复杂背景、尺度变化和不规则目标形状下，预测常出现结构退化，表现为前景碎片化、不完整或局部缺失。这种退化与层级特征传播密切相关：浅层细节引入纹理导致的背景响应，深层语义过度平滑弱结构，不受控的跨尺度融合干扰一致区域。
AI.method: 提出SPLG-Mamba网络，包含三个核心模块：1) Smooth-Detail Recalibration (SDR)：在状态空间建模前重新校准平滑响应和细节残差；2) 层次感知的Local-Global Mamba：浅层特征级别分配局部建模，深层特征级别分配全局建模；3) Gated Cross-Scale Fusion (GCSF)：在解码过程中控制跨尺度细节注入。
AI.result: 在ORSSD、EORSSD和ORSI-4199三个公开数据集上取得state-of-the-art结果，显著提升了预测的结构完整性和连续性。
AI.conclusion: SPLG-Mamba通过针对性的层级建模策略和受控的特征融合机制，有效缓解了ORSI-SOD中的结构退化问题，验证了Mamba架构在遥感显著目标检测中的潜力，代码已开源。

title: An Open-Source, Event-Driven Pipeline for Cryptocurrency Market Data: Ingestion, Forecasting, and On-Chain Fraud Detection
summary: Cryptocurrency markets generate high-frequency, multi-source data that is expensive to work with unless a team already has commercial-grade streaming and warehousing infrastructure in place. This paper describes a fully open-source pipeline that reproduces the behavior of a cloud-native, event-driven system -- file arrival triggering a message, a message triggering compute -- entirely on commodity hardware, using Apache Kafka and a filesystem-watching poller in place of managed cloud triggers. The pipeline partitions historical Gemini exchange data into hourly and minutely files, ingests them asynchronously through two independently grouped Kafka consumers (one for audit logging, one for Spark-triggered ETL), and lands cleaned output in a PostgreSQL warehouse with historical and aggregated schemas plus asset-specific data marts. We use the resulting Bitcoin data mart to compare a seasonal ARIMA model against a single-layer LSTM network for price forecasting, and separately apply Random Forest and Gradient Boosting classifiers, with additional engineered features, to the public Ethereum fraud detection benchmark introduced by Farrugia et al. We report the architecture, the modeling methodology, and the resulting metrics, and we are explicit about the limitations of comparing forecasts issued at different horizons and of evaluating fraud detection on a static, already-labeled dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套完全开源的加密货币数据处理管道，在普通硬件上使用Apache Kafka和文件系统监控替代云端事件驱动架构，将Gemini交易数据分区导入并清洗至PostgreSQL仓库，随后分别用ARIMA/LSTM做比特币价格预测、用随机森林和梯度提升做以太坊欺诈检测。
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场产生高频、多源数据，传统上需要商业级的流处理和仓储基础设施才能高效处理，成本高昂，缺乏开源替代方案。
AI.method: 构建开源管道：文件到达触发消息、消息触发计算的云原生事件驱动模式，用Apache Kafka和文件系统监控轮询器在普通硬件上复现；将历史Gemini数据分区为小时和分钟级文件，通过两组独立Kafka消费者（审计日志和Spark触发ETL）异步摄入，清洗后落地到PostgreSQL仓库（含历史和聚合schema及资产特定数据集市）；建模方面用季节性ARIMA与单层LSTM对比比特币价格预测，用随机森林和梯度提升（含工程特征）做以太坊欺诈检测。
AI.result: 报告了架构设计、建模方法和指标体系，包括比特币价格预测和以太坊欺诈检测的评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 文章明确指出了局限性：预测长度不同导致的对比局限，以及在静态已标注数据集上评估欺诈检测的局限性。

title: Conducting Stylistic Analysis of Paintings through an Art-History Agent
summary: Attributing an artwork to an artist has traditionally relied on detailed visual observations and descriptions, known as stylistic analysis in art history. By contrast, current artificial intelligence (AI) models used in the field offer only unexplained probabilistic classifications. To bridge this methodological gap, we present an AI framework that automates stylistic analysis of paintings, providing a foundation for enhancing evidence collection, discovery, and verification. By training a vision transformer (ViT) on a large corpus of paintings with metadata, our system encodes this art history-specific data as embeddings. These representations are factorized via sparse dictionary learning into a shared set of features that recur across the training set. A large language model (LLM) then interprets each feature by retrieving associated artworks and their accompanying curator-written texts, and synthesizes them into descriptions that reflect their stylistic attributes. Finally, an autonomous coordinator LLM applies a reasoning-and-action (ReAct) framework to weight, test, and refine these features into cohesive descriptions of an artwork, or comparisons of artworks. This approach converts detailed visual features into descriptive terms, addressing a key challenge in art history. It thus connects the use of images as data with the semantic concerns of humanists, establishing vision-based computational art history as an area for future growth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个AI框架，将视觉Transformer与稀疏字典学习、大型语言模型相结合，自动化艺术品风格分析，将视觉特征转化为可解释的描述性术语，弥合AI概率分类与艺术史风格分析之间的方法论鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 传统艺术史通过视觉观察进行风格分析，而当前的AI模型仅提供无法解释的概率分类，两者之间存在方法论鸿沟，缺乏可解释的自动化风格分析工具。
AI.method: 系统包含四个核心组件：(1) 在大型绘画语料库上训练视觉Transformer (ViT) 生成嵌入；(2) 通过稀疏字典学习将嵌入分解为可复现的共享特征；(3) 大型语言模型 (LLM) 检索关联艺术品及策展文本，综合生成风格描述；(4) 自主协调LLM应用ReAct框架对特征进行加权、测试和精炼，生成连贯的艺术品描述或比较。
AI.result: 该框架成功将详细的视觉特征转化为描述性术语，自动化了艺术史风格分析流程，支持证据收集、发现与验证。
AI.conclusion: 该方法弥合了图像数据与人文语义关切之间的鸿沟，确立了基于视觉的计算艺术史作为未来增长领域的地位。

title: AutoCRAT: Within-trajectory Joint Control of Stochasticity and Compute for LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, which depends critically on inference-time decisions. Yet these decisions are commonly handled by static, one-size-fits-all policies, limiting adaptation to diverse tasks and reasoning stages. Recent adaptive methods partially address this limitation, but they primarily adapt either decoding stochasticity (how the model explores) or reasoning compute (how long the model reasons) in isolation, leaving their interaction within a single reasoning trajectory unmodeled. To address this challenge, we shift toward a within-trajectory joint control view, and instantiate it in AutoCRAT, a decoder-side controller for frozen backbones. Using only signals available during decoding, AutoCRAT jointly adjusts sampling stochasticity and reasoning budget during generation. AutoCRAT operates over a discrete action space and updates control decisions only at semantic boundaries, improving stability while remaining responsive to the evolving reasoning process. Comprehensive evaluation across 6 benchmarks demonstrates that AutoCRAT (I) uses 13.8-52.7% fewer inference tokens on average than recommended static configurations, (II) surpasses recommended static and adaptive baselines by 1.5-4.5% in relative accuracy, and (III) enjoys strong cross-backbone transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoCRAT，一个解码器侧控制器，能够在单个推理轨迹内联合调整采样随机性和推理预算，实现在冻结LLM骨干上的自适应推理控制。
AI.motivation: LLM的推理性能严重依赖推理时的决策，但现有方法通常采用静态的一刀切策略；最近的适应性方法仅单独调整解码随机性或推理计算量，未建模两者在单一推理轨迹内的交互作用。
AI.method: AutoCRAT是一种解码器侧控制器，仅利用解码过程中可获得的信号，在生成过程中联合调整采样随机性和推理预算。它在离散动作空间上操作，仅在语义边界处更新控制决策，以提高稳定性同时保持对推理过程的响应性。
AI.result: 在6个基准上的全面评估显示：比推荐静态配置平均节省13.8-52.7%的推理token；在相对准确率上超越推荐静态和自适应基线1.5-4.5%；并具有强跨骨干可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: AutoCRAT通过轨迹内联合控制视角，有效解决了静态策略和孤立适应方法的局限，实现了更高效且更准确的推理控制，且具备良好的跨模型迁移能力。

title: PhysVR: Vision-Language Model Guided Interference-aware Temporal Feature Refinement for Remote Physiological Measurement
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological measurement from facial videos, yet its subtle pulse-related variations are easily affected by illumination variation, head motion, facial blur, and region-of-interest instability. Existing methods mainly suppress interference during feature learning, while whether the learned temporal features remain affected by interference and how to further suppress such interference before rPPG estimation are rarely examined. To address this limitation, we propose PhysVR, a vision-language model guided interference-aware temporal feature refinement framework for rPPG estimation. Specifically, a physiological backbone produces global temporal features and a coarse rPPG prediction, from which signal-derived physiological reliability evidence is constructed from local temporal characteristics. In parallel, a frozen vision-language model processes sampled facial frames under an interference-oriented prompt, and an evidence head extracts visual interference evidence from the VLM output. Temporal cross-attention integrates the physiological and visual evidence with the global temporal features to construct interference-aware temporal context. Guided by this context, a shared temporal correction unit performs general refinement, while four interference-specific experts selectively suppress different interference through adaptive routing. The refined temporal features are then used for final rPPG estimation. Extensive experiments on five public benchmarks demonstrate that PhysVR consistently outperforms representative methods under both intra-dataset and cross-dataset evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: PhysVR提出了一种基于视觉-语言模型引导的干扰感知时间特征细化框架，用于远程光电容积描记（rPPG）估计。该方法通过VLM提取视觉干扰证据，结合生理可靠性证据，利用时间交叉注意力构建干扰感知上下文，并通过共享校正单元与四个干扰专属专家进行选择性特征细化，在五个公开数据集上取得了优于现有方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有rPPG方法主要在特征学习过程中抑制干扰，但很少检验学习到的时间特征是否仍受干扰影响，以及如何在rPPG估计前进一步抑制此类干扰。这一空白促使作者提出了干扰感知的时间特征细化框架。
AI.method: PhysVR包含以下核心组件：(1)生理骨干网络生成全局时间特征和粗略rPPG预测，并从中构建信号衍生的生理可靠性证据；(2)冻结的视觉-语言模型在干扰导向提示下处理采样面部帧，证据头从VLM输出中提取视觉干扰证据；(3)时间交叉注意力整合生理与视觉证据与全局时间特征，构建干扰感知的时间上下文；(4)共享时间校正单元进行一般细化，四个干扰专属专家通过自适应路由选择性抑制不同干扰。
AI.result: 在五个公开基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，PhysVR在数据集内和跨数据集两种评估协议下均持续优于具有代表性的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了在rPPG估计前进行干扰感知的时间特征细化的有效性，证明了利用视觉-语言模型提供的外部语义知识来提升rPPG鲁棒性的可行性。

title: Automatic Conversion of NICE Guidelines to an Executable Computational Model Using Large Language Models
comment: 18 pages. Published in Learning Health Systems (2026)
summary: Introduction: NICE guidelines provide evidence-based recommendations for clinical care but remain largely in unstructured natural language. Existing approaches to converting them into computable representations often focus on individual diseases, require substantial manual encoding, and do not scale. Large language models (LLMs) may enable much of this translation to be automated. Methods: We present an end-to-end approach that converts textual clinical guidelines into executable models capable of generating explainable, patient-specific recommendations. A stepwise LLM-based transformation with in-context examples produces human-inspectable intermediate artifacts. We apply the approach to NICE pancreatic and lung cancer guidelines, use expert review to assess rule alignment, and evaluate the executable pancreatic cancer model on 20 patient vignettes. Results: Expert review showed strong alignment between the source guidelines and generated executable models. Most discrepancies were partial omissions rather than incorrect logic, while hallucinated or fundamentally incorrect rules were rare. On the patient vignettes, the executable model achieved an F1 score of 82.5%. Conclusion: LLMs can transform natural-language NICE guidelines into interpretable, executable models that preserve guideline structure, support transparent inspection and modification, and generate patient-specific recommendations. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of scalable automated generation of computable clinical guidelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）将NICE临床指南从非结构化自然语言自动转换为可执行的、可解释的计算模型。该方法应用于胰腺癌和肺癌指南，通过专家评审和患者案例评估验证了其有效性，可执行模型在患者案例上F1分数达82.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有临床指南以非结构化自然语言存在，将其转化为可计算表示的方法通常针对单一疾病、需要大量人工编码且缺乏可扩展性。这阻碍了计算机化临床决策支持系统的发展，因此需要一种自动化的、可扩展的方法来转换指南。
AI.method: 采用端到端方法，通过基于LLM的逐步转换流程，结合上下文示例（in-context examples），生成可供人工检查的中间产物。该方法应用于NICE胰腺癌和肺癌指南，并通过专家评审评估规则一致性，同时在20个患者案例上评估可执行胰腺癌模型的性能。
AI.result: 专家评审显示源指南与生成的可执行模型之间高度一致；大部分差异为部分遗漏而非错误逻辑，幻觉或根本性错误规则罕见。在患者案例评估中，可执行模型实现了82.5%的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够将自然语言的NICE指南转换为可解释、可执行的模型，保留指南结构、支持透明检查和修改，并生成患者特定的推荐。这证明了自动化生成可计算临床指南的可扩展性的可行性。

title: MedSegBenchmarker: A Raw-Count-First Framework for Controlled 2D Medical Image Segmentation Benchmarks
summary: Despite rapid advances in MIS, fair and reproducible comparisons of segmentation models remain challenging due to heterogeneous datasets, inconsistent evaluation protocols, and rapidly evolving architectures. In particular, comparisons often implicitly assume that model rankings are invariant to data partitioning, preprocessing, metric aggregation, uncertainty estimation, and computational constraints. The lack of extensible and unified evaluation frameworks further limits systematic investigation of new models, datasets, and training paradigms. We present MEDSEGBENCHMARKER (MSB), a configuration-driven framework for controlled benchmarking of 2D MIS. It integrates duplicate and near-duplicate image detection, group-aware data splitting, YAML study specifications, resumable training, hyperparameter optimization, cross-validation, and checkpoint-based evaluation. Rather than retaining only aggregate performance measures, MSB exports sample- and class-level pixel counts and predictions together with the evaluation context. These elementary artifacts enable post-hoc analyses without repeated inference. We demonstrate MSB in a case study involving three heterogeneous 2D datasets and multiple MIS and general-purpose vision models evaluated at 256- and 512-pixel input resolutions. Reaggregation of identical predictions changes the top-ranked architecture in three of six dataset-resolution settings, despite high rank correlations between aggregation strategies. Increasing input resolution produces model- and dataset-dependent performance gains and losses that must be considered alongside empirically measured inference complexity. These results show that seemingly minor choices in evaluation and experimental setup can affect benchmark conclusions. MSB, available at GitHub, provides a practical and extensible basis for making benchmark conditions and evaluation choices explicit and reproducible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MEDSEGBENCHMARKER (MSB)，一个配置驱动的2D医学图像分割基准测试框架，集成了重复图像检测、分组数据划分、YAML研究规范、可恢复训练、超参数优化、交叉验证和检查点评估。MSB导出样本级和类别级的像素计数及预测结果，而非仅保留聚合指标，从而支持无需重复推理的事后分析。案例研究显示，预测的重新聚合会在六个数据集-分辨率设置中的三个改变排名最高的架构，突显评估细节对基准结论的重要影响。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割(MIS)模型间的公平可复现比较面临挑战，源于异构数据集、不一致的评估协议和快速演进的架构。现有比较通常隐含假设模型排名对数据划分、预处理、指标聚合、不确定性估计和计算约束保持不变，而缺乏可扩展的统一评估框架限制了新模型、数据集和训练范式的系统研究。
AI.method: MSB是一个配置驱动的2D MIS基准测试框架，包含：(1)重复和近重复图像检测；(2)分组感知的数据划分；(3)YAML研究规范；(4)可恢复训练；(5)超参数优化；(6)交叉验证；(7)基于检查点的评估。关键创新是导出样本级和类别级的像素计数及预测结果并附上评估上下文，而非仅保留聚合性能指标，从而实现无需重复推理的事后分析。
AI.result: 在三个异构2D数据集、多个MIS和通用视觉模型、256和512像素输入分辨率的案例研究中，重新聚合相同预测在六个数据集-分辨率设置中的三个改变了排名最高的架构，尽管不同聚合策略之间排名相关性很高。提高输入分辨率产生依赖模型和数据集的不同性能增益和损失，必须与实测推理复杂度一同考虑。
AI.conclusion: 看似微小的评估和实验设置选择可能显著影响基准结论。MSB为明确和可复现的基准条件与评估选择提供了实用且可扩展的基础。

title: Interpreting and Steering for Safe and Correct Code Generation
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently generate source code containing vulnerabilities, yet little work studies the internal mechanisms that distinguish safe from vulnerable generation in them. In this work, we systematically perform a mechanistic interpretation of LLMs, aiming at both understanding how code safety-vs-vulnerability is represented or driven by components in an LM and turning the insights into actionable steering strategies to encourage safer code generation. To this end, we introduce CodeSec-Pairs, a dataset of 9,342 Python safe-and-vulnerable contrastive code pairs, sampled from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Utilizing the dataset, we explore approaches to localize layers and attention heads that relate to code safety, and further experiment with different steering strategies for inference-time vulnerability reduction. In particular, we propose DuoSteer, a double-steering approach that simultaneously applies safety and code-correctness steering to attention heads. In experiments over five vulnerability types, DuoSteer leads to an average of -26.9% vulnerability rate reduction and +7.5% functional correctness improvement, which outperforms not only other steering variants but also prompting and supervised fine-tuning baselines. The advantage also replicates on Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with another 2,500 contrastive pairs sampled from that model.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM代码生成中的安全机制进行可解释性分析，构建了CodeSec-Pairs数据集（9,342对Python安全/脆弱代码对），定位与代码安全相关的层和注意力头，并提出DuoSteer双引导策略——同时施加安全性和代码正确性引导，在五种漏洞类型上实现平均-26.9%的漏洞率降低和+7.5%功能正确性提升，优于其他引导变体、提示工程和监督微调基线，并在Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct上得到复现验证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型经常生成包含漏洞的源代码，但很少有工作从内部机制层面研究LLM如何区分安全与脆弱的代码生成。作者希望填补这一空白，不仅理解LLM内部如何表征/驱动代码安全，还要将洞察转化为可操作的引导策略，促使模型生成更安全的代码。
AI.method: （1）构建CodeSec-Pairs数据集：9,342对Python安全/脆弱对比代码对，从Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct中采样；（2）定位与代码安全相关的层和注意力头，进行机制层面的定位分析；（3）提出DuoSteer双引导方法：在推理时同时向注意力头施加安全性和代码正确性两种引导信号。实验覆盖五种漏洞类型，并在Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct上用2,500对额外对比对进行泛化验证。
AI.result: DuoSteer在五种漏洞类型上平均实现-26.9%的漏洞率降低和+7.5%的功能正确性提升，优于其他引导变体以及提示工程和SFT基线；该优势在Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct上同样复现。
AI.conclusion: 通过在注意力头层面进行双引导（安全性+代码正确性），可以显著降低LLM生成代码的漏洞率同时提升功能正确性，且这种方法具有跨模型泛化能力。这表明对LLM内部机制的深入理解可以转化为有效的安全增强策略。

title: GeoRay: Gauge-Aware Feed-Forward Satellite 3D Reconstruction in the Geodetic Frame
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct perspective scenes in one pass. Satellite photogrammetry needs a different product, one that domain adaptation alone does not deliver: dense surface height in an absolute geodetic frame under non-central rational polynomial cameras (RPCs). Perspective-pretrained features are not reliably observable along RPC height rays, absolute elevation carries a low-order height--datum gauge exchangeable with sensor bias to first order, and monocular and multi-view cues fail in different regions. \method{} treats all three. Lightweight ray-consistent adapters make a frozen backbone matchable along native RPC rays. An explicit datum mechanism separates relief from absolute level and is equivariant to the vertical origin by construction, so one trained model serves zero-, one-, and sparse-control inference. Calibrated inverse-variance fusion combines the two relief streams. \bench{}, our absolute-frame benchmark of eighteen systems across in-domain, cross-dataset, and cross-city tiers, scores absolute placement without registration or test-reference leakage. On 26 held-out US3D tiles, \method{} attains $2.99$\,m absolute MAE at $91.9\%$ coverage, improves completeness-aware accuracy by $46.4$ points over the strongest compliant feed-forward baseline, remains the most accurate such system under both transfer shifts, and runs in $24$\,s model-forward time per tile. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/HIT-SIRS/GeoRay

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoRay方法，解决卫星摄影测量中绝对大地坐标系下密集地表高程重建问题。通过轻量级射线一致性适配器使冻结骨干网络适配RPC射线，显式基准机制分离相对起伏与绝对高程，并用校准逆方差融合整合单目和多视角信息。在GeoBench基准的26个US3D瓦片上达到2.99米绝对MAE和91.9%覆盖率，比最强前馈基线在完整性感知精度上提升46.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 前馈式3D基础模型能一步重建透视场景，但卫星摄影测量需要不同的产品：在非中心有理多项式相机(RPC)下重建绝对大地坐标系中的密集地表高度。现有多视角立体与单目方法存在三个核心问题：透视预训练特征在RPC高度射线上不可靠、绝对高程与传感器偏置存在低阶基准不确定性、单目与多视角线索在不同区域失效。
AI.method: GeoRay包含三个关键组件：(1)轻量级射线一致性适配器使冻结的预训练骨干网络沿原生RPC射线可匹配；(2)显式基准机制分离相对地形起伏与绝对高程，对垂直原点具有等变性，使单一训练模型可支持零控制点、单控制点和稀疏控制点推理；(3)校准逆方差融合整合单目与多视角两条高程估计流。
AI.result: 在GeoBench（包含18个系统的绝对坐标系基准测试，覆盖域内、跨数据集、跨城市三个层级）上，26个US3D测试瓦片中达到2.99米绝对MAE和91.9%覆盖率，完整性感知精度比最强合规前馈基线提升46.4个百分点，在两种迁移场景下仍保持最高精度，模型前向推理每瓦片仅需24秒。
AI.conclusion: GeoRay通过射线一致性适配、显式基准机制和校准融合策略，系统地解决了卫星摄影测量中透视预训练特征不匹配、绝对高程基准不确定性和单目/多视角互补性三大挑战，实现了无需配准或测试参考泄漏的绝对框架高精度高程重建，并展示了良好的跨域泛化能力。

title: Beyond Uncertainty: Multi-Solver Disagreement Rewards for Self-Evolving Reasoning Curricula
comment: Proceedings of the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26), November 07--11, 2026, Rome, Italy
summary: Self-evolving reasoning frameworks train a Challenger to generate questions exposing a Solver's weaknesses, creating adaptive curricula without human data. However, existing approaches use a single solver's sampling uncertainty as the Challenger's reward. This creates a fundamental bottleneck: as the solver grows confident on the Challenger's question distribution, all sampled answers converge identically, collapsing the reward to zero and starving the Challenger of learning signal. Critically, this single-model reward cannot distinguish genuinely easy questions from those that merely align with one solver's learned biases. We propose a multi-solver disagreement reward using a heterogeneous ensemble varying in model capacity and sampling temperature. A normalized Shannon entropy over the ensemble's per-question plurality answers explicitly rewards questions where solvers produce conflicting solutions---capturing difficulty as inter-model divergence rather than intra-model sampling variance. This richer gradient enables the Challenger to discover questions targeting true capability boundaries, producing a curriculum that forces downstream Solvers to develop robust reasoning strategies generalizing across problem types. Our approach is a drop-in reward function replacement requiring no framework modifications or additional data. Experiments with Qwen3-4B show that Solvers trained on disagreement-Challenger questions achieve +1.34 points average improvement on competition-math benchmarks (MATH-500, AMC, Olympiad), suggesting that multi-solver disagreement provides a complementary and scalable signal for curriculum generation in self-play reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多求解器分歧奖励机制（multi-solver disagreement reward），用异构模型集成（不同容量、不同采样温度）的归一化香农熵替代单一求解器的采样不确定性作为挑战者（Challenger）的奖励，从而生成更有效的自适应课程，提升下游求解器（Solver）在竞赛数学基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的自进化推理框架使用单一求解器的采样不确定性作为挑战者奖励，存在根本性瓶颈：当求解器在挑战者的问题分布上变得自信时，所有采样答案趋同，奖励坍缩为零，挑战者缺乏学习信号；且单一模型奖励无法区分真正困难的问题与仅与该求解器学习偏差一致的问题。
AI.method: 使用异构模型集成（在模型容量和采样温度上变化），通过计算集成中每个问题多数答案的归一化香农熵作为奖励。该奖励显式奖励求解器产生冲突解决方案的问题，将难度定义为模型间分歧（inter-model divergence）而非模型内采样方差（intra-model sampling variance）。该方法是即插即用的奖励函数替代方案，无需修改框架或额外数据。
AI.result: 使用Qwen3-4B进行实验，在竞争数学基准（MATH-500、AMC、Olympiad）上，用分歧挑战者问题训练的求解器平均提升+1.34分。
AI.conclusion: 多求解器分歧为自对弈推理系统中的课程生成提供了互补且可扩展的信号，能够帮助挑战者发现针对真实能力边界的问题，促使求解器发展跨问题类型的稳健推理策略。

title: A Calibration Audit of Confidence in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models emit a per-pixel confidence that downstream systems read as a reliability signal. It is trained as a loss weight, not as an uncertainty magnitude, and whether it can be used as an error prediction has not been measured. We audit seven released backbones on thirteen datasets and score the confidence on four properties, how well it ranks error, whether its level is right on average, whether it holds across the confidence range, and whether its intervals cover the truth. The confidence ranks error well, but the predicted uncertainty is too low when it is read under conditions that are not exactly those of training. The median case is off by 2.4x across all seven models, and the error prediction is further off the more confident the model is. We show that this phenomenon can appear even though the loss's optimum is reached. A released model resumed under its own loss reaches that optimum on its training data within a few hundred updates and stays overconfident on unseen frames. A power law with two constants per backbone and dataset corrects the overall magnitude of the predicted uncertainty and leaves the ranking untouched. What no rescaling reaches is the scene, which we attribute to the model's missing knowledge of scale across predictions. Every correction we tried is close to right on average and still leaves two thirds of held-out scenes outside a five-point band, because what a scene is missing is a shape rather than a shift. We release the audit protocol, its results, and the fitted constants per model and dataset. Fitted with the target dataset held out, the constants bring the median case from 2.4x off to 1.35x, and a refit on a few labelled scenes of that dataset reaches 1.12x.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了七个前馈3D重建模型在十三个数据集上的置信度输出，发现其排序误差能力良好，但在训练分布外条件下预测的不确定性系统性偏低（中位数偏差2.4倍）。作者提出每个骨干网络和数据集仅需两个常数的幂律校准可将偏差降至1.35倍，但无法修正场景级别的系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型输出的逐像素置信度被下游系统当作可靠性信号使用，但该置信度是作为损失权重训练的，并非真正的不确定性度量。它能否用作误差预测从未被系统评估过，这构成了一个潜在的安全隐患。
AI.method: 对七个已发布骨干网络在十三个数据集上进行审计，从四个属性评分置信度：误差排序能力、平均水平准确性、置信度范围内的保持性、以及区间对真实值的覆盖率。提出每个模型和数据集两个常数的幂律校准，并对比保留目标数据集的拟合与少量标注场景的重拟合。
AI.result: 置信度对误差排序良好，但预测不确定性系统性偏低，中位数偏差2.4倍，且越自信的模型误差预测越不准。该现象可在损失达到最优时出现。两常数幂律校准将中位数偏差从2.4倍降至1.35倍（目标数据集保留时），重拟合少量标注场景可达1.12倍。但场景级别的校准缺失（形状问题而非平移问题）无法通过重缩放解决。
AI.conclusion: 置信度的排序能力可信，但其绝对不确定性水平在分布偏移下严重低估。简单的幂律校准可以显著修正整体幅度，但场景间的不确定性差异（形状而非平移）需要模型对跨预测尺度的认知能力，这是当前重缩放方法无法弥补的。

title: Balance of Benchmarks: Semantic Density Reweighting for Benchmark Multiplicity and Task-Conditioned Evaluation
summary: Language models are commonly compared by averaging scores across a benchmark list with equal weight. Such lists grow through publication outside an explicit measurement design, so equal weighting turns the density of published benchmarks into an implicit capability weight: densely benchmarked regions count repeatedly. We introduce Balance of Benchmarks (BoB), which embeds benchmark descriptions and assigns each benchmark an inverse-density semantic weight. Nearby entries share aggregate influence at a disclosed density scale. After equating heterogeneous scores onto a common latent scale, a residual field uses the same geometry to condition model rankings on a task query. The two components serve distinct empirical roles. On a snapshot of 586 models and 14 benchmarks, BoB predicts which models are unusually strong on a held-out task beyond their general ability, reaching a profile correlation of 0.462 compared with 0.049 under equal weighting. It also limits the influence of densely repeated benchmarks on the aggregate. After adding four copies of each benchmark in turn, the resulting rankings retain a Kendall tau of 0.995, compared with 0.936 under equal weighting. The residual field therefore provides task-conditioned prediction, and inverse-density weighting provides robustness to benchmark multiplicity. Together, they turn benchmark-list composition from an incidental property of evaluation suites into an explicit, controllable part of measurement design, providing a principled foundation for task-aware and multiplicity-robust model evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Balance of Benchmarks (BoB)方法，通过嵌入基准描述并分配逆密度语义权重，解决语言模型基准评估中因基准列表密度不均导致的隐式能力权重问题，同时提供残差场用于任务条件化排名预测。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型比较通常对基准列表进行等权平均，但基准列表通过非显式测量设计的出版过程增长，导致等权加权将基准密度转变为隐式能力权重——密集基准区域被重复计数，从而扭曲评估结果。
AI.method: BoB包含两个核心组件：(1) 将基准描述嵌入语义空间，为每个基准分配逆密度语义权重，使邻近基准共享聚合影响力，并在披露的密度尺度下工作；(2) 将异构得分统一到共同潜在尺度后，利用相同几何结构构建残差场，根据任务查询条件化模型排名。
AI.result: 在586个模型和14个基准的快照上，BoB在保留任务上预测模型异常强项的轮廓相关性达0.462，而等权加权仅0.049；在逐一添加四份各基准副本后，排名Kendall tau保持0.995，等权加权则为0.936。
AI.conclusion: 残差场提供任务条件化预测，逆密度加权提供对基准多重性的鲁棒性。两者共同将基准列表组成从评估套件的偶然属性转变为测量设计中显式、可控的部分，为任务感知和多重性鲁棒的模型评估提供原则性基础。

title: XDG: Accelerated Visual Disambiguation
summary: Visual aliasing, also known as the doppelganger problem, remains a key challenge for structure-from-motion (SfM): visually similar but physically distinct surfaces can produce incorrect image matches and degrade reconstruction quality. Previous work mitigates this issue with geometry-aware foundation-model features, but places a heavy transformer classifier on top of the backbone, making large-scale disambiguation expensive. We introduce XDG, an efficient visual disambiguation model designed for scalable SfM. Our key observation is that a 3D foundation model already performs the cross-view geometric reasoning necessary for visual disambiguation, so doppelganger classification should adapt the backbone representation directly rather than relearn pair reasoning in a separate heavy decoder. XDG fine-tunes Depth Anything 3 with lightweight LoRA adapters and repurposes its camera tokens as compact pair-level classification tokens. A compact MLP head predicts whether a candidate image pair observes the same 3D surface. Extensive experiments show that XDG provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency tradeoff: it remains competitive with the state-of-the-art disambiguation method across pairwise and reconstruction benchmarks and delivers more than a 3x inference speedup. On individual LaMAR scenes containing thousands of images, XDG saves more than 10 hours of visual disambiguation processing. Code is available at https://github.com/xtcpete/xdg.

AI.tldr: XDG是一种高效的视觉消歧模型，通过微调3D基础模型Depth Anything 3并利用轻量级LoRA适配器和紧凑MLP头，在保持与SOTA方法相当性能的同时实现3倍以上的推理加速，大幅节省大规模SfM中的视觉消歧处理时间。
AI.motivation: 视觉混淆（doppelganger问题）是SfM中的关键挑战，现有方法虽使用几何感知的foundation-model特征，但在骨干网络上堆叠重型transformer分类器导致大规模消歧成本高昂，需要更高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 核心洞察是3D基础模型已具备跨视图几何推理能力，因此消歧应直接适配骨干网络表示而非在独立重型解码器中重新学习配对推理。XDG微调Depth Anything 3，使用轻量级LoRA适配器，将相机token重用作紧凑的配对级分类token，通过紧凑MLP头预测图像对是否观察同一3D表面。
AI.result: XDG在成对和重建基准上与SOTA消歧方法竞争力相当，实现超过3倍的推理加速；在包含数千张图像的LaMAR场景上节省超过10小时的视觉消歧处理时间。
AI.conclusion: XDG证明了利用3D基础模型的固有几何推理能力并直接适配其表示，可以在保持准确性的同时显著提升视觉消歧的效率，为大规模SfM提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Can LLM Agents Discover? Evaluating Creativity on ML Engineering Tasks
summary: Recent AI systems promise autonomous scientific discovery, claiming to discover algorithms and produce research papers, yet understanding whether they exhibit creativity, the capacity to produce solutions that are both novel and useful, remains an open question. We present a framework for evaluating multi-turn LLM research agents' creativity using ML engineering tasks as a testbed, through three dimensions: P-Creativity (psychological novelty: novel relative to the agent's own prior solutions within a run), H-Creativity (historical novelty: novel relative to the corpus of human solutions), and Usefulness (task performance). Evaluating two agent frameworks, AIDE and AIRA-Dojo, on 10 Kaggle-style machine learning tasks from MLE-Bench, we develop an LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline and verify its strong correlation with human creativity judgments, providing a reliable automated metric for P-Creativity evaluation at scale. Applying this pipeline to agent trajectories, we find: (1) all agents exhibit declining P-Creativity as they transition from exploration to exploitation; (2) LLMs exhibit greater H-Creativity than medal-winning humans, yet achieve lower performance. Our findings reveal that current agents can explore novel regions of the solution space but lack the capacity to convert this novelty into improved task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个评估多轮LLM研究智能体创造力的框架，从心理学新颖性（P-Creativity）、历史新颖性（H-Creativity）和实用性三个维度，在10个Kaggle式机器学习任务上评估了AIDE和AIRA-Dojo两个智能体框架，发现所有智能体在从探索转向利用时P-Creativity下降，且LLM的历史新颖性高于人类奖牌得主但性能更低。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI系统声称能自主进行科学发现，但目前缺乏系统性框架来评估这些系统是否真正具备创造力（即产生既新颖又有用的解决方案的能力），这是一个悬而未决的问题。
AI.method: 提出三维创造力评估框架：(1) P-Creativity（相对智能体自身先前解决方案的心理新颖性）、(2) H-Creativity（相对人类解决方案语料库的历史新颖性）、(3) Usefulness（任务性能）。在MLE-Bench的10个Kaggle式ML任务上评估AIDE和AIRA-Dojo两个智能体框架，并开发LLM-as-a-Judge流水线，验证其与人类创造力判断的强相关性。
AI.result: (1) 所有智能体在从探索转向利用阶段时P-Creativity均呈下降趋势；(2) LLM表现出的H-Creativity高于获得奖牌的人类，但任务性能更低；LLM-as-a-Judge流水线与人类判断高度相关，可作为可扩展的自动化P-Creativity评估指标。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI智能体能够探索解决方案空间中的新颖区域，但缺乏将这种新颖性转化为改进任务性能的能力，这表明虽然探索能力已具备，但从创造力到实际效用的转化仍是瓶颈。

title: Drift Calibration in Geometric Eye Tracking Systems
summary: Geometric eye trackers can provide the spatial accuracy required for gaze-based interaction and multimodal studies, but their measurements remain sensitive to residual session-specific calibration error. Research on correcting this error is difficult to compare because methods are typically evaluated with different devices, target layouts, and error definitions. We present a calibration-focused dataset containing 163 trials from 12 participants, with separate 18-point fitting and 32-point test grids, and use it to evaluate global, local, and composite correction functions under a common spatial-extrapolation protocol. We further introduce a lightweight neural refiner that combines ranked predictions from complementary calibrators. On this controlled dataset, post-vendor correction reduces the mean angular error from $1.53^\circ$ to $1.03^\circ$ with the strongest classical composite and to $0.96^\circ$ with the refiner. In a closed-loop gaze task, lower residual error is associated with higher performance across four online correction conditions. These results provide a reproducible data-quality benchmark for using gaze as a behavioral signal in interactive modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个校准聚焦数据集（163次试验、12名参与者，含18点拟合与32点测试网格），并在统一的空间外推协议下评估全局、局部和复合校正函数；同时引入轻量级神经精化器，结合互补校准器的排名预测。后厂商校正将平均角度误差从1.53°降至1.03°（最强经典复合）和0.96°（精化器）。闭环凝视任务中，较低残差误差与较高性能相关。
AI.motivation: 几何眼动追踪器虽能提供凝视交互所需的空间精度，但对会话特定的残余校准误差敏感。现有研究因设备、目标布局和误差定义不同而难以比较，缺乏统一的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建包含163次试验、12名参与者的校准数据集，采用18点拟合网格和32点测试网格；在统一空间外推协议下评估全局、局部及复合校正函数；提出轻量级神经精化器，结合来自互补校准器的排名预测。
AI.result: 后厂商校正将平均角度误差从1.53°降至1.03°（最强经典复合校正）和0.96°（神经精化器）；闭环凝视任务中四种在线校正条件下，较低残差误差均与更高性能相关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了可复现的数据质量基准，为在交互建模中将凝视作为行为信号提供了可靠评估标准，且神经精化器性能优于经典复合校正方法。

title: Spec2Twin-Chain: Orchestrating Bi-Level Optimization with LLMs for Blockchain Digital Twin Construction
summary: Building a blockchain digital twin largely requires translating domain knowledge and specific system descriptions into a simulator architecture, calibrating its parameters against behavioral evidence, and validating the constructed twin. These steps are commonly performed through application-specific modeling efforts that can be difficult to reuse across systems and downstream decision problems. We consider automating this process through Spec2Twin-Chain, a framework that formulates blockchain digital-twin construction as a bi-level optimization problem. At the upper level, a large language model proposes and revises structurally admissible architectures using system specifications, behavioral evidence, and feedback from evaluated designs. At the lower level, a simulation-based optimizer calibrates the architecture-conditioned parameters under explicit objectives and guardrail constraints. The two levels iterate. The evaluated candidates at lower levels are retained in a global archive and used to guide subsequent proposals at upper levels. We conduct controlled experiments involving twin calibration, feedback-driven recovery, stress analysis, downstream policy optimization, and policy updating. The results demonstrate that the framework can construct behaviorally accurate twins, improve initial designs through iterative feedback, and reuse calibrated twins to support downstream decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Spec2Twin-Chain框架，将区块链数字孪生构建形式化为双层优化问题：上层由大语言模型提出并修订系统架构，下层由基于仿真的优化器在目标与约束下校准参数，两层迭代演进，并通过全局归档重用已验证的孪生模型以支持下游决策。
AI.motivation: 构建区块链数字孪生通常需要将领域知识和系统描述转化为仿真架构、校准参数并验证，这些步骤目前依赖特定应用的建模工作，难以跨系统和跨决策问题复用，缺乏自动化流程。
AI.method: 提出Spec2Twin-Chain框架：(1) 上层由LLM基于系统规格、行为证据和评估反馈提出/修订结构上可接受的架构；(2) 下层由仿真优化器在显式目标和护栏约束下校准架构条件参数；(3) 两层迭代，下层的评估候选存入全局归档并用于指导上层后续提案。
AI.result: 通过孪生校准、反馈驱动的恢复、压力分析、下游策略优化和策略更新等受控实验，证明框架能构建行为准确的孪生模型，通过迭代反馈改进初始设计，并能重用校准后的孪生模型支持下游决策。
AI.conclusion: Spec2Twin-Chain实现了区块链数字孪生构建的自动化，验证了LLM驱动的架构探索与仿真参数优化的协同机制，并展示了校准孪生的跨任务可重用性。

title: SynCrash: A Multi-Stage Pipeline for Zero-Shot Accident Detection and Localization in Traffic Surveillance Video
comment: Accepted at the CVPR 2026 AUTOPILOT Workshop (non-archival)
summary: We present SynCrash, a multi-stage pipeline for zero-shot accident detection, spatial localization, and collision-type classification in fixed-view CCTV surveillance video. Our approach addresses the ACCIDENT at CVPR 2026 Challenge, which requires predicting when an accident occurs, where in the frame the impact happens, and what type of collision it is, all without access to labeled real-world training data. The pipeline operates in three decoupled stages: (1) Temporal localization via a VideoMAEv2-giant backbone fine-tuned on CARLA-based synthetic clips with metadata-aware embeddings and dense sliding-window inference; (2) Spatial localization using YOLO for object detection combined with a physics-informed hybrid heuristic that leverages bounding-box overlap and trajectory-based reasoning to predict the impact point; and (3) Collision-type classification using a lightweight rule-based strategy derived from the number and configuration of detected vehicles. The key insight is that temporal understanding benefits from supervised fine-tuning on synthetic data, whereas spatial understanding is better served by pretrained object detectors and physics priors that transfer naturally across domains.

AI.tldr: SynCrash是一个多阶段零样本事故检测pipeline，用于固定视角CCTV监控视频中的事故时间定位、空间定位和碰撞类型分类。通过CARLA合成数据微调VideoMAEv2进行时间定位，结合YOLO检测与物理启发式规则进行空间定位，最后用轻量级规则进行碰撞分类。
AI.motivation: 解决CVPR 2026 ACCIDENT挑战赛中的零样本事故检测问题，需要在没有标注真实世界训练数据的情况下，同时预测事故发生的时间、空间位置和碰撞类型。
AI.method: 三阶段解耦pipeline：(1)时间定位：VideoMAEv2-giant骨干网络在CARLA合成数据上微调，使用元数据感知嵌入和密集滑窗推理；(2)空间定位：YOLO目标检测结合物理启发的混合启发式算法（基于边界框重叠和轨迹推理）；(3)碰撞分类：基于检测车辆数量和配置的轻量级规则策略。
AI.result: 论文提出关键洞察：时间理解受益于合成数据上的监督微调，而空间理解更适合使用预训练目标检测器和物理先验，这些先验可以自然地跨域迁移。
AI.conclusion: SynCrash验证了合成数据微调与物理启发式结合的有效性，展示了在零样本设置下通过解耦各阶段任务来处理复杂事故检测场景的可行性。

title: Mitigating Over-Optimization in PRM-Guided Search in Mathematical Reasoning by Optimizing the Guide
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) provide dense step-level guidance for search-based reasoning, enabling inference-time compute to be allocated toward promising partial solutions. However, recent evidence suggests that PRM-guided search can over-optimize imperfect process rewards, pruning viable trajectories while expanding spurious ones. In this work, we theoretically show that directly leveraging PRM score is vulnerable to verifier noise through an extreme-value effect: non-viable prefixes become more likely to receive spuriously high scores as reasoning depth increase. Therefore, we formulate the PRM-guided search as a robust optimization problem over plausible reward perturbations, termed maximin PRM-guided search, leading to a training-free robust process supervision method that preserves promising alternatives when step-level scores are noisy. Maximin PRM-guided search mitigates this failure mode by reducing sensitivity to over-optimized PRM outliers. Without fine-tuning or online adaptation, maximin search consistently improves the PRM-guided search by 17-35\% on average, outperforming outcome- and step-level baselines in 14 out of 16 settings. Our source code is available at https://github.com/tjoo512/maximin-search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出maximin PRM-guided search，一种免训练的鲁棒过程监督方法。作者理论上证明直接利用PRM分数会因极端值效应（extreme-value effect）在推理深度增加时对不可行前缀产生虚假高分，因此将PRM引导搜索形式化为对奖励扰动的鲁棒优化问题（maximin），以减少对过优化PRM离群值的敏感性。该方法无需微调或在线适应，平均提升PRM引导搜索17-35%，在14/16个设置中优于结果级和步骤级基线。
AI.motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）为搜索推理提供逐步级指导，但近期证据表明PRM引导的搜索会过度优化不完美的过程奖励，剪除可行轨迹同时扩展虚假轨迹。作者从理论上揭示PRM分数直接使用易受验证器噪声影响的内在缺陷，需要更鲁棒的监督方法。
AI.method: 将PRM引导搜索形式化为在合理奖励扰动上的鲁棒优化问题（maximin PRM-guided search），即最大化最坏情况下的奖励。这是一种免训练的鲁棒过程监督方法，在步骤级分数有噪声时保留有前景的备选方案，通过降低对过优化PRM离群值的敏感性来缓解失败模式。
AI.result: 不需要微调或在线适应，maximin搜索在所有设置中平均将PRM引导搜索提升17-35%；在16个设置中的14个中优于结果级和步骤级基线。
AI.conclusion: maximin PRM-guided search是一种简单有效的免训练鲁棒化方法，能够显著改善PRM引导搜索在噪声条件下表现，代码已开源。

title: InspectorGPT: A Comparative Reasoning Enhanced VLM for Comprehensive Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection is a critical component of modern manufacturing. Most traditional unsupervised methods rely on modelling normal feature distributions, inherently limiting generalization to unknown categories. To improve generalizability, some recent methods incorporate vision-language models (VLMs) for zero-shot detection via text prompts. However, we observe that reasoning-oriented post-training can cause anomaly discrimination to collapse, with some fine-tuned models performing worse than their base VLMs. Existing methods also provide only textual decisions or coarse boxes, without pixel-level segmentation. A more explicit detection principle comes from human inspection: anomalies are identified by comparing a query image with a defect-free reference. Inspired by this, we propose InspectorGPT, a VLM framework centered on comparative reasoning. Given a normal reference and a query image, InspectorGPT compares them to identify discrepancies and perform multiple inspection tasks with detailed reasoning. We internalize this capability through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with tailored, verifiable rewards. We further introduce InspectorGPT-Seg for pixel-level anomaly masks. Segmentation supervision improves anomaly discrimination but weakens semantic reasoning, while joint training fails to balance them. We therefore train the two branches separately and combine them through task-vector fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior multi-dimensional performance and generalization to unseen benchmarks, validating comparative reasoning for comprehensive industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InspectorGPT，一个基于比较推理的VLM框架，用于工业异常检测。通过将查询图像与无缺陷参考图像进行对比，结合CoT微调和GRPO强化学习，实现零样本异常检测和多任务工业检测。同时引入InspectorGPT-Seg用于像素级分割，并通过任务向量融合解决分割监督与语义推理之间的平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 传统无监督异常检测方法依赖建模正常特征分布，泛化性受限；现有VLM方法仅提供文本决策或粗糙边界框，缺乏像素级分割，且推理导向的后训练可能导致异常判别能力崩溃，性能甚至不如基础VLM。
AI.method: 1) 提出InspectorGPT框架，以正常参考图像与查询图像的比较推理为核心；2) 使用Chain-of-Thought（CoT）微调和Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）配合定制可验证奖励来内化比较推理能力；3) 提出InspectorGPT-Seg用于像素级异常掩码，通过任务向量融合将分割分支与推理分支分离训练后组合，避免联合训练导致的语义推理与异常判别之间的失衡。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，InspectorGPT在多个维度上表现优异，并展现出对未见基准的泛化能力，验证了比较推理在全面工业检测中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于人类视觉检查原理（比较查询图像与无缺陷参考）的比较推理方法，能够有效提升工业异常检测的泛化性能和综合检测能力，任务向量融合是解决多任务训练失衡的有效策略。

title: Game-Agnostic Value Functions through Automatic JSON Feature Extraction
comment: 4 pages, to be published in Conference on Games (CoG) 2026
summary: JSON Bag-of-Tokens (JSON-Bag) is a recently proposed method to generically represent game trajectories by tokenizing their JSON descriptions. We introduce JSON-Bag VF, a game-agnostic approach to training value functions for game-playing agents using JSON-Bag prototypes. We show that this approach can be enhanced with Random Forest-based feature selection and a method to select game-stage-specific features. We evaluate JSON-Bag VF with One-step-look-ahead (JSON-Bag OSLA) on six tabletop games over different combinations of prototype-tokenization and feature selections. JSON-Bag OSLA outperforms baseline OSLA agents in most games. Our analysis also shows that feature selection significantly improves JSON-Bag VF and that feature selection is the most important factor in JSON-Bag VF performance, over prototype-tokenization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JSON-Bag VF，一种基于JSON-Bag原型tokenization的游戏无关价值函数训练方法，并结合随机森林特征选择与游戏阶段特定特征选择，在六款桌游上评估其在One-step-look-ahead（JSON-Bag OSLA）应用中的表现。
AI.motivation: JSON-Bag方法能够通用地表示游戏轨迹，但如何在此基础上高效训练价值函数以提升游戏智能体的决策能力仍是一个值得探索的问题，尤其是特征选择对性能的影响尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出JSON-Bag VF，使用JSON-Bag原型tokenization训练价值函数；增强方法包括基于随机森林的特征选择，以及选择游戏阶段特定特征的方法；与JSON-Bag OSLA结合，在六款桌游上采用不同的原型tokenization与特征选择组合进行评估。
AI.result: JSON-Bag OSLA在大多数游戏中优于基线OSLA智能体；特征选择显著提升了JSON-Bag VF的性能，且特征选择是影响JSON-Bag VF性能的最重要因素，其重要性超过原型tokenization。
