CP-SAT enforces 14 hard constraints guaranteeing zero regulatory violations, while optimizing 15 soft objectives via a unified weighted penalty function. Contributions include a shift-window decomposition enabling break scheduling with centrality control, acuity-weighted workload equity, multi-granularity resolution from 15 minutes to 1 day, inter-week stability, and grid-offset preprocessing mapping cross-midnight shifts into a single scheduling day without solver changes.
  CP-SAT is evaluated on 18 instances: five synthetic hospital units (10-33 nurses), 10 INRC-II benchmarks (5-80 nurses, up to 8-week horizons) and 3 NRP-23 compatible instances (10-25 nurses) with cross-midnight Night shifts. Results: zero hard-constraint violations across all 18 instances by construction; proven optimality on INRC-II n005w4 (objective 118, gap 0.0%, 104s); feasible schedules scaling to 179,800 variables and 351,425 constraints (80 nurses); service quality improved 50-67% over MOGA; and model size scaling near-linearly at approximately 4,400 variables per employee. The formulation enforces 29 total constraints (14 hard, 15 soft), nearly three times the industry average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CP-SAT，一种面向多角色、多技能医疗人员排班的约束规划（CP）方法，通过14个硬约束和15个软目标构建统一加权惩罚函数，解决传统方法无法保证法规合规、缺乏多技能支持、跨午夜班次及亚班次粒度等难题，在18个实例上实现零硬约束违规并证明最优性。
AI.motivation: 医疗人员排班是NP-hard优化问题，现有方法（遗传算法、整数规划、约束规划）仅建模6-12个班次级约束，无法保证法规合规，且缺乏对多角色多技能异构性、强制休息调度（中点控制）、按敏锐度加权的负载均衡、亚班次粒度、周间稳定性和跨午夜班次的支持。因此需要一个更全面、可扩展且合规性有保障的排班框架。
AI.method: CP-SAT采用约束规划（CP）建模，包含：(1) 14个硬约束保证零法规违规；(2) 15个软目标通过统一加权惩罚函数优化；(3) 班次窗口分解（shift-window decomposition）实现带中心性控制的休息调度；(4) 敏锐度加权的工作量均衡；(5) 15分钟到1天的多粒度解析；(6) 周间稳定性机制；(7) 网格偏移预处理（grid-offset preprocessing）将跨午夜班次映射到单一排班日，无需修改求解器。
AI.result: 在18个实例上评估（5个合成医院单元、10个INRC-II基准、3个NRP-23兼容实例）：所有实例硬约束违规为零；在INRC-II n005w4上证明最优（目标值118，gap 0.0%，104秒）；可扩展到80名护士、179,800个变量和351,425个约束；服务质量较MOGA提升50-67%；模型规模近似线性扩展（每员工约4,400个变量）；总计29个约束（14硬+15软），约为行业平均水平的三倍。
AI.conclusion: CP-SAT通过更全面的约束建模（是行业平均的近三倍）和创新的分解与预处理技术，实现了医疗人员排班中合规性、可扩展性和求解质量的统一，在合成数据与国际标准基准上均展现出领先性能，为多技能医疗排班提供了新的工程化解决方案。

title: Everybody Tracking Every Body
summary: We address the problem of 3D body pose estimation of multiple interacting people from their egocentric views with centralized coordination. Each individual wears a camera recording egocentric video and IMU data. Processing this video with VIO SLAM provides high-quality tracking of each egocentric camera through space. The first-person view from one individual provides third-person observations of other people, although these exocentric observations are sparse, intermittent, and of highly variable reliability as both cameras and subjects move. To integrate these synchronized data streams, we propose a diffusion-based approach that fuses estimates of pose based on head motion derived from egocentric camera motion with exocentric pose observations, conditioning on both observation content and reliability. Our model is trained on a mixture of single-person motion-capture data and multi-person video in order to learn rich priors for body motion trajectories and video observation reliability. Evaluation on challenging multi-person datasets suggests our fusion approach improves over motion-only and vision-only baselines in terms of both absolute and relative pose accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的3D人体姿态估计方法，用于多人在第一人称视角（egocentric）下交互的场景。每个个体佩戴相机（VIO SLAM跟踪）和IMU设备，融合第一人称头部运动估计与第三人称外部观察（exocentric）姿态信息，同时考虑观察内容的可靠性和质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么仅依赖单一人称视角（第一人称或第三人称），难以应对多人交互场景中遮挡、视角转换和观测稀疏/间歇的问题。第一人称视角提供的高质量头部轨迹与其他人的外部观察之间存在互补性，但外部观察的可靠性高度可变，如何有效融合这些异构且不确定的数据流是一个挑战。
AI.method: 提出基于扩散（diffusion）的方法，融合两条信息源：1）基于第一人称相机运动（VIO SLAM）推导的头部运动姿态估计；2）从第一人称视图中获取的第三人称身体姿态观察。模型以观察内容和可靠性为条件，在单人多动捕数据和多人视频的混合数据上训练，学习身体运动轨迹先验和视频观察可靠性。
AI.result: 在挑战性的多人数据集上，所提出的融合方法在绝对和相对姿态精度上均优于仅基于运动（motion-only）和仅基于视觉（vision-only）的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 验证了将第一人称头部运动信息与第三人称外部观察通过扩散模型进行可靠性加权融合的有效性，为多人第一人称场景下的3D姿态估计提供了可行方案。

title: EvoSkill Injection: Red-Teaming Autonomous Skill Generation and Evolution in Self-Evolving Agents
summary: LLM-based agent systems increasingly adopt skill-based architectures to reduce repetitive reasoning costs and improve stable, efficient task execution. Recent studies propose self-evolving agents that autonomously generate, refine, and reuse skills from past experiences to enable continuous capability evolution. However, autonomous skill evolution introduces a new attack surface in which malicious capabilities are generated, stored, and reused as legitimate skills. In this paper, we define EvoSkill Injection as a threat model targeting the autonomous skill generation and evolution pipeline of self-evolving agents. We further propose SARGE (Red-teaming Autonomous Skill Generation and Evolution in self-evolving agents), a red-teaming framework for evaluating this threat model through iterative generation, escalation, and reinforcement interactions. To support our framework, we construct EvoSkillBench, a benchmark dataset of malicious interaction trajectories for inducing malicious skill formation in self-evolving agents, and introduce EvoSkillSafetyBench, a post-attack benchmark for evaluating whether injected malicious skills are subsequently retrieved and activated as harmful behaviors. Our evaluation shows that SARGE induces malicious skill formation and that injected skills are persistently stored and repeatedly activated, highlighting the risk of persistent capability corruption.

AI.tldr: 本文首次定义了自进化智能体（self-evolving agents）中的EvoSkill Injection威胁模型，并提出SARGE红队框架及两个基准数据集（EvoSkillBench和EvoSkillSafetyBench），系统性地评估恶意技能注入、存储与激活的风险，揭示技能进化管道存在持久性能力腐化隐患。
AI.motivation: 自进化智能体通过自主生成、精炼和复用技能来降本增效，但这一自主技能进化过程引入了新的攻击面：恶意能力可能被当作合法技能生成、存储并复用，导致持久性能力腐化，现有研究对该风险缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 提出SARGE红队框架，通过迭代生成、升级、强化三种交互环节对自进化智能体的技能生成与进化管道进行攻击测试；构建EvoSkillBench恶意交互轨迹数据集诱导恶意技能形成，并提出EvoSkillSafetyBench基准评估注入后恶意技能是否被检索与激活。
AI.result: SARGE成功诱导恶意技能形成，且注入的恶意技能会被持久存储并反复激活，证实了技能进化管道存在持久性能力腐化的重大安全风险。
AI.conclusion: 自进化智能体的自主技能进化机制存在严重安全漏洞，恶意技能可被注入形成、持久存储并被反复激活，亟需在技能生成与复用环节引入安全保障机制。

title: Biomechanical 3D Body: Self-Supervised Distillation of Biomechanical Pose from a 3D Body Foundation Model
comment: Accepted to the ECCV 2026 Workshop MoCha
summary: State-of-the-art monocular body recovery methods predict mesh vertices and angles on the corresponding kinematic tree, but their outputs lack biomechanically defined joint angles that downstream applications like clinical and biomechanical analyses require. We extend an existing foundation model, SAM-3D-Body, with an additional biomechanical prediction head that, from a single RGB image, regresses the joint angles and scales of a biomechanical model. Training this model presents a challenge, as there are limited datasets of paired images and biomechanical fits. To overcome this, we supervise biomechanical outputs with in-loop optimized targets from a Levenberg-Marquardt solver performing inverse kinematics fits against markers from the mesh predictions. This allows distilling the biomechanical head from the mesh head, even from unlabeled images. To make this work with GPU-optimized biomechanical models in MuJoCo, the entire model was implemented in JAX using Equinox. We trained this distilled output head on the publicly released SAM-3D-Body dataset. We then validated this model on biomechanical fits to two publicly available marker-based datasets, MoVi and BioCV, as well as movements from a clinical cohort captured with multiview markerless motion capture. The resulting model outperforms existing models for direct regression of biomechanics from images while only slightly underperforming the state-of-the-art monocular biomechanics method that performs more costly inference-time optimization of entire trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展SAM-3D-Body基础模型，增加一个生物力学预测头，从单张RGB图像直接回归生物力学模型的关节角度和尺度。通过Levenberg-Marquardt求解器反向动力学拟合网格预测中的标记点来生成优化目标，从而从未标注图像中蒸馏生物力学头部。整个模型用JAX和Equinox实现以兼容MuJoCo的GPU优化生物力学模型，在SAM-3D-Body数据集上训练，并在MoVi、BioCV及临床数据集上验证，性能优于现有直接回归方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的单目身体恢复方法输出网格顶点和运动学树角度，但缺乏下游临床应用（如临床和生物力学分析）所需的生物力学定义的关节角度。
AI.method: 在SAM-3D-Body基础模型上添加生物力学预测头，从单张RGB图像回归生物力学模型的关节角度和尺度；利用Levenberg-Marquardt求解器对网格预测进行反向运动学拟合生成优化目标来监督训练（知识蒸馏）；整个模型使用JAX和Equinox实现，兼容MuJoCo中GPU优化的生物力学模型。
AI.result: 在MoVi、BioCV和临床多视角无标记动捕数据集上验证，模型在直接回归生物力学参数方面优于现有方法，仅略逊于需要昂贵推理时整条轨迹优化的最先进单目生物力学方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过蒸馏策略解决了配对图像-生物力学数据稀缺的问题，实现了从单张图像高效直接回归生物力学参数的能力，为临床和生物力学分析提供了实用工具。

title: CHASE: How Content Ecosystems Are Reshaped When Ranking Is the Only Target
comment: Accepted to the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
summary: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is increasingly used to improve content visibility in LLM-based retrieval systems, yet its population-level effects under repeated optimization remain poorly understood. We introduce Content Homogenization under rAnking Signal Exploitation (CHASE), a controlled simulation framework for studying how content ecosystems are reshaped when creators repeatedly adapt documents to an LLM ranking signal. We use ranking as a proxy for source visibility and validate this abstraction against citations in grounded generated responses, obtaining a rank-citation AUC of 0.853 $\pm$ 0.093 across six domains. CHASE then iterates ranking, feature discrimination, rewriting, and evaluation over 20 rounds across different domains. Quality-ranking alignment decreases in all six domains: from R0 to R20, the change in Spearman's rho ranges from -0.107 to -0.018, with a mean change of -0.068, which means documents closer to the ranking feature profile become less aligned with independently judged document quality over the simulation horizon. A random-target control has shown that it is associated with adaptation toward ranking-derived incentives rather than iterative rewriting alone. The resulting ecosystem dynamics are strongly domain-dependent. Together, these findings show how repeated optimization against a fixed LLM ranking signal can reshape both content populations and the incentives faced by content creators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CHASE框架，一个受控模拟框架，用于研究创作者反复针对LLM排名信号优化内容时，内容生态系统如何被重塑。在六个领域进行20轮迭代后，发现质量-排名对齐度普遍下降（Spearman's rho平均变化-0.068），表明反复优化会导致内容同质化并削弱内容质量与排名之间的关联。
AI.motivation: 生成式引擎优化(GEO)被越来越多地用于提升内容在LLM检索系统中的可见性，但其在反复优化下对内容群体的种群层面影响仍知之甚少，缺乏系统性的研究框架来理解这一动态过程。
AI.method: 提出CHASE（Content Homogenization under rAnking Signal Exploitation）受控模拟框架。该方法包括：1) 使用排名作为来源可见性的代理，并通过引用验证该抽象（rank-citation AUC为0.853±0.093）；2) 跨六个领域迭代执行排名、特征区分、重写和评估等步骤，共20轮；3) 设置随机目标对照组以区分迭代重写本身与适应排名激励的效果。
AI.result: 在全部六个领域中，质量-排名对齐度均下降：从R0到R20，Spearman's rho变化范围为-0.107至-0.018，平均变化为-0.068。随机目标对照实验表明这种下降与适应排名激励相关，而非单纯的迭代重写导致。生态系统动态表现出强烈的领域依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 反复针对固定LLM排名信号进行优化，会重塑内容种群结构并改变内容创作者面临的激励，导致内容与排名特征趋同而偏离质量评判，最终形成内容同质化现象。这揭示了GEO的长期种群层面影响及其潜在的内容质量风险。

title: Evaluating 2D and 3D-Aware Vision Foundation Models for Vehicle Attribute Recognition
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI)
summary: Vehicle attribute recognition is an important task in intelligent transportation systems, particularly when Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) is unavailable or unreliable. Although vision foundation models have shown strong transferability across domains, their effectiveness for fine-grained vehicle classification remains underexplored. Moreover, given the inherently three-dimensional structure of vehicles, it is unclear whether emerging 3D-aware foundation models offer advantages over standard 2D architectures. This paper presents an empirical benchmark of 14 state-of-the-art 2D and 3D-aware vision foundation models. Using the challenging real-world UFPR-VeSV dataset, we evaluate these models as frozen feature extractors via linear probing for vehicle type, make, and model recognition. We further stress-test the best-performing models under few-shot learning and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) domain shifts. Our results show that standard 2D self-supervised models, particularly DINOv3, substantially outperform 3D-aware models in fine-grained tasks, achieving over 93% Macro-Accuracy for make and model recognition. However, the 3D-aware Depth Anything v2 exhibits stronger invariance to viewing angles in vehicle type classification. These findings motivate hybrid approaches that combine 2D and 3D priors for robust vehicle recognition. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/UFPR-IPASPPR/3D-Vision-Benchmark/.

AI.tldr: 本文对14个最先进的2D和3D感知视觉基础模型在车辆属性识别任务上进行了实证基准测试，使用UFPR-VeSV数据集，通过线性探测评估冻结特征提取器在车辆类型、品牌和型号识别上的表现。结果表明标准2D自监督模型（尤其是DINOv3）在细粒度任务上显著优于3D感知模型（品牌和型号识别达到93%以上宏精度），但3D感知模型Depth Anything v2在车辆类型分类中展现出更强的视角不变性，启示了融合2D和3D先验的混合方法。
AI.motivation: 在自动驾驶车牌识别（ALPR）不可用或不可靠时，车辆属性识别至关重要。尽管视觉基础模型展现出强大的跨域迁移能力，但其在细粒度车辆分类上的有效性尚未被充分探索；此外，鉴于车辆的三维结构特性，新兴的3D感知基础模型是否比标准2D架构更具优势仍是个未解问题。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个包含14个最先进的2D和3D感知视觉基础模型的实证基准，在具有挑战性的真实世界UFPR-VeSV数据集上，将这些模型作为冻结特征提取器，通过线性探测（linear probing）评估车辆类型、品牌和型号识别性能。此外，对最佳模型进行了少样本学习（few-shot learning）和分布外（OOD）域偏移的压力测试。
AI.result: 标准2D自监督模型，特别是DINOv3，在细粒度任务上大幅超越3D感知模型，在品牌和型号识别上达到93%以上的宏精度（Macro-Accuracy）。然而，3D感知模型Depth Anything v2在车辆类型分类中展现出更强的视角变化不变性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明2D基础模型在细粒度车辆识别任务中仍占主导地位，但3D感知模型在视角不变性方面具有独特优势，这为开发结合2D和3D先验的混合方法以提升车辆识别的鲁棒性提供了有力动机。

title: CM2: Multimodal Cultural Reasoning via an Integrated Multi-Agent Framework
comment: Accepted to the 23rd Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence (PRICAI 2026) as a short paper. 11 pages, 4 figures. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/GitHub-12138/CM2-Multimodal-Cultural-Reasoning-via-an-Integrated-Multi-Agent-Framework
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown remarkable success in STEM domains, where progress is often driven by vertical, step-by-step deduction under relatively stable symbol systems. Their horizontal, interdisciplinary cultural reasoning, however, remains underexplored.We propose CM2, a multi-agent framework grounded in the cognitive pathway of human cultural interpretation. CM2 integrates multimodal perception, retrieval-augmented generation, networked reasoning, gated fusion, and reward-driven feedback.Experiments on CM2D across multiple MLLM backbones show consistent gains over CoT and typical reasoning paradigms; ablations validate each module's contribution, and conflict analyses confirm genuine cross-modal arbitration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CM2多智能体框架，针对多模态大语言模型在跨学科文化推理方面的不足，通过整合多模态感知、检索增强生成、网络化推理、门控融合和奖励驱动反馈，在CM2D基准上取得了优于CoT及典型推理范式的稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在STEM领域表现出色，但主要依赖纵向、逐步演绎的推理方式，在需要横向、跨学科文化解读的任务上仍未被充分探索，缺乏有效的文化推理框架支撑。
AI.method: 提出CM2多智能体框架，以人类文化解读的认知路径为基础，整合多模态感知、检索增强生成、网络化推理、门控融合和奖励驱动反馈五个核心模块协同工作。
AI.result: 在CM2D基准上，多个MLLM骨干模型下CM2均获得一致性能提升；消融实验验证了各模块的贡献；冲突分析证实了真正的跨模态仲裁能力。
AI.conclusion: CM2有效弥补了MLLMs在跨学科文化推理上的短板，验证了基于人类认知路径的多智能体框架在文化推理任务中的可行性与有效性。

title: On the Role of MRI Sequences in Cross-Dataset Generalization for Brain Tumor Segmentation
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI)
summary: Brain tumor segmentation in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a critical task for diagnosis and treatment planning. Despite the success of deep learning architectures such as U-Net and its variants, performance degradation across datasets remains a major challenge, particularly under domain shift and limited annotated data. To address this issue, this study systematically evaluates how individual MRI sequences influence model robustness across two well-known datasets. A ResUNet-based framework is employed, where each modality is trained independently to isolate its effect under a controlled cross-dataset evaluation protocol with tumor size stratification, without target-domain training, or with limited domain adaptation. Results show that the T2f/FLAIR sequence achieves the best cross-dataset performance, with Dice scores exceeding 75%. It consistently outperforms other modalities across most tumor size ranges, while multi-sequence training further improves performance. Additionally, even limited target-domain adaptation yields rapid initial gains, reducing the need for extensive annotations and costly retraining. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/henrique-zan/brain_tumor_segmentation/.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了脑肿瘤MRI分割中各单一MRI序列（模态）对跨数据集鲁棒性的影响。采用ResUNet框架，在跨数据集协议下独立训练每个模态，发现T2f/FLAIR序列在跨数据集性能上最优（Dice超过75%），多序列训练可进一步提升性能，且少量目标域适应能带来快速初始收益。
AI.motivation: 尽管U-Net及其变体在脑肿瘤MRI分割中取得成功，但跨数据集性能退化仍是重大挑战，尤其在域偏移和标注数据有限的情况下。现有研究缺乏对个体MRI序列如何影响模型鲁棒性的系统评估。
AI.method: 采用ResUNet框架，在跨数据集评估协议下独立训练每个MRI模态以隔离其单独影响；协议包含肿瘤大小分层、无目标域训练或有限域适应，在两个公开数据集上系统评估各模态的鲁棒性表现。
AI.result: T2f/FLAIR序列在跨数据集分割中表现最优，Dice分数超过75%，且在大多数肿瘤大小范围内一致优于其他模态；多序列联合训练进一步提升了性能；有限的目标域适应也能带来快速的初始性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 单序列评估揭示了T2f/FLAIR在跨数据集鲁棒性方面的重要价值，有限域适应能够有效降低对大量标注数据和昂贵重训练的需求，为实际临床部署中的模态选择和数据效率提供了指导性建议。

title: ScienceArena: Benchmarking LLMs on Latest Scientific Olympiad Competitions
summary: Benchmark saturation and data contamination increasingly obscure genuine scientific reasoning in frontier LLMs. We introduce \textsc{ScienceArena}, an olympiad-style benchmark from thirteen public science competitions in physics, chemistry, and biology, including IPhO and IChO 2025--2026, IBO 2023, USAPhO 2026, and USNCO 2025. Its open-ended, multi-step problems use process-credit rubrics, making faithful scoring difficult. We build ScienceArena through an expert-audited digitization pipeline that converts official exams, figures, solutions, and rubrics into structured items verified by olympiad medalists. To scale evaluation beyond costly human grading, we calibrate LLM-as-judge against medalist ground truth on archived answers from five models across IPhO and IChO; two strong judges stay within one point of expert total scores. Medalist notes show that failures often stem from visual grounding, structure fidelity, and global problem control rather than missing terminology. Evaluating fourteen recent LLMs with interleaved solving, we find that top models obtain medal-equivalent rubric scores on several public international exams, while chemistry and long-horizon consistency remain key bottlenecks. We provide an interactive \href{https://science-arena.onrender.com/}{demo}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScienceArena，一个基于十三项国际科学竞赛（如IPhO、IChO、IBO等）的奥林匹克级基准，用于评估前沿LLM在物理学、化学和生物学中的开放型推理能力。通过专家审核的数字化流程构建高质量题目，并利用LLM-as-judge替代人工评分，实验发现顶级模型在部分公开国际竞赛中已达到奖牌水平，但化学和长程一致性仍是关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准面临饱和与数据污染问题，难以真实反映前沿LLM的科学推理能力。开放式的竞赛题目需要过程性评分（process-credit rubrics），传统自动评估难以覆盖，且人工评分成本高昂，亟需更可靠、可扩展的科学推理评估框架。
AI.method: 1) 从13个公开科学竞赛（IPhO/IChO 2025-2026、IBO 2023、USAPhO 2026、USNCO 2025等）构建ScienceArena；2) 采用专家审核的数字化管道，将官方试题、图表、解答和评分细则转换为结构化题目，并由奥林匹克奖牌得主验证；3) 通过LLM-as-judge校准，使用5个模型在IPhO和IChO上的存档答案对照奖牌得主真值，筛选出两个评分偏差在1分以内的强评判器；4) 评估14个近期LLM，采用交错解题（interleaved solving）策略。
AI.result: 顶级LLM在多项公开国际竞赛上获得了奖牌等级的评分，但化学领域和长时间序列推理（long-horizon consistency）仍是主要瓶颈。奖牌得主笔记分析表明，模型失败的主因来自视觉定位（visual grounding）、结构保真度（structure fidelity）和全局问题控制（global problem control），而非术语缺失。
AI.conclusion: ScienceArena提供了更真实、抗污染的科学推理评估基准，验证了LLM-as-judge可规模化替代人工评分，并揭示了当前模型在视觉理解与长程推理方面的核心短板，为后续科学推理能力提升指明方向。

title: RIDGE: Region-Informed Derivative-Guided Evidence Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long videos contain far more visual content than Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) can process under a fixed visual-token budget, making frame selection essential. Existing query-aware selectors usually estimate frame-query relevance and build a compact subset from high-scoring frames. Although their mechanisms differ, the similarity sequence is still often treated primarily as values to rank or sample from, rather than as an ordered signal whose shape reflects how query-relevant evidence emerges, peaks, and fades over time. This can obscure frames that explain, contextualize, or follow an event, because such evidence may lie on the rising or falling sides of a nearby relevance peak and receive lower absolute scores. We propose RIDGE, a frame selection framework that reads the frame-query similarity curve as a temporal signal. By using local changes and curvature, RIDGE partitions the timeline into structural regions and applies region-specific selection to preserve event cores, transitions, buildup, aftermath, and contextual frames under a fixed budget. It is a lightweight post-processing step on precomputed frame-query scores and requires neither training nor iterative LVLM calls. Across four long-video benchmarks and three backbones, RIDGE achieves the best performance in most settings and remains competitive in the others.

AI.tldr: 提出RIDGE框架，将帧-查询相似度曲线视为时间信号，通过局部变化和曲率将时间线划分为结构区域，并采用区域特定选择策略在固定预算下保留事件核心、过渡、铺垫、后续及上下文帧，无需训练即可提升长视频LVLM性能。
AI.motivation: 现有查询感知帧选择器通常将相似度序列仅视为用于排序或采样的数值，忽略了其形状所反映的查询相关证据随时间出现、达到峰值和消退的时序模式。这会导致位于相关峰值上升或下降侧的帧（如解释、上下文或后续证据）因绝对分数较低而被遗漏。
AI.method: RIDGE将帧-查询相似度曲线读取为时间信号，利用局部变化和曲率将时间线划分为结构化区域（事件核心、过渡、铺垫、后续、上下文），并对每个区域采用特定的选择策略，在固定预算下保留多样化的关键帧。该方法是对预计算帧-查询分数的轻量级后处理，无需训练或迭代调用LVLM。
AI.result: 在四个长视频基准测试和三个骨干模型上，RIDGE在大多数设置下取得最佳性能，在其他设置中保持具有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过将相似度序列视为有形状的有序信号而非简单数值排名，能更全面地捕捉视频中与查询相关的结构化证据，为长视频LVLM的帧选择提供了一种高效、无需训练的改进方案。

title: Learning-Assisted Congestion-Aware Route Scheduling for Semiconductor Fab Material Control Systems
summary: Automated material handling systems in semiconductor fabs are operated by a material control system (MCS) that must schedule a relay route for every transport command online, before execution. This is a data-driven scheduling problem in which route cost is dominated in the upper tail by queueing at heterogeneous, partially observable relay equipment, so route selection requires estimating both delivery time and congestion risk at the decision moment. This paper proposes a transport-network-aware dynamic congestion representation (TN-DCR). Built on a static directed transport graph induced by historically observed relay segments, TN-DCR combines structural route priors, multi-window network-wide congestion context, route-level bottleneck exposure, and an inductive graph-aware route embedding, all constructed under a prediction-time-safety invariant that admits only information observed strictly before the prediction moment. The representation feeds separate queue- and transfer-time regressors and an ordinal multi-label classifier producing calibrated multi-threshold exceedance scores, with an empirical-Bayes stock-key residual correction reducing systematic queue-time underprediction. The predictions serve as costs in a risk-constrained route-scheduling rule that minimizes predicted delivery time subject to a bound on extreme-congestion probability, embedding the learned predictors within a lightweight operations-research decision model. In a controlled closed-loop evaluation, mean delivery time falls by 16.4\% and internal resource waiting time by 22.6\% while throughput remains essentially unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文针对半导体晶圆厂中自动化物料搬运系统（MCS）的在线路径调度问题，提出了一种运输网络感知的动态拥塞表征（TN-DCR）方法，结合结构路由先验、多窗口全网拥塞上下文、路由级瓶颈暴露和归纳式图感知路由嵌入，并配合两个回归器与序数多标签分类器输出校准后的超阈值分数，最后以风险约束路线调度规则实现预测与决策的闭环。实验显示平均交付时间降低16.4%，内部资源等待时间降低22.6%，吞吐量基本不变。
AI.motivation: MCS需在每条运输命令执行前在线调度中转路线，这是一个数据驱动的调度问题，其成本由异构、部分可观测中转设备处的排队效应主导（尤其在上尾分布），因此路径选择需在决策时刻同时估计交付时间与拥塞风险。现有方法缺乏对运输网络拓扑与动态拥塞的综合建模。
AI.method: 提出TN-DCR表征，基于历史中转片段构建的静态有向运输图，整合四类信息：结构性路线先验、多时间窗口的网络级拥塞上下文、路线级瓶颈暴露度、以及归纳式图感知路线嵌入；所有表征在"预测时刻安全性"不变量下构建（仅允许预测时刻之前观测到的信息）。表征输入分别用于排队时间与转移时间回归器以及序数多标签分类器，生成经过校准的多阈值超限分数，并以经验贝叶斯残差修正减少系统性排队时间低估。最终将这些预测作为路径代价，嵌入一个轻量级运筹决策模型，实现在极端拥塞概率约束下最小化预期交付时间的风险约束路径调度规则。
AI.result: 在受控闭环评估中，平均交付时间下降16.4%，内部资源等待时间下降22.6%，吞吐量基本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: TN-DCR通过预测与决策的紧耦合集成，在不牺牲吞吐量的前提下显著改善了物料交付时间与资源等待时间，验证了考虑运输网络动态拥塞表征在MCS路径调度中的有效性。

title: Confidence-Aware Ensemble and Long-Word Refinement for Artistic Text Recognition
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI)
summary: Artistic Text Recognition (ATR) remains challenging because word images often combine decorative fonts, curved layouts, object-like characters, clutter, and severe distortions. This paper studies WordArt-V1.5 as a standardized benchmark for this setting and evaluates recent scene and artistic text recognizers under a common protocol. We propose a confidence-aware ensemble that combines SVTRv2, PARSeq, and MAERec after fine-tuning on the official training split. The ensemble selects predictions using the minimum confidence over disagreement positions, emphasizing characters that separate competing hypotheses. For long words, where a single character error can invalidate the whole prediction, we add a targeted refinement stage based on Needleman-Wunsch alignment and lexicon-guided correction. On the WordArt-V1.5 Test B split, the proposed system reaches 89.90% Word Recognition Accuracy, improving the best individual fine-tuned model by 1.77 percentage points. The long-word refinement produces a modest global gain, but improves the targeted long-word subset by 2.72 percentage points. Finally, an error analysis of all remaining mistakes shows that 48.8% are associated with labeling issues, visual ambiguity, or illegible samples, highlighting the value of diagnostic reporting for future ATR benchmarks and models. Our source code is available at https://github.com/lucas-azdias/Artistic-Text-Recognition/.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了WordArt-V1.5作为艺术文字识别(ATR)的标准基准，提出了一种置信度感知的集成模型（结合SVTRv2、PARSeq和MAERec），并针对长词引入基于Needleman-Wunsch对齐和词典引导校正的细化阶段。在Test B集上达到89.90%的字识别准确率，比最佳单模型提升1.77个百分点，长词子集提升2.72个百分点。错误分析显示48.8%的错误源于标注问题、视觉歧义或难以辨认的样本。
AI.motivation: 艺术文字识别(ATR)仍具挑战性，因为单词图像常结合装饰性字体、弯曲布局、类物体字符、杂乱背景和严重畸变。需要一个标准化基准和通用协议来评估现有场景及艺术文字识别器的性能。
AI.method: 1) 在WordArt-V1.5官方训练集上微调SVTRv2、PARSeq和MAERec三种识别器；2) 提出置信度感知集成方法，利用分歧位置的最小置信度选择预测，强调区分竞争假设的关键字符；3) 针对长词加入基于Needleman-Wunsch对齐和词典引导校正的定向细化阶段。
AI.result: 在WordArt-V1.5 Test B上达到89.90%字识别准确率，比最佳单个微调模型提升1.77个百分点；长词细化带来适度的全局增益，但使目标长词子集提升2.72个百分点。错误分析显示48.8%的残留错误与标注问题、视觉歧义或不可读样本相关。
AI.conclusion: 置信度感知集成结合长词细化能有效提升艺术文字识别性能；诊断性错误报告对推动ATR基准和模型发展具有重要价值，应被纳入未来研究。

title: DiffPDE: Masked Diffusion Language Models as PDE Solver
summary: Existing approaches for synthesizing Partial Differential Equation (PDE) solvers predominantly rely on autoregressive models, yet their global left-to-right decoding incurs substantial redundancy when addressing inherently localized bugs. In this work, we challenge this inefficient paradigm and propose DiffPDE, a framework leveraging discrete diffusion language models for targeted code repair. By introducing a localized re-masking and infilling strategy, DiffPDE regenerates only erroneous regions while preserving correct context, naturally aligning generation with the sparse nature of PDE errors. Furthermore, to handle coupled bugs requiring sequential interventions, we present Iterative Debugging GRPO (ID-GRPO), a reinforcement learning scheme that enables multi-round debugging within single trajectories via intermediate rewards. Experiments on PDEBench show that DiffPDE achieves competitive accuracy, outperforms same-scale AR models, and significantly accelerates repair.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffPDE，一个基于离散扩散语言模型的PDE求解器合成框架，通过局部重掩码与填充策略实现定向代码修复，并引入ID-GRPO强化学习方案支持多轮调试，在PDEBench上取得竞争性精度并加速修复。
AI.motivation: 现有PDE求解器合成方法主要依赖自回归模型，其全局从左到右的解码方式在修复局部bug时存在大量冗余计算，效率低下。作者希望挑战这一低效范式，提出更符合PDE错误稀疏特性的修复方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出DiffPDE框架，利用离散扩散语言模型进行定向代码修复；2) 设计局部重掩码（re-masking）与填充（infilling）策略，仅重新生成错误区域而保留正确上下文；3) 提出Iterative Debugging GRPO (ID-GRPO)强化学习方案，通过中间奖励支持单轨迹内的多轮调试，以处理需要顺序干预的耦合bug。
AI.result: 在PDEBench基准上的实验表明，DiffPDE达到了具有竞争力的精度，性能优于同规模的自回归模型，并显著加速了代码修复过程。
AI.conclusion: 通过将扩散模型与局部修复策略及多轮强化学习调试相结合，DiffPDE验证了非自回归范式在PDE求解器合成任务中的有效性，为解决该领域代码修复效率问题提供了新思路。

title: SpanCalib-VLM: Calibrated Hallucination Span Detection in Vision-Language Models
summary: Detecting hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) requires both accurate span localization and well-calibrated confidence scores. Fine-tuned generative VLMs excel at identifying hallucinated text spans but suffer from overconfidence and high inference latency. Discriminative sequence taggers offer deterministic speed and superior calibration but exhibit conservative span recall. We present SpanCalib-VLM, a hybrid dual-system for the SHROOM-Visions Shared Task that combines a multimodal sequence tagger, consisting of XLM-RoBERTa-Large fused with a SigLIP vision encoder via cross-attention, with our fine-tuned generative VLM (Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT). Through a Union-Calibrated Fusion strategy, candidate spans from the generative model are re-scored with calibrated probabilities from the sequence tagger. On the SHROOM-Visions English evaluation split, our ensemble achieves a Pearson calibration correlation of 0.41 and an overall IoU of 0.39, with a clean-response IoU of 0.91} and overall detection accuracy of 70.7%. We make our model weights and code publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpanCalib-VLM，一种用于大视觉语言模型幻觉检测的混合双系统，结合多模态序列标注器（XLM-RoBERTa-Large + SigLIP）与微调的生成式VLM（Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT），通过Union-Calibrated Fusion策略对生成模型的候选跨度用序列标注器的校准概率重新评分，在SHROOM-Visions任务上取得良好性能。
AI.motivation: 幻觉检测需要精确的跨度定位和良好的置信度校准。生成式VLM擅长识别幻觉文本跨度但存在过度自信和推理延迟高的问题；判别式序列标注器速度快、校准好但跨度召回保守。两者互补，需要结合双方优势。
AI.method: 构建混合双系统：1）多模态序列标注器，由XLM-RoBERTa-Large与SigLIP视觉编码器通过交叉注意力融合；2）微调的生成式VLM（Qwen3.5-4B-SHROOM-SFT）。通过Union-Calibrated Fusion策略，将生成模型的候选跨度用序列标注器的校准概率重新打分。
AI.result: 在SHROOM-Visions英文评估集上，集成系统达到Pearson校准相关度0.41、总体IoU 0.39、干净响应IoU 0.91、总体检测准确率70.7%。
AI.conclusion: 混合双系统策略有效结合了生成式模型的跨度识别能力和判别式模型的校准优势，模型权重和代码已公开。

title: Designing an Auditable LLM-Supported Workflow for Qualitative Thematic Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new possibilities for scaling qualitative analysis, but existing applications often provide limited methodological transparency regarding how qualitative methods are translated into computational procedures. This paper presents an auditable and privacy-preserving computational operationalization of inductive and latent Thematic Analysis (TA). This paper first derives five design principles from the methodological requirements of TA and the conditions introduced by LLM-based inference: preserving interpretative context, maintaining traceable relationships between empirical material and analytical outputs, representing analytical constructs and reasoning explicitly, constraining LLM inference to interpretative tasks, and enabling privacy-preserving local deployment. Second, it presents a proof-of-concept for a two-phase workflow that operationalizes these principles by combining interpretative LLM inference with deterministic procedural control to generate codes, analytical justifications, themes, and theme descriptions while preserving explicit links to the source material. Third, it proposes an evaluation framework combining structural comparison with human-led TA and independent expert assessment of analytical quality. The evaluation is conducted on semi-structured Danish interview transcripts. and the results shows that the workflow produces code-level outputs with coverage broadly comparable to human annotations and highly rated analytical justifications, while generating a more compressed thematic structure characterized by fewer and broader themes. The findings demonstrate the feasibility of auditable LLM-supported TA through a modular workflow designed to scale to larger datasets, accommodate different LLMs, and support transfer across research domains, with domain adaptation primarily requiring adjustments to the prompting strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可审计且保护隐私的计算化操作方案，用于归纳性和潜在主题分析（TA）。该方案通过两条腿走路的方式——解释性LLM推理结合确定性程序控制——生成代码、分析理由、主题及主题描述，并保留与原始材料的显式关联。在丹麦语半结构化访谈数据上的评估显示，其代码级输出覆盖率与人工标注大体相当，分析理由评分较高，但生成的主题结构更压缩（更少且更宽泛）。
AI.motivation: LLM为规模化定性分析提供了新可能，但现有应用在方法论透明度上不足——即如何将定性方法转化为计算程序缺乏清晰的说明。作者旨在弥合这一差距，提供可审计且可复现的LLM辅助主题分析方法。
AI.method: 论文包含三部分：(1) 从TA方法论要求和LLM推理条件中推导出五项设计原则；(2) 提出两阶段工作流的原型验证，结合解释性LLM推理与确定性程序控制；(3) 提出评估框架，将结构比较与人工主导的TA及独立专家评估相结合。
AI.result: 在丹麦语半结构化访谈转录数据上的评估表明：工作流产生的代码级输出与人工注释覆盖率大体相当，分析理由获得高度评价，但生成的主题结构更压缩——主题数量更少、范围更宽泛。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了可审计的LLM支持主题分析的可行性，其模块化工作流可扩展至更大数据集、适配不同LLM，并支持跨研究领域迁移；领域适配主要需调整提示策略即可。

title: FIS-OT: Feature-Induced Optimal Transport for Unsupervised Action Segmentation
summary: Unsupervised action segmentation is a challenging task. It involves finding action categories and boundaries in videos without labels. Existing Optimal Transport (OT) methods use global constraints. This causes them to overlook the use of local information. Furthermore, existing Optimal transport architectures are prone to confirmation bias because they overly trust the pseudo-labels they generate. This causes models to learn from noise in the early training stages. To address these issues, we propose FIS-OT. It is a novel Feature-Induced Structured Optimal Transport framework. First, we introduce a Feature Enhanced Generator (FEG) module. It serves as an internal regularizer. By using triplet loss, FEG captures local consistency. It provides robust supervision that is independent of noisy pseudo-labels. Second, we propose a Feature-Induced Residual Structural Prior. This combines a fixed temporal backbone with dynamic feature similarities. This design ensures temporal continuity. It also allows the solver to adapt to complex action structures. Finally, we establish a cyclic optimization loop. This aligns local feature learning with global structural alignment. Extensive experiments on the three datasets show the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出FIS-OT框架，通过特征增强生成器（FEG）和特征诱导残差结构先验解决无监督动作分割中OT方法忽视局部信息及确认偏差的问题，在三个数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有最优传输（OT）方法使用全局约束，忽视了局部信息的利用；同时OT架构过度信任自生成的伪标签，在早期训练阶段产生确认偏差，导致模型从噪声中学习。
AI.method: 提出FIS-OT框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 特征增强生成器（FEG）模块作为内部正则化器，通过三元组损失捕获局部一致性，提供独立于噪声伪标签的稳健监督；(2) 特征诱导残差结构先验，结合固定时间骨干网络与动态特征相似性，确保时间连续性同时适应复杂动作结构；(3) 循环优化循环，将局部特征学习与全局结构对齐相结合。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的广泛实验证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: FIS-OT通过引入局部信息监督和缓解确认偏差，有效提升了无监督动作分割的性能。

title: GarmentWeaver: Schema-Aware Structured Synthesis for Multimodal Sewing Patterns
summary: Multimodal Sewing pattern generation aims to infer executable sewing patterns from design cues such as sketches and textual descriptions. As an interpretable and simulation-compatible representation, sewing patterns are particularly valuable for digital garment creation. However, existing methods often model garment specifications as flat long sequences, which entangles garment structure with detailed parameters and leads to redundant components, inaccurate local details, and poor simulation compatibility. In this paper, we present GarmentWeaver, a schema-aware framework for multimodal Sewing pattern generation. GarmentWeaver constructs compact hierarchical targets by activating garment-relevant structural branches and predicts executable Sewing patterns in a structured manner. Specifically, we introduce a schema-aware target construction strategy, build the generator on top of a pretrained vision-language model for multimodal garment understanding, and impose feasibility-aware regularization to encourage structurally valid and simulation-compatible outputs. Extensive experiments show that GarmentWeaver produces more accurate and more executable sewing patterns than strong baselines, while also yielding better simulation results. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of schema-aware structured generation for reliable multimodal Sewing pattern prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GarmentWeaver，一种基于模式感知的框架，用于多模态缝纫图案生成。该框架通过构建紧凑的分层目标、激活服装相关结构分支，并以结构化方式预测可执行的缝纫图案，解决了现有方法将服装规格建模为扁平长序列导致的结构纠缠、局部细节不准确和仿真兼容性差的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将服装规格建模为扁平长序列，导致服装结构与其详细参数纠缠在一起，产生冗余组件、不准确的局部细节以及较差的仿真兼容性，难以生成可靠可执行的多模态缝纫图案。
AI.method: GarmentWeaver包含三个核心组件：(1) 模式感知的目标构建策略，通过激活服装相关结构分支构建紧凑的分层目标；(2) 基于预训练视觉-语言模型构建生成器，实现多模态服装理解；(3) 可行性感知的正则化，鼓励生成结构有效且仿真兼容的输出。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，GarmentWeaver在生成准确性和可执行性上均优于强基线方法，同时产生更好的仿真结果。
AI.conclusion: 模式感知的结构化生成方法对于可靠的多模态缝纫图案预测是有效的，能够显著提升缝纫图案的准确性和仿真兼容性。

title: SVI2LoD3: Agent-Driven Reconstruction of LoD3 Facade Openings in Semantic 3D City Models from Volunteered Street View Imagery using Large Language and Visual Models
comment: Accepted for publication in the ISPRS Annals of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences
summary: This paper presents an end-to-end, agent-driven pipeline for the LoD3 reconstruction of facade openings in 3D city models, producing directly usable CityGML-conform outputs. In contrast to existing approaches that rely on supervised semantic segmentation and therefore require large amounts of manually annotated training data, the proposed method employs a zero-shot segmentation strategy. This substantially reduces the annotation effort while still achieving strong performance in our benchmark on the eTRIMS dataset. A further key contribution is the enforcement of correct partonomic hierarchies, thereby producing CityGML-conform LoD3 building models. Beyond the reconstruction pipeline itself, this work also introduces a novel evaluation metric for facade reconstruction, termed Facade Feature Distance (FFD). Unlike conventional metrics such as mIoU or FRDS, which assess similarity primarily through pixel-wise overlap, FFD measures distance in a high-level feature space derived from a vision transformer. In doing so, it captures both semantic correctness and architectural layout, providing a more suitable assessment of facade reconstruction quality. The proposed pipeline and evaluation strategy together offer a practical and scalable contribution toward the automated generation and analysis of semantically enriched 3D city models. The developed code is published at: https://github.com/hcu-cml/citydb-SVI2LoD3-ai.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端、智能体驱动的LoD3立面开口重建管线，采用零样本分割策略生成CityGML兼容的3D城市模型，并引入新的评估指标FFD（Facade Feature Distance）来衡量立面重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有立面重建方法依赖监督式语义分割，需要大量人工标注训练数据，标注成本高昂；同时传统评估指标（如mIoU、FRDS）主要基于像素级重叠，无法充分捕捉语义正确性和建筑布局结构。
AI.method: 采用零样本分割策略替代监督式分割，减少标注需求；通过强制正确的部分-整体层级关系（partonomic hierarchies）生成CityGML合规的LoD3建筑模型；提出基于视觉Transformer高维特征空间的FFD评估指标，同时衡量语义正确性与建筑布局。
AI.result: 在eTRIMS数据集基准测试中取得强性能表现，同时大幅减少标注工作量；FFD指标相比传统像素级指标更能反映立面重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该管线与评估策略为自动化生成和分析语义丰富的3D城市模型提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案，代码已开源发布。

title: AdaPath: Query-Adaptive Path-Finding via Path-Bank for Multi-Hop Implicit Biomedical KGQA
summary: Path-finding over knowledge graphs has become an effective way to ground LLM reasoning on multi-hop questions. However, biomedical QA introduces two distinct challenges that general-domain methods are not designed for: (i) queries do not expose intermediate reasoning and can be answered through multiple valid pathways, and (ii) biomedical knowledge graphs are densely connected, so path-finding methods easily take wrong turns. To address these challenges, we propose AdaPath, a path-finding framework that retrieves query-adaptive meta-paths from Path-Bank, which captures both query semantics and biomedical knowledge graph structure. AdaPath provides the missing cues in biomedical queries while effectively pruning dense knowledge graph neighborhoods during multi-hop reasoning. We further release BioStrat-QA, a biomedical KGQA benchmark that stratifies multi-hop queries by how much intermediate reasoning they expose. Across biomedical KGQA benchmarks, AdaPath consistently outperforms baselines, sustaining meaningful path-finding even when multi-hop queries expose less surface information. The source code is available at https://github.com/Jun-Hyeong-Kim/AdaPath.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaPath，一个面向生物医学知识图谱问答的路径查找框架，通过从Path-Bank检索查询自适应的元路径来弥补查询中缺失的中间推理信息，并有效剪枝密集的知识图谱邻域。同时发布了BioStrat-QA基准测试集，用于按中间推理暴露程度对多跳查询进行分层评估。
AI.motivation: 生物医学问答中存在两个通用方法未解决的挑战：(i) 查询不暴露中间推理且可通过多条有效路径回答；(ii) 生物医学知识图谱连接密集，路径查找方法容易走错方向。这两点使通用领域的路径查找方法难以直接适用。
AI.method: 提出AdaPath框架，通过从Path-Bank中检索查询自适应的元路径，同时捕捉查询语义和生物医学知识图谱的结构信息，在进行多跳推理时有效剪枝密集的知识图谱邻域。此外发布了BioStrat-QA基准，按中间推理暴露程度对多跳查询进行分层。
AI.result: 在多个生物医学KGQA基准上，AdaPath一致优于基线方法；即使在多跳查询暴露较少表面信息的情况下，仍能维持有意义的路径查找性能。
AI.conclusion: AdaPath通过查询自适应的元路径检索机制，有效解决了生物医学查询中间推理缺失和知识图谱密集连接带来的路径查找难题，展示了在生物医学KGQA领域的实用性。

title: Partition-Aware Unlearning for Removing Spurious Correlations in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance across many multimodal tasks; however, they often exploit spurious object-background correlations, resulting in predictions driven by contextual shortcuts rather than object-relevant visual evidence. Despite growing interest in hallucination and robustness evaluation, existing benchmarks provide limited control over whether model predictions are grounded in the target object or induced by correlated background cues. In this work, we introduce PURGE (\underline{P}artition-aware \underline{U}nlearning for \underline{R}emoving spurious-correlation \underline{G}enerated \underline{E}rrors), a framework for constructing, benchmarking, and mitigating spurious-correlation-induced failures in LVLMs. The framework consists of: -- (1) Structured dataset construction wherein we develop three complementary structured data construction strategies that partition examples by object-relevant evidence and spurious background cues, enabling controlled diagnosis of shortcut reliance; and -- (2) Partition-aware unlearning, which uses these partitions to selectively remove spurious object-background associations while preserving object-based reasoning. We evaluate the \algo~framework across multiple LVLMs, including LLaVA-1.6-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-9B, together with CLIP as a vision-language encoder, on a diverse suite of benchmarks, including CHAIR, POPE, Causal-HalBench, MM-SpuBench, AMBER, MMHal, and Waterbirds. Our results show that PURGE consistently reduces hallucinations and spurious-correlation-driven errors while maintaining or improving overall performance in most evaluated settings, providing both a reusable evaluation protocol and an effective mitigation framework for more reliable LVLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PURGE框架，用于构建、评估和缓解大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中由虚假物体-背景相关性导致的预测偏差。框架包含结构化数据集构建（三种互补策略分区目标物体证据与背景线索）和分区感知的反学习（选择性消除虚假关联同时保留基于物体的推理），在多个LVLM和基准上验证了其减少幻觉和虚假相关性错误的有效性。
AI.motivation: LVLM常利用虚假的物体-背景相关性做出预测，而非基于目标物体的视觉证据。现有基准无法有效控制模型预测是基于目标物体还是受背景线索诱导，缺乏对这类问题的系统性诊断和缓解手段。
AI.method: PURGE框架包含两部分：(1) 三种互补的结构化数据构建策略，将样本按物体相关证据和虚假背景线索进行分区，实现受控诊断；(2) 分区感知的反学习机制，利用这些分区选择性移除虚假的物体-背景关联，同时保留基于物体的推理能力。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.6-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、Qwen3.5-9B和CLIP等多个模型上，在CHAIR、POPE、Causal-HalBench、MM-SpuBench、AMBER、MMHal和Waterbirds等基准上，PURGE一致性地减少了幻觉和虚假相关性驱动的错误，并在大多数评估场景中保持或提升了整体性能。
AI.conclusion: PURGE提供了一套可复用的评估协议和有效的缓解框架，有助于提升LVLM的可靠性和鲁棒性，减少对虚假背景线索的依赖。

title: TuringLLM: Efficiently Scaling Foundation Models Toward Physical AI
summary: We present Turing-20B-A2B, a 20B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model that activates approximately 2B parameters per token, designed for long-context and latency-sensitive physical AI applications. The model adopts Quantile Routing in a dynamic top-k configuration, enabling token-adaptive expert allocation while maintaining balanced expert utilization and a controlled average compute budget. During deployment, we further apply capacity-constrained routing to prompt prefill for more regular and efficient expert execution, while retaining dropless routing during pretraining. Turing-20B-A2B also employs a hybrid attention architecture that combines Lightning Attention with a small number of full-attention layers for efficient long-context modeling. The model is pretrained with a progressive three-stage curriculum and extended to a native context length of 128K through continued pretraining, with further inference-time extension to 512K using YaRN. Despite its compact active-parameter budget, Turing-20B-A2B achieves, at the base-model stage, overall general capability exceeding Qwen3-8B Base and approaching Qwen3.5-9B Base, while maintaining strong long-context performance and favorable prefill-latency scaling. These results demonstrate an effective balance among model capability, long-context scalability, and practical inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出Turing-20B-A2B，一个20B参数的MoE语言模型，每token仅激活约2B参数。采用Quantile Routing动态top-k配置实现token自适应专家分配，结合Lightning Attention与少量全注意力层的混合架构支持长上下文，通过三阶段课程预训练扩展到128K原生上下文，可进一步扩展到512K。在基础模型阶段，其综合能力超过Qwen3-8B Base并接近Qwen3.5-9B Base，同时保持良好的长上下文性能和prefill延迟。
AI.motivation: 面向长上下文和延迟敏感的物理AI应用，需要在模型能力、长上下文可扩展性和实际推理效率之间取得平衡，传统稠密模型或固定路由MoE难以同时满足这些需求。
AI.method: 1) Quantile Routing动态top-k配置，实现token自适应的专家分配并保证专家利用均衡；2) 部署时对prompt prefill采用容量约束路由提升执行效率，预训练阶段保留dropless routing；3) 混合注意力架构：Lightning Attention结合少量全注意力层；4) 三阶段渐进式课程预训练，持续预训练扩展至128K上下文，通过YaRN进一步扩展至512K。
AI.result: 基础模型综合能力超过Qwen3-8B Base，接近Qwen3.5-9B Base；在每token仅激活2B参数的紧凑预算下保持了强大的长上下文性能和良好的prefill延迟扩展特性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了在模型能力、长上下文可扩展性和实际推理效率三者之间实现有效平衡的可行路径，验证了动态路由MoE与混合注意力架构结合的有效性。

title: Discrete Diffusion Bridges for Spatiotemporally Aligned Image Translation and Generation
summary: We propose Discrete Diffusion Bridges (DDB), a novel framework designed to resolve the fundamental spatiotemporal misalignment of standard discrete diffusion in image translation and generation. By corrupting data into a pure mask state via a random schedule, the conventional forward process induces a twofold misalignment: spatially, this pure-mask destination entirely discards the rich structural priors of the source image; temporally, the random masking order inherently contradicts the ``easy-first, hard-last'' decoding mechanism used during inference. To address this, DDB constructs a direct and efficient trajectory between domains. Spatially, we introduce a hybrid absorption mechanism that redefines the absorbing state to a stochastic mixture of mask and source tokens, effectively injecting source prior as spatial anchors into the latent space. Temporally, we design an information-guided noise schedule that quantifies semantic variation to prioritize the corruption of high-information regions at earlier timesteps. This ensures the model learns to resolve difficult semantic changes using robust context from invariant regions. Extensive experiments validate the versatility and robustness of our framework across diverse generative paradigms. DDB effectively balances edit alignment with structural fidelity across both text-guided semantic manipulation and pure structural image translation, while inherently complementing text-to-image generation and guaranteeing robust high-quality decoding under extremely low sampling steps. Code and models are available at \href{https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DDB}{https://github.com/HKU-HealthAI/DDB}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出离散扩散桥（DDB）框架，解决标准离散扩散在图像翻译和生成中的时空错位问题。通过混合吸收机制在空间上注入源图像先验，以及信息引导噪声调度在时间上优先破坏高信息区域，DDB构建了领域间直接高效的轨迹，在多种生成范式上均验证了有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 标准离散扩散的前向过程将数据破坏为纯掩码状态，导致双重错位：空间上纯掩码目标完全丢弃了源图像的丰富结构先验；时间上随机掩码顺序与推理时"易先难后"的解码机制相矛盾。
AI.method: 1) 空间上：提出混合吸收机制，将吸收态重新定义为掩码与源token的随机混合，将源先验作为空间锚点注入潜空间；2) 时间上：设计信息引导的噪声调度，量化语义变化以优先破坏早期时间步的高信息区域，使模型能利用不变区域的鲁棒上下文解决困难语义变化。
AI.result: 广泛实验验证了框架在多种生成范式中的通用性和鲁棒性。DDB在文本引导语义操作和纯结构图像翻译中有效平衡了编辑对齐与结构保真度，同时天然补充文本到图像生成，并保证极低采样步数下的高质量解码。
AI.conclusion: DDB通过空间和时间两个维度的针对性设计，成功解决了离散扩散在图像翻译中的错位问题，提供了统一且高效的框架，兼容多种生成范式，并开源了代码和模型。

title: Automated Testing of LLM-Based Post Hoc Explainers Using Model Checking as an Oracle
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used as post hoc explainers of sequential decision-making policies, producing natural-language explanations of why an action was chosen. However, LLMs often generate plausible but incorrect statements, and no existing approach systematically tests whether such explanations are faithful to the underlying environment. Two classic software testing challenges stand in the way: there is no oracle for the correctness of an explanation, and the test inputs, natural language queries about a policy's behavior, lack the structure needed for systematic test case generation. We address both. Probabilistic model checking provides the test oracle, computing exact reference results against which LLM answers are graded automatically. A taxonomy of post hoc query categories structures the input space around the environment-level facts from which policy explanations are composed; test cases generated from it are prioritized by question-specific diagnostic difficulty scores. Across seven MDP environments, the testing separates three open-weight LLMs: a reasoning model passes 85% of test cases, a mid-size model 70%, and a 1B model falls below the random baseline, while prioritization surfaces significantly harder cases than random selection. Our results indicate how trustworthy LLM-generated explanations are in model-free settings, where the same LLMs are used but no oracle exists to verify them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种系统化测试LLM作为顺序决策策略事后解释器的方法。通过概率模型检验提供测试预言机，基于事后查询类别分类法构造测试输入空间，并以诊断难度分数对测试用例进行优先级排序。在七个MDP环境中测试三个开源LLM，推理模型通过85%的测试，中型模型通过70%，1B模型低于随机基线。
AI.motivation: LLM常被用作顺序决策策略的事后解释器，但会生成看似合理实则错误的陈述，且现有方法无法系统性地测试解释是否忠实于底层环境。面临的挑战是：缺乏解释正确性的预言机，以及自然语言查询缺乏结构化输入以进行系统化测试用例生成。
AI.method: 1) 使用概率模型检验作为测试预言机，计算精确参考结果自动评分LLM答案；2) 构建事后查询类别分类法，围绕环境级事实结构化输入空间；3) 基于问题特定诊断难度分数对生成的测试用例进行优先级排序。
AI.result: 在七个MDP环境中，测试能够区分三个开源LLM：推理模型通过85%的测试用例，中型模型通过70%，而1B模型低于随机基线。优先级排序方法相比随机选择能发现明显更难的测试用例。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明在存在预言机验证的模型已知（model-free）设置下，可以评估LLM解释的信任度；该结果也为在无预言机可验证的场景中LLM生成解释的可靠性提供了参考。

title: OPAL: Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning for Interpretable Image Classification
summary: Prototypical part-based models provide explainable predictions by comparing input regions to learned prototypes. However, current approaches are burdened by complex, multi-stage training pipelines and heavily rely on auxiliary regularization to prevent prototype collapse. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Orthonormal Prototype Alignment Learning (OPAL), a single-stage, end-to-end framework that simplifies interpretable classification. Our approach anchors the latent space using predefined orthonormal bases, embedding each class within a dedicated subspace spanned by fixed part-prototypes. To achieve precise part localization, OPAL enforces spatial competition across feature maps. This mechanism isolates sparse, discriminative regions, directing each prototype to consistently attend to the same semantic concept across different images. By framing classification as a direct representation alignment task, our method eliminates the need for auxiliary losses. Extensive experiments on fine-grained benchmarks demonstrate that OPAL outperforms both its non-interpretable counterparts and state-of-the-art part-prototype methods, delivering granular visual explanations by explicitly revealing the specific image regions driving every prediction. Code is available at https://github.com/ilancarretero/OPAL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPAL（正交原型对齐学习），一种单阶段端到端的可解释分类框架。它使用预定义的正交基锚定潜在空间，使每个类别嵌入到由固定部件原型张成的专用子空间中，并通过跨特征图的空间竞争机制实现精确的部件定位，无需辅助正则化损失。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于原型部件的可解释模型存在两大局限：一是训练流程复杂，需要多阶段流水线；二是过度依赖辅助正则化来防止原型坍缩（prototype collapse），增加了训练负担和复杂性。
AI.method: 1）使用预定义的正交基锚定潜在空间，每个类别嵌入到由固定部件原型张成的专用子空间中；2）通过跨特征图的空间竞争机制实现精确部件定位，使每个原型在不同图像中一致地关注相同语义概念；3）将分类问题转化为直接的表示对齐任务，消除对辅助损失的需求，实现单阶段端到端训练。
AI.result: 在细粒度基准数据集上的大量实验表明，OPAL在性能上超越了不可解释的对应方法以及最先进的部件原型方法，并能为每个预测显式揭示驱动预测的具体图像区域，提供细粒度的可视化解释。
AI.conclusion: OPAL通过正交原型对齐与空间竞争机制，简化了可解释分类的训练流程，在保持或超越分类性能的同时提供了细粒度的部件级可解释性，为原型部件方法提供了一种更简洁有效的替代方案。

title: Geometry of Divergence: Tracking Hidden-State Trajectories for Adaptive Multi-Turn Reasoning
summary: LLM agents need to sustain goal-consistent reasoning across long multi-turn interactions under strict resource constraints. However, as the multi-turn context accumulates, it can destabilize the underlying LLM's internal representation of task-relevant information from earlier turns, blurring the boundary between constructive reasoning and representation drift. We formulate multi-turn reasoning as a hidden-state trajectory of the underlying LLM that is characterized via two complementary signals: temporal curvature that captures the directional consistency of turn-to-turn updates, and variance slope which measures the expansion or contraction of the exploration space. Across four tasks and three underlying LLMs, we observed that these geometric signals distinguish between correct and incorrect episodes prior to completion. We further decompose each episode into three-action chains formed from four actions (Read, Write, Respond, Transfer) and show that separability is action-dependent, with different signals distinguishing various chain patterns. Our experiments demonstrate that trajectory geometry can identify critical turns in the reasoning process, increasing task success rates on $τ$-Bench from 24.1% to 39.6% while reducing token cost by 11.2%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用LLM多轮推理的隐藏状态轨迹几何特征（时间曲率和方差斜率）来识别推理漂移与关键轮次，从而在资源受限下提升智能体任务成功率并降低token成本。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长多轮交互中，随着上下文累积会导致模型对早期任务相关信息的内部表征发生漂移，使得建设性推理与表征漂移之间的界限变得模糊，影响目标一致性推理的可持续性。
AI.method: 将多轮推理建模为底层LLM的隐藏状态轨迹，通过两个互补信号进行刻画：时间曲率（捕捉轮次间更新的方向一致性）和方差斜率（衡量探索空间的扩张或收缩）。进一步将每个回合分解为四个动作（读、写、响应、传递）组成的三动作链，分析不同动作链模式下信号的可分离性。
AI.result: 在四个任务和三个底层LLM上，这些几何信号能在回合完成前区分正确与错误的推理过程，且可分离性依赖于具体动作模式。在τ-Bench上，任务成功率从24.1%提升至39.6%，同时token成本降低11.2%。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹几何分析能够识别推理过程中的关键轮次，在资源受限条件下有效提升多轮LLM智能体的性能与效率，为多轮推理的可解释性和可控性提供了新的几何视角。

title: Input-Adaptive Gating of a Dehazing Front-End for On-Device Perception in Smoke-Obscured Environments
summary: Two-stage vision pipelines often place an enhancement network before a task network, on the assumption that a cleaner input produces a better output. We evaluate this in a firefighter assistance pipeline, where a dehazer precedes an edge detector that renders smoke-filled rooms as structural outlines. Both were designed for a Raspberry Pi 4, at 355K and 23K parameters, and quantized to UINT8 via TensorFlow Lite. The float dehazer reaches 18.60 dB peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) on held-out real smoke against 13.60 dB unprocessed and 17.08 dB for an AOD-Net trained on the same data, and the edge detector reaches an F-measure at optimal dataset scale (ODS) of 0.738, outperforming an optimized Canny's result of 0.692. Dehazing improves edge extraction under dense smoke but degrades it on clear and lightly hazed frames, where the dehazer discards more detail than the haze obscures. We therefore run the dehazer only when a dark channel haze estimate exceeds a threshold, a 10.1 ms test that lets the pipeline save 469.6 ms on the dehazing stage. Averaged over four haze levels, gating is more accurate than either fixed decision, at 0.675 mean ODS against 0.664 for always dehazing and 0.630 for never dehazing. It reduces the mean per-frame time on the Raspberry Pi from 569 ms to 321 ms, and on clear frames increases the frame rate fivefold, from 1.8 to 9 frames per second.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了消防员辅助管道中"去雾网络+边缘检测器"的两阶段视觉流程，发现盲目去雾在清晰和轻度雾霾帧上反而降低性能，因此提出基于暗通道雾霾估计的门控机制，仅在高雾霾时启用去雾，平均ODS达到0.675，帧率提升近五倍。
AI.motivation: 传统两阶段视觉管道假设"输入越干净，输出越好"，因此在任务网络前恒常放置增强网络（如去雾）。但该假设未经验证，尤其在实时嵌入式场景下，不必要的去雾会浪费时间并可能丢失细节，需要评估何时去雾真正有益。
AI.method: 在树莓派4上构建轻量级去雾网络（355K参数，UINT8量化）+边缘检测器（23K参数）的两阶段管道。通过实验发现去雾在清晰/轻雾帧上反而损害边缘提取，因此引入基于暗通道雾霾估计的阈值门控机制（仅10.1ms），决定是否启用去雾阶段。
AI.result: 浮点去雾PSNR达18.60dB（优于AOD-Net的17.08dB和未处理的13.60dB）；边缘检测ODS为0.738优于优化Canny的0.692。门控机制在四个雾霾等级上平均ODS为0.675，优于始终去雾（0.664）和永不去雾（0.630）；平均帧时间从569ms降至321ms，清晰帧率从1.8提升至9 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 去雾并非始终有益，条件式门控比固定决策更优。在资源受限的嵌入式设备上，通过廉价检测选择性地启用计算昂贵的增强模块，可以在保持精度的同时大幅提升实时性能，为两阶段视觉管道的设计提供了新思路。

title: PyKEEN-NSX: A Modular Framework for Static, Dynamic and Schema-Aware Negative Sampling in PyKEEN
summary: Embedding methods have become popular due to their scalability on link prediction and/or triple classification tasks on Knowledge Graphs (KGs). Embedding models are trained relying on both positive and negative samples of triples. However, since KGs generally contain only positive assertions, negative samples are artificially generated through negative sampling strategies, ranging from simple random corruption to more sophisticated approaches that exploit structural, semantic, or embedding information. The design and implementation of advanced negative samplers remains challenging, as most popular Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) libraries provide support only for basic strategies and lack a unified framework for developing more advanced and customized solutions. To address this gap, we introduce PyKEEN-NSX, an extension of PyKEEN, the popular KGE framework, that provides a modular engineered abstraction for negative sampling. The proposed architecture separates the generation of candidate negative pools, conditioned on an explicit context, from the selection strategy, enabling the development and integration of static, schema-aware and dynamic approaches within a consistent framework. Based on this abstraction, we implement six negative samplers, while remaining fully compatible with existing PyKEEN workflows and pipelines. As a proof of concept, we study negative availability across four datasets, showing that constrained pools frequently fall below the requested number of negatives, so that the encoded criterion is to a large extent replaced by the random fallback that supplements them.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍PyKEEN-NSX，一个PyKEEN的扩展框架，为知识图谱嵌入中的负采样提供模块化、统一的抽象架构，将负候选池的生成与选择策略分离，并实现六种负采样器，同时通过实验揭示了约束负池经常不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱嵌入模型依赖人工生成的负样本进行训练，但现有流行的KGE库（如PyKEEN）仅支持基础的负采样策略，缺乏统一的框架来开发和集成更高级、定制化的负采样方法，这阻碍了先进负采样策略的研究与应用。
AI.method: 提出PyKEEN-NSX架构，关键设计是分离两个模块：(1) 基于显式上下文条件生成负候选池；(2) 从候选池中进行选择策略。该抽象支持静态、schema感知和动态三类负采样方法，并在PyKEEN框架内实现了六种负采样器，保持与现有工作流的完全兼容。
AI.result: 作为概念验证，研究在四个数据集上考察负样本可用性，发现受约束的候选池经常低于请求的负样本数量，这意味着编码的约束条件在很大程度上被补充它们的随机回退策略所替代。
AI.conclusion: PyKEEN-NSX提供了模块化的负采样开发框架，同时揭示了当前负采样策略中约束池不足的实际问题，为未来设计更有效的负采样策略提供了重要见解。

title: TAKE 85: Testing Audiovisual filmmaKer's intEnt across 85 Hours of Film
summary: Films communicate through deliberate creative choices, including lighting, color, composition, editing, dialogue, music, and sound. Humans naturally interpret these signals as directorial intent, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are evaluated almost exclusively on understanding what happens rather than why it is presented that way. We introduce TAKE 85, the first benchmark for directorial-intent understanding, comprising 398 short films (85 hours) with expert-verified question-answer pairs spanning global and fine-grained visual and audio intent. Through controlled modality ablations, TAKE 85 enables systematic evaluation of multimodal reasoning. Experiments on state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal a substantial gap between perceptual recognition and intentional understanding: while models accurately describe events and narratives, they consistently fail to infer the communicative role of filmmaking decisions. Our results establish directorial intent as a previously overlooked dimension of multimodal understanding: even the strongest model reaches only 58 out of 100, and our ablations show that no input modality is sufficient on its own. All code, Q&As, and models are publicly available from https://github.com/KaiShinozakiConefrey/Take-85

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAKE 85——首个导演意图理解基准，包含398部短片（85小时）及专家验证的多模态问答对，评估MLLM在视觉与音频维度上理解电影创作意图的能力。实验表明最强模型仅得58分，且任何单一模态都不足以支撑意图理解。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM评估几乎只关注"发生了什么"（感知层次），而忽略了"为什么这样呈现"（导演意图）。电影通过灯光、色彩、构图、剪辑、对白、音乐和声音等创作选择传达意图，人类能自然地将其解读为导演意图，但当前模型在此维度上缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 构建TAKE 85基准：收集398部短片（85小时），由专家验证生成覆盖全局与细粒度视觉和音频意图的问答对。通过受控模态消融实验，系统评估多模态推理能力，对比感知识别与意图理解之间的差距。
AI.result: 最先进的MLLM在导演意图理解任务上表现不佳，最强模型仅得58/100分；模型能够准确描述事件和叙事，但无法推断电影制作决策的传达作用；模态消融显示没有任何单一输入模态足以独立完成意图理解。
AI.conclusion: 导演意图理解是先前被忽视的多模态理解维度，现有MLLM在此维度上与人类存在显著差距，这为未来多模态模型的发展指明了新的研究方向。

title: HiRS-Agent: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent System for Reliable Long-Horizon Remote Sensing Task Solving
summary: Recent advances in large language models and multimodal models have pushed remote sensing (RS) processing from simple perception models to agentic systems designed to tackle complex, long-horizon RS tasks. However, existing systems often rely on monolithic decision-making frameworks, which fail to accommodate the multi-stage, interdependent nature of RS tasks. This centralized approach leads to challenges such as unstable task execution, incorrect tool usage, and error propagation across stages. To address these issues, we propose HiRS-Agent, a hierarchical multi-agent system for long-horizon RS task solving. HiRS-Agent adopts a two-level collaborative architecture: the Manager Layer handles dynamic routing, step-level verification, replanning, and termination control, while the Specialist Layer organizes domain-specific tools according to the RS workflow and is responsible for subtask reasoning and tool execution. To further enhance the system's capability, we introduce a two-stage supervised tuning strategy and a verification-guided hierarchical reinforcement learning stage to jointly optimize coordination and tool-use policies. Experiments on Earth-Agent Benchmark and ThinkGeo show that HiRS-Agent substantially improves long-horizon tool-use capability and final-task correctness, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured multi-agent collaboration for reliable RS agents. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/IntelliSensing/HiRS-Agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiRS-Agent，一个用于长时序遥感任务求解的层次化多智能体系统，采用两层协作架构（管理层+专家层），并通过两阶段监督微调和验证引导的层次化强化学习进行优化，在Earth-Agent Benchmark和ThinkGeo上显著提升了任务正确率。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感智能体系统依赖单一化的决策框架，无法适应遥感任务多阶段、彼此依赖的特性，导致任务执行不稳定、工具使用错误、跨阶段错误传播等问题。
AI.method: HiRS-Agent采用两层协作架构：管理层负责动态路由、步骤级验证、重新规划和终止控制；专家层按遥感工作流组织领域专用工具，负责子任务推理与工具执行。同时引入两阶段监督微调策略和验证引导的层次化强化学习，联合优化协调与工具使用策略。
AI.result: 在Earth-Agent Benchmark和ThinkGeo基准上的实验表明，HiRS-Agent显著提升了长时序工具使用能力和最终任务正确率。
AI.conclusion: 结构化多智能体协作方法能有效提升遥感智能体的可靠性，为复杂长时序遥感任务提供了一种有效的解决方案。

title: The Nearest Target Is the Wrong One: Target Separation in Arc2Face Identity Unlearning
comment: 16 pages, accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Unlearning and Model Editing (U&ME)
summary: Unlearning an identity from a face-conditioned generator by redirecting its conditioning embedding can silently fail if the redirected output is still verified as the original person. We show that this failure depends on a controllable choice of how far the redirection target lies from the forget identity in recognition space, and that the most intuitive target, the nearest neighbour, is the one most likely to cause it. We audit Arc2Face with a locked ArcFace protocol and a projection adapter that redirects identity conditioning before generation. On a hard-neighbour stress test built from the hardest 0.5% of eligible identities, four target-selection policies show a monotonic response: clean forgetting rises from 9/30 groups under the nearest hard target to 30/30 under the least similar one. Mean forget-identity re-identification falls from 51.9 to 0.0 while mean retention stays flat. This reflects successful redirection rather than outputs becoming unverifiable: 710 of 720 least-sim-hard generations arrive at the chosen target, with no leakage to unrelated identities. Re-verifying identical images with an independent recogniser (AdaFace) preserves that trend, correlating at r=0.94, arguing against a verifier artefact. Target separation is thus a first-order, reportable design variable for identity unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，基于人脸条件的生成器通过重定向条件嵌入来进行身份遗忘时，会存在"静默失败"的问题——即重定向输出仍被验证为原人物。研究证明这种失败取决于重定向目标在识别空间中与遗忘身份的距离，而最直观的最近邻目标最易引发失败。在Arc2Face上的压力测试中，四种目标选择策略呈单调响应，证明目标分离度是身份遗忘的一阶可报告设计变量。
AI.motivation: 现有身份遗忘方法（通过重定向条件嵌入）可能产生静默失败，即输出仍被识别为原人物却未被察觉。作者希望揭示这一失败的根本原因，并建立可量化的控制变量来指导身份遗忘设计。
AI.method: 使用锁定ArcFace协议审计Arc2Face，通过投影适配器在生成前重定向身份条件。构建了最难0.5%候选身份的硬邻居压力测试，系统比较四种目标选择策略（从最近硬目标到最不相似目标），并用AdaFace独立识别器进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 在四种目标选择策略下呈现单调响应：干净遗忘从最近硬目标下的9/30组提升到最不相似目标下的30/30组；平均遗忘身份再识别率从51.9降至0.0，保留率保持平稳。710/720个最不相似硬目标生成可达目标身份且无泄漏。AdaFace交叉验证相关系数r=0.94，排除验证器伪影。
AI.conclusion: 目标分离度是身份遗忘的一阶、可报告的设计变量。选择最不相似的目标而非最近邻，可以显著提升遗忘效果而不会损害保留能力，且不会产生无法验证的输出或身份泄漏。

title: MedAgent-R1: Faithfulness-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Medical Reasoning
summary: When medical AI systems hallucinate clinical reasoning, the consequences extend beyond incorrect answers: fabricated justifications that superficially reference retrieved evidence can mislead clinicians into unsafe treatment decisions. Medical reasoning agents must therefore produce not only correct answers but also faithful justifications that clinicians can verify against cited evidence. We identify a systematic failure mode in RL-trained retrieval agents: outcome-only rewards improve accuracy while degrading faithfulness, a phenomenon we term confident hallucination. The agent learns to answer from parametric memory and backfill plausible but unsupported justifications; citation fabrication rates rise from 16.5% to 31.8% even as accuracy improves by 5 points over the supervised baseline. We address this with a faithfulness-gated reward design: accuracy credit is conditioned on evidence grounding via a hard gate, complemented by retrieval validity and conciseness signals that close exploitation paths unique to agentic retrieval. The resulting system, MedAgent-R1, reduces citation fabrication from 31.8% to 4.7% and raises evidence completeness from 58.7 to 82.6 while maintaining 75.1% accuracy, with 13.2-point gains on HealthBench Safety. Under the same agentic retrieval setup, MedAgent-R1 outscores GPT-4o on faithfulness-specific dimensions (Factual Support 4.55 vs. 4.25; Overclaiming 4.40 vs. 4.15) while remaining below GPT-4o in overall accuracy, suggesting that explicit faithfulness training yields evidence-grounding gains not achieved by scaling alone.

AI.tldr: 本文针对医疗AI系统中强化学习训练检索代理的"自信幻觉"问题——仅用结果奖励会提高准确性但降低忠实度（引用捏造率从16.5%升至31.8%）。作者提出忠实度门控奖励设计（MedAgent-R1），将准确性奖励与证据接地硬性绑定，结合检索有效性和简洁性信号，将引用捏造率从31.8%降至4.7%，证据完整性从58.7提升至82.6，同时保持75.1%的准确性，并在HealthBench Safety上获得13.2分提升。
AI.motivation: 医疗AI系统的幻觉不仅产生错误答案，更危险的是会生成看似引用检索证据但实际无依据的虚假推理，可能误导临床医生做出不安全治疗决策。现有RL训练的检索代理存在系统性失败模式：结果奖励优化提高准确性却牺牲忠实度，即"自信幻觉"。亟需同时保证正确答案与可验证的忠实证明。
AI.method: 提出忠实度门控奖励设计（faithfulness-gated reward）：1) 准确性格通过硬门与证据接地条件绑定，只有基于检索证据的推理才能获得准确性奖励；2) 补充检索有效性和简洁性信号，封闭代理式检索特有的利用路径。构建系统MedAgent-R1。
AI.result: MedAgent-R1将引用捏造率从31.8%降至4.7%，证据完整性从58.7提升至82.6，保持75.1%准确性，HealthBench Safety提升13.2点。在同一代理检索设置下，MedAgent-R1在忠实度维度超过GPT-4o（Factual Support 4.55 vs 4.25；Overclaiming 4.40 vs 4.15），但总体准确性仍低于GPT-4o。
AI.conclusion: 显式忠实度训练能带来单纯模型扩展无法实现的证据接地增益。研究揭示了RL训练中准确性与忠实度之间的权衡，证明通过精心设计的门控奖励可以在保持准确性的同时大幅提升医疗AI推理的忠实度和可验证性。

title: A Hybrid State-Space Approach for Census-Tract Population Estimation
summary: Sequence models---the architecture family behind large language models and, increasingly, state-of-the-art image recognition---have redefined how machines learn from high-dimensional data. Yet population estimation from satellite imagery, a task that underpins infrastructure planning, public health, and disaster response, has scarcely benefited: leading systems still bind population to a uniform raster, disaggregating census counts onto grid cells through weighting surfaces built from ancillary data (e.g., in WorldPop and LandScan), which can introduce systematic spatial bias, and predicting population per grid cell with convolutional neural networks. In this approach, the administrative-unit structure in which the census was actually collected is discarded. We close this gap with MambaPop, which renders each administrative unit as a single polygon-masked satellite image and treats tract-level population estimation as a sequence-modeling problem over its image patches, pairing each tract image directly with its population label and eliminating the disaggregation step entirely. Built on the hybrid state-space--attention MambaVision backbone, MambaPop is, to our knowledge, the first method to learn population directly from an administrative unit's own image as well as the first to apply a state-space based (Mamba) hybrid architecture to the population estimation task. Across all $\sim$84{,}000 contiguous-US census tracts of the 2020 census, MambaPop attains a mean absolute error (MAE) of $1{,}141$ persons per tract, matching the strongest convolutional baseline (YOLOv11, MAE $1{,}122$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出MambaPop，将人口普查片区（行政单元）直接作为多边形掩膜卫星图像输入，用基于MambaVision（混合状态空间与注意力）的序列模型预测人口，完全跳过传统的人口栅格分解（disaggregation）步骤。在全美约84,000个2020年人口普查tract上，MambaPop取得MAE 1,141人，与最强卷积基线YOLOv11（MAE 1,122）相当。
AI.motivation: 现有基于卫星影像的人口估计系统（如WorldPop、LandScan）大多将人口绑定到统一栅格上，通过辅助数据构建权重面将普查人口分解到网格单元，这引入了系统性空间偏差，且丢失了普查原始收集时的行政单元结构。卷积神经网络预测每个网格单元人口的方式忽视了行政单元-人口标签的直接对应关系。
AI.method: MambaPop将每个行政单元（census tract）渲染为单一多边形掩膜的卫星图像，将该人口的tract级估计转化为对其图像块（image patches）的序列建模问题。每个tract图像直接与其人口标签配对，完全消除分解（disaggregation）步骤。骨干网络采用混合状态空间-注意力架构MambaVision。
AI.result: 在全美约84,000个2020年普查tract上，MambaPop达到每tract MAE 1,141人，与最强卷积基线YOLOv11（MAE 1,122）性能相当。
AI.conclusion: MambaPop是首个直接从行政单元自身图像学习人口的方法，也是首个将基于状态空间（Mamba）的混合架构应用于人口估计任务的工作。它证明序列模型/状态空间架构可以胜任人口估计任务，并达到与强卷积基线相当的性能，同时避免了栅格分解带来的空间偏差问题。

title: ATLAS: Dual-Horizon Diagnostic Evaluation for Industrial Tool-Use Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in user-facing services that require iterative tool use under dynamic business conditions. Reliable evaluation is essential for sustained improvement: it must reveal capability deficiencies, inform priorities, and assess interventions. Yet industrial agent service unfolds both through the iterative trajectory of a current request and through continued user interaction. Final-outcome assessment can therefore obscure where deficiencies arise and whether later service remains aligned with context from earlier exchanges. We propose ATLAS, a dual-horizon diagnostic evaluation framework for industrial tool-use agents. At the request horizon, trajectory-wise diagnostic signals relate deficiencies to execution locations and capability concerns. At the interaction horizon, user-wise signals assess whether service remains responsive across continued interaction. Together, these views provide structured diagnostic evidence for analyzing execution deficiencies and sustained service behavior. ATLAS instantiates them as executable signals with explicit evidence scopes and decision boundaries. LLM judge interfaces are calibrated against high-confidence references from real business logs; when needed, their decision behavior is distilled into efficient diagnostic models for lower-latency, lower-cost evaluation. The resulting feedback supports policy optimization. We evaluate ATLAS on Meituan Xiaotuan production traffic. Offline experiments assess diagnostic-signal fidelity and replay-based policy improvement, while online A/B experiments show concurrent gains in user engagement, downstream business outcomes, and sampled human-audit quality.

AI.tldr: ATLAS是一个面向工业级工具使用型LLM智能体的双视界（dual-horizon）诊断评估框架，分别在请求视界（request horizon）提供轨迹级诊断信号以定位执行缺陷，在交互视界（interaction horizon）提供用户级信号以评估持续服务响应性，并在美团团小满生产流量上通过离线与在线实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 工业级智能体服务不仅包含当前请求的迭代工具使用轨迹，还涉及持续的后续用户交互。传统的最终结果评估无法揭示缺陷出现的具体位置，也无法判断后续服务是否与先前对话上下文保持一致，因此需要一种能够提供结构化诊断证据的双视界评估框架。
AI.method: ATLAS提出双视界诊断框架：在请求视界，轨迹级诊断信号将缺陷关联到执行位置和能力关注点；在交互视界，用户级信号评估持续交互中的服务响应性。框架将信号实例化为具有明确证据范围和决策边界的可执行信号，LLM评判接口针对真实业务日志中的高置信参考进行校准，并在需要时将决策行为蒸馏为高效诊断模型以降低延迟和成本，最终反馈支持策略优化。
AI.result: 在美团团小满生产流量上评估ATLAS：离线实验验证了诊断信号保真度和基于回放的策略改进效果；在线A/B实验显示在用户参与度、下游业务结果和抽样人工审计质量方面均取得同步提升。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS通过双视界诊断信号为工业工具使用型智能体提供了结构化的评估证据，不仅能定位执行中的缺陷，还能评估持续服务的对齐性，其反馈可有效支持策略优化，并在生产环境中带来用户参与度和业务结果的实质性改善。

title: Aligning Multi-Trajectory Supervision with Policy Optimization for VLA Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving methods increasingly combine multi-trajectory imitation learning with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), making trajectory selection critical to final performance. However, some high-scoring trajectories that improve imitation can degrade subsequent GRPO by inducing advantage estimates misaligned with the current policy's feasible behavior distribution, driving updates away from safe and compliant behaviors. To address this, we propose a novel framework that aligns multi-trajectory supervision with policy optimization. To address the policy gradient bias induced by infeasible noisy trajectories outside the feasible region, augmented trajectories are constrained to a neighboring manifold of the ground-truth feasible region, and a Pareto-optimality criterion is adopted in place of the conventional aggregate score, retaining only non-dominated candidates and thereby filtering out conflicting samples at the source. To ensure that expanded trajectory supervision is effectively absorbed during policy optimization, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: feasibility-first advantage assignment and dynamic distillation. The former adapts Pareto credit to the feasibility composition of each rollout group and guides fully infeasible groups toward safe references. The latter updates teacher trajectories across refinement rounds to continually transfer useful supervision. Together, they progressively translate the benefits of expanded supervision into policy improvement. On NAVSIM v1 and v2, our method achieves 91.4 PDMS and 89.1 EPDMS, respectively, under single-trajectory inference, and recovers 440 of 658 initially failed scenes, 11.1\% higher than the original GRPO baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐的框架，解决VLA驾驶方法中GRPO因不可行噪声轨迹导致的优势估计偏差问题，通过可行域约束、Pareto最优准则、可行性优先优势分配和动态蒸馏等机制，在NAVSIM上取得SOTA性能并显著恢复失败场景。
AI.motivation: VLA驾驶方法结合多轨迹模仿学习与GRPO时，高分但不可行的轨迹会改善模仿却破坏后续GRPO优化（优势估计与当前策略可行行为分布不对齐），导致更新偏离安全合规行为。
AI.method: 1) 可行域邻域流形约束增强轨迹，过滤不可行噪声；2) 用Pareto最优准则替代聚合评分，保留非支配候选；3) 可行性优先优势分配（根据rollout组可行性组成调整Pareto信用）；4) 动态蒸馏在迭代轮次中持续更新教师轨迹。
AI.result: NAVSIM v1和v2上分别达到91.4 PDMS和89.1 EPDMS（单轨迹推理）；恢复440/658个初始失败场景，比原始GRPO基线高11.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过源头过滤冲突样本与优化阶段的双重机制，实现了扩展轨迹监督向策略改进的有效转化，验证了多轨迹监督与策略优化对齐的有效性。

title: Multimodal Adaptive Expert Selection with Text Routing and Ordinal Prototype Optimization for Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) is a fundamental component of affective computing that aims to decipher complex emotional states by integrating verbal content with non-verbal cues including vocal intonation and facial micro-expressions. While recent disentanglement-based approaches have advanced the field, their potential is hindered by two methodological challenges. First, static computation graphs process all samples indiscriminately regardless of semantic complexity, which leads to suboptimal representation for diverse emotional expressions and contextual scenarios. Second, generic contrastive objectives often neglect the intrinsic ordinal hierarchy of sentiment intensities. To systematically address these limitations, we introduce Multimodal Adaptive Expert Selection with Text Routing and Ordinal prototype optimization (MAESTRO), a novel framework designed to dynamically orchestrate and refine multimodal representations. Drawing inspiration from an orchestra conductor, we design a Text-Guided Hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism. Unlike static fusion, this module utilizes linguistic context as a routing signal to dynamically activate specific audio-visual experts, thereby resolving cross-modal ambiguity through adaptive feature enhancement. Furthermore, to capture fine-grained sentiment gradations, we propose an Ordinal-aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (O-PCL). By incorporating distance-based penalties into the prototype learning objective, O-PCL enforces a structured latent space that preserves the natural order of emotion. Extensive experiments on the CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI benchmarks demonstrate that MAESTRO achieves state-of-the-art performance, and qualitative analysis further confirms the interpretability of our dynamic routing paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAESTRO框架，用于多模态情感分析（MSA）。该框架包含两个核心创新：一是Text-Guided Hybrid Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）机制，利用文本作为路由信号动态激活音频-视觉专家，解决跨模态歧义；二是Ordinal-aware Prototype Contrastive Learning（O-PCL），通过距离惩罚保留情感强度的自然顺序。在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI基准上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于解缠的多模态情感分析方法存在两个关键挑战：(1) 静态计算图对所有样本一视同仁，忽略语义复杂度的差异，无法适配多样的情感表达和情境；(2) 通用对比学习目标忽视了情感强度的内在有序层级结构。
AI.method: MAESTRO框架包含两个主要模块：(1) Text-Guided Hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)：以语言上下文作为路由信号，动态激活特定的音视频专家，实现自适应的跨模态特征增强；(2) Ordinal-aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (O-PCL)：在原型学习目标中引入基于距离的惩罚项，构建保留情感自然顺序的结构化潜在空间。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI两个基准数据集上取得最先进（SOTA）性能，并通过定性分析验证了动态路由范式的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: MAESTRO通过动态专家路由和有序原型对比学习，系统性解决了静态计算图和忽视情感顺序的问题，为多模态情感分析提供了更优越且可解释的方案。

title: Efficient and High-Quality Depth Estimation via Pixel-Space Diffusion with Linear Attention
summary: This work presents $\textbf{Lapis}$, a $\textbf{l}$inear-$\textbf{a}$ttention-based $\textbf{pi}$xel-$\textbf{s}$pace generative framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity depth estimation with one-step diffusion. While generative frameworks have significantly advanced monocular depth estimation with superior detail fidelity, the $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ complexity of standard attention and the multi-step denoising process introduce prohibitive computational costs when scaling them to high-resolution image applications. Although linear attention and one-step prediction are intuitively viable, directly applying them leads to poor structural consistency, detail loss, and noise. Lapis rectifies these limitations through a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Specifically, a Patch-level Consistency Module restores structural coherence by integrating semantic and spatial priors. Subsequently, a Pixel-level Refinement Module recovers sharp geometric boundaries via skip-connection-based pixel correspondence. Furthermore, to mitigate sampling noise inherent in one-step diffusion, we leverage the manifold assumption and adopt a direct $\mathbf{x}$-prediction strategy to target the clean data manifold. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Lapis consistently achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy and boundary sharpness across various resolutions, reducing inference latency by up to 7.6$\times$ at 1080P and 10.9$\times$ at 1440P resolution compared to previous SOTA generative models.

AI.tldr: Lapis是一个基于线性注意力的一步扩散像素空间生成框架，用于高效高保真深度估计。通过粗到细的层级设计（Patch级一致性模块+像素级细化模块）克服一步扩散的结构不一致、细节丢失和噪声问题，在1080P和1440P分辨率下相比现有最优生成模型分别加速7.6倍和10.9倍。
AI.motivation: 生成式框架在单目深度估计中展现出卓越的细节保真度，但标准注意力的O(N²)复杂度和多步去噪过程使得高分辨率应用的计算成本过高。虽然线性注意力和一步预测直觉上可行，但直接应用会导致结构一致性差、细节丢失和噪声问题。
AI.method: 提出粗到细的层级架构：1) Patch级一致性模块，融合语义和空间先验恢复结构连贯性；2) 像素级细化模块，基于跳跃连接的像素对应恢复锐利几何边界；3) 利用流形假设采用直接x-prediction策略，直接瞄准干净数据流形以缓解一步扩散的采样噪声。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，Lapis在不同分辨率下均取得最先进的精度和边界锐度，在1080P分辨率下推理延迟降低7.6倍，在1440P分辨率下降低10.9倍。
AI.conclusion: Lapis证明了线性注意力与一步扩散在深度估计任务中的可行性，通过层级设计和流形约束成功克服了直接应用所带来的质量退化，实现了效率与保真度的双赢。

title: Autoregressive Mosaics: Probing 2D Spatial Reasoning in Text-Only Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained only on text and code can sometimes generate programs that draw recognizable images. However, it is unclear whether this reflects an internal representation of 2D spatial layout or simply the ability to translate spatial descriptions into code. We introduce Autoregressive Mosaics (AM-Bench), a benchmark that separates these factors: First, a translation task gives a model a fully specified geometry of a picture in words as a prompt and asks for the code that produces it. Second, a layout task requires the model to compose an image from an underspecified prompt. Across eight open-weight text-and-code-only models, all models reliably translate specified geometry into code, but their open-ended layout performance differs substantially, indicating that these differences are not explained by code-generation ability alone. An output-medium ablation further shows that the interface or medium of expression that the model uses matters: replacing procedural code with raw SVG improves layout scores across all models. Finally, probing model activations shows that a coarse layout plan is present before generation, but reflects only the layout implied by the prompt. During generation, models track the evolving geometric state instead of executing an initially fixed plan. Overall, these results show that 2D spatial performance in text-only LLMs depends on both the model and the output medium, and is not explained by code-generation ability alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AM-Bench基准，通过分离"翻译任务"（将完全指定的几何描述翻译为代码）和"布局任务"（从欠指定提示生成图像），证明纯文本训练的LLM的2D空间布局能力不能仅由代码生成能力解释，且输出媒介（如SVG vs 代码）对布局性能有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM虽能生成可识别的图像代码，但尚不清楚这是否反映了真实的2D空间布局内部表征，还是仅仅具备将空间描述翻译为代码的能力。作者希望分离这两个因素，探究LLM是否真正理解空间布局。
