AI.method: 提出AM-Bench基准，包含两个任务：(1) 翻译任务——给定单词描述的完整几何结构，要求模型生成对应代码；(2) 布局任务——从欠指定的提示中要求模型自主构图。测试8个开放权重的文本+代码模型，并进行输出媒介消融（过程代码vs原始SVG），同时通过激活探针分析模型生成前的内部布局规划。
AI.result: 所有模型都能可靠地将指定的几何结构翻译为代码，但在开放式布局任务上表现差异显著，表明差异不能仅由代码生成能力解释。输出媒介消融显示，使用原始SVG替代过程代码可提升所有模型的布局得分。激活探针表明，模型在生成前存在粗略的布局规划，但仅反映提示隐含的布局；生成过程中模型跟踪演化的几何状态而非执行预设的固定计划。
AI.conclusion: 纯文本LLM的2D空间性能取决于模型本身和输出媒介，不能仅由代码生成能力解释。这揭示了LLM内部空间表征的局限——它们并非在执行一个初始固定的完整布局计划，而是在生成过程中动态跟踪几何状态。

title: Repeatability Characterisation and Error Budget of a Consumer Structured-Light Scanner for 3-D Wound Geometry:A Rigid-Phantom Study
summary: We characterise the measurement error of a free- hand consumer structured-light scanner used to derive three- dimensional geometric wound descriptors. Rigid wound-care phantoms cannot change, so every difference between repeat scans of one site is measurement error; all repeats come from a single scanner unit, nine sites and 23 scans, so this charac- terises one instrument. The 95 percent repeatability limit for reconstructed surface area is a factor of 4.8, with a confidence interval from 3.0 to 7.0, so rescanning an unchanged site can shift the reading from a 79 percent decrease to a 377 percent increase. Forty-four of 45 descriptors fall below an intraclass correlation of 0.50, and none of 248 descriptor and pipeline combinations reaches 0.75. An error budget formed by holding the analy- sis region fixed, leaving sensor and reconstruction untouched, bounds the share of variance attributable to how much surface the operator captured at 75 percent for surface area, 91 percent for hull area and 95 percent for bounding-box diagonal; only hull volume is majority instrumental, at 48 percent, so a better sensor would buy little. No wound is delineated anywhere in the chain, so the comparison against the four-week area reduction used clinically to predict healing, a ratio near 2.1, is a lower bound on the noise an unsegmented pipeline must overcome, not a measurement of wound-area reproducibility. Standardising the analysis region cuts the limit to 2.13, meeting that ratio rather than clearing it. Statistical outlier removal imposes a measured systematic area deficit near 11 percent.

AI.tldr: 本研究表征了手持式消费级结构光扫描仪在重建三维伤口几何描述符时的测量误差。通过重复扫描刚性伤口护理模型，发现重建表面积的95%重复性限值高达4.8倍（置信区间3.0-7.0），45个描述符中有44个的组内相关系数低于0.50，所有248种描述符与流程组合均未达到0.75。误差预算显示操作者捕获的表面积差异是主要误差来源（占总方差75%-95%），仅船体体积主要受仪器影响（48%）。与临床使用的四周面积缩减率（约2.1）相比，标准化的分析区域可将限值降至2.13，但仍仅勉强达到而非显著超越该比值。统计离群值去除会引入约11%的系统性面积偏差。
AI.motivation: 评估消费级结构光扫描仪在三维伤口几何测量中的实际可靠性，因为此类设备正被越来越多地用于临床伤口评估，但其测量误差尚未被严格表征。
AI.method: 使用刚性伤口护理模型（无法变化），对9个部位进行23次重复扫描（单台设备），将任何重复扫描间的差异视为测量误差。计算95%重复性限值、组内相关系数（ICC）、误差预算分析，并比较未分段管线与临床四周面积缩减率的信噪比。
AI.result: 重建表面积的95%重复性限值为4.8倍因子（CI: 3.0-7.0），45个描述符中44个ICC<0.50，全部248种组合均<0.75。操作者捕获面积差异是误差主因（表面积75%、船体面积91%、包围盒对角线95%），仪器的贡献仅对船体体积达48%。标准化分析区域后限值降至2.13，离群值去除带来约11%的系统面积缺失。
AI.conclusion: 该消费级结构光扫描仪在三维伤口描述符测量上的重复性严重不足，主要误差来源是操作者捕获的皮肤表面范围而非传感器本身，因此升级硬件收效甚微。当前未分段管线与临床愈合预测比值的比较仅是一个噪声下限，并非伤口面积的真正可重复性测量，需要标准化分析区域并进一步改进测量流程。

title: Which Rules Matter Now? Policy-Centroid Routing Before an Intelligent System Acts
comment: Theory and research-program paper; 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Includes a synthetic worked example; reports no empirical efficacy result
summary:
Before an intelligent system can decide whether an action is allowed, it must first know which rules the action has approached. A single proposed action can implicate several policy regimes at once. Their requirements may stack, overlap, or qualify one another, yet many remain written in natural language while the action itself arrives as an incomplete description of intent. The first problem is not judgment. It is attention.
  Policy-centroid routing creates a layer before adjudication. It compresses expressions within each policy regime into one or more representative centroids, places the proposed action in the same semantic space, applies a declared measure, and routes every regime crossing a declared threshold to authoritative review. Several regimes may trigger at once. The output is a review agenda, not permission, prohibition, legality, breach, compliance, certification, or enforcement.
  The paper develops six falsifiable propositions and seven follow-on studies comparing the hypothesis with structured workflows, lexical and semantic retrieval, hierarchical and direct classification, and selective prediction under matched review burden. The studies are designed to identify where policy geometry recovers applicable regimes, where compression loses rare or overlapping obligations, and where the mechanism should abstain. The paper includes a synthetic worked example and reports no empirical efficacy result.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"策略质心路由"（Policy-centroid routing）机制，在裁决之前增加一个"注意力"层：将各政策制度中的表述压缩为代表性质心，将拟议行动映射到同一语义空间，通过声明度量将跨越阈值的制度路由至权威审查。输出是审查议程而非许可或禁令。论文提出六个可证伪命题和七项后续研究设计，但声明无实证效果结果。
AI.motivation: 智能系统在判断某个行动是否被允许之前，首先需要知道该行动涉及哪些规则。一个行动可能同时触发多个政策制度，它们的要求可能叠加、重叠或相互限定，但多数政策以自然语言书写，而行动本身只是不完整意图描述。因此首要问题不是判断，而是注意力——即系统先要知道该注意哪些规则。
AI.method: 提出策略质心路由层：将每个政策制度内的表达压缩为一个或多个代表性质心；将拟议行动置于同一语义空间；应用声明的度量；将所有跨越声明阈值的制度路由至权威审查。多个制度可同时触发，输出是审查议程。论文设计了六项可证伪命题和七项后续对比研究（与结构化工作流、词汇/语义检索、层级/直接分类、匹配审查负担下的选择性预测对比），并给出合成工作示例。
AI.result: 论文报告无实证效果结果，仅提供合成工作示例和未来研究设计。研究旨在识别策略几何在何处能恢复适用制度、压缩在何处丢失罕见或重叠义务、以及机制在何处应放弃（abstain）。
AI.conclusion: 策略质心路由作为裁决前的注意力层，核心价值在于将"关注哪些规则"这一前置问题从"如何判断"中分离出来。作者明确声明当前无实证结果，定位为提出可证伪命题和后续研究议程的概念性工作，旨在为多政策制度交叉场景下的规则识别奠定基础。

title: CedarCypress3D: an annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset of individual trees in planted cedar and cypress forests
summary: Individual tree measurements derived from Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) mounted on Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) provide valuable information for forest inventory, ecosystem monitoring, and sustainable forest management. Recent advancements in machine learning have increased the demand for annotated datasets to develop and evaluate point cloud-based approaches, especially for individual tree segmentation. However, publicly available annotated UAV-LiDAR datasets in temperate forests are limited. In this article, we present CedarCypress3D, a manually annotated UAV-LiDAR dataset collected in Japanese cedar (Cryptomeria japonica) and Japanese cypress (Chamaecyparis obtusa) plantations in Japan. The dataset consists of UAV-LiDAR point clouds and field survey measurements from 34 circular plots across two sites with different topographic characteristics, along with terrestrial LiDAR point clouds available for a subset of 22 plots. A total of 1,627 trees were measured in the census field survey and manually annotated to match the corresponding trees in the UAV-LiDAR point clouds. For the subset of plots with terrestrial LiDAR data, semantic labels (i.e., stem and non-stem) were additionally assigned to tree points in the UAV-LiDAR data. CedarCypress3D provides high-quality annotated UAV-LiDAR data for developing and evaluating individual tree instance segmentation and semantic segmentation methods in temperate planted forests. The dataset can also support research on tree attribute prediction and multi-platform LiDAR analysis. The dataset is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22168721.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CedarCypress3D，一个在日本柳杉和日本扁柏人工林中采集的人工标注无人机LiDAR数据集，包含34个圆形样地的点云数据、野外调查测量以及部分样地的地面LiDAR数据，用于支持单木分割和语义分割等研究。
AI.motivation: 无人机LiDAR结合机器学习进行单木分割的需求日益增长，但温带森林中公开可用的带标注UAV-LiDAR数据集非常有限，制约了点云方法的发展与评估。
AI.method: 在日本两个具有不同地形特征的柳杉和扁柏人工林站点采集UAV-LiDAR点云，共34个圆形样地；通过野外调查测量1,627棵树并人工标注与点云中的树木对应；对22个样地额外获取地面LiDAR数据，并为树木点分配语义标签（树干与非树干）。
AI.result: 构建了包含UAV-LiDAR点云、野外调查数据、部分地面LiDAR点云及语义标签的高质量标注数据集CedarCypress3D，并公开提供下载。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集可用于开发与评估温带人工林中单木实例分割和语义分割方法，也可支持树木属性预测及多平台LiDAR分析研究。

title: SkillZip Pro: Execution-Aware Dynamic Compression of Progressively Loaded Skills for Self-Evolving Agents
summary:
Production agent skills are directory bundles, not isolated prompts. The root is loaded at activation; references, schemas, scripts, assets, and nested subskills are loaded only when an execution path needs them. Compressing only the root misses most deployment cost and may move branch-specific details into the always-loaded context. Flattening instead destroys progressive-loading boundaries.
  We introduce \method, an evaluation-free compressor for complete, progressively loaded skill bundles. It leaves the agent harness unchanged and emits an ordinary directory. The method combines two safeguards. First, it compresses \emph{across files}, removing content from a reference or subskill when the root or a declared environment contract already provides it. Second, it preserves routing, so every required file and directly callable entry remains reachable after rewriting. Users can configure \method along two independent axes. \emph{One-Shot} mode rebuilds the full bundle; \emph{Continual} mode reuses state and applies Zip-on-Write after each evolution patch. \emph{Persistent} compression rewrites the shipped bundle to reduce storage and runtime context. \emph{Transient} compression keeps that bundle byte-identical and builds a task-specific view, reducing only per-run context after build cost. Entry contracts mark private, public, and conditional resources; a multi-entry audit preserves standalone public subskills.
  On a production content-moderation skill evaluated by our industrial multi-round harness, \method removes \hl{38\%} of skill bundle tokens and \hl{10.4\%} of end-to-end per-run tokens with no quality loss, while an unprotected 71\% configuration loses up to 26 accuracy points to one-sided false positives. On a multi-entry bundle, \method effeciently reduces token cost while near-perfectly preserving every route and public entry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出\method，一种无评估（evaluation-free）的压缩方法，用于完整且渐进加载的Agent技能包（skill bundles）。该方法跨文件压缩内容并保留路由，支持One-Shot/Continual和Persistent/Transient两种独立配置轴。在生产内容审核技能上，该方法移除38%的技能包token和10.4%的端到端每次运行token且无质量损失。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的Agent技能是目录包而非孤立提示词，采用渐进加载机制（根节点激活时加载，引用、脚本、资源等按需加载）。仅压缩根节点会遗漏大部分部署成本，甚至可能将分支细节引入常驻上下文；而扁平化则会破坏渐进加载边界。因此需要一种专门针对完整技能包的压缩方法。
AI.method: \method包含两个安全保障：(1) 跨文件压缩——当根节点或声明的环境契约已提供某内容时，从引用或子技能中移除冗余内容；(2) 保留路由——确保所有必需文件和可直接调用的入口在重写后仍然可达。用户可沿两个独立轴配置：One-Shot模式重建完整包，Continual模式复用状态并在每次演进补丁后应用Zip-on-Write；Persistent压缩重写发布包以减少存储和运行时上下文，Transient压缩保持包字节一致并构建任务特定视图。入口契约标记私有、公开和条件资源，多入口审计保留独立的公开子技能。
AI.result: 在工业多轮评估框架下的生产内容审核技能上，\method移除38%的技能包token和10.4%的端到端每次运行token且无质量损失；而未受保护的71%压缩配置最多损失26个准确率点（表现为单侧误报）。在多入口包上，\method在近完美保留每条路由和公开入口的同时高效降低token成本。
AI.conclusion: \method证明了在保留渐进加载结构和路由完整性的前提下，对完整技能包进行有效压缩是可行的，且能在不牺牲质量的情况下显著降低token成本，同时相较无保护的激进压缩更能避免性能退化。

title: AI-enabled Low-Cost 3D Maize Ear Morphometry Platform at Breeding Scale
summary: Maize ear geometry (length, width, curvature, and volume) is closely tied to yield and grain-filling outcomes, but existing high-throughput phenotyping pipelines remain constrained by the cost, labor, and specialized hardware they require. We developed and validated a low-cost pipeline that reconstructs a watertight 3-D mesh of a maize ear from a single 20-second video captured with a consumer-grade DSLR on a motorized turntable under uniform LED illumination. Camera poses from a multi-seed COLMAP procedure initialize a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF), and a cylindrical holder of known diameter, visible in every frame, provides automatic metric scaling with downstream geometric quality control. Applied to 300 ears spanning a diverse maize inbred panel, 250 (83.3%) passed automated processing and quality control. Skeleton length agreed with manual caliper measurements across all 250 ears (R^2 = 0.964, RMSE = 4.68 mm), and convex-hull volume agreed with water-displacement volume on a 15-ear subset spanning the full size range (R^2 = 0.982, RMSE = 5.26 mL). Residual length error grew with ear curvature, whereas bounding-box height, which records the same straight-line chord as calipers, showed no such trend; the discrepancy therefore originates in the measurement definition, since calipers record the chord while skeleton length traces the geodesic arc. The capture hardware costs approximately 607 USD, and operator involvement fell from roughly five minutes to one minute per ear, with all downstream processing running unattended. The platform provides a foundation for breeding-scale 3-D ear phenotyping.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并验证了一种低成本玉米果穗3D表型高通量测量管道：利用消费级单反相机+电机转台拍摄20秒视频，通过COLMAP初始化相机姿态并训练NeRF重建水密3D网格，借助已知直径的圆柱固定器实现自动度量尺度化。在300个果穗中250个（83.3%）通过自动化流程，骨架长度与卡尺测量高度一致（R²=0.964），凸包体积与排水法高度一致（R²=0.982）。硬件成本约607美元，操作时间从5分钟降至1分钟。
AI.motivation: 玉米果穗几何形态（长度、宽度、曲率、体积）与产量和灌浆结果密切相关，但现有高通量表型测量管道受限于成本高、劳动密集和需要专用硬件，缺乏低成本、易推广的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 使用消费级DSLR相机+电动转台+均匀LED照明录制20秒视频；2) 采用多种子COLMAP流程估计相机位姿，初始化NeRF模型；3) NeRF重建水密3D网格；4) 每帧可见的已知直径圆柱固定器提供自动度量尺度校准及下游质量控制；5) 对果穗骨架长度和凸包体积进行几何测量。
AI.result: 300个果穗中250个（83.3%）通过自动处理和质量控制。骨架长度与卡尺测量R²=0.964（RMSE=4.68mm），凸包体积与排水法R²=0.982（RMSE=5.26mL）。残余长度误差随曲率增大，但证实源于测量定义差异（卡尺测弦长而骨架测测地线弧长）。硬件成本约607美元，操作时间从5分钟降至1分钟/果穗。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为育种规模的3D果穗表型分析提供了低成本、自动化、高精度的基础，具备良好的可扩展性和实际应用价值。

title: HSRM: Hidden-State Reward Models for Test-Time Verification
summary: Large language models can often generate plausible mathematical reasoning traces, but reliably identifying the correct solution among multiple candidates remains a key challenge. Existing test-time reasoning pipelines typically rely on text-based verifiers that re-read each generated solution, making verification an expensive component of inference. Prior work has shown, however, that LLMs often encode correctness-related signals in their internal representations, including awareness of when their own answers are likely to be wrong. Building on this observation, we introduce HSRM, a lightweight hidden-state reward model that verifies candidate solutions by directly reading the generator's internal representations rather than re-processing its text. HSRM extracts hidden states from a frozen generator at reasoning-step boundaries and uses a small Transformer encoder to rank candidates. It is trained from self-generated trajectories with outcome labels, requiring neither human-written process supervision nor a large pretrained verifier. Across four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, HSRM matches or outperforms a 55M-parameter text-only energy verifier in 15 of 16 generator--dataset settings while using only about 2M parameters, providing an efficient alternative to text-only verification by reusing representations already computed during generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSRM（Hidden-State Reward Model），一种轻量级隐藏状态奖励模型，通过直接读取冻结生成器在推理步骤边界处的内部表示来验证候选解决方案，而非重新处理文本。HSRM仅需约200万参数，在四个数学推理基准上，15/16的设置中匹配或超越了5500万参数的文本能量验证器。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时推理流水线依赖基于文本的验证器，需要重新读取每个生成的解决方案，使得验证成为推理中昂贵的环节。然而已有研究表明LLM在内部表示中编码了正确性相关信号（包括对自身答案可能出错的感知），可以利用这些信号构建更高效的验证机制。
AI.method: HSRM从冻结的生成器中提取推理步骤边界处的隐藏状态，使用一个小型Transformer编码器对候选方案进行排序。训练数据来自自生成轨迹及结果标签，无需人工过程监督或大型预训练验证器。
AI.result: 在四个数学推理基准上，HSRM在15/16的生成器-数据集设置中匹配或超越了5500万参数的文本能量验证器，同时仅使用约200万参数。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用生成过程中已计算的表示，HSRM为纯文本验证提供了一种高效替代方案，在保证验证性能的同时大幅降低计算开销。

title: ATGS: Anchored Temporal Gaussian Splatting for Long Volumetric Video Representation
summary: Volumetric video enables immersive free viewpoint rendering of dynamic real world scenes, yet existing methods struggle with long sequences and complex motions, often leading to temporal instability and visual artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose \ourname, a Gaussian splatting based framework for volumetric video reconstruction. Our key insight is that explicitly tracking long term complex motion with individual Gaussian primitives is inherently unstable. Instead, we organize Gaussians around time conditioned anchors that localize their spatial and temporal support, thereby reducing long range motion complexity. We further introduce a temporal windowing strategy to activate only anchors relevant to the queried time, which improves scalability and temporal coherence. In addition, to ensure spatial and temporal stability, we design a compact set of multi level anchor features that encode global features, local spatial features, and local temporal features, jointly constraining Gaussian generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \ourname \ consistently outperforms prior methods on long sequence volumetric videos with complex motions. Project page: https://github.com/WuJH2001/ATGS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATGS，一个基于高斯泼溅（Gaussian splatting）的体积视频重建框架。核心思想是不直接追踪单个高斯的长期复杂运动（这 inherently 不稳定），而是将高斯组织在时间条件锚点（time-conditioned anchors）周围，锚点本地化高斯的时空支持范围，从而降低长距离运动复杂度。同时引入时间窗口策略仅激活与查询时间相关的锚点，提升可扩展性与时间一致性，并通过多级锚点特征（全局、局部空间、局部时间）联合约束高斯生成以增强时空稳定性。实验表明在长序列复杂运动体积视频上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有体积视频重建方法在处理长序列和复杂运动时表现不佳，常导致时间不稳定和视觉伪影。作者认为直接以单个高斯图元显式追踪长期复杂运动 inherently 不稳定，因此需要新的组织方式来降低运动复杂性并提升稳定性。
AI.method: 1) 将高斯组织在时间条件锚点周围，锚点负责定位高斯的空间与时间支持范围；2) 引入时间窗口策略，仅激活与查询时间相关的锚点以提高可扩展性和时间连贯性；3) 设计紧凑的多级锚点特征集，包含全局特征、局部空间特征和局部时间特征，联合约束高斯生成，确保时空稳定性。
AI.result: 在长序列、复杂运动的体积视频上，ATGS一致性地优于先前的方法，实证验证了所提出框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过锚点驱动的组织方式降低长距离运动复杂性，并结合时间窗口与多级特征约束，ATGS有效解决了体积视频重建中的时空稳定性和长序列可扩展性问题。

title: VFR-Audit: Verdict-Level Reliability for Fairness Audits in Hospital Length-of-Stay Prediction
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Fairness audits in clinical Artificial Intelligence convert continuous fairness metrics into binary pass-or-fail verdicts against operational thresholds, where hospital governance boards, payers, and regulators act on the resulting verdicts. Such audits are repeated over time and across hospital sites, thus the same verdict can flip between pass and fail across audits. Existing uncertainty methods such as Bayesian posteriors, bootstrap confidence intervals, and permutation tests address verdict instability only at the continuous-metric level. Converting metric-level uncertainty into a verdict-stability claim remains a manual step that scales poorly across the (model, metric, attribute) cells an audit covers. Existing uncertainty methods also leave open whether bias-mitigation steps, such as reweighing or per-group threshold shifts, yield a stable passing verdict at the cost of model discrimination measured as AUROC or AUPRC.To address this verdict-stability gap, we propose VFR-Audit, a framework built around the Verdict Flip Rate (VFR), a scalar bounded between 0 and 0.5 that measures the probability of verdict reversal under stratified bootstrap resampling. VFR-Audit reports VFR alongside three reliability axes, namely within-cohort resampling stability, audit-size sensitivity, and cross-hospital verdict agreement via Fleiss' kappa.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VFR-Audit框架，引入Verdict Flip Rate (VFR)指标来衡量临床AI公平性审计中判定（pass/fail）翻转的概率，并配套三个可靠性维度（队列内重采样稳定性、审计规模敏感性、跨医院判定一致性），解决现有不确定性方法只能在连续指标层面处理、无法直接量化判定稳定性且扩展性差的问题。
AI.motivation: 临床AI公平性审计将连续公平性指标转化为基于阈值的二元判定（通过/失败），医院治理委员会、支付方和监管机构依据判定结果采取行动。此类审计会随时间重复、跨医院站点进行，导致同一判定可能在不同审计中翻转。现有方法（贝叶斯后验、bootstrap置信区间、置换检验）只能在连续指标层面处理不确定性，将指标层面不确定性转化为判定稳定性声明仍依赖人工操作，难以在大规模（模型、指标、属性）单元格上扩展；此外，现有方法也无法回答偏差缓解步骤是否以牺牲模型判别能力为代价换来稳定的通过判定。
AI.method: 提出VFR-Audit框架，核心是Verdict Flip Rate (VFR)——一个有界于0到0.5之间的标量，用于衡量在分层bootstrap重采样下判定反转的概率。VFR-Audit在报告VFR的同时，提供三个可靠性维度：队列内重采样稳定性（within-cohort resampling stability）、审计规模敏感性（audit-size sensitivity），以及通过Fleiss' kappa衡量的跨医院判定一致性（cross-hospital verdict agreement）。
AI.result: 论文提出了一种新的判定稳定性量化指标VFR及配套审计框架，弥补了现有不确定性方法仅能在连续指标层操作、无法直接给出判定级稳定性声明的缺口。
AI.conclusion: VFR-Audit通过VFR指标与三个可靠性维度，为临床AI公平性审计提供了系统化的判定稳定性评估方案，使审计结论不再止步于连续指标层面，而是能在（模型、指标、属性）层次上大规模、可扩展地量化并报告判定翻转风险。

title: NoisEasier: Test-Time Noise Optimization for Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Diffusion models have recently advanced text-to-video (T2V) generation, yet they still struggle with fine-grained compositional alignment, such as attribute binding, spatial relations, and object interactions. While reward-based fine-tuning improves alignment, it is susceptible to reward hacking and adapts poorly to new prompt distributions. In this work, we propose NoisEasier, a test-time scaling framework that improves T2V generation through differentiable reward-guided noise optimization without modifying the underlying model. By combining efficient short-step generators with a multi-objective reward formulation, NoisEasier enables stable and practical test-time optimization under realistic inference budgets. Our key insight is that jointly optimizing the entire stochastic trajectory accelerates reward convergence and improves compositional alignment over optimizing only the initial latent, with negligible additional computational and time cost. Experiments on VBench and T2V-CompBench demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple backbones, achieving over 10% average gains on challenging dimensions such as attribute binding, object interaction, and numeracy. Overall, NoisEasier serves as both a flexible alternative and a complementary enhancement to reward-based fine-tuning, establishing test-time scaling as an effective paradigm for controllable text-to-video generation.

AI.tldr: NoisEasier提出了一种测试时扩展框架，通过可微分的奖励引导噪声优化来提升文本到视频（T2V）生成的组合对齐能力，无需修改底层模型。该方法结合高效短步生成器与多目标奖励公式，在实用推理预算下实现稳定优化，尤其通过联合优化整个随机轨迹而非仅初始潜在变量，显著加速奖励收敛并改善组合对齐，在VBench和T2V-CompBench上平均提升超过10%。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在T2V生成中仍难以实现细粒度组合对齐（如属性绑定、空间关系、物体交互）。现有的奖励微调方法存在奖励黑客问题且对新提示分布适应性差，因此需要一种不修改底层模型且更稳健的替代方案。
AI.method: NoisEasier提出测试时扩展框架：(1)使用可微分的奖励引导噪声优化，无需修改底层模型；(2)结合高效短步生成器与多目标奖励公式，实现稳定实用的测试时优化；(3)核心洞察是联合优化整个随机轨迹而非仅优化初始潜在变量，以加速奖励收敛并改善组合对齐，且额外计算成本可忽略。
AI.result: 在VBench和T2V-CompBench上的实验表明，该方法在多个骨干网络上均取得一致提升，在属性绑定、物体交互和计数等挑战性维度上平均提升超过10%。
AI.conclusion: NoisEasier既是奖励微调方法的灵活替代方案，也是其互补增强手段，确立了测试时扩展作为可控文本到视频生成的有效范式。

title: Predicting Residential Rents in Dakar Using Machine Learning
summary: Dakar's residential rental market remains poorly documented despite its economic and social importance: 54.4% of households are renters, compared to 23.3% nationally. This study develops a complete machine learning pipeline to predict residential rents in Dakar, from data collection to model interpretation. An original dataset of 1,507 rental listings was built through systematic web scraping and a documented cleaning pipeline, then enriched with four purpose-built features, including a luxury score and a keyword-based quality score. Five models were compared: linear regression, Random Forest (baseline), XGBoost, and LightGBM optimized through Bayesian optimization with Optuna, using leakage-free KFold target encoding for location. The optimized XGBoost model achieved the best performance with an $R^2$ of 0.847, an MAE of 210,902 XOF, and an RMSE of 324,195 XOF. Feature importance was assessed using native XGBoost gain and SHAP values, revealing a substantial difference in the ranking of location, which appears as a minor predictor by gain but as the second most influential variable by SHAP. This result carries methodological implications for hedonic studies using target-encoded categorical variables. This study provides an interpretable benchmark for Dakar's rental market and highlights several avenues for improvement, including the integration of geospatial features and conformal prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个完整的机器学习流程来预测达喀尔（Dakar）住宅租金，通过网页爬虫构建了1,507条租赁数据的原始数据集，并添加了豪华度评分和关键词质量评分等特征。在五种模型中，经贝叶斯优化的XGBoost表现最佳（R²=0.847, MAE=210,902 XOF），并通过XGBoost gain与SHAP值对比揭示了位置特征在不同重要性排序方法下的显著差异，为带目标编码的分类变量的享乐价格研究提供了方法论启示。
AI.motivation: 达喀尔住宅租赁市场虽然在经济和社会层面具有重要意义（54.4%的家庭为租户，远高于全国23.3%），但相关数据和研究严重匮乏。作者旨在填补这一空白，为该市场提供一个可解释的租金预测基准。
AI.method: 研究采用完整的机器学习管道：(1) 通过系统化网页爬虫收集1,507条租赁信息并建立文档化的清洗流程；(2) 构建四个定制特征，包括豪华度评分和基于关键词的质量评分；(3) 比较五种模型（线性回归、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM，后者经Optuna贝叶斯优化）；(4) 采用无泄漏的K-Fold目标编码处理位置特征；(5) 使用原生XGBoost gain和SHAP值进行特征重要性评估。
AI.result: 优化后的XGBoost模型表现最佳，取得R²=0.847、MAE=210,902西非法郎、RMSE=324,195西非法郎。特征重要性分析显示，位置变量的排名存在显著差异：在gain指标中仅为次要预测因子，但在SHAP中却成为第二重要变量，揭示了两类特征重要性评估方法间的实质性分歧。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为达喀尔租赁市场提供了首个可解释的机器学习基准，并指出位置变量在不同重要性度量下的差异对使用目标编码分类变量的享乐价格研究具有方法论启示。未来改进方向包括整合地理空间特征和引入共形预测（conformal prediction）方法。

title: DICS: Exploring Data Intrinsic Consistency for Visual Instruction Selection
summary: Visual instruction tuning is crucial for advancing the vision-language alignment and instruction-following capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, identifying optimal subsets under a fixed ratio constraint from rapidly expanding datasets remains a significant bottleneck. While existing methods largely depend on distribution diversity or heuristic filtering, they often overlook the internal coherence within individual samples. To bridge this gap, we propose Data Intrinsic Consistency (DIC), a self-scoring metric designed to quantify the sample-level inter-component consistency. DIC consists of two modules: Visual Information Consistency (VIC), evaluating the alignment between visual content and instructions, and Response Information Consistency (RIC), assessing response coherence relative to the instruction. Building upon DIC, we introduce Data Intrinsic Consistency Selection (DICS), an adaptive data selection method that optimizes the trade-off between high intra-sample consistency and global distributional diversity under varying data budgets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DICS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse dataset scales and model architectures, surpassing full-dataset fine-tuning while using only 25% of the LLaVA-1.5-665K data. We further curate DICS-6M, a 6M-sample multi-modal instruction corpus that enables the largest-scale visual instruction selection study to date; remarkably, DICS reaches 94.52\% of the official InternVL3-8B-Instruct performance using less than 25\% of its reported training data. Code can be seen at https://github.com/cqu-student/DICS

AI.tldr: 提出数据内在一致性(DIC)自评分指标及自适应数据选择方法(DICS)，通过量化样本内视觉-指令-响应的一致性来优化多模态指令数据的子集选择，在多种规模与模型架构上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉指令微调的数据选择方法主要依赖分布多样性或启发式过滤，忽略了单个样本内部组件之间的一致性，这限制了在固定比例约束下从快速增长的数据集中识别最优子集的能力。
AI.method: 提出DIC (数据内在一致性)指标，包含两个模块：VIC(视觉信息一致性，评估视觉内容与指令的匹配度)和RIC(响应信息一致性，评估响应与指令的连贯性)。基于DIC构建DICS(数据内在一致性选择)方法，在样本内在一致性与全局分布多样性之间进行自适应权衡优化，以适应不同数据预算。
AI.result: 实验表明DICS在多种数据规模与模型架构上一致超越SOTA方法，仅用LLaVA-1.5-665K数据的25%即超越全量数据微调性能。构建的DICS-6M语料支持了迄今最大规模的视觉指令选择研究，仅用不到InternVL3-8B-Instruct报告训练数据的25%即达到其官方性能的94.52%。
AI.conclusion: 样本级内在一致性是视觉指令数据选择中一个有效且此前被忽视的关键维度，DICS在数据效率上展现出显著优势，且具备扩展到大规模多模态语料的能力。

title: CAER: Causal Action Effect Reweighting for World Model Training
summary: World models are becoming core infrastructure for embodied intelligence, with action-conditioned video generation providing controllable predictions of how scenes evolve after agent interventions. Yet existing models are commonly trained with space-time-uniform mean squared error, allowing abundant background tokens to dominate the gradient while sparse interaction dynamics remain under-optimized; such uniform fitting rewards reconstructing appearance rather than learning how actions change the world. We introduce Causal Action Effect Reweighting (CAER), a general training paradigm that redistributes supervision toward the tokens whose predicted future is causally affected by the action. CAER contrasts the model's own predictions with and without action conditioning to localize these tokens online, then normalizes the resulting effect map into a weight that preserves the total coefficient mass and changes only where it is spent. This online signal requires no external annotations or offline preprocessing, avoids additional data-processing time, and scales naturally with model and dataset size. Experiments across heterogeneous action-conditioned world-model tasks show that CAER converges to better solutions than uniform MSE training, with consistent improvements in the physical consistency, controllability, and visual quality of generated videos.

AI.tldr: CAER重新分配训练监督权重，聚焦于被动作因果影响的视频token，以改善动作条件世界模型的训练效果。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频生成模型使用空间-时间均匀的MSE损失训练，导致大量背景token主导梯度，而稀疏的交互动态未被充分优化。均匀拟合奖励的是重建外观而非学习动作如何改变世界。
AI.method: CAER通过对比模型自身有无动作条件下的预测来在线定位受动作因果影响的token，将效果图归一化为权重，保持总系数质量不变但改变分配位置。该在线信号无需外部标注或离线预处理。
AI.result: 在多种异构动作条件世界模型任务上，CAER相较于均匀MSE训练收敛到更优解，在生成视频的物理一致性、可控性和视觉质量方面均有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: CAER作为一种通用训练范式，可以自然地扩展到更大的模型和数据集，为动作条件世界模型提供了更有效的监督信号分配方法。

title: Towards a Joint Khmer Text Recognition and Word Segmentation
summary: Text recognition, or extracting electronic text from document images, has been indispensable for knowledge retrieval tasks, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). For Khmer, extracted text is subject to an extra word segmentation step, as Khmer does not use any visible word delimiters to denote word boundaries. Thus, a recognition-then-segmentation pipeline for Khmer requires two separate sequential models; this is not only error-prone but also adds significant latency for large-scale document processing. This paper proposes a novel joint Khmer text recognition and word segmentation framework in a unified model. The proposed model, using a connectionist-temporal-classification (CTC) decoder for fast, parallel decoding, can be instructed to recognize Khmer text with ($b=1$) and without ($b=0$) word segmentation. Experimental results on different benchmark datasets of different document modalities (document, scene, and handwritten images) show that the proposed model can not only recognize characters in document images but also locate word boundaries, removing the need for an extra word segmentation step in a conventional sequential pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种联合高棉语文本识别与分词的统一模型，使用CTC解码器实现快速并行解码，可同时完成字符识别和词边界定位，省去传统识别后分词的两阶段流水线。
AI.motivation: 高棉语不使用可见的词分隔符，传统识别-分词的顺序流水线需要两个独立模型，不仅容易出错，而且在大规模文档处理中引入显著延迟。因此需要一种统一模型同时完成识别和分词任务。
AI.method: 提出一个统一的联合高棉语文本识别与分词框架，使用连接主义时间分类（CTC）解码器实现快速并行解码，该模型可通过参数b=1（分词）或b=0（不分词）来指导其输出是否包含词边界信息。
AI.result: 在多种文档模态（文档、场景和手写图像）的不同基准数据集上的实验表明，该模型不仅能识别文档图像中的字符，还能定位词边界，消除了传统顺序流水线中额外分词步骤的需求。
AI.conclusion: 联合识别与分词框架在统一模型中有效完成高棉语文本识别和词边界定位，提升了准确性和效率，适用于大规模文档处理场景如RAG等知识检索任务。

title: Responsible Integration of AI in Cancer Genomics: Barriers, Risks, and Pathways to Trustworthy Clinical Translation
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) and natural language processing (NLP) are increasingly used to extract, integrate, and interpret biomedical knowledge relevant to cancer genomics, yet their translation into routine clinical oncology has been comparatively slow. The central challenge is not computational capability alone, but trustworthy integration into clinical workflows. This review examines how NLP and AI support the cancer genomics pipeline, from literature mining and automated variant interpretation to clinical trial matching, knowledge graph construction, and multimodal data integration. We identify four interrelated translational failure domains: evidence inconsistency, explainability and uncertainty, data governance and reproducibility, and interoperability. Rather than considering these challenges in isolation, we take a systems-level view, focusing on their interaction across the translational pathway. We propose a conceptual framework and roadmap for addressing these domains through rigorous validation, uncertainty-aware methods, interoperable infrastructures, regulatory alignment, and human oversight across the AI lifecycle. Progress toward routine clinical use will depend less on further improving model capability than on systematically addressing these interacting failure domains from development through deployment and post-deployment monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了AI和NLP在癌症基因组学管线中的应用，指出核心挑战不在于计算能力，而在于临床工作流的可信整合。作者识别出四个相互关联的转化失败域（证据不一致、可解释性与不确定性、数据治理与可重复性、互操作性），并从系统层面提出概念框架和路线图，强调通过严格验证、不确定性感知方法、可互操作基础设施、监管对齐和全生命周期的人类监督来推进临床转化。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI和NLP在癌症基因组学的知识提取、整合和解释方面应用日益增多，但其向常规临床肿瘤学的转化相对缓慢。作者认为核心问题不是计算能力不足，而是如何实现可信赖地整合到临床工作流中，因此需要系统地审视并解决跨转化路径的失败域及其相互作用。
AI.method: 本文是一篇综述性研究，首先梳理AI/NLP在癌症基因组学管线中的应用（包括文献挖掘、自动化变异解释、临床试验匹配、知识图谱构建和多模态数据整合），然后识别四个相互关联的转化失败域，采用系统级视角而非孤立看待各挑战，最后提出概念框架和路线图来应对这些领域。
AI.result: 识别出四个相互关联的转化失败域：证据不一致、可解释性与不确定性、数据治理与可重复性、互操作性。提出解决路线包括严格验证、不确定性感知方法、可互操作基础设施、监管对齐和AI生命周期中的人类监督。
AI.conclusion: 向常规临床使用推进的关键不在于进一步提升模型能力，而在于系统性地解决从开发到部署及部署后监测过程中这些相互作用失败域的间题。作者的框架强调从系统层面协调各挑战而非孤立处理。

title: Amortized Anchor Refinement for Deployable Continuous-Time 4D Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Continuous-time 4D reconstruction remains impractical on standalone XR headsets. Per-scene optimization demands deployment-infeasible compute, and lower budgets cause collapse rather than degrade gradually. Feed-forward prediction is fast, but struggle to recover scene-specific detail. We present Amortized Anchor Refinement, which uses a frozen backbone to predict an initial Gaussian representation and a short optimization to specialize it under a fixed compute budget, with a capacity floor preserving representational density. A training-free stage then applies a persistent-homology constraint to prune unstable Gaussians while preserving topologically persistent structures, and streams the resulting trajectories directly as scene flow. On the Stage-Capture benchmark, Amortized Anchor Refinement achieves 24.31$\pm$2.22dB, while our deployment experiments demonstrate reconstruction within the target budget on a single consumer GPU and playback on a standalone XR headset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Amortized Anchor Refinement方法，结合冻结骨干网络的快速前馈预测与短时优化的场景特化，在固定计算预算下实现连续时间4D重建，并利用持久同调约束在无需训练的情况下修剪不稳定高斯体，最终在消费级GPU上完成重建、在独立XR头显上实现回放。
AI.motivation: 连续时间4D重建在独立XR头显上不切实际：逐场景优化需要部署不可行的计算量，而降低预算会导致重建崩溃而非逐步退化；前馈预测虽快但难以恢复场景特有细节。
AI.method: 1) 使用冻结骨干网络预测初始高斯表示，并在固定计算预算下进行短时优化以特化场景；2) 引入容量下限（capacity floor）保持表示密度；3) 采用免训练的持久同调约束，修剪不稳定高斯体同时保留拓扑持久结构；4) 将生成的轨迹直接流式传输为场景流。
AI.result: 在Stage-Capture基准上达到24.31±2.22dB，部署实验表明可在单个消费级GPU上在目标预算内完成重建，并能在独立XR头显上流畅回放。
AI.conclusion: 该方法证明了通过结合前馈预测的高效性与短时优化的场景特化能力，并辅以拓扑感知的修剪策略，可以在消费级硬件上实现实用的连续时间4D重建，为XR等实时应用提供了可行路径。

title: CARVE: Verified Expansion for Variable-Length Generation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models predict tokens from a partially observed response canvas, enabling bidirectional conditioning and parallel token refinement. Yet standard masked-diffusion decoders use a rigid inference interface: the number of masked positions allocated to the answer is fixed before generation begins. Choosing this length is difficult. A short canvas can truncate reasoning or code, while a long canvas wastes computation and can perturb denoising. We introduce CARVE (Counterfactual-Aware Reveal with Verified Expansion), a training-free variable-length algorithm for masked diffusion LMs. Starting from a shorter canvas, CARVE can grow the response during decoding by inserting additional [MASK] positions. Rather than keeping every insertion, CARVE tests a candidate expanded canvas and asks a counterfactual question: would the model make similar predictions for the unresolved positions in the original canvas if the extra masked space were present? The inserted masks are kept only when they induce low Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence on aligned unresolved positions. This makes length growth a verified stability decision rather than a pure confidence heuristic. CARVE applies without retraining to both full-canvas and blockwise diffusion decoders. Across code generation and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CARVE consistently improves average performance over fixed-length baselines across all evaluated model families. Crucially, CARVE achieves these accuracy gains while reducing inference cost, reaching half the FLOPs of fixed-length decoding in some settings.

AI.tldr: 提出CARVE算法，一种无需训练的变长解码方法，允许掩码扩散语言模型在解码过程中动态扩展响应画布，通过反事实验证和JS散度检查来决定是否保留插入的[MASK]位置，在提升准确率的同时降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 标准掩码扩散解码器存在刚性的推理接口：答案分配的掩码位置数量在生成前就已固定。选择该长度非常困难——画布过短会截断推理或代码，画布过长则浪费计算且可能扰动去噪过程。
AI.method: CARVE从较短画布开始，在解码过程中动态插入额外的[MASK]位置以扩展响应。每次扩展时，通过反事实问题验证：如果额外掩码空间存在，模型对原始画布中未解析位置的预测是否相似。仅当插入掩码在对齐的未解析位置上诱导低JS散度时才保留，使长度增长成为可验证的稳定性决策而非纯置信度启发式。无需重训练，适用于全画布和分块扩散解码器。
AI.result: 在代码生成和数学推理基准上，CARVE在所有评估的模型家族中一致优于固定长度基线，同时在部分设置下将推理成本降低至固定长度解码的一半FLOPs。
AI.conclusion: 通过将长度增长从启发式置信度判断转变为可验证的稳定性决策，CARVE在降低计算开销的同时实现了更好的生成质量，为掩码扩散语言模型提供了更灵活高效的推理方式。

title: Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement for Generalized Visual Grounding
summary: Generalized Visual Grounding (GVG) task aims to localize targets in an image based on referring expressions, extends the classical visual grounding paradigm by integrating multi-target and non-target scenarios. Previous methods typically rely on global semantic matching or coarse-grained region interactions for localization, where the discriminative cues are primarily derived from sentence-level semantics or regional context. In complex multi-target scenarios, such approaches tend to confuse visually similar targets, making it difficult to establish stable instance-level decision boundaries. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel Semantic-Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SSDE) framework for generalized visual grounding, which aims to enhance the discriminative ability on fine-grained semantics and spatial localization, improving both cross-modal understanding and instance-level grounding. Specifically, to enhance the semantic discriminability of query representations at the fine-grained level, we propose a Semantic Discriminability Enhancement (SeDE) module, which leverages spatially guided cross-attention to disentangle fine-grained target-relevant visual attributes and integrates them with the textual subject semantics. Furthermore, to strengthen the spatial discriminability of the referred targets, we introduce a Spatial Discriminability Enhancement (SpDE) module, which models an instance center density map to characterize the spatial distribution of targets, and explicitly constructs instance separation structures in the spatial domain by employing them as an auxiliary supervision signal. Extensive experiments show that SSDE achieves superior performance on ten datasets across both classic and generalized visual grounding tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSDE框架用于广义视觉定位任务，通过SeDE模块增强细粒度语义判别能力，SpDE模块增强空间判别能力，在十个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有GVG方法依赖全局语义匹配或粗粒度区域交互，在复杂多目标场景中难以区分视觉相似的目标，缺乏稳定的实例级决策边界。
AI.method: 提出SSDE框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) SeDE模块利用空间引导的交叉注意力解耦细粒度目标相关视觉属性并与文本主语语义融合；(2) SpDE模块建模实例中心密度图表征目标空间分布，并将其作为辅助监督信号显式构建空间域中的实例分离结构。
AI.result: 在经典和广义视觉定位任务的十个数据集上均取得优于现有方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时增强语义判别力和空间判别力，SSDE有效解决了多目标场景下视觉相似目标混淆的问题，为广义视觉定位提供了一种兼顾跨模态理解与实例级定位的有效方案。

title: Learning Action Models with Conditional and Quantified Effects via Uncertainty-Guided Exploration
summary: Accurate action models are critical for effective planning. Existing action-model learning methods largely assume simple action representations or become computationally intractable when learning conditional and quantified effects. We present Online Hypothesis-Driven Conditional Action Model Learning (OHCAM), an online approach for learning action models with conditional and quantified effects from limited interactions with the environment. OHCAM maintains a belief over hypothesized action models and actively selects informative actions to reduce uncertainty by maximizing disagreement among competing hypotheses, while being robust to noisy observations. To enable scalability, OHCAM begins with a small set of simple action model hypotheses and expands to more complex conditions only when the current hypotheses become inconsistent with the data. Experiments on six benchmark planning domains demonstrate that OHCAM is sample efficient in learning action models that solve substantially more tasks than baselines, even with observation noise. We validate OHCAM on two tasks using a Kinova Gen3 robot, demonstrating the real-world applicability of our approach.

AI.tldr: OHCAM是一种在线动作模型学习方法，能够从有限的环境交互中学习带条件和量化效应的动作模型。它维护一组假设并主动选择信息量大的动作来减少不确定性，通过最大化假设间的分歧来工作，同时对噪声观测保持鲁棒性。在六个基准规划域和真实机器人（Kinova Gen3）上验证了其样本效率和实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有动作模型学习方法要么假设简单的动作表示，要么在学习条件和量化效应时变得计算上不可处理，难以应对复杂动作模型的高效学习需求。
AI.method: OHCAM维护一个对假设动作模型的信念，主动选择信息丰富的动作以减少不确定性（通过最大化竞争假设之间的分歧），并对噪声观测具有鲁棒性。为了可扩展性，OHCAM从少量简单假设开始，仅在当前假设与数据不一致时才扩展至更复杂的条件。
AI.result: 在六个基准规划域的实验中，OHCAM在样本效率上优于基线方法，能够解决更多任务，即便存在观测噪声也能保持良好性能。在Kinova Gen3机器人上的两项任务验证了该方法在真实世界中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: OHCAM证明了在线假设驱动的主动学习方法能够在有限交互和噪声环境下高效学习复杂动作模型，并具备现实应用潜力。

title: OPUS: A Simple yet Effective Unified Framework for Open-Vocabulary Detection
summary: Recent unified open-vocabulary detection (OVD) supports heterogeneous prompts, including text queries, visual exemplars, and their combinations, but often rely on increasingly complex designs such as heavy cross-modal fusion, staged training, and iterative annotation pipelines. We revisit whether such complexity is necessary in the era of stronger foundation models. Our finding is that unified OVD can be made substantially simpler with semantic-rich visual representations and scalable grounding supervision. We present OPUS (\textbf{O}pen-vocabulary, \textbf{P}rompt-\textbf{U}nified, \textbf{S}imple), a unified detector supporting text, interactive visual, generic visual, and mixed prompting within one framework. OPUS adopts a simple three-part design. Its model architecture combines a semantic-rich visual encoder, built on a DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B backbone with efficient hybrid encoding, with a prompt-aware decoder that avoids prompt-specific branches for unified prompt reasoning. OPUS is trained with a one-stage text-visual training strategy with Instance-level Contrastive Alignment (ICA), and is supported by a SAM3-based single-pass data engine for heterogeneous grounding supervision. Experiments on COCO, LVIS-minival, and ODinW35 show that OPUS achieves state-of-the-art Visual-I performance, reaching 68.1/69.2/54.7 AP, while maintaining balanced Text and Visual-G accuracy. OPUS also turns mixed prompting from interference into complementarity, improving over text or visual prompt alone. These results show that simplicity and strong unified prompting capability can be achieved together.

AI.tldr: OPUS 提出了一种简化的统一开放词汇检测框架，利用语义丰富的视觉表示和可扩展的 grounding 监督，在单一框架内支持文本、交互式视觉、通用视觉和混合提示，无需复杂的跨模态融合或分阶段训练。
AI.motivation: 现有统一开放词汇检测方法为了支持异构提示（文本、视觉示例及其组合），往往依赖日益复杂的设计（如重跨模态融合、分阶段训练、迭代标注流程）。作者质疑在更强基础模型时代，这种复杂性是否必要，并探索是否可以用更简单的设计实现同等或更好的效果。
AI.method: OPUS 采用简单的三部分设计：(1) 模型架构结合基于 DINOv3-ConvNeXt-B 骨干的语义丰富视觉编码器与高效混合编码，以及避免提示特定分支的提示感知解码器，实现统一提示推理；(2) 采用单阶段文本-视觉训练策略，包含实例级对比对齐（ICA）；(3) 基于 SAM3 的单遍数据引擎生成异构 grounding 监督。
AI.result: 在 COCO、LVIS-minival 和 ODinW35 上的实验表明，OPUS 在 Visual-I 性能上达到最先进水平（68.1/69.2/54.7 AP），同时保持平衡的 Text 和 Visual-G 精度。混合提示从干扰转变为互补，优于单独使用文本或视觉提示。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明简洁的设计与强大的统一提示能力可以同时实现，挑战了之前认为统一 OVD 必须依赖复杂架构的观点。

title: MNIST-PRO: MNIST is Back as a Partially Observable World for AI Agents
summary: AI agents in partially observable environments need to coordinate active sensing with working memory to maintain an evolving perceptual state. However, existing benchmarks struggle to isolate this perceptual-state construction and interpretation capability because they introduce physical and control complexities. We address this with MNIST-PRO, a benchmark that isolates agentic perception by converting MNIST digit recognition into a sequential, glimpse-based search task with lookback constraints. We evaluate ten multimodal models across four memory representations, including raw visual history, textual states, structured metric grid maps, and a consolidated visual canvas. While models excel under full observability, partial observability exposes a clear performance gap. We identify three distinct bottlenecks. First, perceptual-state construction and interpretation present a challenge, as agents struggle to integrate fragmented glimpses. Second, agents often stop exploring before they see the full sequence. Third, models often fail to revise early, incorrect beliefs even when faced with subsequent contradictory evidence. These results show that simply acquiring visual evidence is not enough. Agents must also be able to build and update a reliable perceptual state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MNIST-PRO基准，将MNIST数字识别转化为带回溯约束的序列化瞥视搜索任务，用于隔离评估部分可观测环境下智能体的主动感知与工作记忆协调能力。评估10个多模态模型和4种记忆表示，发现部分可观测性下存在明显性能差距，并识别出三大瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准因引入物理和控制复杂度，难以隔离评估智能体在部分可观测环境中构建和解释感知状态的能力。作者希望专门针对"感知状态构建与解释"这一核心能力设计一个纯净的评估基准。
AI.method: 将MNIST数字识别改造为序列化的、基于瞥视的搜索任务，并施加回溯约束（仅能观察部分信息）。在四种记忆表示（原始视觉历史、文本状态、结构化度量网格图、整合视觉画布）下评估十个多模态模型。
AI.result: 模型在完全可观测条件下表现优异，但部分可观测条件下性能显著下降。识别出三个瓶颈：1) 感知状态构建与解释困难；2) 智能体过早停止探索；3) 面对矛盾证据时未能修正早期错误信念。
AI.conclusion: 仅获取视觉证据是不够的，智能体必须能够构建并持续更新可靠的感知状态。这为评估和提升AI智能体的主动感知与工作记忆能力提供了新的基准和方向。

title: Centering before Pruning: Lightweight Geometry Correction for Diversity-Based Visual Token Pruning in LVLMs
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) incur substantial inference costs due to their long and highly redundant visual-token sequences. Diversity-based pruning mitigates this cost by selecting token subsets based on pairwise cosine similarity. We find, however, that similarities between raw visual tokens are strongly concentrated in the positive range, limiting their ability to distinguish non-redundant tokens. A natural way to improve this resolution is to center token features before computing cosine similarity. Centering indeed reveals a substantially richer pairwise structure, yet unexpectedly degrades pruning performance when used alone. We show that this apparent contradiction arises because the raw geometry does more than represent pairwise diversity: it also implicitly favors globally distinctive tokens, which tend to contain semantically informative content. Centering better resolves subset diversity but loses this useful token-wise preference, revealing that diversity and distinctiveness are entangled in the raw geometry. Based on this analysis, we propose the \textbf{Cen}tered Geometry \textbf{Prune}r (Cen-Prune), which measures subset diversity using centered cosine similarity while retaining raw-space distinctiveness as a complementary token-wise preference. This lightweight, plug-and-play correction leaves the underlying selection mechanism unchanged and incurs negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple image- and video-understanding benchmarks and LVLM architectures demonstrate that Cen-Prune provides robust improvements in overall performance across existing diversity-based pruners.

AI.tldr: 提出了Cen-Prune方法，通过"居中余弦相似度"来衡量子集多样性，同时保留原始空间中的显著性作为互补的token偏好，解决了LVLM视觉token剪枝中原始几何结构分辨不足和纯居中剪枝性能下降的矛盾，在多种基准和架构上取得稳健提升。
AI.motivation: LVLM推理成本高源于视觉token序列冗长且高度冗余。现有基于多样性的剪枝方法使用成对余弦相似度选择token子集，但原始视觉token的相似度高度集中在正值区间，难以区分非冗余token。居中特征能揭示更丰富的成对结构，但单独使用时反而降低剪枝性能，这一矛盾亟需解释和解决。
AI.method: 分析发现原始几何不仅表示成对多样性，还隐式偏好全局显著token（含语义信息），而居中可以更好分辨子集多样性但丢失了token级别的显著性偏好。基于此，提出Cen-Prune：使用居中余弦相似度度量子集多样性，同时保留原始空间的显著性作为互补的token级偏好。该方法轻量、即插即用，不改变底层选择机制。
AI.result: 在多个图像和视频理解基准以及多种LVLM架构上进行大量实验，证明Cen-Prune在现有基于多样性的剪枝器上提供稳健的整体性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 多样性（diversity）和显著性（distinctiveness）在原始几何中是纠缠的，Cen-Prune通过同时利用两者的优势实现了更好的视觉token剪枝，且几乎不增加计算开销。

title: Measure Before You Manage: Evaluating Agent Working Memory in Coding Agents
summary: Agent working memory is heterogeneous. Objects such as instructions, artifacts, tool outputs, and agent-generated state play different semantic roles and exhibit different size, retention, and representation profiles. Recent work has begun to explore memory-management mechanisms that account for such heterogeneity. This work focuses on semantic heterogeneity and studies how it should shape the management and evaluation of working memory in coding agents. Across 55 archived coding-agent trajectories, we find that semantically different working-memory objects exhibit distinct retention and compression behavior. This heterogeneity motivates semantically informed memory management. We study two semantically informed strategies: an object-aware compression policy and a retrieval-based policy. Their evaluation shows that calibration gains may not transfer to held-out tasks, and that equal token budgets do not imply equal delivered context or management cost. A real-system replay further exposes serving limits that nominal budgets alone do not capture. Together, these results show why semantic structure matters for agent working memory and why evaluating memory-management strategies requires more than a nominal token budget. We organize these lessons into four levels: stored state, delivered context, management work, and task or process outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文研究编码智能体中工作记忆的语义异质性，发现不同语义类型的记忆对象（指令、工件、工具输出、智能体状态）在保留和压缩行为上存在显著差异，并据此提出两种语义感知的记忆管理策略（对象感知压缩策略和检索式策略），通过55条编码智能体轨迹进行评估，揭示名义token预算不足以衡量记忆管理策略效果。
AI.motivation: 智能体工作记忆是异质的，不同类型的记忆对象（指令、工件、工具输出、智能体生成状态）具有不同的语义角色、大小、保留和表示特征。已有工作开始探索考虑这种异质性的记忆管理机制，但缺乏对语义异质性如何影响记忆管理和评估的系统研究，特别是在编码智能体场景中。
AI.method: 基于55条已归档的编码智能体轨迹，分析语义不同的工作记忆对象在保留和压缩行为上的差异；提出两种语义感知策略：对象感知压缩策略（object-aware compression policy）和基于检索的策略（retrieval-based policy）；通过校准实验、保留任务测试和真实系统重放进行评估。
AI.result: 发现语义异质性确实存在于保留和压缩行为中；语义感知策略的校准增益无法迁移到保留任务（held-out tasks）上；等量token预算并不意味着等量的实际传递上下文或管理成本；真实系统重放暴露了名义预算无法捕捉的服务限制。
AI.conclusion: 语义结构对智能体工作记忆管理至关重要，评估记忆管理策略不能仅依赖名义token预算。论文将评估经验总结为四个层级：存储状态、传递上下文、管理工作和任务/过程结果。

title: Motion-Saliency Complementary Masked Modeling for Point Cloud Video Understanding
summary: Point cloud video representation learning is crucial for 3D dynamic scene understanding. In this paper, we propose MoSaiC, a novel Motion-Saliency Complementary masked modeling framework for self-supervised point cloud video representation learning. MoSaiC couples three components: Curriculum Motion-Saliency Masking (CMSM), which guides the masking process toward motion-salient tokens under a curriculum schedule; Normal-Flow Motion (NFM) modeling, which supervises the local rigid rotation of each token in the Lie algebra so(3) as an explicit geometric motion target; and Cross-view Token Consistency Prediction (CTCP), which enforces consistency between two complementary masked views at the token level. Together, these components allow MoSaiC to effectively capture both appearance and motion dynamics. Extensive experiments on multiple downstream tasks, including action recognition, temporal action segmentation, and point-level semantic segmentation, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: MoSaiC是一个针对点云视频自监督表示学习的框架，通过课程运动显著性掩码(CMSM)、法向流运动建模(NFM)和跨视角令牌一致性预测(CTCP)三个组件协同工作，有效捕捉点云视频中的外观和运动动态信息，在动作识别、时间动作分割和点级语义分割等下游任务中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 点云视频表示学习对于3D动态场景理解至关重要，但目前尚无有效的自监督学习框架能够同时捕捉点云序列中的外观与运动信息。
AI.method: 提出MoSaiC框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) Curriculum Motion-Saliency Masking (CMSM)——通过课程学习策略引导掩码聚焦于运动显著性令牌；(2) Normal-Flow Motion (NFM)——在so(3)李代数中监督每个令牌的局部刚体旋转，作为显式几何运动目标；(3) Cross-view Token Consistency Prediction (CTCP)——在两个互补掩码视图间强制执行令牌级别的一致性。
AI.result: 在动作识别、时间动作分割和点级语义分割等多个下游任务上的大量实验均证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: MoSaiC通过三个互补组件的协同设计，成功实现了点云视频中外观与运动动态的综合捕捉，为3D动态场景的自监督表示学习提供了有效解决方案。

title: Wrong Prediction, Right Answer: Recovering Evidence from Collapsed LLM Sequence Scores
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures, and 43 appendix tables. Research paper on language-model interpretability, reasoning evaluation, output-scoring bottlenecks, and label-free calibration. The paper evaluates controlled three-way logical reasoning tasks, ProofWriter, ANLI, and FOLIO using Qwen3.5, OLMo-2-1B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Pythia checkpoints
summary: When a large language model fails a reasoning task, it is often assumed to lack the underlying capability. However, this conflates a genuine absence of reasoning with a late-stage output bottleneck. We observe a consistent readout gap across diverse reasoning benchmarks: hidden-state probes successfully decode correct answers even when native sequence scoring completely collapses due to structural biases. To test whether instance-specific logic survives this collapse, we introduce a diagnostic protocol using a minimal, target-label-free additive correction. Fitting just two parameters on as few as 25 unlabeled examples recovers 9--34 accuracy points for Qwen3.5 models, transferring successfully to OLMo-2-1B and Llama-3.1-8B. Crucially, these recovered decisions persist on hard instances unresolved by simple lexical overlap and significantly exceed count-preserving permutation baselines. Our results show that many apparent zero-shot reasoning deficits are expression failures masking intact internal logic, urging a narrower interpretation of benchmark evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大语言模型在推理任务中的失败常被误认为能力缺失，但实际上许多是"读出阶段"（输出瓶颈）而非内在逻辑缺失。通过对隐藏状态进行探针解码，即使在序列打分因结构偏差完全失效时，仍能正确解码答案。作者提出一种仅需两个参数、无需目标标签的加性修正协议，在仅25个无标签样本上即可恢复Qwen3.5模型9-34个准确率点，并能迁移到OLMo-2-1B和Llama-3.1-8B。恢复出的决策在难以用词法重叠解决的困难实例上依然稳健，且显著超过保持计数的排列基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型推理失败常被归因于能力缺失，但作者认为这混淆了"真正缺乏推理能力"与"输出阶段瓶颈"两种不同情况。现有评估方法忽略了模型内部隐藏状态可能已包含正确答案，只是序列生成阶段存在结构偏差导致输出失败。
AI.method: 提出一种诊断协议：使用隐藏状态探针解码正确答案，并设计一个极简的、目标标签无关的加性修正方法，仅拟合两个参数，在少量（25个）无标签样本上即可实现精度恢复。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5模型上恢复9-34个准确率点，该修正可迁移到OLMo-2-1B和Llama-3.1-8B；恢复的决策在困难实例上持续有效，且显著优于基于计数保持的排列基线。
AI.conclusion: 许多表观上的零样本推理缺陷实为"表达失败"（expression failures），掩盖了模型内部仍然完好的逻辑能力。因此对基准测试的解读应更加审慎，不能将输出失败直接等同于能力缺失。

title: SELECT: SELEctive Context Transfer for Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation
summary: Class-Incremental Semantic Segmentation (CISS) is fundamentally challenged by catastrophic forgetting and background shift, where learning new concepts degrades performance on previously seen classes. While existing methods attempt to balance stability (retaining old knowledge) and plasticity (learning new knowledge), they often fail to leverage prior knowledge effectively. These approaches typically rely on indiscriminate knowledge transfer or ambiguous initializations, which can dilute crucial semantic information. To overcome this limitation, we propose SELECT, a novel approach for Selective Context Transfer, which instead grounds each new class in a small set of semantically similar past classes. Its core is a Context Transfer Attention mechanism that aggregates the learned tokens from similar classes into a structured initialization for the new class. To ensure this transfer does not corrupt the borrowed representations, we add a controlled noise perturbation and a margin-based context-transfer loss that enforces separation between the new class token and its source tokens. Extensive experiments on Pascal VOC and ADE20K show that SELECT consistently outperforms prior work, achieving mIoU of 2.2% on VOC and 2.8% on ADE, providing an effective handle on the stability-plasticity dilemma. Code is available at https://github.com/avigupta2798/SELECT.

AI.tldr: SELECT是一种针对类增量语义分割（CISS）的新方法，通过选择性上下文迁移（Selective Context Transfer）机制，将每个新类锚定在一小组语义相似的旧类上，利用上下文迁移注意力（Context Transfer Attention）聚合相似类的已学习token作为新类的结构化初始化，并结合受控噪声扰动和基于边界的上下文迁移损失来防止表示腐化，在Pascal VOC和ADE20K上分别提升mIoU 2.2%和2.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有CISS方法在平衡稳定性（保留旧知识）和可塑性（学习新知识）时，常采用无差别知识迁移或模糊初始化，这会稀释关键语义信息，无法有效利用先前知识。
AI.method: 1) 提出选择性上下文迁移（SELECT）框架，为每个新类选择一小群语义相似的旧类进行知识迁移；2) 设计上下文迁移注意力机制，聚合相似类的已学习token作为新类的结构化初始化；3) 引入受控噪声扰动和基于边界的上下文迁移损失，保证新类token与源token之间的分离，防止迁移过程腐化借用表示。
AI.result: 在Pascal VOC和ADE20K数据集上的大量实验表明，SELECT一致优于先前方法，mIoU分别提升2.2%（VOC）和2.8%（ADE）。
AI.conclusion: SELECT通过选择性而非无差别的知识迁移，为稳定性-可塑性困境提供了有效解决方案，代码已开源。

title: Scaling Large Reasoning Models beyond Human Supervision: A Path toward Superintelligence
summary: Recent advances in large reasoning models (LRMs) have shown that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can substantially improve reasoning in mathematics and code, where outcomes can be checked automatically. Extending this progress to open-ended and agentic tasks remains difficult because reliable rewards are harder to obtain and direct human supervision cannot keep pace with the scale and complexity of model-generated experience. This paper studies how LRMs can continue to improve as human supervision gradually recedes from the learning loop. We examine two connected dimensions of this problem. The reward axis traces the development from per-instance human judgments to reusable verifiers and rewards that operate even without human feedback. The experience axis examines how learning can progress from human-curated tasks and environments toward self-generated curricula, constructed environments, and autonomous co-evolution. We connect these dimensions through a five-level ladder from L0 to L4 that identifies which parts of the learning process remain under continued human control. Our analysis further highlights the risks introduced by increasingly autonomous rewards and experience generation, including reward hacking, feedback drift, curriculum collapse, and environment errors. Consequently, we also provide the evaluation around three complementary objects: policy capability, feedback fidelity, and experience quality. This analysis provides a structured account of current approaches to scaling LRMs beyond human supervision and the open problems involved in developing self-sustaining learning systems toward superintelligence. Furthermore, we maintain a continuously updated \href{https://github.com/visitworld123/Awesome-Scaling-LRM-Beyond-Human-Supervision}{GitHub repository} to track the latest advances.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了大型推理模型（LRMs）如何在人类监督逐渐退出学习循环后继续提升的问题，提出了一个从L0到L4的五级阶梯框架，从奖励轴（人工判断→可复用验证器→无人类反馈的奖励）和经验轴（人工策划任务→自生成课程→自主协同进化）两个维度刻画学习过程的自主化进程，并分析了随之而来的风险（奖励黑客、反馈漂移、课程崩溃、环境错误）以及对应的评估维度（策略能力、反馈保真度、经验质量）。
AI.motivation: 尽管RLVR在数学和代码领域已显著提升推理能力，但这些领域的成功依赖于可自动验证的结果。扩展到开放性和智能体任务时，可靠奖励难以获取，且直接人工监督无法跟上模型生成经验的规模和复杂度。因此，需要研究如何让LRMs在人类监督逐渐退出的情况下持续自我改进。
AI.method: 论文提出一个五级阶梯框架（L0到L4），从两个维度系统分析学习过程的自主化：(1) 奖励轴：从逐实例人工判断到可复用验证器，再到无需人类反馈的奖励；(2) 经验轴：从人类策划的任务和环境，到自生成课程、构造环境，再到自主协同进化。同时提出三方面评估对象：策略能力、反馈保真度和经验质量。
AI.result: 该分析提供了当前超越人类监督扩展LRMs方法的系统化描述，识别了自主化过程中的关键风险（奖励黑客、反馈漂移、课程崩溃、环境错误），并建立了对应的评估框架（策略能力、反馈保真度、经验质量）。此外，维护了一个持续更新的GitHub仓库以追踪最新进展。
AI.conclusion: 实现超出人类监督的LRMs规模化是一个关键但充满开放问题的方向。通过五级阶梯和双轴分析，本文为构建自维持学习系统（迈向超级智能）提供了结构化框架，并明确了其中的挑战与评估途径。

title: Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions at arbitrary times over a continuously growing visual stream. The central challenge is to compactly remember long-range history while effectively retrieving question-relevant evidence. We propose Dynamic Hub-and-Spoke Memory (D-HSM), a training-free framework that represents distant history as structured textual memory while preserving the recent frames as visual tokens for fine-grained perception. Specifically, D-HSM turns selected historical video chunks into typed textual observations and stores them in an entity-centered hub-and-spoke memory, with entities as hubs and related evidence as spokes. When answering a question, D-HSM dynamically retrieves a compact question-aware memory subset, expands it through hub-and-spoke links, and combines it with the recent visual window for frozen-VLM answer prediction. Extensive experiments on both streaming and long video benchmarks show that D-HSM consistently and substantially improves VLM backbones and outperforms other state-of-the-art online and offline video understanding baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态枢纽-辐条记忆（D-HSM），一种无需训练的视频流理解框架。它将远程历史视频转化为结构化的文本记忆，并保留近期帧作为视觉令牌，通过实体中心的枢纽-辐条结构动态检索与问题相关的紧凑记忆子集，结合近期视觉窗口实现冻结VLM的答案预测，在流式和长视频基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需要在不断增长的视觉流上任意时刻回答问题，核心挑战在于如何紧凑地记忆长程历史，同时有效检索与问题相关的证据，以克服传统方法在记忆容量与检索效率之间的权衡。
AI.method: D-HSM采用训练免费框架：1）将选定的历史视频块转换为类型化的文本观察；2）存储在实体为中心的枢纽-辐条记忆中（实体为枢纽，相关证据为辐条）；3）回答问题时空态检索紧凑的问题感知记忆子集；4）通过枢纽-辐条链接扩展；5）与近期视觉窗口结合，供冻结VLM预测。
AI.result: 在流式和长视频基准上的大量实验表明，D-HSM一致且显著地提升了VLM骨干网络的性能，并超越了其他最先进的在线和离线视频理解基线。
AI.conclusion: D-HSM通过结构化的文本记忆与动态检索机制，有效解决了流式视频理解中长程记忆与细粒度感知的矛盾，验证了训练免费框架在该任务中的可行性与优越性。

title: Reconciling Process Supervision with Outcome-Based Credit in Agentic Policy Optimization
summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides verified feedback for language-model agents, but assigns trajectory-level advantage uniformly to all decisions, yielding coarse credit over long-horizon interactions. On-policy self-distillation offers finer supervision by re-evaluating sampled behavior with privileged information (PI) available only during training. However, fine-grained supervision is not necessarily fine-grained credit: PI-induced likelihood changes describe how additional information alters policy preference, but do not directly determine how an executable action should inherit the verified task outcome. This creates a supervision-credit gap. Privileged signals may be irrelevant to the current interaction state, operate at a token granularity misaligned with executable decisions, and lack the outcome semantics required for reinforcement. We introduce TASPO, which converts privileged supervision into outcome-grounded action credit. TASPO constructs decision-applicable PI from verified successful experience, aggregates PI-induced likelihood shifts at the executable-action level, and converts relative action support into positive, bounded, mean-preserving weights on the original trajectory advantage. Thus, the verified outcome determines the update direction and average scale, while PI only redistributes credit across actions. Across three agentic benchmarks, TASPO improves over GRPO by 10.6\% and generalizes better to unseen tasks. Further analysis indicates that TASPO reduces supervision mismatch and that action-level assignment stabilizes the policy optimization process. These findings offer the community another interesting perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TASPO方法，将基于结果的强化学习中的特权监督信号转化为可执行的、基于结果的行动信用分配，解决了监督-信用差距问题，在三个智能体基准上相比GRPO提升10.6%。
AI.motivation: 基于结果的强化学习（如GRPO）对所有决策均匀分配轨迹级优势，导致长程交互中信用分配粗糙。虽然on-policy自蒸馏利用训练时的特权信息（PI）提供细粒度监督，但细粒度监督不等于细粒度信用——PI引起的似然变化只反映信息如何改变策略偏好，不能直接决定可执行动作如何继承已验证的任务结果，存在"监督-信用差距"。
AI.method: TASPO通过三个步骤实现：1) 从已验证的成功经验中构建决策可应用的特权信息（PI）；2) 在可执行动作层面聚合PI引起的似然偏移；3) 将相对动作支持度转换为正的有界均值保持权重，作用于原始轨迹优势上。这样验证结果决定更新方向和平均规模，PI仅负责在动作间重新分配信用。
AI.result: 在三个智能体基准上，TASPO相比GRPO提升10.6%，并对未见任务具有更好的泛化能力。进一步分析表明TASPO减少了监督不匹配，动作级信用分配稳定了策略优化过程。
AI.conclusion: TASPO有效弥合了特权监督与结果信用之间的差距，为基于结果的智能体强化学习提供了一种更有原则的动作级信用分配方法，也为社区提供了新的视角。

title: Learning to Restore More: Continual Capability Expansion for Pretrained Image Restoration Models
summary: Image restoration models are typically trained with a fixed set of capabilities. When new restoration requirements emerge, existing solutions usually train additional models or jointly retrain the original model with both new and historical data. Instead of designing another restoration backbone, we investigate how a trained restorer can continually acquire new capabilities without forgetting those learned previously. We propose RestoreMore, a continual capability-expansion framework that preserves the pretrained restoration model as a frozen capability anchor and learns residual expansion modules for newly arriving degradations. RestoreMore introduces a capability-oriented bi-level routing mechanism at multiple feature stages. The first routing level identifies restoration capabilities relevant to the current input, while the second selects and combines a sparse set of complementary degradation experts. This design enables newly introduced tasks to selectively reuse historical restoration knowledge and progressively enriches the expert bank available for subsequent restoration tasks. Extensive experiments on a wide range of restoration benchmarks demonstrate that RestoreMore consistently acquires new restoration abilities while preserving and improving previously learned capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RestoreMore，一个持续能力扩展框架，通过冻结预训练恢复模型作为能力锚点，学习残差扩展模块来获取新的图像恢复能力，并引入能力导向的双层路由机制在多个特征阶段选择相关恢复能力和稀疏组合退化专家，实现新任务选择性复用历史知识，逐步丰富专家库，在不遗忘旧能力的同时持续获取新能力。
AI.motivation: 现有图像恢复模型通常以固定能力集训练，当出现新的恢复需求时，需要训练额外模型或联合重训原模型来处理新旧数据，缺乏高效的能力持续扩展方案。
AI.method: RestoreMore框架包含三个关键设计：(1) 冻结预训练模型作为能力锚点；(2) 学习残差扩展模块处理新退化类型；(3) 能力导向的双层路由机制：第一层识别与当前输入相关的恢复能力，第二层选择并组合稀疏的互补退化专家，实现历史知识的选择性复用和专家库的渐进丰富。
AI.result: 在广泛的图像恢复基准上，RestoreMore持续获取新恢复能力的同时，能够保持甚至提升先前学习的能力。
AI.conclusion: RestoreMore证明了通过冻结能力锚点加残差扩展模块的方式，可以实现高效的持续图像恢复能力扩展，避免遗忘旧能力，且新任务能受益于历史知识。

title: Token-Efficient Data Reasoning Agents via Adaptive Structuring of Unstructured Data
summary: Valuable data remains embedded in unstructured sources: web pages, reports, contracts, filings, earnings calls, and PDFs. The big bet in enterprise AI is deploying LLM agents that reason over this data to answer complex questions for every knowledge worker. Agents can do this today, but at prohibitive cost. Each question repeatedly opens large documents to recover scattered evidence, consuming up to a million tokens. However, if the data were already structured, the same question would reduce to a cheap database lookup. For example, on FanOutQA benchmark, reasoning over an ideal pre-structured store is 28X cheaper, and the gap grows to orders of magnitude as questions fan out over more documents. Yet structuring everything in advance is not viable: documents hold vastly more possible structure than any workload will use, and the useful structure and documents are unknown until queries arrive. We propose agentic data cracking, a method that structures unstructured data adaptively and speculatively as a byproduct of reasoning itself. Structuring is adaptive because observed queries decide when it happens and what matters, and speculative because it goes beyond the current question. Whenever the agent opens a document to answer, a cracking sub-agent forks from the already-loaded context at marginal cost and extracts grounded structure likely to serve related future queries. Over time, an increasing share of queries is fully covered by structured data and answered without opening a document, keeping agentic accuracy at close to RAG cost. On FanOutQA, extended with merely one related question per test question, cracking cuts cost by 53% while preserving accuracy. Agentic data cracking is a first step toward next-generation data infrastructure for agentic reasoning over unstructured data: a shared substrate beneath the model where knowledge that reasoning already paid to uncover accumulates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体数据破解"(agentic data cracking)方法，在LLM智能体推理过程中自适应且推测性地将非结构化数据转为结构化数据，作为推理的副产品，从而在不牺牲准确率的情况下大幅降低查询成本（在FanOutQA基准上削减53%成本）。
AI.motivation: 企业AI的核心挑战是让LLM智能体在非结构化数据（网页、报告、合同等）上进行推理，但成本高昂——每个问题需要反复打开大型文档，消耗高达百万token。若数据预先结构化，同一问题仅需廉价的数据库查找（在FanOutQA上便宜28倍）。然而预先结构化一切并不可行，因为文档可能的结构远超工作负载所需，且有用的结构在查询到达前不可知。
AI.method: 提出智能体数据破解方法：在推理过程中自适应且推测性地对非结构化数据进行结构化。自适应性体现在由观察到的查询决定何时结构化及什么内容重要；推测性体现在超越当前问题进行额外提取。每当智能体打开文档回答问题时，一个"破解子智能体"(cracking sub-agent)从已加载的上下文中分叉（边际成本极小），提取可能服务未来相关查询的接地结构。随着时间推移，越来越多的查询被结构化数据完全覆盖，无需打开文档即可回答。
AI.result: 在FanOutQA基准上，仅增加每个测试问题一个相关问题，破解方法削减53%成本同时保持准确率。理想预结构化存储在FanOutQA上比原始推理便宜28倍，且差距随问题在更多文档间扇出而扩大到数量级。
AI.conclusion: 智能体数据破解是迈向下一代数据基础设施的第一步——在模型之下建立一个共享基底，让推理已付费发现的"知识"得以累积，从而支持关于非结构化数据的智能体推理。

title: ScenePilot: Grow-and-Repair Policy for Text-Driven 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Text-driven 3D indoor scene generation has advanced from dataset-bound layout modeling to open-vocabulary synthesis with large language and vision-language models. Yet existing methods remain limited: one-pass generators often yield geometrically invalid layouts, heavy post-hoc optimization is costly and unstable, and prompt-only planners lack reusable layout priors for functional grouping and object relations. We propose \textbf{ScenePilot}, a retrieval-augmented \textbf{Grow-and-Repair} framework that formulates scene generation as prior-guided incremental growth with learned rectification. Given a prompt, the Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented Planning (HRAP) module retrieves room-, group-, and anchor-level layout priors to support functional group planning. A text-driven base generator then inserts object groups sequentially, while the Reinforcement Multimodal Repair (RMR) module performs lightweight local correction after each insertion and a final global repair after completion. To train this policy, we construct \textbf{SceneReverse-17k}, a repair-trajectory dataset built by perturbing high-quality 3D scenes in position, rotation, and scale, then using inverse operations as executable rectification targets. The policy predicts structured \emph{move--rotate--scale} actions from rendered views, scene state, retrieved priors, and edit history. By combining HRAP with RMR, ScenePilot offers an efficient alternative to one-shot generation and heavy full-scene optimization, improving physical plausibility, functional coherence, and controllability while preserving diversity.

AI.tldr: ScenePilot 是一个检索增强的"生长-修复"框架，用于文本驱动的3D室内场景生成。它通过层级检索增强规划(HRAP)获取房间、组和锚点级别的布局先验，并使用强化多模态修复(RMR)策略进行轻量级局部校正和全局修复，在SceneReverse-17k数据集上训练，兼顾物理合理性、功能连贯性和可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D室内场景生成方法存在三方面局限：单次生成器往往产生几何无效的布局；重度后处理优化成本高且不稳定；仅基于提示的规划器缺乏可复用的布局先验，难以处理功能分组和物体关系。
AI.method: 提出ScenePilot框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 层级检索增强规划(HRAP)，从房间、组、锚点三个层级检索布局先验来支持功能组规划；(2) 强化多模态修复(RMR)，在每组插入后进行轻量级局部修正，完成后进行全局修复。策略预测结构化的移动-旋转-缩放动作，输入包括渲染视图、场景状态、检索先验和编辑历史。同时构建了SceneReverse-17k修复轨迹数据集，通过扰动高质量场景并利用逆操作作为可执行修复目标来训练策略。
AI.result: ScenePilot提供了相较于单次生成和重度全场景优化的高效替代方案，在物理合理性、功能连贯性和可控性方面均有提升，同时保持了场景多样性。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合层级检索增强规划与强化多模态修复，ScenePilot证明了先验引导的增量生长加学习式修正范式能够有效解决开放词汇3D室内场景生成中的布局有效性问题，为场景生成提供了一条更高效、更可控的技术路径。

title: Cross-Regional Grapevine Cold Hardiness Prediction via Learned Multimodal Latent Representations
summary: Accurate daily predictions of cold hardiness in woody plants are critical in regions where freezing temperatures can damage dormant buds and reduce seasonal yield. Existing biophysical, hybrid, and deep learning models have shown high predictive accuracy when trained on local data but remain largely site-specific. The limited availability of cold hardiness data, coupled with the lack of principled methods for transferring cold hardiness predictions to new regions and cultivars, has limited the broader adoption and practical utility of these approaches, particularly in data-scarce regions. To address these limitations, we propose a cold hardiness prediction framework that learns a transferable latent representation by capturing region-specific variation through learned embeddings. To enable prediction in previously unseen regions, we infer embeddings from (1) text descriptions of the cultivar and growing region, and (2) limited historical observations, supporting both zero-shot and few-shot transfer. Experiments on datasets from six regions across North America demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art cold hardiness prediction methods, yielding more accurate predictions and substantially improving transfer to data-scarce regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可迁移的木本植物耐寒性预测框架，通过学习区域嵌入表示，结合文本描述和有限历史观测，实现零样本和少样本迁移预测，在北美六个区域的数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有耐寒性预测模型（生物物理、混合、深度学习）依赖局部训练数据，站点特异性强，难以迁移到新区域和新品种。数据稀缺加上缺乏原则性的迁移方法，限制了这些模型在数据稀缺地区的实际应用。
AI.method: 提出一个可迁移的耐寒性预测框架，通过学习嵌入表示捕捉区域特定变异。对于未见区域，通过（1）品种和种植区域的文本描述，以及（2）有限的历史观测来推断嵌入，支持零样本和少样本迁移。
AI.result: 在北美六个区域的数据集上，该方法的预测准确度一致优于最先进的耐寒性预测方法，且显著改善了向数据稀缺区域的迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了耐寒性预测在数据稀缺区域的应用瓶颈，通过可迁移的潜在表示实现了跨区域和跨品种的泛化，为广泛采用耐寒性预测工具提供了新的可能。

title: Knowing Beyond the Known: Reinforced Knowledge Specification for Multi-Label Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Existing class-incremental learning methods struggle in multi-label scenarios (MLCIL) due to the inherent contradiction of learning objectives arising from co-occurring and incomplete labels. We argue that the core obstacle is the model's ambiguous boundary between known and unknown knowledge, which undermines historical knowledge retention, complicates current task learning, and limits adaptability to future concepts. To address this, we propose KBK (Knowing Beyond the Known), a reinforced knowledge specification framework that explicitly models what is known or not to unify historical, current, and prospective learning. Specifically, to clarify known knowledge, we develop a hierarchical feature purification module that disentangles fine-grained class-specific features from global features, where high-level semantic abstraction is reinforced with low-level visual features. Additionally, an uncertainty-aware recall enhancement strategy suppresses unreliable predictions based on distribution priors, improving the quality of historical recall. For probing the unknown, KBK leverages semantic correlations to synthesize informative unknown features under co-occurring, preserving embedding space for future learning. Furthermore, to mitigate heterogeneous forgetting, we design a category-balanced gradient compensation loss that dynamically reweights gradient backpropagation according to forgetting speeds. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness and robustness of KBK, which surpasses prior best methods by 2.7% in Avg. Acc on MS-COCO B0-C10 setting even without any replay buffers.

AI.tldr: 提出KBK框架，通过显式建模"已知与未知"的知识边界来解决多标签类增量学习（MLCIL）中长期存在的目标矛盾问题，在MS-COCO B0-C10设定下超越先前最优方法2.7%的平均精度，且无需回放缓冲区。
AI.motivation: 现有类增量学习方法在多标签场景下表现不佳，根本原因在于共现标签和不完整标注带来的学习目标内在矛盾。论文认为核心障碍是模型对已知与未知知识之间边界模糊，这损害了历史知识保留、复杂化了当前任务学习，并限制了对未来概念的适应能力。
AI.method: KBK框架包含三个关键模块：(1) 层级特征净化模块，从全局特征中解耦细粒度类别特定特征，并用低级视觉特征强化高级语义抽象，以澄清已知知识；(2) 不确定性感知回忆增强策略，基于分布先验抑制不可靠预测，提升历史回忆质量；(3) 探索未知方面，利用语义相关性在共现条件下合成信息丰富的未知特征，为未来学习保留嵌入空间。此外，设计类别均衡梯度补偿损失，根据遗忘速度动态重加权梯度反向传播，以缓解异质遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个基准上验证了KBK的有效性和鲁棒性，在MS-COCO B0-C10设定下平均精度超越先前最优方法2.7%，且无需任何回放缓冲区。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式区分"已知"与"未知"知识，KBK统一了历史、当前和未来的学习目标，有效解决了多标签类增量学习中的核心矛盾，展示了无需回放缓冲区即可取得优异性能的可能性。

title: BLOOM-WILT: Logit Tilting for Behaviour Elicitation in Automated LLM Auditing
summary: Users of a deployed language model routinely encounter behaviours that testing almost never surfaces, since deployment puts the model through orders of magnitude more interactions than any evaluation can simulate. Automated auditors make testing cheap to scale and flexible enough to cover almost any specified behaviour, yet their lack of optimisation pressure makes them sample-inefficient. To address this shortcoming, we introduce BLOOM-WILT, a full auditing pipeline that elicits natural multi-turn instances of rare behaviours, without training cost or access beyond the target's next-token distribution. On the input side, WILT's auditor model revises its conversational strategy across rounds, learning from previous scored interactions. On the output side, WILT adaptively reweights the target's decoding using the model's own distribution conditioned on an elicitation prompt, so that behaviour-relevant generations are sampled ahead of others it finds equally probable when unprompted. We evaluate WILT across 4 target models and 8 behaviours, where it beats the baseline auditor in 30 of the 32 settings and overturns the previous model safety rankings. WILT raises average behaviour presence from 51% to 100% when eliciting self-harm encouragement from Qwen3.5-4B, beating every elicitation method we port into the same pipeline at matched compute, without pushing output probability below the baseline's.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLOOM-WILT，一个无需训练成本、仅需访问目标模型下一token分布即可自动探测稀有行为的完整审计流水线。WILT在输入侧通过审计者模型跨轮次学习调整对话策略，在输出侧利用目标模型自身分布自适应重新加权解码，使行为相关生成优先被采样。在4个目标模型、8种行为上，WILT在30/32个设置中击败基线审计者，并推翻此前模型安全排名。
AI.motivation: 已部署的语言模型在日常使用中常常出现测试几乎无法发现的行为，因为部署时的交互量远超任何评估能模拟的量级。自动审计者虽然能低成本、灵活地覆盖任意指定行为，但缺乏优化压力导致采样效率低下。作者旨在解决自动审计者采样效率不足的问题。
AI.method: WILT采用双端策略：(1)输入侧，审计者模型（WILT's auditor）跨轮次迭代调整对话策略，从先前评分的交互中学习；(2)输出侧，WILT利用目标模型在给定诱发提示（elicitation prompt）条件下的自身分布，自适应地重新加权解码，使与行为相关的生成优先于模型在未提示时认为同等概率的其他生成。整个过程无需训练成本，也不需要超越目标模型next-token分布的额外访问权限。
AI.result: 在4个目标模型和8种行为上评估，WILT在30/32个设置中击败基线审计者，且推翻了此前的模型安全排名。具体而言，在从Qwen3.5-4B中诱发自伤鼓励行为时，WILT将平均行为出现率从51%提升到100%，在所有以相同计算量移植到同一流水线的诱发方法中表现最佳，且未将输出概率压低到基线以下。
AI.conclusion: WILT通过结合输入侧的跨轮次策略学习与输出侧的自适应解码重加权，显著提升了自动审计者的采样效率，能够在无需训练成本的条件下高效诱发稀有行为，从而更真实地揭示已部署模型的实际行为风险，甚至改变了对模型安全性的既有排名认知。

title: CapFrame: Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding in 3D Gaussian Scenes via Geometric Pseudo Labels
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic real-time novel view synthesis, yet placing a virtual camera to capture a desired frame remains largely manual. Existing language-guided approaches in 3D scenes mainly focus on object-centric grounding, determining what to observe but rarely controlling how it should appear in a single frame, such as subject orientation or frame layout. To address this limitation, we introduce a new task, Text-Instructed Viewpoint Grounding (TIVG), which aims to identify a 6-DoF camera pose in a 3D Gaussian scene whose rendered frame aligns with a text instruction. To solve this task, we propose CapFrame, a partially differentiable framework that converts language into geometric pseudo labels for camera pose optimization. CapFrame follows a Retrieve-Translate-Refine pipeline: it retrieves relevant views and ranks them through a Question-Evaluation process with MLLMs, translates the instruction into orientation and layout pseudo labels, and refines the camera pose via differentiable optimization with layout and orientation losses in 3DGS. Experiments on 38 real-world scenes with 135 instructions indicate that CapFrame produces viewpoints better aligned with texts than heuristic viewpoint search and adapted trajectory generation baselines, validated by VLM metrics, MLLM judges, and user studies. Code is available at: https://github.com/jirongli/CapFrame

AI.tldr: 本文提出新任务TIVG（文本指令视点定位），旨在3D高斯场景中根据文本指令自动找到6自由度相机位姿。作者提出CapFrame框架，采用"检索-翻译-精炼"流水线，通过MLLM将语言转换为几何伪标签，并在3DGS中通过可微优化得到与文本对齐的视点。在38个真实场景、135条指令上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS在照片级实时新颖视图合成方面表现出色，但放置虚拟相机来捕捉所需画面仍需大量人工操作。已有的语言引导方法主要聚焦于目标级定位（决定看什么），很少控制单一帧中物体如何呈现（如朝向或构图）。需要一种能根据文本指令自动确定相机位姿的方法。
AI.method: 提出CapFrame框架，遵循Retrieve-Translate-Refine流水线：(1) 检索相关视图并通过MLLM的问题-评估过程排序；(2) 将文本指令翻译为朝向和布局伪标签；(3) 在3DGS中通过带布局损失和朝向损失的可微优化精炼相机位姿。该方法部分可微，将语言转换为几何伪标签用于相机位姿优化。
AI.result: 在38个真实场景和135条指令上的实验表明，CapFrame生成的视点比启发式视点搜索和改编轨迹生成基线更符合文本描述，通过VLM指标、MLLM评判和用户研究进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: CapFrame成功实现了文本指令驱动的视点定位，弥补了语言引导3D场景中只关注"看什么"而忽略"如何看"的空白，为3DGS场景的智能相机控制提供了一种有效方案。

title: When Does Bigger Help? A Controlled Study of LLM Scale for Ontology Learning
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, and 5 tables. WOP 2026 workshop at ISWC 2026
summary: The effect of Large Language Model (LLM) scale on ontology learning (OL) performance remains insufficiently characterized. We present a controlled evaluation of 13 models spanning dense and Mixture-of-Experts variants from the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 lineages, together with proprietary GPT release variants, using the OntoLearner retrieval-augmented generation pipeline. All models are evaluated with the same embedding model, retrieval configuration, prompt templates, decoding settings, datasets, and metrics on term typing, taxonomy discovery, and non-taxonomic relationship extraction across four biomedical and materials science and engineering ontologies. Within the dense Qwen3.5 lineage, increasing parameter count primarily improves precision rather than recall, with the largest gains occurring between 9B and 27B parameters. However, the effect of scale is neither monotonic nor uniform across tasks and domains. Dense 27B models outperform substantially larger sparse models on term typing, whereas larger Mixture-of-Experts models achieve the strongest open-weight results on taxonomy discovery. Non-taxonomic relationship extraction remains difficult across model scales, particularly for the Materials Data Science ontology. Performance differences across matched Qwen variants and proprietary GPT releases further indicate that architecture and model lineage can outweigh nominal parameter count. These findings show that model size alone is an insufficient selection criterion for OL and provide empirical guidance for reproducible LLM-assisted ontology engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文对13个LLM模型（涵盖Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6系列的稠密和MoE变体以及专有GPT模型）在基于检索增强生成的OntoLearner流水线上进行了受控评估，考察模型规模对本体学习（OL）性能的影响。结果表明：增大模型参数主要提升精确率而非召回率，规模效应并非单调一致，稠密27B模型在术语类型标注上优于更大的稀疏模型，而更大的MoE模型在分类法发现上表现最佳。模型架构和血缘关系对性能的影响可能超过名义参数量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型规模对本体学习性能的影响尚未得到充分刻画，模型选择缺乏经验性指导，需要系统评估模型规模与本体学习各任务表现之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用受控实验设计，使用OntoLearner检索增强生成流水线，在相同的嵌入模型、检索配置、提示模板、解码设置、数据集和评估指标条件下，对13个模型（Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6稠密与MoE变体、专有GPT变体）在4个生物医学和材料科学与工程本体上评估术语类型标注、分类法发现和非分类关系抽取三项任务。
AI.result: Qwen3.5稠密系列中，参数量增加主要提升精确率而非召回率，最大增益出现在9B到27B之间；规模效应非单调且随任务和领域变化。稠密27B模型在术语类型标注上优于更大的稀疏模型，更大的MoE模型在分类法发现上取得最佳开源权重结果。非分类关系抽取在所有模型规模下都比较困难，尤其在材料数据科学本体上。匹配的Qwen变体和专有GPT版本之间的性能差异表明架构和模型血缘关系可能比名义参数量更重要。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模本身不是本体学习模型选择的充分标准，架构和模型血缘关系等因素可能超越参数量对性能的影响，该研究为可复现的LLM辅助本体工程提供了实证指导。
