title: OntoAligner-Ensemble: Voting-Based Fusion across Heterogeneous Ontology Alignment Techniques
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, accepted for OM-2026 workshop at ISWC 2026
summary: Ontology alignment (OA) has evolved through several methodological paradigms, ranging from lexical and structural aligners to knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models and, more recently, Large Language Model (LLM)-based approaches. Although modern OA frameworks provide unified ecosystems for deploying these heterogeneous aligners, mechanisms for systematically reconciling their complementary and sometimes conflicting predictions remain relatively underexplored. We present OntoAligner-Ensemble, a modular and aligner-agnostic framework that combines candidate correspondences through a configurable two-stage process comprising voting-based fusion strategies followed by post-fusion selection policies. The framework supports any aligner implemented within OntoAligner that produces candidate correspondences, enabling diverse alignment paradigms to be integrated through a unified decision process. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we instantiate the framework using representative lightweight string-aligner, KGE-based, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation aligners powered by both open-weight and API-based LLMs. We evaluate individual aligners and ensemble configurations across eight benchmark tasks from five OAEI tracks spanning biomedical to beyond-equivalence. The results show that ensemble fusion consistently improves the balance between precision and recall and frequently outperforms standalone aligners across diverse domains. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that ensemble composition directly affects the precision-recall trade-off: heterogeneous cross-paradigm ensembles generally improve precision, whereas homogeneous LLM ensembles more often achieve higher overall F1-scores. These findings demonstrate that systematic ensemble learning offers a robust and reproducible strategy for OA while providing practical guidance for selecting ensemble compositions under different alignment scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OntoAligner-Ensemble，一个模块化且与对齐器无关的本体对齐集成框架，通过两阶段过程（投票融合策略+融合后选择策略）系统性地整合来自不同范式（词汇、KGE、LLM）的对齐器预测结果。在8个OAEI基准任务上的实验表明，集成融合能一致改善精确率与召回率的平衡，且异构跨范式集成通常提升精确率，而同质LLM集成更常获得更高的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 本体对齐领域已发展出多种方法论范式（词汇、结构、KGE、LLM），现代OA框架虽能统一部署这些异构对齐器，但如何系统性地调和它们互补甚至冲突的预测结果仍缺乏充分探索。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供系统性集成学习的机制。
AI.method: 提出OntoAligner-Ensemble框架，采用可配置的两阶段流程：(1) 基于投票的融合策略，组合候选对应关系；(2) 融合后的选择策略。框架与具体对齐器无关，支持OntoAligner中任何能产生候选对应关系的对齐器。实验中实例化轻量级字符串对齐器、基于KGE的对齐器以及基于RAG的LLM对齐器（包括开源权重和API型LLM）。
AI.result: 在来自5个OAEI轨道的8个基准任务（涵盖生物医学到超越等价关系的领域）上评估。结果显示：集成融合一致改善精确率与召回率的平衡，且经常优于独立对齐器。异质跨范式集成通常提升精确率，而同质LLM集成更常达到更高的整体F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 系统性集成学习为本体对齐提供了稳健且可复现的策略，并针对不同对齐场景给出了选择集成组合的实用指导。

title: Seeing the Unseen: Camouflaged Object Detection Beyond the Visible Spectrum
summary: Recent advances in camouflaged object detection (COD) have led to substantial progress in challenging low-visibility scenarios, with pioneering studies demonstrating notable success in localizing objects in camouflaged scenes. Despite these achievements, existing approaches predominantly rely on conventional three-channel RGB imagery, thereby constraining the available visual information to a limited spectral range. Multispectral images offer a wide range of information about a scene by capturing fine-grained spectral signatures. Hence, by leveraging multispectral images for COD, we introduce a novel approach to detect camouflaged objects from the corresponding multispectral inputs. In particular, we propose an end-to-end framework, \textbf{\textit{MSFormer}}, that takes a multispectral camouflaged image as input and predicts a binary mask for it. Additionally, we also provide empirical justification for integrating multispectral bands for this complex low-vision task. Our extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, which outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MSFormer，一种基于多光谱图像的端到端伪装目标检测（COD）框架，通过利用多光谱图像中丰富的频谱信息来克服传统RGB图像在低可见性场景中的局限，实验证明其性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有伪装目标检测方法大多依赖传统的三通道RGB图像，限制了可用的视觉信息范围。多光谱图像能捕获精细的光谱特征，提供更丰富的场景信息，因此本文探索利用多光谱图像来提升伪装目标检测的性能。
AI.method: 提出一个名为MSFormer的端到端框架，将多光谱伪装图像作为输入，直接预测对应的二值分割掩码。同时提供经验性论证，说明为何整合多光谱波段有利于这一复杂的低视觉任务。
AI.result: 大量实验表明MSFormer方法有效，性能优于现有的伪装目标检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用多光谱图像进行伪装目标检测是可行的且有效的，为COD领域开辟了新的研究方向，未来可在此基础上进一步探索光谱信息的应用。

title: MCSeg: Pre-training and Fine-tuning Volumetric Pyramid Transformer for Multi-modal Cardiac Image Segmentation
summary: Automatic cardiac image segmentation is pivotal for diagnosing and treating cardiac diseases. In this work, we introduce MCSeg, a volumetric transformer-based network tailored for multi-modal cardiac segmentation. To overcome the architectural mismatch inherent in existing hybrid networks, we propose a novel Scaling Feature Pyramid (SFP). Unlike conventional skip connections, the SFP effectively bridges the single-scale 3D Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder and the multi-scale CNN decoder by transforming the ViT's output into a hierarchical feature pyramid, ensuring that global contextual information is effectively leveraged. For the training paradigm, the ViT encoder first undergoes self-supervised pre-training via masked image modeling. Subsequently, the network is fine-tuned on downstream tasks, during which a regional mutual information (RMI) loss is integrated to improve boundary segmentation accuracy. In experiments, MCSeg consistently outperforms eleven SOTA methods on CT dataset ImageCHD, multi-modal dataset MM-WHS, MRI dataset HVSMR-2.0 and MSD Heart, highlighting the effectiveness of our MCSeg for multi-modal cardiac segmentation tasks. Furthermore, MCSeg's superior performance in few-shot experiment showcases its significant potential in adapting to limited data scenarios. Codes and pre-trained ViT-B weights are open-sourced at https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/OpenMedIA/MCSeg

AI.tldr: MCSeg是一种基于体积Transformer的多模态心脏分割网络，通过提出缩放特征金字塔（SFP）桥接单尺度3D ViT编码器与多尺度CNN解码器，并结合掩码图像建模自监督预训练和区域互信息（RMI）损失来提升边界分割精度，在多个CT/MRI数据集上超越11种SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 心脏图像自动分割对心脏疾病诊断和治疗至关重要，但现有混合网络存在架构不匹配问题——3D ViT编码器输出为单尺度特征，而CNN解码器需要多尺度特征金字塔，导致全局上下文信息无法被有效利用。
AI.method: 1) 提出缩放特征金字塔（SFP），将ViT的单尺度输出转换为层次化特征金字塔，替代传统跳跃连接以适配多尺度CNN解码器；2) ViT编码器先通过掩码图像建模进行自监督预训练；3) 下游微调时集成区域互信息（RMI）损失以提升边界分割精度。
AI.result: MCSeg在CT数据集ImageCHD、多模态数据集MM-WHS、MRI数据集HVSMR-2.0和MSD Heart上均一致优于11种SOTA方法，并在少样本实验中展现出优异性能，证明其在有限数据场景下的适应潜力。
AI.conclusion: MCSeg通过创新的SFP架构有效解决了混合网络中编码器-解码器的尺度不匹配问题，结合自监督预训练和RMI损失，在多种模态的心脏分割任务上取得了领先性能，且代码和预训练权重已开源。

title: PRISM: Predictive Recomposition via Semantic Latent Decomposition for View-invariant Video Representation Learning
summary: Cross-view video representation learning aims to capture viewpoint-invariant action semantics despite substantial appearance changes across egocentric and exocentric videos. However, existing methods encode each video as a unified embedding, where view-invariant and view-variant semantics inevitably entangle under co-occurrences - a failure mode we show persists even in cross-view methods explicitly trained for view-invariance. Our key insight is that a view-invariant feature is truly disentangled when it can be sufficiently recomposed with an arbitrary view-variant feature while preserving their independent semantics. Building on this, we propose PRISM, that decomposes video into view-invariant and view-variant latents and recompose them under language supervision encouraging clean decomposition of the two streams. PRISM achieves state-of-the-art results on EgoExo4D, EgoExoLearn, AE2, even surpassing in-domain models under zero-shot setting. Code is available at https://github.com/litcoderr/prism.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一种跨视角视频表示学习方法，通过将视频分解为视角不变和视角变化两种潜在特征，并在语言监督下重组它们，实现两类语义的干净解耦，在多个基准上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的跨视角视频学习方法将每个视频编码为统一嵌入，导致视角不变与视角变化的语义在共现中不可避免地被纠缠，即便是在明确训练视角不变性的跨视角方法中，这一失败模式依然存在。
AI.method: 核心洞察是：当一个视角不变特征能够与任意视角变化特征充分重组并保持各自独立语义时，才真正实现了解耦。基于此，PRISM将视频分解为视角不变和视角变化两种潜在表示，并在语言监督下进行重组，鼓励两条信息流被干净地分离。
AI.result: PRISM在EgoExo4D、EgoExoLearn、AE2基准上取得最先进结果，甚至在零样本设置下超越了领域内（in-domain）训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过重组验证的解耦策略和语言监督的结合，能够有效解决跨视角视频学习中视角不变与视角变化语义纠缠的问题，证明了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Real-Time Scene-Adaptive Tone Mapping for High-Dynamic Range Object Detection
summary: High-dynamic-range (HDR) images, with their rich tone and detail reproduction, hold significant potential to enhance computer vision systems, particularly in autonomous driving. However, most neural networks for embedded systems are trained on low-dynamic-range (LDR) inputs and suffer substantial performance degradation when handling high-bit-depth HDR images due to the challenges posed by extreme dynamic ranges. In this paper, we propose a novel tone mapping method that not only bridges the gap between HDR RAW inputs and the LDR sRGB requirements of detection networks but also achieves end-to-end optimization with downstream tasks. Instead of relying on the traditional image signal processing (ISP) pipeline, we introduce neural photometric calibration to regularize dynamic ranges and a scaling-invariant local tone mapping model to preserve image details. In addition, our architecture also supports performance transfer finetuning, enabling efficient adaptation from the LDR sRGB images to the HDR RAW images with minimal cost. The proposed method outperforms traditional tone mapping algorithms and advanced AI-ISP methods in challenging automotive HDR scenes. Moreover, our pipeline achieves real-time processing of 4K high-bit-depth HDR inputs on NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向自动驾驶场景的新型色调映射方法，弥合HDR RAW输入与检测网络所需的LDR sRGB之间的差距，实现与下游任务端到端联合优化，并能在嵌入式平台上实时处理4K高比特深度HDR输入。
AI.motivation: HDR图像在自动驾驶中具有巨大潜力，但大多数嵌入式神经网络仅基于LDR图像训练，面对高比特深度HDR图像时因极端动态范围而性能严重退化。传统的ISP管线无法有效桥接HDR输入与LDR检测网络之间的差异。
AI.method: 提出一种新型色调映射方法：1) 引入神经光度校准（neural photometric calibration）来正则化动态范围；2) 采用尺度不变局部色调映射模型（scaling-invariant local tone mapping model）保留图像细节；3) 与下游任务实现端到端联合优化；4) 支持从LDR sRGB图像到HDR RAW图像的性能迁移微调（performance transfer finetuning），以最小代价实现高效适配。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的汽车HDR场景中，所提方法优于传统色调映射算法和先进的AI-ISP方法；在NVIDIA Jetson平台上实现了4K高比特深度HDR输入的实时处理。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了HDR输入与LDR检测网络之间的动态范围鸿沟问题，通过端到端优化和轻量化设计，在保证检测性能的同时满足嵌入式平台的实时性要求，为自动驾驶场景下的HDR图像处理提供了实用解决方案。

title: ImageCAS-X: a dataset and benchmark for coronary artery segmentation and centerline extraction in coronary CT angiography
summary: Accurate segmentation of the coronary vessel lumen is a prerequisite for quantitative assessment of atherosclerotic plaque and perivascular adipose tissue in coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA). Cardiologists rely on semi-automated methods for this task because manual vessel tracing and segmentation are labour-intensive. Although many automated methods have been proposed, their validation remains limited by the lack of large, high-quality publicly available datasets. We provide a new dataset of voxel-wise annotations of the vessel lumen and coronary segments, alongside centerlines, and mesh surfaces for 800 scans from the publicly available ImageCAS dataset. Using this dataset, we benchmark established lumen segmentation methods against inter-observer variability, stratifying performance by disease, image quality, coronary dominance, coronary segment, vessel diameter, and lumen attenuation. These labels allow segmentation accuracy to be described in anatomical and clinical context rather than reported as a single aggregate score. The dataset supports the development and validation of methods for lumen segmentation, plaque and perivascular quantification, and haemodynamic modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于ImageCAS数据集的大规模冠状动脉管腔分割数据集，包含800个扫描的体素级标注、中心线和网格表面，并对现有分割方法进行了基准测试，将性能与观察者间变异进行比较，按疾病、图像质量、冠脉节段等临床因素分层评估。
AI.motivation: 冠脉血管管腔的准确分割是CCTA中动脉粥样硬化斑块和血管周围脂肪组织定量评估的前提。现有自动化方法缺乏大规模高质量公开数据集进行验证，导致验证受限。
AI.method: 基于公开的ImageCAS数据集，提供800个扫描的体素级管腔和冠脉节段标注，附带中心线和网格表面；使用该数据集对既有管腔分割方法进行基准测试，与观察者间变异比较，并按疾病、图像质量、冠脉优势型、冠脉节段、血管直径和管腔衰减等因素分层评估性能。
AI.result: 提供了新的高质量大规模标注数据集，并完成了对现有分割方法的系统性基准测试，能够在解剖学和临床背景下描述分割精度而非仅仅报告单一聚合分数。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集支持管腔分割、斑块和血管周围定量以及血流动力学建模方法的开发和验证，为冠脉分割研究提供了更全面的临床上下文的评估资源。

title: SePArate: Segmenting Patterns from Defects in Wafer Manufacturing Using Weak Supervision
comment: 7 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 63rd ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC 2026)
summary: In semiconductor manufacturing, defect analysis is essential, but manual inspection cannot scale. However, existing automated inspection methods remain insufficient for root-cause analysis and process optimization. To this end, we present SePArate, a weakly supervised wafer defect segmentation method. SePArate enables pixel-level separation of patterns by leveraging only image-level annotations. It consists of a three-phase training: encoder pretraining, knowledge transfer to learn spatial cues, and training on synthetic mixed-defect data for accurate segmentation. Experiments demonstrate that SePArate outperforms the baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SePArate，一种弱监督晶圆缺陷分割方法，仅利用图像级标注实现像素级模式分离，通过三阶段训练（编码器预训练、知识迁移学习空间线索、合成混合缺陷数据训练）提升缺陷分析精度，实验表明优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 半导体制造中的缺陷分析至关重要，但人工检测无法扩展规模，而现有自动化检测方法在根因分析和工艺优化方面仍不够充分。
AI.method: SePArate采用弱监督学习框架，仅需图像级标注即可实现像素级缺陷分割。方法包含三阶段训练流程：第一阶段进行编码器预训练；第二阶段进行知识迁移以学习空间线索；第三阶段在合成混合缺陷数据上进行训练以实现精确分割。
AI.result: 实验证明SePArate在缺陷分割性能上优于各基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SePArate通过弱监督方式有效解决了晶圆缺陷像素级分割问题，为半导体制造的根因分析和工艺优化提供了可行的自动化方案。

title: Whole-Slide Image Analysis under Realistic Few-Shot Annotation Protocols
summary: Automating the analysis of whole-slide images has high clinical value, since characterizing cancers requires examining them in detail. Such analysis increasingly relies on vision-language models that provide patch-level zero-shot predictions. However, these predictions remain noisy and must be refined with a few annotations. A promising paradigm for this refinement is few-shot transduction. Rather than treating each patch independently, these methods leverage the relations between patches, together with a few annotations, to refine all predictions jointly. However, current transductive methods are evaluated under conditions that overlook key properties of whole-slide images: (i) datasets consist of independent patches extracted from multiple slides, ignoring the complex tissue organization; (ii) datasets are mostly balanced, whereas a single whole-slide image exhibits severe class imbalance, with several classes absent; and (iii) annotations are sampled at random, without reflecting how a pathologist annotates a limited number of regions. To align the transduction paradigm to realistic whole-slide settings, we introduce the following contributions. First, we propose SlideCRF, which adapts conditional random fields for whole-slide images by combining spatial and biological cues while accounting for classes that may be absent from a given slide. Second, we provide a set of realistic annotation protocols, based on spatially localized clicks and scribbles, modeling different pathologist interactions, such as the iterative correction of model errors. Across four datasets, we show that SlideCRF outperforms current transductive methods in macro F1, improving over the zero-shot predictions by +24.2% and +37.5% with one and 16 clicks per present class, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SlideCRF，一种针对全切片图像（WSI）的转导式少样本精炼方法。该方法将条件随机场适配于WSI场景，结合空间和生物线索，并处理类别缺失问题。同时提出了基于空间局部化点击和涂抹的逼真注释协议。在四个数据集上，SlideCRF在宏F1指标上显著优于现有转导方法，相比零样本预测提升24.2%和37.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有转导式少样本方法在全切片图像上评估时忽略了三个关键特性：(i)忽略切片间复杂组织结构的独立性；(ii)忽略单张WSI中的严重类别不平衡和类别缺失；(iii)注释采样方式不符合病理学家的真实标注行为。这些缺陷导致现有方法在实际临床场景中表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出SlideCRF，将条件随机场适配到全切片图像：结合空间相邻关系和生物语义线索，同时显式处理单张切片中可能缺失的类别。此外设计了一套基于空间定位点击和scribble的注释协议，模拟病理学家的不同交互行为，包括迭代修正模型错误。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，SlideCRF在宏F1指标上优于现有转导方法。相比零样本预测，在每个现有类别提供1个点击时提升24.2%，提供16个点击时提升37.5%。
AI.conclusion: 将转导范式与真实WSI场景对齐是必要的，SlideCRF通过适配CRF结构并结合真实注释协议，显著提升了全切片图像上的少样本预测精度，验证了空间结构信息和生物线索在病理图像精炼中的价值。

title: ObjectSplat: Improving Mesh Fidelity and Interactivity for 3D Scenes via Object-Level Mesh Splatting
summary: Splatting-based algorithms reconstruct photorealistic, real-time-renderable, and mesh-exportable 3D scenes from regular images, but they represent a scene as a single monolithic field. Therefore, the reconstruction has no object-level structure, leaving it infeasible for downstream editing or interaction. Moreover, regions that are never directly observed in the input scans are contaminated by the surrounding texture and left uncorrected, capping both mesh fidelity and novel-view synthesis. We propose a decompose-before-reconstruct approach: we segment the instances out of every frame, consider the remaining as background and inpaint it, reconstruct each instance and the background independently with mesh splatting, and compose them into a single scene. Our method significantly improves mesh fidelity (over a 5\% gain in F-score) and novel-view synthesis, while supporting object-wise modifiability and interactivity. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"先分解再重建"的方法，将场景中的实例从每帧中分割出来，对背景进行修补，然后分别用网格splatting重建每个实例和背景，最后组合成单一场景。该方法显著提升了网格保真度（F-score提升超5%）和新视角合成质量，并支持物体级别的编辑与交互。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于splatting的3D重建算法虽然能生成逼真、实时可渲染且可导出网格的场景，但将整个场景表示为单一整体场，缺乏物体级别的结构，无法支持下游编辑和交互。此外，输入扫描中从未直接观察到的区域会被周围纹理污染且无法修正，限制了网格保真度和新视角合成质量。
AI.method: 采用"分解-重建"策略：1) 从每一帧中分割出实例；2) 将剩余部分视为背景并进行修补；3) 使用网格splatting独立重建每个实例和背景；4) 将所有部分组合成单一3D场景。
AI.result: 该方法显著提升了网格保真度（F-score提升超过5%）和新视角合成质量，同时支持物体级别的可修改性和交互性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将场景分解为独立物体再分别重建的组合策略，可以有效解决整体重建中缺乏物体结构及未观察区域被污染的问题，提升重建质量并赋予场景可编辑性和交互性。

title: FlowVVTON: Flow-Guided Mask-Free Video Virtual Try-On
summary: Video virtual try-on aims to transfer a target garment onto a moving person across video frames. Current methods rely on human parsing masks or pose keypoints that frequently fail under large motions and occlusions, causing boundary artifacts and temporal inconsistency. A further limitation is that most approaches rely solely on attention mechanisms for temporal modeling, providing no explicit motion supervision. We propose FlowVVTON, a mask-free framework that eliminates parsing mask dependency entirely. Optical flow is used solely as a training-time supervision signal: a flow-warped latent loss, applied across all layers of the generation model, enforces multi-scale temporal consistency by aligning adjacent-frame features under explicit physical motion constraints. A two-stage training strategy establishes mask-free spatial alignment before introducing flow-guided temporal supervision. Experiments on TikTokDress show that FlowVVTON outperforms baselines by substantial margins, particularly in temporal consistency (5.7$\times$ VFID-R improvement over SwiftTry), while requiring no segmentation masks, pose keypoints, or region annotations at any stage.

AI.tldr: 提出FlowVVTON，一种无掩码的视频虚拟试穿框架。它完全消除了解析掩码依赖，仅将光流作为训练时的监督信号，通过跨所有生成层的流扭曲潜在损失实现多尺度时间一致性，并采用两阶段训练策略先进行无掩码空间对齐再引入光流引导的时间监督。
AI.motivation: 现有视频虚拟试穿方法依赖人体解析掩码或姿态关键点，在剧烈运动和遮挡场景下频繁失败，产生边界伪影和时间不一致；且多数方法仅依赖注意力机制进行时间建模，缺乏显式运动监督。
AI.method: 1) 完全去除解析掩码依赖的框架设计；2) 光流仅作为训练时监督信号，通过流扭曲潜在损失在所有生成层施加多尺度时间一致性约束；3) 两阶段训练策略：先建立无掩码空间对齐，再引入光流引导的时间监督。
AI.result: 在TikTokDress数据集上，FlowVVTON显著优于基线方法，特别是在时间一致性方面较SwiftTry实现了5.7倍VFID-R提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了无需分割掩码、姿态关键点或区域标注即可实现高质量的视频虚拟试穿，为消除语义先验依赖提供了可行路径。

title: SeqAlign3DVG: A Sequence-Aligned Benchmark and Voxel Reasoning Framework for 3D Visual Grounding
summary: Image-based 3D visual grounding is critical for embodied agents, yet existing benchmarks suffer from loose text-observation alignment and neglect temporal ordering. We introduce SeqAlign3DVG, a novel benchmark dedicated to temporally ordered and strictly observation-aligned image-based 3D visual grounding. Unlike prior works using order-agnostic views or global point clouds, SeqAlign3DVG ensures all expressions are human-verified and strictly grounded in the provided RGB observations (single frames or ordered observation sequences). It comprises 9,622 single-view and 14,493 sequence samples featuring rich descriptions, complex relations, and multi-instance ambiguities. To tackle this benchmark, we propose a unified voxel-based pipeline featuring Relevance-Ordered Voxel Memory (ROVM) and Progressive Language-Voxel Fusion (PLVF). ROVM dynamically ranks and aggregates multi-view evidence via a conservative memory to mitigate noisy observations, while PLVF performs coarse-to-fine spatial-linguistic reasoning for precise disambiguation. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance under the depth-free protocol, significantly improving localization for targets defined by complex relations and appearance cues.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeqAlign3DVG基准，专注于时间有序且严格观察对齐的图像3D视觉定位，并设计了基于体素的统一框架（ROVM+PLVF），在无深度协议下达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图像3D视觉定位基准存在文本与观察对齐松散的问题，且忽视时序顺序，这限制了具身智能体在真实场景中理解复杂关系和时空信息的能力。
AI.method: 提出统一的体素管线，包含两个关键组件：(1) Relevance-Ordered Voxel Memory (ROVM) 通过保守记忆动态排序和聚合多视角证据以缓解噪声观测；(2) Progressive Language-Voxel Fusion (PLVF) 进行由粗到细的空间-语言推理以精确消解歧义。
AI.result: 构建了包含9,622个单视图和14,493个序列样本的基准，在无深度（depth-free）协议下达到SOTA性能，显著提升了对复杂关系和外观线索目标的定位精度。
AI.conclusion: SeqAlign3DVG通过严格对齐和时间有序的基准设计，以及ROVM+PLVF的体素融合方法，有效推动了图像3D视觉定位在复杂场景中的进展。

title: Federated Multi-Task Learning for Bladder Tumor Segmentation and MIBC Classification Using a Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architecture
summary: Accurate bladder tumor segmentation and assessment of mus- cle invasion from T2-weighted MRI are important for treatment plan- ning, but developing robust models across institutions is challenging be- cause patient data cannot be centrally pooled and imaging characteristics vary across scanners and acquisition protocols. We propose a federated multi-task learning framework for joint bladder tumor segmentation and MIBC/NMIBC classification across four clinical centers. The proposed Swin Hybrid model combines a ResNet-34 branch for local texture and boundary information with a Swin-Tiny Transformer for global anatomi- cal context. A segmentation-guided classification mechanism further uses tumor localization information to support MIBC prediction. We also investigate several augmentation strategies under both centralized and federated training to improve robustness to multi-center variability. Ex- periments on the FedBCa dataset show that the Swin Hybrid provides the best overall balance between segmentation and classification among the evaluated architectures. Under federated training, Geo+Elastic aug- mentation achieved a DSC of 0.8100 and a patient-level AUC of 0.8931, yielding the highest combined score of 0.8474. These results demonstrate that joint segmentation and classification can be effectively performed across multiple institutions using federated training without centralizing patient data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种联邦多任务学习框架，用于联合膀胱肿瘤分割和MIBC/NMIBC分类，在四个临床中心间无需集中患者数据即可协作训练。所提出的Swin Hybrid模型结合ResNet-34和Swin-Tiny Transformer，并通过分割引导的分类机制提升性能。在FedBCa数据集上，联邦训练配合Geo+Elastic增强取得了最佳的综合效果（DSC 0.8100，AUC 0.8931）。
AI.motivation: 膀胱肿瘤的准确分割和肌层浸润评估对治疗计划至关重要，但跨机构的稳健模型开发面临两大挑战：患者数据无法集中汇总（隐私问题），以及不同扫描仪和采集协议导致的成像特征差异。
AI.method: 提出联邦多任务学习框架，包含：(1) Swin Hybrid模型，融合ResNet-34分支（局部纹理和边界信息）与Swin-Tiny Transformer（全局解剖上下文）；(2) 分割引导的分类机制，利用肿瘤定位信息辅助MIBC预测；(3) 在集中式和联邦训练下探索多种数据增强策略以提升对多中心变异的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在FedBCa数据集上，Swin Hybrid在分割和分类之间取得了最佳平衡。联邦训练下Geo+Elastic增强达到DSC 0.8100和患者级AUC 0.8931，综合评分为0.8474。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过联邦训练可以在多个机构间有效进行联合分割和分类，无需集中患者数据，为跨中心医疗AI协作提供了可行方案。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Quantifying Pulmonary Attribution in Anatomy-Guided Chest X-Ray Classification Under Domain Shift
comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Abdullah-229/BeyondAccuracy
summary: Deep-learning models can achieve strong chest X-ray (CXR) classification performance without establishing whether their predictions predominantly rely on pulmonary image content. This study evaluates pulmonary attribution containment as an anatomy-related reliability property distinct from diagnostic performance. We propose DBCA-SegNet-MGAP, a multi-task anatomy-guided CNN-Transformer framework that combines complementary feature representations through bidirectional cross-backbone attention, predicts a soft lung mask, and incorporates this anatomical prior directly into classification through Mask-Guided Adaptive Global Average Pooling (MGAP). Pulmonary attribution containment is quantified using the Anatomical Local Energy Ratio (ALR) and high-intensity cumulative ALR (cALR@0.9). Experiments were repeated across three training seeds using the COVID-19 Radiography Database for four-class internal testing and a locked Shenzhen-to-Montgomery protocol for zero-shot external tuberculosis testing. On COVID-19, the proposed model achieved a weighted F1 of $0.9615 \pm 0.0015$ and macro ROC-AUC of $0.9906 \pm 0.0007$. In an architecture-matched dual-bridge comparison, replacing conventional GAP with MGAP increased ALR from $0.3878 \pm 0.0098$ to $0.7086 \pm 0.0104$ and cALR@0.9 from $0.5265 \pm 0.0101$ to $0.9905 \pm 0.0018$, while weighted F1 remained essentially unchanged ($0.9618 \pm 0.0015$ vs. $0.9615 \pm 0.0015$). Under locked external transfer to Montgomery, ROC-AUC remained $0.9080 \pm 0.0043$ and pulmonary ALR remained $0.6466 \pm 0.0081$, whereas weighted F1 decreased to $0.7528 \pm 0.0080$ and ECE increased to $0.1683 \pm 0.0055$. These findings show that diagnostic discrimination, calibration, and pulmonary attribution containment are distinct model properties and support their joint evaluation under internal testing and external domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DBCA-SegNet-MGAP多任务解剖引导框架，通过双向跨骨干注意力融合CNN-Transformer特征，并利用MGAP将肺掩码先验直接融入分类。实验表明该方法在不损失诊断性能的前提下大幅提升肺部归因占比（ALR从0.39增至0.71），同时证明诊断判别力、校准度和肺部归因包含度是独立模型属性，应在内部测试和外部域偏移下联合评估。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在胸部X光（CXR）分类中表现优异，但现有方法未验证预测是否真正依赖肺部图像内容。作者认为需要建立一个独立于诊断性能的解剖学可靠性属性——肺部归因包含度（pulmonary attribution containment）——以评估模型是否"看对了地方"。
AI.method: 提出DBCA-SegNet-MGAP框架：(1) 多任务解剖引导设计，同时预测肺部软掩码；(2) 双向跨骨干注意力（bidirectional cross-backbone attention）融合CNN与Transformer互补特征；(3) Mask-Guided Adaptive Global Average Pooling（MGAP）将肺掩码作为解剖先验直接融入分类。归因量化采用Anatomical Local Energy Ratio（ALR）和高强度累积ALR（cALR@0.9）。
AI.result: COVID-19数据集上加权F1为0.9615±0.0015，宏ROC-AUC为0.9906±0.0007。架构匹配对比中，MGAP将ALR从0.3878提升至0.7086，cALR@0.9从0.5265提升至0.9905，而加权F1基本不变。零样本外部迁移到Montgomery时，ROC-AUC保持0.9080，肺部ALR保持0.6466，但F1降至0.7528，ECE升至0.1683。
AI.conclusion: 诊断判别力、校准度和肺部归因包含度是三种相互独立且可解耦的模型属性。MGAP能在不牺牲诊断性能的前提下显著增强归因的解剖学合理性，但外部域偏移下三种属性表现各异，支持在内部测试和域外测试中联合评估这些属性。

title: VisER: Visual Evidence and Reliance for Object Hallucination Detection in LVLMs
summary: Object hallucination remains a persistent reliability issue in large vision-language models, where generated object mentions may sound plausible but lack visual grounding. Recent training-free detectors use internal signals such as token likelihood, attention, visual confidence, or image-text similarity to identify hallucinated objects. These signals are useful, but they are often source-confounded. They measure how strongly an object is supported inside the model without distinguishing whether that support comes from object-specific visual evidence or the generated text prefix. In difficult cases, a hallucinated object can still receive high internal support because it fits the scene, is associated with nearby visual cues, or follows naturally from the generated text prefix. We propose VisER, a training-free two-sided metric for object-level hallucination detection. VisER evaluates each generated object mention from two complementary views. Visual Evidence measures whether object-context compatibility is backed by object-specific evidence from image tokens. Visual Reliance measures whether the object is supported more by the image than by the generated prefix. Combining these views gives a more source-aware grounding score, while avoiding additional object-level verification generations. Across multiple LVLMs and benchmarks, VisER improves AUROC and AUPR over a range of baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出VisER，一个训练免费的双视角目标级幻觉检测指标，同时评估视觉证据和视觉依赖，以区分目标支持来源是图像还是文本前缀。
AI.motivation: 现有训练免费的幻觉检测方法使用的内部信号（如token似然、注意力、视觉置信度、图文相似度）存在来源混淆问题：它们无法区分目标获得的高内部支持究竟来自目标特定的视觉证据还是生成的文本前缀，导致在困难情况下（如目标符合场景、与附近视觉线索相关、或自然跟随文本前缀）仍会错误判定。
AI.method: VisER从两个互补视角评估每个生成的物体提及：(1) 视觉证据（Visual Evidence）——衡量物体-上下文兼容性是否有来自图像token的物体特定证据支持；(2) 视觉依赖（Visual Reliance）——衡量物体受图像支持的程度是否大于受生成前缀支持的程度。结合两者得到更来源感知的接地分数，且无需额外的目标级验证生成。
AI.result: 在多个LVLM和基准测试上，VisER相比一系列基线方法在AUROC和AUPR指标上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分目标内部支持的来源（视觉vs文本），VisER能更可靠地检测幻觉目标，解决了现有信号来源混淆的根本问题。

title: Lot Machine: Multimodal Lot Extraction from Auction Catalogs
comment: Accepted at the VISART Workshop (Computer Vision for Art Analysis), ECCV 2026. 19 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material included as an appendix. Code, benchmark data, and prompt templates: https://github.com/mathiaszinnen/auction-lot-extraction
summary: For provenance research and art market studies, auction catalogs are an essential resource to trace specific objects over time and space. While historical auction catalogs follow established domain conventions, their internal formatting remains highly variable, and their large-scale analysis is currently restricted by the lack of machine-readable representations of the auction lots. We propose a pipeline to automatically extract structured lot-level metadata from German Sales, a large database of historical auction and sales catalogs from the 19th and 20th centuries. Using a manually annotated test set of representative catalog pages, we evaluate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under varying prompt strategies and constrained decoding frameworks. To reflect the practical constraints faced by cultural heritage institutions, including budget, compute resources, and data privacy requirements, we benchmark the methods across different deployment modes ranging from commercial providers to locally hosted, quantized models. We find that commercial endpoints establish the performance ceiling, while institutional gateways offer a viable, privacy-preserving alternative. Local deployments remain feasible, but strictly require enforcing the output structure during generation to guarantee a valid JSON format. While varying degrees of human-in-the-loop correction are still necessary, this work demonstrates that a VLM-based pipeline can successfully unlock historical auction catalogs for large-scale automated analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的流水线，用于从德国19-20世纪历史拍卖目录中自动提取结构化的批次级元数据。通过在手动标注的测试集上评估不同提示策略、约束解码框架以及多种部署模式（商业API、机构网关、本地量化模型），发现商业端点性能最佳，机构网关是可行的隐私保护替代方案，本地部署需强制输出结构以保证JSON格式有效。
AI.motivation: 历史拍卖目录是溯源研究和艺术市场研究的重要资源，但其内部格式高度可变，且缺乏机器可读的批次级表示，导致大规模分析受限。文化遗产机构面临预算、计算资源和数据隐私等多重约束，需要一种自动化提取方案。
AI.method: 构建了一个从German Sales数据库自动提取批次级元数据的流水线。使用手动标注的代表性目录页面测试集，在多种提示策略和约束解码框架下评估视觉语言模型（VLMs），并在商业提供商、机构网关和本地量化模型等多种部署模式下进行基准测试。
AI.result: 商业端点达到性能上限；机构网关提供可行且保护隐私的替代方案；本地部署可行但必须在生成过程中强制输出结构以确保有效的JSON格式。所有模式仍需要不同程度的人工参与校正。
AI.conclusion: 基于VLM的流水线能够成功解锁历史拍卖目录，实现大规模自动化分析，为文化遗产机构提供了从商业到本地的多层级部署选择。

title: MEOM: Multi-View Expected-OKS Maximization for Human Pose Triangulation
summary: Conventional algebraic triangulation solves 3D human pose estimation (HPE) from multi-view 2D keypoints. The typical approach, decoding 2D keypoints from predicted heatmaps, is unreliable as heatmaps can be multimodal under occlusion, and collapsing them into single peaks discards their spatial distribution. We seek to use the entire heatmap to estimate 3D poses more accurately, which requires solving two problems: how to robustly fuse heatmaps across views, and how to assess the reliability of heatmaps. For the former, we introduce a novel objective, Multi-viewExpected-OKS Maximization (MEOM), that locates a 3D joint where the views agree in probability mass. For the latter, we adopt highest-density-region (HDR) calibration as a diagnostic of that mass, independently of distance-based metrics. The proposed framework covers two settings, with and without 3D supervision. Without 3D supervision, we optimize 3D poses from pretrained heatmap predictors by maximizing MEOM, achieving comparable performance with state-of-the-art methods that rely on larger backbones, temporal fusion, and simulated 3D data. On ambiguous Human3.6M (H36MA) and occluded CMU Panoptic frames, the advantage is substantial. When 3D labels are available, we train the model end-to-end with a combined MEOM and MSE loss, achieving 19.11 mm absolute MPJPE on Human3.6M outperforming the state-of-the-art volumetric approach on absolute MPJPE at half the inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用完整热图分布进行多视图3D人体姿态估计的新框架。通过引入多视图期望OKS最大化（MEOM）目标函数实现跨视图热图的鲁棒融合，并采用最高密度区域（HDR）校准来评估热图可靠性。该框架无需3D监督即可达到与依赖更大骨干网络和时间融合方法相当的性能，在含3D监督时以一半推理成本达到19.11mm的MPJPE，超越最先进的体积方法。
AI.motivation: 传统代数三角化方法从预测热图中解码2D关键点进行3D姿态估计，但热图在遮挡下可能是多模态的，将其压缩为单一峰值会丢失空间分布信息，导致估计不可靠。因此需要利用完整热图信息来提高3D姿态估计精度。
AI.method: 1) 提出多视图期望OKS最大化（MEOM）目标函数，通过在各视图间定位概率质量一致的3D关节点来实现热图融合。2) 采用最高密度区域（HDR）校准作为热图可靠性的诊断方法，独立于基于距离的度量。3) 框架涵盖两种设置：无3D监督时通过最大化MEOM优化3D姿态；有3D监督时采用MEOM与MSE损失的联合训练进行端到端优化。
AI.result: 在无3D监督设置下，达到与使用更大骨干网络、时间融合和模拟3D数据的最先进方法相当的性能，在模糊的Human3.6M（H36MA）和遮挡的CMU Panoptic帧上优势显著。在有3D监督设置下，在Human3.6M上达到19.11mm的绝对MPJPE，以一半推理成本超越最先进的体积方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用完整热图分布而非单一的峰值解码可以显著提升多视图3D姿态估计的精度和鲁棒性，尤其在遮挡和模糊场景下效果突出，同时保持高效的计算成本。

title: Minerals in the Wild: A Hyperspectral-XRF Dataset for Elemental Composition Estimation
summary: Rapid mineral characterization is essential for applications ranging from mineral exploration to industrial ore processing. To this end, Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) has emerged as a promising sensing modality thanks to its fine spectral resolution, enabling mineral discrimination in both close-range and remote sensing settings. However, the scarcity of publicly available datasets with reliable ground-truth labels hinders the development and evaluation of HSI-based mineral identification methods. We release Minerals in the Wild, a multi-purpose dataset comprising 1,132 rock specimens collected across Europe. For each specimen, we provide an HSI acquisition together with an elemental characterization obtained via an XRF sensor. We define the task of elemental characterization on our dataset and propose a pruning mechanism that removes distant signatures from the USGS dictionary prior to a convex optimization approach for matching HSI pixels with USGS spectral signatures. Finally, we empirically show that our approach outperforms simpler baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个名为 "Minerals in the Wild" 的多用途数据集，包含1132个岩石标本的HSI高光谱图像和XRF元素表征数据，并设计了一种基于USGS光谱字典匹配的矿物识别方法。
AI.motivation: 高光谱成像（HSI）在矿物识别中具有潜力，但缺乏带有可靠标注的公开数据集，阻碍了基于HSI的矿物识别方法的开发与评估。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含1132个欧洲岩石标本的数据集，提供HSI采集和XRF元素表征；2) 定义了元素表征任务；3) 提出一种剪枝机制，在凸优化匹配前从USGS字典中移除距离较远的签名；4) 采用凸优化方法将HSI像素与USGS光谱签名进行匹配。
AI.result: 实验表明所提出的方法在元素表征任务上优于更简单的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集和方法的发布将推动基于HSI的矿物质识别研究，为解决数据稀缺问题提供了有价值的资源。

title: Modality Disentangled Learning for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition: A Primitive Memory Distillation Perspective
comment: 19 Pages, 8 Figures, 13 Tables. Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) systems often suffer from missing modalities in real-world scenarios. Existing methods usually generate, align, or distill missing modalities as a whole, overlooking the heterogeneous nature of the information carried by each modality. Such holistic treatment mixes inferable shared semantics with uncertain modality-specific details, yielding unstable representations and degrading robustness. To address this issue, we propose the Primitive Memory Distillation (PriMD) framework. Unlike existing methods, PriMD takes an intra-modal perspective and focuses on how different types of information within a modality differ in recoverability within each modality. PriMD first disentangles cross-modal shared semantics from modality-specific representations, and then discretizes the latter into learnable semantic primitives to construct modality-specific memory banks. When modalities are missing, PriMD is a teacher-student framework that the student model uses the shared semantics of available modalities as queries to dynamically retrieve primitives. It compensates for missing modality-specific information within a constrained memory space and aligns with the teacher model. Extensive experiments on IEMOCAP, CMU-MOSI, and CMU-MOSEI demonstrate that PriMD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently stronger robustness across a wide range of missing-modality settings, while mitigating the instability caused by holistic feature inference. Our code and project website are available at https://github.com/JiaqiZhang-Sengoku/PriMD and https://jiaqizhang-sengoku.github.io/PriMD/, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出Primitive Memory Distillation (PriMD)框架解决多模态情感识别中模态缺失问题。与现有整体式处理方法不同，PriMD从模态内部视角出发，解耦共享语义与模态特定表示，并将其离散化为可学习的语义基元构建记忆库；模态缺失时，学生模型利用可用模态的共享语义动态检索基元进行补偿，并与教师模型对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有MER方法在模态缺失时将缺失模态作为整体进行生成、对齐或蒸馏，忽视了每个模态内部所携带信息的异质性。这种整体式处理混淆了可推断的共享语义与不确定的模态特定细节，导致表示不稳定并降低鲁棒性。
AI.method: PriMD首先在模态内部将跨模态共享语义与模态特定表示解耦，将后者离散化为可学习的语义基元以构建模态特定记忆库。在模态缺失场景下，采用教师-学生框架，学生模型以可用模态的共享语义作为查询，在受约束的记忆空间中动态检索语义基元来补偿缺失的模态特定信息，并与教师模型对齐。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP、CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI三个基准数据集上，PriMD在广泛的模态缺失设置下均取得最优性能，并展现出一致的强鲁棒性，同时缓解了整体特征推断带来的不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: PriMD通过模态内视角理解信息可恢复性差异，以离散语义基元记忆库和教师-学生动态检索机制有效解决模态缺失问题，在多个基准上达到SOTA并显著提升鲁棒性。

title: Learning Compositional Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Synthetic Curriculum
summary: Despite the impressive progress of recent MLLMs on spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG), existing evaluations and training data focus primarily on simple queries. They largely overlook the compositional queries prevalent in real-world scenarios, where a target must be disambiguated by jointly reasoning about its attributes and relations to other entities. To bridge this gap, we propose Compositional Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (CompSTVG), a task that requires models to process complex textual queries where every intertwined attribute and relational cue is essential for disambiguation. To facilitate this task at scale, we build a synthetic data engine that leverages a spatio-temporal scene graph as a difficulty measure and casts difficulty-controlled query synthesis as a constraint programming problem, producing difficulty-graded data for both evaluation and training. Built on this engine, we introduce STVG-CompBench, a benchmark stratified by explicit difficulty levels that jointly capture temporal complexity and spatial interference. Evaluating 11 representative STVG models on STVG-CompBench reveals that current models perform poorly on compositional queries, exhibiting a sharp performance drop that is typically obscured by overall dataset-level averages. We further construct synthetic training data and propose CurrSTVG, a curriculum reinforcement learning framework that delivers consistent gains, with the largest improvements observed on the most challenging compositional queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出组合时空视频定位（CompSTVG）任务，针对现有MLLM在组合查询（需联合推理属性和关系来消歧目标）上表现不佳的问题。作者构建了合成数据引擎，利用时空场景图作为难度度量，将难度可控的查询合成建模为约束规划问题，生成分层难度数据，并构建了STVG-CompBench基准和CurrSTVG课程强化学习框架，实验显示现有模型在组合查询上性能大幅下降，而CurrSTVG能带来一致提升。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在STVG任务上的评估和训练数据主要基于简单查询，忽略了真实世界中普遍存在的组合查询——这些查询需要通过联合推理目标的属性及其与其他实体的关系来消除歧义，现有模型在此类查询上表现不佳，且整体数据集平均值掩盖了这种性能骤降。
AI.method: 1) 提出CompSTVG任务；2) 构建合成数据引擎，以时空场景图为难度度量，将难度可控的查询合成转化为约束规划问题；3) 基于该引擎构建STVG-CompBench基准，按显式难度级别分层，同时涵盖时间复杂度和空间干扰；4) 提出CurrSTVG课程强化学习框架，利用合成的分级训练数据进行训练。
AI.result: 在STVG-CompBench上评估11个代表性STVG模型，发现现有模型在组合查询上表现差，性能大幅下降（被数据集级平均值掩盖）；CurrSTVG框架带来一致性能提升，在最具挑战性的组合查询上提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频定位模型对组合查询的推理能力严重不足，需要专门的基准和训练方法；通过合成数据引擎和课程强化学习可以显著提升模型在复杂组合查询上的表现。

title: DiffSAC: Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation
summary: Robust estimation is a core computer vision task frequently tackled using sample consensus. However, traditional methods suffer from inefficient sampling as they struggle to identify effective minimum sets before hypothesis evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation (DiffSAC) framework. DiffSAC introduces a diffusion model to learn the distribution of effective minimum sets. It refines the confidence for each data point, indicating whether it belongs to a good minimum set, rather than ranking the data points as in previous work. This significantly reduces the need to process numerous bad sets. To constrain the refinement direction, geometric features are incorporated as conditions within our diffusion model. Consequently, DiffSAC outputs a small number of high-quality minimum sets, enabling identification of the best hypothesis via consensus evaluation. Notably, compared to previous works requiring evaluating over ten thousand hypotheses, DiffSAC achieves state-of-the-art performance with only dozens, significantly boosting efficiency. Extensive experiments across five classic computer vision tasks demonstrate the superiority of DiffSAC. The diffusion model's sampling accelerators enable real-time operation, and DiffSAC can be used as a plug-and-play module to improve existing sample consensus methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffSAC框架，利用扩散模型学习有效最小集合的分布，通过细化每个数据点的置信度来指导鲁棒估计中的采样过程，仅需评估数十个假设即可达到SOTA性能，显著优于传统需要评估上万个假设的方法。
AI.motivation: 传统基于样本共识的鲁棒估计方法面临采样效率低下的问题，难以在假设评估前识别有效的"最小集合"，从而浪费大量计算资源在处理无效集合上。
AI.method: DiffSAC引入扩散模型学习有效最小集合的分布，通过细化每个数据点的置信度（而非简单排序）来判断其是否属于好的最小集合；同时将几何特征作为条件嵌入扩散模型以约束细化方向，最终输出少量高质量的最小集合。
AI.result: 与需要评估上万种假设的先前工作相比，DiffSAC仅需评估数十种假设即可达到SOTA性能，大幅提升效率；在五个经典计算机视觉任务上验证了优越性，且扩散模型采样加速器支持实时运行。
AI.conclusion: DiffSAC是一种高效、可实时运行且即插即用的鲁棒估计采样框架，可作为模块改进现有样本共识方法，为鲁棒估计中的采样问题提供了新的解决思路。

title: OCR-Based Field Extraction for Archaeological Pottery Metadata: The CENTURIA Dataset
summary: Pottery is a primary source for reconstructing the chronological and economic dimensions of past societies. Archaeologists often document ceramic finds through technical drawings and handwritten metadata. This metadata is critical for dating, provenance attribution, and cross-site comparison, but remains inaccessible to computational analysis, requiring manual transcription of every record. We investigate whether state-of-the-art document analysis models can address this task, and introduce CENTURIA, a dataset of 507 pottery records from the Roman site of Carnuntum, providing transcriptions, bounding boxes, and structured field-level labels across seven metadata categories. Benchmarking five OCR models reveals a substantial domain gap: zero-shot transcription error reaches 15-32% SpACER-M, far exceeding rates on printed archival documents, with domain-specific fields recovered in fewer than 3% of cases. LoRA fine-tuning on just 57 samples, reflecting a realistic archival annotation budget, closes this gap, reducing transcription error to below 1.5% and recovering overall field-level accuracy above 87%. Our results show that a small expert-validated fine-tuning set suffices to convert handwritten pottery documentation into structured, searchable metadata ready for archaeological databases.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了CENTURIA数据集，包含罗马Carnuntum遗址507条陶器记录的转录、边界框和七类结构化字段标签。研究发现零样本OCR模型在手工陶器文档上存在巨大领域差距（转录错误15-32%），但仅用57个样本进行LoRA微调即可将错误降至1.5%以下，字段级准确率超87%，证明小规模专家验证微调集足以将手写陶器文档转化为结构化可检索元数据。
AI.motivation: 考古学家通常通过技术图纸和手写元数据记录陶器发现，这些关键元数据（用于断代、产地归因和跨遗址比较）无法直接进行计算分析，需要手动转录每条记录。研究者希望探究最先进的文档分析模型能否解决这一手写文档的自动化转录问题。
AI.method: 构建CENTURIA数据集（来自罗马Carnuntum遗址的507条陶器记录，包含转录、边界框和七类元数据字段的结构化标签），对五个OCR模型进行基准测试，并在57个样本上进行LoRA微调以评估领域适应效果。
AI.result: 零样本转录错误率达15-32%（SpACER-M），远超印刷档案文档的水平，领域特定字段恢复率不足3%。经LoRA微调后，转录错误降至1.5%以下，字段级准确率恢复至87%以上。
AI.conclusion: 少量（57个）专家验证的微调样本足以将手写陶器文档高效转换为结构化、可搜索的元数据，可直接用于考古数据库，弥合了手写考古记录与计算分析之间的鸿沟。

title: RealCAD: Towards Real-World Image-to-CAD Reconstruction under Domain Shift and Parameter Bias
comment: The code and dataset are publicly available. Code: https://github.com/sunyh39/RealCAD. Dataset: https://www.modelscope.cn/datasets/yeguomao/RealCAD
summary: Reconstructing editable Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models from images is essential for downstream modification, manufacturing, and design reuse. However, existing image-to-CAD methods are developed predominantly on synthetic renderings and face two coupled obstacles: a substantial appearance domain gap between synthetic and real images, and a previously overlooked parameter bias in widely used CAD data. We show that the local normalization adopted by DeepCAD concentrates several geometric parameters around a few discrete values while encoding substantial information in a single scale factor. Consequently, a model can achieve deceptively high parameter accuracy by exploiting these frequent values rather than inferring geometry from the input image. In this paper, we propose RealCAD, a unified framework that addresses these limitations at the representation, image, and feature levels. At the representation level, we redistribute scale information to the corresponding geometric parameters, producing less concentrated parameter distributions in a shared scale space. At the image level, geometry-constrained translation converts synthetic renderings toward the real-image domain while conditioning on object contours. At the feature level, a multi-positive contrastive objective aligns representations of the same CAD model across viewpoints and image domains, enabling CAD sequence prediction from each individual view. We further introduce OpenRealCAD, comprising four-view photographs of 392 3D-printed objects paired with ground-truth command sequences. Experiments show that the revised representation substantially reduces the accuracy attainable from parameter-frequency priors, making parameter accuracy a more reliable measure of image-conditioned geometric inference. RealCAD further improves real-domain command and parameter accuracy, while retaining competitive synthetic-domain performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RealCAD框架，解决从图像重建可编辑CAD模型时面临的合成图像与真实图像之间的域差距，以及现有CAD数据中参数偏差两大问题。通过在表示层、图像层和特征层三个层面进行改进，并引入OpenRealCAD真实图像数据集，显著提升了真实域下的CAD重建性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到CAD的方法主要基于合成渲染图开发，面临两个耦合的障碍：(1) 合成与真实图像之间存在显著的外观域差距；(2) 广泛使用的CAD数据中存在被忽视的参数偏差——DeepCAD采用的局部归一化使几何参数集中在少量离散值上，模型可通过利用高频值而非从图像推断几何来获得"欺骗性"的高参数精度。
AI.method: RealCAD在三个层面统一解决上述问题：(1) 表示层面：将尺度信息重新分配到对应的几何参数上，在共享尺度空间中产生更不集中的参数分布；(2) 图像层面：采用几何约束的翻译方法，以物体轮廓为条件将合成渲染图转换为真实图像域；(3) 特征层面：引入多正样本对比学习目标，使同一CAD模型在不同视角和图像域下的表示对齐，支持从单个视角进行CAD序列预测。同时构建了OpenRealCAD数据集，包含392个3D打印物体的四视角照片及对应的真实命令序列。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) 修订后的表示显著降低了利用参数频率先验可获得的高精度，使参数精度成为更可靠的图像条件几何推断衡量指标；(2) RealCAD在真实域的指令和参数精度上均有提升，同时保持了有竞争力的合成域性能。
AI.conclusion: RealCAD通过同时解决表示偏差和域差距问题，在保持合成域性能的同时显著提升了真实图像到CAD的转换能力，为该领域提供了更可靠且实用的解决方案。

title: AQ3D: Adaptive Query Transformer for 3D Instance Segmentation
summary: Transformer-based decoders for 3D instance segmentation typically commit to a fixed number of queries and positional modeling calibrated on the training distribution rather than on the scene at hand. Indoor scans vary widely in spatial extent and object count, so a fixed query set over-initializes small scenes and under-initializes large ones, while learned absolute and relative encodings are bound to the training scenes' extents and can saturate. We present AQ3D, which is designed to handle scenes of various sizes during training and inference. Queries are instantiated at a fixed ratio of the scene's superpoints, forming an overcomplete set whose background rejection is entirely left to the decoder. Positional information is encoded using 3D RoPE over quantized metric coordinates, replacing learned bounded lookup tables of prior decoders. Further, we improve the decoder itself by using attribution-based superpoint pooling, a mask refinement branch, and a cosine classifier for background rejection. Experiments show our method sets a new state-of-the-art on validation and hidden test splits across the datasets ScanNetV2, ScanNet200, and ScanNet++V2 among decoder methods trained without additional data augmentation. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/kenomo/aq3d}{github.com/kenomo/aq3d}.

AI.tldr: AQ3D提出了一种自适应的3D实例分割解码器，通过按场景超点数比例实例化查询、使用3D RoPE编码度量坐标位置信息，以及改进池化、掩码细化分支和余弦分类器，实现了对任意规模和物体数量的室内场景的鲁棒处理，并在ScanNetV2、ScanNet200和ScanNet++V2上达到了新的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的Transformer解码器在3D实例分割中通常使用固定数量的查询和基于训练分布校准的位置编码，这无法适应室内扫描场景在空间范围和物体数量上的巨大差异——小场景被过度初始化，大场景则初始化不足，且学习的绝对/相对位置编码受限于训练场景的范围并可能饱和。
AI.method: 1) 查询实例化：按场景超点数的固定比例生成过完备的查询集，将背景拒绝完全交给解码器处理；2) 位置编码：使用3D RoPE（旋转位置编码）对量化度量坐标进行编码，替代之前的学习型有界查找表；3) 解码器改进：采用基于归因的超点池化、掩码细化分支和用于背景拒绝的余弦分类器。
AI.result: 在ScanNetV2、ScanNet200和ScanNet++V2数据集上，在验证集和隐藏测试集上均达到新的SOTA，超越现有的解码器方法（在无额外数据增强的条件下）。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: AQ3D通过去除对训练分布的先验假设，使解码器能够自适应地处理任意规模和复杂度的场景，验证了过完备查询结合3D RoPE和优化后的解码器组件的有效性，为3D实例分割提供了更具泛化能力的解决方案。

title: Cost-efficient Active Learning for Referring Image Segmentation and Grounding
summary: Collecting natural-language referring expressions along with region annotations, such as masks or boxes, is a major bottleneck in visual grounding (VG), as annotators must write descriptions that distinguish target regions from visually similar ones. We tackle this by formulating active learning (AL) for VG under the realistic setting where only raw images are available without accompanying text. Since ground-truth text is unavailable, sample selection must estimate which images contain ambiguous regions that would require discriminative referring expressions. To address this, we generate auxiliary region-text pairs using foundation models, and introduce Referred Region Ambiguity, a new acquisition function that measures whether the model's confidence collapses onto a single region or disperses across multiple candidates. It allows our method to prioritize images with strong cross-region competition, which are more informative due to their visual ambiguity. We also design a referring-expression annotation interface that helps annotators quickly focus on writing discriminative language with a few clicks. Experiments on RIS and REC benchmarks show that our AL framework consistently outperforms several AL baselines, while a user study shows up to 1.6X faster description labeling of ours.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种视觉定位（VG）任务中的主动学习（AL）框架，解决无文本标注条件下如何选择最值得标注的图像的问题。通过使用基础模型生成辅助区域-文本对，并引入"Referral Region Ambiguity"采集函数来度量模型信心在多个候选区域间的分散程度，从而优先选择视觉歧义性高的图像进行标注。此外还设计了高效的指代表达标注界面，使用户研究显示标注速度提升高达1.6倍。
AI.motivation: 视觉定位任务中收集指代表达式及区域标注（如mask或box）成本极高，因为标注者需要写出能区分目标区域与视觉相似区域的描述。现有的主动学习方法假设有文本可用，但现实场景下只有原始图像，这使得样本选择必须估计哪些图像包含需要具有区分性指代表达的模糊区域，这是一个关键的未解决问题。
AI.method: 1) 利用基础模型生成辅助区域-文本对；2) 提出新的采集函数"Referral Region Ambiguity"，度量模型预测信心是集中在单一区域还是分散在多个候选区域；3) 设计一个指代表达标注界面，帮助标注者通过几次点击快速聚焦于撰写区分性描述。
AI.result: 在REC（指代表达理解）和RIS（指代表达分割）两个基准上，该主动学习框架一致优于多种AL基线；用户研究显示标注描述的速度比现有方法快最多1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了在无文本条件下通过估计区域歧义性来选择样本的有效性，为视觉定位任务中的低成本数据收集提供了新的主动学习范式，同时通过界面设计显著提升了标注效率。

title: Quantum-Grassmann-Plucker Token Mixing for Deep Learning-Based Post-Disaster Damage Assessment
summary: Timely post-disaster building damage assessment from satellite imagery is a critical engineering decision support task, yet it remains constrained by class imbalance, ambiguous intermediate damage states, and limited cross-event transferability. This study presents, to our knowledge, the first application of Grassmann-Plucker (GP) token mixing to computer vision and introduces two extensions for image classification: the Quantum-inspired Grassmann-Plucker (QGP) head and the Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning Grassmann-Plucker (HQML-GP) head. The GP head represents multiscale relationships among image patch tokens by encoding subspaces formed by token pairs with Plucker coordinates; QGP enriches these coordinates with amplitude-derived probability features, whereas HQML-GP incorporates expectation values generated by a simulated quantum circuit into the geometric token representation. Paired pre- and post-event image patches from the xBD tornado dataset were processed using a frozen six-channel Vision Transformer base encoder with 16 x 16-pixel patches. The three GP-based heads were compared with multilayer perceptron and Transformer baselines under identical training, checkpoint selection, and evaluation protocols. Joplin and Moore tornado samples were used for model development and seen-event testing, while Tuscaloosa was reserved for unseen-event evaluation. QGP led both test sets in accuracy and macro-F1: 83.46% and 64.50% for the seen events, and 66.45% and 52.70% for the unseen event. Although HQML-GP obtained the highest validation macro-F1 of 65.63%, it did not surpass QGP on either test set and required substantially more training time per epoch. These results establish GP token mixing as a competitive attention-free alternative to conventional Transformer-based token mixing for paired satellite image damage classification.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将Grassmann-Plucker (GP) token混合方法引入计算机视觉，提出QGP和HQML-GP两种扩展头用于灾后建筑损毁分类。在xBD龙卷风数据集上，QGP头在seen和unseen测试集上均取得最佳准确率和macro-F1，证明了GP token混合是传统Transformer注意力机制的有效替代方案。
AI.motivation: 灾后建筑物损毁评估是关键的工程决策支持任务，但面临类别不平衡、中间损毁状态模糊以及跨事件迁移能力有限等挑战。现有基于注意力的方法在这些场景下表现受限，需要探索新的token混合机制。
AI.method: 提出三种基于Grassmann-Plucker坐标的token混合头：(1) GP头，通过编码patch token对张成的子空间来表示多尺度关系；(2) QGP头，在Plucker坐标上增加振幅派生概率特征；(3) HQML-GP头，将模拟量子电路生成的期望值融入几何token表示。使用冻结的六通道Vision Transformer作为基础编码器，处理16x16像素的配对（灾前/灾后）图像patch。
AI.result: QGP头在两个测试集上均取得最佳性能：seen事件准确率83.46%、macro-F1 64.50%；unseen事件准确率66.45%、macro-F1 52.70%。HQML-GP在验证集上获得最高macro-F1（65.63%），但在测试集上未超越QGP，且每epoch训练时间显著更长。
AI.conclusion: GP token混合被证明是传统Transformer token混合在配对卫星图像损毁分类中的竞争性无注意力替代方案，QGP头综合表现最佳。

title: Fine-Grained Multi Image Object Hallucination Benchmark
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-image scenarios requiring complex reasoning across visual contexts. However, current MLLMs remain fundamentally limited by object hallucination-generating plausible yet factually inconsistent descriptions about objects. Existing benchmarks, designed primarily for single-image settings or providing only high-level multi-image assessments, cannot systematically diagnose how visual complexity and reasoning demands trigger hallucination. To address this gap, we introduce MIOH, a fine-grained multi-image object hallucination benchmark that systematically evaluates object hallucination across four foundational tasks (existence, counting, attribute, position) through three multi-image reasoning patterns (comprehensive, comparative, selective) under three controlled adversarial pressures (visual context scale, perceptual difficulty, contextual bias). Through evaluation of 29 models, we reveal that even state-of-the-art systems like GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro exhibit distinct failure patterns across different reasoning patterns and tasks. Our evaluation reveals that hallucination stems not merely from perceptual failures but from integration-stage limitations when maintaining object representations across multiple images. MIOH provides a controlled framework for analyzing multi-image object hallucination and serves as a critical evaluation tool for developing more reliable multimodal AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIOH，一个细粒度的多图像物体幻觉基准，系统评估MLLM在四种基础任务（存在性、计数、属性、位置）和三种多图像推理模式（综合、比较、选择性）下的物体幻觉，并通过三种对抗性压力进行受控评估。对29个模型的评估揭示，即使GPT-5和Gemini-2.5-Pro等先进系统也呈现不同失败模式，且幻觉不仅源于感知失败，更源于跨图像整合阶段的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在多图像场景中仍受物体幻觉困扰，但现有基准主要针对单图像设置或仅提供多图像高层评估，无法系统诊断视觉复杂度和推理需求如何触发幻觉。
AI.method: 构建MIOH基准，通过4种基础任务×3种推理模式×3种受控对抗压力（视觉上下文规模、感知难度、上下文偏差）的结构化矩阵，对29个MLLM进行系统评估。
AI.result: 即使最先进的模型如GPT-5和Gemini-2.5-Pro也在不同推理模式和任务上表现出明显的失败模式；幻觉主要源于跨图像信息整合阶段的表示维持限制，而非单纯的感知失败。
AI.conclusion: MIOH提供一个受控框架用于分析多图像物体幻觉，可作为开发更可靠多模态AI系统的关键评估工具。

title: APT: Anchor-aligned Perturbations for Tamper Localization in Fully Regenerated Images
summary: Proactive tamper localization embeds an imperceptible signal into an image prior to distribution, enabling pixel-level manipulation detection. Existing methods assume a spliced (SP) setting, where synthesized regions are composited onto the original background, leaving embedded signals intact. However, real-world diffusion-based inpainting operates in a fully regenerated (FR) setting, where the entire image undergoes denoising, disrupting background signals and rendering existing frameworks ineffective. We propose APT, a semi-fragile latent-space perturbation that embeds a dense, vector-wise localization signal. By aligning each spatial feature vector toward a fixed anchor direction, APT localizes tampering via the alignment disparity between synthesized foreground and anchor-aligned background features after inpainting. The proposed hard negative mining loss and noisy perturbation branch further enforce uniform alignment. Experiments on COCO demonstrate that APT achieves an FR IoU of 0.92, outperforming the strongest baseline (WAM, 0.84), while existing methods collapse to near-random performance (AUC 0.5), establishing APT as a practical forensic framework generalizable across tampering types unknown at test time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出APT，一种半脆弱潜在空间扰动方法，用于在完全重建（FR）设置下实现主动篡改定位。与现有假设拼接（SP）设置的方法不同，APT通过在潜在空间嵌入密集的逐向量定位信号，利用合成前景与锚定对齐背景特征之间的对齐差异来定位篡改区域。实验表明APT在COCO上达到0.92的FR IoU，远超最强基线WAM（0.84），而现有方法性能几乎退化到随机水平（AUC 0.5）。
AI.motivation: 现有主动篡改定位方法均假设拼接（SP）设置，即合成区域被拼接到原始背景上，嵌入信号保持完整。但真实世界的扩散修复是完全重建（FR）过程，整个图像都经过去噪处理，会破坏背景嵌入信号，导致现有框架失效。因此需要一种适应FR设置的新方法。
AI.method: APT通过在潜在空间中嵌入密集的逐向量定位信号。核心思想是将每个空间特征向量对齐到固定的锚点方向，经过扩散修复后，通过合成前景与锚定对齐背景特征之间的对齐差异来定位篡改。此外，设计了硬负样本挖掘损失（hard negative mining loss）和带噪扰动分支（noisy perturbation branch）来强制实现均匀对齐。
AI.result: 在COCO数据集上，APT达到0.92的FR IoU，优于最强基线WAM（0.84）；而现有方法在FR设置下性能崩溃至近随机水平（AUC 0.5）。APT对测试时未知的多种篡改类型具有泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: APT建立了一个实用的取证框架，能够在完全重建（FR）设置下有效定位篡改区域，并在测试时未知的篡改类型上保持泛化性，填补了现有方法在该场景下的空白。

title: InfraOcc: An Infrastructure Occupancy Benchmark with Static-to-Dynamic Reasoning
summary: Fixed-viewpoint infrastructure sensors repeatedly observe the same traffic space, making roadside 3D occupancy structurally different from ego-vehicle perception: a near-persistent static scaffold is overlaid with sparse, short-lived dynamic events. Existing occupancy benchmarks and methods, however, are built around moving ego vehicles and neither measure nor exploit this structure, instead treating occupancy as flat one-shot voxel classification. We address this gap from both data and model perspectives. We build InfraOcc, to our knowledge, the first real-world infrastructure-side semantic occupancy benchmark, with dense voxel annotations for 290 multi-modal sequences in a fixed roadside frame, a static-dynamic decoupled annotation pipeline, unified camera-only, LiDAR-only, and multi-modal evaluation, and diagnostics for static and dynamic occupancy. InfraOcc shows that static infrastructure fills 97.3% of occupied voxels and persists across frames, whereas dynamic participants have a median occupied-frame ratio of only 1.8% per location, revealing a structural static-dynamic asymmetry beyond semantic long-tailedness. We further propose ProSD-Occ, which reformulates occupancy as progressive static-to-dynamic evidence reasoning: it explains persistent layout, exposes residual dynamic evidence under static-confidence guidance, and recomposes static, dynamic, and free-space evidence into a unified field. ProSD-Occ ranks first in overall, dynamic, static, and geometric occupancy on every track, e.g., a 23.5% relative camera-only dynamic-mIoU gain over the strongest baseline and 65.87 multi-modal overall mIoU, establishing fixed-viewpoint roadside occupancy as a distinct problem with its own reasoning paradigm. The benchmark and code will be publicly available at https://github.com/yanglei18/InfraOcc

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出面向固定视角路侧基础设施的语义占据栅格基准 InfraOcc，并提出了静态到动态渐进推理模型 ProSD-Occ，揭示路侧占据的静态-动态结构不对称性，并在所有评测指标上取得最优。
AI.motivation: 现有占据栅格基准与方法均围绕移动自车视角构建，将占据视为平坦的一次性体素分类，既未测量也未利用固定视角路侧感知中近持久的静态脚手架与稀疏短暂动态事件并存的结构特性。
AI.method: 构建 InfraOcc 基准：290个多模态序列的密集体素标注、静态-动态解耦标注流程、统一的多模态评测及静态/动态诊断。提出 ProSD-Occ 模型：渐进式静态到动态证据推理，先解释持久布局，再在静态置信度引导下暴露残余动态证据，最后将静态、动态与自由空间证据重组成统一场。
AI.result: 静态基础设施占据97.3%的占据体素且跨帧持久，而动态参与者在每个位置的中位占据帧率仅1.8%，揭示显著的结构性静态-动态不对称。ProSD-Occ在所有赛道（整体、动态、静态、几何占据）均排名第一，例如相机仅动态mIoU相对最强基线提升23.5%，多模态整体mIoU达65.87。
AI.conclusion: 固定视角路侧占据应被视为独立问题，拥有其自身的推理范式（渐进静态到动态证据推理），而非简单套用移动视角的方法。

title: UFPR-PEs: A Brazilian Face Recognition Benchmark with Self-Declared Race/Color Labels
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Graphics, Patterns and Images (SIBGRAPI)
summary: While face recognition systems are widely deployed, ensuring their demographic reliability and robustness under uncontrolled visual conditions remains a critical challenge. To bridge this gap, we present UFPR-PEs, a benchmark for face recognition bias evaluation using public videos of elected Brazilian politicians annotated with official self-declared race/color categories. The dataset adopts the Brazilian census taxonomy, including the parda category, which has no direct equivalent in the U.S.- or Europe-centric schemas commonly used in prior benchmarks. Our benchmark is built from compressed public video and preserves difficult samples so that performance can be analyzed under realistic conditions. We describe the construction pipeline, report dataset statistics, and evaluate face recognition performance across verification and (closed- and open-set) identification settings, including subgroup analysis by race/color and difficulty level. The results show that recognition performance varies substantially with image quality, and that subgroup gaps must be interpreted jointly with visual difficulty rather than in isolation. Overall, UFPR-PEs provides a reproducible and demographically grounded setting for studying face recognition bias under challenging public video conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了UFPR-PEs基准数据集，用于评估人脸识别系统在巴西政治人物公开视频中的种族/肤色偏见，采用巴西人口普查分类体系（包含独特的parda类别），并在真实压缩视频条件下进行验证和识别任务的偏差分析。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸识别系统的种族偏见评估框架多基于美国或欧洲中心化的种族分类体系（如白人、黑人、亚裔等），缺乏对不同区域人口统计分类的适应性，且很少关注不受控视觉条件下的表现。巴西的parda（混血）类别在现有基准中缺乏对应物，导致该人群的偏见评估存在空白。
AI.method: 从巴西政客的公开压缩视频中构建基准数据集，采用官方自我声明的种族/肤色标签（基于巴西人口普查分类），保留困难样本以模拟真实场景。构建完整的数据集流水线，统计数据集特征，并在验证和闭集/开集识别任务中进行性能评估，包括按种族/肤色和难度级别的子组分析。
AI.result: 识别性能随图像质量显著变化；种族/肤色子组差距必须结合视觉难度共同解读，而非孤立看待。不同种族类别在验证和识别任务中表现出差异化的性能分布。
AI.conclusion: UFPR-PEs提供了一个可复现的、基于人口统计学的基准，用于在具有挑战性的公共视频条件下研究人脸识别偏见，弥补了现有基准在种族分类体系和真实场景覆盖上的不足。

title: CANVAS: Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling for Long-Context Text-to-SVG Generation
comment: 30 pages (including supplementary material), 9 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/Louis-YW/CANVAS
summary: Autoregressive large models have recently advanced Text-to-SVG generation from simple icons to complex, long-context graphics, yet standard autoregressive decoding often fails to maintain global consistency across geometry, layout, occlusion, and composition. We introduce CANVAS (Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling), a training-free, render-aware inference framework that combines power-sharpened trajectory likelihood with visual feedback from rendered futures and derives a stroke-wise navigation rule. It effectively estimates each candidate stroke's future value under a limited generation and rendering budget and adaptively allocates samples according to candidate uncertainty, decision influence, and rollout cost. Experiments across multiple autoregressive SVG backbones and complementary benchmarks demonstrate improvements in global consistency, which includes sound geometric relationships, spatial layouts, occlusion ordering, and overall composition, without additional training, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization ability of our framework.

AI.tldr: CANVAS是一个无需训练的推理框架，通过功率锐化的轨迹似然与渲染未来视觉反馈相结合，为自回归文本到SVG生成提供笔划级导航规则，在有限生成和渲染预算下自适应分配样本，提升多笔画SVG的全局一致性（几何关系、空间布局、遮挡顺序和整体构图），无需额外训练即可在多个SVG骨干模型上泛化。
AI.motivation: 自回归大模型在文本到SVG生成上已从简单图标推进到复杂长上下文图形，但标准自回归解码在几何、布局、遮挡和构图方面往往无法保持全局一致性，现有方法缺乏对生成未来状态的视觉反馈机制。
AI.method: 提出CANVAS框架：(1) 结合功率锐化（power-sharpened）的轨迹似然与渲染未来提供的视觉反馈；(2) 推导出笔划级导航规则；(3) 在有限生成和渲染预算下估计每个候选笔划的未来价值；(4) 根据候选不确定性、决策影响力和展开成本自适应分配采样资源。
AI.result: 在多个自回归SVG骨干模型和互补基准上的实验表明，该方法在全局一致性（几何关系、空间布局、遮挡顺序、整体构图）上取得改进，且无需额外训练，证明了框架的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: CANVAS作为训练免费、渲染感知的推理框架，通过视觉反馈与自适应采样分配策略，有效解决了自回归SVG生成中的全局一致性问题，且具有良好的跨模型泛化能力。

title: Can Video World Models Track Unobserved World States?
summary: Video world models are increasingly used as simulators, yet visual fidelity alone does not show that a model maintains the hidden state of the world. We examine this gap with an action-conditioned video Shell Game, a visual analog of $S_5$ state tracking that decouples visual rendering from compositing the hidden state underneath. Bidirectional and autoregressive Transformers, Mamba, and linear attention restricted to nonnegative transition eigenvalues all fit the training horizon of 5 swaps and then fall toward chance on longer swap chains (extrapolation) while still rendering plausible video with additional denoising steps providing no benefit. The pixel-based diffusion target never supervises the unseen hidden state, so the generated frames cannot carry it and the state has to live inside the architecture rather than in the tokens. For a Transformer, that architectural state is only an append-only KV cache, so the model has to re-derive the hidden arrangement from the whole history at every chunk. We find two mechanisms that do extrapolate, and both carry a state across chunks and revise it in place. Linear attention succeeds once its transition eigenvalues may be negative, and TTT with a nonlinear fast weight succeeds by updating the feature map through which it reads its own state. We further examine harder cases in dynamic world exploration tasks, and discuss the broader implications for building stateful video world models.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了视频世界模型中视觉保真度与隐藏状态追踪能力之间的差距。作者提出了一个行动条件化的视频"Shell Game"任务（S5状态追踪的视觉类比），将视觉渲染与隐藏状态组合解耦。研究发现双向和自回归Transformer、Mamba以及受限非负转移特征值的线性注意力都能拟合5次交换的训练范围，但在更长交换链上（外推）表现下降到随机水平，同时仍能生成看似合理的视频。论文发现两种能真正外推的机制：允许负转移特征值的线性注意力和使用非线性快速权重的TTT（Test-Time Training）方法，它们都能跨块携带状态并就地修订。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型主要以视觉保真度为评估标准，但视觉保真度并不能证明模型真正维护了世界的隐藏状态。作者想要揭示这种差距，并探索什么样的架构才能真正进行状态追踪而非仅仅渲染出看似合理的画面。
AI.method: 设计了一个行动条件化的视频Shell Game任务，该任务将视觉渲染与底层隐藏状态组合解耦，作为S5状态追踪的视觉类比。系统性地对比了多种架构（双向和自回归Transformer、Mamba、线性注意力和TTT），通过控制转移特征值的符号约束来研究各架构的外推能力，并分析状态存储位置（KV缓存 vs. 架构内部状态）对泛化的影响。
AI.result: 1) 所有主流架构（Transformer、Mamba、受限线性注意力）都能拟合训练范围的5次交换，但在更长链上外推到随机水平；2) 像素级扩散目标从未监督隐藏状态，因此生成的帧无法携带状态，状态只能存在于架构内部而非token中；3) Transformer的附加-only KV缓存机制迫使模型在每块从整个历史重新推导隐藏排列；4) 两种能外推的机制是允许负特征值的线性注意力和使用非线性快速权重的TTT
AI.conclusion: 视觉世界模型不应仅以视觉渲染质量来评估，必须考虑其状态追踪能力。架构设计中的状态存储和更新机制（而非单纯的注意力机制）是决定外推能力的关键。这项研究为构建有状态的(stateful)视频世界模型提供了重要启示，指出TTT和灵活的线性注意力是更有前景的方向。

title: TUE-Detector: A Tool-Using Expert MLLM-Based Detector for AI-Generated Videos
comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, 28 tables; includes supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/Louis-YW/TUE
summary: AI-generated video detection, which aims to distinguish AI-generated videos from real ones, has recently received increasing research attention. To perform this task reliably, a key challenge lies in accurately identifying subtle-yet-measurable unnatural artifacts. In this work, we address this challenge from a novel perspective of tool-mediated evidence discovery and propose Tool-Using Expert MLLM-based AI-generated Video Detector (TUE-Detector), a novel framework for AI-generated video detection. TUE-Detector trains a general MLLM into a task-tailored tool-using expert detector that learns to invoke suitable tools, collect concrete evidence of unnaturalness, and reason over the evidence for reliable detection. Meanwhile, TUE-Detector further introduces novel designs to equip the expert detector with high-quality and suitable tools. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TUE-Detector，一个基于工具使用专家MLLM的AI生成视频检测框架，通过让模型调用合适的工具收集具体证据并进行推理，实现可靠的AI视频检测。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频检测的关键挑战在于准确识别细微但可测量的不自然伪影，现有方法难以有效发现并利用这些证据。
AI.method: 将通用MLLM训练为任务定制的工具使用专家检测器，学习调用合适的工具、收集不自然性的具体证据，并基于证据进行推理；同时引入新颖设计以配备高质量和合适的工具。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了该框架在AI生成视频检测任务上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 从工具中介的证据发现这一新视角出发，通过工具使用专家MLLM框架成功提升了AI生成视频检测的可靠性。

title: VisLens: Single-Pass Interpretable Visual Search for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with fine-grained Visual Search, the task of locating small or rare objects in high-resolution images. Existing remedies fall into two families: (1) Training-free methods based on attention or confidence scores are accurate but slow, since they require multiple MLLM queries per example. (2) Reinforcement Learning (RL) trained tool-use models are faster at inference but opaque, since their tool calls remain uncontrollable and hard to interpret. To overcome this, we propose \emph{VisLens} (Visual Focus via Logit Lens), a Visual Search method built on the logit lens, which decodes the semantics held in a hidden state by projecting it through the LLM head. VisLens further uses a lightweight tuned-lens that maps early hidden states into the final hidden state space, so visual tokens can be read out from early layers. These tokens are matched to target words in the query to generate a crop of the relevant region, which is fed back in alongside the original image to produce the final answer. The whole process, from decoding to the final answer, completes in a single forward pass without repeated queries. VisLens matches or exceeds prior baselines while delivering a substantial latency advantage, running $8.5$--$9.9\times$ faster than Thyme and up to $22.2\times$ faster than training-free multi-pass search methods.

AI.tldr: VisLens提出了一种基于logit lens的视觉搜索方法，通过将早期隐藏状态投影到头空间解码视觉语义，在单次前向传播中完成细粒度视觉搜索，相比现有方法速度提升8.5-22倍。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在细粒度视觉搜索任务（定位高分辨率图像中的小目标或稀有物体）上表现不佳。现有方法存在两难：基于注意力/置信度的训练无关方法准确但慢（每张图需多次查询），而基于强化学习的工具调用模型推理快但不可解释且难以控制。
AI.method: VisLens采用logit lens机制，将隐藏状态通过LLM头投影解码其中蕴含的语义信息。具体包含：(1) 使用轻量级tuned-lens将早期隐藏状态映射到最终隐藏状态空间，使视觉token可从浅层读出；(2) 将解码出的视觉token与查询中的目标词匹配以生成相关区域的裁剪；(3) 将裁剪区域与原图一起输入模型生成最终答案，整个过程在单次前向传播中完成。
AI.result: VisLens在性能上匹配或超越现有基线方法，同时在延迟上具有显著优势：比Thyme快8.5-9.9倍，比训练无关的多趟搜索方法快高达22.2倍。
AI.conclusion: VisLens通过logit lens在单次前向传播中实现可解释的细粒度视觉搜索，兼顾了准确性和速度，为MLLM视觉搜索提供了一种高效的统一解决方案。

title: RailSyn: Diagnosis-Guided Image Generation for Traceable Data Completion in Railway Foreign Object Detection
summary: Railway foreign object detection (RFOD) is critical to safe railway operation, yet scarce real positive samples incompletely represent task-relevant variations in object scale, intrusion relation, railway scene, illumination, and adverse weather. Existing synthetic augmentation can improve RFOD detection, but its gains lack an explicit account of the task-relevant deficiencies complemented by the generated data. We therefore introduce RailSyn, a diagnosis-guided framework comprising a real-referenced Inspector and a requirement-aligned Generator. The Inspector constructs a variable-radius empirical cover from finite real observations to localize candidate completion regions and profile synthetic pools. The resulting audit identifies railway-context, intrusion-semantic, and visual-consistency requirements; the Generator addresses them through domain adaptation, agent-planned placement and physical contact relations, and plan-consistent conditional refinement. Using the Inspector, we further trace representation-space changes across generation variants; the complete system attains a local-shell occupation of $C_{gap}$ to 13.64%, which measures generated coverage of real-derived completion regions. Extensive experiments show AP50--95 gains of up to 4.9 points and consistent improvements across nine mainstream detectors, demonstrating broad cross-architecture utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RailSyn，一个诊断引导的铁路异物检测（RFOD）合成数据增强框架。它包含一个真实参考的Inspector（用于定位数据缺失区域并剖面化合成数据池）和一个需求对齐的Generator（通过域适应、智能体规划放置和物理接触关系、以及条件精化来补全缺失）。实验表明完整系统将C_gap局部壳覆盖提升至13.64%，在九个主流检测器上AP50-95最高提升4.9点。
AI.motivation: 铁路异物检测（RFOD）对铁路安全至关重要，但真实正样本稀缺，无法完整覆盖目标尺度、入侵关系、场景、光照和恶劣天气等任务相关变化。现有合成数据增强能提升检测性能，但其增益缺乏对生成数据所补全的任务相关缺陷的显式说明，无法解释"补了什么、缺了什么"。
AI.method: 提出RailSyn框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 真实参考的Inspector：从有限真实观测构建可变半径经验覆盖，定位候选补全区域并剖面化合成数据池，识别铁路上下文、入侵语义和视觉一致性三类需求；(2) 需求对齐的Generator：通过域适应、智能体规划放置与物理接触关系、以及计划一致的条件下细化来分别满足上述需求。同时利用Inspector追踪不同生成变体在表示空间中的变化。
AI.result: 完整系统将C_gap的局部壳占据率提升至13.64%（衡量生成数据对真实衍生补全区域的覆盖度）。在9个主流检测器上AP50-95最高提升4.9点，且所有检测器均有一致性改进，展现跨架构泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: RailSyn证明了诊断引导的合成增强方法能显式识别并补全真实数据中的任务相关缺陷，相比盲目数据增强具有更可控且可解释的提升效果。其跨架构一致性的性能提升表明该方法具有广泛适用性，为RFOD等少样本场景下的数据增强提供了一种新型范式。

title: SegWave: Wavelet-Driven Segmentation of Tampered Regions
comment: Accepted at the PFATCV Workshop, ECCV 2026
summary: Verifying image authenticity is increasingly difficult, posing serious risks across journalism, law enforcement, and political domains. Most existing forensic methods rely on high-level visual artifacts and treat frame detection as a simple binary task. To address this, we propose SegWave, a hybrid framework that jointly leverages spatial and frequency-domain cues for image tampering detection. SegWave integrates a transformer-based architecture with the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) to capture localized, multi-scale frequency inconsistencies indicative of manipulation. To further improve localization effectiveness, we introduce an Adaptive Sub-band Attention module (ASA) that dynamically highlights the informative high-frequency wavelet components. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that SegWave consistently outperforms state-of-the-art tampering detection methods in challenging evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SegWave，一种结合空间域与频域线索的混合框架，用于图像篡改检测。该框架集成基于Transformer的架构与离散小波变换（DWT），并引入自适应子带注意力模块（ASA）以动态突出信息丰富的高频小波分量，在多个基准数据集上优于现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 图像伪造检测日益困难，对新闻、执法和政治领域构成严重风险。现有取证方法大多依赖高层视觉伪影，并将伪造区域检测视为简单的二元分类任务，缺乏对局部、多尺度频率不一致性的有效捕捉能力。
AI.method: SegWave是一个混合框架，同时利用空间域和频域线索。它集成基于Transformer的架构与离散小波变换（DWT），用于捕获指示篡改的局部多尺度频率不一致性；同时引入自适应子带注意力模块（ASA），动态突出具有信息量的高频小波分量以提升定位效果。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SegWave在具有挑战性的评估设置下持续优于现有的最先进篡改检测方法。
AI.conclusion: SegWave通过联合利用空间与频域信息，并借助自适应子带注意力机制有效提升了图像篡改检测与定位的准确性，为图像取证领域提供了一种优于现有方案的新框架。

title: RailGen: Improving Railway Intrusion Detection via Agent-Guided Small-Scale Foreign Object Generation
summary: Small-object detection under long-tailed data distributions is a fundamental yet challenging problem in multimedia. Railway Foreign Object Detection (RFOD) epitomizes this challenge with easily confused small intrusions and scarce samples. To address these issues, we propose a generative-augmented detection paradigm that leverages multimodal image generation to enrich the feature space of rare and small objects. We first construct RailGen, a multimodal image generation agent based on large models. Under semantic constraints, RailGen automatically invokes tools to generate railway scenes, calibrate intrusion positions, extract foreign objects, and fuse them into realistic intrusion effects. This process produces high-quality synthetic samples that effectively densify the feature representations of tail classes and complete the small-object feature space. Within this paradigm, we further propose FocalDEIM, a detection framework designed to enhance training with generated data. FocalDEIM improves dense matching with Focal Modulation for better small-object discrimination and adopts Focal Loss to emphasize hard samples, thereby alleviating blurred inter-class boundaries in complex railway scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that RailGen can generate high-quality small-scale foreign objects, reducing the object pixel area by up to 58x and 13.85x on average. Equipped with these challenging samples, our paradigm surpasses the baseline DEIM by 5.6% and 7.5% in mAP@50 and mAP@(50-95), respectively, and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies verify RailGen's feature-space enrichment and FocalDEIM's boundary discrimination. The paradigm provides an effective multimodal generative solution for long-tailed small-object detection in safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多模态图像生成的检测范式，用于解决长尾分布下的铁路异物小目标检测问题。通过构建RailGen多模态图像生成智能体（基于大模型自动生成逼真铁路场景并合成异物），以及FocalDEIM检测框架（融合Focal Modulation和Focal Loss），大幅提升了小目标和稀有类别的检测性能。
AI.motivation: 铁路异物检测（RFOD）面临两个核心挑战：一是小目标物体在复杂场景中易混淆；二是长尾数据分布下稀有类别的样本极度稀缺。传统的检测方法难以同时应对特征空间稀疏和小目标判别困难的问题。
AI.method: 1）构建RailGen：一个基于大模型的多模态图像生成智能体，在语义约束下自动调用工具生成铁路场景、校准异物位置、提取异物并融合为逼真的入侵效果，从而增密尾类特征空间。2）提出FocalDEIM检测框架：采用Focal Modulation改进密集匹配以提升小目标判别能力，并利用Focal Loss强调难样本，缓解复杂铁路场景中的类间边界模糊问题。
AI.result: RailGen生成的小尺度异物将目标像素面积平均缩小13.85倍（最大58倍）。相比基线DEIM，该范式在mAP@50上提升5.6%，在mAP@(50-95)上提升7.5%，并超越现有最先进方法。消融实验验证了RailGen的特征空间增密效果和FocalDEIM的边界判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 该范式为安全关键应用中的长尾小目标检测提供了一种有效的多模态生成式解决方案，证明了生成数据增强与针对性检测框架结合的巨大潜力。

title: CheXGround: Anatomical Region Tokens for Grounded Longitudinal Chest X-ray Interpretation
comment: Accepted for publication at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC2026)
summary: Recent radiology multi-modal language models have made substantial progress in chest X-ray report generation, visual question answering, and temporal reasoning. While longitudinal chest X-ray interpretation compares sequential examinations to describe change, visual grounding aims to connect clinical language with localized image evidence. Although longitudinal modeling and visual grounding have each advanced radiology language models, how localized visual evidence can support longitudinal interpretation remains under-explored. We introduce CheXGround, a region-grounded longitudinal chest X-ray language model that represents paired studies through corresponding anatomical regions. CheXGround extracts anatomical regions from current and prior radiographs, encodes them as temporally enhanced Region-of-Interest (ROI) tokens, and combines them with global temporal image context during generation. To connect these region tokens with clinical text, we propose Temporal Region--Phrase Alignment, a pretraining objective that aligns temporal anatomical representations with localized report phrases. We evaluate CheXGround on single-study and longitudinal Visual Question Answering (VQA), longitudinal findings generation, temporal grounded VQA, and anatomical grounding. Across these tasks, CheXGround improves clinical language quality, temporal reasoning, and localization accuracy over recent baselines. Our results suggest that organizing longitudinal evidence at the anatomical level is a strong representation for grounded radiology language modeling. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/chexground-website

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CheXGround，一个基于区域定位的纵向胸部 X 光语言模型。它通过提取当前和既往影像的解剖区域，编码为时间增强的 ROI token，并结合全局时间影像上下文进行生成。同时提出 Temporal Region-Phrase Alignment 预训练目标，将时间解剖表征与局部报告短语对齐。实验表明该模型在纵向 VQA、发现生成、时间定位 VQA 和解剖定位等任务上均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 虽然纵向建模和视觉定位分别在放射学语言模型中取得了进展，但局部视觉证据如何支持纵向影像解读仍然未被充分探索。现有工作尚未将区域级证据与跨时间序列的影像比较有效结合。
AI.method: 1) 从当前和既往 X 光片中提取解剖区域，编码为时间增强的 ROI token；2) 将区域token与全局时间影像上下文结合进行文本生成；3) 提出 Temporal Region-Phrase Alignment 预训练目标，对齐时间解剖表征与局部报告短语。
AI.result: 在单次研究和纵向 VQA、纵向发现生成、时间定位 VQA 和解剖定位等任务上，CheXGround 相比近期基线在临床语言质量、时间推理和定位准确性方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 在解剖层面组织纵向证据是进行基于定位的放射学语言建模的有效表征方式，为胸部 X 光纵向解读提供了新思路。

title: ChessQueries: Toward Better Chess Board Recognition
summary: Chess board recognition is the task of mapping the image of a chess board to the information of which piece is on which square. So far this task has two established benchmarks: ChessCog is synthetic, and ChessReD comes from smartphone pictures of a single chess board setup. We introduce ChessQueries, a new method combining a ViT encoder with a DETR-style decoder, which outperforms existing methods. On the ChessReD benchmark, we improve the state of the art from 15.3% to 99.2%, and demonstrate strong capabilities on out-of-distribution datasets. Our method saturates the task on the two datasets, with an average 0.01 wrong squares per board (vs. SotA: 3.4 / 0.15 respectively). We also share a new, harder public dataset, parsed from broadcasted top-level chess tournaments. Code, model weights and the SLCC data will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChessQueries方法，结合ViT编码器和DETR风格解码器进行棋盘识别，在ChessReD基准上将SOTA从15.3%大幅提升至99.2%，平均每盘仅0.01个错误方块，并在分布外数据上展现出强大能力，同时发布了更具挑战性的新数据集SLCC（源自顶级棋赛转播）。
